Tin-Hungh caux wuov dauh dorn yiem. Ninh hlo daaih yiem deic-bung-huaang aengx benx dauh buonv orv henv nyei mienh.
Ninh yiem Baalaan Deic-Bung-Huaang. Ninh nyei maa mingh gorngv dauh I^yipv sieqv bun ninh longc zoux auv.
Dongh wuov zanc Aa^mbi^me^lekv Hungh caux jienv ninh nyei domh baeng-bieiv, Fiko, gorngv mbuox Apc^laa^ham, “Maiv gunv meih zoux haaix nyungc, Tin-Hungh caux meih yiem.

Meih oix zuqc yiem naaiv ziangv jienv Tin-Hungh laengz meih maiv zoux haaix nyungc dorngc yie fai yie nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv. Yie hnangv haaix nor zoux longx bun meih, meih yaac oix zuqc hnangv wuov nor zoux longx bun yie caux meih ih zanc yiem jienv naaiv nyei deic-bung.”
Apc^laa^ham gorngv, “Yie ziangv jienv Tin-Hungh laengz aqv.”
Apc^laa^ham yaac guaix Aa^mbi^me^lekv nyei bou mbuo nzaeng wuov norm wuom-kuotv bun Aa^mbi^me^lekv muangx.
Aa^mbi^me^lekv gorngv, “Yie maiv hiuv duqv haaix dauh hnangv naaiv nor zoux. Meih liemh maiv mbuox yie. Ih zanc cingx daaih haiz meih gorngv.”
Apc^laa^ham ziouc dorh ngongh caux ba'gi yungh daaih bun Aa^mbi^me^lekv. Ninh mbuo i dauh yaac liepc jiez ngaengc waac.
Apc^laa^ham yiem ninh nyei ba'gi yungh guanh ginv cuotv siec dauh ba'gi yungh zeic dorn bun nqoi dorngx yiem.
Aa^mbi^me^lekv naaic gaax ninh, “Meih ginv cuotv naaiv deix siec dauh ba'gi yungh zeic dorn ganh ca'lengc an maaih haaix nyungc eix leiz?”
Apc^laa^ham dau, “Yie tov meih longc naaiv deix siec dauh ba'gi yungh zeic dorn weic zoux zorng-zengx bun cing se dongh yie wetv naaiv norm wuom-kuotv.”
Wuov norm dorngx ninh mbuo ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Mbe^e^qe^mbaa, weic zuqc ninh mbuo i dauh yiem wuov lomh nzoih liepc jiez ngaengc waac.
Yiem Mbe^e^qe^mbaa liepc liuz ngaengc waac, Aa^mbi^me^lekv caux ninh nyei domh baeng-bieiv, Fiko, nzuonx Fi^li^saa^die Deic-Bung.
Apc^laa^ham yiem wuov Mbe^e^qe^mbaa zuangx zungh linh liouz ndiangx, aengx yiem wuov gorngv cuotv Ziouv nyei mbuox zaangc Ziouv, dongh Yietc Liuz Yiem nyei Tin-Hungh.
Apc^laa^ham corc yiem wuov Fi^li^saa^die Deic-Bung lauh nyei.
Naaiv deix sic jiex liuz, nqa'haav Tin-Hungh seix Apc^laa^ham. Tin-Hungh gorngv mbuox ninh, “Apc^laa^ham aac.” Apc^laa^ham dau, “Oeix! Yie yiem naaiv oc.”

Tin-Hungh gorngv, “Meih oix zuqc dorh meih nyei dorn, se meih nyei ndoqc dorn, I^sakc, dongh meih hnamv wuov dauh, mingh Mo^li^yaa Deic. Taux wuov yie ziouc mbuox meih oix zuqc faaux haaix norm mbong longc meih nyei dorn zoux buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv.”

Da'nyeic ndorm nziouv nyei, Apc^laa^ham jiez sin daaih buic jienv ninh nyei lorh, dorh i dauh ninh nyei bou caux ninh nyei dorn, I^sakc, mingh. Ninh gaeqv zaangh gaux ninh oix buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv ziouc cuotv jauv mingh Tin-Hungh mbuox ninh mingh wuov norm dorngx.
Taux da'faam hnoi Apc^laa^ham cau hmien mangc buatc wuov norm dorngx mv baac corc go nyei.
Apc^laa^ham gorngv mbuox ninh nyei bou, “Meih mbuo caux lorh yiem naaiv zuov oc. Yie mbuo i dorn-diex oix mingh wuov zaangc Ziouv, nqa'haav yie mbuo aengx nzuonx meih mbuo naaiv.”
Apc^laa^ham zorqv longc buov ziec nyei zaangh bun ninh nyei dorn, I^sakc, nyiex jienv. Ninh ganh dorh douz caux nzuqc. Ninh mbuo i dorn-diex mingh aqv.

I^sakc caux ninh nyei die, Apc^laa^ham, gorngv, “Aa die aah!” Apc^laa^ham dau, “Aa dorn aac, zoux haaix nyungc?” I^sakc gorngv, “Maaih douz, maaih zaangh nyei, mv baac longc buov ziec nyei ba'gi yungh dorn yiem haaix?”
Apc^laa^ham dau, “Aa dorn aac, Tin-Hungh ganh oix liuc leiz ziangx buov ziec nyei ba'gi yungh dorn.” I dorn-diex aengx yangh jienv mingh.

Mingh taux Tin-Hungh mbuox ninh wuov norm dorngx, Apc^laa^ham ceix norm ziec-dorngh daaih, zorqv zaangh zueih yietv zueih nyeic mbaih jienv ziec-dorngh gu'nguaaic. Ninh yaac zorqv ninh nyei dorn, I^sakc, ndoh jienv an jienv ziec-dorngh, zaangh ndui gu'nguaaic.
Ninh ziouc hnyaa buoz zorqv nzuqc weic daix ninh nyei dorn.
Mv baac Ziouv nyei fin-mienh yiem gu'nguaaic lungh kaatv Apc^laa^ham gorngv, “Apc^laa^ham aah! Apc^laa^ham!” Apc^laa^ham dau, “Oeix! Yie yiem naaiv oc.”

Fin-mienh gorngv, “Maiv dungx hoic naaiv dauh dorn. Maiv dungx zoux haaix nyungc bun ninh. Ih zanc yie hiuv duqv meih gamh nziex yaac taaih Tin-Hungh weic zuqc meih maiv nzaeng meih nyei dorn, nyunc zorqv meih nyei ndoqc dorn fungx bun yie.”

Apc^laa^ham cau hmien huin nzuonx mangc nqa'haav nqaang, buatc maaih dauh ba'gi yungh gouv, jorng kuangx jienv lomc-mbiorqc. Ninh ziouc mingh zorqv daaih zoux buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv div ninh nyei dorn.
Wuov norm dorngx Apc^laa^ham tengx cuotv mbuox heuc “ Ziouv ganh oix liuc leiz ziangx.” Ih jaax hnoi mienh corc gorngv, “Yiem Ziouv nyei mbong, Ziouv ganh liuc leiz ziangx bun.”
Ziouv nyei fin-mienh yiem gu'nguaaic lungh aengx heuc da'nyeic nzunc gorngv mbuox Apc^laa^ham,
“ Ziouv gorngv, ‘Yie ziangv jienv yie ganh laengz waac weic zuqc meih hnangv naaiv zoux. Meih maiv nzaeng meih nyei dorn, se meih nyei ndoqc dorn.

Yie ndongc haaix zungv oix ceix fuqv bun meih. Yie oix bun meih nyei zeiv-fun hiaangx jienv faaux ndongc lungh nyei hleix camv yaac ndongc koiv-hlen nyei saa-ziou camv. Meih nyei zeiv-fun yaac oix duqv ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv nyei zingh zoux ninh mbuo nzipc nyei buonc.
Lungh ndiev maanc guoqv mienh weic meih nyei zeiv-fun oix duqv fuqv, weic zuqc meih muangx yie nyei waac.’+”
Apc^laa^ham aengx daaux sin nzuonx taux ninh nyei bou wuov. Ninh mbuo lomh nzoih nzuonx Mbe^e^qe^mbaa. Apc^laa^ham aengx yiem wuov Mbe^e^qe^mbaa.
Naaiv deix sic jiex liuz, nqa'haav maaih mienh daaih mbuox Apc^laa^ham, “Minkaa yaac yungz duqv fu'jueiv bun meih nyei youz, Naa^ho, mi'aqv.
Dorn-hlo heuc Utc. Ninh nyei youz heuc Mbutc, Ke^mu^en (se Aalam nyei die),
Kesetc, Haaso, Bin^ndaatc, Yitv^laapv, caux Mbe^tu^en.”
Mbe^tu^en zoux Le^mbe^kaa nyei die. Minkaa yungz duqv naaiv deix hietc dauh dorn bun Apc^laa^ham nyei youz, Naa^ho.
Aengx maaih Naa^ho nyei auv-dorn, Le^u^maa, yungz duqv Te^mbaa, Gaa^ham, Taa^haatc caux Maa^aa^kaa.
Saalaa ziangh seix zaangc nyei hnyangx-jeiv duqv yietc baeqv nyic ziepc cietv hnyangx.
Ninh guei seix wuov zanc yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic, Ki^li^yaatv Aan^mbaa, se He^mbo^lon Zingh wuov. Saalaa daic mingh, Apc^laa^ham nzauh haic, yiem wuov nyiemv.
Apc^laa^ham yiem geqc ninh nyei auv nyei ga'hlen mingh mbuox Hitv^tai Mienh,
“Yie se ganh fingx mienh daaih caux meih mbuo yiem naaiv. Tov meih mbuo maaic deix yiem naaiv nyei ndau bun yie zoux zouv-gemh zangx yie nyei auv.”
Wuov deix Hitv^tai Mienh dau, “Domh Gorx aac,

meih muangx yie mbuo gorngv oc. Meih yiem yie mbuo mbu'ndongx se yietc dauh zoux hlo nyei mienh. Meih mangc gaax, haaix norm dorngx gauh longx jiex, meih gunv dorh meih nyei auv mingh zangx wuov. Yiem yie mbuo naaiv maiv maaih haaix dauh nzaeng jienv ninh nyei zouv fai laanh jienv maiv bun zangx meih nyei auv.”
Apc^laa^ham ziouc jiez sin baaix wuov norm deic-bung nyei Hitv^tai Mienh.
Ninh gorngv, “Se gorngv meih mbuo maaih hnyouv bun yie zangx yie nyei auv yiem naaiv norm dorngx, tov meih mbuo muangx yie nyei waac aengx tengx yie tov So^haax nyei dorn, E^fo^lon.

Tov ninh maaic Makv^be^laa mbaengx-kuotv bun yie. Naaiv norm mbaengx-kuotv yiem ninh nyei ndeic-daauh. Tov ninh yiem meih mbuo nyei nza'hmien maaic buangv jaax-zinh weic benx yie nyei buonc zoux zouv-gemh.”
Wuov dauh Hitv^tai Mienh, E^fo^lon, yiem ninh ganh nyei mienh mbu'ndongx dorng jienv zueiz zingh gaengh ndaangc nyei Hitv^tai Mienh dau Apc^laa^ham, “Domh Gorx aac,

maiv zuqc aqv. Muangx yie gorngv oc. Yie zorqv wuov nzong ndeic, liemh mbaengx-kuotv, fungx bun meih nzengc. Yiem naaiv dorng jienv yie ganh nyei mienh yie jiu bun meih. Gunv dorh meih nyei auv mingh zangx wuov aqv.”
Mv baac Apc^laa^ham aengx baaix wuov norm deic-bung nyei mienh,

dorng jienv zuangx mienh mbuox E^fo^lon. “Se gorngv meih a'hneiv nor, tov meih muangx yie oc. Yie buangv hnyouv bun wuov nzong ndeic nyei jaax-zinh. Tov meih zipv weic bun yie haih yiem wuov norm dorngx zangx yie nyei auv.”
E^fo^lon dau Apc^laa^ham,

“Domh Gorx aac, muangx yie oc. Naaiv nzong ndeic nyei jaax-zinh zic duqv i joih caux faah ziepc feix lungz nyaanh hnangv. Mv baac meih caux yie maiv zuqc funx haaix nyungc aqv. Gunv zangx meih nyei auv aqv.”

Apc^laa^ham ziouc dingc maaiz aqv. Ei E^fo^lon dorng jienv Hitv^tai Mienh gorngv nyei waac, ninh nziang i joih faah ziepc feix lungz nyaanh, ziux wuov norm deic-bung nyei saeng-eix mienh nziang nyei hniev-daauh, bun E^fo^lon.
E^fo^lon nyei ndeic yiem Makv^be^laa, se yiem Mamle nyei dong bung maengx. Naaiv nzong ndeic caux ndeic gu'nyuoz nyei mbaengx-kuotv, liemh huing nzuonx nyei ndiangx benx nzengc Apc^laa^ham nyei.
Yiem zingh gaengh caangh laangh wuov zanc, wuov deix Hitv^tai Mienh dauh dauh ziouc hiuv duqv wuov nzong ndeic maaic dangx bun Apc^laa^ham mi'aqv.
Apc^laa^ham ziouc dorh ninh nyei auv, Saalaa, mingh zangx yiem Makv^be^laa nyei mbaengx-kuotv, Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, nitv Mamle wuov. (Se nitv He^mbo^lon.)
Wuov nzong ndeic caux ndeic gu'nyuoz nyei mbaengx-kuotv, Hitv^tai Mienh maaic dangx bun Apc^laa^ham longc zoux zouv-gemh.
Apc^laa^ham nyei hnyangx-jeiv hlang, gox haic aqv. Yiem ninh zoux nyei nyungc-nyungc Ziouv yaac ceix fuqv bun ninh.
Apc^laa^ham mbuox ninh hnyangx-jeiv gauh gox jiex wuov dauh bou, dongh tengx ninh goux nzengc jaa-dingh wuov dauh, “Dorh meih nyei buoz daaih an jienv yie nyei camh zuih ga'ndiev maengx.
Yie oix meih ziangv jienv Ziouv, dongh lungh caux ndau nyei Tin-Hungh, laengz waac meih maiv lorz ih zanc yie yiem jienv nyei Kaa^naa^an Mienh mbu'ndongx nyei sieqv zoux yie nyei dorn nyei auv.
Oix zuqc nzuonx yie nyei loz-deic-bung, yie nyei cien-ceqv wuov, tengx yie nyei dorn, I^sakc, gorngv auv.”
Bou naaic gaax, “Se gorngv sieqv maiv kangv gan yie daaih naaiv norm deic-bung ni? Yie oix zuqc fungx meih nyei dorn nzuonx meih cuotv daaih wuov norm deic-bung saah?”
Apc^laa^ham gorngv, “Cin-maanc maiv dungx fungx yie nyei dorn nzuonx wuov norm deic-bung.

Lungh zaangc nyei Tin-Hungh wuov dauh Ziouv, dorh yie leih nqoi yie nyei die nyei biauv, guangc jienv yie cuotv seix nyei deic-bung. Ninh yaac caux yie laengz ngaengc waac. Ninh gorngv, ‘Yie oix zorqv naaiv norm deic-bung bun meih nyei zeiv-fun.’ Ziouv oix paaiv ninh nyei fin-mienh mingh ndaangc, meih ziouc haih duqv dauh wuov norm deic-bung nyei sieqv zoux yie nyei mbuangz.

Se gorngv wuov dauh sieqv maiv laengz caux meih daaih naaiv, yie bun meih laengz liuz nyei ngaengc waac jiex mi'aqv. Mv baac meih cin-maanc maiv dungx dorh yie nyei dorn nzuonx wuov norm deic-bung oc.”
Wuov dauh bou ziouc dorh ninh nyei buoz an jienv ninh nyei ziouv, Apc^laa^ham, nyei camh zuih ga'ndiev maengx houv jienv laengz ei naaiv deix waac zoux.
Wuov dauh bou ziouc dorh jienv ziepc dauh ninh nyei ziouv nyei lorh torh caux ziex nyungc maaih jaax-zinh nyei ga'naaiv cuotv jauv mingh Me^so^bo^de^mie Deic, Naa^ho nyei zingh.
Taux zingh ga'nyiec maengx, ninh bun lorh torh gueic njiec wuom-kuotv hlen. Wuov zanc lungh maanz-hmuangx aqv, doix zuqc m'sieqv dorn cuotv daaih zaangh wuom nyei ziangh hoc.

Wuov dauh bou daux gaux gorngv, “O Ziouv, yie nyei ziouv, Apc^laa^ham, nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov tengx yie ih hnoi zoux duqv ziangx yie laengz nyei waac. Tov meih yaac zoux longx bun yie nyei ziouv, Apc^laa^ham.
Yie souv jienv naaiv wuom-zingv hlen. Yiem naaiv norm zingh nyei sieqv ih zanc cuotv daaih zaangh wuom.

Yie oix caux dauh sieqv gorngv, ‘Tov meih bungx meih naaic nie-ha'louh njiec bun deix wuom yie hopv oc.’ Se gorngv wuov dauh sieqv gorngv, ‘Domh Gorx aac, gunv hopv maah! Yie corc aengx oix bun wuom meih nyei lorh torh hopv’ nor, yie ziouc hiuv duqv meih ginv wuov dauh daaih zoux meih nyei bou, I^sakc, nyei auv aqv. Se gorngv hnangv naaiv nor, yie hiuv duqv meih za'gengh zoux longx bun yie nyei ziouv.”

Daux gaux zungv maiv gaengh setv, maaih dauh sieqv, mbuox heuc Le^mbe^kaa, ndaam jienv nie-ha'louh cuotv daaih. Le^mbe^kaa se Mbe^tu^en nyei sieqv. Le^mbe^kaa nyei gux heuc Minkaa. Minkaa zoux Naa^ho nyei auv. Naa^ho zoux Apc^laa^ham nyei youz.
Naaiv dauh sieqv ziangh duqv nzueic haic yaac maiv gaengh nziaauc jiex dorn. Ninh njiec taux wuom-zingv zaangh wuom buangv ha'louh aengx faaux daaih.
Apc^laa^ham nyei bou ziouc tiux jienv mingh taux sieqv nyei ga'hlen gorngv, “Tov bun deix meih naaic nie-ha'louh nyei wuom yie hopv oc.”
Wuov dauh sieqv gorngv, “Domh Gorx aac, gunv hopv maah!” Sieqv ziouc bungx nie-ha'louh njiec mba'dauh, bouh jienv bun ninh hopv.
Ninh hopv liuz wuom, sieqv aengx gorngv, “Yie corc oix mingh zaangh wuom bun meih nyei lorh torh hopv beuv.”
Ninh ziouc gaanv jienv dox nie-ha'louh nyei wuom an wuov zoh bun lorh torh hopv. Aengx tiux mingh wuom-kuotv wuov zaangh wuom bun ninh nyei dauh dauh lorh torh hopv.
Wuov dauh bou souv jienv wuov maiv ko lo, samx mangc gaax, Ziouv tengx ninh zoux ziangx ziux ninh cuotv daaih zoux nyei gong fai ni?
Lorh torh hopv liuz wuom, wuov dauh bou zorqv norm jiem-mba'zorng-hiun, hniev-daauh yietc zinh faam-buon, aengx zorqv doix jiem nyei jiemh, hniev-daauh faam-lungz, bun wuov dauh sieqv.
Wuov dauh bou naaic, “Tov mbuox yie, meih haaix dauh nyei sieqv? Meih nyei die nyei biauv maaih dorngx bun yie mbuo bueix muonz fai?”
Sieqv dau, “Yie Mbe^tu^en nyei sieqv. Yie nyei ong heuc Naa^ho. Gux heuc Minkaa.”
Ninh aengx gorngv, “Yie mbuo nyei biauv maaih miev maaih mbiauh nqaauv camv nyei uix saeng-kuv. Yaac maaih dorngx bun meih bueix.”
Wuov dauh bou ziouc gueic njiec ndau baaix Ziouv.

Ninh gorngv, “Ceng Ziouv, yie nyei ziouv, Apc^laa^ham, nyei Tin-Hungh. Ziouv maiv guangc laengz jiex nyei ngaengc waac, zungv ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux longx bun yie nyei ziouv. Yie ganh aeqv, Ziouv dorh jauv taux yie nyei ziouv, Apc^laa^ham, nyei cien-ceqv nyei biauv.”
Sieqv tiux jienv nzuonx mingh, zorqv naaiv deix jauv-louc mbuox ninh nyei maa caux biauv zong mienh.
Le^mbe^kaa maaih dauh gorx, mbuox heuc Laa^mbaan. Laa^mbaan gaanv jienv mingh wuov wuom-zingv lorz wuov dauh mienh.

Laa^mbaan buatc liuz ninh nyei muoc dangh jienv nyei mba'zorng-hiun caux buoz-jiemh, yaac haiz ninh gorngv nzengc wuov dauh mienh gorngv nyei waac, ninh ziouc cuotv mingh lorz wuov dauh mienh. Buatc ninh souv jienv lorh torh ga'hlen nitv wuom-zingv.
Laa^mbaan gorngv, “Daaih oc. Meih se Ziouv ceix fuqv nyei mienh. Meih fungc souv jienv ga'nyiec hnangv? Yie zungv liuc leiz biauv yaac liuc leiz ziangx lorh torh yiem nyei dorngx.”

Wuov dauh bou ziouc bieqc biauv mi'aqv. Laa^mbaan bouh lorh torh nyei dorx njiec, aengx zorqv mbiauh nqaauv zorqv miev bun lorh torh nyanc. Ninh lorz wuom bun Apc^laa^ham nyei bou caux gan Apc^laa^ham nyei bou daaih nyei mienh nzaaux zaux.

Mbenc ziangx hnaangx, heuc Apc^laa^ham nyei bou nyanc mv baac ninh gorngv, “Yie maiv gaengh nyanc oc. Zuov yie gorngv nzengc yie daaih nyei jauv-louc cingx nyanc.” Laa^mbaan gorngv, “Maaih haaix nyungc, gunv gorngv maah!”
Wuov dauh bou gorngv, “Yie se Apc^laa^ham nyei bou.

Ziouv za'gengh ceix fuqv yie nyei ziouv, Apc^laa^ham, camv haic, bun ninh butv zoih haic, maaih ngongh, maaih ba'gi yungh, maaih yungh camv, yaac maaih jiem maaih nyaanh, maaih nouh gauv nouh beiz, maaih lorh torh caux lorh.
Yie nyei ziouv nyei auv, Saalaa, hnyangx-jeiv gox nyei ziangh hoc, yungz duqv dauh dorn bun yie nyei ziouv. Yie nyei ziouv maaih nyei nyungc-nyungc ninh jiu bun wuov dauh dorn mi'aqv.
Yie nyei ziouv heuc yie caux ninh laengz jiex ngaengc waac gorngv, ‘Maiv dungx lorz dongh ih zanc yiem jienv naaiv norm Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung nyei sieqv bun yie nyei dorn longc zoux auv.
Oix zuqc nzuonx yie nyei die nyei zouv zaangc mienh caux yie nyei cien-ceqv tengx yie nyei dorn lorz dauh sieqv zoux auv.’+”
“Yie aengx naaic gaax yie nyei ziouv, ‘Se gorngv wuov dauh sieqv maiv kangv gan yie daaih ni?’+”

“Yie nyei ziouv dau, ‘Dongh yie buoqc zaangc nyei Ziouv oix paaiv ninh nyei fin-mienh caux meih mingh tengx meih zoux duqv ziangx ziux meih cuotv jauv zoux nyei gong. Meih oix zuqc lorz dauh yie nyei cien-ceqv nyei sieqv, yie nyei die nyei zouv zaangc mienh, bun yie nyei dorn longc zoux auv.
Meih mingh taux yie nyei cien-ceqv wuov, meih caux yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac ziouc jiex mi'aqv. Maiv gunv ninh mbuo maiv bun sieqv meih, meih caux yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac jiex mi'aqv.’+”
“Ih hnoi yie taux wuov wuom-kuotv hlen, yie daux gaux gorngv, ‘ Ziouv, yie nyei ziouv, Apc^laa^ham, nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov tengx yie zoux ziangx yie cuotv jauv daaih zoux nyei gong.
Ih zanc yie souv jienv naaiv wuom-zingv hlen. Maaih dauh sieqv cuotv daaih zaangh wuom yie oix gorngv, “Tov deix meih nyei nie-ha'louh nyei wuom hopv oc.”

Se gorngv ninh gorngv, “Gunv hopv maah! Yie yaac oix zaangh wuom bun meih nyei lorh torh hopv” nor, yie ziouc hiuv duqv dongh wuov dauh sieqv Ziouv dingc daaih zoux yie nyei ziouv nyei dorn nyei auv.’
“Yie yiem hnyouv daux gaux zungv maiv gaengh setv, Le^mbe^kaa ziouc ndaam jienv nie-ha'louh cuotv daaih. Ninh njiec taux wuom-zingv zaangh wuom, yie ziouc mbuox ninh, ‘Tov deix wuom hopv oc.’

“Ninh ziouc siepv-siepv nyei bungx nie-ha'louh njiec mba'dauh yaac gorngv, ‘Gunv hopv maah! Yie aengx zaangh wuom bun meih nyei lorh torh hopv.’ Yie ziouc hopv. Ninh aengx zaangh wuom bun lorh torh hopv.

“Yie aengx naaic ninh, ‘Meih haaix dauh nyei sieqv?’ “Ninh dau, ‘Yie Mbe^tu^en nyei sieqv. Yie nyei ong heuc Naa^ho. Gux heuc Minkaa.’ “Yie ziouc zorqv mba'zorng-hiun dangh jienv ninh nyei mba'zorng, aengx zorqv jiemh dangh jienv ninh nyei buoz.

Yie yaac gueic njiec baaix Ziouv. Yie ceng Ziouv, yie nyei ziouv, Apc^laa^ham, nyei Tin-Hungh. Ninh dorh yie mingh duqv zuqc jauv, bun yie lorz duqv yie nyei ziouv nyei youz nyei sieqv-fun zoux yie nyei ziouv nyei mbuangz.
Ih zanc se gorngv meih a'hneiv ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux doix yie nyei ziouv nyei waac, tov mbuox yie. Meih maiv oix zoux nor, tov mbuox yie, yie cingx hiuv duqv oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor zoux.”
Laa^mbaan caux Mbe^tu^en dau, “Naaiv deix jauv se yiem Ziouv daaih. Yie mbuo maiv haih caux meih gorngv longx fai ciouv.
Le^mbe^kaa m'daaih yiem naaiv nyei. Gunv dorh ninh mingh zoux meih nyei ziouv nyei mbuangz aqv, hnangv Ziouv Tin-Hungh gorngv nor.”
Apc^laa^ham nyei bou haiz ninh mbuo nyei waac ziouc puoqv njiec ndau baaix Ziouv.
Ninh yaac zorqv longc jiem longc nyaanh daav daaih nyei siou-setv caux lui-houx bun Le^mbe^kaa. Ninh aengx zorqv jaaix nyei zingh nyeic bun sieqv nyei gorx caux maa.

Apc^laa^ham nyei bou bun liuz, ninh caux gan ninh daaih nyei mienh ziouc nyanc hnaangx aqv. Nyanc liuz hopv liuz, ninh mbuo bueix muonz wuov. Da'nyeic ndorm jiez sin daaih, wuov dauh bou gorngv, “Tov bun yie nzuonx yie nyei ziouv wuov oc.”
Sieqv nyei gorx caux ninh nyei maa gorngv, “Tov bun sieqv caux yie mbuo yiem ziepc baav hnoi liuz, nqa'haav mingh duqv nyei.”
Wuov dauh bou gorngv, “Tov meih mbuo maiv dungx zorv yie weic zuqc Ziouv tengx yie zoux sung yie nyei jauv mi'aqv. Tov bun yie nzuonx yie nyei ziouv wuov aqv.”
Ninh mbuo dau, “Wuov nyungc, heuc sieqv daaih naaic gaax ninh hnangv haaix nor gorngv.”
Ninh mbuo ziouc heuc Le^mbe^kaa daaih naaic, “Meih za'gengh oix gan naaiv dauh m'jangc dorn mingh nyei fai?” Sieqv dau, “Mingh nyei.”
Ninh mbuo ziouc bun Le^mbe^kaa caux dorh Le^mbe^kaa hlo daaih wuov dauh bou gan Apc^laa^ham nyei bou mbuo mingh.

Ninh mbuo buang waac Le^mbe^kaa, gorngv mbuox ninh, “Yie mbuo nyei muoc aac, tov bun meih zoux ziex cin ziex waanc mienh nyei maa. Tov bun meih nyei zeiv-fun haih duqv nzipc ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv nyei zingh.”
Le^mbe^kaa caux ninh nyei m'sieqv bou mbuo mbenc nzoih ga'naaiv, geh jienv lorh torh gan jienv Apc^laa^ham nyei bou nzuonx. Wuov dauh bou ziouc cuotv jauv dorh jienv Le^mbe^kaa mingh aqv.
I^sakc yiem Mbe^e Laa^hai Loi Deic-Bung-Huaang nzuonx weic zuqc wuov zanc ninh yiem Negepc.
Maaih hnoi lungh maanz-hmuangx, I^sakc cuotv mingh saau wuov ndeic. Ninh cau hmien buatc guanh lorh torh hungx jienv daaih.
Le^mbe^kaa yaac cau hmien buatc I^sakc ziouc njiec lorh torh daaih

naaic gaax Apc^laa^ham nyei bou, “Yiem wuov ndeic hungx jienv mbuo daaih wuov dauh mienh se haaix dauh?” Wuov dauh bou gorngv, “Ninh zoux yie nyei ziouv.” Le^mbe^kaa ziouc zorqv kuaaiv ndie buang jienv ganh nyei hmien.
Wuov dauh bou ziouc gorngv nzengc ninh nyei jauv-louc bun I^sakc muangx.

I^sakc ziouc dorh jienv Le^mbe^kaa bieqc I^sakc nyei maa, Saalaa, nyei ndopv-liuh. Le^mbe^kaa ziouc benx I^sakc nyei auv mi'aqv. I^sakc yaac hnamv haic ninh. I^sakc ziouc duqv auv daaih tengx jaiv ninh nyei maa daic mingh nyei you-nzauh.
Apc^laa^ham aengx longc dauh auv, mbuox heuc Ke^tu^laa.
Ke^tu^laa yungz duqv camv-dauh dorn bun ninh. Maaih Simx^laan, Yokv^saan, Me^ndaan, Mi^ndien, Itc^mbaakc caux Quwaa.
Yokv^saan nyei dorn nyei mbuox heuc Qe^mbaa caux Nde^ndaan. Nde^ndaan nyei dorn bun njiec benx Atc^su^lim, Le^tu^sim caux Le^um^mim Mienh.
Mi^ndien nyei dorn heuc E^faa, Efe, Haanokv, Aa^mbi^ndaa caux En^ndaa^aa. Naaiv deix yietc zungv zoux Ke^tu^laa nyei zeiv-fun.
Apc^laa^ham jiu ninh nyei jaa-dingh yietc zungv ga'naaiv bun ninh nyei dorn, I^sakc, nzipc nzengc.
Mv baac Apc^laa^ham maiv gaengh guei seix wuov zanc ninh bun zingh nyeic ninh nyei auv-dorn nyei dorn mbuo. Nqa'haav ziouc heuc ninh mbuo leih nqoi I^sakc mingh yiem dong bung maengx nyei deic-bung,
Apc^laa^ham nyei hnyangx-jeiv ziangh duqv yietc baeqv cietv ziepc hmz hnyangx.
Ninh ziangh duqv siouc nyuonh ndaauv, benx mienh gox mienh ziouc dangx qiex, guei seix mi'aqv.
Ninh nyei dorn, I^sakc caux I^saa^maa^en, dorh ninh mingh zangx nitv Mamle wuov norm Makv^be^laa mbaengx-kuotv. Naaiv norm mbaengx-kuotv yiem Hitv^tai Mienh, So^haax nyei dorn, E^fo^lon, nyei ndeic.
Se Apc^laa^ham tengx Hitv^tai Mienh maaiz nyei ndeic. Apc^laa^ham caux ninh nyei auv, Saalaa, ziouc zangx jienv wuov aqv.
Apc^laa^ham guei seix liuz, Tin-Hungh ceix fuqv bun ninh nyei dorn, I^sakc. I^sakc yiem nitv Mbe^e Laa^hai Loi.
Ih zanc gorngv Apc^laa^ham nyei dorn, I^saa^maa^en, nyei zeiv-fun, dongh Saalaa nyei nouh beiz, I^yipv Mienh, Haagaa, yungz bun Apc^laa^ham wuov dauh dorn nyei zeiv-fun.
Yiem naaiv mingh gorngv I^saa^maa^en nyei dorn nyei mbuox zueih hlo taux faix. Dorn-hlo heuc Ne^mbaa^yotv. Aengx maaih Ke^ndaa, Atc^mbe^en, Mipv^samx,
Mitv^maa, Ndumaa, Matv^saa,
Haa^ndatc, Temaa, Yetu, Naafitv, caux Ke^nde^maa.
Naaiv se I^saa^maa^en nyei dorn nyei mbuox. Ninh bun njiec zoux ziepc nyeic fingx nyei bieiv zeiv. Ninh mbuo liepc nyei laangz caux corng ndopv-liuh nyei dorngx gan ninh mbuo ganh nyei mbuox heuc.
I^saa^maa^en nyei hnyangx-jeiv ziangh duqv yietc baeqv faah ziepc cietv hnyangx, ninh dangx qiex, guei seix mi'aqv.

I^saa^maa^en nyei zeiv-fun mbuo yiem Haa^wi^laa caux Suwaa mbu'ndongx, yaac yiem nitv I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei gapv-jaaix, mingh Atc^si^lie Deic-Bung wuov diuh jauv. Ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun maiv caux Apc^laa^ham nyei ganh deix zeiv-fun yiem.
Yiem naaiv mingh gorngv Apc^laa^ham nyei dorn, I^sakc, nyei jauv-louc. Apc^laa^ham zoux I^sakc nyei die.

I^sakc longc Le^mbe^kaa zoux auv wuov zanc ninh duqv feix ziepc hnyangx. Le^mbe^kaa zoux Mbe^tu^en nyei sieqv. Mbe^tu^en se Aalam Mienh, yiem Batc^ndaan Aalam. Le^mbe^kaa yaac zoux Aalam Mienh, Laa^mbaan nyei muoc.
Le^mbe^kaa maiv maaih fu'jueiv, I^sakc ziouc weic ninh nyei auv daux gaux tov Ziouv bun ninh nyei auv maaih fu'jueiv. Ziouv ei I^sakc tov nyei waac zoux, Le^mbe^kaa ziouc maaih gu'nguaaz aqv.
Maaih sung-gu'nguaaz. Gu'nguaaz yiem maa nyei ga'sie borngz jaax. Le^mbe^kaa gorngv, “Yie weic haaix diuc ndongc naaiv kouv?” Ninh ziouc mingh naaic Ziouv.

Ziouv gorngv mbuox ninh, “Maaih i fingx mienh yiem meih nyei ga'sie gu'nyuoz. Meih yungz cuotv naaiv deix i fingx, yietc fingx caux yietc fingx oix bun nqoi. Naaiv fingx oix gauh henv wuov fingx. Gorx yaac oix zuqc fu-sux youz.”
Taux yungz nyei ziangh hoc ninh ziouc yungz duqv sung-gu'nguaaz-dorn.
Yungz cuotv ndaangc wuov dauh, sin siqv nyei, ziangh sin cuotv biei suqv-suqv wuov, hnangv maaih biei nyei ndopv-lui nor. Ninh mbuo ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Esaau.

Nqa'haav yungz wuov dauh nanv jienv ninh nyei gorx, Esaau, nyei zaux-nqo cuotv. Ninh mbuo ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Yaakopv. Le^mbe^kaa yungz naaiv deix i dauh dorn wuov zanc, I^sakc duqv luoqc ziepc hnyangx.

Naaiv deix i dauh dorn hlo daaih. Esaau zoux dauh buonv orv henv haic nyei mienh. Haaix zanc yaac oix mingh gemh buonv orv. Yaakopv aeqv, waac zoqc, hnyouv ndo nyei mienh. Ninh oix yiem biauv gauh camv.
I^sakc gauh hnamv Esaau, weic zuqc ninh duqv nyanc Esaau buonv daaih nyei orv. Mv baac Le^mbe^kaa gauh hnamv Yaakopv.
Maaih hnoi nor, Yaakopv wuonh jienv dopc siqv, Esaau mingh gemh nzuonx daaih, hnyouv za'gengh! sie haic.
Ninh gorngv mbuox Yaakopv, “Yie hnyouv sie, oix daic haic aqv. Bun deix wuov nyungc ga'naaiv-siqv yie naqv gaax.” (Weic naaiv mienh cuotv mbuox heuc ninh zoux E^ndom.)
Yaakopv gorngv, “Maaic meih zoux dorn-hlo duqv sung-gouv nyei leiz bun yie ndaangc maah!”
Esaau dau, “Mangc maah! Yie oix daic haic aqv. Zoux gorx duqv sung-gouv nyei leiz weic yie maaih haaix nyungc maaih lamh longc?”
Yaakopv gorngv, “Mv baac meih oix zuqc houv maaic bun yie ndaangc.” Esaau houv liuz ziouc maaic ninh zoux dorn-hlo duqv sung-gouv nyei leiz bun Yaakopv mi'aqv.
Yaakopv ziouc zorqv deix njuov caux dopc bun Esaau nyanc. Nyanc liuz hopv liuz, Esaau ziouc jiez sin mingh mi'aqv. Maiv korv-fiqv ninh zoux dorn-hlo duqv sung-gouv nyei leiz.

Yiem Apc^laa^ham nyei seix zeiv, naaiv norm deic-bung buangh zuqc yietc nzunc domh huaang domh ngorc. Taux I^sakc nyei seix zeiv aengx buangh nzunc. I^sakc ziouc mingh taux Ge^laa^aa Zingh, Fi^li^saa^die Mienh nyei hungh, Aa^mbi^me^lekv wuov.
Ziouv hinc cuotv gorngv mbuox I^sakc, “Maiv dungx mingh yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung. Oix zuqc yiem dongh yie oix mbuox meih yiem nyei deic-bung.

Oix zuqc yiem naaiv norm deic-bung, yie ziouc caux meih yiem yaac ceix fuqv bun meih, weic zuqc yie oix zorqv naaiv deix yietc zungv deic-bung bun meih caux meih nyei zeiv-fun yietc liuz yiem. Yie oix ei jienv yie caux meih nyei die, Apc^laa^ham, houv jiex ngaengc waac zoux ziangx.

Yie oix bun meih nyei zeiv-fun hiaangx daaih ndongc gu'nguaaic lungh nyei hleix camv, yaac zorqv naaiv deix yietc zungv deic-bung bun ninh mbuo. Lungh ndiev maanc guoqv mienh yaac oix weic meih nyei zeiv-fun duqv fuqv,
weic zuqc Apc^laa^ham muangx yie nyei waac yaac ei jienv yie paaiv nyei jauv, caux yie nyei leiz-latc, yie nyei lingc caux leiz.”
I^sakc ziouc yiem jienv Ge^laa^aa Zingh.

Wuov norm dorngx nyei mienh naaic taux ninh nyei auv. I^sakc gorngv Le^mbe^kaa zoux ninh nyei muoc, gamh nziex maiv gorngv Le^mbe^kaa zoux ninh nyei auv. Ninh yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Nziex yiem naaiv nyei mienh haih laaix Le^mbe^kaa daix yie mv bei, weic zuqc Le^mbe^kaa ziangh duqv nzueic haic.”
I^sakc yiem wuov lauh aqv. Maaih hnoi nor, Aa^mbi^me^lekv Hungh yiem hungh dinc mangc cuotv fong muonh, buatc I^sakc caux Le^mbe^kaa qam jienv jaax.

Aa^mbi^me^lekv heuc I^sakc daaih ziouc gorngv, “Ninh za'gengh meih nyei auv niaa. Meih weic haaix diuc gorngv ninh zoux meih nyei muoc?” I^sakc dau, “Weic zuqc yie nzauh heix laaix ninh mienh oix daix yie mv bei.”
Aa^mbi^me^lekv gorngv, “Meih fungc hnangv naaiv nor zoux bun yie mbuo? Se gorngv maaih dauh yie nyei baeqc fingx caux meih nyei auv bueix nor, se meih ganh dorh zuiz daaih hoic yie mbuo.”
Aa^mbi^me^lekv ziouc hatc ninh nyei baeqc fingx, “Haaix dauh zoux haaix nyungc bun naaiv dauh mienh fai ninh nyei auv, wuov dauh oix zuqc daix daic.”
I^sakc yiem wuov norm deic-bung zuangx ga'naaiv. Wuov hnyangx ninh zuangx yietc gouv siou duqv yietc baeqv gouv weic zuqc Ziouv ceix fuqv bun ninh.
Ninh gunv zoux gunv benx jienv faaux taux za'gengh zoux domh butv-zoih mienh.
Ninh maaih ngongh, maaih ba'gi yungh, maaih yungh camv. Bou yaac maaih camv. Fi^li^saa^die Mienh ziouc mueic jieqv haic.
Ninh mbuo ziouc wetv nie dinh ndipc dongh zinh ndaangc yiem I^sakc nyei die, Apc^laa^ham, nyei seix zeiv wuov zanc ninh nyei bou wetv daaih nyei wuom-kuotv.
Aa^mbi^me^lekv gorngv mbuox I^sakc, “Meih oix zuqc suiv nqoi yie mbuo aqv, weic zuqc meih ih zanc gauh henv yie mbuo.”
I^sakc ziouc suiv mingh corng ndopv-liuh yiem Ge^laa^aa Horngz.

Ninh aengx wetv nzunc dongh yiem ninh nyei die, Apc^laa^ham, nyei seix zeiv wetv daaih nyei wuom-kuotv, weic zuqc Apc^laa^ham guei seix liuz, nqa'haav Fi^li^saa^die Mienh dinh ndipc nzengc mi'aqv. I^sakc yaac cuotv wuov deix wuom-kuotv nyei mbuox ziux zinh ndaangc ninh nyei die cuotv nyei mbuox.
I^sakc nyei bou aengx wetv norm wuom-kuotv yiem wuov horngz. Wetv cuotv zingv wuom daaih aqv.

Ge^laa^aa Zingh nyei yungz saeng-kuv nyei bou daaih caux I^sakc nyei yungz saeng-kuv nyei bou nzaeng. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Naaiv norm wuom-kuotv se yie mbuo nyei.” I^sakc ziouc cuotv wuov norm wuom-kuotv nyei mbuox heuc E^sekc, weic zuqc ninh mbuo daaih caux ninh nzaeng.
I^sakc nyei bou aengx wetv duqv norm wuom-kuotv. Mienh aengx daaih nzaeng. I^sakc ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Sitc^naa.

I^sakc ziouc leih nqoi wuov norm dorngx aengx ganh wetv norm wuom-kuotv. Naaiv nzunc maiv maaih haaix dauh nzaeng aqv. Ninh ziouc cuotv wuov norm wuom-kuotv nyei mbuox heuc Le^hox^mbotc. Ninh gorngv, “Ih zanc Ziouv bun mbuo maaih dorngx yiem. Mbuo yiem naaiv norm deic-bung haih jaa duqv longx jienv mingh aqv.”
I^sakc aengx suiv mingh yiem Mbe^e^qe^mbaa Zingh.

Wuov muonz Ziouv hinc cuotv mbuox ninh, “Yie se meih nyei die, Apc^laa^ham, nyei Tin-Hungh. Maiv dungx gamh nziex oc. Yie caux meih yiem yaac weic yie nyei bou, Apc^laa^ham, oix ceix fuqv bun meih yaac bun meih nyei zeiv-fun hiaangx jienv faaux.”
I^sakc ziouc yiem wuov ceix norm ziec-dorngh yaac gorngv cuotv Ziouv nyei mbuox daaih zaangc. Ninh yaac corng ndopv-liuh yiem wuov norm dorngx. Ninh nyei bou aengx wetv norm wuom-kuotv.
Aa^mbi^me^lekv Hungh caux tengx ninh caangh laangh nyei mienh, Aa^hutc^satv, aengx caux ninh nyei domh baeng-bieiv, Fiko, yiem Ge^laa^aa Zingh mingh lorz I^sakc.
Taux wuov I^sakc ziouc naaic gaax, “Zinh ndaangc meih mbuo nzorng yie, zunc yie cuotv meih mbuo nyei deic-bung. Ih zanc meih mbuo aengx daaih lorz yie zoux haaix nyungc?”
Ninh mbuo dau, “Yie mbuo buatc duqv mengh nyei, Ziouv caux meih yiem. Yie mbuo daaih tov caux meih lomh nzoih laengz waac, bun meih caux yie mbuo liepc jiez ngaengc waac.

Tov laengz meih maiv zoux haaix nyungc hoic yie mbuo, hnangv zinh ndaangc yie mbuo maiv zoux haaix nyungc hoic meih nor. Yie mbuo kungx zoux longx bun meih hnangv. Meih yaac duqv baengh orn nyei cuotv deic-bung. Ih zanc meih se Ziouv ceix fuqv nyei mienh.”
I^sakc weic ninh mbuo mbenc donx hnaangx longx nyei. Ninh mbuo ziouc yiem wuov nyanc, yiem wuov hopv.
Da'nyeic ndorm ninh mbuo jiez sin nziouv nyei, laanh caux laanh liepc jiez ngaengc waac. Liepc liuz, I^sakc fungx ninh mbuo cuotv jauv, baengh orn nyei leih nqoi doic.
Dongh wuov hnoi I^sakc nyei bou daaih gorngv taux ninh mbuo wetv wuom-kuotv nyei jauv. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo wetv taux wuom mi'aqv.”
I^sakc ziouc cuotv wuov norm wuom-kuotv nyei mbuox heuc Qi^mbaa. Weic naaiv, wuov norm dorngx nyei zingh nyei mbuox heuc Mbe^e^qe^mbaa taux ih jaax hnoi.
Esaau duqv feix ziepc hnyangx wuov zanc ninh dorng jaa. Ninh longc Hitv^tai Mienh, Mbe^e^li, nyei sieqv, Yu^nditc. Aengx longc Hitv^tai Mienh, Elon, nyei sieqv, Mbaa^se^matv.
Weic naaiv deix i dauh m'sieqv dorn, I^sakc caux Le^mbe^kaa zuqc nzauh camv.
I^sakc gox haic aqv. M'zing yaac mbuov, mangc maiv buatc. Ninh heuc ninh nyei dorn-hlo, Esaau, daaih gorngv mbuox ninh, “Dorn aac.” Esaau dau, “Aa die aac, yie yiem naaiv oc.”
I^sakc gorngv, “Die gox haic aqv. Maiv hiuv duqv haaix hnoi daic.
Dorn aac, zorqv meih nyei juang-zinx caux forng mingh gemh buonv dauh orv daaih bun yie nyanc.
Zoux kuv nyei hnangv yietc gau yie oix nyanc wuov nor, mbenc daaih bun yie, weic yiem yie maiv gaengh daic yie duqv buang nqa'haav laai wuov nzunc waac bun meih.”
I^sakc caux ninh nyei dorn, Esaau, i dorn-diex gorngv waac wuov zanc, Le^mbe^kaa muangx jienv nyei. Esaau mingh gemh buonv orv wuov zanc,
Le^mbe^kaa mbuox ninh nyei dorn, Yaakopv, “A'jang yie haiz meih nyei die gorngv mbuox Esaau,
‘Buonv dauh orv mbenc daaih kuv nyei bun yie nyanc weic yiem yie maiv gaengh daic duqv yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien buang waac bun meih.’
Dorn aac, hnangv naaic, meih muangx yie, ei jienv yie nyei waac zoux.
Meih mingh yungh guanh wuov ginv i dauh yungh dorn nzueic nyei junc nyei dorh daaih bun maa. Maa ziouc ei jienv yietc gau meih nyei die oix nyanc kuv nyei mbenc daaih bun ninh nyanc.
Mbenc ziangx meih dorh mingh bun meih nyei die nyanc weic yiem ninh maiv gaengh daic haih buang nqa'haav laai wuov nzunc waac bun meih.”
Yaakopv gorngv mbuox ninh nyei maa, “Maa ganh hiuv duqv nyei, Esaau cuotv biei suqv-suqv wuov. Yie maiv maaih biei, hliouv njang nyei.
Buangh zuqc die hluo yie, ninh ziouc hiuv duqv yie nduov ninh. Ninh maiv zeiz buang waac bun yie, zungv zioux yie mv bei!”
Ninh nyei maa gorngv, “Yie nyei dorn aac, se gorngv zuqc houv nor, se ndortv zuqc maa ganh. Kungx oix zuqc muangx maa nyei waac hnangv. Mingh zorqv yungh daaih bun maa oc.”
Yaakopv ziouc mingh zorqv daaih bun ninh nyei maa. Ninh nyei maa ei jienv Yaakopv nyei die yietc gau oix nyanc nyei mbenc ziangx.
Le^mbe^kaa aengx mingh zorqv ninh nyei dorn-hlo, Esaau, nyei lui-houx, dongh siou jienv wuov biauv gauh longx jiex wuov yiemc, bun ninh nyei dorn-faix, Yaakopv, zuqv jienv.
Ninh aengx zorqv yungh dorn nyei ndopv naetv jienv Yaakopv nyei buoz caux jaang, dongh maiv maaih biei nyei dorngx. Zorng ziangx,
Le^mbe^kaa zorqv ninh liuc leiz ziangx nyei orv caux njuov bun Yaakopv bouh mingh.
Yaakopv mingh taux ninh nyei die wuov gorngv, “Aa die aac.” Ninh nyei die dau, “Dorn aac, meih dongh haaix dauh dorn?”
Yaakopv dau, “Yie meih nyei dorn-hlo, Esaau. Yie ei die nyei waac mbenc ziangx. Die jiez sin zueiz jienv nyanc yie buonv daaih nyei orv aqv. Nyanc liuz, die duqv buang waac bun yie.”
I^sakc naaic ninh nyei dorn, “Dorn aah! Meih fungc buonv duqv orv ndongc naaic siepv?” Yaakopv dau, “ Ziouv, meih nyei Tin-Hungh, bun yie haih buangh orv siepv nyei.”
I^sakc aengx gorngv mbuox Yaakopv, “Dorn aac, daaih fatv deix bun yie hluo gaax, meih za'gengh yie nyei dorn, Esaau, zeiz fai maiv zeiz.”
Yaakopv mingh fatv nyei. Ninh nyei die, I^sakc, ziouc hluo ninh. I^sakc gorngv, “Meih nyei qiex se hnangv Yaakopv nyei qiex, mv baac meih nyei buoz haiz hnangv Esaau nyei buoz nor.”
Ninh zieqv maiv duqv naaiv se Yaakopv weic zuqc buoz maaih biei suqv-suqv hnangv ninh nyei gorx, Esaau, nyei buoz nor. I^sakc ziouc buang waac bun ninh.
Mv baac ninh aengx naaic nzunc, “Meih za'gengh yie nyei dorn, Esaau, fai?” Yaakopv dau, “Zeiz nyei.”

I^sakc gorngv, “Dorn aac, dorh meih buonv daaih nyei orv bun die nyanc. Nyanc liuz ziouc buang waac bun meih.” Yaakopv ziouc dorh orv daaih bun ninh nyanc, aengx dorh a'ngunc diuv daaih bun ninh hopv.
Nyanc liuz, hopv liuz I^sakc gorngv, “Dorn aac, daaih fatv deix zom dangh die nyei hmien.”

Yaakopv mingh zom ninh nyei die wuov zanc, ninh nyei die hnomv zuqc Yaakopv nyei lui nyei nziaau ziouc buang waac ninh nyei dorn aqv. Ninh gorngv, “Yie nyei dorn ndaang nyei, hnangv Ziouv ceix fuqv nyei liangx-ndeic ndaang nor.
Tov Tin-Hungh bun mbiungc-suiv yiem wuov lungh njiec, yaac bun meih nyei ndau longx. Tov ninh yaac bun meih duqv mbiauh hmeiv caux siang-a'ngunc diuv camv.

Tov bun camv-fingx mienh fu-sux meih, yaac bun camv-norm guoqv nyei mienh gueic njiec baaix meih. Tov bun meih haih zoux meih nyei muoz-doic nyei ziouv, yaac bun meih nyei maa nyei zeiv-fun gueic njiec baaix meih. Haaix dauh zioux meih, tov bun wuov dauh zuqc zioux. Haaix dauh buang waac meih, tov bun wuov dauh duqv Ziouv ceix fuqv.”
I^sakc buang liuz waac, Yaakopv jang-jang cuotv mingh hnangv, ninh nyei gorx, Esaau, buonv duqv orv nzuonx daaih.
Esaau ziouc zoux deix orv kuv nyei dorh mingh bun ninh nyei die nyanc. Ninh gorngv, “Aa die aah! Jiez sin zueiz jienv nyanc yie buonv daaih nyei orv aqv. Nyanc liuz, aa die duqv buang waac bun yie.”
Ninh nyei die, I^sakc, naaic gaax, “Meih haaix dauh?” Esaau dau, “Yie meih nyei dorn-hlo, Esaau.”

I^sakc liemh zeih sin zinx njuonv-njuonv nyei. Ninh gorngv, “Wuov nyungc, haaix dauh buonv orv dorh daaih bun yie? Yie koqv hoqc nyanc liuz, meih ziouc taux. Die zungv buang waac bun ninh mi'aqv. Ziux die buang nyei waac ninh yaac za'gengh duqv.”
Esaau haiz ninh nyei die nyei waac ninh hnyouv mun haic, bungx-sing bungx-qiex nyei nyiemv jienv gorngv, “Aa die aah! Tov buang waac yie. Tov die yaac buang waac bun yie maah!”
I^sakc dau, “Dongh yie oix buang meih nyei waac meih nyei youz daaih nduov yie buang bun ninh nzengc mi'aqv.”

Esaau gorngv, “Ninh nyei mbuox heuc Yaakopv gengh! puix haic aqv, weic zuqc ninh nduov yie i nzunc mi'aqv. Yie zoux dorn-hlo duqv sung-gouv nyei leiz ninh nduov duqv mi'aqv. Ih zanc dongh die oix buang bun yie nyei waac ninh yaac nduov die buang bun ninh nzengc mi'aqv. Aa die aah! Meih maiv liouh yietc deix buang bun yie aqv?”

I^sakc dau, “Die bun ninh zoux meih nyei ziouv yaac bun yietc zungv muoz-doic cien-ceqv zoux ninh nyei bou. Liemh mbiauh hmeiv caux siang-a'ngunc diuv yie bun weic yungz ninh nyei maengc. Dorn aah! Yie maaih haaix nyungc haih tengx meih?”
Esaau qaqv tov ninh nyei die, “Aa die aah! Meih kungx maaih nduqc nyungc buang nyei waac hnangv? Tov meih yaac buang deix bun yie maah!” Ninh aengx nyiemv nzunc aqv.
I^sakc ziouc gorngv mbuox ninh, “Meih zuqc yiem leih ndau-touv longx nyei dorngx go. Lungh nyei mbiungc-suiv meih yaac maiv duqv.
Meih oix zuqc kaux nzuqc ndaauv yungz maengc, yaac oix zuqc fu-sux meih nyei youz. Mv baac meih haaix zanc haih simv duqv ndutv ninh, meih ziouc maiv zuqc ninh gunv.”

Esaau nzorng haic Yaakopv laaix ninh nyei die buang waac bun Yaakopv. Ninh yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Hnamv daaih maiv lauh yie nyei die guei seix. Zuov yie mbuo nzauh nyiemv nyei ziangh hoc jiex liuz, yie oix daix Yaakopv guangc aqv.”

Le^mbe^kaa haiz gorngv ninh nyei dorn-hlo, Esaau, daav za'eix daix dorn-faix, Yaakopv, ninh ziouc heuc Yaakopv daaih gorngv mbuox ninh, “Muangx gaax, meih nyei gorx, Esaau, daav za'eix oix jaauv win daix meih.
Dorn aah! Muangx maa nyei waac oc. Meih oix zuqc biaux mingh Haalaan Zingh, maa nyei gorx, Laa^mbaan wuov.
Oix zuqc caux ninh mbuo yiem douc zuov meih nyei gorx nyei ga'qiex fiu mingh,
la'kuqv meih zoux bun ninh nyei sic, yie m'daaih bun mienh mingh dorh meih nzuonx. Maa fungc haih bun duqv yietc hnoi daic i dauh dorn?”

Le^mbe^kaa gorngv mbuox I^sakc, “Laaix Esaau nyei i dauh Hitv^tai Mienh auv, yie maiv noic faanh ziangh aqv. Se gorngv Yaakopv aengx longc dauh naaiv norm deic-bung nyei Hitv^tai Mienh nyei sieqv zoux auv nor, yie daic gauh longx.”
I^sakc ziouc heuc Yaakopv daaih yaac buang waac bun ninh, ziouc hatc ninh, “Meih maiv dungx longc Kaa^naa^an Mienh nyei sieqv zoux auv.
Meih oix zuqc mingh Batc^ndaan Aalam, meih nyei daa ong, Mbe^tu^en, nyei biauv. Yiem wuov longc auv, longc dauh meih nyei maa nyei gorx, Laa^mbaan, nyei sieqv.
Tov Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh ceix fuqv bun meih hiaangx daaih maaih fu'jueiv camv, ziouc duqv zoux camv-fingx mienh nyei ong-taaix.

Tov ninh ceix fuqv bun meih caux meih nyei zeiv-fun hnangv zinh ndaangc ninh ceix fuqv bun Apc^laa^ham wuov nor. Yaac bun meih mbuo duqv meih ih zanc yiem jienv naaiv norm deic-bung benx meih mbuo nyei buonc, dongh zinh ndaangc Tin-Hungh ceix bun Apc^laa^ham nyei deic-bung.”
Hnangv naaic I^sakc ziouc heuc Yaakopv mingh Batc^ndaan Aalam, mingh lorz Aalam Mienh, Mbe^tu^en nyei dorn, Laa^mbaan. Laa^mbaan yaac zoux Yaakopv caux Esaau nyei maa, Le^mbe^kaa, nyei gorx.

Esaau hiuv duqv ninh nyei die, I^sakc, buang waac Yaakopv, mbuox ninh mingh Batc^ndaan Aalam lorz auv longc. Ninh yaac hiuv duqv, buang waac wuov zanc I^sakc heuc ninh maiv dungx longc Kaa^naa^an Mienh nyei sieqv zoux auv.
Aengx buatc Yaakopv muangx ninh diex maac nyei waac za'gengh mingh Batc^ndaan Aalam mi'aqv.
Esaau ziouc zieqv duqv ninh nyei die, I^sakc, maiv a'hneiv Kaa^naa^an sieqv.
Ninh ziouc mingh lorz dauh Apc^laa^ham nyei dorn, I^saa^maa^en, nyei sieqv, Ne^mbaa^yotv nyei muoc, mbuox heuc Maa^haa^latv, longc zoux auv-faam.
Yaakopv cuotv Mbe^e^qe^mbaa, hungx jienv mingh Haalaan Zingh.
Mingh gau, taux norm dorngx buatc mba'hnoi muotv mi'aqv, ziouc hitv wuov. Ninh bueix wuov nzomz jienv la'bieiv m'njormh.
Ninh mbeix buatc maaih zung tei yiem ga'ndiev ndau liepc faaux taux gu'nguaaic lungh. Yaac buatc Tin-Hungh nyei fin-mienh faaux-faaux njiec-njiec nyei.

Yaac maaih Ziouv souv jienv tei gu'nguaaic gorngv mbuox ninh, “Yie se Ziouv, meih nyei ong, Apc^laa^ham, nyei Tin-Hungh, caux I^sakc nyei Tin-Hungh. Dongh meih ih zanc bueix naaiv deix ndau yie oix jiu bun meih caux meih nyei zeiv-fun.
Meih nyei zeiv-fun oix hnangv lungh ndiev nyei nie-mbung camv. Ninh mbuo oix hiaangx jangv jienv mingh dong naamh fai baqv. Weic meih caux meih nyei zeiv-fun lungh ndiev maanc fingx oix duqv fuqv.

Jangx jienv oc. Maiv gunv meih mingh taux haaix yie caux meih yiem, oix goux jienv meih. Yie yaac oix dorh meih aengx nzuonx taux naaiv norm deic-bung. Yie zungv maiv leih nqoi meih, taux yie zoux ziangx ei yie laengz nyei waac.”
Yaakopv nyie daaih gorngv, “ Ziouv za'gengh yiem naaiv norm dorngx mv baac yie liemh maiv hiuv.”
Ninh za'gengh gamh nziex haic aengx gorngv, “Naaiv za'gengh yiev haic nyei dorngx. Hnangv haaix zungv zoux Tin-Hungh nyei dinc, yaac zoux tin-dorngh nyei gaengh.”
Da'nyeic ndorm Yaakopv jiez sin daaih nziouv nyei, zorqv ninh nzomz wuov norm la'bieiv liepc jiez daaih don jienv zoux jangx-hoc. Aengx zorqv youh dox jienv la'bieiv fungx bun Tin-Hungh.
Wuov norm dorngx ninh cuotv mbuox heuc Mbetc^en. (Zinh ndaangc wuov norm zingh nyei mbuox heuc Lutv.)
Yaakopv aengx laengz ngaengc waac. Ninh gorngv, “Se gorngv Tin-Hungh caux yie yiem dongh ih zanc yie mingh nyei jauv, yaac goux jienv yie, bun yie maaih nyanc maaih hopv, maaih lui-houx zuqv,
yaac bun yie baengh orn nyei nzuonx yie nyei die nyei biauv nor, Ziouv ziouc benx yie nyei Tin-Hungh aqv.
Yie liepc naaiv norm la'bieiv daaih weic zoux jangx-hoc ziouc benx Tin-Hungh nyei dinc. Da'faanh meih bun haaix nyungc yie, yie oix zorqv ziepc gouv nyei yietc gouv fongc horc meih.”
Yaakopv aengx gan jienv jauv mingh taux dong bung mienh nyei deic-bung.

Yiem wuov ninh buatc norm wuom-kuotv yiem lomc-huaang gu'nyuoz. Maaih buo guanh ba'gi yungh bueix jienv wuom-kuotv ga'hlen weic zuqc goux yungh nyei mienh zaangh naaiv norm wuom-kuotv nyei wuom bun yungh hopv. Buang jienv wuom-kuotv wuov kuaaiv la'bieiv yaac hlo nyei.

Zuov guanh guanh ba'gi yungh taux nzoih, mangc yungh nyei mienh ziouc nzien nqoi la'bieiv, zaangh wuom daaih bun yungh hopv. Hopv liuz, ninh mbuo aengx zorqv wuov kuaaiv la'bieiv gomv jienv wuom-kuotv.
Yaakopv naaic gaax goux yungh nyei mienh, “Gorx-youz aac, meih mbuo yiem haaix daaih?” Ninh mbuo dau, “Yie mbuo yiem Haalaan Zingh daaih.”
Ninh aengx naaic gaax, “Meih mbuo hiuv duqv Naa^ho nyei fun, Laa^mbaan, nyei fai?” Ninh mbuo dau, “Hiuv nyei oc.”
Yaakopv aengx naaic gaax, “Ninh longx nyei saah?” Ninh mbuo dau, “Ninh longx nyei. Wuov ni! Ninh nyei sieqv, Laasen, dorh jienv Laa^mbaan nyei ba'gi yungh daaih aqv loh!”

Yaakopv naaic gaax ninh mbuo, “Ih zanc mba'hnoi corc hlang nyei. Maiv gaengh taux ziangh hoc horngh yungh nzuonx. Meih mbuo weic haaix diuc maiv zaangh wuom bun ba'gi yungh hopv aengx bungx ninh mbuo mingh nyanc miev?”
Ninh mbuo dau, “Yie mbuo maiv haih hnangv naaic zoux. Yie mbuo oix zuqc zuov guanh guanh ba'gi yungh daaih nzoih cingx nzien nqoi la'bieiv zaangh wuom bun yungh hopv.”
Yaakopv caux naaiv deix mienh corc gorngv jienv waac wuov zanc, Laasen yaac horngh jienv ninh nyei die nyei ba'gi yungh taux daaih, weic zuqc ninh goux naaiv deix yungh.

Yaakopv buatc ninh nyei maa nyei gorx, Laa^mbaan, nyei sieqv, Laasen, horngh jienv Laa^mbaan nyei ba'gi yungh, ninh ziouc mingh wuov wuom-kuotv nzien nqoi la'bieiv zaangh wuom bun ninh nyei domh nauz nyei yungh hopv.
Zaangh liuz wuom, Yaakopv zom Laasen nyei hmien, a'hneiv gau, siangx nyiemv nyei.
Ninh yaac mbuox Laasen, “Yie zoux meih nyei die nyei cien-ceqv, se zoux Le^mbe^kaa nyei dorn.” Laasen ziouc tiux nzuonx mingh mbuox ninh nyei die.

Laa^mbaan yietv haiz gorngv ninh nyei muoc nyei dorn, Yaakopv, daaih, ninh ziouc tiux jienv mingh zipv, qam jienv zom, yaac dorh jienv nzuonx biauv mi'aqv. Yaakopv gorngv nzengc ninh nyei jauv-louc bun Laa^mbaan muangx.
Laa^mbaan ziouc gorngv, “Meih za'gengh caux yie juangc nziaamv-fei nyei mienh.” Yaakopv caux Laa^mbaan yiem yietc hlaax nyieqc.
Laa^mbaan gorngv mbuox Yaakopv, “Meih maiv dungx hnamv laaix zoux cien-ceqv muoz-doic oix zuqc baeqc baeqc tengx yie zoux gong. Meih oix longc gong-zinh mbu'ziex gunv mbuox yie.”
Laa^mbaan maaih i dauh sieqv. Sieqv-hlo heuc Le^aa. Sieqv-faix heuc Laasen.
Le^aa nyei m'zing maiv nangc njang. Laasen aeqv, ziangh duqv longx, ziangh duqv nzueic.
Yaakopv hnamv haic Laasen ziouc gorngv mbuox Laa^mbaan, “Se gorngv domh nauz laengz bun meih nyei sieqv-faix, Laasen, yie nor, yie laengz tengx meih zoux siec hnyangx gong.”
Laa^mbaan gorngv, “Bungx bun meih se gauh longx bungx bun ganh dauh. Hnangv naaic, gunv caux yie yiem aqv.”
Yaakopv tengx ninh nyei domh nauz zoux siec hnyangx gong weic bietv Laasen. Ninh hnamv haic Laasen ziouc haiz hnangv i ziex hnoi hnangv.
Yaakopv gorngv mbuox Laa^mbaan, “Ziangh hoc buangv aqv. Tov bun yie nyei auv yie, weic bun yie duqv bieqc mingh caux ninh bueix.”
Laa^mbaan ziouc mbenc cing-jaa-hnaangx, cingv wuov norm dorngx nyei zuangx mienh daaih.
Mv baac wuov muonz Laa^mbaan fungx ninh nyei sieqv, Le^aa, mingh bun Yaakopv. Yaakopv yaac caux ninh bueix.
(Laa^mbaan aengx bun dauh ninh nyei nouh beiz, mbuox heuc Sinx^baa, zoux Le^aa nyei nouh beiz.)

Taux lungh njang, Yaakopv zieqv duqv se Le^aa, ziouc mingh doix Laa^mbaan gorngv, “Meih weic haaix diuc hnangv naaiv nor zoux bun yie? Yie tengx meih zoux gong bietv Laasen maiv zeiz? Meih weic haaix diuc pienx yie?”
Laa^mbaan dau, “Ziux yie mbuo yiem naaiv, maiv maaih leiz bun sieqv-faix dorng jaa ndaangc sieqv-hlo.
Meih oix zuqc zuov naaiv norm siec hnoi nyei yinh jiex liuz, yie aengx bun sieqv-faix meih longc. Mv baac meih oix zuqc aengx tengx yie zoux siec hnyangx laangh.”
Yaakopv yaac laengz aqv. Zuov naaiv norm cing-jaa-yinh nyei siec hnoi jiex liuz, Laa^mbaan bun ninh nyei sieqv-faix Yaakopv zoux auv.
(Laa^mbaan aengx bun dauh ninh nyei nouh beiz, mbuox heuc Mbin^haa, zoux Laasen nyei nouh beiz.)
Yaakopv ziouc duqv longc Laasen zoux auv yaac hnamv Laasen gauh camv Le^aa. Ninh aengx tengx Laa^mbaan zoux siec hnyangx laangh.
Ziouv buatc Yaakopv maiv hnamv Le^aa ziouc bun ninh haih maaih gu'nguaaz. Laasen aeqv, maiv haih maaih.

Le^aa ziouc maaih jienv sin, yungz duqv dauh dorn. Ninh gorngv, “Se weic zuqc Ziouv buatc yie nyei kouv naanc. Ih zanc nziex yie nyei nqox oix hnamv yie mv bei?” Ninh ziouc cuotv wuov dauh dorn nyei mbuox heuc Lu^mben.

Le^aa aengx maaih jienv sin, yungz duqv dauh dorn. Ninh gorngv, “ Ziouv bun yie aengx duqv naaiv dauh dorn weic zuqc ninh muangx haiz yie nyei nqox maiv hnamv yie.” Le^aa ziouc cuotv naaiv dauh dorn nyei mbuox heuc Si^me^on.
Le^aa aengx maaih nzunc sin, aengx yungz duqv dauh dorn. Ninh gorngv, “Yie yungz duqv buo dauh dorn. Yie nyei nqox za'gengh! oix hnamv yie.” Ninh aengx tengx wuov dauh dorn cuotv mbuox heuc Lewi.
Ninh aengx maaih jienv sin, aengx yungz duqv dauh dorn. Ninh gorngv, “Naaiv nzunc yie oix ceng Ziouv. ” Ninh cuotv mbuox heuc Yu^ndaa. Ninh duqv liuz naaiv dauh dorn ziouc maiv yungz aqv.
Laasen hiuv duqv ninh ganh maiv haih yungz gu'nguaaz bun Yaakopv, ninh ziouc mueic jieqv ninh nyei dorc. Ninh gorngv mbuox Yaakopv, “Meih bun yie duqv fu'jueiv maah! Maiv zei aeqv, yie daic aqv.”
Yaakopv qiex jiez haic Laasen. Ninh gorngv, “Yie maiv zeiz Tin-Hungh. Tin-Hungh ganh bun meih maiv haih maaih gu'nguaaz.”
Laasen gorngv, “Naaiv yie nyei nouh beiz, Mbin^haa. Meih gunv caux ninh bueix maah! Ninh haih yungz gu'nguaaz bun yie, yie ziouc laaix ninh duqv dauh gu'nguaaz funx yie nyei buonc.”
Laasen ziouc bun ninh nyei nouh beiz, Mbin^haa, ninh nyei nqox longc zoux auv. Yaakopv yaac caux ninh bueix.
Mbin^haa ziouc maaih jienv sin, yungz duqv dauh dorn bun Yaakopv.
Laasen gorngv, “Tin-Hungh siemv liuz dingc bun yie, yaac haiz yie jouh nyei waac ziouc bun dauh dorn yie.” Laasen ziouc tengx wuov dauh dorn cuotv mbuox heuc Ndaan.
Laasen nyei nouh beiz, Mbin^haa, aengx maaih jienv sin, yungz duqv da'nyeic dauh dorn bun Yaakopv.
Laasen gorngv, “Yie caux yie nyei dorc nzaeng domh jaax yaac nzaeng duqv hingh.” Ninh tengx wuov dauh dorn cuotv mbuox heuc Napv^taa^li.
Le^aa hiuv duqv ninh ganh maiv yungz gu'nguaaz aqv. Ninh ziouc bun ninh nyei nouh beiz, Sinx^baa, Yaakopv longc zoux auv.
Sinx^baa yaac yungz duqv dauh dorn bun Yaakopv.
Le^aa gorngv, “Yie gengh maengc longx.” Ninh ziouc tengx wuov dauh dorn cuotv mbuox heuc Gaatc.
Le^aa nyei nouh beiz, Sinx^baa, aengx yungz duqv da'nyeic dauh dorn bun Yaakopv.
Le^aa gorngv, “Yie njien-youh haic aqv. Zuangx m'sieqv dorn yaac oix gorngv yie njien-youh haic.” Ninh ziouc tengx wuov dauh dorn cuotv mbuox heuc Aa^se.

Gaatv mbiauh witv nyei ziangh hoc, Lu^mben mingh saau wuov ndeic, buatc zungh ndu^ndaa^im jieh. Ninh ziouc dorh daaih bun ninh nyei maa Le^aa. Laasen gorngv mbuox ninh nyei dorc, “Tov bun deix dorc nyei dorn nyei ndu^ndaa^im jieh yie maah!”

Le^aa dau, “Yie nyei nqox meih zungv nzaeng mingh aqv. Corc maiv gaengh gaux? Meih aengx oix nzaeng yie nyei dorn nyei ndu^ndaa^im jieh?” Laasen gorngv, “Meih bun deix meih nyei dorn nyei ndu^ndaa^im jieh yie nor, ih muonz yie bun Yaakopv caux meih bueix.”

Hmuangx deix, Yaakopv yiem ndeic nzuonx, Le^aa mingh zipv. Ninh gorngv, “Ih muonz meih oix zuqc caux yie bueix. Yie dorh yie nyei dorn nyei ndu^ndaa^im jieh yienc meih mi'aqv.” Wuov muonz Yaakopv ziouc caux Le^aa bueix.
Tin-Hungh dau Le^aa jouh ninh nyei waac. Le^aa aengx maaih jienv sin, yungz duqv da'hmz dauh dorn bun Yaakopv.
Le^aa gorngv, “Weic zuqc yie bun yie nyei nouh beiz yie nyei nqox longc, Tin-Hungh bun zingh nyeic yie.” Ninh cuotv wuov dauh dorn nyei mbuox heuc Itc^saax^kaa.
Le^aa aengx maaih jienv sin, yungz duqv da'luoqc dauh dorn bun Yaakopv.

Le^aa gorngv, “Tin-Hungh bun longx haic nyei zingh nyeic yie. Ih zanc yie nyei nqox ndongc haaix yaac oix taaih yie weic zuqc yie yungz duqv juqv dauh dorn bun ninh.” Ninh cuotv ninh nyei dorn nyei mbuox heuc Se^mbu^lun.
Nqa'haav Le^aa aengx yungz duqv dauh sieqv yaac cuotv mbuox heuc Ndinaa.
Zoux gau, Tin-Hungh jangx taux Laasen, aengx dau ninh jouh nyei waac, bun ninh haih maaih gu'nguaaz.
Ninh ziouc maaih jienv sin, yungz duqv dauh dorn. Ninh gorngv, “Tin-Hungh bun dauh dorn yie, tengx yie buang hmien, maiv zuqc diev nyaiv.
Tov Tin-Hungh aengx bun dauh dorn yie.” Ninh ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Yosepv.
Laasen duqv liuz Yosepv, nqa'haav Yaakopv gorngv mbuox ninh nyei ong-daa, Laa^mbaan, “Tov bun yie nzuonx yie nyei buonv-deic dorngx aqv oc.
Die hiuv duqv yie daaih tengx meih zoux gong bietv ndutv yie nyei auv-jueiv mi'aqv. Tov bun yie dorh jienv nzuonx aqv.”
Mv baac Laa^mbaan gorngv, “Se gorngv meih buangv hnyouv, tov aengx caux yie yiem. Yie samx duqv cuotv, hiuv duqv se weic meih, Ziouv cingx ceix fuqv bun yie.
Meih nyei gong-zinh oix longc mbu'ziex gunv gorngv mbuox yie maah! Yie ziouc bun.”
Yaakopv dau ninh nyei ong-daa, “Die hiuv duqv yie zoux nyei gong ndongc haaix longx, yaac hiuv duqv meih nyei saeng-kuv ndongc haaix camv.

Yie maiv gaengh daaih nyei ziangh hoc, die maaih deix baav hnangv. Ih zanc maaih camv haic aqv. Yie zoux taux haaix, Ziouv ceix fuqv bun meih. Mv baac taux haaix zanc yie cingx liepc duqv yie nyei jaa-dingh?”

Laa^mbaan naaic gaax ninh, “Wuov nyungc, yie oix zuqc bun haaix nyungc meih?” Yaakopv dau, “Die maiv zuqc bun haaix nyungc yie. Se gorngv die oix hnangv naaiv nor tengx yie, yie aengx goux jienv meih nyei ba'gi yungh caux yungh guanh mingh.

Ih hnoi yie oix mingh dimv mangc meih nyei yietc zungv ba'gi yungh caux yungh guanh. Da'faanh ba'gi yungh maaih diemv cou, diemv muonc nyei, caux ba'gi yungh dorn jieqv, caux dauh dauh yungh maaih diemv cou fai diemv muonc nyei, yie longc zoux yie nyei gong-zinh.

Hnangv naaiv nor, nqa'haav hingv yie zoux hnyouv zaqc fai maiv zaqc, die ziouc hiuv nyei. Haaix zanc mingh mangc yie nyei gong-zinh, buatc haaix dauh yungh maiv ben yaac maiv maaih diemv, fai buatc haaix dauh ba'gi yungh dorn maiv jieqv nor, ziouc hiuv duqv yie pinx daaih aqv.”
Laa^mbaan dau, “Longx aqv. Hnangv meih gorngv nor zoux.”

Dongh wuov hnoi Laa^mbaan mingh dimv mangc ninh nyei yungh. Yungh gouv ben nyei, maaih diemv nyei, ninh ginv cuotv. Yungh nyeiz maaih diemv cou diemv muonc caux dauh dauh maaih baeqc zorpc jienv, caux yietc zungv ba'gi yungh dorn jieqv ninh yaac ginv cuotv. Naaiv deix yietc zungv ninh jiu bun ninh ganh nyei dorn mbuo goux,
yaac horngh jienv mingh leih Yaakopv buo hnoi nyei jauv. Yaakopv aeqv, corc goux jienv Laa^mbaan zengc njiec nyei ba'gi yungh caux yungh guanh.
Yaakopv mingh jamv borpc^laah, an^man caux pa'len ndiangx-nquaah nyiemz daaih nqenx qongx nqaeqv qongx ndiangx-ndopv guangc, bun ndiangx-orv cuotv daaih baeqc nyei, ben nyei.
Ninh ziouc dorh naaiv deix zoux ben nyei ndiangx-nquaah an jienv saeng-kuv nyei nza'hmien, wuom-zoh gu'nyuoz. Saeng-kuv saeng nyei ziangh hoc daaih hopv wuom,
ninh mbuo ziouc yiem naaiv deix ndiangx nyei nza'hmien maengx daapv zuangv. Ninh mbuo yaac njiec dorn ben nyei, maaih diemv cou fai diemv muonc nyei.

Yaakopv zorqv yungh caux ba'gi yungh dorn bun nqoi ganh ca'lengc an norm dorngx. Ba'gi yungh caux yungh ninh bun hungx mingh Laa^mbaan nyei ba'gi yungh jieqv caux ben wuov bung. Ninh hnangv naaiv nor zoux bun ganh nyei ba'gi yungh hiaangx. Ninh nyei buonc yungh caux ba'gi yungh ganh ca'lengc an norm dorngx, maiv bun zorpc Laa^mbaan nyei.
Haaix zanc henv nyei wuov deix saeng-kuv daapv zuangv ninh zorqv wuov deix ndiangx-nquaah don jienv nza'hmien maengx, wuom-zoh gu'nyuoz. Ninh mbuo yiem naaiv deix ndiangx nyei ga'hlen daapv zuangv,

mv baac maiv henv wuov deix daapv zuangv ninh maiv zorqv naaiv deix ndiangx-nquaah don nza'hmien maengx. Hnangv naaic, maiv henv wuov deix benx Laa^mbaan nyei. Henv wuov deix benx nzengc Yaakopv nyei.
Yaakopv gunv zoux gunv butv zoih. Maaih yungh, maaih ba'gi yungh, maaih nouh gauv nouh beiz, maaih lorh torh, maaih lorh. Nyungc-nyungc zungv maaih camv.
Yaakopv haiz gorngv Laa^mbaan nyei dorn ngopv. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yaakopv nzaeng nzengc aa die nyei jaa-dingh ga'naaiv. Ninh butv zoih daaih maaih nyei nyungc-nyungc se yiem mbuo nyei die daaih.”
Yaakopv yaac zieqv duqv Laa^mbaan nyei eix leiz maiv hnangv zinh ndaangc wuov nor, pioux camv haic aqv.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Yaakopv, “Nzuonx meih nyei cien-ceqv nyei deic-bung wuov oc. Yie oix caux meih yiem.”
Yaakopv ziouc bun waac mingh mbuox Laasen caux Le^aa daaih ninh nyei ba'gi yungh yiem nyei ciangv.
Yaakopv gorngv mbuox ninh nyei auv mbuo, “Yie buatc meih nyei die nyei eix leiz caux yie maiv hnangv zinh ndaangc. Mv baac yie nyei die nyei Tin-Hungh caux yie yiem.
Meih mbuo yaac hiuv duqv yie longc nzengc qaqv tengx meih mbuo nyei die zoux gong.
Mv baac meih mbuo nyei die corc pienx yie. Ninh tiuv yie nyei gong-zinh duqv ziepc nzunc aqv. Mv baac Tin-Hungh maiv bun ninh zoux haaix nyungc hoic yie.

Se gorngv ninh gorngv, ‘Yungh maaih diemv nyei oix zuqc funx meih nyei gong-zinh,’ yietc zungv yungh njiec dorn maaih diemv nyei hnangv. Se gorngv ninh gorngv, ‘Yungh ben oix zuqc funx meih nyei gong-zinh,’ ziangh guanh yungh ziouc kungx njiec dorn ben nyei hnangv.
Hnangv naaic, Tin-Hungh zorqv meih nyei die nyei buonc saeng-kuv bun yie nzengc mi'aqv.
“Yungh saeng nyei ziangh hoc, yie mbeix buatc tiux yungh nyeiz nyei yungh gouv, maaih deix ben nyei, maaih deix maaih diemv cou nyei, maaih deix maaih diemv muonc nyei.
Mbeix buatc jienv nyei ziangh hoc, Tin-Hungh nyei fin-mienh heuc yie, ‘Yaakopv aac.’ Yie dau, ‘Oeix! Yie yiem naaiv oc.’

Ninh gorngv, ‘Mangc gaax maah! Tiux yungh nyeiz nyei yietc zungv yungh gouv maaih deix ben nyei, maaih deix diemv muonc nyei, maaih deix diemv cou nyei, weic zuqc Laa^mbaan zoux bun meih nyei yietc zungv yie buatc nzengc.

Yie se Tin-Hungh, dongh yiem Mbetc^en hinc cuotv bun meih buatc wuov dauh. Yiem Mbetc^en meih liepc norm la'bieiv don jienv dox youh fungx bun yie, yaac yiem wuov laengz jiez ngaengc waac. Mingh aqv. Ih zanc cuotv naaiv norm deic-bung nzuonx meih cuotv seix nyei deic-bung.’+”
Laasen caux Le^aa dau Yaakopv, “Yie mbuo nyei die nyei jaa-dingh ih zanc zungv maiv maaih yie mbuo nzipc nyei buonc.
Ninh zoux bun yie mbuo hnangv benx ganh fingx mienh nor. Ninh yaac maaic yie mbuo nyei m'nqorngv daaih yaac naqv nzengc mi'aqv.
Tin-Hungh bun meih duqv yie mbuo nyei die nyei ga'naaiv se benx yie mbuo nyei yaac benx yie mbuo nyei fu'jueiv nyei. Ih zanc Tin-Hungh hnangv haaix nor mbuox meih, gunv hnangv wuov nor zoux.”
Yaakopv ziouc mbenc ziangx ga'naaiv. Ninh bun ninh nyei auv-jueiv geh jienv lorh torh,
yaac zunc jienv saeng-kuv mingh ndaangc. Aengx dorh jienv ninh yiem Batc^ndaan Aalam zornc duqv daaih nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv cuotv jauv nzuonx Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, ninh nyei die, I^sakc, wuov.
Wuov zanc Laa^mbaan cuotv mingh japv ninh nyei ba'gi yungh biei. Laasen bangc wuov norm ziangh hoc nimc ninh nyei die yiem biauv zaangc nyei miuc-fangx.
Yaakopv yaac nduov ninh nyei ong-daa, Aalam Mienh, Laa^mbaan, weic zuqc ninh bingx jienv biaux, maiv mbuox.
Ninh dorh jienv ninh maaih nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv biaux jiex ziqc Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih, hungx jienv Gi^le^aatc nyei mbong-aiv dorngx mingh.
Yaakopv biaux mingh duqv buo hnoi, Laa^mbaan cingx hiuv duqv.
Ninh ziouc dorh jienv ninh nyei gorx-youz mingh zunc. Zunc siec hnoi ziouc zunc zaaic yiem Gi^le^aatc nyei mbong-aiv dorngx.
Wuov muonz Laa^mbaan mbeix buatc Tin-Hungh daaih gorngv mbuox ninh, “Faix fim oc. Maiv gunv longx fai ciouv, maiv dungx gorngv haaix nyungc bun Yaakopv.”

Laa^mbaan zunc zaaic Yaakopv wuov zanc, Yaakopv corng jienv ndopv-liuh yiem Gi^le^aatc nyei mbong-aiv dorngx. Laa^mbaan caux gan ninh mingh nyei gorx-youz yaac corng jienv ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh wuov.
Laa^mbaan gorngv mbuox Yaakopv, “Meih fungc hnangv naaiv zoux? Meih nduov yie aengx guaaiv jienv yie nyei sieqv biaux hnangv mborqv jaax caangv duqv daaih nyei m'sieqv dorn nor.

Meih fungc hnangv naaiv nor nduov yie, bingx jienv biaux yaac maiv mbuox yietc joux yie? Se gorngv yie hiuv nor, yie zoux nauc nyitc bun mienh baaux nzung, mborqv lorh mborqv nzoz, patv daanh baah, fungx meih mbuo njien-youh nyei cuotv jauv.
Meih liemh maiv bun yie duqv zom yie nyei fun caux yie nyei sieqv. Naaiv meih zoux nyei jauv za'gengh hngongx haic.

Ih zanc meih yiem yie nyei buoz-ndiev. Yie oix zoux haaix nyungc hoic meih se zoux duqv nyei. Mv baac a'hmuangx meih nyei die nyei Tin-Hungh box mbeix mbuox yie, ‘Maiv gunv longx fai ciouv, maiv dungx gorngv haaix nyungc bun Yaakopv.’
Yie hiuv duqv meih nyei hnyouv oix nzuonx meih nyei die nyei biauv cingx daaih biaux. Mv baac meih weic haaix diuc nimc yie yiem biauv zaangc nyei miuc-fangx?”
Yaakopv dau Laa^mbaan, “Yie gamh nziex meih oix zorqv meih nyei sieqv nzuonx.

Mv baac meih nyei miuc-fangx aeqv, se gorngv lorz buatc yiem haaix dauh, maiv dungx liouh ninh nyei maengc aqv. Dorng jienv yie mbuo nyei zuangx gorx-youz sou cuotv meih nyei haaix nyungc ga'naaiv, gunv zorqv nzuonx aqv.” Yaakopv maiv hiuv duqv Laasen nimc ninh nyei die nyei miuc-fangx.

Laa^mbaan ziouc bieqc Yaakopv nyei ndopv-liuh caux Le^aa nyei ndopv-liuh caux wuov deix i dauh nouh beiz nyei ndopv-liuh sou mv baac sou maiv cuotv ninh nyei miuc-fangx. Ninh yiem Le^aa nyei ndopv-liuh cuotv daaih aengx bieqc Laasen nyei ndopv-liuh.
Laasen zorqv wuov deix yiem biauv zaangc nyei miuc-fangx dapv jienv lorh torh nyei dorx. Ninh ganh aeqv, zueiz jienv gu'nguaaic. Laa^mbaan sou nzengc Laasen nyei ndopv-liuh mv baac lorz maiv buatc.

Laasen gorngv mbuox ninh nyei die, “Aa die aac, meih maiv dungx nouz yie oc. Yie horpc zuqc jiez sin zipv die, mv baac yie nyei sin-yienc taux, yie jiez maiv duqv sin.” Laa^mbaan sou nzengc ga'naaiv yaac lorz maiv buatc ninh yiem biauv zaangc nyei miuc-fangx.
Yaakopv qiex jiez haic ziouc gorngv Laa^mbaan, “Yie zoux haaix nyungc dorngc meih, ziqc zuiz meih, meih cingx qaqv zunc jienv yie daaih?

Meih sou nzengc yie nyei ga'naaiv meih buatc haaix nyungc zeiz meih nyei ga'naaiv? Zorqv cuotv daaih an jienv naaiv maah! Bun meih nyei mienh caux yie nyei mienh lomh nzoih mangc. Ninh mbuo ziouc hiuv duqv yie caux meih, haaix dauh zoux horpc.
“Yie caux meih yiem duqv nyic ziepc hnyangx aqv. Meih nyei ba'gi yungh caux yungh maiv mbaang jiex dorn. Yietc dauh meih nyei ba'gi yungh gouv fai yungh gouv yie maiv nyanc jiex.

Se gorngv hieh ga'naaiv ngaatc, yie maiv dorh mingh bun meih mangc. Yie ganh laengz ndortv hnangv. Janx-zaqc nimc haaix nyungc, maiv gunv lungh hnoi zanc fai lungh muonz zanc, meih zungv heuc yie ganh tipv.
Lungh hnoi zanc yie diev nyutc pui, diev yuoqv. Lungh muonz zanc yaac diev juangv, guangc m'njormh jaax.

Yie hnangv naaiv nor caux meih yiem buangv nyic ziepc hnyangx. Yie zoux gong ziepc feix hnyangx bietv meih nyei i dauh sieqv longc. Aengx zoux juqv hnyangx bietv meih nyei saeng-kuv. Meih corc tiuv yie nyei gong-zinh duqv ziepc nzunc mi'aqv.

Se gorngv maiv zeiz yie nyei die nyei Tin-Hungh, Apc^laa^ham nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh I^sakc zaangc nyei Tin-Hungh, caux yie yiem nor, meih zungv bun yie kungx-buoz baeqc zaux nyei cuotv hnangv. Mv baac Tin-Hungh buatc yie nyei kouv-zingh caux yie nyei buoz zoux nyei gong. A'hmuangx ninh ziouc baav jienv meih.”

Laa^mbaan dau Yaakopv, “Naaiv deix sieqv se yie nyei sieqv. Naaiv deix fu'jueiv yaac yie nyei. Naaiv deix yungh guanh caux ba'gi yungh guanh yaac yie nyei. Meih buatc jienv nyei yietc zungv se yie nyei. Ih hnoi yie haih zoux haaix nyungc tengx yie nyei sieqv caux ninh mbuo nyei fu'jueiv?
Daaih maah! Meih caux yie oix zuqc liepc jiez ngaengc waac weic tengx mbuo i dauh zoux zorng-zengx.”
Yaakopv ziouc zorqv norm la'bieiv liepc jiez daaih don jienv zoux jangx-hoc,

aengx mbuox ninh nyei mienh, “Nzauz la'bieiv daaih maah!” Ninh mbuo ziouc nzauz la'bieiv daaih ndui jienv aqv. Ndui liuz, ninh mbuo ziouc lomh nzoih yiem wuov la'bieiv-ndui nyei ga'hlen nyanc hnaangx.
Laa^mbaan cuotv wuov norm dorngx nyei mbuox heuc Yegaa Saax^haax^ndu^taa, mv baac Yaakopv cuotv mbuox heuc Gaa^le^etc.
Laa^mbaan gorngv, “Ih hnoi naaiv ndui la'bieiv zoux mbuo i dauh nyei zorng-zengx.” Weic naaiv wuov norm dorngx heuc Gaa^le^etc.
Aengx duqv mbuox heuc Mitv^baa, weic zuqc Laa^mbaan gorngv, “Mbuo leih nqoi doic mv baac tov Ziouv yiem meih caux yie mbuo mbu'ndongx zuov jienv.
Se gorngv meih zoux doqc yie nyei sieqv, fai cuotv liuz yie nyei sieqv meih aengx ganh longc dauh auv, maiv gunv yie maiv hiuv, jangx jienv oc, maaih Tin-Hungh tengx meih caux yie zoux zorng-zengx.”
Laa^mbaan aengx gorngv mbuox Yaakopv, “Mangc gaax, naaiv se yie ndui nyei la'bieiv caux don jienv nyei la'bieiv-dongc yiem meih caux yie mbu'ndongx.

Naaiv ndui la'bieiv caux naaiv norm la'bieiv-dongc zoux zorng-zengx tengx mbuo jangx zuqc, yie maiv jiex meih wuov bung zoux haaix nyungc hoic meih. Meih yaac maiv jiex naaiv bung zoux haaix nyungc hoic yie.

Tov Apc^laa^ham nyei Tin-Hungh caux Naa^ho nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh ninh mbuo nyei die nyei Tin-Hungh, tengx mbuo dunx sic.” Yaakopv ziouc ziangv jienv dongh ninh nyei die, I^sakc, zaangc nyei Tin-Hungh nyei mbuox laengz jiez ngaengc waac.
Ninh yaac yiem wuov norm mbong-aiv longc saeng-kuv ziec bun Tin-Hungh yaac heuc ninh nyei gorx-youz daaih lomh nzoih nyanc hnaangx. Nyanc liuz, ninh mbuo ziangh muonz yiem wuov norm mbong.
Da'nyeic ndorm nziouv nyei, Laa^mbaan zom ninh nyei sieqv caux ninh nyei fun yaac buang waac ninh mbuo, ziouc cuotv jauv nzuonx biauv aqv.
Yaakopv gan jienv jauv mingh wuov zanc, maaih deix Tin-Hungh nyei fin-mienh daaih buangh ninh.
Yaakopv buatc fin-mienh ninh gorngv, “Naaiv se Tin-Hungh nyei baeng.” Ninh ziouc cuotv wuov norm dorngx nyei mbuox heuc Maa^haa^naa^im.
Yaakopv paaiv deix douc fienx mienh mingh ndaangc taux Se^i Deic, E^ndom Deic-Bung, lorz ninh nyei gorx, Esaau.

Ninh yaac njaaux ziangx waac ninh mbuo. Ninh gorngv, “Meih mbuo oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor mbuox yie nyei ziouv, Esaau, oc. Mbuox ninh, ‘Meih nyei bou, Yaakopv, gorngv, yie mingh caux Laa^mbaan yiem taux ih zanc.
Yie maaih ngongh, lorh, ba'gi yungh caux yungh, maaih nouh gauv nouh beiz. Yie paaiv mienh mingh mbuox meih, yie nyei ziouv, tov meih nqoi fim nqoi eix bun yie.’+”
Douc fienx mienh nzuonx taux Yaakopv wuov gorngv, “Yie mbuo taux meih nyei gorx Esaau wuov mi'aqv. Ih zanc ninh daaih buangh meih, aengx maaih feix baeqv dauh mienh caux jienv ninh daaih.”
Yaakopv gamh nziex haic yaac nzauh haic aqv, ziouc zorqv gan ninh daaih nyei mienh caux ngongh guanh, ba'gi yungh guanh, yungh guanh, caux lorh torh bun nqoi zoux i guanh.
Ninh yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Se gorngv Esaau daaih zoux waaic daauh guanh, da'nyeic guanh corc haih biaux duqv ndutv.”

Yaakopv daux gaux gorngv, “Yie nyei ong, Apc^laa^ham, nyei Tin-Hungh caux yie nyei die, I^sakc, nyei Tin-Hungh aac. O Ziouv, meih mbuox yie nzuonx yie ganh nyei buonv-deic-bung, yie nyei cien-ceqv muoz-doic nyei dorngx. Meih yaac oix bun yie duqv longx.

Yie maiv puix meih ndongc naaiv korv-lienh, ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux bun yie, meih nyei bou. Jiex Jor^ndaen Ndaaih wuov zanc yie kungx maaih nduqc diuh biaav-mbiaac hnangv. Ih zanc yie aengx nzuonx maaih naaiv deix i guanh mienh caux saeng-kuv.
Tov meih njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei gorx, Esaau, nyei buoz-ndiev weic zuqc yie gamh nziex ninh oix daaih daix nzengc yie mbuo, liemh m'sieqv dorn caux fu'jueiv daix nzengc.
Ziouv gorngv jiex, ‘Yie oix bun meih duqv longx yaac bun meih nyei zeiv-fun ndongc koiv-hlen nyei saa-ziou camv, zungv saauv maiv zienz.’+”
Wuov muonz Yaakopv hitv wuov norm dorngx. Ninh ginv cuotv deix ninh maaih nyei ga'naaiv zoux zingh nyeic bun ninh nyei gorx, Esaau.
Ninh zorqv cuotv nyic baeqv dauh yungh nyeiz, nyic ziepc dauh yungh gouv, caux nyic baeqv dauh ba'gi yungh nyeiz, nyic ziepc dauh ba'gi yungh gouv,
caux faah ziepc dauh lorh torh dorh jienv dorn nyei, caux feix ziepc dauh ngongh nyeiz, ziepc dauh ngongh gouv, caux nyic ziepc dauh lorh nyeiz, ziepc dauh lorh gouv.

Ninh bun nqoi yietc nyungc zoux yietc guanh, yietc guanh bun yietc dauh bou goux. Ninh aengx mbuox bou, “Meih oix zuqc horngh saeng-kuv mingh ndaangc yie. Yietc guanh caux yietc guanh oix zuqc leih saa deix.”

Yaakopv yaac gorngv mbuox mingh ndaangc wuov dauh, “Buangh zuqc yie nyei gorx, Esaau, wuov zanc, ninh naaic gaax meih, ‘Meih nyei ziouv dongh haaix dauh?’ caux ‘Meih mingh haaix? Mingh ndaangc naaiv deix saeng-kuv se haaix dauh nyei?’
Oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor dau. ‘Dongh meih nyei bou, Yaakopv, nyei. Ninh fungx naaiv deix saeng-kuv daaih zoux zingh nyeic bun ninh nyei ziouv, Esaau. Yaakopv ganh yaac gan jienv nqa'haav daaih.’+”
Yaakopv njaaux ziangx da'nyeic caux da'faam aengx caux dauh dauh horngh saeng-kuv nyei mienh, “Buangh Esaau nyei ziangh hoc oix zuqc dongh joux waac gorngv.

Meih mbuo oix zuqc gorngv, ‘Meih nyei bou, Yaakopv, gan jienv yie mbuo nqa'haav daaih.’+” Weic zuqc Yaakopv yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Yie fungx zingh nyeic mingh ndaangc nunz jienv ninh nyei hnyouv. Yie duqv buatc ninh nyei hmien nziex ninh caux yie zoux horpc mv bei.”
Yaakopv fungx zingh nyeic mingh ndaangc. Ninh ganh aeqv, aengx bueix muonz wuov ndopv-liuh ciangv.
Wuov muonz Yaakopv jiez sin dorh ninh nyei i dauh auv, i dauh nouh beiz, caux ninh nyei ziepc yietv dauh fu'jueiv, yangh Yapv^mborkc Ndaaih nyei jauv-bouc jiex wuov ngaanc ziqc Yapv^mborkc Ndaaih.
Ninh aengx fungx ninh nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv jiex nzengc.
Kungx zengc ninh ganh yiem wuov hnangv. Aengx maaih dauh mienh daaih caux ninh borngz jaax taux lungh aav lamh njang.
Wuov dauh mienh haiz ninh borngz maiv hingh Yaakopv, ninh ziouc muoqv Yaakopv nyei camh zuih mbungv piatv mingh.
Wuov dauh mienh gorngv, “Bungx yie maah! Lungh njang aqv niaa.” Yaakopv dau, “Meih maiv buang waac yie nor, yie maiv bungx meih.”
Wuov dauh mienh naaic gaax, “Meih nyei mbuox heuc haaix nyungc?” Ninh dau, “Yie heuc Yaakopv.”

Wuov dauh mienh gorngv, “Yiem naaiv mingh meih nyei mbuox maiv heuc Yaakopv aqv. Meih nyei mbuox heuc I^saa^laa^en, weic zuqc meih caux Tin-Hungh borngz jaax yaac borngz duqv hingh. Caux mienh borngz jaax yaac borngz duqv hingh.”
Yaakopv gorngv, “Tov mbuox yie, meih nyei mbuox heuc haaix nyungc?” Mv baac ninh dau, “Meih weic haaix diuc naaic yie nyei mbuox?” Ninh ziouc yiem wuov buang waac Yaakopv.
Yaakopv gorngv, “Yie hmien doix hmien buatc liuz Tin-Hungh, yie corc maaih maengc ziangh nyei.” Ninh ziouc cuotv wuov norm dorngx nyei mbuox heuc Be^ni^en.
Yaakopv jiex Be^ni^en wuov zanc, mba'hnoi cuotv daaih aqv. Ninh ziouc la'mbai-la'mbai nyei mingh aqv, laaix ninh nyei camh zuih mbungv piatv mingh.
Laaix Yaakopv zuqc wuov dauh mienh muoqv ninh nyei camh zuih mbungv piatv mingh, yiem naaic daaih taux ih zanc, I^saa^laa^en Mienh maiv nyanc camh zuih mbungv nyei jaan.
Yaakopv mingh gau, buatc Esaau caux ninh nyei feix baeqv dauh mienh daaih. Ninh ziouc bun nqoi ninh nyei fu'jueiv bun Le^aa, Laasen caux i dauh nouh beiz, yietc dauh dorh deix mingh.
Ninh bun ninh nyei i dauh nouh beiz caux ninh mbuo nyei fu'jueiv mingh ndaangc. Jiex daaih maaih Le^aa caux ninh nyei fu'jueiv. Laasen caux Yosepv nqa'haav laai jiex.
Yaakopv ganh mingh ndaangc puoqv njiec taux ndau siec nzunc cingx taux fatv deix ninh nyei gorx wuov.
Mv baac Esaau tiux mingh zipv, qam jienv zom. I muoz zungv nyiemv.

Esaau cau hmien buatc wuov deix m'sieqv dorn caux fu'jueiv, ninh naaic gaax, “Gan meih daaih naaiv deix mienh se haaix dauh?” Yaakopv dau, “Naaiv deix fu'jueiv se Tin-Hungh korv-lienh yie, ceix bun yie, meih nyei bou.”
Wuov deix i dauh nouh beiz caux ninh mbuo nyei fu'jueiv ziouc daaih gueic njiec baaix.
Jiex daaih Le^aa caux ninh nyei fu'jueiv yaac daaih gueic njiec baaix. Yosepv caux Laasen nqa'haav taux yaac fih hnangv nyei gueic njiec baaix.
Esaau naaic gaax, “Yie buangh wuov deix saeng-kuv guanh maaih haaix nyungc eix leiz?” Yaakopv dau, “Ov, naaiv se weic oix bun gorx nqoi fim nqoi eix hnamv yie.”
Mv baac Esaau dau, “Youz aac, yie mv baac maaih gaux longc nyei. Meih nyei, liouh meih ganh longc aqv.”

Yaakopv gorngv, “Tov maiv dungx hnangv naaiv nor gorngv oc. Se gorngv meih nqoi eix yie nor, tov longc yie nyei zingh nyeic. Ih zanc yie buatc meih nyei hmien se hnangv buatc Tin-Hungh nyei hmien nor, weic zuqc meih maaih hnyouv zipv yie longx haic.
Tov gorx zipv yie dorh daaih nyei zingh nyeic. Tin-Hungh korv-lienh yie, bun yie maaih gaux longc.” Yaakopv gorngv gau, Esaau laengz longc mi'aqv.
Esaau gorngv, “Mbuo lomh nzoih mingh aqv. Yie mingh ndaangc dorh meih.”

Yaakopv dau, “Yie nyei ziouv yaac hiuv nyei, fu'jueiv muonc haic. Yie yaac oix zuqc hnamv taux ba'gi yungh caux yungh caux ngongh dorh jienv dorn nyei. Se gorngv horngh jienv mingh beqv nor, yietc hnoi hnangv saeng-kuv zungv daic nzengc aqv.
Meih gunv mingh ndaangc aqv. Yie nqa'haav manc-manc mingh. Se gorngv fu'jueiv caux saeng-kuv mingh duqv nor, yie mv baac gaanv jienv mingh taux yie aengx buangh meih, yie nyei ziouv, yiem Se^i Deic.”
Esaau gorngv, “Wuov nyungc, yie bun i ziex dauh yie ganh nyei mienh caux meih yiem naaiv.” Yaakopv dau, “Maiv zuqc hnangv naaic lorqc. Da'faanh duqv yie nyei ziouv nqoi eix hnangv duqv aqv.”
Wuov hnoi Esaau ziouc nzuonx Se^i Deic mi'aqv.
Mv baac Yaakopv mingh Sukc^kotv gomv biauv, zoux saeng-kuv liuh. Wuov norm dorngx ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Sukc^kotv.
Yaakopv yiem Batc^ndaan Aalam mingh taux Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, Sekem Zingh mi'aqv. Longx nyei, maiv maaih haaix nyungc. Ninh corng jienv ndopv-liuh yiem wuov zingh ga'hlen.
Corng ndopv-liuh nyei ndau ninh longc yietc baeqv kuaaiv nyaanh tengx Haamo nyei dorn mbuo, Sekem nyei die, maaiz daaih.
Yiem wuov norm dorngx ninh ceix norm ziec-dorngh aengx cuotv mbuox heuc En E^lo^he I^saa^laa^en.
Yaakopv caux Le^aa maaih dauh sieqv, mbuox heuc Ndinaa. Maaih hnoi Ndinaa cuotv mingh caux wuov norm dorngx nyei m'sieqv dorn nziaauc.
Gunv wuov norm dorngx nyei Hiwai Mienh, Haamo nyei dorn, Sekem, buatc Ndinaa ziouc nyau jienv ninh caa.
Ninh haiz hnamv naaiv dauh sieqv, Ndinaa, ziouc caux Ndinaa gorngv longx, oix nduov naaiv dauh sieqv hnamv ninh.
Sekem mbuox ninh nyei die, Haamo, “Tov die mingh tengx yie gorngv naaiv dauh sieqv oc.”

Yaakopv hiuv duqv Sekem zoux bun ninh nyei sieqv nyei mengh dauh waaic mv baac Yaakopv maiv gaengh gorngv haaix nyungc weic zuqc ninh nyei dorn mbuo yiem wuov naah bungx saeng-kuv. Ninh zuov jienv ninh nyei dorn mbuo nzuonx.
Sekem nyei die, Haamo, cuotv mingh caux Yaakopv caangh laangh.

Yaakopv nyei dorn mbuo yiem wuov naah yietv haiz naaiv deix sic ninh mbuo ziouc nzuonx daaih. Ninh mbuo haiz hnyouv waaic nzengc, qiex jiez haic Sekem hnangv naaiv nor zoux doqc caa Yaakopv nyei sieqv. Se maiv horpc zuqc zoux nyei sic yaac mangc piex haic ninh mbuo I^saa^laa^en Mienh.
Haamo gorngv mbuox Yaakopv mbuo dorn-diex doic, “Yie nyei dorn, Sekem, hnamv haic naaiv dauh sieqv. Tov meih mbuo bun naaiv dauh sieqv yie nyei dorn longc zoux auv.
Yiem naaiv mingh mbuo lomh nzoih jiu tong. Bungx meih mbuo nyei sieqv bun yie mbuo nyei dorn longc, yaac dorh yie mbuo nyei sieqv bun meih mbuo nyei dorn longc.
Hnangv naaiv meih mbuo haih caux yie mbuo juangc deic-bung yiem. Meih mbuo oix yiem haaix norm dorngx, gunv yiem duqv nyei, aengx lorz ndau liepc ganh nyei nguaaz-gorn, bieqc cuotv zoux saeng-eix.”
Sekem yaac gorngv mbuox Ndinaa nyei die caux ninh nyei gorx mbuo, “Tov meih mbuo nqoi fim nqoi eix yie. Meih mbuo oix longc haaix nyungc yie ziouc bun.
Oix longc leiz-ging caux zingh nyeic mbu'ziex gunv gorngv maah! Meih mbuo oix longc haaix nyungc mbu'ziex yie bun nzengc, da'faanh duqv meih mbuo nyei sieqv hnangv.”
Laaix Sekem zoux waaic ninh mbuo nyei muoc, Ndinaa, nyei mengh dauh, Yaakopv nyei dorn mbuo nduov Sekem caux ninh nyei die, Haamo.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo maiv haih bungx yie mbuo nyei muoc bun maiv jiex gaatv nyei leiz nyei mienh longc. Hnangv naaiv zoux, yie mbuo nyei mengh dauh waaic nzengc aqv.
Yie mbuo maaih nduqc diuh leiz hnangv cingx haih laengz bun, se meih mbuo dauh dauh m'jangc dorn oix zuqc hnangv yie mbuo nor, jiex gaatv nyei leiz nzengc.
Hnangv naaic yie mbuo ziouc haih bungx yie mbuo nyei sieqv bun meih mbuo, yaac dorh meih mbuo nyei sieqv daaih longc zoux auv. Yie mbuo yaac haih caux meih mbuo juangc deic-bung yiem.
Mv baac se gorngv meih mbuo maiv muangx yie mbuo, maiv jiex gaatv nyei leiz nzengc, yie mbuo dorh yie mbuo nyei muoc biaux aqv.”
Haamo caux ninh nyei dorn, Sekem, haiz naaiv deix waac horpc hnyouv nyei.
Wuov dauh dorn ziouc maiv ngaih, ei jienv Yaakopv nyei dorn mbuo nyei waac gaanv jienv zoux, weic zuqc ninh hnamv haic Yaakopv nyei sieqv. Ninh mbuo yietc zungv muoz-doic se Sekem zoux gauh hlo jiex.
Haamo caux ninh nyei dorn, Sekem, ziouc mingh zingh gaengh ndaangc caux yietc norm zingh nyei gorx-youz gorngv.

Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Naaiv deix mienh caux mbuo zoux gorx-youz doic. Mbuo oix zuqc bun ninh mbuo caux mbuo juangc deic-bung yiem, bieqc cuotv maaiz maaic. Mbuo nyei deic-bung jangv nyei, gaux duqv bun ninh mbuo yiem nyei. Mbuo yaac haih longc ninh mbuo nyei sieqv. Ninh mbuo yaac haih longc mbuo nyei sieqv.

Naaiv deix mienh a'hneiv caux mbuo juangc deic-bung yiem, benx yietc fingx, mv baac maaih yietc diuc ninh mbuo cingx daaih laengz, se mbuo dauh dauh m'jangc dorn oix zuqc hnangv ninh mbuo nor, jiex gaatv nyei leiz.
Ninh mbuo nyei saeng-kuv, ninh mbuo maaih nyei nyungc-nyungc ga'naaiv ziouc benx mbuo nyei maiv zeiz? Tov bun mbuo hnangv naaiv nor zoux. Ninh mbuo ziouc caux mbuo yiem naaiv aqv.”
Wuov norm zingh nyei yietc zuangx gorx-youz buangv hnyouv Haamo caux Sekem nyei waac. Zingh gu'nyuoz nyei yietc zungv m'jangc dorn ziouc jiex gaatv nyei leiz nzengc.

Jiex liuz gaatv nyei leiz da'faam hnoi wuov hnoi, wuov deix m'jangc dorn corc mun jienv nyei. I dauh Yaakopv nyei dorn, Ndinaa nyei gorx, Si^me^on caux Lewi, buix jienv nzuqc ndaauv bieqc zingh, liemh maiv maaih haaix dauh gouv nyeih. Ninh mbuo ziouc bieqc mingh daix nzengc wuov norm zingh nyei m'jangc dorn.
Liemh Haamo caux Sekem i dorn-diex, ninh mbuo yaac daix guangc mi'aqv. Yaac dorh Ndinaa yiem Sekem nyei biauv cuotv mingh mi'aqv.
Yaakopv nyei dorn mbuo bieqc naaiv deix zuqc daix daic nyei mienh nyei biauv, luv nzengc wuov norm zingh, laaix wuov norm zingh nyei mienh zoux bun ninh mbuo nyei muoc nyei mengh dauh waaic.
Ninh mbuo zorqv ba'gi yungh, yungh, ngongh, lorh, yietc zungv ga'naaiv. Maiv gunv yiem zingh fai yiem ndeic, ninh mbuo zorqv nzengc mi'aqv.
Haaix nyungc maaih jaax-zinh nyei ga'naaiv ninh mbuo yaac zorqv nzengc. Liemh m'sieqv dorn, liemh fu'jueiv yaac dorh jienv mingh. Liemh ninh mbuo nyei jaa-dingh yaac luv njang nzengc mi'aqv.

Yaakopv mbuox Si^me^on caux Lewi, “Meih mbuo hnangv naaiv nor zoux oix bun yie zuqc sic, zuqc Kaa^naa^an Mienh, Be^litv^si Mienh caux yietc zungv yiem naaiv norm deic-bung nyei mienh nzorng yie aqv. Mbuo yaac maiv maaih mienh camv. Se gorngv wuov deix mienh gapv qaqv daaih mborqv yie nor, yie caux yie nyei biauv zong mienh ziouc zuqc mietc nzengc.”
Ninh nyei dorn mbuo dau, “Yie mbuo maiv bun ninh zoux bun yie mbuo nyei muoc dorngx maaic buonv-sin nyei m'sieqv dorn.”

Tin-Hungh gorngv mbuox Yaakopv, “Ih zanc meih oix zuqc suiv mingh yiem Mbetc^en. Yiem wuov oix zuqc ceix norm ziec-dorngh weic yie, dongh zinh ndaangc meih biaux meih nyei gorx, Esaau, wuov zanc hinc cuotv daaih bun meih buatc nyei Tin-Hungh.”

Yaakopv ziouc mbuox ninh nyei hmuangv doic aengx caux ninh yiem wuov deix mienh, “Meih mbuo maaih ganh fingx nyei haaix nyungc miuc-fangx oix zuqc guangc taux nzengc. Oix zuqc saax nzengc uix, yienc lui-houx.

Mbuo oix zuqc leih nqoi naaiv norm dorngx mingh yiem Mbetc^en. Taux wuov yie oix ceix norm ziec-dorngh weic Tin-Hungh, dongh zinh ndaangc yie buangh zuqc kouv naanc ninh tengx yie, yie mingh taux haaix ninh yaac caux yie mingh, wuov dauh Tin-Hungh.”

Ninh mbuo yietc zungv ziouc zorqv ninh mbuo maaih nyei ganh fingx mienh nyei miuc-fangx caux dangh jienv nyei m'normh hiun, jiu bun Yaakopv. Yaakopv ziouc biopv jienv domh mba'ong zuei ndiangx-gorn ndiev, leih Sekem Zingh maiv nangc go.
Yaakopv caux gan ninh nyei zuangx mienh cuotv jauv mingh wuov zanc, Tin-Hungh bun huing nzuonx wuov deix zingh nyei mienh gamh nziex haic, ziouc maiv zunc Yaakopv nyei dorn mbuo.
Yaakopv caux yietc zungv gan ninh nyei mienh mingh taux Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, Lutv Zingh, (se Mbetc^en Zingh).
Taux wuov ninh ceix norm ziec-dorngh daaih aengx cuotv wuov norm dorngx nyei mbuox heuc En Mbetc^en, weic zuqc biaux ninh nyei gorx, Esaau, wuov zanc, Tin-Hungh yiem wuov hinc cuotv bun ninh buatc.

Dongh zinh ndaangc dorh Le^mbe^kaa hlo daaih wuov dauh bou, Nde^mbo^laa, guei seix mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo ziouc zangx jienv yiem Mbetc^en nyei naamh bung, yietc diuh domh mba'ong zuei ndiangx-gorn hlen. Wuov diuh ndiangx ninh mbuo cuotv norm mbuox heuc Anlon Mbaakutv.
Yaakopv yiem Batc^ndaan Aalam Deic nzuonx daaih, Tin-Hungh aengx hinc cuotv nzunc, buang waac bun ninh.
Tin-Hungh mbuox ninh, “Meih nyei mbuox heuc Yaakopv mv baac yangh naaiv jiex meih nyei mbuox oix zuqc goiv heuc I^saa^laa^en.” Hnangv naaiv ninh ziouc duqv mbuox heuc I^saa^laa^en.

Tin-Hungh aengx gorngv, “Yie se Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh. Meih oix zuqc maaih fu'jueiv camv. Meih nyei zeiv-fun oix hiaangx daaih benx yietc fingx caux camv-guoqv nyei fingx. Maaih deix meih nyei zeiv-fun yaac oix duqv zoux hungh.
Yie jiu bun Apc^laa^ham caux I^sakc nyei deic-bung, yie yaac jiu bun meih caux meih nyei hoz doic zeiv-fun.”
Gorngv liuz, Tin-Hungh ziouc yiem wuov norm dorngx faaux mingh mi'aqv.
Yaakopv zorqv norm la'bieiv don jienv Tin-Hungh caux ninh gorngv waac nyei dorngx, yaac zorqv a'ngunc diuv ciev dongc gu'nguaaic, yaac zorqv ga'lanv youh dox jienv.
Ninh aengx cuotv wuov norm dorngx nyei mbuox heuc Mbetc^en.
Yaakopv mbuo yiem Mbetc^en cuotv jauv mingh. Corc leih E^faa^laa^taa Mungv go deix nyei, Laasen taux ziangh hoc ndutv sin. Ninh mun kouv, aqc duqv yungz haic.
Mun kouv jiex nyei ziangh hoc, goux ninh wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn gorngv, “Meih maiv dungx gamh nziex oc. Naaiv dauh gu'nguaaz se dorn.”
Laasen aav lamh daic wuov zanc, ninh aengx tauv cuotv nzunc qiex, tengx ninh nyei dorn cuotv mbuox heuc Mben^o^ni. Mv baac Yaakopv cuotv mbuox heuc Mben^yaa^min.
Laasen daic mi'aqv, zangx jienv mingh E^faa^laa^taa nyei jauv-hlen. (E^faa^laa^taa aengx maaih norm mbuox heuc Mbetc^le^hem.)
Yaakopv zorqv norm la'bieiv don jienv Laasen nyei zouv zoux jangx-hoc. Wuov norm la'bieiv yiem taux ih jaax hnoi.
I^saa^laa^en mbuo aengx suiv mingh corng ndopv-liuh yiem E^nde Fanh Taapv nyei wuov ndaangc maengx.
Yiem gau wuov norm deic-bung, gb I^saa^laa^en nyei dorn, Lu^mben, caux ninh nyei maa-faix, Mbin^haa, maaih jauv. Ninh nyei die hiuv mi'aqv. Yaakopv maaih ziepc nyeic dauh dorn.
