Le^aa nyei dorn maaih Lu^mben. Lu^mben se Yaakopv nyei dorn-hlo. Aengx maaih Si^me^on, Lewi, Yu^ndaa, Itc^saax^kaa, caux Se^mbu^lun.
Laasen nyei dorn maaih Yosepv caux Mben^yaa^min.
Laasen nyei nouh beiz, Mbin^haa, nyei dorn maaih Ndaan caux Napv^taa^li.
Le^aa nyei nouh beiz, Sinx^baa, nyei dorn maaih Gaatc caux Aa^se. Naaiv deix yietc zungv dorn, Yaakopv yiem Batc^ndaan Aalam duqv daaih.
Yaakopv nzuonx taux ninh nyei die, I^sakc, yiem Mamle, nitv Ki^li^yaatv Aan^mbaa, (se He^mbo^lon, dongh zinh ndaangc Apc^laa^ham caux I^sakc yiem nyei dorngx).
I^sakc ziangh duqv yietc baeqv betv ziepc hnyangx.
Ninh ziangh duqv siouc nyuonh ndaauv, hnyangx-jeiv gox haic, ziouc dangx qiex, guei seix mi'aqv. Ninh nyei i dauh dorn, Esaau caux Yaakopv, dorh ninh nyei sei mingh zangx.
Yiem naaiv mingh gorngv Esaau nyei zeiv-fun. Esaau aengx maaih norm mbuox heuc E^ndom.
Esaau nyei auv se Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung nyei sieqv. Maaih dauh se Hitv^tai Mienh, Elon nyei sieqv, Aa^ndaa. Maaih dauh Hiwai Mienh, Si^mbe^on, nyei fun, se Aanaa nyei sieqv, O^ho^li^mbaa^maa.
Esaau aengx longc I^saa^maa^en nyei sieqv, Ne^mbaa^yotv nyei muoc, Mbaa^se^matv.
Aa^ndaa yungz duqv E^li^fatv bun Esaau. Mbaa^se^matv yungz duqv Le^u^en.
O^ho^li^mbaa^maa yungz duqv Ye^utc, Yaalaam caux Kolaa. Naaiv deix se Esaau nyei dorn, yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung yungz daaih.

Esaau dorh jienv ninh nyei auv, ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei sieqv, ninh nyei yietc zungv biauv zong mienh, ngongh, yungh, saeng-kuv caux yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung zornc daaih nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv ziouc caux ninh nyei youz, Yaakopv, bun nqoi doic mingh yiem ganh norm deic-bung.
Ninh mbuo i muoz maaih jaa-dingh camv haic, juangc dorngx yiem maiv duqv. Dorngx-daauh hepc, maiv gaux yungz ninh mbuo nyei saeng-kuv.
Esaau (se E^ndom) ziouc biaux mingh yiem Se^i Deic nyei mbong-aiv dorngx.
Yiem naaiv mingh gorngv yiem Se^i Deic nyei mbong-aiv dorngx, E^ndom Mienh nyei ong-taaix, Esaau, nyei zeiv-fun.
Naaiv se Esaau nyei dorn nyei mbuox. Maaih Esaau nyei auv, Aa^ndaa, nyei dorn, E^li^fatv, caux Esaau nyei auv, Mbaa^se^matv, nyei dorn, Le^u^en.
E^li^fatv nyei dorn maaih Temaan, Omaa, Sefo, Gaataam caux Kenatv.

Esaau nyei dorn, E^li^fatv, aengx maaih dauh auv-dorn, mbuox heuc Timnaa. Timnaa yungz duqv dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Aa^maa^lekv, bun E^li^fatv. Naaiv deix dorn yietc zungv zoux Esaau nyei auv, Aa^ndaa, nyei fun.
Le^u^en nyei dorn maaih Naa^hatc, Zelaa, Sammaa caux Mitv^saa. Naaiv se Esaau nyei auv, Mbaa^se^matv, nyei fun.
Esaau nyei auv, Si^mbe^on nyei dorn, Aanaa, nyei sieqv, O^ho^li^mbaa^maa, yungz duqv buo dauh dorn bun Esaau. Maaih Ye^utc, Yaalaam caux Kolaa.
Naaiv se Esaau nyei zeiv-fun zoux bieiv zeiv nyei mienh. Maaih Esaau nyei dorn-hlo, E^li^fatv nyei dorn, Temaan, Omaa, Sefo, Kenatv,
Kolaa, Gaataam, caux Aa^maa^lekv. Naaiv se yiem E^ndom Deic-Bung gan E^li^fatv cuotv nyei bieiv zeiv, se Esaau nyei auv, Aa^ndaa, nyei fun.
Maaih Esaau nyei dorn, Le^u^en, nyei dorn Naa^hatc, Zelaa, Sammaa caux Mitv^saa. Naaiv se yiem E^ndom Deic-Bung gan Le^u^en cuotv nyei bieiv zeiv, se Esaau nyei auv, Mbaa^se^matv, nyei fun.
Maaih Esaau nyei auv, O^ho^li^mbaa^maa, nyei dorn, Ye^utc, Yaalaam caux Kolaa. Naaiv se yiem Esaau nyei auv, Aanaa nyei sieqv, O^ho^li^mbaa^maa, cuotv nyei bieiv zeiv.
Naaiv deix yietc zungv se Esaau (dongh E^ndom) nyei dorn caux yiem Esaau cuotv daaih nyei bieiv zeiv.
Naaiv se yiem wuov norm deic-bung nyei Holi Mienh, Se^i nyei dorn. Maaih Lotaan, So^mbaan, Si^mbe^on, Aanaa,
Ndison, E^se caux Ndisaan. Naaiv deix mienh se yiem E^ndom Deic, Se^i nyei zeiv-fun, Holi Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv.
Lotaan nyei dorn maaih Holi caux Homam. Lotaan nyei muoc heuc Timnaa.
So^mbaan nyei dorn maaih Anwaan, Maa^naa^haatv, E^mbaan, Qefo caux Onam.
Si^mbe^on nyei dorn maaih Aiyaa caux Aanaa. Dongh naaiv dauh Aanaa yiem deic-bung-huaang tengx ninh nyei die, Si^mbe^on, bungx lorh wuov zanc buatc zingv wuom-jorm.
Aanaa nyei dorn heuc Ndison. Aanaa yaac maaih dauh sieqv heuc O^ho^li^mbaa^maa.
Ndison nyei dorn maaih Hem^ndaan, Etc^mbaan, Itc^laan caux Kelaan.
E^se nyei dorn maaih Mbin^haan, Saax^waan caux Aakaanx.
Ndisaan nyei dorn maaih Utc caux Aalan.
Naaiv se Holi Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv. Maaih Lotaan, So^mbaan, Si^mbe^on, Aanaa,
Ndison, E^se caux Ndisaan. Naaiv deix yietc zungv se yiem Se^i Deic-Bung, Holi Mienh, ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.
Zinh ndaangc I^saa^laa^en Mienh maiv gaengh maaih hungh diex gunv, E^ndom Deic-Bung maaih hungh diex gunv nyei.
Mbe^o nyei dorn, Mbelaa, duqv zoux E^ndom nyei hungh. Ninh nyei domh zingh heuc Ndin^haa^mbaa.
Mbelaa guei seix, aengx maaih yiem Mbo^saa^laa Zingh daaih wuov dauh Zelaa nyei dorn, Yo^mbapc, duqv nzipc zoux hungh.
Yo^mbapc guei seix, aengx maaih yiem Temaan Deic-Bung daaih wuov dauh Husaam duqv nzipc zoux hungh.
Husaam guei seix, aengx maaih Mbe^ndatc nyei dorn, Haa^ndatc, duqv nzipc zoux hungh. Haa^ndatc dongh yiem Mo^apc Deic mborqv hingh Mi^ndien Mienh wuov dauh. Ninh nyei domh zingh heuc Aawitv.
Haa^ndatc guei seix, aengx maaih yiem Matv^le^kaa Zingh daaih wuov dauh Samx^laa duqv nzipc zoux hungh.
Samx^laa guei seix, aengx maaih yiem Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih hlen nyei Le^hox^mbotc Zingh daaih wuov dauh Saa^un duqv nzipc zoux hungh.
Saa^un guei seix, Akc^mbo nyei dorn, Mbaa^an Haanan, duqv nzipc zoux hungh.

Akc^mbo nyei dorn, Mbaa^an Haanan, guei seix, Haa^ndaa duqv nzipc zoux hungh. Ninh nyei domh zingh heuc Baa^u. Ninh nyei auv heuc Me^he^taa^mben. Me^he^taa^mben zoux Matv^letv nyei sieqv, Me^saa^hapc nyei fun.
Yiem naaiv mingh se yiem Esaau bun njiec nyei bieiv zeiv ziux ninh mbuo nyei mbuox, ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc caux ninh mbuo yiem nyei dorngx. Maaih Timnaa, Anwaa, Yetetv,
O^ho^li^mbaa^maa, Elaa. Binon,
Kenatv, Temaan, Mipv^saa,
Makv^ndi^en, I^laam. Naaiv se E^ndom nyei bieiv zeiv ziux ninh mbuo yiem nyei deic liepc ninh mbuo nyei nguaaz-gorn nyei dorngx. Naaiv se E^ndom Mienh nyei ong-taaix, Esaau, nyei zeiv-fun.
Yaakopv corc yiem jienv zinh ndaangc ninh nyei die yiem wuov norm deic-bung, se Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung.

Yiem naaiv mingh gorngv Yaakopv nyei dorn-jueiv nyei jauv-louc. Yosepv benx mienh lunx mienh, duqv ziepc cietv hnyangx wuov zanc, ninh caux ninh nyei gorx, se ninh nyei die nyei auv, Mbin^haa caux Sinx^baa, nyei dorn mbuo bungx ba'gi yungh caux yungh. Yosepv dorh ninh nyei gorx mbuo zoux maiv benx nyei jauv mingh gorngv mbuox ninh nyei die.
I^saa^laa^en hnamv Yosepv gauh camv jiex ninh nyei yietc zungv dorn, weic zuqc ninh gox aqv, cingx duqv Yosepv daaih. Ninh lunh deix lui-ndaauv, lui-mueiz yaac ndaauv, bun Yosepv.
Yosepv nyei gorx mbuo buatc ninh mbuo nyei die hnamv Yosepv gauh camv hnamv ninh mbuo, ninh mbuo ziouc nzorng Yosepv. Caux ninh gorngv waac yaac maiv maaih waac longx aqv.
Maaih nzunc Yosepv mbeix buatc, yaac gorngv ninh nyei mbeix bun ninh nyei gorx mbuo muangx. Ninh mbuo ziouc gauh fatv nzorng ninh aqv.
Yosepv gorngv, “Gorx mbuo muangx yie gorngv yie nyei mbeix oc.
Yie mbeix buatc mbuo yiem ndeic sai mbiauh zeiv. Yie nyei mbiauh zeiv ganh jiez sin daaih don jienv. Gorx mbuo nyei mbiauh zeiv yaac jiez daaih weih gormx yie nyei mbiauh zeiv baaix.”

Ninh nyei gorx mbuo naaic gaax ninh, “Meih gengh oix zoux yie mbuo nyei hungh? Oix gunv yie mbuo?” Laaix Yosepv mbeix nyei mbeix caux ninh gorngv nyei waac, ninh nyei gorx mbuo gauh fatv nzorng ninh aqv.

Nqa'haav Yosepv aengx mbeix buatc nzunc yaac gorngv bun ninh nyei gorx mbuo muangx. Ninh gorngv, “Yie aengx mbeix buatc. Naaiv nzunc yie buatc mba'hnoi caux hlaax caux ziepc yietv norm hleix yietc zungv baaix yie.”

Ninh aengx gorngv naaiv norm mbeix bun ninh nyei die, ninh nyei gorx mbuo muangx. Ninh nyei die gorngv-hemx ninh, “Naaiv haaix nyungc mbeix laeh? Meih hnamv daaih meih nyei maa caux yie caux meih nyei gorx mbuo yietc zungv oix zuqc puoqv njiec taux ndau baaix meih?”
Yosepv nyei gorx mbuo gengh mueic jieqv ninh, mv baac ninh nyei die haaix zanc yaac jangx jienv naaiv deix jauv-louc.
Yosepv nyei gorx mbuo dorh ninh mbuo nyei die nyei ba'gi yungh caux yungh guanh mingh Sekem bungx.
I^saa^laa^en ziouc gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Meih nyei gorx mbuo yiem Sekem bungx yungh. Meih mingh meih nyei gorx wuov oc.” Yosepv dau, “Mingh nyei.”

Ninh nyei die mbuox ninh, “Yie oix meih mingh mangc gaax meih nyei gorx mbuo longx nyei fai? Yungh longx nyei fai? Mangc liuz nzuonx daaih mbuox die oc.” Ninh nyei die ziouc mbuox ninh mingh, ninh ziouc yiem He^mbo^lon Horngc cuotv jauv mingh Sekem. Yosepv mingh taux Sekem,
Maaih dauh mienh buangh zuqc ninh yiem lomc-huaang jiex naaiv jiex wuov nyei, ziouc naaic gaax ninh, “Meih lorz haaix nyungc?”
Yosepv dau, “Yie lorz yie nyei gorx mbuo. Meih hiuv duqv ninh mbuo yiem haaix bungx yungh, tov mbuox yie oc.”
Wuov dauh mienh gorngv, “Ninh mbuo suiv dorngx mi'aqv. Yie haiz ninh mbuo gorngv oix suiv mingh Ndotaan.” Yosepv ziouc mingh lorz ninh nyei gorx mbuo, lorz buatc yiem Ndotaan.
Ninh nyei gorx mbuo buatc Yosepv corc yiem go nyei. Daaih maiv gaengh taux, ninh mbuo ziouc lomh nzoih caangh laangh daav za'eix daix.
Laanh mbuox laanh, “Wuov dauh ga'naaiv-mbeix mbeix daaih aqv loh!
Mbuo lomh nzoih mingh zorqv ninh daix guangc aqv. Daix dapv jienv wuom-kuotv-nqaai. Mbuo ziouc gorngv ga'naaiv ngaatc mi'aqv. Mbuo mangc gaax ninh nyei mbeix ndongc haaix lingh?”
Lu^mben haiz ninh youz mbuo hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, ninh oix lorz jauv njoux Yosepv cuotv ninh mbuo nyei buoz-ndiev. Ninh ziouc gorngv, “Mbuo maiv dungx daix ninh.”

Lu^mben aengx mbuox ninh mbuo, “Maiv dungx bun yietc deix nziaamv cuotv. Zorqv ninh dapv naaiv deic-bung-huaang nyei wuom-kuotv-nqaai duqv aqv. Mv baac maiv dungx zoux haaix nyungc hoic ninh.” Lu^mben hnangv naaiv nor gorngv weic oix njoux Yosepv cuotv ninh youz mbuo nyei buoz-ndiev aengx fungx nzuonx bun ninh nyei die.
Yosepv daaih taux, ninh nyei gorx mbuo ziouc caa jienv zorqv ninh nyei lui ndaauv, dongh maaih lui-mueiz-ndaauv wuov deix lui, ciev guangc mingh,
aengx zorqv ninh fongv ndortv wuom-kuotv. Wuov norm kuotv maiv maaih wuom.

Yosepv nyei gorx mbuo zueiz jienv nyanc hnaangx wuov zanc, ninh mbuo cau hmien mangc buatc guanh I^saa^maa^en Mienh yiem Gi^le^aatc daaih oix mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung. Ninh mbuo nyei lorh torh tor jienv ndiangx-zung ndaang caux ndie-ndaang caux mu^yorc.
Yu^ndaa gorngv mbuox ninh nyei muoz-doic, “Se gorngv mbuo daix guangc mbuo nyei youz aengx lorz jauv bingx yie mbuo zoux nyei sic, mbuo duqv haaix nyungc?
Mbuo oix zuqc maaic bun naaiv deix I^saa^maa^en Mienh gauh longx daix guangc. Ninh zoux mbuo nyei youz, caux mbuo juangc nziaamv-fei.” Ninh nyei muoz-doic buatc horpc nyei.

Wuov deix zoux saeng-eix nyei Mi^ndien Mienh jiex jauv taux wuov. Yosepv nyei gorx mbuo ziouc cie Yosepv cuotv kuotv daaih maaic bun naaiv deix I^saa^maa^en Mienh, duqv luoqc lungz nyaanh. Wuov deix saeng-eix mienh ziouc dorh Yosepv mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung aqv.
Lu^mben daaih taux wuov norm kuotv, yaac maiv buatc Yosepv mi'aqv. Ninh nzauh haic ziouc betv ganh nyei lui.
Ninh nzuonx ninh nyei youz mbuo wuov gorngv, “Wuov dauh dorn maiv yiem naaiv aqv loh! Yie oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor zoux?”
Ninh mbuo ziouc daix dauh yungh gouv aengx zorqv Yosepv nyei lui-ndaauv, dongh maaih lui-mueiz-ndaauv wuov deix, ziemx yungh nyei nziaamv,
aengx dorh nzuonx bun ninh nyei die mangc. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo lorz buatc naaiv deix lui. Die mangc gaax, meih nyei dorn nyei lui saah?”
Yaakopv zieqv duqv nyei. Ninh gorngv, “Naaiv za'gengh! yie nyei dorn nyei lui. Za'gengh! ga'naaiv ngaatc, ga'naaiv betv mi'aqv lorqc.”
Yaakopv nzauh haic, betv ninh ganh nyei lui aengx zorqv la'maah ndie-cou sai jienv jaaiv. Ninh nzauh haic, nyiemv ninh nyei dorn ziex laaic lauh.

Ninh nyei dorn ninh nyei sieqv mbuo yietc zungv kuinx ninh, “Maiv dungx nyiemv,” mv baac ninh maiv muangx. Ninh gorngv, “Maiv dungx gorngv aqv. Yie oix zuqc nzauh taux daic mingh caux yie nyei dorn yiem yiemh gen.” Ninh corc nzauh jienv, weic ninh nyei dorn nyiemv.
Dongh wuov zanc yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung wuov deix zoux saeng-eix nyei Mi^ndien Mienh aengx maaic Yosepv bun hungh diex nyei yietc dauh jien, se goux hungh dinc nyei domh baeng-bieiv, Bo^ti^faa, mi'aqv.
Dongh wuov zanc, Yu^ndaa leih nqoi ninh nyei muoz-doic, biaux mingh gan dauh Aa^ndun^lam Mienh, mbuox heuc Hilaa.
Yiem wuov Yu^ndaa buangh dauh Kaa^naa^an Mienh, Qu^aa, nyei sieqv, ziouc longc zoux auv. Longc jienv,
ninh nyei auv ziouc maaih jienv sin aqv, yungz duqv dauh dorn, cuotv mbuox heuc E^aa.
Ninh nyei auv aengx maaih da'nyeic nzunc sin, yungz duqv dauh dorn, cuotv mbuox heuc Onan.
Nqa'haav aengx yungz dauh dorn, cuotv mbuox heuc Qelaa. Qelaa cuotv seix wuov zanc Yu^ndaa yiem Kesipv.
Yu^ndaa tengx ninh nyei dorn-hlo, E^aa, lorz duqv dauh auv, mbuox heuc Taamaa.
Mv baac ziux Ziouv mangc, E^aa waaic haic. Ziouv ziouc bun ninh daic mi'aqv.
Yu^ndaa aengx gorngv mbuox Onan, “Meih oix zuqc mingh caux meih nyei nyaam bueix weic zoux youz nyei leiz-nyeic, duqv fu'jueiv tengx meih nyei gorx maaih hoz doic zeiv-fun.”

Onan hiuv duqv yungz duqv fu'jueiv mv baac maiv funx ninh nyei buonc. Hnangv naaic, haaix zanc caux ninh nyei nyaam bueix, ninh duqv-eix bungx ninh nyei nyim ndortv ga'ndiev ndau weic maiv bun gorx maaih hoz doic zeiv-fun.
Ziux Ziouv mangc, Onan zoux nyei sic se waaic haic. Ziouv yaac bun ninh daic mi'aqv.

Yu^ndaa gorngv mbuox ninh nyei mbuangz, Taamaa, “Nzuonx mingh caux meih nyei die yiem aqv. Meih oix zuqc zoux auv-guaav zuov yie nyei dorn, Qelaa, hlo daaih.” Yu^ndaa hnangv naaiv nor gorngv weic zuqc ninh yiem hnyouv hnamv nzauh heix Qelaa daic hnangv ninh nyei gorx mbuo nor. Taamaa ziouc nzuonx ninh nyei die nyei biauv mi'aqv.

Jiex daaih, Yu^ndaa nyei auv, Qu^aa nyei sieqv, guei seix mi'aqv. Zuov nzauh nyei ziangh hoc jiex liuz, Yu^ndaa caux ninh nyei loz-gaeng doic, Aa^ndun^lam Mienh, Hilaa, mingh Tim^naa^haa, maaih mienh tengx japv ninh nyei ba'gi yungh biei wuov norm dorngx.
Maaih mienh mbuox Taamaa, “Meih nyei ong-buoc oix mingh Tim^naa^haa japv ba'gi yungh biei.”

Taamaa ziouc yienc nqoi ninh nyei auv-guaav lui-houx, zorqv kuaaiv ndie buix jienv, mbiorngz jienv hmien. Zorng ziangx, ninh zueiz jienv mingh Tim^naa^haa nyei jauv-hlen, bieqc E^naa^im Mungv nyei zingh gaengh ndaangc. Ninh hiuv duqv Yu^ndaa nyei dorn-laai, Qelaa, hlo aqv, mv baac Yu^ndaa maiv bun ninh longc.
Yu^ndaa buatc Taamaa, laaic ninh zoux maaic buonv-sin nyei m'sieqv dorn, weic zuqc ninh maaih ndie mbiorngz jienv hmien.

Yu^ndaa mingh wuov jauv-hlen caux ninh gorngv waac. Ninh gorngv, “Daaih maah! Bun yie caux meih bueix oc.” Yu^ndaa maiv hiuv duqv se ninh nyei mbuangz. Taamaa naaic, “Yie caux meih bueix, meih bun haaix nyungc yie?”
Yu^ndaa dau, “Yie oix zorqv dauh yie nyei yungh guanh nyei yungh dorn bun meih.” Taamaa dau, “Meih oix longc haaix nyungc dingc jienv ndaangc taux meih fungx yungh dorn daaih?”

Yu^ndaa naaic gaax, “Meih oix yie dingc haaix nyungc ndaangc gauh longx?” Taamaa gorngv, “Oix zuqc bun meih nyei yienx caux ndiux yienx nyei hlaang aengx caux meih ih zanc nanv jienv naaiv diuh biaav-mbiaac.” Yu^ndaa ziouc zorqv daaih bun ninh mi'aqv. Bun jienv ziouc caux ninh bueix. Nqa'haav Taamaa maaih jienv Yu^ndaa nyei gu'nguaaz aqv.
Taamaa nzuonx mingh zorqv nqoi mbiorngz hmien nyei ndie aengx zuqv jienv ninh nyei auv-guaav nyei lui-houx hnangv loz wuov nor.
Yu^ndaa mbuox ninh nyei loz-gaeng doic, wuov dauh Aa^ndun^lam Mienh, Hilaa, dorh yungh dorn mingh zuoqc ninh dingc wuov deix ga'naaiv nzuonx. Hilaa mingh gau, lorz maiv buatc wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn.

Ninh ziouc naaic gaax wuov norm dorngx nyei mienh, “Yiem E^naa^im Mungv nyei jauv-hlen wuov dauh maaic buonv-sin nyei m'sieqv dorn jiex haaix mi'aqv.” Ninh mbuo dau, “Yiem naaiv maiv maaih maaic buonv-sin nyei m'sieqv dorn.”
Hilaa ziouc nzuonx mingh mbuox Yu^ndaa, “Yie lorz maiv buatc wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn. Yiem wuov nyei mienh yaac gorngv yiem naaic maiv maaih jiex maaic buonv-sin nyei m'sieqv dorn.”
Yu^ndaa gorngv, “Wuov deix ga'naaiv cinh ninh longc aqv. Nziex mienh oix jatv mbuo mv bei. Dorh yungh dorn mingh oix bun yaac lorz maiv buatc ninh bun.”

Nqa'haav aav lamh deix buo hlaax nyieqc nyei dorngx, maaih mienh mbuox Yu^ndaa, “Meih nyei mbuangz, Taamaa, hienx nqox. Ih zanc toi gu'nguaaz aqv.” Yu^ndaa gorngv, “Dorh ninh cuotv daaih buov guangc maah!”

Dorh Taamaa cuotv daaih wuov zanc, Taamaa juix waac mingh mbuox ninh nyei ong-buoc, “Hienx yie toi gu'nguaaz se dongh naaiv deix ga'naaiv nyei ziouv. Longx-longx nyei mangc gaax. Naaiv norm yienx, hlaang caux biaav-mbiaac se haaix dauh nyei?”

Yu^ndaa zieqv duqv naaiv deix ga'naaiv se ninh nyei. Ninh gorngv, “Naaiv dauh m'sieqv dorn zoux nyei se gauh horpc yie zoux nyei, weic zuqc yie maiv bun ninh longc yie nyei dorn, Qelaa.” Nqa'haav Yu^ndaa yietc liuz maiv caux ninh bueix.
Taux yungz nyei ziangh hoc buatc Taamaa maaih sung-gu'nguaaz.
Mun jienv wuov zanc, maaih dauh nyei buoz cuotv ndaangc. Goux Taamaa wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn zorqv diuh fei-siqv ndoh jienv gu'nguaaz nyei buoz-sei-jaang aengx gorngv, “Naaiv dauh cuotv seix ndaangc.”

Mv baac gu'nguaaz aengx hluotv ninh nyei buoz bieqc, da'nyeic dauh ziouc yungz cuotv ndaangc. Goux Taamaa wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn gorngv, “Zoux haaix nyungc meih mbengx cuotv ndaangc laeh?” Wuov dauh dorn ninh mbuo ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Beletv.
Ndoh jienv fei-siqv wuov dauh dorn nqa'haav yungz yaac cuotv mbuox heuc Zelaa.
I^saa^maa^en Mienh dorh Yosepv mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung maaic bun dauh I^yipv Mienh, se Faalo Hungh nyei domh jien, dongh goux hungh dinc nyei domh baeng-bieiv, Bo^ti^faa.
Ninh yiem ninh nyei I^yipv Mienh biauv-ziouv nyei biauv. Ziouv caux Yosepv yiem, bun ninh duqv longx.
Wuov dauh biauv-ziouv buatc Ziouv caux Yosepv yiem. Ziouv yaac bun Yosepv yiem ninh zoux nyei nyungc-nyungc duqv longx.
Yosepv zoux duqv horpc Bo^ti^faa nyei hnyouv yaac duqv zoux ninh nyei lengc jeiv bou. Bo^ti^faa ziouc bun ninh goux biauv zong caux jaa-dingh yietc zungv ga'naaiv.

Yiem Bo^ti^faa paaiv Yosepv goux jienv ninh nyei biauv zong yietc zungv jaa-dingh, Ziouv weic Yosepv ceix fuqv bun wuov dauh I^yipv Mienh nyei jaa-dingh. Da'faanh yiem biauv yiem ndeic nyei yietc zungv ziouc camv jienv faaux.

Bo^ti^faa nyei yietc norm jaa-dingh nyungc-nyungc ga'naaiv ninh jiu bun Yosepv goux nzengc. Cuotv liuz ninh ganh nyei nyanc hopv, ninh maiv zuqc nzauh haaix nyungc. Yosepv nyei sin-pei ziangh duqv longx, hmien-mueic yaac nzueic.
Yiem gau, ninh nyei ziouv nyei auv mangc Yosepv haiz hanc haic, ziouc yuoqc ninh gorngv, “Meih daaih caux yie bueix oc.”
Mv baac Yosepv maiv muangx. Ninh gorngv mbuox ninh nyei ziouv nyei auv, “Yie nyei ziouv maiv zuqc nzauh yiem biauv gu'nyuoz nyei haaix nyungc. Yietc zungv jaa-dingh ninh jiu bun yie goux.

Yiem naaiv biauv yie maaih hatc maaz ndongc ninh hlo. Yie nyei ziouv maiv nzaeng haaix nyungc cuotv liuz meih weic zuqc meih zoux ninh nyei auv. Yie fungc haih zoux waaic sic ndongc naaic hlo, baamz zuiz dorngc Tin-Hungh?”
Maiv gunv wuov dauh auv hnoi-hnoi yuoqc Yosepv, Yosepv maiv kangv caux ninh bueix, liemh maiv caux ninh yiem yietc norm dorngx.
Maaih hnoi nor, Yosepv bieqc biauv zoux ninh horpc zuqc zoux nyei gong, yaac maiv maaih yietc dauh biauv nyei bou yiem wuov.
Bo^ti^faa nyei auv nyau jienv Yosepv nyei lui gorngv, “Daaih caux yie bueix maah!” Mv baac Yosepv guangc jienv ninh nyei lui yiem wuov dauh auv nyei buoz, biaux cuotv ga'nyiec ziqc biauv mingh.
Wuov dauh auv buatc Yosepv guangc jienv ninh nyei lui biaux cuotv ga'nyiec,

ninh ziouc nauc-nauc nyei heuc yiem ninh nyei biauv wuov deix m'jangc bou daaih. Ninh gorngv, “Mangc gaax naaic! Yie nyei nqox dorh naaiv dauh Hipv^lu Mienh daaih. Ih zanc ninh mangc piex yie mbuo. Ninh bieqc daaih oix yie caux ninh bueix, mv baac yie qaqv nauc.
Ninh haiz yie heuc, ninh ziouc guangc jienv ninh nyei lui yiem yie naaiv aengx biaux cuotv biauv mi'aqv.”
Wuov dauh auv zorqv Yosepv nyei lui an jienv ninh nyei ga'hlen zuov Yosepv nyei ziouv nzuonx daaih.
Ninh ziouc hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, “Dongh meih dorh daaih mbuo naaiv wuov dauh Hipv^lu nouh gauv bieqc daaih mangc yie maiv jiez, oix caux yie.
Yie qaqv heuc, ninh ziouc guangc ninh nyei lui yiem yie naaiv biaux cuotv gaengh ka'ndau mi'aqv.”
Yosepv nyei ziouv haiz ninh nyei auv gorngv, “Meih nyei nouh hnangv naaiv nor zoux bun yie,” ninh ziouc qiex jiez! haic,
zorqv Yosepv wuonx jienv loh, dongh wuonx hungh diex nyei zuiz-mienh wuov norm loh. Yosepv zuqc wuonx jienv wuov
mv baac Tin-Hungh caux ninh yiem, yaac zoux longx bun ninh, bun ninh zoux duqv horpc goux loh wuov dauh jien nyei hnyouv.
Goux loh jien ziouc bun Yosepv goux yietc zungv yiem loh nyei zuiz-mienh. Da'faanh yiem loh gu'nyuoz nyei sic, Yosepv ganh gunv nzengc.
Yosepv goux jienv nyei yietc zungv sic, goux loh jien maiv zuqc nzauh weic zuqc Ziouv caux Yosepv yiem. Ninh zoux nyei nyungc-nyungc Ziouv tengx ninh zoux duqv longx.
Jiex liuz yietc caamx, tengx I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei Faalo Hungh bouh a'ngunc diuv wuov dauh domh jien caux zoux njuov bun Faalo Hungh nyanc wuov dauh domh jien dorngc hungh diex.
Hungh diex qiex jiez haic naaiv deix i dauh jien,
ziouc zorqv ninh mbuo wuonx jienv goux hungh dinc wuov dauh domh baeng-bieiv nyei biauv nyei loh, dongh Yosepv zuqc wuonx wuov norm loh.
Goux hungh dinc wuov dauh domh baeng-bieiv paaiv Yosepv goux ninh mbuo. Ninh mbuo i dauh yaac zuqc wuonx jienv loh lauh nyei.
Maaih muonz nor, bouh diuv caux zoux njuov wuov deix i dauh domh jien yiem wuov loh mbeix mbeix. Yietc dauh mbeix buatc yietc nyungc. Yietc dauh nyei mbeix yaac maaih yietc nyungc eix leiz.
Da'nyeic ndorm Yosepv bieqc mingh mangc, buatc ninh mbuo i dauh zungv nzauh nzauh wuov.
Ninh naaic gaax Faalo nyei domh jien, dongh caux ninh zuqc wuonx jienv ninh nyei ziouv nyei biauv nyei loh wuov deix i dauh, “Meih mbuo ih hnoi zoux haaix nyungc? Buatc nzauh nzauh wuov!”

Ninh mbuo dau, “A'hmuangx yie mbuo i dauh zungv mbeix mbeix. Yiem naaiv yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh haih tengx yie mbuo porv mbeix.” Yosepv dau, “Kungx Tin-Hungh hnangv haih porv mbeix maiv zeiz? Meih mbuo gorngv meih mbuo nyei mbeix bun yie muangx maah!”
Bouh a'ngunc diuv wuov dauh domh jien ziouc gorngv ninh nyei mbeix bun Yosepv muangx. Ninh gorngv, “Yie buatc diuh a'ngunc hmei yiem yie nyei nza'hmien.
Wuov diuh hmei yaac maaih buo caax nquaah. Yietv cuotv cunx daaih yaac nqoi biangh, biouv-joih yaac zuoqc.
Wuov zanc Faalo Hungh nyei zaanv yiem yie nyei buoz. Yie ziouc gaeqv wuov deix a'ngunc biouv nanv biouv-wuom dapv jienv zaanv bouh bun Faalo.”
Yosepv gorngv, “Meih nyei mbeix nyei eix leiz se hnangv naaiv. Wuov deix buo nquaav nquaah beiv buo hnoi.

Aengx buo hnoi Faalo Hungh oix bungx meih cuotv, oix guangc meih nyei zuiz, yaac bun meih duqv zoux gong hnangv loz wuov nor. Meih aengx duqv bouh a'ngunc diuv bun Faalo Hungh hnangv zinh ndaangc meih zoux wuov nor.
Meih duqv longx nyei ziangh hoc tov jangx deix yie, zoux longx bun yie. Gorngv deix yie nyei jauv bun Faalo Hungh muangx, njoux yie cuotv naaiv norm loh.
Yie yiem Hipv^lu Mienh nyei deic-bung zuqc dorh taux naaiv daaih. Yiem naaiv I^yipv Deic-Bung yie yaac maiv dorngc haaix nyungc zic duqv bun yie zuqc wuonx jienv naaiv loh hmuangx.”

Zoux njuov nyei domh jien buatc Yosepv porv mbeix nyei eix leiz longx, ninh ziouc gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Yie yaac mbeix norm mbeix. Yie buatc yie ganh nyei m'nqorngv ndongx jienv buo norm jei, dapv jienv njuov nyei.
Gu'nguaaic wuov norm jei maaih nyungc-nyungc ziqv daaih nyei njuov bun Faalo Hungh nyanc. Mv baac norqc daaih nyanc wuov deix njuov.”
Yosepv gorngv, “Meih nyei mbeix nyei eix leiz se hnangv naaiv. Wuov deix buo norm jei beiv buo hnoi.
Aengx buo hnoi Faalo Hungh oix bun mienh hngaqv ndutv meih nyei m'nqorngv aengx zorqv meih nyei sei ndiux jienv ndiangx. Norqc yaac oix daaih nyanc meih nyei orv.”

Aengx jiex buo hnoi taux Faalo Hungh nyei sih nyietv-hnoi, ninh ziouc mbenc nyanc hopv zoux jorm cingv ninh nyei yietc zungv zoux jien nyei mienh daaih. Ninh yaac bungx bouh a'ngunc diuv caux zoux njuov wuov deix i dauh domh jien cuotv daaih yiem zuangx jien nyei nza'hmien.
Bouh a'ngunc diuv wuov dauh aengx duqv zoux gong hnangv loz wuov nor, ziouc zorqv diuv-zaanv bouh mingh bun hungh diex.
Mv baac zoux njuov wuov dauh aeqv, Faalo Hungh heuc zorqv daaih ndiux jienv wuov ndiangx daix guangc mi'aqv. Naaiv deix sic za'gengh doix nzengc Yosepv porv nyei mbeix.
Mv baac bouh a'ngunc diuv wuov dauh jien la'kuqv Yosepv mi'aqv. Maiv jangx zuqc ninh aqv.
Jiex daaih buangv i hnyangx, Faalo Hungh mbeix norm mbeix, mbeix buatc ninh ganh souv jienv Nai^aa Ndaaih hlen.
Maaih siec dauh yangh ngongh nyeiz nzueic nyei, junc nyei, yiem ndaaih cuotv daaih yiem wuov nyanc luoqc diqc normh.
Aengx maaih siec dauh yangh ngongh nyeiz korng jaic nyei, aqc mangc nyei, yiem Nai^aa Ndaaih cuotv daaih souv jienv junc wuov deix ngongh nyeiz nyei ga'hlen.
Ngongh jaic ziouc nyanc nzengc wuov deix siec dauh ngongh junc. Mbeix liuz, hungh diex ziouc nyie daaih aqv.
Hungh diex aengx m'njormh mingh, mbeix da'nyeic norm mbeix. Mbeix buatc maaih zungh mbiauh cuotv siec dorv, yietc zungv jauh nyei, yangh nyei.
Nqa'haav aengx cuotv siec dorv mbiauh maux, jieqv nyei, laaix zuqc dong bung maengx nyei nziaaux buonc.
Mbiauh maux naqv nzengc wuov deix siec dorv jauh nyei, yangh nyei mbiauh mi'aqv. Faalo Hungh ziouc nyie daaih, hiuv duqv ninh mbeix buatc.

Da'nyeic ndorm ninh haiz hnyouv maiv henh ziouc heuc I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei mangc sou porv mbeix nyei fin-saeng caux guai-gorqv fin-saeng yietc zungv daaih. Faalo ziouc gorngv ninh nyei mbeix bun ninh mbuo muangx. Mv baac maiv maaih haaix dauh haih porv duqv mbeix cuotv.
Wuov zanc tengx Faalo Hungh bouh diuv wuov dauh domh jien gorngv mbuox hungh diex, “Ih hnoi yie jangx zuqc yie zoux dorngc nyei sic aqv.
Maaih nzunc hungh diex qiex jiez ninh nyei bou, ziouc zorqv yie caux zoux njuov nyei domh jien mingh wuonx jienv yiem goux hungh dinc nyei domh baeng-bieiv nyei biauv wuov norm loh.
Maaih muonz nor, yie mbuo i dauh zungv mbeix mbeix. Yietc dauh nyei mbeix maaih yietc nyungc eix leiz.

Maaih dauh Hipv^lu mienh lunx mienh yaac caux yie mbuo zuqc wuonx jienv loh. Ninh zoux goux hungh dinc nyei domh baeng-bieiv nyei nouh. Yie mbuo gorngv yie mbuo nyei mbeix bun ninh muangx, ninh ziouc ziux gorqv-mienh nyei mbeix porv mbeix nyei eix leiz.
Nqa'haav za'gengh doix-diuc nzengc ninh porv nyei eix leiz. Yie duqv zoux gong hnangv zinh ndaangc nor, mv baac zoux njuov wuov dauh zuqc dorh mingh ndiux jienv ndiangx daix guangc.”

Faalo Hungh ziouc paaiv mienh mingh heuc Yosepv daaih. Ninh mbuo ziouc siepv-siepv nyei mingh dorh ninh cuotv. Yosepv teix siaam, japv mba'bieiv, yienc nqoi lui-houx, mingh taux Faalo Hungh nyei nza'hmien.
Hungh diex gorngv mbuox ninh, “Yie mbeix norm mbeix yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh haih porv duqv cuotv. Yie haiz mienh gorngv meih haiz liuz mbeix ziouc haih porv mbeix nyei.”
Yosepv dau Faalo Hungh, “Se maiv zeiz yie haih porv mbeix. Tin-Hungh ganh oix porv duqv horpc mbuox Faalo.”
Faalo Hungh ziouc gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Yie mbeix buatc yie ganh souv jienv Nai^aa Ndaaih hlen.
Maaih siec dauh yangh ngongh nyeiz nzueic nyei, junc nyei, yiem wuov ndaaih cuotv daaih yiem wuov nyanc luoqc diqc normh.
Nqa'haav aengx maaih siec dauh yangh ngongh nyeiz korng jaic nyei, aqc mangc nyei, cuotv daaih. Yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung yie maiv gaengh buatc jiex yangh ngongh ndongc naaic aqc mangc.
Wuov deix ngongh jaic nyanc nzengc cuotv ndaangc wuov deix siec dauh ngongh junc.
Nyanc liuz mv baac maiv maaih haaix dauh zieqv duqv ninh mbuo nyanc wuov deix ngongh junc. Ninh mbuo corc hnangv zinh ndaangc nor, aqc mangc. Yie ziouc nyie daaih aqv.
“Yie aengx mbeix buatc maaih zungh mbiauh cuotv siec dorv jauh nyei, yangh nyei.
Nqa'haav aengx cuotv siec dorv mbiauh maux, nyaux nzengc, jieqv nzengc, laaix zuqc dong bung nyei nziaaux buonc.
Wuov deix mbiauh maux naqv nzengc wuov deix siec dorv mbiauh jauh mi'aqv. Yie gorngv yie nyei mbeix bun mangc sou porv mbeix nyei fin-saeng muangx yaac maiv maaih yietc dauh haih porv duqv cuotv.”
Yosepv ziouc gorngv mbuox Faalo Hungh, “I norm mbeix nyei eix leiz zungv fih hnangv nyei. Tin-Hungh jaa-ndaangc bun meih hiuv duqv ninh oix hnangv haaix nor zoux.
Wuov deix siec dauh yangh ngongh junc beiv siec hnyangx. Wuov deix siec dorv mbiauh jauh yaac beiv siec hnyangx. I norm mbeix nyei eix leiz se fih hnangv nyei.

Nqa'haav cuotv wuov deix siec dauh yangh ngongh jaic nyei, aqc mangc nyei, caux wuov deix siec dorv mbiauh maux zuqc dong bung maengx nyei nziaaux buonc jieqv mingh, se beiv siec hnyangx domh huaang domh ngorc.
“Naaiv za'gengh hnangv yie mbuox liuz hungh diex wuov nor. Tin-Hungh oix bun meih hiuv duqv ninh oix hnangv haaix nor zoux.
Yiem naaiv mingh siec hnyangx gu'nyuoz, gormx I^yipv Deic-Bung bungx-zuoqc longx.
Nqa'haav aengx maaih siec hnyangx domh huaang domh ngorc. Laaix ngorc hnaangx, mienh zungv oix la'kuqv bungx-zuoqc longx nyei hnyangx. Deic-bung yaac oix waaic nzengc.
Taux ngorc nyei ziangh hoc ba'laqc ngorc duqv kouv haic, mienh ziouc la'kuqv nzengc bungx-zuoqc longx nyei ziangh hoc.
Hungh diex mbeix naaiv deix i norm mbeix biux mengh Tin-Hungh dingc ziangx hnangv naaiv nor zoux yaac oix siepv-siepv nyei zoux.
“Hnangv naaiv, tov hungh diex ginv dauh guai nyei, maaih cong-mengh nyei mienh, orn ninh gunv I^yipv Deic-Bung.
Aengx orn deix jien gunv gormx deic-bung. Naaiv deix bungx-zuoqc longx nyei siec hnyangx gu'nyuoz oix zuqc siou yietc zungv gaeng-zuangx biaa gouv nyei yietc gouv.
Naaiv deix hnyangx-zingh longx nyei ziangh hoc naaiv deix jien oix zuqc zorqv laangh ziqc gapv nzoih guei Faalo Hungh nyei buoz-ndiev siou jienv yiem norm-norm zingh zoux nyanc hopv.
Naaiv deix laangh ziqc liouh jienv mbungh I^yipv Deic-Bung ngorc siec hnyangx nyei ziangh hoc ziouc maaih nyanc maaih hopv weic maiv bun deic-bung laaix ngorc hnaangx zuqc mietc nzengc.”
Faalo Hungh caux ninh nyei yietc zungv jien haiz Yosepv nyei za'eix longx nyei.
Hungh diex gorngv mbuox ninh nyei zuangx jien, “Mbuo haih lorz duqv ganh dauh hnangv naaiv dauh maaih Tin-Hungh nyei Singx Lingh fai?”
Ninh gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh bun meih hiuv duqv naaiv deix yietc zungv sic, maiv maaih haaix dauh ndongc meih guai yaac maaih cong-mengh.
Yie oix bun meih goux yie nyei dinc. Yie nyei zuangx baeqc fingx yaac oix zuqc mbuoqc meih, muangx meih nyei waac. Kungx yie ganh maaih lingc gauh hlo jiex meih nyei hnangv.”
Faalo Hungh aengx gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Yie ih zanc orn meih gunv nzengc I^yipv Deic-Bung.”
Faalo Hungh ziouc hlutv maaih yienx nyei buoz-ndoqv-nzaeng tengx Yosepv dangh jienv. Bun ninh zuqv jienv la'maah ndie-muonc nyei lui-ndaauv, aengx zorqv diuh jiem-limc kuangx jienv ninh nyei jaang.
Faalo yaac bun Yosepv zueiz ninh nyei da'nyeic norm maaz-cie. Aengx maaih mienh mingh ndaangc heuc jienv gorngv, “Gueic njiec ov!” Faalo Hungh hnangv naaiv orn ninh gunv I^yipv Deic-Bung.
Faalo aengx gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Yie zoux Faalo Hungh Diex. Cuotv liuz meih ganh nqoi nzuih, yiem naaiv I^yipv Deic-Bung maiv maaih haaix dauh haih zoux haaix nyungc.”

Hungh diex tengx Yosepv cuotv norm I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei mbuox heuc Saax^fe^naatv Baa^ne^aa yaac zorqv On Zingh nyei sai mienh, Bo^ti^fe^laa, nyei sieqv, Aa^se^natv, bun Yosepv longc zoux auv. Yosepv ziouc cuotv mingh zaah gormx I^yipv Deic-Bung.
Yosepv jiez gorn weic I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei Faalo Hungh zoux gong wuov zanc, ninh nyei hnyangx-jeiv duqv faah ziepc hnyangx. Ninh yiem hungh dinc cuotv mingh youh gormx I^yipv Deic-Bung.
Yiem wuov deix bungx-zuoqc longx nyei siec hnyangx gu'nyuoz, deic-bung cuotv gaeng-zuangx ga'naaiv longx haic.

Yosepv ziouc siou naaiv deix siec hnyangx gu'nyuoz nyei laangh ziqc gapv zunv yiem norm-norm zingh. Yiem haaix norm zingh nyei horngc zaangc zuangx nyei laangh ziqc yaac siou daaih gapv zunv an jienv wuov norm zingh.
Yosepv siou duqv laangh ziqc ndongc koiv-hlen nyei saa-ziou camv. Camv gau, hlaau maiv hingh, saauv maiv hingh, ziang naaic maiv saauv aqv.
Domh ngorc nyei hnyangx-zingh maiv gaengh taux, On Zingh nyei sai mienh, Bo^ti^fe^laa, nyei sieqv, Aa^se^natv, yungz duqv i dauh dorn bun Yosepv.
Yosepv ziouc tengx ninh nyei dorn-hlo cuotv mbuox heuc Maa^natv^se. Ninh gorngv, “Tin-Hungh tengx yie la'kuqv yie nyei yietc zungv kouv naanc caux yie nyei die nyei biauv zong hmuangv doic.”
Da'nyeic dauh dorn ninh cuotv mbuox heuc E^faa^im yaac gorngv, “Weic zuqc yiem naaiv deic-bung yie siouc kouv naanc mv baac Tin-Hungh bun yie duqv fu'jueiv.”
I^yipv Deic-Bung bungx-zuoqc longx nyei siec hnyangx jiex liuz,
aengx bieqc siec hnyangx nyei domh ngorc doix nzengc Yosepv gorngv nyei waac. Norm-norm guoqv ngorc nzengc aqv. Mv baac I^yipv Deic-Bung norm-norm dorngx maaih nyanc nyei.

Taux I^yipv Mienh ngorc daaih, zuangx baeqc fingx mingh tengx Faalo Hungh tov nyanc. Hungh diex gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo oix zuqc mingh lorz Yosepv hnangv. Ninh hnangv haaix nor gorngv, meih mbuo oix zuqc ei jienv ninh nyei waac zoux.”
Domh ngorc gunv zoux gunv kouv buangv nzengc I^yipv Deic-Bung mi'aqv. Yosepv ziouc koi nqoi ninh nyei norm-norm dorngx nyei domh lamz maaic mbiauh cuotv bun I^yipv Mienh.
Aengx maaih lungh ndiev mienh yietc zungv mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung tengx Yosepv maaiz mbiauh, weic zuqc lungh ndiev zuqc domh huaang domh ngorc kouv haic.
Yaakopv haiz gorngv I^yipv Deic-Bung maaih mbiauh nyei. Ninh ziouc mbuox ninh nyei dorn, “Meih mbuo zoux haaix nyungc ngih ngorngh ngorngz naaic? Meih mangc yie, yie mangc meih hnangv!
Yie haiz gorngv I^yipv Deic-Bung maaih mbiauh nyei. Meih mbuo mingh maaiz deix daaih nyanc maah! Tengx mbuo maiv zuqc ngorc hnaangx daic.”
Yosepv nyei ziepc dauh gorx ziouc mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung maaiz mbiauh aqv.
Mv baac Yosepv nyei youz, Mben^yaa^min, Yaakopv maiv bun gan ninh gorx mbuo mingh. Gamh nziex haih buangh zuqc haaix nyungc hoic ninh mv bei.
Yaakopv nyei dorn mbuo caux jienv mienh camv mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung maaiz mbiauh weic zuqc Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung yaac buangh domh ngorc.
Yosepv zoux I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei zungx, maaic mbiauh bun baeqc fingx. Ninh nyei gorx mbuo mingh taux wuov ziouc puoqv njiec taux ndau baaix Yosepv.

Yosepv zieqv duqv ninh nyei gorx mbuo mv baac ninh zoux hnangv maiv hiuv nor. Ninh caux ninh mbuo gorngv waac beqv nyei naaic gaax, “Meih mbuo yiem haaix daaih?” Ninh mbuo dau, “Yie mbuo yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung daaih maaiz mbiauh.”
Yosepv zieqv duqv ninh gorx mbuo nyei, mv baac ninh nyei gorx mbuo zieqv maiv duqv ninh.
Yosepv jangx zuqc ninh zinh ndaangc mbeix nyei mbeix. Ninh aengx gorngv, “Meih mbuo daaih caaiv juoqv zaah mangc yie mbuo nyei deic-bung mau nyei dorngx hnangv.”
Ninh mbuo dau, “Ziouv aah! Gengh maiv zeiz! Yie mbuo, meih nyei bou, daaih maaiz mbiauh hnangv.
Yie mbuo yietc zungv benx yietc dauh die nyei dorn. Yie mbuo yietc zungv, meih nyei bou, hnyouv zingx nyei mienh. Yie mbuo maiv zeiz daaih zaah deic-bung.”
Yosepv aengx gorngv, “Maiv zeiz aqv. Meih mbuo daaih samx mangc yie mbuo nyei deic-bung haaix norm dorngx piex hnangv.”

Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo, meih nyei bou, yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung. Yietc zungv maaih ziepc nyeic muoz-dorn juangc dauh die. Youz-laai caux yie mbuo nyei die yiem biauv. Aengx maaih dauh youz daic mi'aqv.”
Yosepv aengx dau, “Za'gengh hnangv yie gorngv nor. Meih mbuo daaih zaah deic-bung hnangv.
Yie hnangv naaiv nor seix meih mbuo. Yie ziangv jienv Faalo Hungh nyei maengc houv waac. Cuotv liuz meih mbuo nyei youz-laai daaih taux naaiv, meih mbuo maiv duqv cuotv naaiv norm dorngx.

Bun dauh nzuonx mingh dorh meih mbuo nyei youz-laai daaih. Zengc njiec naaiv deix, yie wuonx jienv zuov taux yie mbuo hiuv duqv meih mbuo nyei waac za'gengh zien fai maiv zien. Se gorngv meih mbuo nyei waac maiv zien, yie ziouc hiuv duqv dingc, ndongc yie hiuv duqv Faalo Hungh ziangh jienv nor, meih mbuo za'gengh daaih zaah deic-bung hnangv.”
Gorngv liuz, Yosepv zorqv ninh mbuo dorh mingh wuonx jienv loh buo hnoi.
Taux da'faam hnoi, Yosepv gorngv mbuox ninh gorx mbuo, “Yie se zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei mienh. Se gorngv meih mbuo ziux yie nyei waac zoux, meih mbuo ziouc duqv meih mbuo nyei maengc cuotv.
Meih mbuo za'gengh hnyouv zaqc nyei mienh nor, oix zuqc bun dauh wuonx jienv naaiv loh. Wuov deix dorh mbiauh nzuonx bun yiem biauv ngorc hnaangx nyei hmuangv doic nyanc.

Mv baac meih mbuo oix zuqc dorh meih mbuo nyei youz-laai daaih yie naaiv. Hnangv naaiv ziouc bun cing meih mbuo nyei waac se zien. Meih mbuo yaac maiv zuqc daic.” Ninh mbuo ziouc laengz ei jienv zoux.

Laanh gorngv mbuox laanh, “Zinh ndaangc mbuo zoux doqc mbuo nyei youz. Wuov zanc mbuo buatc ninh ndongc haaix kouv, ninh njiec qaqv tov mbuo, mbuo yaac maiv muangx. Weic naaiv, mbuo ih zanc cingx buangh zuqc naaiv deix sic.”
Lu^mben gorngv, “Yie baav meih mbuo maiv dungx zoux hoic wuov dauh dorn, mv baac meih mbuo maiv muangx. Ih zanc laaix daix ninh, mbuo cingx daaih oix zuqc siouc zuiz ndongc naaiv kouv.”
Ninh mbuo maiv hiuv duqv Yosepv mengh baeqc ninh mbuo gorngv nyei waac weic zuqc ninh haaix zanc caux ninh mbuo gorngv waac maaih mienh tengx faan.
Yosepv haiz naaiv deix waac, ninh ziouc cuotv mingh nyiemv. Nyiemv liuz, ninh aengx bieqc mingh caux ninh mbuo gorngv waac yaac zorqv Si^me^on cuotv daaih dorng jienv ninh mbuo ndoh jienv aqv.

Yosepv heuc mienh zorqv mbiauh dapv buangv ninh gorx mbuo nyei mbuoqc, aengx zorqv gorqv-mienh maaiz mbiauh nyei nyaanh dapv gorqv-mienh nyei mbuoqc nzuih, aengx tengx ninh mbuo liuc leiz ndaamv-jauv nyanc nyei bienh fuix bun ninh mbuo. Mienh ziouc ei jienv ninh nyei waac zoux.
Yosepv nyei gorx mbuo mbenc ziangx bun lorh tor jienv mbiauh ziouc cuotv jauv nzuonx.
Wuov muonz taux ninh mbuo hitv nyei dorngx, maaih dauh koi ninh nyei mbuoqc, oix zorqv deix mbiauh uix lorh, yaac buatc maaiz mbiauh nyei nyaanh yiem wuov mbuoqc nzuih.

Ninh gorngv mbuox ninh nyei muoz-doic, “Yie nyei nyaanh ninh mbuo aengx bun nzuonx daaih aex! Yiem naaiv yie nyei mbuoqc nzuih.” Ninh mbuo haiz hnyouv waaic nzengc, meih mangc yie, yie mangc meih, sin zinx jienv gorngv, “Tin-Hungh hnangv haaix nor zoux bun mbuo mv bei?”
Nzuonx taux Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, ninh mbuo nyei die, Yaakopv wuov, ninh mbuo zueih yietv zueih nyeic nyei gorngv nzengc ninh mbuo buangh nyei sic bun ninh muangx.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Wuov norm deic-bung nyei ziouv gorngv ciouv nyei bun yie mbuo, hnangv yie mbuo zoux zaah deic-bung nyei mienh.
Yie mbuo dau, ‘Yie mbuo maiv zeiz daaih zaah deic-bung. Yie mbuo se hnyouv zaqc nyei mienh.
Yietc zungv maaih ziepc nyeic muoz-dorn juangc dauh die. Maaih dauh youz maiv yiem aqv. Youz-laai corc caux ninh nyei die yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung.’

“Wuov norm deic-bung nyei ziouv gorngv, ‘Yie hnangv naaiv nor zoux seix mangc gaax meih mbuo za'gengh hnyouv zaqc fai maiv zaqc. Meih mbuo oix zuqc bun dauh caux yie yiem naaiv. Wuov deix dorh mbiauh nzuonx mingh bun ngorc hnaangx nyei hmuangv doic nyanc.

Oix zuqc dorh meih mbuo nyei youz-laai daaih bun yie mangc. Yie ziouc hiuv duqv meih mbuo hnyouv zaqc nyei mienh, maiv zeiz daaih zaah deic-bung. Yie ziouc bungx meih mbuo nyei gorx bun meih mbuo. Meih mbuo yiem naaiv deic-bung zoux saeng-eix yaac duqv nyei.’+”

Ninh mbuo dox mbiauh cuotv wuov zanc, gorqv-mienh buatc gorqv-mienh nyei nyaanh beu yiem wuov mbiauh mbuoqc gu'nyuoz. Ninh mbuo caux ninh mbuo nyei die buatc nyaanh beu, ninh mbuo ziouc gamh nziex haic.

Ninh mbuo nyei die, Yaakopv, gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo oix zoux bun yie nyei fu'jueiv maiv zengc yietc dauh? Maiv maaih Yosepv aqv. Yaac maiv maaih Si^me^on. Ih zanc meih mbuo aengx oix dorh Mben^yaa^min mingh. Haaix nyungc sic yaac kungx hoic yie diev hnangv.”

Lu^mben gorngv mbuox ninh nyei die, “Se gorngv yie maiv duqv dorh Mben^yaa^min nzuonx daaih bun meih, meih gunv zorqv yie nyei i dauh dorn daix guangc duqv nyei. Gunv bun yie goux Mben^yaa^min. Yie aengx dorh ninh nzuonx daaih bun meih.”

Mv baac Yaakopv gorngv, “Yie ndongc haaix zungv maiv bun yie nyei dorn caux meih mbuo mingh. Ninh nyei gorx daic mi'aqv. Kungx zengc ninh ganh hnangv. Gamh nziex ndaamv-jauv buangh zuqc haaix nyungc sic hoic ninh, meih mbuo ziouc bun yie, ong-m'nqorngv-baeqc, nzauh duqv daic nyei.”
Yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung maaih domh huaang domh ngorc kouv haic.
Yaakopv nyei hmuangv doic nyanc nzengc mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung maaiz daaih nyei mbiauh mi'aqv. Yaakopv ziouc gorngv mbuox ninh nyei dorn, “Meih mbuo oix zuqc aengx mingh maaiz deix mbiauh maah!”

Yu^ndaa gorngv mbuox ninh nyei die, “Wuov laanh mienh gorngv hniev nyei mbuox yie mbuo, se gorngv yie mbuo maiv dorh yie mbuo nyei youz-laai caux jienv mingh nor, yie mbuo liemh maiv duqv buatc ninh nyei hmien.
Se gorngv die bun youz-laai caux yie mbuo mingh, yie mbuo ziouc mingh tengx die maaiz mbiauh.

Mv baac se gorngv maiv bun youz-laai caux yie mbuo mingh, yie mbuo maiv haih mingh aqv. Weic zuqc wuov laanh mienh mbuox yie mbuo, ‘Meih mbuo maiv dorh youz-laai daaih nor, meih mbuo liemh maiv duqv buatc yie nyei hmien.’+”
I^saa^laa^en gorngv, “Meih mbuo zoux haaix nyungc hoic yie ndongc naaiv kouv? Weic haaix diuc mbuox wuov laanh mienh meih mbuo aengx maaih dauh youz?”

Ninh nyei dorn mbuo dau, “Wuov laanh mienh naaic muonc taux yie mbuo caux yie mbuo nyei hmuangv doic. Ninh naaic gaax, ‘Meih mbuo nyei die corc yiem nyei fai? Aengx maaih youz nyei?’ Yie mbuo kungx ziux ninh naaic nyei waac dau hnangv. Yie mbuo fungc hiuv duqv ninh oix gorngv, ‘Oix zuqc dorh youz-laai daaih?’+”

Yu^ndaa gorngv mbuox ninh nyei die, I^saa^laa^en, “Tov bun wuov dauh dorn caux yie mingh maah! Yie mbuo ziouc cuotv jauv mingh aqv. Die caux yie mbuo caux yie mbuo nyei fu'jueiv yaac maiv zuqc ngorc daic.
Yie longc yie ganh nyei maengc zoux ndaam-daauh. Die heuc yie ganh beu naaiv dauh dorn duqv nyei. Se gorngv yie maiv dorh ninh nzuonx taux meih naaiv, yie laengz yietc seix ndaam-dorng.
Se gorngv maiv hnangv naaiv zuov lauh, yie mbuo zungv mingh duqv i nzunc nzuonx daaih aqv.”

I^saa^laa^en gorngv mbuox ninh nyei dorn mbuo, “Se gorngv za'gengh oix zuqc dorh ninh mingh nor, meih mbuo oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor zoux. Oix zuqc dorh deix naaiv norm deic-bung gauh longx jiex nyei ga'naaiv mingh zoux zingh nyeic bun wuov laanh mienh. Zorqv deix ndiangx-zung ndaang caux deix mueiz-dorngh, ndie-ndaang, mu^yorc caux nyungc biouv-nganh ndaang caux an^man biouv, dapv jienv ga'naaiv dorh mingh.
Meih mbuo yaac oix zuqc dorh nyaanh gauh camv mingh ndaangc wuov nzunc i gouv. Oix zuqc dorh dongh yiem mbuoqc wuov deix nyaanh tuix nzuonx, nziex ninh mbuo dapv dorngc mv bei.
Gunv dorh jienv meih mbuo nyei youz mingh lorz wuov laanh mienh.

Tov Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh bun meih mbuo yiem wuov laanh mienh nyei nza'hmien duqv ninh korv-lienh meih mbuo, bun meih mbuo duqv Mben^yaa^min caux Si^me^on dorh nzuonx. Yie ganh aeqv, maiv gunv oix zuqc guangc yie nyei fu'jueiv yaac cinh ninh aqv.”

Ninh mbuo muoz-doic ziouc cuotv jauv mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung, aengx dorh jienv zingh nyeic caux nyaanh gauh camv mingh ndaangc wuov nzunc nyei i gouv, yaac dorh jienv Mben^yaa^min mingh. Mingh taux I^yipv Deic-Bung, ninh mbuo bieqc mingh lorz Yosepv.

Yosepv buatc Mben^yaa^min caux jienv daaih ziouc mbuox goux ninh nyei biauv nyei domh bou, “Dorh naaiv deix mienh mingh yie nyei biauv. Oix zuqc daix dauh saeng-kuv mbenc daaih nyanc weic zuqc naaiv deix mienh oix zuqc caux yie nyanc lungh aanx.”
Wuov dauh bou ei jienv Yosepv nyei waac zoux, dorh jienv wuov deix muoz-doic mingh Yosepv nyei biauv.

Bou dorh jienv ninh mbuo bieqc Yosepv nyei biauv wuov zanc, ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic, yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Ninh dorh yie mbuo daaih naaiv se laaix daauh nzunc dapv jienv yie mbuo nyei mbuoqc nzuih wuov deix nyaanh. Ih zanc ninh mbuo oix lorz sic bun yie mbuo, zorqv yie mbuo zoux nouh, aengx zorqv yie mbuo nyei lorh mv bei.”
Taux gaengh ndaangc ninh mbuo ziouc gorngv mbuox goux Yosepv nyei biauv wuov dauh domh bou,
“Domh Gorx aac, yie mbuo tov mbuox joux waac meih oc. Yie mbuo daaih maaiz daauh nzunc mbiauh.

Nzuonx maengx, taux yie mbuo hitv nyei dorngx, yie mbuo koi mbuoqc buatc gorqv-mienh maaiz mbiauh nyei nyaanh yietc zungv yiem gorqv-mienh nyei mbuoqc nzuih. Nyaanh nyei hniev-daauh yaac fih hnangv nyei. Naaiv deix yietc zungv nyaanh yie mbuo aengx dorh jienv daaih tuix nzuonx.
Yie mbuo ganh ca'lengc dorh jienv nyaanh daaih maaiz mbiauh. Zinh ndaangc wuov nzunc nyei nyaanh, maiv hiuv duqv haaix dauh dapv yie mbuo nyei mbuoqc gu'nyuoz.”

Wuov dauh bou dau, “Maiv dungx nzauh, maiv dungx gamh nziex. Daaix meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, meih mbuo nyei die nyei Tin-Hungh, zorqv naaiv deix nyaanh dapv mbuoqc bun meih mbuo. Meih mbuo maaiz daauh nzunc mbiauh nyei nyaanh yie duqv siou mi'aqv.” Gorngv liuz, ninh aengx dorh Si^me^on daaih.
Wuov dauh bou dorh wuov deix muoz-doic bieqc biauv lorz wuom bun ninh mbuo nzaaux zaux yaac lorz miev bun ninh mbuo nyei lorh nyanc.
Wuov deix muoz-doic mbenc ziangx ninh mbuo nyei zingh nyeic zuov jienv Yosepv nzuonx, weic zuqc ninh mbuo hiuv duqv ninh mbuo oix zuqc caux ninh yiem wuov nyanc lungh aanx.
Yosepv taux biauv, ninh mbuo zorqv ninh mbuo dorh daaih nyei zingh nyeic yiem wuov biauv bun Yosepv, yaac puoqv taux ndau baaix.
Yosepv naaic ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo yiem longx nyei saah?” Aengx naaic ninh mbuo, “Zinh ndaangc meih mbuo gorngv meih mbuo nyei die gox haic aqv. Ninh corc yiem nyei fai? Ninh longx nyei saah?”
Ninh mbuo dau, “Meih nyei bou, yie mbuo nyei die, yiem longx nyei.” Ninh mbuo aengx ndoqv njiec baaix.

Yosepv buatc caux ninh juangc maa wuov dauh youz, Mben^yaa^min, ninh ziouc naaic, “Zinh ndaangc meih mbuo gorngv mbuox yie, meih mbuo maaih dauh youz-laai, dongh naaiv dauh saah? Dorn aac, tov Tin-Hungh ceix en bun meih.”
Gorngv liuz, Yosepv oix zuqc biaux. Ninh haiz hnamv! haic ninh nyei youz, nyienz maiv jienv wuom-mueic, ziouc bieqc wuov biauv gen nyiemv.
Nzaaux liuz hmien, ninh cuotv daaih nyienz jienv wuom-mueic, aengx heuc ninh nyei bou mbenc hnaangx.

Bou weic Yosepv ganh mbenc norm dieh, weic wuov deix muoz-doic aengx ganh mbenc norm dieh. Aengx maaih caux Yosepv nyanc hnaangx wuov deix I^yipv Mienh ganh ca'lengc mbenc norm dieh, weic zuqc I^yipv Mienh haiz maiv kuh caux Hipv^lu Mienh juangc dieh nyanc hnaangx.

Yosepv bun zuangx muoz-doic zueiz jienv hmien huin mingh Yosepv nyei dieh wuov bung, yaac ziux ninh mbuo nyei hnyangx-jeiv zueiz mbaih yiem dorn-hlo mbaih mingh taux dorn-faix. Ninh mbuo ganh buatc hnangv naaiv nor zueiz jienv, ninh mbuo mbuoqc horngh haic, laanh mangc laanh.
Ninh mbuo nyanc nyei ga'naaiv, bou yiem Yosepv nyei dieh zorqv daaih bun ninh mbuo. Mv baac Mben^yaa^min duqv camv biaa gouv. Ninh mbuo caux Yosepv njien-youh nyei nyanc, njien-youh nyei hopv.

Yosepv paaiv goux ninh nyei biauv nyei domh bou, “Zorqv mbiauh dapv naaiv deix mienh nyei mbuoqc. Dapv gaux ninh mbuo dorh. Aengx zorqv gorqv-mienh maaiz mbiauh nyei nyaanh dapv gorqv-mienh nyei mbuoqc nzuih.
Zorqv yie nyei zaanv, dongh nyaanh zaanv wuov norm, caux maaiz mbiauh nyei nyaanh dapv jienv youz-laai wuov dauh nyei mbuoqc nzuih.” Bou ziouc ei jienv Yosepv nyei waac zoux.
Da'nyeic ndorm nziouv nyei, lungh mbiouz-mbiouz njang, domh bou ziouc fungx ninh mbuo caux ninh mbuo nyei lorh cuotv jauv nzuonx.

Cuotv ziqc zingh mingh maiv gaengh nangc go, Yosepv gorngv mbuox ninh nyei domh bou, “Gaanv mingh zunc wuov deix mienh. Zunc zaaic, oix zuqc naaic gaax ninh mbuo, ‘Yie mbuo zoux longx bun meih mbuo. Meih mbuo weic haaix diuc zoux waaic bun yie mbuo?
Meih mbuo weic haaix diuc nimc yie nyei ziouv nyei nyaanh zaanv mingh? Naaiv norm zaanv ninh longc hopv yaac longc naaic zinh hoz nyei jauv. Meih mbuo za'gengh zoux dorngc ndo haic aqv.’+”
Wuov dauh bou zunc zaaic, ninh ziouc ei Yosepv nyei waac gorngv.
Mv baac wuov deix muoz-doic gorngv, “Domh Gorx aac, meih zoux haaix nyungc hnangv naaiv nor gorngv? Yie mbuo zungv maiv hnamv taux hnangv naaiv nor zoux.

Mangc gaax, maaiz daauh nzunc mbiauh nyei nyaanh yiem yie mbuo nyei mbuoqc yie mbuo zungv yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung dorh daaih tuix nzuonx bun meih. Yie mbuo fungc haih nimc yiem meih nyei ziouv nyei biauv nyei jiem nyaanh?
Se gorngv meih buatc wuov norm zaanv yiem haaix dauh, bun wuov dauh zuqc daic aqv. Zengc wuov deix laengz zoux meih nyei nouh.”

Bou gorngv, “Horpc nyei. Ei jienv meih mbuo nyei waac zoux aqv. Mv baac lorz buatc yiem haaix dauh nyei mbuoqc, wuov dauh ganh oix zuqc zoux yie nyei nouh. Zengc njiec wuov deix maiv dorngc haaix nyungc.”
Dauh dauh ziouc siepv-siepv nyei bouh mbuoqc njiec don jienv wuov ndau koi.
Bou ziouc sou aqv, yiem domh gorx nyei sou jienv mingh taux youz-laai nyei. Taux Mben^yaa^min nyei mbuoqc ziouc sou cuotv wuov norm zaanv.
Wuov deix muoz-doic nzauh haic, betv ninh mbuo nyei lui, aengx bouh mbuoqc faaux bun lorh tor jienv daaux nqaang nzuonx wuov zingh aqv.
Yu^ndaa caux ninh nyei muoz-doic nzuonx taux Yosepv nyei biauv wuov zanc, Yosepv corc yiem biauv nyei. Ninh mbuo yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien mbaapv njiec ndau.
Yosepv gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Naaiv meih mbuo zoux haaix nyungc laeh? Meih mbuo maiv hiuv duqv yie naaiv nyungc mienh haih mangc duqv cuotv zinh hoz nyei sic, haih zorqv duqv meih mbuo fai?”

Yu^ndaa gorngv, “Yie mbuo hnangv haaix nor haih dau ziouv? Hnangv haaix nor haih gorngv? Yie mbuo hnangv haaix nor haih jaiv sin? Tin-Hungh wetv cuotv nzengc yie mbuo zoux dorngc nyei sic. Ih zanc maiv zeiz kungx zaanv yiem mbuoqc wuov dauh benx meih nyei nouh hnangv. Liemh yie mbuo yietc zungv benx meih nyei nouh aqv.”
Yosepv gorngv, “Maiv zeiz hnangv naaic lorqc. Kungx zaanv yiem mbuoqc wuov dauh oix zuqc zoux yie nyei nouh hnangv. Zengc wuov deix gunv baengh orn nyei nzuonx meih mbuo nyei die wuov aqv.”
Yu^ndaa aengx mingh fatv deix doix Yosepv gorngv, “Yie nyei ziouv aac, yie tov caux meih gorngv joux waac. Meih maiv dungx gaengh qiex jiez yie, meih nyei bou, maiv gunv meih ndongc Faalo Hungh hlo.
Ziouv naaic yie mbuo, meih nyei bou, ‘Meih mbuo corc maaih die, maaih youz nyei fai?’

Yie mbuo dau, ‘Die maaih nyei mv baac gox haic aqv. Youz yaac maaih nyei. Die zungv gox haic cingx duqv naaiv dauh dorn-laai. Naaiv dauh dorn nyei gorx daic mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo i muoz juangc maa mv baac ih zanc kungx maaih ninh ganh hnangv. Ninh nyei die yaac hnamv haic ninh.’
“Meih heuc yie mbuo, meih nyei bou, dorh ninh daaih naaiv bun meih mangc.
Yie mbuo mbuox meih, yie mbuo nyei ziouv, ‘Wuov dauh dorn leih maiv duqv ninh nyei die. Leih nor, ninh nyei die haih daic nyei.’
Mv baac meih mbuox yie mbuo, meih nyei bou, ‘Yie mbuo maiv dorh naaiv dauh youz-laai caux jienv daaih nor, yie mbuo maiv duqv aengx buatc meih nyei hmien.’
Yie mbuo dorh meih nyei waac nzuonx mingh gorngv bun meih nyei bou, yie mbuo nyei die, muangx.
“Yie mbuo nyei die mbuox yie mbuo, ‘Aengx mingh maaiz deix mbiauh maah!’

Yie mbuo dau, ‘Yie mbuo maiv haih mingh. Se gorngv yie mbuo nyei youz-laai caux jienv yie mbuo mingh nor, yie mbuo mingh nyei. Weic zuqc youz-laai maiv caux yie mbuo mingh nor, yie mbuo maiv duqv buatc wuov laanh mienh nyei hmien.’
“Meih nyei bou, yie mbuo nyei die, mbuox yie mbuo, ‘Meih mbuo hiuv duqv yie nyei auv, Laasen, yungz duqv i dauh dorn bun yie hnangv.
Maaih dauh zungv leih nqoi yie. Yie hnamv daaih ninh zuqc hieh ga'naaiv betv ninh mi'aqv. Taux ih zanc yie maiv duqv buatc wuov dauh dorn.
Se gorngv meih mbuo dorh naaiv dauh mingh, ninh yaac buangh zuqc sic nor, meih mbuo ziouc bun yie, ong-m'nqorngv-baeqc, nzauh taux bieqc yiemh gen.’+”
Yu^ndaa aengx gorngv, “Se gorngv yie nzuonx meih nyei bou, yie nyei die, wuov, yaac maiv maaih naaiv dauh dorn caux yie nzuonx,

yie nyei die buatc yie nyei youz maiv caux yie nzuonx nor, ninh ziouc daic aqv, weic zuqc naaiv dauh dorn zoux yie nyei die nyei mba'nziu-gorn. Hnangv naaiv yie nyei die, meih nyei bou, ong-m'nqorngv-baeqc, nzauh taux daic.
Yie ganh longc yie nyei maengc zoux ndaam-daauh mbuox yie nyei die, ‘Yie maiv dorh naaiv dauh youz nzuonx bun die nor, yie laengz yiem die nyei nza'hmien yietc seix ndaam-dorng.’
“Hnangv naaic, yie tov bun yie, meih nyei bou, yiem naaiv zoux meih nyei nouh div naaiv dauh dorn. Tov bun ninh gan jienv ninh nyei gorx mbuo nzuonx aqv oc.
Se gorngv naaiv dauh dorn maiv caux yie nzuonx, yie hnangv haaix nor haih nzuonx yie nyei die wuov. Yie maiv oix buatc yie nyei die zuqc zeqc naanc hoic ninh.”

Yosepv haiz nyienz maiv jienv, wuom-mueic oix cuotv haic aqv, ziouc beqv souv ninh nyei ga'hlen nyei mienh, “Meih mbuo yietc zungv cuotv mingh maah!” Yosepv bun ninh nyei muoz-doic hiuv duqv ninh wuov zanc, maiv maaih yietc dauh ga'hlen mienh yiem.
Yosepv qaqv nyiemv mbui nyei, I^yipv Mienh ziouc haiz mi'aqv, aengx sing mingh taux hungh dinc wuov.
Yosepv mbuox ninh nyei muoz-doic, “Yie se Yosepv. Yie nyei die corc yiem nyei fai?” Ninh nyei muoz-doic haiz ninh hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, ninh mbuo hnyouv waaic nzengc, zungv maiv haih dau.

Yosepv ziouc mbuox ninh mbuo, “Tov meih mbuo daaih fatv deix maah!” Ninh mbuo ziouc mingh fatv. Yosepv gorngv, “Yie se meih mbuo nyei youz, Yosepv, dongh gorx mbuo maaic mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung wuov dauh.
Meih mbuo maiv dungx hnyouv mun, winx ganh zoux dorngc laaix maaic yie daaih naaiv. Se Tin-Hungh paaiv yie daaih ndaangc meih mbuo weic njoux mienh camv nyei maengc.
Deic-bung ngorc duqv i hnyangx aqv. Corc aengx maaih biaa hnyangx maiv haih zuangx, maiv haih siou.
Tin-Hungh paaiv yie daaih ndaangc meih mbuo, weic meih mbuo liouh deix mienh yiem naaiv lungh ndiev, yaac longc naaiv nyungc domh za'eix njoux gorx mbuo cuotv.

“Hnangv naaiv se maiv zeiz gorx mbuo bun yie daaih naaiv. Se Tin-Hungh ganh paaiv yie daaih. Ninh bun yie hnangv Faalo Hungh nyei die, zoux ninh nyei biauv zong nyei ziouv, yaac gunv nzengc I^yipv Deic-Bung.

Ih zanc gaanv nzuonx mingh mbuox yie nyei die, ninh nyei dorn, Yosepv, hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, ‘Tin-Hungh bun yie zoux I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei ziouv. Die oix zuqc siepv-siepv nyei daaih yie naaiv, maiv dungx ngaih.
Die haih yiem naaiv, Gosen Deic, nitv fatv deix yie, die ganh caux die nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv, ngongh guanh, ba'gi yungh guanh, yungh guanh, liemh yietc zungv maaih nyei ga'naaiv.
Hnangv naaiv yie haih goux die, weic zuqc aengx maaih biaa hnyangx domh ngorc. Maiv zeiz nor aeqv, die caux die nyei biauv zong mienh caux die maaih nyei yietc zungv ndortv naanc kouv.’+”
Yosepv aengx gorngv, “Meih mbuo dauh dauh gorx aengx caux yie nyei youz, Mben^yaa^min, zieqv duqv ih zanc caux meih mbuo gorngv waac se yie, Yosepv.
Gorngv mbuox die, yie yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung duqv nyei yietc zungv njang-laangc. Gorngv nzengc meih mbuo buatc nyei jauv-louc bun die muangx. Yaac oix zuqc gaanv jienv dorh yie nyei die daaih naaiv.”
Yosepv qam jienv ninh nyei youz, Mben^yaa^min, nyiemv. Mben^yaa^min yaac qam jienv ninh nyei gorx nyiemv.
Yosepv aengx zom ninh nyei dauh dauh gorx aengx nyiemv. Nqa'haav ninh nyei muoz-doic caux ninh gorngv waac.
Yosepv nyei muoz-doic daaih nyei fienx sing taux hungh dinc. Faalo Hungh caux ninh nyei zuangx jien a'hneiv haic aqv.
Faalo Hungh gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Mbuox meih nyei muoz-doic, ‘Oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor zoux. Zorqv ga'naaiv bun meih mbuo nyei lorh tor jienv nzuonx Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung.

Bienh meih mbuo nyei die caux meih mbuo nyei hmuangv doic daaih yie naaiv. Yie oix bun I^yipv Deic-Bung gauh longx jiex nyei ga'naaiv ninh mbuo. Naaiv norm deic-bung maaih haaix nyungc longx jiex ninh mbuo duqv nyanc aqv.’

“Meih yaac oix zuqc mbuox ninh mbuo, ‘Meih mbuo oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor zoux. Dorh I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei ngongh cie mingh bienh meih mbuo nyei fu'jueiv caux meih mbuo nyei auv, yaac oix zuqc dorh meih mbuo nyei die daaih.
Meih mbuo maiv dungx korv-fiqv meih mbuo nyei ga'naaiv weic zuqc I^yipv Deic-Bung maaih gauh longx jiex nyei ga'naaiv se benx meih mbuo nyei.’+”
I^saa^laa^en nyei dorn mbuo ziouc ei jienv zoux. Yosepv yaac ei jienv Faalo Hungh paaiv nyei waac bun ngongh cie ninh mbuo, yaac bun jienv ndaamv-jauv nyei bienh fuix.
Ninh nyei gorx mbuo, ninh bun yietc dauh yietc yiemc lui-houx yienc. Mv baac Mben^yaa^min ninh bun i joih cietv lungz nyaanh caux biaa yiemc lui-houx.

Yosepv fungx ziepc dauh lorh tor jienv I^yipv Deic-Bung longx jiex nyei ga'naaiv mingh bun ninh nyei die. Aengx fungx ziepc dauh lorh nyeiz tor mbiauh caux njuov caux bun ninh nyei die yiem ndaamv-jauv nyanc nyei bienh fuix.
Yosepv ziouc fungx ninh nyei muoz-doic cuotv jauv nzuonx. Oix mingh wuov zanc ninh gorngv, “Ndaamv-jauv meih mbuo maiv dungx da'hauv ox!”
Wuov deix muoz-doic ziouc yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung nzuonx taux Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, ninh mbuo nyei die wuov.
Ninh mbuo mbuox ninh mbuo nyei die, “Aa die aah! Yosepv corc yiem nyei aex! Ih zanc ninh gunv nzengc yietc norm I^yipv Deic-Bung.” Yaakopv mouh mengh mouh baeqc nyei, maiv sienx ninh mbuo nyei waac.
Ninh nyei dorn mbuo gorngv nzengc Yosepv nyei waac bun ninh muangx. Yaakopv yaac buatc Yosepv bun daaih zipv ninh mingh I^yipv wuov deix ngongh cie, ninh nyei hnyouv ziouc fingv daaih aqv.
I^saa^laa^en gorngv, “Buangv hnyouv aqv. Yie nyei dorn, Yosepv, yiem nyei. Yie maiv gaengh daic, yie oix mingh buatc yietc mueic ninh.”
I^saa^laa^en dorh jienv ninh maaih nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv cuotv jauv mingh taux Mbe^e^qe^mbaa Deic yiem wuov ziec ninh nyei die, I^sakc, nyei Tin-Hungh.
Lungh muonz zanc Tin-Hungh hinc cuotv daaih heuc ninh, “Yaakopv aac, Yaakopv!” Yaakopv dau, “Oeix! Yie yiem naaiv oc.”
Tin-Hungh gorngv, “Yie se Tin-Hungh, meih nyei die nyei Tin-Hungh. Maiv dungx gamh nziex. Gunv mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung aqv, weic zuqc yiem wuov yie zungv bun meih benx yietc fingx hlo nyei.
Yie caux meih mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung, ndongc haaix zungv oix dorh meih nzuonx daaih. Meih guei seix nyei ziangh hoc, Yosepv ganh oix tengx meih nyei m'zing njipv.

Yaakopv yiem Mbe^e^qe^mbaa Deic cuotv jauv. Ninh nyei dorn mbuo bun ninh mbuo nyei die caux ninh mbuo nyei fu'jueiv-faix caux ninh mbuo yietc zungv nyei auv faaux Faalo Hungh bun daaih zipv Yaakopv mbuo wuov deix ngongh cie mingh.
Ninh mbuo yaac dorh jienv yiem Kaa^naa^an duqv daaih nyei saeng-kuv caux nyungc-nyungc ga'naaiv mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung. Yaakopv caux ninh nyei fun-faqv yietc zungv mingh.
Ninh dorh jienv ninh nyei dorn, dorn-fun, sieqv, sieqv-fun, se ninh nyei yietc zungv fun-faqv mingh taux I^yipv.
Yiem naaiv mingh gorngv mingh yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei mbuox. Se Yaakopv caux ninh nyei fun-faqv. Maaih Yaakopv nyei dorn-hlo, Lu^mben.
Lu^mben nyei dorn se Haanokv, Banlu, Hetv^lon, caux Kaanmi.
Si^me^on nyei dorn se Ye^mu^en, Yaamin, O^haatc, Yaakin, So^haax caux Saa^un. Saa^un zoux Kaa^naa^an sieqv nyei dorn.
Lewi nyei dorn se Geson, Ko^haatv caux Me^laa^li.
Yu^ndaa nyei dorn se E^aa, Onan, Qelaa, Beletv caux Zelaa. (Mv baac E^aa caux Onan yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung wuov zanc guei seix mi'aqv.) Beletv nyei dorn se Hetv^lon caux Haamun.
Itc^saax^kaa nyei dorn se Tolaa, Buwaa, I^opc caux Simlon.
Se^mbu^lun nyei dorn se Seletv, Elon caux Yaa^le^en.

Naaiv deix se Le^aa yiem Batc^ndaan Aalam yungz bun Yaakopv nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv. Aengx maaih dauh sieqv, mbuox heuc Ndinaa. Le^aa nyei buonc dorn-jueiv fun-faqv yietc zungv maaih faah ziepc faam dauh.
Gaatc nyei dorn se Si^fi^yon, Hakv^gi, Suni, Etc^mbon, E^le^i, Aa^lo^ndi caux Aa^le^li.
Aa^se nyei dorn se Imnaa, Itc^waa, Itc^wi caux Mbe^li^yaa. Naaiv deix dorn nyei muoc heuc Se^laa^aa. Mbe^li^yaa nyei dorn se He^mbe caux Man^ki^en.
Naaiv deix se Laa^mbaan bun ninh nyei sieqv, Le^aa, wuov dauh nouh beiz, Sinx^baa, yungz bun Yaakopv nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv. Yietc zungv maaih ziepc luoqc dauh.
Yaakopv nyei auv, Laasen, nyei dorn se Yosepv caux Mben^yaa^min.
Yosepv yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung duqv Maa^natv^se caux E^faa^im, se On Zingh nyei sai mienh, Bo^ti^fe^laa, nyei sieqv, Aa^se^natv, yungz bun ninh.
Mben^yaa^min nyei dorn se Mbelaa, Mbeke, Atc^mben, Gelaa, Naa^aa^maan, E^hai, Lo^atc, Mapv^bim, Hupc^bim caux Aatc.
Naaiv deix se Laasen yungz bun Yaakopv nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv. Yietc zungv maaih ziepc feix dauh.
Ndaan nyei dorn se Husim.
Napv^taa^li nyei dorn se Yaa^si^en, Guni, Yese caux Sinlem.
Naaiv deix se Laa^mbaan bun ninh nyei sieqv, Laasen, wuov dauh nouh beiz, Mbin^haa, yungz bun Yaakopv nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv. Yietc zungv maaih siec dauh.
Gan Yaakopv mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung wuov zanc, ninh ganh nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv maaih luoqc ziepc luoqc dauh, cih cuotv ninh nyei mbuangz.
Aengx maaih Yosepv yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung duqv wuov deix i dauh dorn. Yaakopv bieqc I^yipv Deic-Bung wuov zanc, ninh nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv yietc zungv maaih cietv ziepc dauh.
Yaakopv heuc Yu^ndaa mingh ndaangc mbuox Yosepv ninh gan jienv jauv daaih Gosen aqv. Ninh mbuo mingh taux Gosen Deic,
Yosepv mbenc ninh nyei maaz-cie mingh Gosen zipv ninh nyei die, I^saa^laa^en. Yosepv yietv buatc, ziouc qam jienv ninh nyei die qaqv nyiemv lauh nyei.
I^saa^laa^en gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Ih zanc yie duqv buatc liuz meih, hiuv duqv meih corc ziangh jienv nyei, yie daic yaac hnyouv nqaai aqv.”

Yosepv gorngv mbuox ninh nyei muoz-doic caux ninh nyei die mbuo yietc zungv hmuangv doic, “Yie oix mbuox Faalo Hungh, ‘Yie nyei muoz-doic caux yie nyei die mbuo hmuangv doic yietc zungv yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung ih zanc daaih taux yie naaiv daaih aqv.
Yie oix mbuox ninh meih mbuo zoux yungz yungh, yungz saeng-kuv nyei mienh. Meih mbuo dorh jienv meih mbuo nyei yungh, saeng-kuv caux nyungc-nyungc ga'naaiv daaih.’
Faalo Hungh heuc meih mbuo daaih lorz ninh wuov zanc, ninh oix naaic meih mbuo, ‘Meih mbuo zoux haaix nyungc gong nyanc nyei mienh?’

Meih mbuo oix zuqc dau, ‘Yie mbuo, meih nyei bou, faix-faix nyei m'daaih yungz saeng-kuv taux ih zanc, hnangv yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix nor.’ Meih mbuo hnangv naaiv nor gorngv nor, ninh ziouc bun meih mbuo yiem Gosen, weic zuqc I^yipv Mienh youx haic yungz yungh nyei mienh.”

Yosepv ziouc nzuonx mingh mbuox Faalo Hungh, “Yie nyei die caux yie nyei muoz-doic yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung bienh jienv ninh mbuo nyei yungh, ba'gi yungh, saeng-kuv, yietc zungv ga'naaiv daaih taux aqv. Ih zanc ninh mbuo yiem wuov Gosen.”
Yosepv ginv biaa dauh ninh nyei gorx caux ninh mingh wuic buangh Faalo Hungh.
Faalo Hungh naaic Yosepv nyei gorx mbuo, “Meih mbuo zoux haaix nyungc gong nyanc nyei mienh?”

Ninh mbuo dau, “Yie mbuo, meih nyei bou, se yungz yungh, yungz ba'gi yungh nyei mienh hnangv yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix nor. Yie mbuo daaih yiem douc naaiv norm deic-bung weic zuqc Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung ngorc duqv kouv haic. Liemh maiv maaih miev bun yungh guanh ba'gi yungh guanh nyanc. Tov bun yie mbuo yiem wuov Gosen.”
Faalo gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Ih zanc meih nyei die, meih nyei muoz-doic daaih taux meih naaiv aqv.

I^yipv Deic-Bung se yiem meih nyei nza'hmien. Bun ninh mbuo yiem deic-bung gauh longx jiex nyei dorngx liepc nguaaz-gorn, se bun ninh mbuo yiem Gosen Deic. Se gorngv ninh mbuo haaix dauh maaih banh zeic, oix zuqc orn zoux bieiv zeiv goux yie nyei saeng-kuv.”
Yosepv aengx dorh ninh nyei die, Yaakopv, mingh wuic buangh Faalo Hungh. Yaakopv yaac buang waac Faalo.
Hungh diex naaic Yaakopv, “Meih nyei hnyangx-jeiv duqv mbu'ziex hnyangx aqv?”

Yaakopv dau Faalo, “Yie nyei seix zeiv youh jiex naaiv youh jiex wuov yiem duqv yietc baeqv faah ziepc hnyangx aqv. Naaiv deix hnoi-nyieqc youc nangv youc kouv. Maiv ndongc yie nyei ong-taaix mbuo youh jiex naaiv yiem youh jiex wuov yiem nyei nyutc zeiv ndaauv.”
Yaakopv aengx buang nzunc waac Faalo liuz, ziouc cuotv mi'aqv.
Yosepv dorh ninh nyei die caux ninh nyei muoz-doic mingh liepc nguaaz-gorn yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung gauh longx jiex nyei dorngx, Laa^maa^setc Zingh ga'hlen, ziux Faalo Hungh mbuox nyei waac.
Yosepv bun nyanc hopv ninh nyei die, ninh nyei muoz-doic, liemh ninh nyei die nyei yietc zungv biauv zong mienh, ziux mienh laanh juang ninh mbuo.
Gormx wuov norm deic-bung maiv maaih nyanc hopv. Mienh ngorc duqv kouv! haic. I^yipv Deic-Bung caux Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung nyei mienh ngorc gau hnaangx, jaic nzengc mi'aqv.
Yosepv siou nzengc I^yipv Mienh caux Kaa^naa^an Mienh maaiz mbiauh nyei yietc zungv nyaanh aengx dorh mingh Faalo nyei hungh dinc.

I^yipv Mienh caux Kaa^naa^an Mienh nyei nyaanh longc njang nzengc mi'aqv. I^yipv Mienh ziouc mingh lorz Yosepv gorngv, “Tov bun deix hnaangx yie mbuo nyanc. Yie mbuo weic haaix diuc oix zuqc yiem meih nyei nza'hmien ngorc daic? Weic zuqc yie mbuo nyei nyaanh nzengc mi'aqv.”
Yosepv gorngv, “Se gorngv meih mbuo nyei nyaanh nzengc mi'aqv nor, dorh meih mbuo nyei saeng-kuv daaih yienc mbiauh.”

Baeqc fingx ziouc dorh ninh mbuo nyei saeng-kuv mingh Yosepv wuov. Yosepv longc mbiauh yienc ninh mbuo nyei yungh, ba'gi yungh, ngongh, lorh, maaz. Wuov hnyangx Yosepv heuc ninh mbuo dorh saeng-kuv daaih yienc laangh ziqc.

Wuov hnyangx jiex liuz, nqa'haav hnyangx ninh mbuo aengx daaih mbuox Yosepv, “Yie mbuo maiv bingx, gorngv zaqc mbuox ziouv, yie mbuo nyei nyaanh nzengc. Yie mbuo nyei saeng-kuv yaac benx meih nyei nzengc mi'aqv. Cuotv liuz yie mbuo nyei sin caux yie mbuo nyei ndau maiv maaih haaix nyungc bun meih aqv.

Yie mbuo weic haaix diuc oix zuqc yiem meih nyei nza'hmien ngorc daic? Liemh yie mbuo caux yie mbuo nyei ndau oix zuqc mietc nzengc. Tov meih longc laangh ziqc yienc yie mbuo caux yie mbuo nyei ndau. Yie mbuo ziouc benx Faalo Hungh nyei nouh. Yie mbuo nyei ndau yaac benx ninh nyei mi'aqv. Tov bun mbiauh nyim yie mbuo weic bun yie mbuo haih duqv maengc ziangh, maiv daic. Ndeic yaac maiv zuqc guangc jienv huaang-huaang wuov.”

Hnangv naaic Yosepv maaiz nzengc I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei ndau bun Faalo Hungh. I^yipv Mienh dauh dauh maaic nzengc ninh mbuo nyei ndau, laaix ninh mbuo ngorc duqv ba'laqc kouv cung mingh. Ndau yietc zungv ziouc benx nzengc Faalo nyei.
Yosepv yaac bun zuangx baeqc fingx yiem naaiv bung I^yipv mingh taux wuov bung I^yipv benx nzengc Faalo Hungh nyei nouh.

Kungx zengc sai mienh nyei ndau Yosepv maiv maaiz hnangv, weic zuqc sai mienh zanc-zanc duqv Faalo Hungh juang nyei buonc. Ninh mbuo duqv gaux Faalo Hungh nyei buonc yungz maengc ziouc maiv zuqc maaic ganh nyei ndau.
Yosepv gorngv mbuox zuangx baeqc fingx, “Ih hnoi yie maaiz meih mbuo caux meih mbuo nyei ndau bun Faalo Hungh mi'aqv. Naaiv yie aengx bun jienv ga'naaiv-nyim bun meih mbuo zuangx wuov ndeic.
Taux siou nyei ziangh hoc, biaa gouv zorqv cuotv yietc gouv bun Faalo Hungh. Zengc wuov deix biei gouv bun meih mbuo zoux nyim zuangx yaac bun meih mbuo ganh caux meih mbuo nyei hmuangv doic nyanc.”
Baeqc fingx gorngv, “Meih njoux cuotv yie mbuo nyei maengc. Tov bun yie mbuo yiem meih nyei nza'hmien duqv longx, yie mbuo ziouc laengz zoux Faalo Hungh nyei nouh.”

Yosepv liepc diuh leiz daaih, corc longc jienv taux ih jaax hnoi, se I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei gaeng-zuangx ga'naaiv biaa gouv oix zuqc bun gouv hungh diex. Kungx maaih sai mienh nyei ndau hnangv maiv benx hungh diex nyei buonc.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung, Gosen Deic, duqv ninh mbuo ganh nyei ndau yaac hiaangx daaih maaih fu'jueiv camv.
Yaakopv yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung duqv ziepc cietv hnyangx, ninh nyei hnyangx-jeiv duqv yietc baeqv feix ziepc cietv hnyangx.

Taux aav lamh deix guei seix nyei ziangh hoc, ninh heuc ninh nyei dorn, Yosepv, daaih, mbuox Yosepv, “Se gorngv ziux dorn buatc, yie zoux horpc meih nyei hnyouv nor, tov dorh meih nyei buoz an jienv yie nyei camh zuih ga'ndiev maengx laengz ngaengc waac. Oix zuqc laengz meih oix ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux longx bun yie, maiv zangx yie nyei sei yiem naaiv I^yipv Deic-Bung.
Yie guei seix, dorn oix zuqc dorh yie nyei sei cuotv I^yipv Deic-Bung nzuonx mingh juangc yie nyei ong-taaix nyei zouv zangx.” Yosepv dau, “Yie zungv oix ei jienv die nyei waac zoux.”
Yaakopv gorngv, “Yie oix meih laengz ngaengc waac meih za'gengh zoux.” Yosepv ziouc laengz jiez ngaengc waac. Laengz liuz, Yaakopv yiem wuov coux-daauh ndoqv njiec baaix Tin-Hungh.
Nqa'haav maiv nangc lauh, maaih mienh mbuox Yosepv, “Meih nyei die maiv longx.” Yosepv ziouc dorh jienv ninh nyei i dauh dorn, Maa^natv^se caux E^faa^im, mingh mangc ninh nyei die.
Mienh mbuox Yaakopv, “Meih nyei dorn, Yosepv, daaih mangc meih aqv.” Yaakopv ziouc caengx jiez sin daaih zueiz jienv wuov coux.
Yaakopv gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, Lutv Deic, hinc cuotv daaih buang waac die.
Ninh gorngv, ‘Yie oix bun meih maaih dorn-jueiv fun-faqv camv, hiaangx daaih zoux camv-fingx mienh. Yie yaac oix zorqv naaiv norm deic-bung jiu bun meih nyei hoz doic zeiv-fun yietc liuz nzipc.’+”

Yaakopv aengx gorngv, “Yosepv aac, dongh yie maiv gaengh daaih, meih yiem naaiv I^yipv Deic-Bung duqv wuov deix i dauh dorn, E^faa^im caux Maa^natv^se, oix zuqc funx benx yie nyei buonc dorn hnangv Lu^mben caux Si^me^on nor.
Nqa'haav meih aengx duqv fu'jueiv nor, ziouc funx benx meih ganh nyei buonc. Ninh mbuo nzipc nyei buonc se gan ninh mbuo nyei gorx nyei mbuox nzipc hnangv.

Yie yiem Batc^ndaan Aalam nzuonx wuov zanc, yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung leih E^faa^laa^taa Mungv maiv nangc go, meih nyei maa, Laasen, guei seix, bun yie nzauh haic. Yie zangx ninh mingh E^faa^laa^taa Mungv wuov diuh jauv nyei ga'hlen.” (E^faa^laa^taa aengx maaih norm mbuox heuc Mbetc^le^hem.)
I^saa^laa^en buatc Yosepv nyei dorn mbuo, ninh naaic gaax, “Naaiv haaix dauh?”
Yosepv mbuox ninh nyei die, “Naaiv se Tin-Hungh bun yie yiem naaiv duqv daaih nyei dorn.” I^saa^laa^en gorngv, “Dorh daaih yie naaiv weic bun yie buang waac ninh mbuo.”
I^saa^laa^en nyei hnyangx-jeiv gox haic, m'zing mbuov, mangc maiv nangc zien. Yosepv ziouc dorh ninh nyei dorn mingh taux ninh nyei die wuov, ninh nyei die qam jienv zom.
I^saa^laa^en gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Yie hnamv daaih yietc liuz maiv duqv buatc meih, mv baac Tin-Hungh bun yie liemh meih nyei dorn duqv buatc.”
Yosepv hlorpv ninh nyei dorn njiec I^saa^laa^en nyei camh zuih yaac yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien puoqv njiec taux ndau.
Yosepv ken jienv ninh nyei i dauh dorn, mbiaauc jieqv buoz ken E^faa^im mingh yiem I^saa^laa^en nyei zaaix bung. Zaaix jieqv buoz ken Maa^natv^se mingh yiem I^saa^laa^en nyei mbiaauc bung.

Mv baac I^saa^laa^en jiuv jienv buoz. Mbiaauc jieqv maan jienv E^faa^im nyei m'nqorngv maiv gunv ninh zoux dorn-faix. Zaaix jieqv aengx maan jienv Maa^natv^se nyei m'nqorngv maiv gunv Maa^natv^se zoux dorn-hlo.

Ninh ziouc buang waac Yosepv aqv. Ninh gorngv, “Tov yie nyei ong, Apc^laa^ham, caux yie nyei die, I^sakc, buoqc zaangc nyei Tin-Hungh ceix fuqv naaiv deix i dauh dorn. Tov yietc seix dorh yie taux ih hnoi nyei Tin-Hungh ceix fuqv bun ninh mbuo.

Tov njoux yie leih ndutv yietc zungv haih hoic yie nyei zeqc naanc wuov dauh fin-mienh ceix fuqv bun naaiv deix i dauh dorn. Tov bun naaiv deix i dauh dorn nzipc yie nyei mbuox caux yie nyei ong, Apc^laa^ham, caux yie nyei die, I^sakc, nyei mbuox. Tov bun ninh mbuo yiem naaiv lungh ndiev hiaangx jiez daaih camv.”

Yosepv buatc ninh nyei die hnangv naaiv nor zorqv mbiaauc jieqv buoz maan jienv E^faa^im nyei m'nqorngv, ninh maiv horpc hnyouv. Ninh ziouc zorqv ninh die nyei buoz yiem E^faa^im nyei m'nqorngv waan nqoi, oix bun ninh maan Maa^natv^se nyei m'nqorngv.
Ninh gorngv mbuox ninh nyei die, “Die aah! Maiv zeiz hnangv naaiv lorqc. Dorn-hlo dongh naaiv dauh. Oix zuqc longc meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz maan naaiv dauh nyei m'nqorngv.”

Mv baac ninh nyei die maiv kangv. Ninh gorngv, “Dorn aah! Yie hiuv nyei. Maa^natv^se nyei zeiv-fun yaac oix benx yietc fingx. Ninh yaac duqv zoux hlo. Mv baac ninh nyei youz oix duqv zoux gauh hlo. Youz nyei zeiv-fun oix benx camv-fingx hlo nyei.”

Wuov hnoi Yaakopv buang waac ninh mbuo. Ninh gorngv, “I^saa^laa^en Mienh oix dorh meih nyei mbuox mingh buang waac. Ninh mbuo oix gorngv, ‘Tov Tin-Hungh bun meih hnangv E^faa^im caux Maa^natv^se nor.’+” I^saa^laa^en ziouc hnangv naaiv nor bun E^faa^im duqv zoux gauh hlo Maa^natv^se.

Buang liuz waac, I^saa^laa^en gorngv mbuox Yosepv, “Yie guei seix nyei ziangh hoc aav lamh taux aqv. Mv baac Tin-Hungh zungv caux meih mbuo yiem, yaac oix dorh meih mbuo nzuonx meih mbuo nyei ong-taaix nyei deic-bung.
Yie zorqv dongh yie longc nzuqc ndaauv caux juang-zinx caangv duqv Aa^mo^lai Mienh nyei wuov norm zorng jiu bun meih, maiv zeiz bun meih nyei gorx mbuo.”
Yaakopv heuc ninh nyei dorn mbuo daaih nzoih. Ninh gorngv, “Meih mbuo daaih gapv zunv yie naaiv. Yie oix gorngv nqa'haav hingv meih mbuo oix buangh nyei sic.
“Yaakopv nyei dorn aac, meih mbuo daaih zunv muangx. Daaih muangx meih nyei die, I^saa^laa^en, gorngv.

“Lu^mben aac, meih zoux yie nyei dorn-hlo. Meih se yie nyei qaqv. Yie benx domh mienh duqv daaih nyei daauh dauh dorn. Meih zoux domh gorx, yietc buoqv dorn meih gauh maaih mengh jiex, meih yaac gauh henv.
Meih beiv hnangv wuom-seix nor, ziouc maiv duqv zoux hlo, weic zuqc meih bueix meih nyei die nyei auv-dorn, bun die nyei coux maaih uix.
“Si^me^on caux Lewi zoux i muoz. Ninh mbuo nyei nzuqc ndaauv se zoux doqc nyei wuoqc ginc.

Ninh mbuo daav za'eix, yie maiv caux ninh mbuo caangh laangh. Ninh mbuo gapv zunv nyei ziangh hoc, yie maiv caux ninh mbuo zoux doic, weic zuqc ninh mbuo qiex jiez daix mienh. Ninh mbuo sueih eix hngaqv ngongh gouv nyei domh luangc jaan dangx.

Laaix ninh mbuo qiex jiez, ciouv, ninh mbuo zuqc houv. Laaix qiex beqv, hnyouv doqc, ninh mbuo zuqc zioux. Yie oix bun ninh mbuo nzaanx mingh gormx I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung, yaac oix bun ninh mbuo zorpc jienv I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem.
“Yu^ndaa aac, meih nyei muoz-doic oix ceng meih. Meih longc meih nyei buoz nanv jienv meih nyei win-wangv nyei jaang. Meih nyei muoz-doic oix gueic njiec ndau baaix meih.

Yu^ndaa aac, meih se hnangv dauh sienh dorn nor. Yie nyei dorn aac, meih cuotv mingh ngaatc orv aengx nzuonx meih nyei dorngx. Meih mbaapv njiec aengx bueix njiec hnangv sienh gouv. Hnangv sienh nyeiz nor, haaix dauh haih gaamv haeqv ninh nyie?

Yu^ndaa oix yietc liuz nanv jienv hungh diex nyei biaav. Ninh gunv mienh nyei biaav-mbiaac zungv maiv leih ninh nyei i jieqv zaux mbu'ndongx, zuov taux wuov diuh biaav-mbiaac nyei ziouv daaih taux. Maanc fingx mienh yaac muangx ninh nyei waac.

Ninh nyei lorh gouv ninh ndoh jienv a'ngunc hmei, lorh dorn ndoh jienv gauh longx jiex nyei a'ngunc hmei nquaah. Ninh oix longc a'ngunc diuv nzox ninh nyei lui-houx, longc a'ngunc wuom siqv nyei hnangv nziaamv nor, nzox ninh nyei lui-ndaauv.
Weic hopv a'ngunc diuv, ninh nyei m'zing siqv, weic ninh hopv ngongh nyorx, ninh nyei nyaah yaac baeqc.
“Se^mbu^lun duqv yiem wuov koiv-hlen, benx norm nzangv-bouc bun nzangv dingh. Ninh nyei gapv-jaaix mingh daaux jienv Sai^ndorn Zingh.
“Itc^saax^kaa hnangv lorh nor henv, mbaapv njiec ninh nyei ba'gi yungh laanh mbu'ndongx.
Ninh buatc ninh hitv nyei dorngx longx, wuov norm deic-bung kuh yiem, ninh ziouc nyiex jienv ga'naaiv jutv-jutv nyei mingh, laengz zoux nouh bun mienh aapv zoux gong kouv.
“Ndaan oix baengh fim nyei siemv ninh nyei baeqc fingx. Ninh nyei fingx se yietc fingx I^saa^laa^en Mienh.
Ndaan oix benx diuh naang yiem wuov jauv, benx diuh naang-doqc yiem wuov jauv-hlen, nyorqv maaz nyei zaux, hoic geh maaz nyei mienh da'nziaaux faan, ndortv ga'ndiev ndau mingh.
“ Ziouv aac, yie zuov jienv meih njoux yie.
“Gaatc oix zuqc guanh janx-zaqc caangv, mv baac ninh daaux sin zunc jienv nitv jienv zaux-nqo mingh.
“Aa^se nyei deic-bung bungx-zuoqc, ga'naaiv-zuangx longx, haih zoux duqv puix hungh diex nyanc.
“Napv^taa^li benx dauh njaih nyeiz bungx wuov lomc, ninh njiec duqv dorn nzueic nyei.
“Yosepv se ziangh biouv camv nyei ndiangx-nquaah, se yiem wuom-zingv hlen ziangh biouv gitv nyei nquaah. Ninh nyei nquaah yaac yormc cuotv ga'nyiec ziqc laatc.
Buonv juang-zinx nyei mienh daaih caux ninh mborqv jaax zoux doqc, buonv ninh, zoux hoic ninh.
Mv baac ninh zaangv dingc ninh nyei juang-zinx. Ninh nyei buoz yaac maaih qaqv henv weic Yaakopv nyei Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh, weic Goux Ba'gi Yungh nyei Mienh, se I^saa^laa^en nyei La'bieiv.

Weic meih nyei die nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh tengx meih wuov dauh, yaac weic Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh ceix fuqv bun meih. Ninh bun gu'nguaaic nyei fuqv, ga'ndiev ndau nyei fuqv, caux maaih saeng-kuv caux duqv fu'jueiv nyei fuqv.

Meih nyei die bun meih duqv nyei fuqv se gauh hlo jiex yietc liuz yiem nyei mbong duqv daaih nyei fuqv. Se gauh hlo jiex yie nyei ong-taaix bun daaih nyei fuqv. Tov naaiv deix fuqv yiem Yosepv nyei m'nqorngv, yaac yiem zinh ndaangc leih ninh nyei muoz-doic wuov dauh nyei biorngh.
“Mben^yaa^min hnangv dauh hieh juv cei orv, lungh ndorm nyanc ninh ngaatc daaih nyei orv, lungh hmuangx bun nqoi ninh caangv daaih nyei ga'naaiv.”
Naaiv se I^saa^laa^en nyei ziepc nyeic fingx. Yaac ziux ninh mbuo nyei die buang nyei waac puix duqv ninh mbuo dauh dauh.
Yaakopv paaiv waac bun ninh nyei dorn mbuo, “Yie aav lamh guei seix aqv. Oix zuqc dorh yie mingh caux yie nyei ong-taaix mbuo zangx jienv Hitv^tai Mienh, E^fo^lon, nyei ndau,

Makv^be^laa, nyei mbaengx-kuotv. Naaiv deix ndau yiem Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, Mamle nyei dong bung maengx. Se Apc^laa^ham tengx wuov dauh Hitv^tai Mienh, E^fo^lon, maaiz wuov nzong ndau caux wuov norm mbaengx-kuotv zoux zouv-gemh.
Apc^laa^ham caux ninh nyei auv, Saalaa, zangx wuov. I^sakc caux ninh nyei auv, Le^mbe^kaa, yaac zangx wuov. Yie yaac zangx Le^aa yiem wuov norm dorngx.
Wuov nzong ndau caux mbaengx-kuotv tengx Hitv^tai Mienh maaiz daaih.”
Yaakopv paaiv waac mbuox liuz ninh nyei dorn mbuo, ninh bueix njiec coux ziouc dangx qiex, guei seix mi'aqv.
Yosepv buatc ninh nyei die dangx qiex, ninh ziouc puoqv jienv ninh nyei die gu'nguaaic qaqv nyiemv yaac zom ninh nyei die nyei hmien.
Ninh paaiv tengx ninh zoux gong wuov deix ndie-sai longc ndie-wuom ziemx jienv ninh nyei die, I^saa^laa^en, nyei sei bun sei maiv haih huv, maiv haih zueix.
Ndie-sai ziouc longc feix ziepc hnoi zoux, weic zuqc naaiv deix gong qiemx zuqc feix ziepc hnoi. I^yipv Mienh yaac tengx jienv nzauh nyiemv cietv ziepc hnoi.

Naaiv deix nzauh nyiemv nyei ziangh hoc jiex liuz, Yosepv gorngv mbuox Faalo Hungh nyei jien, “Se gorngv yie zoux duqv horpc meih mbuo, tov meih mbuo dorh yie naaiv deix waac mingh mbuox Faalo Hungh oc.

Mbuox ninh, ‘Yie nyei die oix guei seix wuov zanc, ninh oix yie laengz jiez ngaengc waac dorh ninh nyei sei mingh Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung zangx jienv ninh ganh zuqc ziangx nyei zouv-mouh.’ Hnangv naaiv, tov bun yie dorh yie nyei die mingh zangx. Zangx liuz, yie aengx nzuonx naaiv.”
Faalo Hungh dau, “Gunv dorh meih nyei die mingh zangx ziux meih caux ninh laengz jiez nyei waac.”

Yosepv ziouc dorh ninh nyei die mingh zangx aqv. Faalo Hungh nyei yietc zungv jien yaac caux jienv mingh. Se yiem hungh dinc zoux gauh hlo wuov deix jien, caux yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung haaix dauh zoux hlo nyei mienh, yaac gan jienv Yosepv mingh.

Yosepv nyei hmuangv doic caux ninh nyei muoz-doic aengx caux ninh nyei die nyei biauv zong mienh yietc zungv gan jienv mingh. Kungx zengc fu'jueiv-faix caux ba'gi yungh, yungh caux ngongh yiem wuov Gosen hnangv.
Maaih maaz-cie, maaih mienh geh maaz caux jienv mingh. Naaiv deix mienh yietc zungv benx yietc guanh camv nyei.
Mingh taux Jor^ndaen Ndaaih nyei dong bung maengx, Aataatv nyei mborqv mbiauh ciangv, ninh mbuo qaqv nyiemv mbui nyei. Yosepv yaac yiem naaic weic ninh nyei die nzauh nyiemv siec hnoi.

Yiem wuov norm dorngx nyei Kaa^naa^an Mienh buatc mienh yiem Aataatv mborqv mbiauh nyei ciangv nzauh nyiemv, ninh mbuo gorngv, “Naaiv deix I^yipv Mienh nzauh nyiemv, zoux norm janx-daic yinh hlo nyei.” Weic naaiv ninh mbuo ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc wuov norm dorngx Aa^mben Mitv^laa^im. Wuov norm dorngx yiem Jor^ndaen Ndaaih nyei dong bung maengx.
Yaakopv nyei dorn mbuo ziouc ei jienv ninh mbuo nyei die paaiv nyei waac zoux.

Ninh mbuo dorh sei mingh Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, zangx jienv yiem Makv^be^laa wuov nzong ndau nyei mbaengx-kuotv, leih Mamle maiv go. Dongh zinh ndaangc Apc^laa^ham tengx Hitv^tai Mienh, E^fo^lon, maaiz zoux zouv-gemh wuov nzong ndau.
Zangx liuz ninh nyei die, Yosepv caux ninh nyei muoz-doic aengx caux ninh mingh nyei mienh yietc zungv nzuonx I^yipv Deic-Bung aqv.
Ninh mbuo nyei die guei seix mi'aqv, Yosepv nyei gorx mbuo gorngv, “Nziex Yosepv oix nzorng mbuo mv bei, ziux mbuo zinh ndaangc zoux hoic ninh nyei sic oix winh bun mbuo.”
Ninh mbuo ziouc bun mienh mingh mbuox Yosepv, “Mbuo nyei die maiv gaengh guei seix wuov zanc ninh gorngv,

‘Oix zuqc mbuox Yosepv, tov guangc nqoi meih nyei gorx mbuo zoux dorngc hoic meih wuov deix sic.’ Ih zanc yie mbuo, meih nyei die nyei Tin-Hungh nyei bou, tov meih guangc nqoi yie mbuo zoux dorngc meih nyei zuiz.” Yosepv haiz cuotv naaiv deix waac ninh ziouc nyiemv aqv.
Ninh nyei gorx mbuo ziouc mingh taux Yosepv nyei nza'hmien gueic njiec ndau baaix aengx gorngv, “Yie mbuo yiem meih nyei nza'hmien tov zoux meih nyei nouh.”
Mv baac Yosepv gorngv mbuox ninh nyei gorx mbuo, “Maiv dungx gamh nziex. Yie se maiv zeiz Tin-Hungh.
Meih mbuo daav za'eix hoic yie, mv baac Tin-Hungh longc wuov nyungc za'eix zoux longx nyei sic. Hnangv ih zanc mbuo buatc jienv nor, ninh longc naaiv nyungc za'eix njoux mienh camv nyei maengc.
