Mv baac da'cietv hnyangx se Dingh Gong Hnyangx weic fungx bun Ziouv. Oix zuqc bun ndau hitv kuonx. Maiv dungx zuangx ga'naaiv meih mbuo nyei lingh deic fai fioux meih mbuo nyei a'ngunc huingx.
Maiv dungx mingh gaatv ninh ganh cuotv nyei gaeng-zuangx fai siou meih mbuo maiv fioux nyei a'ngunc huingx biouv. Oix zuqc bun ndau hitv kuonx yietc hnyangx.

Dingh Gong Hnyangx wuov hnyangx, ndau ganh cuotv nyei ga'naaiv se weic meih mbuo nyei nyanc hopv. Se weic meih mbuo ganh yaac weic meih mbuo nyei nouh gauv nouh beiz, weic meih mbuo cingv daaih nyei gong-mienh, caux yiem meih mbuo gu'nyuoz nyei ganh fingx mienh.
Naaiv deix ga'naaiv se weic meih mbuo nyei saeng-kuv nyanc caux yiem meih mbuo nyei deic-bung lomc zaangc nyei hieh zoih nyanc. Ndau ganh cuotv nyei haaix nyungc nyanc duqv nyei.
“+‘Meih mbuo oix zuqc saauv siec norm Dingh Gong Hnyangx, se saauv siec hnyangx siec nzunc. Yietc zungv se feix ziepc juov hnyangx.
Dongh wuov hnyangx, cietv hlaax saeng-ziepc, oix zuqc biomv nzatc nyei qiex mbui buangv norm-norm dorngx. Se Fiqv Zuiz Hnoi oix zuqc maaih nzatc nyei qiex mbui gormx meih mbuo nyei deic-bung.

Hnangv naaiv zoux se zorqv naaiv hmz ziepc hnyangx wuov hnyangx benx lengc jeiv nyei hnyangx yaac zunh mbuox yiem wuov norm deic-bung nyei zuangx baeqc fingx, ih hnyangx benx bungx nqoi nyei hnyangx. Gorqv-mienh oix zuqc nzuonx gorqv-mienh ganh nyei buonv-fingx, ganh nyei buonv-deic dorngx.

Hmz ziepc wuov hnyangx se weic meih mbuo zoux Houc nyei Hnyangx. Maiv dungx zuangx haaix nyungc. Ndau ganh cuotv nyei maiv dungx mingh gaatv. Maiv fioux nyei a'ngunc huingx nyei biouv maiv dungx mingh siou.
Weic zuqc wuov hnyangx se Houc nyei Hnyangx. Se weic meih mbuo benx cing-nzengc hnyangx. Meih mbuo kungx oix zuqc nyanc ndau ganh cuotv nyei ga'naaiv hnangv.
“+‘Yiem Houc nyei Hnyangx, gorqv-mienh oix zuqc nzuonx gorqv-mienh nyei buonv-deic dorngx.
“+‘Se gorngv meih mbuo maaic ndau bun meih mbuo nyei gorx-youz fai tengx ninh maaiz, laanh maiv dungx kuei laanh.
Meih mbuo oix zuqc tengx ninh maaiz ziux Houc nyei Hnyangx nqa'haav nyei hnyangx-soux. Ninh oix zuqc ziux aengx maaih zuangx ga'naaiv nyei hnyangx-soux nyei soux mouc maaic.
Hnyangx-soux camv, oix zuqc bun jaax-zinh faaux deix. Hnyangx-soux zoqc, bun jaax-zinh njiec deix. Weic zuqc ninh maaic nyei se zuangx duqv ga'naaiv nyei hnyangx-soux.
Meih mbuo maiv dungx laanh kuei laanh, mv baac oix zuqc gamh nziex, taaih meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, weic zuqc yie se Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.
“+‘Meih mbuo oix zuqc gan yie nyei lingc, muangx longx yie nyei leiz, meih mbuo ziouc baengh orn nyei yiem wuov norm deic-bung.
Ndau yaac oix cuotv gaeng-zuangx, meih mbuo ziouc duqv nyanc beuv. Meih mbuo yaac duqv baengh orn nyei yiem.
Nziex meih mbuo oix naaic, “Se gorngv da'cietv hnyangx yie mbuo maiv duqv zuangx yaac maiv duqv siou, oix zuqc nyanc haaix nyungc?”
Da'luoqc hnyangx yie oix ceix fuqv camv nyei, bun ndau cuotv gaeng-zuangx gaux nyanc buo hnyangx.
Da'betv hnyangx meih mbuo zuangx nyei ziangh hoc, corc duqv nyanc loz nyei, yaac duqv nyanc jienv mingh taux da'juov hnyangx siou nyei ziangh hoc.
“+‘Meih mbuo maaic ndau maiv dungx maaic dangx, weic zuqc ndau se yie nyei. Meih mbuo se hnangv kaeqv mienh yaac hnangv ganh fingx mienh daaih caux yie yiem nor.
Yiem meih mbuo duqv nzipc nyei yietc zungv ndau, oix zuqc bun mienh haih zuoqc nzuonx.
“+‘Se gorngv maaih dauh meih mbuo nyei gorx-youz jomc njiec ziouc maaic deix ninh nyei ndau, ninh gauh cien jiex wuov dauh cien-ceqv oix zuqc daaih zuoqc ninh nyei gorx-youz maaic nyei ndau nzuonx.
Se gorngv wuov dauh mienh maiv maaih haaix dauh zuoqc ndau, ninh ganh manc-manc benx daaih ziouc maaih gaux zuoqc,
oix zuqc funx yiem ninh maaic mingh duqv mbu'ziex hnyangx, zorqv zengc njiec nyei hnyangx-soux nyei jaax-zinh tuix bun maaiz ndau wuov dauh. Ninh ziouc duqv nzuonx ganh nyei ndau aqv.

Mv baac se gorngv wuov dauh mienh maiv maaih nyaanh gaux zuoqc ninh maaic nyei ndau, ndau ziouc benx dongh maaiz wuov dauh mienh nyei taux Houc nyei Hnyangx. Taux wuov hnyangx oix zuqc fungx nzuonx bun maaic wuov dauh ziouv. Loz-ziouv ziouc duqv nzuonx mingh yiem ninh ganh nyei ndau.
“+‘Se gorngv mienh maaic biauv yiem maaih zingh laatc nyei zingh, maaic liuz daauh hnyangx ninh zuoqc nzuonx duqv nyei. Yiem yietc hnyangx gu'nyuoz corc maaih leiz zuoqc nzuonx.

Se gorngv yietc hnyangx gu'nyuoz maiv duqv zuoqc nzuonx, yiem maaih zingh laatc nyei zingh wuov norm biauv ziouc benx maaiz wuov laanh mienh caux ninh doic jiex doic nyei zeiv-fun nyei mi'aqv. Taux Houc nyei Hnyangx yaac maiv zuqc tuix nzuonx.
Mv baac biauv yiem maiv maaih zingh laatc nyei laangz oix zuqc funx hnangv ndeic nor. Zuoqc nzuonx duqv nyei. Taux Houc nyei Hnyangx maaiz nyei mienh zungv oix zuqc tuix nzuonx.
“+‘Yiem Lewi Mienh duqv nzipc nyei zingh, ninh mbuo nyei biauv Lewi Mienh haaix zanc yaac maaih leiz zuoqc duqv nyei.

Mv baac se gorngv yiem Lewi Mienh nyei zingh maaih dauh Lewi Mienh maaic biauv yaac maiv zuoqc nzuonx, taux Houc nyei Hnyangx maaiz nyei mienh oix zuqc tuix nzuonx, weic zuqc yiem Lewi Mienh nyei zingh nyei biauv se yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh mbu'ndongx duqv nzipc nyei buonc.
Mv baac wuov deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv maiv dungx maaic, weic zuqc benx ninh mbuo yietc liuz duqv nzipc nyei buonc.

“+‘Se gorngv maaih dauh meih mbuo nyei gorx-youz jomc njiec, yungz maiv duqv ganh, meih mbuo oix zuqc nzie ninh, bun ninh duqv caux meih mbuo yiem hnangv ganh fingx mienh fai haaix dauh daaih ziouc meih mbuo yiem nyei mienh wuov nor.
Maiv dungx longc haaix nyungc ndaauv-daauh. Oix zuqc gamh nziex, taaih meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, weic bun meih mbuo nyei gorx-youz duqv yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx.
Bungx zaeqv bun ninh, maiv dungx longc ndaauv-daauh. Maaic nyanc hopv bun ninh yaac maiv dungx douh weic duqv leic zinh.
Yie se Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh dorh meih mbuo yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung cuotv daaih weic zorqv Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung jiu bun meih mbuo yaac zoux meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh wuov dauh.
“Se gorngv maaih dauh gorx-youz jomc njiec, zorqv ganh maaic tengx meih zoux nouh, meih maiv dungx bun ninh zoux gong hnangv nouh nor.
Ninh oix zuqc caux meih yiem hnangv cingv daaih nyei gong-mienh fai ziouc meih yiem nyei mienh. Ninh oix zuqc tengx meih zoux gong taux Houc nyei Hnyangx.
Taux wuov hnyangx ninh caux ninh nyei fu'jueiv duqv cuotv aengx nzuonx ganh nyei buonv-fingx mienh caux ninh nyei ong-taaix nyei buonv-deic dorngx.
Weic zuqc I^saa^laa^en Mienh se yie nyei bou, dongh yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung yie dorh cuotv daaih, maiv dungx maaic ninh mbuo zoux nouh.
Yaac maiv dungx gunv ba'laqc jienv, guatc doqc zeix ninh mbuo. Oix zuqc gamh nziex, taaih meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.
“+‘Meih mbuo duqv nyei nouh gauv nouh beiz oix zuqc yiem weih gormx meih mbuo wuov deix ganh fingx mienh maaiz.

Meih mbuo yaac haih maaiz yiem meih mbuo gu'nyuoz nyei ganh fingx mienh caux yiem meih mbuo nyei deic-bung cuotv seix, dongh wuov deix mienh nyei bungh buonc. Ninh mbuo ziouc benx meih mbuo nyei jaa-dingh mi'aqv.

Meih mbuo haih liouh bun meih mbuo nyei naamh nyouz nzipc yaac bun ninh mbuo ziangh seix zoux nouh. Mv baac meih mbuo gunv I^saa^laa^en gorx-youz, maiv dungx gunv ba'laqc jienv, guatc doqc zeix ninh mbuo.

“+‘Se gorngv yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx maaih dauh ganh fingx mienh fai daaih ziouc meih mbuo yiem nyei mienh butv zoih jiez daaih, aengx maaih dauh meih mbuo nyei gorx-youz jomc njiec ziouc maaic ganh zoux nouh tengx wuov dauh ganh fingx mienh fai ziouc meih mbuo wuov dauh fai yietc dauh ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc mienh,
ninh corc oix zuqc maaih leiz zuoqc ganh nzuonx. Maaih dauh ninh nyei cien-ceqv zuoqc ninh nzuonx yaac duqv.
Ninh nyei baeqv fai baeqv-muoz doic fai haaix dauh juangc fingx juangc nziaamv-fei nyei cien-ceqv zuoqc ninh duqv nyei. Fai se gorngv ninh ganh benx daaih, zuoqc ganh yaac duqv nyei.

Ninh oix zuqc caux maaiz ninh wuov dauh funx yiem maaiz nyei ziangh hoc taux Houc nyei Hnyangx nyei hnyangx-soux. Zuoqc ninh nyei jaax-zinh oix zuqc ziux cingv daaih nyei gong-mienh zoux gong nyei hnyangx-soux nyei gong-zinh.
Se gorngv corc maaih zengc njiec nyei hnyangx-soux camv ziouc oix zuqc ziux camv nyei hnyangx-soux tuix nzuonx zoux zuoqc nyei jaax-zinh.
Se gorngv taux Houc nyei Hnyangx zengc njiec nyei hnyangx zoqc, oix zuqc caux maaiz ninh wuov dauh ziux hnyangx-soux funx zuoqc nyei jaax-zinh tuix nzuonx.
Maaiz ninh wuov dauh ziouv oix zuqc funx ninh hnangv hnyangx jiex hnyangx cingv daaih nyei gong-mienh. Yaac maiv dungx bun ninh nyei ziouv gunv ba'laqc jienv, guatc doqc zeix ninh.
“+‘Se gorngv ninh maiv duqv ziux naaiv deix haaix diuc jauv zuoqc nzuonx, taux Houc nyei Hnyangx oix zuqc bungx ninh caux ninh nyei dorn-jueiv cuotv,
weic zuqc I^saa^laa^en Mienh benx yie nyei bou. Ninh mbuo zoux yie nyei bou, dongh yie yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung dorh cuotv daaih. Yie se Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.

“+‘Yiem meih mbuo nyei deic-bung maiv dungx zoux haaix nyungc miuc-fangx fai liepc haaix nyungc nyei fangx zeiv fai la'bieiv-ndiouh fai zuqc daaih nyei la'bieiv weic ganh gueic njiec baaix. Yie se Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.
“+‘Oix zuqc gan longx yie nyei norm-norm Dingh Gong Hnoi, yaac oix zuqc taaih yie nyei singx dinc. Yie se Ziouv.
“+‘Se gorngv meih mbuo gan longx yie nyei lingc, muangx longx yie nyei leiz, yaac ei jienv zoux,
yie oix ziux cun-ciou bun lungh duih mbiungc. Ndau ziouc cuotv gaeng-zuangx. Biouv-ndeic nyei ndiangx yaac oix ziangh biouv.

Mborqv mbiauh ziouc duqv mborqv taux gaeqv a'ngunc biouv nyei ziangh hoc. Gaeqv a'ngunc biouv yaac duqv gaeqv taux aengx zuangx ga'naaiv nyei ziangh hoc. Meih mbuo ziouc maaih nyanc maaih hopv beuv. Meih mbuo yaac duqv baengh orn nyei yiem meih mbuo nyei deic-bung.

“+‘Yie oix bun wuov norm deic-bung taaix-baengh. Meih mbuo oix duqv bueix njiec yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh bun meih mbuo gamh nziex. Yie oix bun wuov norm deic-bung ciouv nyei hieh zoih zutc nzengc. Meih mbuo nyei deic-bung yaac maiv maaih mborqv jaax nyei sic.
Meih mbuo oix zunc meih mbuo nyei win-wangv, ninh mbuo ziouc yiem meih mbuo nyei wuov ndaangc maengx zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix.
Meih mbuo biaa dauh oix zunc yietc baeqv dauh. Yietc baeqv dauh oix zunc yietc waanc dauh. Meih mbuo nyei win-wangv ziouc yiem meih mbuo nyei wuov ndaangc maengx zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix.
“+‘Yie oix jangx meih mbuo, ceix fuqv bun meih mbuo maaih zeiv-fun hiaangx jienv faaux, yaac oix ei jienv yie caux meih mbuo liepc jiez nyei ngaengc waac.
Meih mbuo corc nyanc jienv loz-mbiauh, zungv oix zuqc zorqv cuotv loz nyei weic bun maaih dorngx dapv siang nyei.
Yie oix liepc yie yiem nyei dorngx yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx. Yie yaac maiv nzorng meih mbuo.
Yie oix yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx yaac zoux meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Meih mbuo yaac oix zoux yie nyei baeqc fingx.

Yie se Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh dorh meih mbuo cuotv I^yipv Deic-Bung daaih weic bun meih mbuo maiv zuqc zoux I^yipv Mienh nyei nouh. Yie wuotv nauv meih mbuo nyei ndiangx-gaaz bun meih mbuo duqv souv zaqc daaih yangh jauv.
“+‘Mv baac se gorngv meih mbuo maiv muangx yie, yaac maiv ei yie nyei diuh diuh leiz-latc zoux,
yaac se gorngv meih mbuo ngaengc jienv yie nyei lingc, youx yie hatc nyei waac, maiv gan yie nyei yietc zungv leiz, ziouc bun yie nyei ngaengc waac ndortv,

yie oix hnangv naaiv nor zoux bun meih mbuo. Yie oix bun meih mbuo liemh zeih zuqc domh heiv sic, butv baengc-ngaaiz, butv sin jorm baengc, m'zing gunv zoux gunv mbuov, maengc manc-manc kou nqaai nzengc. Meih mbuo yaac baeqc baeqc zuangx ga'naaiv weic zuqc meih mbuo nyei win-wangv oix daaih nyanc nzengc.
Yie oix mbienv hmien bun meih mbuo. Meih mbuo ziouc suei meih mbuo nyei win-wangv. Nzorng meih mbuo wuov deix oix duqv gunv meih mbuo. Meih mbuo oix biaux maiv gunv maiv maaih haaix dauh zunc nqaang.
“+‘Se gorngv meih mbuo buangh liuz ndongc naaic nyei sic corc maiv muangx yie, yie ziouc ziux meih mbuo zoux nyei dingc zuiz taux siec gouv.
Yie oix mietc nzengc meih mbuo hnyouv ngaengc, zoux maux nyei qaqv. Yie oix bun lungh haanz, bun ndau mbang ngaengc nyei.
Meih mbuo ziouc baeqc baeqc ndortv qaqv, weic zuqc meih mbuo nyei ndau maiv cuotv gaeng-zuangx. Wuov norm deic-bung nyei ndiangx yaac maiv ziangh biouv.
“+‘Se gorngv meih mbuo corc ngaengc jienv maiv kangv muangx yie, yie ziouc bun zeqc naanc hoic meih mbuo ziux meih mbuo zoux nyei jaa dingc zuiz taux siec gouv.

Yie oix bun hieh zoih bieqc meih mbuo mbu'ndongx. Ninh mbuo oix betv meih mbuo nyei fu'jueiv, naqv meih mbuo nyei saeng-kuv, bun meih mbuo nyei mienh zoqc nzengc, meih mbuo nyei jauv zungv zuqc benx jauv-huaang.
“+‘Se gorngv hnangv naaiv nor mborqv njaaux mv baac meih mbuo corc maiv muangx yie, corc ngaengc jienv yie,
yie ganh oix ngaengc jienv meih mbuo, weic meih mbuo zoux nyei zuiz bun meih mbuo zuqc kouv taux siec nzunc.

Laaix meih mbuo bungx ndortv caux yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac, yie oix bun meih mbuo zuqc mborqv jaax nyei sic jaauv win. Se gorngv meih mbuo gapv zunv yiem zingh gu'nyuoz, yie oix bun meih mbuo butv domh wuon-baengc. Meih mbuo zungv oix zuqc jiu bun yiem meih mbuo nyei win-wangv nyei buoz-ndiev.

Yie zoux bun meih mbuo nyei laangh ziqc dangx wuov zanc, ziepc dauh m'sieqv dorn oix juangc yietc norm nzox ziqv njuov. Njuov yaac oix zuqc ziux hniev-daauh nziang bun nqoi. Meih mbuo duqv nyanc yaac nyanc maiv beuv.
“+‘Se gorngv zuqc ndongc naaic meih mbuo corc maiv muangx yie, ngaengc jienv yie,
yie ziouc qiex jiez! haic, ngaengc jienv meih mbuo, weic meih mbuo zoux nyei dingc zuiz taux siec nzunc.
Meih mbuo ziouc nyanc meih mbuo nyei dorn nyei orv, nyanc meih mbuo nyei sieqv nyei orv.

Yie yaac oix mietc meih mbuo yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx, zoux baaic meih mbuo nyei buov hung dieh yaac zorqv meih mbuo nyei sei zoi an jienv mbaang wuov deix miuc-fangx gu'nguaaic. Yie nyei hnyouv yaac oix nzorng haic meih mbuo.
Yie oix bun meih mbuo nyei zingh benx zingh huaang, zoux waaic baaix zienh nyei dorngx. Meih mbuo dorh ga'naaiv daaih ziec zoux ndaang nyei qiex yie yaac maiv a'hneiv.
Yie oix bun deic-bung benx deic-bung-huaang, liemh daaih yiem jienv nyei win-wangv oix mbuoqc horngh haic.

Yie oix zoux bun meih mbuo nzaanx mingh yiem maanc guoqv mbu'ndongx, yaac oix baeng nzuqc ndaauv cuotv paiv zunc meih mbuo. Meih mbuo nyei ndau ziouc benx ndau-huaang. Meih mbuo nyei zingh yaac benx zingh huaang.

Hnangv naaic, meih mbuo yiem win-wangv nyei deic-bung, meih mbuo nyei deic-bung benx ndau-huaang nyei ziangh hoc, ndau ziouc duqv jiex ninh nyei Dingh Gong Hnyangx. Taux wuov zanc, ndau ziouc duqv hitv kuonx, njien-youh nyei jiex ninh nyei Dingh Gong Hnyangx.
Deic-bung benx ndau-huaang ndongc haaix lauh ziouc duqv hitv ndongc wuov. Se ndau duqv hitv kuonx hnangv meih mbuo yiem jienv jiex Dingh Gong Hnyangx, ndau maiv duqv hitv kuonx nor.

“+‘Meih mbuo zengc njiec nyei mienh, yie oix bun yiem win-wangv nyei deic-bung, hnyouv gamh nziex jienv yiem. Haiz nziaaux buonc yietc kuaaiv ndiangx-normh mbui ziouc haeqv ninh mbuo biaux. Ninh mbuo oix tiux hnangv biaux nzuqc ndaauv. Ninh mbuo yaac oix ndorpc, maiv gunv maiv maaih haaix dauh zunc nqaang.
Laanh oix ndiqv zuqc laanh ndorpc hnangv biaux nzuqc ndaauv nor, maiv gunv maiv maaih haaix dauh zunc. Ninh mbuo zungv maiv maaih qaqv caux meih mbuo nyei win-wangv mborqv jaax.
Meih mbuo oix yiem fingx-fingx mienh mbu'ndongx zuqc mietc. Meih mbuo nyei win-wangv nyei deic-bung yaac oix naqv meih mbuo.
Meih mbuo zengc njiec nyei mienh, laaix ganh zoux nyei zuiz caux ong-taaix nyei zuiz, oix yiem win-wangv nyei deic-bung manc-manc zutc nzengc mi'aqv.
“+‘Mv baac se gorngv ninh mbuo nyiemc ganh nyei zuiz caux ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix nyei zuiz, se ninh mbuo baamz yie, ngaengc jienv yie,

yie cingx ngaengc jienv ninh mbuo, dorh ninh mbuo bieqc win-wangv nyei deic-bung wuov zanc, se gorngv ninh mbuo hnyouv ngaengc nyei mienh, zatv ganh njiec yaac ziux ninh mbuo baamz nyei zuqc dingc liuz zuiz,
yie ziouc jangx taux yie caux Yaakopv liepc nyei ngaengc waac, caux I^sakc liepc nyei ngaengc waac, yaac caux Apc^laa^ham liepc nyei ngaengc waac. Yie yaac jangx taux wuov norm deic-bung aqv.

Mv baac ninh mbuo oix zuqc guangc ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung. Maiv maaih ninh mbuo yiem nyei ziangh hoc, ndau ziouc henh, njien-youh nyei hitv kuonx. Laaix ninh mbuo nqemh yie nyei leiz-latc, nzorng yie nyei lingc, ninh mbuo oix zuqc ziux ninh mbuo baamz nyei zuiz zuqc dingc zuiz.

Maiv gunv hnangv naaic, ninh mbuo yiem win-wangv nyei deic-bung, yie maiv youx ninh mbuo, fai nzorng ninh mbuo weic zorqv ninh mbuo mietc nzengc. Se gorngv hnangv naaiv zoux, yie caux ninh mbuo liepc jiez nyei ngaengc waac ziouc baac mi'aqv. Yie se Ziouv, ninh mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.

Yie oix weic ninh mbuo nyei gorn jangx yie caux ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix liepc nyei ngaengc waac, dongh yie dorng jienv fingx-fingx mienh dorh cuotv I^yipv Deic-Bung weic zoux ninh mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Yie se Ziouv. ’+”
Naaiv deix lingc caux leiz-latc caux diuh diuh leiz se Ziouv yiem Sinaai Mbong, longc Mose weic I^saa^laa^en Mienh liepc daaih.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc mbuox I^saa^laa^en Mienh, ‘Se gorngv haaix dauh zorqv mienh lengc jeiv nyei houv bun Ziouv, oix zuqc puix wuov laanh mienh nyei jaax-zinh bun.
Oix zuqc ziux hnyangx-jeiv yiem nyic ziepc hnyangx taux luoqc ziepc hnyangx nyei m'jangc dorn, ziux singx dinc dingc daaih nyei nyaanh bun ziepc hmz lungz.
Se gorngv m'sieqv dorn, oix zuqc dingc betv lungz.
Se gorngv biaa hnyangx taux nyic ziepc hnyangx nyei dorn, oix zuqc dingc luoqc lungz. M'sieqv dorn, faam-lungz.
Se gorngv yietc hlaax taux biaa hnyangx nyei dorn dingc yietc lungz faam-zinh, sieqv, betv zinh.
Luoqc ziepc hnyangx faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn oix zuqc dingc feix lungz, m'sieqv dorn, faam-lungz.

Se gorngv haaix dauh laengz jiez ngaengc waac mv baac jomc haic, cuotv maiv jiez ziux dingc daaih nyei jaax-zinh, ninh oix zuqc dorh wuov laanh mienh mingh taux sai mienh wuov. Sai mienh ziouc ziux laengz ngaengc waac wuov laanh mienh haih cuotv duqv jiez nyei jaax-zinh dingc.
“+‘Se gorngv houv bun Ziouv nyei ga'naaiv se saeng-kuv, naaiv deix jiu bun Ziouv nyei saeng-kuv ziouc cing-nzengc mi'aqv.

Yaac maiv dungx tiuv. Maiv dungx zorqv dauh longx nyei div maiv benx nyei, fai zorqv dauh waaic nyei tiuv longx nyei. Se gorngv tiuv saeng-kuv, liemh dorh daaih tiuv caux laengz bun wuov dauh cing-nzengc mi'aqv.
Se gorngv houv nyei se maaih uix nyei saeng-kuv, dongh maiv haih fongc horc bun Ziouv nyei ga'naaiv, oix zuqc dorh wuov dauh saeng-kuv mingh jiu bun sai mienh.
Sai mienh ziouc mborqv jaax-zinh ziux longx nyei fai waaic nyei. Sai mienh mborqv jaax-zinh hnangv haaix nor ziouc oix zuqc hnangv wuov nor mi'aqv.
Se gorngv saeng-kuv ziouv oix zuoqc saeng-kuv nzuonx, oix zuqc bun buonv-zinh aengx jaa tipv biaa gouv nyei yietc gouv.

“+‘Se gorngv mienh zorqv ganh nyei biauv fungx bun Ziouv weic zoux cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv, sai mienh ziouc mborqv jaax-zinh ziux biauv benx fai maiv benx. Sai mienh mborqv jaax-zinh mbu'ziex ziouc oix zuqc hnangv wuov nor mi'aqv.
Se gorngv fungx biauv wuov laanh mienh oix zuoqc biauv nzuonx, oix zuqc bun buonv-zinh aengx jaa tipv biaa gouv nyei yietc gouv. Biauv ziouc aengx benx ninh nyei mi'aqv.

“+‘Se gorngv mienh zorqv deix ninh ganh nzipc nyei ndau fungx bun Ziouv, oix zuqc ziux naaiv deix ndau zuangx duqv nyim mbu'ziex mborqv jaax-zinh. Zuangx duqv ziepc yietv tongv mbiauh mbaali nyim oix zuqc mborqv jaax-zinh ziepc hmz lungz nyaanh.
Se gorngv Houc nyei Hnyangx wuov hnyangx fungx nor, oix zuqc ziux dingc daaih nyei jaax-zinh bun buangv.

Se gorngv jiex liuz Houc nyei Hnyangx, nqa'haav cingx fungx bun Ziouv, sai mienh oix zuqc funx corc maaih mbu'ziex hnyangx cingx taux Houc nyei Hnyangx ziouc ziux dingc daaih nyei jaax-zinh bun zoqc njiec.
Se gorngv fungx nyei mienh ganh oix zuoqc ndau nzuonx, ninh oix zuqc bun buonv-zinh aengx jaa tipv biaa gouv nyei yietc gouv. Ndau ziouc aengx benx ninh ganh nyei mi'aqv.
Mv baac se gorngv ninh maiv zuoqc ninh nyei ndau fai zorqv ninh nyei ndau maaic bun ganh dauh, ninh yietc liuz maiv haih zuoqc nzuonx.
Taux Houc nyei Hnyangx fungx ndau nzuonx nyei ziangh hoc, ndau ziouc cing-nzengc weic zuqc fungx bun Ziouv mi'aqv. Ndau ziouc benx sai mienh nyei buonc.
“+‘Se gorngv maaih dauh mienh maaiz nzong ndau daaih, maiv zeiz ninh nzipc daaih nyei ndau, ninh yaac fungx bun Ziouv,
sai mienh ziouc mborqv jaax-zinh funx taux Houc nyei Hnyangx. Dongh wuov hnoi ninh oix zuqc cuotv mborqv daaih nyei jaax-zinh nyei nyaanh benx cing-nzengc ga'naaiv fungx bun Ziouv.
Taux Houc nyei Hnyangx, ndau ziouc nzuonx benx ninh tengx maaiz wuov dauh loz-ziouv nyei mi'aqv, dongh zinh ndaangc nzipc daaih wuov dauh ziouv.
Nyungc-nyungc nyei jaax-zinh oix zuqc mborqv ziux singx dinc nyei nyaanh.
“+‘Maiv maaih haaix dauh haih zorqv daauh toi saeng-kuv fungx bun Ziouv weic zuqc zungv benx Ziouv nyei mi'aqv. Maiv gunv ngongh fai yungh, benx Ziouv nyei mi'aqv.
Se gorngv maaih uix nyei saeng-kuv, oix zuqc ziux mborqv daaih nyei jaax-zinh zuoqc aengx jaa tipv biaa gouv nyei yietc gouv. Maiv zuoqc nor, oix zuqc ziux mborqv daaih nyei jaax-zinh maaic.

“+‘Haaix dauh zorqv haaix nyungc ninh ganh nyei ga'naaiv fungx dangx bun Ziouv, maiv gunv mienh, saeng-kuv, fai nzipc daaih nyei ndau, maiv haih maaic yaac maiv haih zuoqc nzuonx. Fungx dangx bun Ziouv nyei nyungc-nyungc ga'naaiv se gauh cing-nzengc jiex.
“+‘Liemh mienh se gorngv fungx dangx bun Ziouv liuz, maiv haih zuoqc nzuonx. Oix zuqc daix daic.
“+‘Yiem ndau cuotv nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv, liemh laangh ziqc liemh ndiangx nyei biouv, ziepc gouv nyei yietc gouv benx Ziouv nyei mi'aqv.
Se gorngv haaix dauh oix zuoqc haaix deix ninh nyei ziepc gouv nyei yietc gouv, oix zuqc bun buonv-zinh aengx jaa tipv biaa gouv nyei yietc gouv.
Da'faanh ngongh guanh, ba'gi yungh fai yungh guanh, ziepc gouv nyei yietc gouv, se ziepc dauh nyei yietc dauh ziouc cing-nzengc weic fungx bun Ziouv.
Maiv dungx ginv cuotv benx fai maiv benx yaac maiv dungx tiuv. Se gorngv ninh gengh oix tiuv nor, liemh dorh daaih wuov dauh caux oix tiuv wuov dauh se cing-nzengc mi'aqv. Maiv haih zuoqc aqv.’+”
Naaiv deix hatc nyei waac se Ziouv yiem Sinaai Mbong jiu bun Mose weic I^saa^laa^en Mienh.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh cuotv I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei da'nyeic hnyangx, nyeic hlaax, saeng-yietv wuov hnoi, yiem Sinaai Deic-Bung-Huaang, Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh wuov, Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc tengx I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh faaux mienh houz ziux yietc fingx yietc fingx, yietc buonc yietc buonc. Yaac oix zuqc faaux yietc dauh yietc dauh m'jangc dorn nyei mbuox.
Meih caux Aalon oix zuqc ziux guanh guanh I^saa^laa^en Mienh faaux mbuox, yiem hnyangx-jeiv nyic ziepc hnyangx gu'nguaaic, haih zoux duqv baeng nyei dauh dauh m'jangc dorn nyei mbuox.
Fingx-fingx oix zuqc maaih dauh zoux ninh mbuo nyei buonv-fingx mienh nyei bieiv zeiv daaih tengx meih mbuo.”
Tengx meih wuov deix mienh nyei mbuox maaih hnangv naaiv. Lu^mben Fingx Se^nde^e nyei dorn, E^li^su
Si^me^on Fingx Sux^li^satv^ndai nyei dorn, Se^lu^mi^en
Yu^ndaa Fingx Am^mi^naa^ndapc nyei dorn, Naason
Itc^saax^kaa Fingx Zu^aa nyei dorn, Ne^tan^en
Se^mbu^lun Fingx Helon nyei dorn, E^li^apc
E^faa^im Fingx Am^mi^hutv nyei dorn, E^li^saa^maa Maa^natv^se Fingx Be^ndaa^su nyei dorn, Gaa^maa^li^en
Mben^yaa^min Fingx Gi^nde^o^ni nyei dorn, Aa^mbi^ndan
Ndaan Fingx Am^mi^qatv^ndai nyei dorn, Aa^hi^ye^se
Aa^se Fingx Okaan nyei dorn, Baa^gi^en
Gaatc Fingx Nde^u^en nyei dorn, E^li^yaa^saapc
Napv^taa^li Fingx Enan nyei dorn, Aa^hi^laa
Naaiv deix mienh se zuangx mienh ginv daaih zoux fingx-fingx I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv, se dongh loz-hnoi ong-taaix liepc daaih nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.
Mose caux Aalon ziouc dorh jienv dongh maaih mbuox naaiv deix mienh,

taux nyeic hlaax, saeng-yietv wuov hnoi, ninh mbuo heuc zuangx mienh gapv zunv ziouc ziux ong-taaix nyei bungh buonc caux mienh buonc faaux mienh houz, yaac ziux dauh dauh duqv nyic ziepc hnyangx faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn, yietc dauh yietc dauh nyei faaux mbuox.
Ziux Ziouv mbuox Mose zoux, ninh yiem Sinaai Deic-Bung-Huaang saauv mienh.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose caux Aalon,

“I^saa^laa^en Mienh oix zuqc corng ganh nyei ndopv-liuh huing gormx yaac huin mingh Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh wuov bung, gorqv-mienh yiem gorqv-mienh nyei buonv-fingx geh caux bungh buonc geh ga'ndiev.”

Yiem dong bung maengx, mba'hnoi cuotv wuov bung, Yu^ndaa Fingx nyei guanh guanh oix zuqc corng ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh yiem ganh nyei geh ga'ndiev. Yu^ndaa Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Am^mi^naa^ndapc nyei dorn, Naason.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih siec waanc biei cin luoqc baeqv dauh.
Itc^saax^kaa Fingx oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh nitv jienv Yu^ndaa Fingx. Itc^saax^kaa Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Zu^aa nyei dorn, Ne^tan^en.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih biaa waanc biei cin feix baeqv dauh.
Jiex mingh, Se^mbu^lun Fingx oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh nitv jienv. Se^mbu^lun Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Helon nyei dorn, E^li^apc.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih biaa waanc siec cin feix baeqv dauh.
Bieqc Yu^ndaa wuov bung nyei guanh guanh yietc zungv maaih yietc sinx hietc waanc juqv cin feix baeqv dauh. Cuotv jauv nyei ziangh hoc naaiv deix oix zuqc mingh ndaangc.
Yiem naamh bung maengx, Lu^mben Fingx nyei guanh guanh oix zuqc corng ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh yiem ganh nyei geh ga'ndiev. Lu^mben Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Se^nde^e nyei dorn, E^li^su.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih biei waanc juqv cin hmz baeqv dauh.
Si^me^on Fingx oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh nitv jienv Lu^mben Fingx. Si^me^on Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Sux^li^satv^ndai nyei dorn, Se^lu^mi^en.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih biaa waanc nduoh cin faam-baeqv dauh.
Jiex mingh, Gaatc Fingx oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh nitv jienv. Gaatc Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Nde^u^en nyei dorn, E^li^ yaa^saapc.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih biei waanc biaa cin luoqc baeqv hmz ziepc dauh.
Bieqc Lu^mben wuov bung nyei guanh guanh yietc zungv maaih yietc sinx biaa waanc yietc cin feix baeqv hmz ziepc dauh. Cuotv jauv nyei ziangh hoc naaiv deix zoux da'nyeic guanh.

Cuotv jauv nyei ziangh hoc, mingh ndaangc wuov deix i guanh caux nqa'haav mingh wuov deix i guanh mbu'ndongx, oix zuqc maaih Lewi Mienh dorh jienv Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh mingh. Oix zuqc zueih yietv zueih nyeic cuotv jauv ziux guanh guanh corng ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh. Guanh guanh oix zuqc yiem ganh nyei dorngx yaac yiem ganh nyei geh ga'ndiev.
Yiem fai bung maengx, E^faa^im Fingx nyei guanh guanh oix zuqc corng ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh yiem ganh nyei geh ga'ndiev. E^faa^im Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Am^mi^hutv nyei dorn, E^li^saa^maa.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih biei waanc hmz baeqv dauh.
Maa^natv^se Fingx oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh nitv jienv E^faa^im Fingx. Maa^natv^se Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Be^ndaa^su nyei dorn, Gaa^maa^li^en.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih buo waanc i cin nyic baeqv dauh.
Jiex mingh, Mben^yaa^min Fingx oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh nitv jienv. Mben^yaa^min Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Gi^nde^o^ni nyei dorn, Aa^mbi^ndan.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih buo waanc biaa cin feix baeqv dauh.
Bieqc E^faa^im wuov bung nyei guanh guanh yietc zungv maaih yietc sinx hietc cin yietc baeqv dauh. Cuotv jauv nyei ziangh hoc naaiv guanh zoux da'faam guanh.
Yiem baqv bung maengx, Ndaan Fingx nyei guanh guanh oix zuqc corng ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh yiem ganh nyei geh ga'ndiev. Ndaan Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Am^mi^qatv^ndai nyei dorn, Aa^hi^ye^se.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih juqv waanc i cin cietv baeqv dauh.
Aa^se Fingx oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh nitv jienv Ndaan Fingx. Aa^se Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Okaan nyei dorn, Baa^gi^en.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih biei waanc yietc cin hmz baeqv dauh.
Jiex mingh, Napv^taa^li Fingx oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh nitv jienv. Napv^taa^li Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maaih Enan nyei dorn, Aa^hi^laa.
Ninh nyei guanh maaih biaa waanc buo cin feix baeqv dauh.
Bieqc Ndaan Fingx wuov bung yietc zungv maaih yietc sinx biaa waanc siec cin luoqc baeqv dauh. Cuotv jauv nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo zoux nqa'haav laai wuov guanh yaac yiem ganh nyei geh ga'ndiev.
Naaiv se I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei mienh houz saauv. Yiem ndopv-liuh ciangv ziux ninh mbuo nyei guanh saauv daaih yietc zungv maaih juqv sinx buo cin hmz baeqv hmz ziepc dauh mienh.
Mv baac Lewi Mienh maiv duqv saauv bieqc wuov deix I^saa^laa^en Mienh hnangv Ziouv paaiv Mose nor.

I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziouc zoux nzengc ziux Ziouv paaiv Mose nyei waac. Ninh mbuo hnangv naaiv nor yiem ninh mbuo nyei geh ga'ndiev corng ndopv-liuh. Gorqv-mienh yaac ziux gorqv-mienh nyei fingx hnangv wuov nor cuotv jauv.
Naaiv se Aalon caux Mose nyei ziex doic mienh, doix Mose yiem Sinaai Mbong, Ziouv caux ninh gorngv waac nyei ziangh hoc.
Aalon nyei dorn nyei mbuox maaih hnangv naaiv. Dorn-hlo heuc Naa^ndapc yaac maaih Aa^mbi^hu, E^le^aa^saa, caux I^taa^maa.
Naaiv se Aalon nyei dorn nyei mbuox, dongh Mose longc youh orn daaih zoux sai mienh, paaiv zoux sai mienh nyei gong.

Mv baac yiem Sinaai Deic-Bung-Huaang wuov zanc, Naa^ndapc caux Aa^mbi^hu longc maiv maaih leiz longc nyei douz ziec bun Ziouv ziouc zuqc yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien daic mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo maiv maaih dorn-jueiv. Hnangv naaic, Aalon ziangh jienv nyei ziangh hoc, kungx maaih E^le^aa^saa caux I^taa^maa zoux sai mienh nyei gong hnangv.
Ziouv aengx gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc dorh Lewi Fingx daaih jiu bun Aalon sai mienh weic tengx ninh.
Ninh mbuo oix zuqc yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh weic Aalon yaac weic zuangx baeqc fingx zoux ndopv-liuh nyei gong.
Ninh mbuo oix zuqc goux Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei yietc zungv jaa-sic yaac weic I^saa^laa^en Mienh zoux ndopv-liuh nyei gong.
Oix zuqc zorqv Lewi Mienh jiu bun Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn mbuo. Yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh mbu'ndongx se dongh naaiv deix oix zuqc jiu nzengc bun Aalon.
Oix zuqc orn Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn mbuo zoux sai mienh nyei gong. Cuotv liuz naaiv deix, maaih haaix dauh mingh fatv singx dinc, wuov dauh oix zuqc daix daic.”
Ziouv yaac gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Yiem I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh gu'nyuoz yie ginv cuotv Lewi Mienh weic div I^saa^laa^en nyei yietc zungv m'sieqv dorn yungz nyei daauh dauh dorn. Lewi Mienh benx yie nyei,

weic zuqc dauh dauh dorn-la'gauv benx yie nyei. Yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung yie daix mouz dauh dorn-la'gauv wuov zanc, yie ginv cuotv liemh mienh liemh saeng-kuv nyei daauh dauh dorn benx nzengc yie nyei. Ninh mbuo oix zuqc benx yie nyei. Yie se Ziouv. ”
Yiem Sinaai Deic-Bung-Huaang, Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc saauv Lewi Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc, ziux ninh mbuo nyei mienh buonc. Da'faanh buangv hlaax faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn, oix zuqc saauv nzengc.”
Mose ziouc ei jienv Ziouv nyei waac saauv ninh mbuo, hnangv Ziouv paaiv ninh zoux nor.
Naaiv se Lewi nyei dorn nyei mbuox. Maaih Geson, Ko^haatv caux Me^laa^li.
Geson nyei dorn ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc maaih Lipv^ni caux Si^me^i Mienh.
Ko^haatv nyei dorn ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc maaih Amlaam, Itc^haa, He^mbo^lon caux Utc^si^en Mienh.
Me^laa^li nyei dorn ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc benx Maali caux Musi Mienh. Naaiv se Lewi Fingx ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc.
Geson nyei bungh buonc se Lipv^ni caux Si^me^i Mienh. Naaiv se Geson Mienh nyei bungh buonc.
Yiem yietc hlaax faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn yietc zungv maaih siec cin hmz baeqv dauh.
Geson Mienh nyei bungh buonc oix zuqc corng ganh nyei ndopv-liuh yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh nqa'haav maengx, fai bung wuov.
Laa^en nyei dorn, E^li^yaa^saapc, zoux Geson Mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.

Yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh, Geson Mienh oix zuqc goux gomv ndopv-liuh gu'nyuoz wuov yiemc caux ga'nyiec wuov yiemc, aengx goux gomv gu'nguaaic nyei ndopv, bieqc Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei mbaeqc gaengh ndie,
weih gormx ndopv-liuh caux ziec-dorngh mbaeqc laatc caux mbaeqc laatc gaengh nyei ndie. Liemh hlaang aengx caux naaiv buoqv ga'naaiv yietc zungv se ninh mbuo oix zuqc liuc leiz.
Ko^haatv nyei bungh buonc maaih Amlaam, Itc^haa, He^mbo^lon caux Utc^si^en Mienh. Naaiv se Ko^haatv Mienh nyei bungh buonc.
Yiem yietc hlaax faaux maengx nyei yietc zungv m'jangc dorn maaih hietc cin luoqc baeqv dauh. Ko^haatv Mienh nyei gong se oix zuqc goux singx dinc.
Ko^haatv Mienh nyei bungh buonc oix zuqc corng ganh nyei ndopv-liuh yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei naamh bung maengx.
Utc^si^en nyei dorn, E^li^saa^faan, zoux Ko^haatv Mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.

Ninh mbuo oix zuqc goux Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang, dieh, dang-jaax, ziec-dorngh caux buov hung dieh, aengx caux yietc zungv yiem singx dinc longc nyei jaa-sic, liemh mbaeqc gaengh ndie. Da'faanh naaiv buoqv ga'naaiv qiemx longc nyei yietc zungv se yiem ninh mbuo liuc leiz nzengc.
Maaih Aalon sai mienh nyei dorn, E^le^aa^saa, zoux Lewi Mienh gauh hlo jiex nyei bieiv zeiv yaac gunv goux singx dinc wuov deix mienh.
Me^laa^li nyei bungh buonc maaih Maali caux Musi Mienh. Naaiv se Me^laa^li Mienh nyei bungh buonc.
Yiem yietc hlaax faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn yietc zungv maaih juqv cin nyic baeqv dauh.
Aa^mbi^haa^in nyei dorn, Sux^li^en, zoux Me^laa^li Mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv. Ninh mbuo oix zuqc corng ganh nyei ndopv-liuh yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei baqv bung maengx.

Paaiv bun Me^laa^li Mienh zoux nyei gong se oix zuqc goux ndopv-liuh nyei qorng, gungh gangc ndiangx, dongc, taapv, caux yietc zungv zoux qorng nyei ga'naaiv. Da'faanh naaiv buoqv ga'naaiv qiemx longc nyei nyungc-nyungc se yiem ninh mbuo liuc leiz.
Liemh laatc dongc, dongc nyei taapv, mborng ndau corng laatc ndie nyei dongc caux hlaang yaac oix zuqc goux.

Mose caux Aalon caux Aalon nyei dorn mbuo oix zuqc corng ganh nyei ndopv-liuh yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh nyei dong bung maengx, mba'hnoi cuotv wuov bung, se yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh nza'hmien. Ninh mbuo oix zuqc weic I^saa^laa^en Mienh goux singx dinc. Cuotv liuz naaiv deix, haaix dauh mingh fatv singx dinc, oix zuqc daix daic.
Mose caux Aalon ei Ziouv paaiv nyei waac saauv Lewi Mienh. Ziux bungh buonc dauh dauh buangv hlaax faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn yietc zungv maaih i waanc i cin dauh.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose, “Oix zuqc saauv nzengc I^saa^laa^en Mienh yungz daaih buangv hlaax faaux maengx nyei daauh dauh dorn. Oix zuqc fiev jienv mouz dauh nyei mbuox.

Meih mbuo oix zuqc ginv Lewi Mienh bun yie weic div I^saa^laa^en Mienh yungz nyei yietc zungv daauh dauh dorn. Lewi Mienh nyei saeng-kuv yaac oix zuqc longc div I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei yietc zungv saeng-kuv njiec nyei daauh toi dorn. Yie se Ziouv. ”
Mose ziouc ziux Ziouv paaiv nyei waac saauv nzengc I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh yungz nyei daauh dauh dorn.
Ziux faaux mbuox nyei soux mouc, maaih i waanc i cin nyic baeqv cietv ziepc faam dauh yietc hlaax faaux maengx nyei daauh dauh dorn.
Ziouv aengx gorngv mbuox Mose,

“Oix zuqc zorqv Lewi Mienh fungx bun yie div I^saa^laa^en Mienh yungz nyei yietc zungv dorn-la'gauv, yaac longc Lewi Mienh nyei saeng-kuv div I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei saeng-kuv. Lewi Mienh oix zuqc benx yie nyei. Yie se Ziouv.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei dorn-la'gauv gauh camv Lewi Mienh nyei nyic baeqv cietv ziepc faam dauh. Zengc njiec naaiv deix, oix zuqc zuoqc.
Yietc dauh oix zuqc cuotv yietc lungz faam-zinh nyaanh ziux singx dinc dingc daaih nyei hniev-daauh.
Zuoqc zengc njiec naaiv deix mienh nyei nyaanh oix zuqc jiu bun Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn mbuo.”
Mose ziouc siou dongh Lewi Mienh div liuz zengc njiec wuov deix I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei zuoqc mienh nyaanh.
Yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei dorn-la'gauv ninh duqv nduoh joih nyic ziepc hmz lungz nyaanh ziux singx dinc dingc daaih nyei hniev-daauh.
Mose ziouc ziux Ziouv paaiv nyei waac zorqv naaiv deix zuoqc mienh nyei nyaanh fungx bun Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn mbuo.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose caux Aalon,
“Oix zuqc saauv nzengc Lewi Mienh bun njiec nyei Ko^haatv Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc caux ninh mbuo nyei mienh buonc,
yiem faah ziepc hnyangx taux hmz ziepc hnyangx nyei m'jangc dorn, dongh haih yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh fu-sux zoux gong wuov deix.
“Naaiv se Ko^haatv Mienh oix zuqc yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh zoux nyei gong. Ninh mbuo oix zuqc goux gauh cing-nzengc jiex nyei ga'naaiv.
Oix suiv dorngx nyei ziangh hoc, Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn oix zuqc bieqc mingh caeqv mbaeqc gaengh ndie njiec, longc gomv Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang.
Yaac oix zuqc zorqv fuoqv daaih longx nyei saeng-kuv ndopv gomv gu'nguaaic, aengx longc kuaaiv ndie, setv zeiv mbuov nzengc, gomv gu'nguaaic jiex. Aengx zorqv gaeng faang nyei ndiangx cunx jienv.

“Oix zuqc zorqv kuaaiv ndie-mbuov dimc gengx Tin-Hungh nyei njuov wuov norm dieh. Aengx zorqv bienh, ba'gen, nzormc caux ciev ziec a'ngunc diuv nyei nguaah baengh an jienv. Dieh gu'nguaaic yaac oix zuqc maaih zanc-zanc gengx nyei njuov.
Oix zuqc longc kuaaiv ndie-siqv gomv nzengc naaiv deix yietc zungv. Aengx longc kuaaiv fuoqv daaih longx nyei saeng-kuv ndopv gomv gu'nguaaic jiex yaac zorqv gaeng dieh nyei ndiangx cunx jienv.

“Ninh mbuo oix zuqc zorqv kuaaiv ndie-mbuov gomv jienv ziux njang nyei dang-jaax, dang nyei zaanv, japv dang-cov nyei njiuv, an njiuv nyei bienh, aengx caux yietc zungv dapv youh weic dinh dang nyei baengh.
Zorqv dang-jaax caux dang nyei yietc zungv jaa-sic, longc fuoqv daaih longx nyei saeng-kuv ndopv beu jienv, an gaeng ga'naaiv nyei jaax gu'nguaaic.
“Ninh mbuo oix zuqc longc kuaaiv ndie-mbuov gomv jienv buov hung nyei jiem-dieh, aengx longc fuoqv daaih longx nyei saeng-kuv ndopv gomv jienv, zorqv gaeng dieh nyei ndiangx cunx jienv.
“Ninh mbuo oix zuqc zorqv yiem singx dinc longc nyei yietc zungv jaa-sic longc ndie-mbuov beu jienv. Aengx longc fuoqv daaih longx nyei saeng-kuv ndopv gomv jienv an gaeng ga'naaiv nyei jaax.
“Ninh mbuo oix zuqc guaaih cuotv dongh siqv ziec-dorngh nyei saaiv, aengx longc kuaaiv ndie-luoqc gomv jienv ziec-dorngh.

Zorqv weic ziec-dorngh longc nyei jaa-sic, liemh siou douz nyei jei, nyaapv, ga'naaiv-cenv, caux bunh, an ziec-dorngh gu'nguaaic. Aengx longc fuoqv daaih longx nyei saeng-kuv ndopv gomv jienv, zorqv gaeng ziec-dorngh nyei ndiangx cunx jienv.

“Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn mbuo zorqv singx dinc caux singx dinc nyei yietc zungv jaa-sic gomv liuz, taux suiv ndopv-liuh ciangv nyei ziangh hoc, Ko^haatv Mienh oix zuqc daaih gaeng. Mv baac ninh mbuo cin-maanc maiv dungx muoqv naaiv deix cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv. Muoqv nor, oix zuqc daic aqv. Se dongh Ko^haatv Mienh oix zuqc gaeng naaiv deix Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei ga'naaiv.

“Aalon sai mienh nyei dorn, E^le^aa^saa, oix zuqc goux buov dang nyei youh caux hung, ziec nyei laangh ziqc, caux orn mienh nyei cing-nzengc youh. Ninh oix zuqc goux Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh caux yiem ndopv-liuh gu'nyuoz nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv, se goux nzengc singx dinc caux singx dinc nyei yietc zungv jaa-sic.”
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose caux Aalon,
“Maiv dungx bun Ko^haatv nyei bungh buonc mienh yiem Lewi Mienh gu'nyuoz zuqc pai guangc.

Weic bun naaiv deix mienh haih mingh nitv fatv naaiv deix cing-nzengc jiex nyei ga'naaiv yaac maiv zuqc daic, maaih maengc ziangh jienv nyei, oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor tengx ninh mbuo. Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn mbuo oix zuqc bieqc singx dinc paaiv ziangx haaix dauh oix zuqc zoux haaix nyungc gong, haaix dauh oix zuqc gaeng haaix nyungc.
Mv baac Ko^haatv Mienh cin-maanc maiv dungx bieqc mingh mangc naaiv deix cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv, yietc dangh yaac maiv dungx mangc. Maiv zei aeqv, oix zuqc daic aqv.”
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc saauv nzengc Geson Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc caux ninh mbuo nyei mienh buonc.
Saauv nzengc faah ziepc hnyangx taux hmz ziepc hnyangx nyei m'jangc dorn, dongh haih yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh fu-sux zoux gong nyei yietc zungv.
“Naaiv se Geson Mienh nyei bungh buonc oix zuqc zoux gong fu-sux yaac oix zuqc bienh ga'naaiv.

Ninh mbuo oix bienh corng zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh nyei ndie, se corng Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei ndie, dongh gomv nyei ga'naaiv caux gomv gu'nguaaic fuoqv daaih longx nyei saeng-kuv ndopv, caux bieqc Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei mbaeqc gaengh ndie,
weih ndopv-liuh caux ziec-dorngh mbaeqc laatc caux mbaeqc laatc gaengh nyei ndie, hlaang, caux yietc zungv qiemx longc nyei jaa-sic. Ndortv zuqc Geson Mienh oix zuqc liuc leiz naaiv buoqv ga'naaiv.

Ninh mbuo fu-sux zoux nyei yietc zungv gong, maiv gunv gaeng ndopv-liuh nyei ga'naaiv fai zoux haaix nyungc gong, se yiem Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn mbuo nyei buoz-ndiev. Meih ganh oix zuqc paaiv ziangx ninh mbuo oix zuqc bienh nyei nyungc-nyungc.
Naaiv se Geson Mienh nyei bungh buonc yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh zoux nyei gong. Ninh mbuo zoux nyei nyungc-nyungc se yiem Aalon sai mienh nyei dorn, I^taa^maa, nyei buoz-ndiev.
“Oix zuqc saauv Me^laa^li Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc caux ninh mbuo nyei mienh buonc.
Saauv nzengc yiem faah ziepc hnyangx taux hmz ziepc hnyangx nyei m'jangc dorn, dongh haih bieqc daaih fu-sux, yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh zoux gong nyei dauh dauh.
Ninh mbuo yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh oix zuqc fu-sux nyei maaih hnangv naaiv. Oix zuqc bienh zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei Ndopv-Liuh nyei qorng, gungh gangc ndiangx, dongc, caux topv dongc nyei taapv,

aengx caux weih gormx Ndopv-Liuh nyei laatc dongc caux topv dongc nyei taapv, mborng ndau corng laatc ndie nyei dongc, hlaang, yietc zungv zoux qorng nyei ga'naaiv aengx caux naaiv buoqv qiemx longc nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv caux nyungc-nyungc jaa-sic. Oix zuqc ziux mbuox paaiv ziangx haaix dauh oix zuqc bienh nyei haaix nyungc.
Naaiv se Me^laa^li Mienh nyei bungh buonc oix zuqc yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh zoux nyei gong, yaac yiem Aalon sai mienh nyei dorn, I^taa^maa, nyei buoz-ndiev.”
Mose, Aalon caux zuangx mienh nyei bieiv zeiv saauv nzengc Ko^haatv Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc caux ninh mbuo nyei mienh buonc.
Yiem faah ziepc hnyangx taux hmz ziepc hnyangx, haih yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh fu-sux, zoux gong nyei yietc zungv m'jangc dorn
ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc maaih i cin cietv baeqv hmz ziepc dauh.
Naaiv se Ko^haatv Mienh nyei bungh buonc, se yietc zungv yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh fu-sux nyei mienh. Mose caux Aalon saauv nzengc ninh mbuo ziux Ziouv longc Mose paaiv nyei waac.
Ninh mbuo yaac saauv nzengc Geson Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc caux mienh buonc.
Yiem faah ziepc hnyangx taux hmz ziepc hnyangx, haih yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh fu-sux, zoux gong nyei yietc zungv m'jangc dorn,
ziux bungh buonc caux mienh buonc maaih i cin luoqc baeqv faah ziepc dauh.
Naaiv se Geson Mienh nyei bungh buonc, se yietc zungv yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh fu-sux nyei mienh. Mose caux Aalon saauv nzengc ninh mbuo ziux Ziouv paaiv nyei waac.
Ninh mbuo yaac saauv nzengc Me^laa^li Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc caux mienh buonc.
Yiem faah ziepc hnyangx taux hmz ziepc hnyangx, haih yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh fu-sux, zoux gong nyei yietc zungv m'jangc dorn,
ziux ninh mbuo nyei mienh buonc maaih buo cin nyic baeqv dauh.
Naaiv se Me^laa^li Mienh nyei bungh buonc. Mose caux Aalon saauv nzengc ninh mbuo ziux Ziouv longc Mose paaiv nyei waac.
Mose, Aalon caux I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv ziouc ziux bungh buonc, ziux mienh buonc, saauv nzengc Lewi Mienh.
Yiem faah ziepc hnyangx taux hmz ziepc hnyangx, haih yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh zoux gong fu-sux yaac tengx bienh Ndopv-Liuh wuov deix yietc zungv m'jangc dorn,
maaih hietc cin hmz baeqv betv ziepc dauh.
Ziux Ziouv mbuox Mose, ninh mbuo paaiv ziangx gorqv-mienh nyei gong, gorqv-mienh oix zuqc bienh haaix nyungc. Hnangv naaiv nor, ziux Ziouv paaiv nyei waac, Mose saauv nzengc ninh mbuo.
Ziouv mbuox Mose,

“Oix zuqc mbuox I^saa^laa^en Mienh hatc butv gomh huv baengc nyei mienh caux sin zaangc cuotv maiv horpc zuqc cuotv nyei haaix nyungc wuom, aengx caux laaix muoqv zuqc janx-daic maaih uix nyei mienh, cuotv ga'nyiec ziqc ndopv-liuh ciangv.
Maiv gunv m'jangc m'sieqv, oix zuqc hatc cuotv ga'nyiec ziqc ndopv-liuh ciangv weic maiv bun ninh mbuo nyei ciangv, dongh yie yiem ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx nyei dorngx, maaih uix.”
I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziouc hnangv naaiv nor zoux, hatc ninh mbuo cuotv ga'nyiec ziqc ndopv-liuh ciangv. Ziouv hnangv haaix nor mbuox Mose, I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziouc hnangv wuov nor zoux.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc mbuox I^saa^laa^en Mienh, maiv gunv m'jangc m'sieqv, haaix dauh zoux haaix nyungc dorngc haaix dauh, wuov dauh maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux bun Ziouv, ninh ziouc dorngc mi'aqv.
Ninh oix zuqc nyiemc ninh zoux dorngc nyei zuiz, yaac oix zuqc zorqv ninh zoux dorngc nyei yietc zungv tuix nzuonx bun ninh dorngc wuov dauh, aengx buih biaa gouv nyei yietc gouv.

Mv baac se gorngv zuqc mienh zoux dorngc wuov dauh daic yaac maiv maaih cien-ceqv laengz wuov deix buih nyei ga'naaiv, oix zuqc bun sai mienh weih fungx bun Ziouv. Liemh weic fiqv ninh nyei zuiz wuov dauh ba'gi yungh gouv oix zuqc bun.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh dorh daaih fungx bun sai mienh nyei yietc zungv cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv ziouc benx sai mienh nyei.
Gorqv-mienh nyei cing-nzengc ga'naaiv se gorqv-mienh ganh nyei, mv baac ninh fungx haaix nyungc bun sai mienh, wuov nyungc ziouc benx sai mienh nyei.”
Ziouv aengx gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc mbuox I^saa^laa^en Mienh, ‘Se gorngv haaix dauh mienh nyei auv yangh pien zaux-mbiec, maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux bun ninh nyei nqox,
ziouc caux ganh dauh m'jangc dorn bueix beic ninh nyei nqox, maiv gunv ninh zoux maiv cing-nzengc, maiv maaih haaix dauh zoux zorng-zengx, (weic zuqc bueix nyei ziangh hoc mienh zorqv maiv duqv),

yaac se gorngv nqox nzaeng-buang, laaic ninh nyei auv maaih jauv, auv yaac za'gengh zoux maiv cing-nzengc, oix zuqc dorh ninh nyei auv mingh sai mienh wuov. Fai se gorngv nqox nzaeng-buang ninh nyei auv, laaic ninh nyei auv maaih jauv, maiv gunv ninh nyei auv maiv maaih, ninh cing-nzengc nyei,

nqox oix zuqc dorh ninh nyei auv mingh sai mienh wuov. Yaac oix zuqc weic ninh nyei auv dorh jienv i morqv mbaali mbiauh mbuonv. Yaac maiv dungx dox ga'lanv youh, maiv dungx zorqv hung an gu'nguaaic, weic zuqc naaiv deix ziec nyei ga'naaiv se weic nzaeng-buang nyei jauv, weic jangx mienh zoux dorngc nyei sic.
“+‘Sai mienh ziouc dorh naaiv dauh m'sieqv dorn daaih souv jienv Ziouv nyei nza'hmien,
ziouc zorqv deix cing-nzengc nyei wuom daaih dapv nie-baengh, aengx nyau deix zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh nyei ndau nyei nie-mbung dapv jienv.

Sai mienh ziouc bun wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn souv jienv Ziouv nyei nza'hmien yaac jaiv nqoi ninh nyei mba'biei, aengx zorqv weic nzaeng-buang nyei jauv, weic jangx mienh zoux dorngc nyei sic wuov deix ziec nyei mbuonv, bun ninh bouh jienv. Sai mienh ganh bouh jienv houv mienh nyei wuom-im,

ziouc heuc wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn laengz jiez ngaengc waac. Sai mienh gorngv mbuox ninh, “Se gorngv maiv maaih ganh dauh m'jangc dorn caux meih bueix, meih yaac maiv yangh pien zaux-mbiec, yiem jienv nqox nyei buoz-ndiev maiv zoux maiv cing-nzengc nyei sic, tov bun naaiv deix houv nyei wuom hoic maiv zuqc meih.
Mv baac se gorngv meih yiem nqox nyei buoz-ndiev aengx yangh pien zaux-mbiec ziouc zoux maiv cing-nzengc, caux ganh dauh m'jangc dorn bueix, maiv zeiz ganh nyei nqox,”

(taux naaiv norm dorngx, sai mienh bun naaiv dauh m'sieqv dorn ziux ninh laengz ngaengc waac zuqc houv. Sai mienh aengx gorngv), “tov Ziouv bun meih nyei ga'sie omx, camh zuih jaic, nyaux nzengc, ziouc yiem meih nyei mienh mbu'ndongx zoux zuqc mienh houv, zuqc mienh zioux nyei mienh.
Tov bun naaiv deix houv mienh nyei wuom-im bieqc meih nyei ga'sie, bun meih nyei ga'sie omx, camh zuih jaic, nyaux nzengc.” “+‘Wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn oix zuqc dau, “ Aamen. Aamen.”
“+‘Sai mienh ziouc fiev naaiv deix houv nyei waac yiem sou-njunc, aengx nzaaux naaiv deix nzaangc bieqc wuov deix wuom-im.
Ninh ziouc bun wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn hopv naaiv houv nyei wuom-im. Wuom ziouc bieqc ninh nyei sin hoic ninh diev kouv.
Sai mienh aengx zorqv yiem m'sieqv dorn nyei buoz weic nzaeng-buang nyei sic fongc horc nyei mbuonv, yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien bouh jienv cunv ging fongc horc liuz, ziouc dorh mingh taux ziec-dorngh.
Ninh aengx zorqv yietc nyau weic jangx mienh zoux dorngc nyei sic ziec nyei mbuonv hietv ziec-dorngh buov. Buov liuz, ziouc heuc wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn hopv naaiv deix wuom.

Se gorngv ninh zoux maiv cing-nzengc nyei sic, maiv ziepc zuoqv zoux bun ninh nyei nqox, yangh pien zaux-mbiec, ninh hopv liuz naaiv deix wuom bieqc mingh, ninh ziouc zuqc diev kouv. Ninh nyei ga'sie omx, camh zuih jaic, nyaux nzengc. Ninh yaac yiem ninh nyei mienh mbu'ndongx zuqc mienh zioux, zuqc mienh houv.
Mv baac se gorngv wuov dauh mienh cing-nzengc nyei, maiv yangh pien zaux-mbiec, ziouc bun cing ninh maiv dorngc, yaac haih maaih gu'nguaaz nyei.
“+‘Naaiv se nzaeng-buang nyei leiz-latc, dongh m'sieqv dorn yangh pien zaux-mbiec, yiem nqox nyei buoz-ndiev mingh zoux maiv cing-nzengc nyei sic.

Fai mienh laaic ninh nyei auv maaih jauv ziouc hanc ninh nyei auv. Sai mienh oix zuqc bun wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien yaac ei jienv naaiv nyungc leiz-latc nyei diuh diuh leiz zoux.
Nqox yaac maiv maaih zuiz aqv. Mv baac wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn ziux ninh zoux nyei, oix zuqc dingc zuiz.’+”
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc mbuox I^saa^laa^en Mienh, ‘Maiv gunv m'jangc m'sieqv, haaix dauh oix lengc jeiv nyei laengz jiez ngaengc waac, zorqv ganh fungx bun Ziouv weic zoux Naasi Mienh,

wuov dauh oix zuqc gec, maiv dungx hopv a'ngunc diuv fai haaix nyungc diuv. Yaac maiv dungx hopv longc a'ngunc diuv fai haaix nyungc diuv zoux daaih nyei wuom-sui. Maiv dungx hopv a'ngunc biouv nyei wuom fai nyanc a'ngunc biouv, maiv gunv biouv-nyiemz fai biouv-nqaai.
Yiem zoux jienv Naasi Mienh nyei ziangh hoc, maiv dungx nyanc yiem a'ngunc hmei cuotv daaih nyei haaix nyungc ga'naaiv. Maiv gunv a'ngunc nyim fai a'ngunc biouv nyei ndopv, maiv dungx nyanc.

“+‘Yiem laengz jienv zoux Naasi Mienh nyei ziangh hoc maiv dungx teix m'nqorngv. Oix zuqc zuov taux dingc daaih nyei hnoi-nyieqc buangv. Ninh oix zuqc cing-nzengc, zuov taux fungx ganh bun Ziouv nyei hnoi-nyieqc buangv. Oix zuqc liouh mba'biei caux siaam ndaauv.
Yiem ninh fungx ganh bun Ziouv nyei ziangh hoc maiv kuh mingh fatv janx-daic nyei sei.
Liemh ganh nyei die fai maa, gorx fai youz, dorc fai muoc daic, maiv dungx laaix ninh mbuo bun ganh maaih uix, weic zuqc zorqv ganh fungx bun Tin-Hungh nyei jangx-hoc se yiem ninh nyei m'nqorngv.
Da'faanh yiem fungx ganh bun Ziouv nyei hnoi-nyieqc, ninh benx Ziouv nyei cing-nzengc mienh.

“+‘Se gorngv yiem ninh nyei ga'hlen maaih mienh liemh zeih daic, ninh fungx bun Ziouv nyei m'nqorngv ziouc maaih uix. Taux saax uix nyei hnoi, se da'cietv hnoi wuov hnoi, oix zuqc teix nzengc m'nqorngv.
Taux da'betv hnoi wuov hnoi, ninh oix zuqc dorh i norm norqc nqo fai i norm baeqc gopv lunx taux Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei gaengh ndaangc jiu bun sai mienh.
Sai mienh ziouc zorqv norm ziec weic fiqv zuiz, aengx zorqv norm buov ziec weic wuov laanh mienh nitv zuqc janx-daic ziouc maaih nyei uix. Dongh wuov hnoi ninh yaac oix zuqc saax m'nqorngv nyei uix.

Oix zuqc weic dingc daaih nyei hnoi-nyieqc aengx zorqv ganh fungx bun Ziouv. Yaac oix zuqc dorh dauh yietc hnyangx nyei ba'gi yungh gouv daaih ziec weic ninh zoux dorngc nyei sic. Zinh ndaangc nyei hnoi-nyieqc maiv funx aqv, weic zuqc fungx ganh bun Ziouv nyei ziangh hoc zuqc maaih uix mi'aqv.
“+‘Naasi Mienh nyei leiz, dongh ninh zorqv ganh fungx bun Ziouv nyei hnoi-nyieqc buangv, se hnangv naaiv. Oix zuqc dorh ninh mingh taux Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei gaengh ndaangc.

Yiem naaic ninh oix zuqc zorqv ga'naaiv weic fongc horc bun Ziouv. Longc dauh doix hnyangx, maiv waaic fangx nyei ba'gi yungh gouv weic buov ziec, caux dauh doix hnyangx, maiv waaic fangx nyei ba'gi yungh zeic ziec weic fiqv zuiz, caux dauh maiv waaic fangx nyei ba'gi yungh gouv ziec weic jiu tong.

Yaac maaih ziec nyei laangh ziqc caux ciev ziec nyei ga'naaiv yietc njiec ziec. Aengx maaih yietc ndaan maiv an bingv nyei njuov, mbuonv-muonc zorpc jienv ga'lanv youh nyei njuov, caux maiv an bingv nyei njuov-bieqc nzaatv jienv ga'lanv youh.
“+‘Sai mienh ziouc zorqv naaiv deix ga'naaiv daaih yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien ziec fiqv zuiz caux buov ziec.

Ninh aengx zorqv wuov dauh ba'gi yungh gouv caux wuov ndaan maiv an bingv nyei njuov fongc horc ziec bun Ziouv weic jiu tong, yaac maaih ziec nyei laangh ziqc caux ciev ziec nyei ga'naaiv yietc njiec ziec.

“+‘Naasi Mienh oix zuqc yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei gaengh ndaangc teix nzengc dongh zoux jangx-hoc bun cing ninh zorqv ganh fungx bun Ziouv nyei mba'biei caux siaam. Oix zuqc zorqv wuov deix mba'biei daaih dapv ziec weic jiu tong wuov deix ga'naaiv ga'ndiev maengx nyei douz.

“+‘Naasi Mienh teix liuz fungx bun Ziouv nyei mba'biei, sai mienh ziouc zorqv norm wuonh zuoqc nyei ba'gi yungh gouv nyei buoz-zuih, aengx zorqv norm yiem ndaan gu'nyuoz maiv an bingv nyei njuov, caux norm maiv an bingv nyei njuov-bieqc, an jienv naaiv dauh Naasi Mienh nyei buoz gu'nyuoz.

Naaiv deix ga'naaiv sai mienh ziouc zorqv daaih yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien cunv ging weic zoux fongc horc nyei ga'naaiv. Naaiv deix ga'naaiv se cing-nzengc nyei, yaac benx sai mienh nyei mi'aqv, liemh cunv ging fongc horc liuz nyei lorqc hiuang orv caux fongc horc liuz nyei zuih. Yiem naaic mingh, Naasi Mienh hopv duqv a'ngunc diuv aqv.

“+‘Naaiv se Naasi Mienh nyei leiz, dongh ninh zorqv ganh fungx bun Ziouv wuov zanc laengz jiez ngaengc waac oix fongc horc haaix nyungc bun Ziouv. Se gorngv haih laengz bun gauh camv naaic, ninh oix zuqc ei ninh laengz nyei waac zoux nzengc.’+”
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc gorngv mbuox Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn, ‘Meih mbuo oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor buang waac I^saa^laa^en Mienh. Oix zuqc gorngv,
“+‘+“Tov Ziouv ceix fuqv bun meih, ziux goux meih.
Tov Ziouv zoux longx bun meih, ceix en bun meih.
Tov Ziouv huin hmien mangc meih, bun meih maaih baengh orn.”+’
“Hnangv naaic, se gorngv ninh mbuo dengv yie nyei mbuox buang waac I^saa^laa^en Mienh, yie ziouc ceix fuqv bun ninh mbuo.”

Mose liepc ziangx zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh wuov hnoi, ninh longc cing-nzengc youh guoqv jienv bun ndopv-liuh caux ndopv-liuh nyei yietc zungv jaa-sic cing-nzengc. Ninh aengx longc wuov nyungc youh guoqv jienv bun ziec-dorngh caux ziec-dorngh nyei yietc zungv jaa-sic cing-nzengc.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv, dongh liuc leiz saauv mienh wuov deix bieiv zeiv, ziouc dorh ga'naaiv daaih fongc horc.

Ninh mbuo dorh daaih fongc horc bun Ziouv nyei zingh nyeic maaih juqv jaax ngongh cie gomv jienv liuh nyei, caux ziepc nyeic dauh yangh ngongh gouv. I dauh bieiv zeiv fongc horc yietc jaax ngongh cie. Yietc dauh bieiv zeiv fongc horc yietc dauh ngongh. Naaiv deix ga'naaiv ninh mbuo dorh taux zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh daaih fongc horc.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc zipv ninh mbuo fongc horc nyei ga'naaiv longc zoux Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei gong. Oix zuqc jiu bun Lewi Mienh ziux gorqv-mienh nyei gong qiemx longc.”
Mose ziouc zorqv ngongh cie caux ngongh jiu bun Lewi Mienh.
Ninh zorqv i jaax cie caux biei dauh ngongh bun Geson Mienh ziux ninh mbuo zoux nyei gong qiemx longc nyei.
Aengx zorqv biei jaax cie caux hietc dauh ngongh bun Me^laa^li Mienh ziux ninh mbuo zoux nyei gong qiemx longc nyei. Ninh mbuo yietc zungv yiem Aalon sai mienh nyei dorn, I^taa^maa, nyei buoz-ndiev.
Mv baac cie caux ngongh Mose maiv bun Ko^haatv Mienh weic zuqc ninh mbuo zoux nyei gong se oix zuqc longc mba'dauh gaeng cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv.
Longc cing-nzengc youh nzaatv ziec-dorngh bun ziec-dorngh cing-nzengc wuov deix hnoi-nyieqc, bieiv zeiv dorh ga'naaiv daaih yiem wuov ziec-dorngh fongc horc.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose, “Wuov deix bieiv zeiv oix zuqc yietc hnoi daaih dauh weic fongc horc ninh mbuo nyei ga'naaiv houc ziec-dorngh.”
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc mbuox Aalon, ‘Zorqv wuov deix siec norm dang-zaanv an jienv dang-jaax nyei ziangh hoc, oix zuqc bun dang ziux njang dang-jaax nyei nza'hmien maengx.’+”
Aalon ziouc hnangv naaiv nor zoux. Ninh zorqv dang-zaanv an jienv dang-jaax bun ziux nza'hmien maengx, hnangv Ziouv paaiv Mose nor.
Naaiv norm dang hnangv naaiv nor zoux daaih. Ziangh norm dang longc jiem daav daaih yiem ga'ndiev dang-torqv taux gu'nguaaic nyei biangh. Ziux Ziouv mbuox Mose nyei nyungc zeiv zoux ziangx nzengc.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc bun nqoi Lewi Mienh yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh cuotv daaih yaac tengx ninh mbuo saax uix.

Oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor tengx saax uix. Oix zuqc longc saax uix nyei wuom fuqv ninh mbuo, aengx bun ninh mbuo teix nzengc ziangh sin, nzox nzengc ninh mbuo nyei lui-houx, ziouc bun ninh mbuo ganh cing-nzengc.

Oix zuqc bun ninh mbuo dorh dauh ngongh gouv dorn caux ziec nyei laangh ziqc yietc njiec ziec, se longc mbuonv-muonc zorpc jienv youh. Meih oix zuqc aengx ganh longc dauh ngongh gouv dorn ziec fiqv zuiz.
Oix zuqc dorh Lewi Mienh daaih yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei nza'hmien maengx, aengx heuc I^saa^laa^en nyei yietc zungv mienh daaih zunv.
Dorh Lewi Mienh daaih yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien wuov zanc, I^saa^laa^en Mienh oix zuqc longc buoz maan jienv ninh mbuo.
Aalon yaac oix zuqc zorqv Lewi Mienh fungx bun Ziouv weic zoux I^saa^laa^en Mienh cunv ging fongc horc nyei ga'naaiv. Hnangv naaiv zoux liuz, ninh mbuo ziouc haih zoux gong fu-sux Ziouv.
“Lewi Mienh dorh buoz maan jienv naaiv deix i dauh ngongh gouv dorn nyei m'nqorngv liuz, oix zuqc longc dauh ziec bun Ziouv weic fiqv zuiz. Aengx longc dauh buov ziec weic saax Lewi Mienh nyei uix.
Oix zuqc bun Lewi Mienh souv jienv Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn nyei nza'hmien, ziouc zorqv ninh mbuo fungx bun Ziouv, hnangv zoux cunv ging fongc horc nyei ga'naaiv nor.
Hnangv naaiv nor zoux liuz, meih bun Lewi Mienh yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh mbu'ndongx cuotv daaih ziouc benx yie nyei mi'aqv.
“Meih tengx Lewi Mienh saax uix aengx zorqv ninh mbuo cunv ging fongc horc liuz, ninh mbuo oix zuqc daaih yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh zoux ninh mbuo nyei gong aqv.

Naaiv deix mienh yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh mbu'ndongx cuotv daaih fungx bun yie, benx nzengc yie nyei mienh div dorn-la'gauv, dongh I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei yietc zungv m'sieqv dorn yungz nyei daauh dauh dorn.

I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei zuangx dorn-la'gauv, liemh yietc zungv saeng-kuv nyei daauh dauh dorn, yie ginv daaih benx yie nyei mi'aqv. Yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung yie daix yietc zungv dorn-la'gauv wuov hnoi, yie ginv cuotv benx yie nyei mi'aqv.
Yie yaac ginv Lewi Mienh div I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei zuangx dorn-la'gauv.

Yie yaac zorqv Lewi Mienh yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh mbu'ndongx cuotv daaih fungx bun Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn mbuo dorngx I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh zoux gong. Ninh mbuo yaac tengx I^saa^laa^en Mienh saax uix weic bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh mingh nitv fatv singx dinc wuov zanc maiv zuqc domh zeqc naanc hoic.”
Mose, Aalon caux I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh ziouc ziux Ziouv paaiv Mose nyei waac dorh Lewi Mienh ei jienv zoux nzengc.
Lewi Mienh ziouc saax ganh cing-nzengc, aengx nzox nzengc lui-houx. Aalon ziouc fungx bun Ziouv hnangv benx cunv ging fongc horc nyei ga'naaiv. Aalon yaac tengx ninh mbuo fiqv zuiz, saax uix.
Nqa'haav Lewi Mienh yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh zoux ninh mbuo nyei gong yiem Aalon caux ninh nyei dorn nyei buoz-ndiev. Ziux Ziouv paaiv Mose, ninh mbuo dorh Lewi Mienh ei jienv zoux nzengc.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Naaiv deix jauv gorngv Lewi Mienh. Yiem nyic ziepc hmz hnyangx faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn oix zuqc yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh zoux gong.
Hnyangx-jeiv buangv hmz ziepc hnyangx wuov deix, oix zuqc dingh ninh mbuo nyei buonc gong, maiv zoux aqv.
Ninh mbuo haih tengx ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh zoux gong mv baac maiv zeiz ninh mbuo ganh zoux nzengc. Meih oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor paaiv Lewi Mienh zoux gong.”
I^saa^laa^en Mienh cuotv I^yipv Deic-Bung liuz, da'nyeic hnyangx zih hlaax, yiem Sinaai Deic-Bung-Huaang, Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Taux dingc daaih nyei ziangh hoc, oix zuqc bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh jiex Siex Maengc Zipv.
Naaiv norm hlaax, ziepc feix wuov hnoi, mba'hnoi ndortv nyei ziangh hoc, oix zuqc ziux dingc daaih nyei hnoi-nyieqc ei jienv zipv nyei leiz-nyeic caux diuh diuh leiz-latc jiex zipv.”
Mose ziouc mbuox I^saa^laa^en Mienh jiex Siex Maengc Zipv.
Zih hlaax, ziepc feix wuov hnoi, nziemx-yaangh nyei ziangh hoc, ninh mbuo yiem Sinaai Deic-Bung-Huaang jiex zipv. Ziux Ziouv paaiv Mose, I^saa^laa^en Mienh ei jienv zoux nzengc.
Mv baac maaih deix mienh laaix muoqv zuqc janx-daic maaih uix. Doix wuov norm hnoi maiv haih jiex Siex Maengc Zipv. Dongh wuov hnoi ninh mbuo daaih taux Mose caux Aalon mbuo wuov,

gorngv mbuox Mose, “Yie mbuo laaix muoqv zuqc janx-daic maaih uix, mv baac weic haaix diuc maiv bun yie mbuo taux dingc daaih nyei ziangh hoc duqv caux wuov deix I^saa^laa^en Mienh dorh ga'naaiv fongc horc Ziouv? ”
Mose dau, “Zuov muangx gaax Ziouv oix hnangv haaix nor paaiv meih mbuo nyei sic.”
Ziouv mbuox Mose,

“Oix zuqc mbuox I^saa^laa^en Mienh, ‘Se gorngv meih mbuo haaix dauh fai meih mbuo nyei fun-faqv laaix muoqv zuqc janx-daic maaih uix, fai maaih mienh cuotv jauv mingh go nyei dorngx, ninh mbuo corc haih jiex Ziouv nyei Siex Maengc Zipv.

Taux nyeic hlaax, ziepc feix wuov hnoi, mba'hnoi ndortv nyei ziangh hoc, ninh mbuo oix zuqc jiex zipv. Oix zuqc nyanc jiex zipv nyei ba'gi yungh dorn caux maiv an bingv nyei njuov caux im nyei ga'naaiv-ndaang.
Ninh mbuo maiv dungx liouh yietc deix taux njang hnoi ndorm. Yaac maiv dungx bun yungh nyei mbungv nauv yietc diuh. Jiex Siex Maengc Zipv ninh mbuo oix zuqc gan nzengc diuh diuh leiz.

Mv baac se gorngv maaih mienh cing-nzengc nyei, maiv maaih uix, yaac maiv cuotv jauv mingh go nyei dorngx, youc maiv jiex Siex Maengc Zipv nor, wuov dauh yiem ninh nyei mienh gu'nyuoz oix zuqc pai guangc, weic zuqc dingc daaih nyei ziangh hoc ninh maiv dorh ga'naaiv fongc horc Ziouv. Ninh zoux nyei zuiz ninh ganh oix zuqc ndaam-dorng.

“+‘Se gorngv yiem meih mbuo gu'nyuoz maaih ganh fingx mienh oix jiex Ziouv nyei Siex Maengc Zipv, ninh oix zuqc ziux zipv nyei leiz-nyeic caux diuh diuh leiz-latc zoux. Maiv gunv Janx fai buonv-fingx mienh, oix zuqc maaih nduqc nyungc leiz hnangv.’+”
Liepc jiez zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh wuov hnoi, se Laengz Ngaengc Waac nyei Ndopv-Liuh, maaih dorv mbuonx daaih om jienv. Lungh maanz-hmuangx taux lungh njang buatc mbuonx hnangv douz nor.
Yaac zanc-zanc hnangv naaiv nor. Wuov dorv mbuonx om jienv, lungh muonz zanc buatc hnangv douz.
Mbuonx haaix zanc yiem Ndopv-Liuh gu'nguaaic faaux, I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziouc cuotv jauv. Mbuonx dingh njiec haaix, I^saa^laa^en Mienh aengx corng ndopv-liuh ciangv yiem wuov.

Ziux Ziouv mbuox nyei waac, I^saa^laa^en Mienh cuotv jauv. Yaac ziux Ziouv mbuox nyei waac, ninh mbuo corng ndopv-liuh ciangv. Da'faanh mbuonx corc yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei Ndopv-Liuh gu'nguaaic, ninh mbuo corc corng jienv yiem wuov nyei.
Mbuonx haaix zanc yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh gu'nguaaic lauh nyei, I^saa^laa^en Mienh muangx Ziouv mbuox nyei waac, maiv cuotv jauv aqv.
Maaih ziangh hoc mbuonx yiem wuov norm ndopv-liuh gu'nguaaic i ziex hnoi hnangv. Ziux Ziouv paaiv nyei waac, ninh mbuo corng ndopv-liuh ciangv. Yaac ziux Ziouv paaiv nyei waac, ninh mbuo cuotv jauv.

Maaih deix ziangh hoc mbuonx yiem lungh hmuangx taux lungh ndorm hnangv. Lungh ndorm mbuonx faaux nyei ziangh hoc, ninh mbuo ziouc cuotv jauv aqv. Maiv gunv lungh hnoi fai lungh muonz zanc, da'faanh mbuonx faaux, ninh mbuo cuotv jauv aqv.

Maiv gunv mbuonx yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh gu'nguaaic i hnoi, fai yietc hlaax, fai yietc hnyangx, ninh mbuo corc corng jienv ndopv-liuh ciangv yiem wuov nyei, maiv cuotv jauv. Mv baac mbuonx haaix zanc faaux, ninh mbuo ziouc cuotv jauv aqv.
Ziux Ziouv mbuox nyei waac, ninh mbuo corng ndopv-liuh ciangv. Yaac ziux Ziouv mbuox nyei waac, ninh mbuo cuotv jauv. Ninh mbuo ei nzengc Ziouv nyei waac ziux Ziouv longc Mose mbuox ninh mbuo.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,
“Oix zuqc longc nyaanh daav i norm nzatc. Biomv wuov deix i norm nzatc heuc zuangx mienh gapv zunv, yaac biomv heuc suiv ndopv-liuh ciangv.
Biomv i norm nzatc nyei ziangh hoc, zuangx mienh oix zuqc daaih caux meih gapv zunv yiem Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei gaengh ndaangc.
Se gorngv kungx biomv yietc norm nzatc hnangv, fingx-fingx I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv oix zuqc daaih zunv meih naaiv.
Haiz biomv nzatc nyei qiex mbui, beqv nyei, corng ndopv-liuh yiem dong bung maengx wuov deix oix zuqc cuotv jauv.
Haiz biomv da'nyeic nzunc, corng ndopv-liuh yiem naamh bung maengx wuov deix yaac oix zuqc cuotv jauv. Biomv nzatc nyei qiex mbui, beqv nyei, ziouc zoux jangx-hoc bun hiuv duqv oix zuqc cuotv jauv.
Weic heuc zuangx mienh daaih zunv oix zuqc biomv nzatc, mv baac maiv dungx biomv mbui nyei, beqv nyei, wuov nyungc qiex.
“Se dongh Aalon nyei dorn mbuo wuov deix sai mienh oix zuqc biomv nzatc. Naaiv se meih mbuo doic jiex doic, yietc liuz oix zuqc gan nyei leiz.

Meih mbuo yiem ganh nyei deic-bung yaac maaih win-wangv daaih hoic ziouc cuotv mingh caux ninh mbuo mborqv jaax, oix zuqc longc wuov deix nzatc biomv qiex mbui nyei, beqv nyei. Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, ziouc jangx meih mbuo, njoux meih mbuo leih ndutv meih mbuo nyei win-wangv.

Aengx taux njien-youh nyei ziangh hoc, jiex meih mbuo nyei zipv caux Siang-Hlaax nyei Zipv, dorh ga'naaiv mingh buov ziec, yaac ziec weic jiu tong wuov zanc, oix zuqc biomv naaiv deix nzatc. Naaiv se weic bun meih mbuo nyei Ziouv jangx zuqc meih mbuo. Yie zoux Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.”
Taux da'nyeic hnyangx, nyeic hlaax, nyic ziepc wuov hnoi, yiem Laengz Ngaengc Waac nyei Ndopv-Liuh gu'nguaaic wuov dorv mbuonx faaux.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziouc cuotv Sinaai Deic-Bung-Huaang, kang jiex kang mingh taux mbuonx dingh njiec Baalaan Deic-Bung-Huaang.
Ninh mbuo cuotv naaiv da'yietv nzunc jauv ziux Ziouv longc Mose mbuox nyei waac.
Yiem Yu^ndaa Mienh nyei ndopv-liuh ciangv nyei guanh guanh cuotv jauv mingh ndaangc. Ninh mbuo yaac yiem ninh mbuo nyei geh ga'ndiev. Maaih Am^mi^naa^ndapc nyei dorn, Naason, gunv ninh mbuo.
Zu^aa nyei dorn, Ne^tan^en, gunv Itc^saax^kaa Fingx wuov guanh.
Aengx maaih Helon nyei dorn, E^li^apc, gunv Se^mbu^lun Fingx wuov guanh.
Caeqv liuz zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh, Geson Mienh caux Me^laa^li Mienh, dongh bienh Ndopv-Liuh wuov deix, ziouc cuotv jauv.
Jiex daaih, yiem Lu^mben Mienh nyei ndopv-liuh ciangv nyei guanh guanh cuotv jauv, yaac yiem ninh mbuo nyei geh ga'ndiev. Maaih Se^nde^e nyei dorn, E^li^su, gunv ninh mbuo.
Sux^li^satv^ndai nyei dorn, Se^lu^mi^en, gunv Si^me^on Fingx wuov guanh.
Yaac maaih Nde^u^en nyei dorn, E^li^yaa^saapc, gunv Gaatc Fingx wuov guanh.
Jiex daaih, Ko^haatv Mienh cuotv jauv yaac gaeng jienv cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv mingh. Ninh mbuo taux dorngx, zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh zungv corng ziangx aqv.
Jiex daaih, aengx maaih yiem E^faa^im Mienh nyei ndopv-liuh ciangv nyei guanh guanh cuotv jauv, yaac yiem ninh mbuo nyei geh ga'ndiev. Maaih Am^mi^hutv nyei dorn, E^li^saa^maa, gunv ninh mbuo.
Maaih Be^ndaa^su nyei dorn, Gaa^maa^li^en, gunv Maa^natv^se Fingx wuov guanh.
Yaac maaih Gi^nde^o^ni nyei dorn, Aa^mbi^ndan, gunv Mben^yaa^min Fingx wuov guanh.

Nqa'haav laai, weic tengx guanh guanh mbungh jienv nqa'haav maengx, maaih yiem Ndaan Mienh nyei ndopv-liuh ciangv nyei guanh guanh cuotv jauv, yaac yiem ninh mbuo nyei geh ga'ndiev. Maaih Am^mi^qatv^ndai nyei dorn, Aa^hi^ye^se, gunv.
Maaih Okaan nyei dorn, Baa^gi^en, gunv Aa^se Fingx wuov guanh.
Yaac maaih Enan nyei dorn, Aa^hi^laa, gunv Napv^taa^li Fingx wuov guanh.
Guanh guanh I^saa^laa^en Mienh cuotv jauv nyei ziangh hoc, oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor ziux ninh mbuo nyei yietc nyeic mingh.

Mose caux ninh nyei ong-daa, Mi^ndien Mienh, Le^u^en nyei dorn, Ho^mbapc, gorngv, “Yie mbuo oix cuotv jauv mingh taux Ziouv gorngv, ‘Yie oix jiu bun meih mbuo’ wuov norm dorngx. Tov caux yie mbuo mingh oc. Yie mbuo ziouc zoux longx bun meih weic zuqc Ziouv laengz ceix longx nyei ga'naaiv bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh.”
Ho^mbapc dau, “Yie maiv mingh aqv. Yie oix nzuonx yie ganh nyei deic-bung, yie ganh nyei mienh wuov.”
Mose aengx gorngv, “Tov meih maiv dungx guangc yie mbuo oc. Meih hiuv duqv yiem naaiv deic-bung-huaang yie mbuo oix zuqc corng ndopv-liuh ciangv yiem haaix. Meih haih tengx yie mbuo zoux m'zing.
Se gorngv meih caux yie mbuo mingh nor, Ziouv ceix haaix nyungc longx nyei bun yie mbuo, yie mbuo yaac bun meih caux jienv maaih buonc.”
I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziouc cuotv Ziouv nyei mbong mingh buo hnoi nyei jauv. Wuov deix buo hnoi gu'nyuoz Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang mingh ndaangc tengx ninh mbuo lorz dorngx hitv.
Haaix zanc cuotv jauv, lungh hnoi zanc Ziouv nyei mbuonx yiem ninh mbuo gu'nguaaic.

Gaeng Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang cuotv jauv nyei ziangh hoc, Mose gorngv, “O Ziouv aah! Jiez daaih maah! Tov bun meih nyei win-wangv faatv nzaanx nzengc. Tov bun nzorng meih wuov deix mienh yiem meih nyei nza'hmien biaux nqoi.”
Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang haaix zanc dingh njiec, Mose aengx gorngv, “O Ziouv aac, tov meih nzuonx daaih, caux cin-cin waanc-waanc I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem.”

Zuangx baeqc fingx ngopv ninh mbuo zuqc diev nyei kouv naanc. Ziouv yaac haiz mi'aqv, ziouc qiex jiez haic, bungx douz njiec daaih yiem ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx zieqc jienv. Ndopv-liuh ciangv ga'hlen maaih deix dorngx zungv buov qui nzengc.
Baeqc fingx qaqv heuc Mose tengx. Mose daux gaux tov Ziouv, douz ziouc daic mi'aqv.
Wuov norm dorngx ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Taa^mbe^laa, weic zuqc yiem wuov Ziouv nyei douz zieqc jienv ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx.
Maaih deix Janx zorpc jienv I^saa^laa^en Mienh mingh yaac jiez gorn cei oix nyanc ganh nyungc ga'naaiv. Liemh I^saa^laa^en Mienh aengx nyiemv jienv gorngv, “Feix duqv yie mbuo maaih orv nyanc.
Jangx zuqc yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung wuov zanc duqv nyanc nyei mbiauz yaac maiv zuqc ndortv nyaanh. Yaac jangx zuqc guaa-wuom, guaa-domx, Janx-Kaeqv funx, cong caux funx.
Ih zanc haiz sin zaangc mau nzengc, maiv maaih qaqv aqv. Cuotv liuz naaiv maa^naa, maiv maaih ganh nyungc mangc.”
Maa^naa se hnangv yienh si nyim, setv zeiv hnangv ndiangx-zung.

Baeqc fingx cuotv mingh jiex naaiv jiex wuov siou daaih morc fai zong, aengx dapv caeng zouv fai zoux benx njuov yietc norm, yietc norm nyei. Mueix se hnangv yietc nyungc ga'naaiv zorpc jienv ga'lanv youh nor.
Lungh muonz zanc mbiungc-suiv njiec ndopv-liuh ciangv nyei ziangh hoc, maa^naa yaac njiec aqv.
Mose haiz buonc-buonc mienh, gorqv-mienh yiem gorqv-mienh nyei ndopv-liuh gaengh ndaangc nyiemv. Ziouv ziouc qiex jiez! haic aqv. Mose yaac maiv a'hneiv ninh mbuo.

Mose gorngv mbuox Ziouv, “ Ziouv weic haaix diuc bun yie, meih nyei bou, zuqc ndongc naaiv kouv? Yie zoux haaix nyungc maiv horpc meih nyei hnyouv meih cingx daaih zorqv naaiv deix mienh bun yie ndaam ndongc naaiv hniev?

Naaiv deix zuangx mienh yie ganh maaih daaih fai? Se yie ganh yungz daaih fai? Ziouv weic haaix diuc heuc yie hlorpv jienv ninh mbuo hnangv maa hlorpv jienv hopv nyorx nyei gu'nguaaz nor, dorh mingh taux meih laengz jiez ngaengc waac oix bun ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix wuov norm deic-bung?
Yie oix zuqc mingh haaix duqv orv gaux bun naaiv deix zuangx mienh nyanc? Ninh mbuo dorng jienv yie nyiemv jienv gorngv, ‘Bun orv yie mbuo nyanc maah!’
Yie ganh nduqc laanh mienh hnangv, ndaam maiv dongz naaiv deix mienh camv. Yie haiz ba'laqc hniev haic.
Se gorngv Ziouv oix hnangv naaiv nor zoux bun yie, yaac se gorngv Ziouv buangv eix yie, tov bun yie ih zanc zuqc daic, yie ziouc maiv zuqc buatc yie ganh nyei kouv-zingh.”

Ziouv mbuox Mose, “Oix zuqc heuc cietv ziepc dauh I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei mienh gox, dongh meih hiuv duqv yiem baeqc fingx mbu'ndongx zoux mienh gox yaac zoux jien wuov deix. Dorh ninh mbuo daaih taux Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh bun ninh mbuo caux meih souv jienv naaic.

Yie ziouc njiec daaih caux meih yiem naaic gorngv waac. Yie oix zorqv deix yiem meih wuov dauh Singx Lingh bun yiem ninh mbuo. Ninh mbuo ziouc tengx meih ndaam naaiv deix mienh weic bun meih ganh nduqc dauh hnangv maiv zuqc ndaam hniev.

“Oix zuqc mbuox baeqc fingx, ‘Meih mbuo oix zuqc saax nzengc uix, liuc leiz ziangx weic njang hnoi, meih mbuo ziouc duqv orv nyanc aqv. Weic zuqc meih mbuo nyiemv, Ziouv yaac haiz mi'aqv. Meih mbuo gorngv, “Feix duqv yie mbuo maaih orv nyanc. Yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung yie mbuo zungv duqv gauh longx.” Weic naaiv Ziouv oix bun orv meih mbuo nyanc, meih mbuo ziouc duqv nyanc aqv.
Maiv daan nyanc yietc hnoi hnangv, fai i hnoi, fai biaa hnoi, fai ziepc hnoi, fai nyic ziepc hnoi.

Nyanc taux buangv yietc hlaax nyieqc, taux orv zungv yangh meih mbuo nyei mba'zorng-kuotv baetv cuotv, meih mbuo yaac youx nzengc aqv. Weic zuqc meih mbuo nqemh Ziouv, dongh yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx wuov dauh, yaac dorng jienv Ziouv nyiemv jienv gorngv, “Yie mbuo weic haaix diuc cuotv I^yipv Deic-Bung?”+’+”
Mose gorngv, “Caux yie yangh jauv nyei m'jangc dorn maaih juqv sinx dauh. Ziouv yaac gorngv yie oix bun orv ninh mbuo nyanc gaux yietc hlaax nyieqc.
Zorqv yungh guanh, ngongh guanh, daix bun ninh mbuo maaih gaux nyei fai? Zorqv nzengc yietc zungv koiv nyei mbiauz maaih gaux ninh mbuo nyanc fai?”
Ziouv dau Mose, “ Ziouv nyei buoz nangv haic fai? Ih zanc meih oix duqv buatc yie caux meih gorngv nyei waac weic meih cuotv daaih zien fai maiv zien.”
Mose ziouc cuotv mingh ziang Ziouv nyei waac mbuox baeqc fingx. Ninh dorh cietv ziepc dauh ninh mbuo nyei mienh gox daaih gapv zunv bun ninh mbuo souv jienv huing gormx Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh.

Ziouv ziouc yiem wuov dorv mbuonx njiec daaih caux Mose gorngv waac yaac zorqv deix yiem Mose wuov dauh Singx Lingh, bun Singx Lingh yiem wuov deix cietv ziepc dauh mienh gox. Singx Lingh daaih zepv ninh mbuo nyei sin nyei ziangh hoc, ninh mbuo douc Ziouv nyei waac. Nqa'haav maiv douc aqv.

Mv baac maaih i dauh mienh, mbuox heuc En^ndaatc caux Me^ndaatc, corc yiem wuov ndopv-liuh ciangv. Ninh mbuo m'daaih caux wuov deix mienh gox faaux mbuox, mv baac maiv cuotv mingh yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh. Singx Lingh corc daaih zepv jienv ninh mbuo, ninh mbuo yaac yiem wuov ciangv gu'nyuoz douc Ziouv nyei waac.
Maaih dauh mienh lunx mienh tiux jienv mingh mbuox Mose, “En^ndaatc caux Me^ndaatc yiem wuov ciangv douc Ziouv nyei waac aex!”
Nun nyei dorn, Yo^su^waa, yiem ninh lunx nyei ziangh hoc zoux Mose nyei borng-buoz mienh. Yo^su^waa gorngv, “Yie nyei ziouv, Mose aah! Dangv jienv ninh mbuo maah!”
Mv baac Mose dau, “Meih weic yie mueic jieqv fai? Feix duqv Ziouv nyei mienh yietc zungv haih zoux douc waac mienh. Yaac feix duqv Ziouv bun ninh nyei Singx Lingh yiem ninh mbuo yietc zungv.”
Mose caux I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei mienh gox ziouc nzuonx ndopv-liuh ciangv mi'aqv.

Ziouv bun nziaaux buonc norqc mbunh yiem koiv wuov bung daaih njiec huing gormx ndopv-liuh ciangv, zungv taux bung-bung cuotv mingh yietc hnoi nyei jauv. Norqc ndaix jienv ndau-beih gu'nguaaic i ndorqc hlang.

Wuov hnoi mienh cuotv mingh ziangh hnoi ziangh muonz zorqv norqc mbunh, aengx zorqv taux da'nyeic hnoi hmuangx. Zoix zoqc yietc dauh mienh duqv yietc baeqv tongv. Siou daaih ninh mbuo yaac pui buangv ndopv-liuh ciangv.
Norqc orv corc yiem ninh mbuo nyei nyaah mbu'ndongx, maiv gaengh duqv nziuc, Ziouv za'gengh! qiex jiez haic zuangx mienh, ziouc bun butv domh wuon-baengc daix ninh mbuo.
Wuov norm dorngx ziouc cuotv mbuox heuc Kipc^lotv Hatc^daa^aa^waa, weic zuqc wuov norm dorngx ninh mbuo biopv cei ganh nyungc ga'naaiv wuov deix yietc zungv mienh.
Baeqc fingx yiem Kipc^lotv Hatc^daa^aa^waa cuotv jauv mingh taux Haa^se^lotv ziouc yiem naaic aqv.
Mose longc Kutv Mienh sieqv zoux auv. Laaix ninh longc naaiv dauh Kutv Mienh zoux auv, Miliem caux Aalon daanh Mose.
Ninh mbuo i dauh gorngv, “ Ziouv kungx longc Mose douc ninh nyei waac hnangv fai? Ninh maiv zeiz longc yie mbuo douc?” Ziouv yaac haiz mi'aqv.
Mose nyiemc ganh zoux faix. Beiv lungh ndiev zuangx mienh, maiv maaih haaix dauh ndongc ninh nyiemc ganh zoux faix.
Ziouv liemh zeih gorngv mbuox Mose caux Aalon caux Miliem, “Meih mbuo buo dauh cuotv mingh taux Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh wuov.” Ninh mbuo buo dauh ziouc mingh aqv.
Ziouv ziouc yiem mbuonx-ndiouh njiec daaih souv jienv Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei gaengh ndaangc heuc Aalon caux Miliem. Ninh mbuo i dauh ziouc cuotv daaih.

Ziouv gorngv, “Muangx yie nyei waac maah! Se gorngv yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx maaih dauh douc waac mienh, yie, Ziouv, yiem hinc yaangh nyei sic hinc cuotv bun ninh buatc yie. Yie longc mbeix caux ninh gorngv waac.
Mv baac yie nyei bou, Mose, maiv zeiz hnangv naaiv nor. Yiem yie nyei zuangx baeqc fingx ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei.

Yie caux ninh hmien doix hmien gorngv waac, yaac gorngv mengh nyei, maiv gorngv waac-meiv. Liemh yie nyei mou zeiv ninh yaac duqv buatc. Wuov nyungc meih mbuo weic haaix diuc maiv gamh nziex daanh yie nyei bou, Mose?”
Ziouv qiex jiez! haic ninh mbuo, ziang naaic leih nqoi ninh mbuo mi'aqv.
Mbuonx yiem Ndopv-Liuh faaux wuov zanc, buatc Miliem souv jienv wuov butv gomh huv baengc. Ndopv mbopv baeqc nyei, hnangv sorng nor. Aalon huin mangc Miliem, buatc ninh butv gomh huv baengc,
ziouc gorngv mbuox Mose, “Yie nyei ziouv, Mose aah! Tov maiv dungx dingc yie mbuo zoux hngongx nyei sic, baamz nyei zuiz.
Maiv dungx bun Miliem hnangv gu'nguaaz yiem ga'sie daic mingh, yungz cuotv daaih orv yuqc yietc buonc wuov nor.”
Mose ziouc qaqv tov Ziouv, “O Tin-Hungh aac, tov zorc ninh oc.”

Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose, “Se gorngv ninh nyei die tuiv wuom-nzuih naetv ninh nyei hmien, ninh zungv oix zuqc diev nyaiv siec hnoi maiv zeiz? Bun ninh zuqc yiem ga'nyiec ziqc ndopv-liuh ciangv buangv siec hnoi. Nqa'haav aengx dorh ninh bieqc daaih duqv nyei.”
Miliem ziouc zuqc yiem ga'nyiec ziqc ndopv-liuh ciangv buangv siec hnoi. Zuangx mienh yaac maiv suiv mingh haaix, zuov taux dorh ninh aengx bieqc daaih.
Nqa'haav zuangx mienh cuotv Haa^se^lotv mingh yiem Baalaan Deic-Bung-Huaang liepc ciangv.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox Mose,

“Paaiv deix mienh mingh zaah Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, dongh yie oix ceix bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei deic-bung. Ziux ong-taaix liepc daaih nyei fingx, oix zuqc yietc fingx paaiv dauh wuov fingx nyei bieiv zeiv.”
Mose ziux Ziouv nyei waac paaiv ninh mbuo cuotv Baalaan Deic-Bung-Huaang. Ninh mbuo yietc zungv zoux I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv.
Naaiv se ninh mbuo nyei mbuox. Lu^mben Fingx Sakc^ge nyei dorn, Sam^mu^waa
Si^me^on Fingx Holi nyei dorn, Saafatv
Yu^ndaa Fingx Ye^fun^ne nyei dorn, Kaalepv
Itc^saax^kaa Fingx Yosepv nyei dorn, I^gaan
E^faa^im Fingx Nun nyei dorn, Ho^se^yaa
Mben^yaa^min Fingx Laafu nyei dorn, Banti
Se^mbu^lun Fingx So^ndi nyei dorn, Gatc^ndien
Maa^natv^se Fingx Susi nyei dorn, Gatc^ndi
Ndaan Fingx Ge^man^li nyei dorn, Am^mi^en
Aa^se Fingx Mi^kaa^en nyei dorn, Setu
Napv^taa^li Fingx Wopv^si nyei dorn, Naa^mbi
Gaatc Fingx Maaki nyei dorn, Ge^u^en
Naaiv se Mose paaiv mingh zaah deic-bung wuov deix mienh nyei mbuox. (Mose tiuv Nun nyei dorn, Ho^se^yaa, nyei mbuox benx Yo^su^waa.)
Mose ziouc paaiv ninh mbuo mingh zaah Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung, mbuox ninh mbuo, “Oix zuqc yangh baqv bung mingh bieqc Negepc, gan mbong-aiv nyei dorngx mingh.
Zaah mangc gaax, wuov norm deic-bung hnangv haaix nor. Mangc gaax, yiem naaic nyei mienh henv fai maiv henv, camv fai zoqc.
Mangc gaax, ninh mbuo yiem nyei dorngx yaauc fai maiv yaauc. Ninh mbuo yiem nyei zingh hnangv haaix nor? Maaih zingh laatc fai maiv maaih?

Mangc gaax, wuov deix ndau hnangv haaix nor? Jaic fai junc? Maaih ndiangx fai maiv maaih? Yaac oix zuqc zoux daamv hlo nyei, dorh deix wuov norm deic-bung nyei biouv nzuonx.” (Wuov zanc doix zuqc daauh torngx a'ngunc biouv zuoqc.)
Wuov deix mienh ziouc yangh baqv bung maengx, yiem Sin Deic-Bung-Huaang naamh bung, zaah toux taux Le^hopc, nitv bieqc Haamatv Zingh wuov diuh jauv.

Ninh mbuo yangh Negepc, mingh taux He^mbo^lon, dongh Aanaakv nyei zeiv-fun, Aa^hi^maan, Sesai caux Tanmai yiem nyei dorngx. (He^mbo^lon Zingh liepc ndaangc yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei So^an Zingh siec hnyangx.)

Taux Etc^ko Horngz, ninh mbuo hngaqv diuh a'ngunc hmei nyei nquaah, maaih yietc joih biouv. I dauh mienh longc ndiangx cunx jienv ndaam. Ninh mbuo aengx gaeqv deix ziqc liouh biouv caux ngongh nyorx biouv dorh nzuonx.
Wuov norm dorngx ninh mbuo cuotv mbuox heuc Etc^ko, weic zuqc I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem naaic hngaqv wuov joih a'ngunc biouv.
Jiex liuz feix ziepc hnoi, zaah deic-bung nyei mienh ziouc nzuonx daaih.

Nzuonx taux Mose caux Aalon caux I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh yiem Baalaan Deic-Bung-Huaang, Kaa^ndetc wuov, ninh mbuo gorngv nzengc ninh mbuo zaah deic-bung nyei jauv-louc bun zuangx mienh muangx, yaac bun ninh mbuo mangc ninh mbuo gaeqv daaih nyei biouv.
