“Maiv dungx muangx He^se^ki^yaa nyei waac. Atc^si^lie nyei hungh gorngv, ‘Cuotv daaih lorz yie maah! Caux yie gorngv horpc. Gorqv-mienh ziouc duqv nyanc gorqv-mienh nyei a'ngunc hmei nyei biouv. Gorqv-mienh duqv nyanc gorqv-mienh nyei ngongh nyorx ndiangx nyei biouv yaac hopv ganh nyei siou wuom-kuotv nyei wuom.

Zuov yie dorh meih mbuo mingh taux norm deic-bung hnangv meih mbuo ganh nyei deic-bung nor. Se maaih laangh ziqc, maaih siang-a'ngunc diuv nyei deic-bung, maaih njuov, maaih a'ngunc huingx nyei deic-bung, maaih ga'lanv ndiangx caux mueiz-dorngh nyei deic-bung, weic bun meih mbuo maaih maengc ziangh, maiv zeiz zuqc daic.’ “He^se^ki^yaa gorngv, ‘ Ziouv zungv oix njoux yie mbuo,’ wuov deix waac meih mbuo maiv dungx muangx weic zuqc ninh kungx nduov meih mbuo hnangv.
Maaih haaix norm guoqv nyei haaix dauh zienh njoux jiex ganh nyei guoqv biaux ndutv Atc^si^lie hungh nyei buoz-ndiev?
Haamatv caux Aanbatc Mungv nyei zienh yiem haaix? Se^faan^waa^im, Henaa caux Ipc^waa Mungv nyei zienh yiem haaix? Ninh mbuo njoux Saa^maa^lie leih ndutv yie nyei buoz-ndiev fai?

Se gorngv naaiv deix guoqv nyei yietc zungv zienh maiv maaih haaix dauh njoux duqv ninh nyei guoqv biaux ndutv yie nyei buoz-ndiev, wuov nyungc Ziouv fungc haih njoux Ye^lu^saa^lem cuotv yie nyei buoz-ndiev?”
Mv baac baeqc fingx sekv nzieqc nyei, maiv dau yietc joux, weic zuqc hungh diex hatc ninh mbuo, “Maiv dungx dau ninh.”

Goux hungh dinc wuov dauh jien, Hin^ki^yaa nyei dorn, E^li^yaa^kim, caux Sepv^naa sou-biuv caux Aasaapc nyei dorn, fiev sou-daan nyei jien wuov dauh Yo^aa, ziouc betv ganh nyei lui-houx aengx mingh taux He^se^ki^yaa wuov, yaac dorh wuov dauh domh baeng-bieiv nyei waac mingh gorngv mbuox ninh.
He^se^ki^yaa Hungh haiz liuz wuov dauh domh baeng-bieiv gorngv nyei waac, ninh betv ninh nyei lui aengx zuqv jienv la'maah ndie-cou bieqc zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv.

Ninh paaiv goux hungh dinc wuov dauh E^li^yaa^kim caux Sepv^naa sou-biuv caux zoux gauh hlo wuov deix sai mienh, yietc zungv zuqv jienv la'maah ndie-cou, mingh lorz Aamortv nyei dorn, douc waac mienh, I^saa^yaa.
Ninh mbuo gorngv mbuox I^saa^yaa, “Ih hnoi se ndortv naanc, zuqc daanh zuqc nyaiv nyei hnoi. Se hnangv m'sieqv dorn oix yungz gu'nguaaz yaac maiv maaih qaqv yungz.

Nziex Ziouv, meih nyei Tin-Hungh, muangx haiz wuov dauh domh baeng-bieiv, dongh ninh nyei ziouv, Atc^si^lie nyei hungh, paaiv daaih ki ziangh jienv nyei Tin-Hungh wuov deix waac. Ziouv, meih nyei Tin-Hungh, ziouc weic ninh haiz naaiv deix waac gorngv ninh aqv. Weic naaiv tov meih tengx naaiv deix zengc njiec nyei mienh daux gaux.”
He^se^ki^yaa nyei jien mingh taux I^saa^yaa wuov,

I^saa^yaa gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Oix zuqc mbuox meih mbuo nyei ziouv, ‘ Ziouv hnangv naaiv nor gorngv. Maiv dungx gamh nziex meih mbuo haiz liuz naaiv deix waac, dongh Atc^si^lie nyei hungh nyei bou gorngv ki yie nyei waac.
Yie oix bun ninh maaih nyungc hnyouv. Ninh duqv haiz nyungc waac-nziaaux ziouc nzuonx ninh ganh nyei deic-bung. Yiem ninh ganh nyei buonv-deic-bung, yie zungv bun ninh zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix daic.’+”
Wuov dauh domh baeng-bieiv haiz gorngv Atc^si^lie nyei hungh cuotv Laakitv Zingh, ninh ziouc tuix aengx lorz buatc hungh diex yiem Lipv^naa Zingh mborqv jaax.

Atc^si^lie nyei hungh haiz fienx gorngv, I^yipv Deic-Bung, Kutv Mienh nyei hungh, Ti^laa^haa^kaa, cuotv daaih oix caux ninh mborqv jaax. Ninh ziouc paaiv douc fienx mienh mingh He^se^ki^yaa wuov hnangv naaiv nor gorngv,

“Oix zuqc gorngv mbuox Yu^ndaa nyei hungh, He^se^ki^yaa, ‘Meih mbuo sienx kaux nyei Tin-Hungh gorngv, “Ye^lu^saa^lem maiv zuqc jiu bun Atc^si^lie hungh” ninh kungx nduov meih mbuo hnangv. Maiv dungx muangx.
Meih yaac haiz gorngv Atc^si^lie nyei zuangx hungh hnangv haaix nor zoux bun maanc guoqv, zungv mietc nzengc mi'aqv. Meih hnamv daaih meih haih duqv njoux fai?

Wuov deix norm-norm guoqv nyei dauh dauh zienh haih njoux duqv ninh mbuo fai? Se yie nyei ong-taaix mietc wuov deix guoqv nyei zienh, dongh Gosaan, Haalaan, Lesepv caux yiem Ten Atc^saax nyei E^nden Mienh nyei zienh.
Haamatv nyei hungh, Aanbatc nyei hungh, Se^faan^waa^im Zingh nyei hungh fai Henaa nyei hungh fai Ipc^waa nyei hungh yiem haaix?’+”
He^se^ki^yaa doqc liuz douc fienx mienh dorh daaih nyei fienx, ninh ziouc bieqc zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv koi fienx an jienv Ziouv nyei nza'hmien.

He^se^ki^yaa daux gaux gorngv mbuox Ziouv, “O Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh yiem wuov deix i dauh ke^lu^mbim mbu'ndongx wuov dauh aah! Kungx meih ganh zoux lungh ndiev maanc guoqv nyei Tin-Hungh. Meih zeix lungh zeix ndau.
O Ziouv aac, tov baeng m'normh muangx. O Ziouv aac, tov nungx nqoi m'zing mangc. Muangx Sen^naa^ke^lipv fungx daaih ki ziangh jienv nyei Tin-Hungh nyei waac.
“O Ziouv aac, za'gengh zien nyei. Atc^si^lie nyei hungh baaic huaang naaiv deix maanc guoqv yaac bun ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung huaang nzengc,
yaac zorqv ninh mbuo nyei zienh zoi bieqc douz mietc nzengc, weic zuqc maiv zeiz zienh, se mienh ganh nyei buoz longc ndiangx, longc la'bieiv zoux daaih.
O Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh aac, tov njoux yie mbuo biaux ndutv Atc^si^lie hungh nyei buoz-ndiev weic bun lungh ndiev maanc guoqv hiuv duqv meih, Ziouv ganh, se Tin-Hungh.”

Aamortv nyei dorn, I^saa^yaa, bun waac mingh mbuox He^se^ki^yaa, “ Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, ‘Meih daux gaux gorngv taux Atc^si^lie nyei hungh, Sen^naa^ke^lipv, wuov deix waac yie haiz mi'aqv.’
Naaiv se Ziouv nyei waac gorngv ninh. “+‘Maiv bueix jiex dorn nyei sieqv, Si^on, mangc piex meih, huotv meih. Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei Sieqv buatc meih biaux yaac huangx m'nqorngv bun meih.
Meih gorngv doqc ki haaix dauh? Meih longc meih nyei qiex gorngv haaix dauh? Meih nungx meih nyei m'zing zoux maux bun haaix dauh? Meih zoux bun I^saa^laa^en nyei Cing-Nzengc Ziouv.

Meih longc meih nyei douc fienx mienh ki Ziouv. Meih gorngv, “Yie longc yie mborqv jaax nyei maaz-cie camv faaux hlang haic nyei mbong, zungv bieqc Le^mbaa^norn ndo jiex nyei dorngx. Yie goix gauh hlang jiex nyei si^ndaa zongh ndiangx, yaac goix gauh longx jiex nyei zongh. Yie bieqc lomc taux gauh go jiex nyei dorngx, bieqc taux gauh hoz jiex nyei gemh.
Yie yiem ganh norm deic-bung wetv wuom-kuotv yaac yiem wuov hopv wuom. Yie longc yie nyei zaux-benv caaiv nqaai I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei yietc zungv ndoqv.’+”

“ Ziouv gorngv, ‘Meih mbuo maiv haiz jiex fai? Yie dingc ziangx lauh aqv. Loz-hnoi yie daav za'eix, ih zanc bun cuotv daaih aqv, se yie longc meih bun naaiv deix weih wuonv nyei zingh benx la'bieiv-ndui.

Naaiv deix zingh nyei baeqc fingx nyei qaqv nzengc mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo ziouc hnyouv waaic nzengc yaac zuqc nyaiv. Ninh mbuo se hnangv yiem ndau-huaang nyei miev, hnangv miev-yaang lunx nyei nor, se hnangv yiem biauv-ngorh cuotv daaih nyei miev, maiv gaengh hlo, zuqc nyutc douz buov nqaai.
“+‘Mv baac yie hiuv duqv meih yiem haaix, yaac hiuv duqv meih haaix zanc cuotv mingh aengx bieqc daaih, yie yaac hiuv meih qiex jiez, nouz yie, gorngv yie.

Laaix meih qiex jiez nouz yie, gorngv yie, meih bungx nyei waac-maux yaac taux yie nyei m'normh, yie ziouc longc yie nyei hlieqv-ngau, ngau jienv meih nyei mba'zorng, yaac zorqv yie nyei hanh kouv fapv meih nyei nzuih, bun meih daaux nqaang nzuonx meih daaih nyei jauv.’

“O He^se^ki^yaa aah! Naaiv se zoux norm jangx-hoc. “Ih hnyangx meih mbuo duqv nyanc ninh ganh cuotv nyei ga'naaiv, da'nyeic hnyangx duqv nyanc yiem wuov deix hlo daaih nyei ga'naaiv. Mv baac da'faam hnyangx oix zuqc zuangx yaac oix zuqc siou, oix zuqc zuangx a'ngunc huingx yaac nyanc wuov deix biouv.
Yu^ndaa nyei douh zong duqv biaux ndutv zengc njiec nyei mienh, aengx haih yiem naaic hnangv ga'naaiv-zuangx njiec nzungh, hiaangx daaih ziangh biouv.

Weic zuqc maaih deix zengc njiec nyei mienh oix yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem cuotv, maaih guanh duqv maengc cuotv nyei mienh oix yiem Si^on Mbong cuotv. Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv ndongc haaix zungv oix hnangv naaiv nor zoux.

“Weic naaiv Ziouv hnangv naaiv nor gorngv Atc^si^lie nyei hungh. ‘Ninh maiv duqv bieqc naaiv norm zingh, yaac maiv buonv yietc nzitv forng bieqc. Ninh maiv duqv nanv torngv-baaih yiem naaiv norm zingh nyei nza'hmien, yaac maiv duqv ndui nie hlang weih gormx mborqv zingh.
Ninh yangh haaix diuh jauv daaih yaac oix zuqc yangh wuov diuh jauv nzuonx. Ninh zungv maiv bieqc naaiv norm zingh.’ Naaiv se Ziouv gorngv nyei waac.
‘Weic yie ganh yaac weic yie nyei bou, Ndaawitv, yie oix beu jienv naaiv norm zingh, yaac oix njoux naaiv norm zingh.’+”

Wuov muonz Ziouv nyei fin-mienh cuotv mingh yiem Atc^si^lie Mienh nyei ciangv daix yietc sinx hietc waanc biaa cin dauh mienh daic. Da'nyeic ndorm nziouv nyei mienh jiez sin daaih buatc benx janx-daic nyei sei nzengc mi'aqv.
Atc^si^lie nyei hungh, Sen^naa^ke^lipv, ziouc tuix nqoi nzuonx biauv yiem Ni^naa^we.

Maaih hnoi ninh yiem miuc-biauv gu'nyuoz baaix ninh nyei zienh, Nitv^lokv, wuov zanc, i dauh ninh nyei dorn, Atc^lam^me^lekv caux Saa^le^se, longc nzuqc ndaauv daix ninh. Nqa'haav ninh mbuo biaux mingh yiem Aa^laa^latv Deic-Bung. Sen^naa^ke^lipv nyei dorn, E^saanx^hatv^ndon, nzipc jienv ninh zoux hungh.

Doix wuov deix ziangh hoc He^se^ki^yaa butv baengc kouv, kaav deix daic mi'aqv. Aamortv nyei dorn, wuov dauh douc waac mienh, I^saa^yaa, mingh mangc ninh aengx gorngv mbuox ninh, “ Ziouv hnangv naaiv gorngv, ‘Meih oix zuqc liuc leiz nyungc-nyungc sung weic zuqc meih zungv oix zuqc daic. Meih maiv haih longx.’+”
He^se^ki^yaa ziouc huin hmien mingh njongc wuov bung daux gaux gorngv mbuox Ziouv,
“O Ziouv aac, tov meih jangx jienv yie yiem meih nyei nza'hmien ziepc zuoqv nyei gan longx meih yaac ziux meih mangc yie zoux duqv longx.” He^se^ki^yaa ziouc nyiemv duqv hnyouv mun haic.
I^saa^yaa maiv gaengh duqv cuotv hungh dinc mbu'ndongx wuov kang ting wuov zanc, Ziouv gorngv mbuox ninh,

“Oix zuqc nzuonx mingh mbuox yie nyei baeqc fingx nyei bieiv zeiv, He^se^ki^yaa, ‘ Ziouv, meih nyei ong-taaix, Ndaawitv, nyei Tin-Hungh, hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, “Yie haiz meih daux gaux nyei waac yaac buatc meih nyei wuom-mueic. Yie oix zorc longx meih. Aengx jiex mingh taux da'faam hnoi meih duqv mingh bieqc zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv.
Yie aengx oix jaa bun meih ziangh ziepc hmz hnyangx yaac oix njoux naaiv norm zingh leih ndutv Atc^si^lie hungh nyei buoz-ndiev. Weic yie nyei bou, Ndaawitv, yie oix beu naaiv norm zingh.”+’+”
I^saa^yaa gorngv, “Zorqv deix ngongh nyorx biouv daaih.” Mienh ziouc zorqv daaih opv He^se^ki^yaa nyei zueih. Ninh ziouc longx mi'aqv.
He^se^ki^yaa naaic I^saa^yaa, “Maaih haaix nyungc jangx-hoc bun cing Ziouv oix zorc yie longx, taux da'faam hnoi yie duqv mingh zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv?”

I^saa^yaa dau, “Naaiv se Ziouv oix bun meih nyei jangx-hoc weic bun cing Ziouv oix ei jienv ninh laengz nyei waac zoux. Meih oix dongh linh mingh wuov ndaangc ziepc wuonc tei fai oix dongh linh nzuonx nqa'haav nqaang ziepc wuonc tei?”
He^se^ki^yaa dau, “Dongh linh mingh wuov ndaangc ziepc wuonc se gauh hec. Yie gauh oix dongh linh nzuonx nqa'haav ziepc wuonc.”
Douc waac mienh, I^saa^yaa, ziouc tov Ziouv. Ziouv ziouc bun dongh linh yiem Aa^hatc nyei tei tuix nzuonx ninh jiex ndaangc nyei ziepc wuonc tei.
Doix wuov deix ziangh hoc, Mbaa^laa^ndan nyei dorn, Mbaa^mbi^lon Guoqv nyei hungh, Me^lo^ndakc Mbaa^laa^ndan, haiz gorngv He^se^ki^yaa butv baengc ziouc fungx fienx caux zingh nyeic mingh bun ninh.

He^se^ki^yaa zipv naaiv deix douc fienx mienh yaac bun ninh mbuo mangc ninh siou jaaix nyei ga'naaiv nyei dorngx yietc zungv ga'naaiv. Se bun ninh mbuo mangc jiem, nyaanh, laapc liuc, jaaix haic nyei youh caux ninh mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc, dongh ninh maaih nyei nyungc-nyungc jaaix nyei ga'naaiv. Yiem ninh nyei hungh dinc caux ziangh norm guoqv nyei ga'naaiv. Maiv maaih yietc nyungc He^se^ki^yaa maiv bun ninh mbuo buatc.
Douc waac mienh, I^saa^yaa, naaic gaax, “Naaiv deix mienh gorngv haaix nyungc? Yiem haaix daaih?” He^se^ki^yaa dau, “Ninh mbuo yiem go nyei deic-bung daaih, se yiem Mbaa^mbi^lon daaih.”

I^saa^yaa naaic, “Yiem meih nyei hungh dinc ninh mbuo duqv buatc haaix nyungc?” He^se^ki^yaa gorngv, “Yiem yie nyei hungh dinc ninh mbuo duqv buatc nyungc-nyungc. Yie jaaix nyei ga'naaiv maiv maaih yietc nyungc yie maiv bun ninh mbuo mangc.”
I^saa^yaa gorngv mbuox He^se^ki^yaa, “Muangx Ziouv nyei waac maah!

‘Hnoi-nyieqc zungv oix taux. Yiem meih nyei hungh dinc nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv caux meih nyei ong-taaix siou taux ih jaax hnoi nyei ga'naaiv, oix zuqc caangv mingh taux Mbaa^mbi^lon. Yietc nyungc yaac maiv liouh.’ Naaiv se Ziouv gorngv nyei waac.
‘Maaih deix yiem meih ganh nyei nziaamv-fei cuotv nyei dorn-jueiv fun-faqv zungv oix zuqc guaatv mingh yiem Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh dinc benx zuqc im dov nyei mienh.’+”

He^se^ki^yaa dau I^saa^yaa, “Meih douc daaih naaiv joux Ziouv nyei waac se longx nyei.” Ninh hnangv naaiv nor gorngv weic zuqc ninh yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Da'faanh yie nyei seix zeiv taaix-baengh nyei, maiv maaih sic maiv zeiz?”

He^se^ki^yaa gunv nyei ziangh hoc zoux liuz zengc njiec nyei sic, caux ninh nyei qaqv zoux nyei yietc zungv, caux ninh wetv wuom-domh, wetv wuom-jauv gan ndau-ndiev mingh bungx wuom bieqc zingh gu'nyuoz naaiv deix yietc zungv sic, fiev jienv Yu^ndaa hungh nyei hungh douh daan.
He^se^ki^yaa guei seix mi'aqv, ninh nyei dorn, Maa^natv^se, nzipc jienv ninh zoux hungh.
Maa^natv^se faaux weic zoux hungh wuov zanc, ninh duqv ziepc nyeic hnyangx. Ninh yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv hmz ziepc hmz hnyangx. Ninh nyei maa nyei mbuox heuc Hepv^si^mbaa.
Ziux Ziouv mangc ninh zoux waaic sic. Ninh ei jienv Ziouv zunc cuotv I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx wuov deix fingx-fingx mienh zoux gamh nziev haic nyei sic.

Ninh aengx ceix jiez dongh ninh nyei die, He^se^ki^yaa, baaic waaic wuov deix yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx. Ninh aengx weic Mbaa^an zienh ceix ziec-dorngh, yaac zoux Aa^se^laa zienh nyeiz nyei fangx, hnangv I^saa^laa^en nyei hungh, Aa^hapc, nor. Ninh baaix yaac zaangc lungh zaangc nyei nyungc-nyungc.
Ninh yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv ceix ziec-dorngh, se yiem Ziouv gorngv, “Yie oix liepc yie nyei Mengh yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem,” wuov norm dorngx.
Ninh yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv i norm laatc gu'nyuoz nyei dorngx weic lungh zaangc nyei nyungc-nyungc ceix ziec-dorngh.
Ninh zorqv ninh ganh nyei dorn buov ziec, yaac zoux faatv, mangc maengc, gaanv hei, mbouv guaax. Ziux Ziouv mangc ninh zoux waaic sic camv haic, cuoqv Ziouv qiex jiez haic.

Ninh zorqv ninh zuqc daaih wuov norm Aa^se^laa zienh nyeiz nyei fangx an jienv zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv gu'nyuoz. Se naaiv norm biauv Ziouv gorngv mbuox Ndaawitv caux ninh nyei dorn, Saa^lo^morn, “Se naaiv norm biauv caux Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh yie yiem fingx-fingx I^saa^laa^en Mienh mbu'ndongx ginv cuotv daaih liepc yie ganh nyei Mengh weic yietc liuz.

Se gorngv I^saa^laa^en Mienh faix fim ei jienv yie hatc nyei yietc zungv waac zoux yaac ei jienv yie nyei bou, Mose, jiu bun ninh mbuo nyei yietc zungv leiz-latc, yie zungv maiv bun ninh mbuo zuqc zunc cuotv.”
Mv baac ninh mbuo maiv muangx. Maa^natv^se baeng ninh mbuo zoux waaic sic gauh camv Ziouv yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx mietc wuov deix fingx-fingx mienh.
Ziouv longc ninh nyei bou, douc waac mienh, gorngv,

“Yu^ndaa nyei hungh, Maa^natv^se, zoux naaiv deix gamh nziev haic, youx haic nyei sic. Ninh zoux gauh waaic yiem ndaangc ninh wuov deix Aa^mo^lai Mienh. Ninh longc ninh nyei miuc-fangx bun Yu^ndaa Mienh baamz zuiz camv haic.
Weic naaiv, Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, gorngv, ‘Yie oix bun Ye^lu^saa^lem caux Yu^ndaa zuqc domh zeqc naanc. Haaix dauh haiz naaiv deix sic, m'normh ziouc nqingx nzengc wuov.

Yie oix dingc Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei zuiz hnangv yie dingc Saa^maa^lie nyei zuiz nor, yaac hnangv yie dingc Aa^hapc nyei zeiv-fun nyei zuiz. Yie oix sortv Ye^lu^saa^lem hnangv mienh sortv yienv nor. Sortv liuz aengx nqopv jienv.
Yie oix guangc yie zengc njiec nyei mienh, zorqv ninh mbuo jiu bun ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv. Ninh mbuo ziouc zuqc win-wangv luv ninh mbuo, caangv ninh mbuo,
weic zuqc ei yie mangc, ninh mbuo zoux waaic sic yiem ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix cuotv I^yipv taux ih hnoi.’+”

Maiv daan mbuoqc naaiv. Maa^natv^se daix kuv mienh, bun nziaamv liouc cuotv camv, zungv buangv Ye^lu^saa^lem yiem naaiv bung mingh taux wuov bung. Cuotv liuz naaiv, ninh bun Yu^ndaa Mienh baamz zuiz, ziux Ziouv mangc ninh mbuo ziouc zoux waaic sic.
Maa^natv^se gunv nyei ziangh hoc zoux liuz zengc njiec nyei sic, caux ninh zoux nyei yietc zungv, caux ninh baamz nyei zuiz, fiev jienv Yu^ndaa hungh nyei hungh douh daan.
Maa^natv^se guei seix mi'aqv, yaac zangx jienv yiem ninh nyei hungh dinc nyei huingx, se Utc^saa nyei huingx. Ninh nyei dorn, Aamon, nzipc jienv ninh zoux hungh.

Aamon faaux weic zoux hungh wuov zanc, ninh nyei hnyangx-jeiv duqv nyic ziepc nyeic hnyangx. Ninh yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv i hnyangx. Ninh nyei maa nyei mbuox heuc Me^sun^le^metv. Se Yotv^mbaa Mienh, Haalutv, nyei sieqv.
Ziux Ziouv mangc, Aamon zoux waaic sic hnangv ninh nyei die, Maa^natv^se, zoux nor.
Ninh zuotc ninh nyei die nyei yietc zungv nyungc zeiv zoux. Ninh zaangc yaac baaix ninh nyei die zaangc nyei miuc-fangx.
Ninh guangc Ziouv, ninh nyei nyei ong-taaix nyei Tin-Hungh, maiv yangh Ziouv nyei jauv.
Aamon nyei jien daav za'eix ngaengc ninh ziouc yiem hungh dinc gu'nyuoz daix ninh.
Mv baac Yu^ndaa Deic-Bung nyei baeqc fingx daix dongh daav za'eix daix hungh diex wuov deix mienh. Ninh mbuo yaac liepc Aamon nyei dorn, Yo^si^yaa, div ninh zoux hungh.
Aamon gunv nyei ziangh hoc zoux liuz zengc njiec nyei sic fiev jienv Yu^ndaa hungh nyei hungh douh daan.
Ninh zangx jienv Utc^saa nyei huingx, ninh ganh nyei zouv. Ninh nyei dorn, Yo^si^yaa, nzipc jienv ninh zoux hungh.

Yo^si^yaa faaux weic zoux hungh wuov zanc, ninh duqv hietc hnyangx. Ninh yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv faah ziepc yietv hnyangx. Ninh nyei maa nyei mbuox heuc Ye^ndi^ndaa, se Mbotc^kaatv Mienh, Aa^ndaa^yaa nyei sieqv.
Ziux Ziouv mangc, Yo^si^yaa zoux duqv horpc. Ninh ei jienv ninh nyei ong-taaix, Ndaawitv, nyei yietc zungv jauv yangh, maiv mingh mbiaauc, maiv mingh zaaix.
Yo^si^yaa zoux hungh ziepc betv hnyangx wuov hnyangx, ninh paaiv Me^sun^laam nyei fun, Aa^saa^lai^yaa nyei dorn, Saafaan sou-biuv, mingh zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv, gorngv mbuox ninh,
“Mingh lorz Hin^ki^yaa domh sai mienh mbuox ninh funx nzengc dorh daaih hietv zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei nyaanh, dongh zuov gaengh mienh siou baeqc fingx nyei wuov deix nyaanh.
Zorqv wuov deix nyaanh jiu bun liuc leiz zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei gunv gong mienh. Ninh mbuo ziouc haih koi gong-zinh jiu bun zorc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei gong-mienh,
se bun ndiangx-zaangc, zoux biauv zaangc, nanv nie-zun zaangc, bun ninh mbuo maaiz ndiangx, yaac maaiz zuqc ziangx nyei la'bieiv, weic zorc zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv.
Mv baac zorqv nyaanh jiu bun ninh mbuo, maiv zuqc heuc ninh mbuo faaux zaeqv-daan, weic zuqc ninh mbuo ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux.”
Hin^ki^yaa domh sai mienh gorngv mbuox Saafaan sou-biuv, “Yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv yie lorz buatc Leiz-Latc Sou.” Ninh ziouc jiu bun Saafaan. Saafaan doqc mangc.
Saafaan sou-biuv ziouc nzuonx hungh diex wuov gorngv mbuox ninh, “Meih nyei jien zorqv yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei nyaanh jiu bun zorc wuov norm biauv nyei gunv gong mienh.”
Saafaan sou-biuv aengx gorngv mbuox hungh diex, “Hin^ki^yaa sai mienh bun njunc sou yie.” Saafaan ziouc doqc bun hungh diex muangx.
Hungh diex haiz Leiz-Latc Sou nyei waac ziouc betv ninh ganh nyei lui.
Ninh paaiv Hin^ki^yaa domh sai mienh caux Saafaan nyei dorn, Aa^hi^kam, caux Mi^kaa^yaa nyei dorn, Akc^mbo, caux Saafaan sou-biuv caux hungh diex nyei zunc nzuih mienh, Aa^saax^yaa,

“Mingh weic yie caux baeqc fingx caux Yu^ndaa nyei zuangx mienh naaic Ziouv taux naaiv njunc sou gorngv nyei waac. Laaix mbuo nyei ong-taaix maiv muangx naaiv njunc sou nyei waac, maiv ei jienv naaiv njunc sou gorngv mbuo nyei yietc zungv waac, Ziouv ziouc za'gengh! qiex jiez haic mbuo.”

Hin^ki^yaa domh sai mienh caux Aa^hi^kam caux Akc^mbo, Saafaan caux Aa^saax^yaa mingh lorz douc waac mienh m'sieqv dorn, Hun^ndaa, yaac caux ninh caangh laangh. Hun^ndaa zoux goux zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei lui-houx wuov dauh Haan^hatv nyei fun, Tikv^waa nyei dorn, Sanlum nyei auv, yaac yiem siang wuov kang Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh.
Hun^ndaa gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “ Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, ‘Oix zuqc mbuox paaiv meih mbuo daaih lorz yie wuov dauh mienh,
Ziouv hnangv naaiv nor gorngv. “Ziux Yu^ndaa hungh doqc wuov njunc sou nyei yietc zungv waac yie oix bun naaiv norm dorngx caux naaiv norm dorngx nyei baeqc fingx zuqc zeqc naanc.

Weic zuqc ninh mbuo guangc yie aengx buov hung bun nyiec nyei zienh, yaac longc ninh mbuo ganh nyei buoz zoux daaih nyei miuc-fangx, yie nyei ga'qiex ziouc baetv cuotv bun naaiv norm dorngx, yaac maiv haih bun ga'qiex fiu.”+’
Oix zuqc mbuox Yu^ndaa nyei hungh diex, dongh paaiv meih mbuo daaih naaic Ziouv, “ Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, hnangv naaiv nor gorngv taux meih haiz liuz wuov deix waac.

‘Weic zuqc meih haiz yie hnangv haaix nor gorngv naaiv norm dorngx caux naaiv norm dorngx nyei mienh, yaac hiuv duqv ninh mbuo oix zuqc zioux, zuqc baaic waaic, meih ziouc goiv hnyouv, yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien nyiemc ganh zoux faix, betv meih nyei lui-houx yaac dorng jienv yie nyiemv, yie ziouc muangx haiz meih nyei waac.’ Naaiv se Ziouv gorngv nyei waac.

‘Weic naaiv yie oix bun meih guei seix ndaangc, duqv baengh orn nyei zangx jienv zouv. Meih nyei m'zing ziouc maiv duqv buatc dongh yie oix bun naaiv norm dorngx zuqc nyei zeqc naanc.’+” Naaiv deix mienh ziouc dorh naaiv deix waac nzuonx mingh mbuox hungh diex.
Hungh diex ziouc heuc Yu^ndaa caux Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei zuangx mienh gox daaih zunv.

Ninh caux Yu^ndaa nyei zuangx mienh, Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei baeqc fingx, caux sai mienh caux douc waac mienh, yietc zungv baeqc fingx hlo-hlo faix-faix ziouc mingh taux zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv. Ninh ziouc doqc yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv zorqv cuotv daaih nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Sou bun zuangx mienh muangx.

Hungh diex souv jienv ndiouh ga'hlen, yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien liepc ngaengc waac gorngv ninh oix longc nzengc hnyouv, longc nzengc za'eix gan Ziouv, yaac ei jienv ninh hatc nyei waac caux ninh nyei lingc caux leiz-latc. Ninh ziouc laengz ei jienv naaiv njunc sou fiev nyei ngaengc waac. Zuangx baeqc fingx yaac laengz ei jienv naaiv deix ngaengc waac zoux.

Hungh diex paaiv Hin^ki^yaa domh sai mienh caux borng-buoz nyei sai mienh caux zuov zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei mienh zorqv yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv longc baaix Mbaa^an zienh caux Aa^se^laa zienh nyeiz caux yiem lungh zaangc nyei nyungc-nyungc nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv, bienh cuotv daaih. Ninh yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh ga'nyiec, Kitc^lon Horngz ga'hlen, buov nzengc aengx dorh saaiv mingh taux Mbetc^en guangc.

Yo^si^yaa Hungh zorqv guangc Yu^ndaa nyei hungh liepc daaih zaangc nyiec nyei zienh wuov deix sai mienh, se yiem Yu^ndaa nyei mungv caux Ye^lu^saa^lem huing nzuonx yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx buov hung bun Mbaa^an zienh caux mba'hnoi caux hlaax caux hleix caux lungh zaangc nyei nyungc-nyungc ga'naaiv.

Ninh yaac zorqv nqoi yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv wuov norm Aa^se^laa zienh nyeiz nyei fangx, dorh cuotv Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh mingh taux Kitc^lon Horngz, yiem wuov buov. Ninh mborqv muonc benx saaiv aengx haaz njiec pou-tong mienh nyei zouv.
Ninh aengx caeqv yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv weic zaangc zienh maaic buonv-sin nyei m'jangc dorn yiem nyei dorngx, se dongh m'sieqv dorn ndatv ndie zorng Aa^se^laa zienh nyeiz wuov norm dorngx.

Yo^si^yaa dorh yiem Yu^ndaa nyei norm-norm mungv nyei sai mienh daaih taux Ye^lu^saa^lem yaac zoux bun yiem Ge^mbaa taux Mbe^e^qe^mbaa, yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei norm-norm dorngx, se wuov deix sai mienh buov hung nyei dorngx, maaih uix. Ninh yaac caeqv waaic zingh ga'hlen zaangc zienh nyei dorngx, se yiem zingh ziouv, Yo^su^waa, nyei gaengh ndaangc, bieqc zingh gaengh nyei zaaix maengx.

Maiv gunv yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx daaih wuov deix sai mienh maiv duqv yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem, Ziouv nyei ziec-dorngh fu-sux, ninh mbuo duqv yiem ninh mbuo sai mienh doic mbu'ndongx juangc nyanc maiv an bingv nyei njuov.

Ninh zoux bun Tofetv maaih uix, se yiem Mben Hinnom Horngz zaangc nyiec nyei zienh nyei dorngx, weic maiv bun mienh haih zorqv ninh mbuo nyei naamh nyouz longc douz buov ziec fongc horc bun Molekv zienh.

Ninh zorqv nqoi yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei gaengh ndaangc nyei maaz, dongh Yu^ndaa Deic nyei zuangx hungh fungx weic longc zaangc mba'hnoi nyei maaz. Ninh mbuo yiem laatc gu'nyuoz nitv dauh jien, mbuox heuc Naatan Melekv, yiem wuov qongx. Yo^si^yaa yaac zorqv zaangc mba'hnoi nyei maaz-cie buov guangc.

Ninh yaac caeqv njiec Yu^ndaa nyei zuangx hungh yiem biauv-ngorh, nitv Aa^hatc nyei wuov qongx, ceix nyei ziec-dorngh caux Maa^natv^se yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv i norm laatc gu'nyuoz nyei ziec-dorngh. Ninh yiem wuov deix dorngx caeqv daaih dorh mingh mborqv muonc nzengc, zoi guangc Kitc^lon Horngz.

Yo^si^yaa Hungh yaac zoux bun yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx maaih uix, se yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei dong bung, ga'lanv mbong nyei naamh bung maengx, wuov norm dorngx. Naaiv norm dorngx se I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Saa^lo^morn Hungh weic Si^ndorn Mienh nyei gamh nziev haic nyei Atc^taa^lotv zienh nyeiz, caux Mo^apc Mienh gamh nziev haic nyei Kemotv zienh, caux Ammon Mienh, gamh nziev haic nyei zienh liepc daaih.
Yo^si^yaa mborqv huv nzengc zaangc zienh nyei la'bieiv-dongc yaac jamv Aa^se^laa zienh nyeiz nyei fangx, aengx zorqv mienh nyei mbungv guangc jienv wuov.

Maiv daan mbuoqc naaiv. Yo^si^yaa Hungh yaac caeqv yiem Mbetc^en nyei ziec-dorngh, se dongh Ne^mbatc nyei dorn, Ye^lo^mbo^am, ceix daaih wuov norm yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx. Dongh naaiv norm ziec-dorngh caux yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx ninh baaic waaic. Ninh buov yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx aengx mborqv benx saaiv. Ninh yaac buov Aa^se^laa zienh nyeiz nyei fangx.

Yo^si^yaa huin m'nqorngv ziouc mangc buatc yiem wuov jiex mbong-hlen maaih deix janx-daic zouv. Ninh ziouc paaiv mienh mingh wuov zouv dorh mbungv daaih aengx an wuov norm ziec-dorngh buov weic bun ziec-dorngh maaih uix. Naaiv se hnangv zinh ndaangc Tin-Hungh nyei mienh zunh Ziouv nyei zinh hoz waac.

Hungh diex naaic gaax, “Yie mangc buatc wuov se haaix nyungc jangx-hoc?” Wuov norm zingh nyei mienh gorngv, “Naaic se yiem Yu^ndaa daaih nyei yietc dauh Tin-Hungh nyei mienh. Ninh gorngv zinh hoz waac, gorngv Mbetc^en nyei ziec-dorngh doix nzengc hungh diex zoux bun naaiv norm ziec-dorngh nyei yietc zungv sic.”

Hungh diex gorngv, “Sueih ninh yiem naaic aqv. Maiv dungx bun haaix dauh suiv ninh nyei mbungv.” Ninh mbuo ziouc liouh ninh nyei mbungv caux yiem Saa^maa^lie daaih wuov dauh douc waac mienh nyei mbungv.

Dongh zinh ndaangc I^saa^laa^en nyei hungh yiem Saa^maa^lie nyei zingh liepc daaih wuov deix yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx cuoqv Ziouv qiex jiez haic, Yo^si^yaa yaac caeqv nzengc hnangv yiem Mbetc^en zoux wuov nor.

Ninh aengx zorqv yietc zungv yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx nyei sai mienh yiem ziec-dorngh gu'nguaaic daix. Ninh yaac zorqv mienh nyei mbungv yiem wuov deix ziec-dorngh gu'nguaaic buov. Nqa'haav ninh nzuonx Ye^lu^saa^lem.
Hungh diex hatc zuangx baeqc fingx, “Meih mbuo oix zuqc jiex Siex Maengc Zipv weic taaih Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Oix zuqc jiex zipv ziux fiev jienv naaiv buonv Laengz Ngaengc Waac Sou.”
Yiem domh jien gunv I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung nyei lungh ndiev zoux liuz taux ih zanc, maiv maaih I^saa^laa^en fai Yu^ndaa nyei haaix dauh hungh hnangv naaiv nor jiex Siex Maengc Zipv.
Mv baac Yo^si^yaa zoux hungh ziepc betv hnyangx wuov hnyangx, ninh mbuo yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem jiex Siex Maengc Zipv.

Maiv daan mbuoqc naaiv. Yo^si^yaa mietc nzengc gaanv hei caux mbouv guaax nyei mienh, yiem biauv gu'nyuoz zaangc nyei zienh caux miuc-fangx caux yiem Yu^ndaa caux Ye^lu^saa^lem yietc zungv gamh nziev haic nyei ga'naaiv. Ninh hnangv naaiv nor zoux weic zoux ziangx yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv Hin^ki^yaa sai mienh lorz buatc wuov njunc sou fiev jienv leiz-latc nyei joux-joux waac.

Yiem ndaangc Yo^si^yaa caux yiem nqa'haav wuov deix yietc zungv hungh, maiv maaih haaix dauh hungh hnangv Yo^si^yaa longc nzengc hnyouv, longc nzengc za'eix, longc nzengc qaqv gan nzengc Mose nyei yietc zungv Leiz-Latc.
Mv baac Ziouv corc qiex jiez haic, nouz haic Yu^ndaa Mienh taux ih zanc, ga'qiex yaac maiv fiu, laaix Maa^natv^se zoux nyei yietc zungv sic, cuoqv ninh qiex jiez.

Ziouv gorngv, “Yie oix zoux bun Yu^ndaa Mienh hnangv yie zoux bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh nor, maiv bun ninh mbuo yiem yie nyei nza'hmien. Yie oix guangc yie ginv naaiv norm zingh, Ye^lu^saa^lem, caux dongh yie gorngv ‘Yie oix liepc yie nyei Mengh’ naaiv norm zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv.”
Yo^si^yaa gunv nyei ziangh hoc zoux zengc njiec nyei sic caux ninh zoux liuz nyei yietc zungv, fiev jienv Yu^ndaa hungh nyei hungh douh daan.

Yo^si^yaa zoux hungh nyei ziangh hoc, I^yipv nyei hungh, Faalo Neko, gan Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih mingh tengx Atc^si^lie nyei hungh. Yo^si^yaa Hungh cuotv mingh yiem Me^gitc^ndo caux Faalo Neko mborqv jaax. Faalo Neko caux Yo^si^yaa doix hmien wuov zanc Faalo Neko ziouc daix ninh aqv.

Yo^si^yaa nyei jien ziouc zorqv Yo^si^yaa nyei sei dapv jienv mborqv jaax nyei maaz-cie, yiem Me^gitc^ndo tor nzuonx Ye^lu^saa^lem zangx jienv ninh ganh nyei zouv. Wuov norm guoqv nyei baeqc fingx ziouc zorqv Yo^si^yaa nyei dorn, Ye^ho^aa^haatc, orn ninh div ninh nyei die zoux hungh.

Ye^ho^aa^haatc faaux weic zoux hungh wuov zanc, ninh duqv nyic ziepc faam hnyangx, yaac yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv buo hlaax nyieqc. Ninh nyei maa nyei mbuox heuc Haa^mu^taan, se Lipv^naa Mienh, Ye^le^mi nyei sieqv.
Ziux Ziouv mangc, Ye^ho^aa^haatc zoux waaic sic hnangv ninh nyei ong-taaix mbuo zoux nyei nor.

Faalo Neko zorqv ninh mingh wuonx jienv yiem Haamatv Deic nyei Lipv^laa Zingh weic bun ninh maiv duqv yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv. Ninh yaac baatc Yu^ndaa Mienh cuotv i cin yietc baeqv joih nyaanh caux nyic ziepc yietv joih jiem.

Faalo Neko liepc Yo^si^yaa nyei dorn, E^li^yaa^kim zoux hungh div ninh nyei die, Yo^si^yaa, aengx tiuv ninh nyei mbuox heuc Ye^ho^yaa^kim. Ninh yaac dorh Ye^ho^aa^haatc mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung. Yiem I^yipv ninh daic mi'aqv.

Ye^ho^yaa^kim cuotv jiem nyaanh bun Faalo Neko ziux ninh hatc nyei waac. Mv baac weic haih maaih naaiv deix jiem nyaanh cuotv, ninh aapv wuov norm deic-bung nyei baeqc fingx cuotv nzou-zinh ziux gorqv-mienh maaih nyei.

Ye^ho^yaa^kim faaux weic zoux hungh wuov zanc ninh duqv nyic ziepc hmz hnyangx. Ninh yaac yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv ziepc yietv hnyangx. Ninh nyei maa nyei mbuox heuc Se^mbi^ndaa, se Lumaa Mienh, Be^ndaa^yaa, nyei sieqv.
Ziux Ziouv mangc, ninh zoux waaic sic, hnangv ninh nyei ong-taaix mbuo zoux nor.

Yiem Ye^ho^yaa^kim gunv nyei ziangh hoc, Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh, Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa, bieqc daaih caangv Yu^ndaa Deic-Bung. Ye^ho^yaa^kim yaac zuqc yiem ninh nyei buoz-ndiev mbuoqc ninh gunv buo hnyangx. Nqa'haav ninh ngaengc, maiv muangx Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa.

Ziouv bun Mbaa^mbi^lon Mienh, Silie Mienh, Mo^apc Mienh caux Ammon Mienh nyei yietc guanh yietc guanh zaqc baeng daaih mborqv ninh. Ninh paaiv ninh mbuo daaih weic oix mietc Yu^ndaa ziux Ziouv longc ninh nyei bou, zuangx douc waac mienh, gorngv nyei waac.
Naaiv deix sic cuotv daaih ziux Ziouv hatc nyei waac weic bun Yu^ndaa Mienh maiv duqv yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien. Se laaix Maa^natv^se zoux nyei yietc zungv zuiz,
yaac laaix ninh daix kuv mienh camv, bun nziaamv liouc cuotv buangv Ye^lu^saa^lem. Ziouv yaac maiv guangc bun ninh.
Ye^ho^yaa^kim gunv nyei ziangh hoc zoux liuz zengc njiec nyei sic caux ninh zoux nyei yietc zungv, fiev jienv Yu^ndaa hungh nyei hungh douh daan.
Ye^ho^yaa^kim ziouc guei seix mi'aqv. Ninh nyei dorn, Ye^ho^yaa^kin, yaac nzipc jienv ninh zoux hungh.
I^yipv nyei hungh maiv aengx cuotv ninh nyei guoqv, weic zuqc Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh zorqv nzengc ninh nyei deic-bung mi'aqv, yiem I^yipv Ndoqv mingh taux Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih.

Ye^ho^yaa^kin faaux weic zoux hungh wuov zanc, ninh duqv ziepc betv hnyangx. Ninh yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv buo hlaax nyieqc. Ninh nyei maa nyei mbuox heuc Ne^hutc^taa, se Ye^lu^saa^lem Mienh, En^naa^tan, nyei sieqv.
Ziux Ziouv mangc, Ye^ho^yaa^kin zoux waaic sic hnangv ninh nyei die zoux nor.
Wuov zanc Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh, Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa, nyei baeng-bieiv daaih weih gormx Ye^lu^saa^lem.
Baeng-bieiv weih jienv zingh wuov zanc, Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh, Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa, mingh taux Ye^lu^saa^lem.

Yu^ndaa nyei hungh, Ye^ho^yaa^kin, caux ninh nyei maa, ninh nyei jien, ninh nyei zoux hlo nyei mienh caux yiem hungh dinc nyei jien yietc zungv nyiemc suei bun ninh. Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh zoux hungh da'betv hnyangx wuov hnyangx, ninh dorh Ye^ho^yaa^kin mingh wuonx jienv.

Hnangv Ziouv gorngv nor, Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa zorqv nzengc yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv caux yiem hungh dinc nyei yietc zungv jaaix nyei ga'naaiv. Ninh yaac zorqv I^saa^laa^en nyei hungh, Saa^lo^morn, weic zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv zoux daaih nyei jiem-jaa-dorngx hngaqv benx yietc hlengx yietc hlengx.

Ninh aengx guaatv nzengc Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei baeqc fingx, caux yietc zungv baeng-bieiv caux henv haic nyei baeng, liemh yietc zungv buoz-dauh longx nyei zaangc mienh caux ndiangx-zaangc. Yietc zungv maaih yietc waanc dauh. Kungx zengc gauh jomc jiex nyei mienh duqv yiem deic-bung hnangv.

Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa guaatv Ye^ho^yaa^kin mingh Mbaa^mbi^lon. Liemh hungh maac caux ninh nyei auv mbuo, ninh nyei jien caux wuov norm deic-bung zoux hlo nyei mienh, Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem guaatv mingh Mbaa^mbi^lon nzengc.

Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh yaac guaatv yietc zungv haih mborqv jaax henv nyei baeng siec cin dauh, yaac guaatv buoz-dauh longx nyei zaangc mienh caux hlieqv-zaangc yietc cin dauh mingh Mbaa^mbi^lon. Yietc zungv henv nyei, puix duqv zoux baeng mborqv jaax nyei mienh.
Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh liepc Ye^ho^yaa^kin nyei youz-diex, Matv^taa^ni^yaa, zoux hungh div Ye^ho^yaa^kin, aengx tiuv Matv^taa^ni^yaa nyei mbuox heuc Se^nde^ki^yaa.

Se^nde^ki^yaa faaux weic zoux hungh wuov zanc, ninh duqv nyic ziepc yietv hnyangx. Ninh yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv ziepc yietv hnyangx. Ninh nyei maa nyei mbuox heuc Haa^mu^taan, se Lipv^naa Mienh, Ye^le^mi, nyei sieqv.
Ziux Ziouv mangc, Se^nde^ki^yaa zoux waaic sic, hnangv Ye^ho^yaa^kin zoux nor.

Se laaix Ziouv qiex jiez haic, Ye^lu^saa^lem caux Yu^ndaa cingx zuqc naaiv deix sic taux Ziouv guangc, maiv bun ninh mbuo yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien. Zoux gau, Se^nde^ki^yaa ngaengc jienv Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh.

Se^nde^ki^yaa zoux hungh da'juov hnyangx ziepc hlaax saeng-ziepc wuov hnoi, Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh, Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa, dorh jienv ninh nyei zuangx baeng daaih mborqv Ye^lu^saa^lem. Ninh liepc ciangv weih gormx zingh ga'nyiec maengx yaac zoux mborqv jaax nyei jaa-sic weih gormx.
Ninh mbuo weih jienv zingh taux Se^nde^ki^yaa zoux hungh ziepc yietv hnyangx wuov hnyangx.
Taux feix hlaax saeng-juov yiem zingh gu'nyuoz nyei mienh ngorc hnaangx kouv haic aqv. Baeqc fingx maiv maaih haaix nyungc nyanc.

Ninh mbuo ziouc mborqv zingh laatc tong, yietc zungv baeng lungh muonz zanc biaux, yangh nitv hungh diex nyei huingx i norm zingh laatc mbu'ndongx nyei laatc gaengh cuotv, maiv gunv Mbaa^mbi^lon Mienh weih gormx zingh. Biaux cuotv, ninh mbuo hungx jienv Aa^laa^mbaa Deic mingh.
Mv baac Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei baeng-guanh zunc jienv mingh yaac zunc zaaic Se^nde^ki^yaa Hungh yiem Ye^li^ko nyei ndau-baengh. Ninh nyei baeng-guanh guangc jienv ninh, faatv nzaanx nyei biaux.
Hungh diex yaac zuqc zorqv mi'aqv. Baeng dorh ninh mingh taux Lipv^laa Zingh, Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh wuov, dingc ninh nyei zuiz.
Ninh mbuo dorng jienv Se^nde^ki^yaa daix nzengc ninh nyei dorn. Ninh mbuo gueix Se^nde^ki^yaa nyei m'zing cuotv, yaac longc dongh siqv limc ndoh jienv dorh ninh mingh Mbaa^mbi^lon.

Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa zoux Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh ziepc juov hnyangx hmz hlaax saeng-cietv wuov hnoi, hungh diex nyei sin-hlen mienh nyei bieiv, Ne^mbu^saa^laa^ndaan, se Mbaa^mbi^lon Hungh nyei yietc dauh jien, mingh taux Ye^lu^saa^lem.
Ninh longc douz buov zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv caux hungh dinc caux yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei norm-norm biauv. Da'faanh longc jienv nyei biauv ninh buov nzengc.
Dongh gan jienv hungh diex nyei sin-hlen mienh nyei baeng-bieiv wuov deix zuangx baeng mborqv mbaang weih gormx Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh nyei zingh laatc.

Hungh diex nyei sin-hlen mienh nyei baeng-bieiv, Ne^mbu^saa^laa^ndaan, guaatv nzengc yiem zingh zengc njiec nyei baeqc fingx caux guangc jienv ganh nyei hungh bieqc Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh wuov deix, caux yietc zungv mienh mingh Mbaa^mbi^lon.
Mv baac hungh diex nyei sin-hlen mienh nyei baeng-bieiv liouh njiec gauh jomc jiex nyei mienh goux a'ngunc huingx, zoux lingh zoux ndeic.

Yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei dongh siqv ndiouh caux yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei dongh siqv dieh longz caux domh dongh siqv bunh wuov deix, Mbaa^mbi^lon baeng mborqv benx yietc hlengx yietc hlengx, ziouc bienh dongh siqv mingh Mbaa^mbi^lon.
Ninh mbuo yaac zorqv caeng, ga'naaiv-cenv, njapv dang-cov nyei njiuv, ba'gen caux yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv longc nyei yietc zungv dongh siqv jaa-dorngx dorh mingh.
Hungh diex nyei sin-hlen mienh nyei baeng-bieiv yaac zorqv siou douz nyei jei caux bunh dorh mingh. Maiv gunv longc jiem longc nyaanh zoux daaih nyei jaa-dorngx ninh dorh mingh benx jiem benx nyaanh.
Saa^lo^morn weic zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv zoux wuov deix i norm domh ndiouh caux domh bunh caux dieh longz nyei dongh siqv zungv maiv haih nziang maiv hingh.

Norm-norm ndiouh ziepc betv ndorqc hlang. Ndiouh dueiv-mueiz borqv jienv buo ndorqc hlang, maaih hnangv dongh siqv mungz nor, caux dongh siqv ziqc liouh biouv huing gormx. Wuov norm ndiouh yaac fih hnangv nyei zoux, maaih dongh siqv mungz weih gormx.
Hungh diex nyei sin-hlen mienh nyei baeng-bieiv zorqv Se^lai^aa domh sai mienh caux zoux da'nyeic wuov dauh sai mienh, Se^fan^yaa, caux buo dauh zuov gaengh nyei mienh dorh mingh.

Yiem zingh zengc njiec nyei mienh ninh zorqv dauh dorh baeng mborqv jaax nyei domh baeng-bieiv caux biaa dauh tengx hungh diex caangh laangh nyei mienh. Ninh yaac zorqv dauh dongh diuc deic-bung nyei baeng wuov dauh jun-baeng-bieiv nyei sou-biuv, caux yiem zingh gu'nyuoz lorz buatc nyei luoqc ziepc dauh baeqc fingx.
Domh baeng-bieiv, Ne^mbu^saa^laa^ndaan, zorqv ninh mbuo yietc zungv mingh Lipv^laa Zingh, Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh wuov.
Yiem Haamatv Deic, Lipv^laa Zingh wuov, hungh diex bun ninh mbuo zuqc daix daic. Yu^ndaa Mienh ziouc zuqc guaatv mingh, leih nqoi ganh nyei deic-bung.
Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh, Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa, liepc Saafaan nyei fun, Aa^hi^kam nyei dorn, Ge^ndaa^li^yaa, zoux Yu^ndaa nyei saengv-ziouv gunv liouh yiem Yu^ndaa zengc njiec nyei mienh.

Zuangx baeng-bieiv caux ninh mbuo nyei baeng muangx haiz Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh liepc Ge^ndaa^li^yaa zoux saengv-ziouv, ninh mbuo caux ninh mbuo nyei mienh mingh Mitv^baa lorz Ge^ndaa^li^yaa. Maaih Ne^taa^ni^yaa nyei dorn, I^saa^maa^en, caux Kaa^le^aa nyei dorn, Yo^haa^nan, caux Ne^to^faa Mienh, Tan^hu^metv nyei dorn, Se^lai^aa, caux Maa^aa^kaa Mienh nyei dorn, Yaa^aa^san^yaa, caux ninh mbuo nyei mienh.

Ge^ndaa^li^yaa houv jienv laengz waac mbuox ninh mbuo caux ninh mbuo nyei zuangx mienh, “Maiv dungx laaix Mbaa^mbi^lon Mienh nyei jien gamh nziex. Gunv bungx hnyouv yiem naaiv norm deic-bung fu-sux Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh meih mbuo ziouc duqv longx.”

Mv baac yiem cietv hlaax nyei ziangh hoc, maaih hungh nyei douh zong, E^li^saa^maa nyei fun, Ne^taa^ni^yaa nyei dorn, I^saa^maa^en, dorh ziepc dauh mienh daaih daix Ge^ndaa^li^yaa yaac daix caux ninh yiem Mitv^baa wuov deix Yu^ndaa Mienh caux Mbaa^mbi^lon Mienh.
Hnangv naaic zuangx baeqc fingx hlo-hlo faix-faix caux yietc zungv baeng-bieiv ziouc biaux mingh I^yipv Deic-Bung weic zuqc ninh mbuo gamh nziex Mbaa^mbi^lon Mienh.

Yiem Yu^ndaa nyei hungh, Ye^ho^yaa^kin, zuqc caangv mingh faah ziepc cietv hnyangx wuov hnyangx, dongh Ewin Me^lo^ndakc faaux weic zoux Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh wuov hnyangx, ziepc nyeic hlaax nyic ziepc cietv wuov hnoi, Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh bungx Ye^ho^yaa^kin cuotv loh.
Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei hungh caux Ye^ho^yaa^kin gorngv longx yaac bun ninh zueiz gauh hlang jiex caux ninh yiem Mbaa^mbi^lon wuov deix zuangx hungh diex zueiz nor.
Ye^ho^yaa^kin ziouc jaiv nqoi ninh yiem loh zuqv nyei lui-houx, yietc seix zanc-zanc duqv juangc hungh diex nyei dieh nyanc hnaangx.
Yiem Ye^ho^yaa^kin corc ziangh jienv nyei ziangh hoc, hungh diex hnoi-hnoi bun dongh ninh qiemx longc nyei ga'naaiv.
Aa^ndam zoux Setc nyei die, Setc zoux Enotv nyei die,
Enotv zoux Kenan nyei die, Kenan zoux Maa^haa^laa^len nyei die, Maa^haa^laa^len zoux Yaaletv nyei die,
Yaaletv zoux Enokv nyei die, Enokv zoux Me^tu^se^laa nyei die, Me^tu^se^laa zoux Laamekv nyei die,
Laamekv zoux Noyaa nyei die. Noyaa nyei dorn maaih Sem, Haam, caux Yaafetv.
Yaafetv nyei dorn maaih Go^me, Maagokc, Maa^ndai, Yaawaan, Tu^mban, Mesekv, caux Tilaatv.
Go^me nyei dorn maaih Atc^ke^natv, Lifaatv, caux To^gaan^maa.
Yaawaan nyei dorn maaih E^li^se^aa, Taansitv, Kitv^tim caux Lo^ndaa^nim.
Haam nyei dorn maaih Kutv, I^yipv, Putv caux Kaa^naa^an.
Kutv nyei dorn maaih Se^mbaa, Haa^wi^laa, Sapc^taa, Laa^aa^maa caux Sapc^te^kaa. Laa^aa^maa nyei dorn maaih Qe^mbaa caux Nde^ndaan.
Kutv maaih dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Nimlotv. Nimlotv, se yiem lungh ndiev zoux da'yietv dauh daamv hlo, maaih qaqv henv nyei mienh.
I^yipv nyei dorn maaih Lu^ndim, Aa^naa^mim, Le^haa^mbim, Napv^tu^him,
Batc^lu^simx, Katv^lu^him, (dongh zoux Fi^li^saa^die Mienh nyei ong-taaix-ngaeqv wuov dauh), caux Kapv^to Mienh.
Kaa^naa^an maaih i dauh dorn. Dorn-hlo heuc Sai^ndorn, dorn-faix heuc Hetv.
Kaa^naa^an yaac zoux camv-fingx mienh nyei ong-taaix-ngaeqv. Maaih Ye^mbutc Mienh, Aa^mo^lai Mienh, Ge^gaa^si Mienh,
Hiwai Mienh, Aankaa Mienh, Sini Mienh,
Aanwatv Mienh, Seme Mienh caux Haamatv Mienh.
Sem nyei dorn maaih Elaam, Atc^su, Aan^faa^satv, Lu^nde caux Aalam. Aalam nyei dorn maaih Utc, Hun, Ge^te caux Mesekv.
Aan^faa^satv zoux Qelaa nyei die. Qelaa yaac zoux E^mbe nyei die.
E^mbe maaih i dauh dorn. Maaih dauh, mbuox heuc Belekv, weic zuqc yiem ninh nyei seix zeiv mienh bun nqoi ndau-beih yiem. Ninh nyei youz nyei mbuox heuc Yokv^taan.
Yokv^taan nyei dorn maaih An^mo^ndatc, Qelepv, Haa^saan^maa^wetv, Yelaa,
Haa^ndo^lam, Usaan, Ndikc^laa,
E^mbaan, Aa^mbi^maa^en, Qe^mbaa,
Ofi, Haa^wi^laa caux Yo^mbapc. Naaiv deix yietc zungv zoux Yokv^taan nyei dorn.
Yiem Sem njiec mingh taux Apc^laam maaih Sem, Aan^faa^satv, Qelaa,
E^mbe, Belekv, Le^u,
Selukv, Naa^ho, Telaa
caux Apc^laam. (Apc^laam aengx maaih norm mbuox heuc Apc^laa^ham.)
Apc^laa^ham maaih i dauh dorn I^sakc caux I^saa^maa^en.
Naaiv se I^saa^maa^en nyei zeiv-fun. I^saa^maa^en nyei dorn-hlo heuc Ne^mbaa^yotv. Aengx maaih Ke^ndaa, Atc^mbe^en, Mipv^samx,
Mitv^maa, Ndumaa, Matv^saax, Haa^ndatc, Temaa,
Yetu, Naafitv, caux Ke^nde^maa. Naaiv se I^saa^maa^en nyei dorn.
Apc^laa^ham nyei jaav-zeih auv, Ke^tu^laa, nyei dorn maaih Simx^laan, Yokv^saan, Me^ndaan, Mi^ndien, Itc^mbaakc caux Quwaa. Yokv^saan nyei dorn maaih Qe^mbaa caux Nde^ndaan.
Mi^ndien nyei dorn maaih E^faa, Efe, Haanokv, Aa^mbi^ndaa caux En^ndaa^aa. Naaiv deix yietc zungv zoux Ke^tu^laa nyei zeiv-fun.
Apc^laa^ham zoux I^sakc nyei die. I^sakc nyei dorn maaih Esaau caux I^saa^laa^en.
Esaau nyei dorn maaih E^li^fatv, Le^u^en, Ye^utc, Yaalaam caux Kolaa.
E^li^fatv nyei dorn maaih Temaan, Omaa, Zefi, Gaataam, Kenatv, yaac maaih Timnaa yungz nyei dorn, Aa^maa^lekv.
Le^u^en nyei dorn maaih Naa^hatc, Zelaa, Sammaa caux Mitv^saa.
Se^i nyei dorn maaih Lotaan, So^mbaan, Si^mbe^on, Aanaa, Ndison, E^se caux Ndisaan.
Lotaan nyei dorn maaih Holi caux Homam. Lotaan nyei muoc heuc Timnaa.
So^mbaan nyei dorn maaih Anwaan, Maa^naa^haatv, E^mbaan, Sefi caux Onam. Si^mbe^on nyei dorn maaih Ai^aa caux Aanaa.
Aanaa maaih dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Ndison. Ndison nyei dorn maaih Hamlaan, Etc^mbaan, Itc^laan caux Kelaan.
E^se nyei dorn maaih Mbin^haan, Saax^waan caux Yaa^aa^kaan. Ndisaan nyei dorn maaih Utc caux Aalan.

Zinh ndaangc I^saa^laa^en Mienh maiv gaengh maaih hungh diex gunv wuov zanc, E^ndom Deic-Bung maaih hungh diex gunv nyei hnangv naaiv. Maaih Mbe^o nyei dorn, Mbelaa. Ninh nyei zingh heuc Ndin^haa^mbaa.
Mbelaa guei seix, aengx maaih yiem Mbo^saa^laa Zingh daaih wuov dauh Zelaa nyei dorn, Yo^mbapc, duqv nzipc zoux hungh.
Yo^mbapc guei seix, aengx maaih yiem Temaan Deic-Bung daaih wuov dauh Husaam nzipc zoux hungh.
Husaam guei seix, aengx maaih Mbe^ndatc nyei dorn, Haa^ndatc, duqv nzipc zoux hungh. Haa^ndatc dongh yiem Mo^apc mborqv hingh Mi^ndien Mienh wuov dauh. Ninh nyei zingh heuc Aawitv.
Haa^ndatc guei seix, aengx maaih yiem Matv^le^kaa Zingh daaih wuov dauh Samx^laa nzipc zoux hungh.
Samx^laa guei seix, aengx maaih yiem Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih hlen nyei Le^hox^mbotc Zingh daaih wuov dauh Saa^un duqv nzipc zoux hungh.
Saa^un guei seix, Mbaa^an Haanan, duqv nzipc zoux hungh.

Akc^mbo nyei dorn, Mbaa^an Haanan, guei seix, Haa^ndatc duqv nzipc zoux hungh. Ninh nyei zingh heuc Baa^u. Ninh nyei auv heuc Me^he^taa^mben. Me^he^taa^mben zoux Matv^letv nyei sieqv, Me^saa^hapc nyei fun.
Haa^ndatc yaac guei seix mi'aqv. Naaiv se E^ndom Deic nyei bieiv zeiv. Maaih Timnaa, Anwaa, Yetetv,
O^ho^li^mbaa^maa, Elaa, Binon,
Kenatv, Temaan, Mipv^saa,
Makv^ndi^en caux I^laam. Naaiv se E^ndom nyei bieiv zeiv.
Naaiv se I^saa^laa^en nyei dorn. Maaih Lu^mben, Si^me^on, Lewi, Yu^ndaa, Itc^saax^kaa, Se^mbu^lun,
Ndaan, Yosepv, Mben^yaa^min, Napv^taa^li, Gaatc caux Aa^se.

Naaiv se Yu^ndaa nyei dorn. Maaih E^aa, Onan, caux Qelaa. Naaiv se Kaa^naa^an Mienh, Mbatc^su^waa, yungz nyei dorn. Ziux Ziouv mangc, Yu^ndaa nyei dorn-hlo, E^aa, se orqv haic, Ziouv ziouc bun ninh zuqc daic aqv.
Yu^ndaa nyei mbuangz, Taamaa, yungz Beletv caux Zelaa bun Yu^ndaa. Yu^ndaa nyei dorn yietc zungv maaih biaa dauh.
Beletv nyei dorn maaih Hetv^lon caux Haamun.
Zelaa nyei dorn maaih Simx^li, Etaan, Hemaan, Kaanko caux Ndaan^ndaa. Yietc zungv maaih biaa dauh.
Kaanmi nyei dorn, Aakaan, hoic I^saa^laa^en Mienh zuqc domh sic, weic zuqc ninh baamz hatc nyei waac ziouc nzepv cuotv deix fungx dangx bun Tin-Hungh nyei ga'naaiv.
Etaan maaih nduqc dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Aa^saa^li^yaa.
Hetv^lon maaih buo dauh dorn, Ye^laa^me^en, Laam, caux Kaalepv.
Laam zoux Am^mi^naa^ndapc nyei die. Am^mi^naa^ndapc zoux Naason nyei die. Naason zoux Yu^ndaa Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv.
Naason zoux Sanx^mon nyei die. Sanx^mon zoux Mbo^aatc nyei die.
Mbo^aatc zoux O^mbetc nyei die. O^mbetc zoux Jetc^si nyei die.
Jetc^si nyei dorn-hlo se E^li^apc. Da'nyeic dauh dorn heuc Aa^mbi^naa^ndapc. Da'faam dauh heuc Si^me^aa.
Da'feix dauh heuc Ne^tan^en. Da'hmz dauh heuc Latv^ndai.
Da'luoqc dauh heuc Osem. Da'cietv dauh heuc Ndaawitv.
Ninh mbuo nyei dorc heuc Se^lu^yaa caux Aa^mbi^gaa^yin. Se^lu^yaa maaih buo dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Aa^mbi^qai, Yo^aapc, caux Aa^saax^hen.
Aa^mbi^gaa^yin zoux Aa^maa^saax nyei maa. Ninh nyei die se I^saa^maa^en Mienh, Ye^te.
Hetv^lon nyei dorn, Kaalepv, nyei auv, Aa^su^mbaa, yungz duqv dauh sieqv heuc Ye^li^otc. Ye^li^otc yungz buo dauh dorn, Yese, So^mbapc caux Aan^ndon.
Aa^su^mbaa guei seix, Kaalepv aengx longc E^faa^laa^taa duqv dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Hu^aa.
Hu^aa zoux Uli nyei die. Uli zoux Mbe^saa^len nyei die.
Nqa'haav Hetv^lon duqv luoqc ziepc hnyangx nyei ziangh hoc ninh longc Gi^le^aatc nyei die, Maaki, nyei sieqv, ziouc duqv dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Segupc.
Segupc zoux Jaa^i nyei die. Jaa^i gunv nyic ziepc faam norm zingh yiem Gi^le^aatc Deic.
Mv baac Gesu caux Aalam caangv duqv Haau^wotv Jaa^i, yaac caangv Kenaatv caux gormx Kenaatv nyei luoqc ziepc norm laangz. Naaiv deix yietc zungv zoux Gi^le^aatc nyei die, Maaki nyei zeiv-fun.
Hetv^lon yiem Kaalepv E^faa^laa^taa guei seix liuz, nqa'haav Hetv^lon nyei auv, Aa^mbi^yaa, yungz duqv dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Atc^hu. Atc^hu zoux Te^ko^aa nyei die.
Hetv^lon nyei dorn-hlo, Ye^laa^me^en, maaih biaa dauh dorn. Dorn-hlo nyei mbuox heuc Laam. Aengx maaih Mbunaa, Olen, Osem, caux Aa^hi^yaa.
Ye^laa^me^en aengx maaih dauh auv, mbuox heuc Aa^taa^laa. Aa^taa^laa zoux Onam nyei maa.
Ye^laa^me^en nyei dorn-hlo, Laam nyei dorn maaih Maa^atc, Yaamin caux Eke.
Onam nyei dorn maaih Sammai caux Yaa^ndaa. Sammai nyei dorn maaih Naa^ndapc caux Aa^mbi^qu.
Aa^mbi^qu nyei auv nyei mbuox heuc Aa^mbi^haa^in. Aa^mbi^haa^in yungz duqv i dauh dorn, Akc^mbaan caux Molitv bun ninh.
Naa^ndapc nyei dorn maaih Se^le^letv caux Apc^baa^im. Se^le^letv daic mi'aqv, yaac maiv maaih fu'jueiv.
Apc^baa^im nyei dorn maaih Itc^i. Itc^i nyei dorn maaih Sesan. Sesan nyei dorn maaih Akc^lai.
Sammai nyei youz, Yaa^ndaa, maaih Ye^te caux Yo^naa^taan. Ye^te daic mi'aqv, yaac maiv maaih fu'jueiv.
Yo^naa^taan nyei dorn maaih Peletv caux Saax^saa. Naaiv se Ye^laa^me^en nyei zeiv-fun.
Sesan maiv maaih dorn, kungx maaih sieqv hnangv. Sesan maaih dauh bou, se I^yipv Mienh, mbuox heuc Yaa^laa^haa.
Sesan zorqv ninh nyei sieqv zoux Yaa^laa^haa nyei auv. Wuov dauh sieqv yungz dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Atc^tai, bun ninh.
Atc^tai zoux Naatan nyei die. Naatan zoux Saax^mbaatc nyei die.
Saax^mbaatc zoux Efaan nyei die, Efaan zoux O^mbetc nyei die,
O^mbetc zoux Ye^hu nyei die, Ye^hu zoux Aa^saa^li^yaa nyei die,
Aa^saa^li^yaa zoux He^letv^te nyei die, He^letv^te zoux E^le^aa^saax nyei die,
E^le^aa^saax zoux Si^saa^mai nyei die, Si^saa^mai zoux Sanlum nyei die,
Sanlum zoux Ye^kaa^mi^yaa nyei die, Ye^kaa^mi^yaa zoux E^li^saa^maa nyei die.
Kaalepv zoux Ye^laa^me^en nyei youz. Kaalepv nyei dorn-hlo, Mesaa, zoux Sipc^aa nyei die. Maa^le^saa zoux He^mbo^lon nyei die.
He^mbo^lon nyei dorn maaih Kolaa, Tapv^bu^waa, Lekem, Semaa.
Semaa zoux Laa^ham nyei die. Laa^ham zoux Yo^laa^ke^am nyei die. Lekem zoux Sammai nyei die.
Sammai nyei dorn se Maa^on. Maa^on nyei die heuc Mbetc Sux^aa.
Kaalepv nyei jaav-zeih auv, E^faa, zoux Haalaan, Mosaa, caux Kaasetv nyei maa. Haalaan zoux Kaasetv nyei die.
Yaa^ndai nyei dorn maaih Lekem, Yotaam, Gesaan, Beletc, E^faa caux Saa^apc.
Kaalepv nyei jaav-zeih auv, Maa^aa^kaa, zoux Se^mbe caux Ti^laa^haa^naa nyei maa.
Maa^aa^kaa yaac yungz Matv^man^naa nyei die, Saa^apc, yaac yungz Makv^mbe^naa caux Gi^mbe^aa nyei die, Qewaa. Kaalepv nyei sieqv se Akc^saax.
Naaiv se Kaalepv nyei zeiv-fun. E^faa^laa^taa nyei dorn-hlo se Hu^aa nyei dorn, So^mbaan. So^mbaan zoux Ki^li^yaatv Ye^aa^lim nyei die.
Aengx maaih Sanx^maa zoux Mbetc^le^hem, Haaletv caux Mbetc Gaa^nde nyei die.
Ki^li^yaatv Ye^aa^lim nyei die, So^mbaan, nyei zeiv-fun maaih Haa^lo^e caux ndaamv-fingx Maa^naa^haatv Mienh,
yaac maaih Ki^li^yaatv Ye^aa^lim nyei bungh buonc, Itc^lai Mienh, Butai Mienh, Sumatv Mienh, Mitv^laa Mienh, Solaa Mienh caux Etc^taa^on Mienh.
Sanx^maa nyei zeiv-fun maaih Mbetc^le^hem caux Ne^to^faa Mienh, Atc^lotv Mbetc Yo^aapc, ndaamv-fingx Maa^naa^haatv Mienh, Solaa Mienh.
Yaac maaih yiem Yaa^mbetc nyei sou-biuv nyei bungh buonc, Ti^laa^tai Mienh, Si^me^atc Mienh caux Sukaa Mienh. Naaiv se Lekaapv nyei die, Hammatv bun njiec nyei zeiv-fun, Kenatv Mienh.

Naaiv se Ndaawitv yiem He^mbo^lon wuov zanc duqv daaih nyei dorn. Dorn-hlo nyei mbuox heuc Amnon. Se Yitv^le^en Mienh, Aa^hi^no^am, yungz nyei dorn. Da'nyeic dauh dorn, Ndaa^ni^en, se Kaanmen Mienh, Aa^mbi^gaa^yin, yungz nyei dorn.
Da'faam dauh dorn, Apc^saa^lom, se Gesu nyei hungh, Tanmai, nyei sieqv, Maa^aa^kaa, yungz nyei dorn. Da'feix dauh dorn, Aa^ndo^ni^yaa, se Hakv^gitc yungz nyei dorn.
Da'hmz dauh dorn, Se^faa^ti^yaa, se Aa^mbi^tan yungz nyei dorn. Da'luoqc dauh dorn, Itc^le^am, se Ndaawitv nyei auv, Ekc^laa, yungz nyei dorn.
Naaiv deix juqv dauh dorn se Ndaawitv yiem He^mbo^lon duqv daaih nyei dorn. Yiem naaic ninh gunv siec hnyangx caux juqv hlaax nyieqc. Ndaawitv yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem gunv faah ziepc faam hnyangx
yaac yiem naaic duqv naaiv deix fu'jueiv. Maaih Si^me^aa, So^mbapc, Naatan, caux Saa^lo^morn. Naaiv deix biei dauh se Am^mi^en Mienh, Mbatc^qe^mbaa, yungz nyei dorn.
Aengx maaih Ipc^haa, E^li^su^waa, En^be^letv,
Nogaa, Nefekv, Yaafie,
E^li^saa^maa, E^li^yaa^ndaa caux E^li^fe^letv. Yietc zungv maaih nduoh dauh.
Naaiv deix yietc zungv se Ndaawitv nyei dorn. Cuotv liuz naaiv aengx maaih ninh nyei jaav-zeih auv nyei dorn mbuo. Taamaa zoux ninh mbuo nyei muoc.
Saa^lo^morn nyei dorn se Le^hox^mbo^am, Le^hox^mbo^am nyei dorn se Aa^mbi^yaa, Aa^mbi^yaa nyei dorn se Aasaax, Aasaax nyei dorn se Ye^ho^saa^fatv,
Ye^ho^saa^fatv nyei dorn se Ye^ho^lam, Ye^ho^lam nyei dorn se Aa^hatc^yaa, Aa^hatc^yaa nyei dorn se Yo^aatc,
Yo^aatc nyei dorn se Aa^maa^si^yaa, Aa^maa^si^yaa nyei dorn se Aa^saa^li^yaa, Aa^saa^li^yaa nyei dorn se Yotaam,
Yotaam nyei dorn se Aa^hatc, Aa^hatc nyei dorn se He^se^ki^yaa, He^se^ki^yaa nyei dorn se Maa^natv^se,
Maa^natv^se nyei dorn se Ammon, Ammon nyei dorn se Yo^si^yaa.
Yo^si^yaa nyei dorn maaih Yo^haa^nan zoux dorn-hlo, Ye^ho^yaa^kim zoux da'nyeic dauh, Se^nde^ki^yaa zoux da'faam dauh, Sanlum zoux da'feix dauh.
Ye^ho^yaa^kim nyei dorn maaih Ye^ho^yaa^kin, Ye^ho^yaa^kin nyei dorn maaih Se^nde^ki^yaa.
Naaiv se zuqc caangv mingh Mbaa^mbi^lon wuov dauh Ye^ho^yaa^kin nyei zeiv-fun. Maaih ninh nyei dorn, Se^an^ti^en,
aengx maaih Man^ki^laam, Be^ndaa^yaa, Se^naatv^saa, Ye^kaa^mi^yaa, Ho^saa^maa caux Ne^ndaa^mbi^yaa.
Be^ndaa^yaa nyei dorn maaih Se^lupv^mbaa^mben caux Si^me^i. Se^lupv^mbaa^mben nyei dorn maaih Me^sun^laam caux Haa^nan^yaa. Ninh mbuo nyei muoc heuc Se^lo^mitv.
Aengx maaih biaa dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Haa^su^mbaa, O^hen, Mbe^le^ki^yaa, Haa^saax^ndi^yaa caux Yusapv Hesetc.

Haa^nan^yaa nyei dorn maaih Be^laa^ti^yaa caux Ye^saa^yaa. Yaac maaih Ye^saa^yaa nyei dorn, Le^fai^yaa, caux Le^fai^yaa nyei dorn, Aannan, caux Aannan nyei dorn, O^mbaa^ndi, caux O^mbaa^ndi nyei dorn, Se^kaa^ni^yaa, caux Se^kaa^ni^yaa nyei dorn.
Se^kaa^ni^yaa maaih nduqc dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Se^mai^aa. Se^mai^aa nyei dorn, maaih Hatv^tatv, I^gaan, Mbaa^li^yaa, Ne^aa^li^yaa, caux Saafatv. Yietc zungv maaih juqv dauh.
Ne^aa^li^yaa maaih buo dauh dorn. Maaih E^li^o^nai, He^se^ki^yaa caux Atc^li^kam.
E^li^o^nai maaih siec dauh dorn. Maaih Ho^ndaa^wi^yaa, E^li^yaa^sipv, Be^lai^yaa, Akc^kupc, Yo^haa^nan, Nde^lai^yaa caux Aa^naa^ni.
Yu^ndaa nyei dorn maaih Beletv, Hetv^lon, Kaanmi, Hu^aa caux So^mbaan.
So^mbaan nyei dorn, Le^aa^yaa, zoux Yaa^haatc nyei die, Yaa^haatc zoux Aa^hu^mai caux Laa^haatv nyei die. Naaiv se Solaa Mienh nyei bungh buonc.
Edaam nyei dorn maaih Yitv^le^en, Itc^maa caux Itc^mbaatc. Ninh mbuo nyei muoc heuc Hatv^se^len^po^ni.
Be^nu^en zoux Ge^ndo nyei die, E^se zoux Husaa nyei die. Naaiv se Mbetc^le^hem nyei die, E^faa^taa nyei dorn-hlo, Huwaa, nyei dorn.
Te^ko^aa nyei die, Atc^hu, maaih i dauh auv, mbuox heuc Helaa caux Naa^aa^laa.
Naa^aa^laa yungz Aa^hutc^saam, Hefe, Te^me^ni caux Haa^aa^hatc^taa^li bun ninh. Naaiv se Naa^aa^laa nyei zeiv-fun.
Helaa nyei dorn maaih Ce^e^letv, Itc^haa, Etc^naan
caux Kotc. Kotc zoux Aanupv caux So^mbe^mbaa nyei die yaac zoux Haalum nyei dorn, Aa^haanx^hen, nyei bungh buonc nyei ong-taaix.
Yaa^mbetc yiem zuangx muoz-doic duqv mienh gauh taaih jiex. Ninh nyei maa tengx ninh cuotv mbuox heuc Yaa^mbetc, weic zuqc ninh gorngv, “Yungz nyei ziangh hoc yie mun kouv haic.”

Yaa^mbetc heuc jienv tov I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh, “Tov ceix fuqv bun yie, bun yie nyei gapv-jaaix jangv jienv cuotv. Tov bun meih nyei buoz caux yie yiem, beu jienv yie biaux ndutv yietc zungv naanc zingh ziouc maiv zuqc diev mun.” Tin-Hungh yaac ei jienv ninh tov nyei waac zoux.
Su^haa nyei gorx, Kaalepv, zoux Me^hi nyei die. Me^hi zoux Etc^ton nyei die.
Etc^ton zoux Mbetc Laafaa, Baa^se^aa caux Te^hinx^naa nyei die. Te^hinx^naa zoux Naa^haatc nyei die. Naaiv deix mienh se Lekaa Mungv nyei mienh.
Kenatv nyei dorn maaih Otc^ni^en caux Se^lai^aa. Otc^ni^en nyei dorn maaih Haataatv caux Me^o^no^tai.
Me^o^no^tai zoux O^faa^laa nyei die. Se^lai^aa zoux Yo^aapc nyei die, Yo^aapc zoux Ge Haa^laa^sim nyei die. Hnangv naaiv heuc weic zuqc maaih buoz-dauh nyei zaangc mienh yiem wuov norm dorngx.
Ye^fun^ne nyei dorn, Kaalepv, nyei dorn maaih I^lu, Elaa caux Naa^am. Elaa nyei dorn maaih Kenatv.
Ye^haan^le^len nyei dorn maaih Sipc^aa, Sifaa, Ti^li^yaa caux Aa^saax^len.
Etc^laa nyei dorn maaih Ye^te, Meletv, Efe, caux Yaalon. Meletv maaih dauh auv yungz Miliem, Sammai caux Etc^te^mo^aa nyei die, Itc^mbaa.

Naaiv se Meletv longc Faalo Hungh nyei sieqv, Mbi^ti^yaa, duqv daaih nyei fu'jueiv. Meletv nyei Yu^ndaa Mienh auv yungz Ge^ndo nyei die, Yeletv, caux Soko nyei die, He^mbe, caux Saax^no^aa nyei die, Ye^ku^ti^en.
Ho^ndi^yaa nyei auv, Naa^ham nyei muoc nyei dorn maaih Gelem Mienh nyei ong-taaix, Ke^i^laa, caux Maa^aa^katv Mienh nyei ong-taaix, Etc^te^mo^aa.
Siqv^mon nyei dorn maaih Amnon, Linnaa, Mben Haanan caux Tilon. Itc^i nyei dorn maaih So^hetc caux Mben So^hetv.
Yu^ndaa nyei dorn se Qelaa. Qelaa nyei dorn maaih Lekaa nyei die, E^aa caux Maa^le^saa nyei die, Laa^aa^ndaa caux yietc zungv yiem Mbetc Atc^mbe^aa zoux la'maah ndie nyei mienh nyei bungh buonc.
Ko^se^mbaa nyei mienh, Yokim, caux Yo^aatc caux Saax^laapv, dongh yiem Mo^apc Mienh caux Mbetc^le^hem gunv wuov dauh. (Naaiv se yiem loz-hnoi fiev nyei sou-daan zorqv cuotv daaih.)
Naaiv deix mienh yiem Ne^taa^im caux Ge^nde^laa zoux nanv nie zaangc. Ninh mbuo yiem wuov yaac tengx hungh diex zoux gong.
Si^me^on nyei dorn maaih Ne^mu^en, Yaamin, Yaalipv, Zelaa caux Saa^un.
Saa^un nyei dorn se Sanlum, Sanlum nyei dorn, Mipv^samx, Mipv^samx nyei dorn, Mitv^maa.
Mitv^maa nyei dorn se Ham^mu^en, Ham^mu^en nyei dorn, Sakc^ge, Sakc^ge nyei dorn, Si^me^i.
Si^me^i maaih ziepc luoqc dauh dorn, juqv dauh sieqv, mv baac ninh nyei gorx, ninh nyei youz maiv maaih fu'jueiv camv. Si^me^on Fingx ziouc maiv ndongc Yu^ndaa Fingx hiaangx.
Si^me^on Mienh yiem Mbe^e^qe^mbaa, Mo^laa^ndaa, Haasaan Su^aan,
Mbin^haa, Esem, Tolatv,
Mbe^tu^en, Homaa, Sikc^laakv
Mbetc Maan^kaa^mbotc, Haasaan Sux^simx, Mbetc Mbili caux Saa^aa^laa^im. Naaiv benx ninh mbuo nyei zingh taux Ndaawitv zoux hungh nyei ziangh hoc.
Weih gormx nyei laangz maaih Edaam, Aayin, Limmon, Token caux Aaqan. Se biaa norm zingh.
Yaac maaih weih naaiv deix norm-norm zingh nyei fiuv-laangz mingh taux Mbaa^aa^latv. Naaiv se ninh mbuo liepc nguaaz-gorn nyei dorngx. Ninh mbuo yaac fiev douh zong daan.
Maaih Me^so^mbapc, Yamlekv, Aa^maa^si^yaa nyei dorn, Yosaa,
Yo^en caux Ye^hu. Ye^hu se Yo^si^mbi^yaa nyei dorn, Yo^si^mbi^yaa se Aa^si^en nyei dorn, Aa^si^en se Se^lai^aa nyei dorn.
Yaac maaih E^li^o^nai, Yaa^aa^ko^mbaa, Ye^so^haa^yaa, Aa^saax^yaa, Aa^ndi^en, Ye^si^mi^en, Mbe^nai^yaa,
caux Zizaa. Zizaa se Sifi nyei dorn, Sifi se Anlon nyei dorn, Anlon se Ye^ndaa^yaa nyei dorn, Ye^ndaa^yaa se Simli nyei dorn, Simli se Se^mai^aa nyei dorn.
Fiev gu'nguaaic naaiv deix yietc zungv mbuox se ziux bungh buonc nyei bieiv zeiv. Ninh mbuo nyei douh zong hiaangx jienv faaux camv.
Ninh mbuo cuotv mingh taux Ge^ndo ga'hlen, wuov norm horngz nyei dong bung maengx, lorz miev-ciangv yungz ninh mbuo nyei ngongh guanh yungh guanh.
Ninh mbuo lorz duqv miev-ciangv yaauc nyei, jangv nyei, baengh orn sekv nzieqc nyei. Zinh ndaangc maaih deix Haam Mienh yiem wuov deix dorngx.

Fiev jienv naaiv deix mienh nyei mbuox doix zuqc He^se^ki^yaa zoux Yu^ndaa nyei hungh nyei ziangh hoc. Ninh mbuo mborqv yiem ndopv-liuh nyei Haam Mienh caux yiem wuov nyei Me^u^nim Mienh, zorqv ninh mbuo mietc nzengc taux ih jaax hnoi. Ninh mbuo ziouc yiem njiec naaiv norm dorngx weic zuqc maaih miev-ciangv longx haic bungx ninh mbuo nyei yungh guanh.
Naaiv deix Si^me^on Mienh maaih hmz baeqv dauh faaux Se^i mbong-aiv dorngx. Dorh nyei mienh se Itc^i nyei dorn, Be^laa^ti^yaa, Ne^aa^li^yaa, Le^fai^yaa caux Utc^si^en.
Ninh mbuo daix nzengc biaux cuotv zengc njiec nyei Aa^maa^lekv Mienh yaac yiem wuov taux ih jaax hnoi.

Naaiv se I^saa^laa^en nyei dorn-hlo, Lu^mben, nyei zeiv-fun. (Lu^mben zoux dorn-hlo mv baac laaix ninh bun ninh nyei die nyei coux maaih uix, ninh maiv duqv dorn-hlo nyei leiz. Dorn-hlo nyei leiz jiu bun I^saa^laa^en nyei dorn, Yosepv, nyei dorn mi'aqv. Lu^mben ziouc maiv duqv ziux dorn-hlo nyei leiz faaux mbuox yiem mienh houz daan.
Maiv gunv Yu^ndaa gauh henv jiex ninh nyei zuangx muoz-doic, yiem ninh yaac cuotv dauh zoux hlo nyei mienh, mv baac dorn-hlo nyei leiz benx Yosepv nyei mi'aqv.)
I^saa^laa^en nyei dorn-hlo, Lu^mben, nyei dorn maaih Haanokv, Banlu, Hetv^lon caux Kaanmi.
Yo^en nyei zeiv-fun maaih ninh nyei dorn, Se^mai^aa, Se^mai^aa nyei dorn, Gokc, Gokc nyei dorn, Si^me^i,
Si^me^i nyei dorn, Mikaa, Mikaa nyei dorn, Le^aa^yaa, Le^aa^yaa nyei dorn, Mbaa^an,
caux Mbaa^an nyei dorn, Mbe^e^laa, dongh Atc^si^lie nyei hungh, Tikv^latv Bi^le^se, caangv mingh wuov dauh. Mbe^e^laa benx Lu^mben Fingx nyei yietc dauh bieiv zeiv.
Lu^mben nyei cien-ceqv ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc faaux mbuox. Yiem mienh houz daan maaih zoux bieiv wuov dauh Ye^i^en, Se^kaa^li^yaa,
caux Aasaatv nyei dorn, Mbelaa. Aasaatv se Semaa nyei dorn, Semaa se Yo^en nyei dorn. Yo^en yiem nyei deic-bung se yiem Aa^lo^e Zingh cuotv mingh taux Ne^mbo caux Mbaa^an Me^on.
Ninh mbuo yiem dong bung maengx mingh taux naaiv bung Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih nyei deic-bung-huaang weic zuqc ninh mbuo yiem Gi^le^aatc wuov zanc ninh mbuo nyei saeng-kuv hiaangx duqv camv.

Yiem Saulo zoux hungh nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo mingh caux Haagaa Mienh mborqv jaax ziouc mborqv hingh Haagaa Mienh. Ninh mbuo ziouc yiem jienv Haagaa Mienh nyei ndopv-liuh buangv Gi^le^aatc nyei dong bung maengx.
Gaatc nyei zeiv-fun yiem nitv Lu^mben Fingx, se yiem Mbaasaan Deic mingh taux Saax^le^kaa.
Yiem Mbaasaan, Yo^en zoux hlo jiex, Saafaam zoux da'nyeic, yaac maaih Yaanai caux Saafatv.
Ninh mbuo nyei cien-ceqv ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc maaih Mi^kaa^en, Me^sun^laam, Qe^mbaa, Yolai, Yaakaan, Zi^aa, E^mbe. Yietc zungv maaih siec dauh.

Naaiv se Huli nyei dorn, Aa^mbi^haa^in, nyei dorn mbuo. Huli se Yaa^lo^aa nyei dorn, Yaa^lo^aa se Gi^le^aatc nyei dorn, Gi^le^aatc se Mi^kaa^en nyei dorn, Mi^kaa^en se Ye^si^sai nyei dorn, Ye^si^sai se Yaa^ndo nyei dorn, Yaa^ndo se Mbutc nyei dorn.
Guni nyei fun, Apc^ndi^en nyei dorn, Aa^hi, se zoux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.
Gaatc Mienh yiem Gi^le^aatc caux Mbaasaan caux weih gormx nyei fiuv-laangz, liemh gormx Saalon nyei miev-ciangv mingh taux jomc naaiv deix miev-ciangv.
Naaiv deix mienh nyei mbuox yietc zungv fiev jienv yiem douh zong daan doix Yotaam zoux Yu^ndaa nyei hungh caux Ye^lo^mbo^am zoux I^saa^laa^en nyei hungh nyei ziangh hoc.

Lu^mben Mienh, Gaatc Mienh caux Maa^natv^se ndaamv-fingx mienh maaih biei waanc biei cin cietv baeqv luoqc ziepc dauh maaih banh zeic zoux duqv baeng nyei mienh. Ninh mbuo hoqc linc longc torngv-baaih, nzuqc ndaauv caux juang-zinx mborqv jaax.
Ninh mbuo cuotv mingh caux Haagaa Mienh, Yetu Mienh, Naafitv Mienh caux No^ndapc Mienh mborqv jaax.

Tin-Hungh tengx ninh mbuo, aengx zorqv Haagaa Mienh caux gan Haagaa Mienh zoux guanh wuov deix jiu bun yiem ninh mbuo nyei buoz-ndiev. Tin-Hungh tengx weic zuqc ninh mbuo mborqv jaax nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo heuc jienv tov ninh tengx. Ninh dau ninh mbuo daux gaux nyei waac weic zuqc ninh mbuo kaux ninh.
Ninh mbuo ziouc caangv Haagaa Mienh nyei saeng-kuv. Maaih lorh torh biaa waanc dauh, ba'gi yungh i waanc biaa cin dauh, lorh i cin dauh. Ninh mbuo yaac zorqv duqv ziepc waanc dauh mienh.
Win-wangv camv yaac zuqc daix weic zuqc naaiv nzunc mborqv nyei jaax se Tin-Hungh nyei za'eix. Ninh mbuo ziouc yiem jienv naaiv deix dorngx taux zuqc guaatv mingh nyei ziangh hoc.
Maa^natv^se nyei ndaamv-fingx mienh yiem wuov norm deic-bung. Ninh mbuo mienh camv nyei yiem Mbaasaan mingh taux Mbaa^an Hemon, se taux Seni caux Hemon Mbong.

Naaiv se ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv. Maaih Efe, Itc^i, E^li^en, Atc^li^en, Ye^le^mi, Ho^ndaa^wi^yaa caux Yaa^ndi^en. Ninh mbuo zoux henv haic nyei baeng, maaih mengh dauh nyei mienh, yaac zoux ziux bungh buonc nyei bieiv zeiv.

Mv baac ninh mbuo baamz zuiz dorngc ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix nyei Tin-Hungh. Ninh mbuo maaih hieh hnyouv ziouc mingh zaangc yiem wuov norm deic-bung nyei ziex fingx mienh nyei zienh, dongh Tin-Hungh yiem ninh mbuo nyei wuov ndaangc maengx mietc nyei mienh.

Weic naaiv I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh dongz zuqc Atc^si^lie nyei hungh, Bunle, se Atc^si^lie nyei hungh, Tikv^latv Bi^le^se, mingh bieqc ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung. Ninh ziouc zorqv Lu^mben, Gaatc caux Maa^natv^se nyei ndaamv-fingx mienh guaatv ninh mbuo mingh taux Haa^laa^aa, Haa^mbo, Haalaa, caux Gosaan Ndaaih hlen. Ninh mbuo corc yiem naaic taux ih jaax hnoi.
Lewi nyei dorn maaih Geson, Ko^haatv caux Me^laa^li.
Ko^haatv nyei dorn maaih Amlaam, Itc^haa, He^mbo^lon caux Utc^si^en.
Amlaam nyei naamh nyouz maaih Aalon, Mose caux Miliem. Aalon nyei dorn maaih Naa^ndapc, Aa^mbi^hu, E^le^aa^saa caux I^taa^maa.
E^le^aa^saa zoux Fi^ne^hatc nyei die, Fi^ne^hatc zoux Aa^mbi^qu^waa nyei die,
Aa^mbi^qu^waa zoux Mbukc^ki nyei die, Mbukc^ki zoux Utc^si nyei die,
Utc^si zoux Se^laa^hi^yaa nyei die, Se^laa^hi^yaa zoux Me^laa^yotv nyei die,
Me^laa^yotv zoux Aa^maa^li^yaa nyei die, Aa^maa^li^yaa zoux Aa^hi^tupv nyei die,
Aa^hi^tupv zoux Saax^ndokc nyei die, Saax^ndokc zoux Aa^hi^maa^atc nyei die,
Aa^hi^maa^atc zoux Aa^saa^li^yaa nyei die, Aa^saa^li^yaa zoux Yo^haa^nan nyei die.
Yo^haa^nan zoux Aa^saa^li^yaa nyei die. Se dongh naaiv dauh Aa^saa^li^yaa yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem, se yiem dongh Saa^lo^morn ceix wuov norm zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv zoux sai mienh.
Aa^saa^li^yaa zoux Aa^maa^li^yaa nyei die, Aa^maa^li^yaa zoux Aa^hi^tupv nyei die,
Aa^hi^tupv zoux Saax^ndokc nyei die, Saax^ndokc zoux Sanlum nyei die,
Sanlum zoux Hin^ki^yaa nyei die, Hin^ki^yaa zoux Aa^saa^li^yaa nyei die,
Aa^saa^li^yaa zoux Se^lai^aa nyei die, Se^lai^aa zoux Ye^ho^saa^ndakc nyei die.
Ziouv bun Ne^mbu^katv^netv^saa Hungh guaatv Yu^ndaa caux Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei baeqc fingx mingh wuov zanc, Ye^ho^saa^ndakc yaac zuqc guaatv mingh.
Lewi nyei dorn maaih Geson, Ko^haatv caux Me^laa^li.
Naaiv se Geson nyei dorn nyei mbuox. Maaih Lipv^ni caux Si^me^i.
Ko^haatv nyei dorn maaih. Amlaam, Itc^haa, He^mbo^lon caux Utc^si^en.
Me^laa^li nyei dorn maaih Maali caux Musi. Naaiv se Lewi Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei douh zong nyei bungh buonc.
Naaiv se Geson nyei zeiv-fun. Geson nyei dorn se Lipv^ni, Lipv^ni nyei dorn se Yaa^haatc, Yaa^haatc nyei dorn se Simx^maa,
Simx^maa nyei dorn se Yo^aa, Yo^aa nyei dorn se Itc^ndo, Itc^ndo nyei dorn se Zelaa, Zelaa nyei dorn se Ye^aa^te^lai.
Ko^haatv nyei zeiv-fun maaih ninh nyei dorn, Am^mi^naa^ndapc, Am^mi^naa^ndapc nyei dorn, Kolaa, Kolaa nyei dorn, Atc^si,
Atc^si nyei dorn, En^kaa^naa, En^kaa^naa nyei dorn, E^mbi^yaa^saapc, E^mbi^yaa^saapc nyei dorn, Atc^si,
Atc^si nyei dorn, Taa^hatc, Taa^hatc nyei dorn, U^li^en, U^li^en nyei dorn, Utc^si^yaa, Utc^si^yaa nyei dorn, Saa^un.
En^kaa^naa nyei zeiv-fun maaih ninh nyei dorn, Aa^maa^saix caux Aa^hi^motv,
Aa^hi^motv nyei dorn, En^kaa^naa, En^kaa^naa nyei dorn, Sofai, Sofai nyei dorn, Naa^hatc,
Naa^hatc nyei dorn, E^li^apc, E^li^apc nyei dorn, Ye^lo^ham, Ye^lo^ham nyei dorn, En^kaa^naa, En^kaa^naa nyei dorn, Saa^mu^en.
Saa^mu^en nyei dorn maaih dorn-hlo heuc Yo^en. Dorn-faix heuc Aa^mbi^yaa.
Me^laa^li nyei zeiv-fun maaih Maali, Maali nyei dorn, Lipv^ni, Lipv^ni nyei dorn, Si^me^i, Si^me^i nyei dorn, Utc^saa,
Utc^saa nyei dorn, Si^me^aa, Si^me^aa nyei dorn, Hakv^gi^yaa, Hakv^gi^yaa nyei dorn, Aa^saax^yaa.
Yiem suiv Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nzuonx daaih an jienv zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv liuz, Ndaawitv orn naaiv deix mienh weic gunv baaux nzung nyei jauv.
Ninh mbuo yiem Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh nza'hmien maengx baaux nzung fu-sux taux Saa^lo^morn yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem ceix zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv. Ninh mbuo ei jienv leiz luonh baan fu-sux.
Naaiv se fu-sux nyei mienh caux ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun. Yiem Ko^haatv Mienh daaih maaih Hemaan, zoux baaux nzung nyei bieiv. Hemaan, se Yo^en nyei dorn, Yo^en se Saa^mu^en nyei dorn,
Saa^mu^en se En^kaa^naa nyei dorn, En^kaa^naa se Ye^lo^ham nyei dorn, Ye^lo^ham se E^li^en nyei dorn, E^li^en se To^aa nyei dorn,
To^aa se Supc nyei dorn, Supc se En^kaa^naa nyei dorn, En^kaa^naa se Maa^haatv nyei dorn, Maa^haatv se Aa^maa^saix nyei dorn,
Aa^maa^saix se En^kaa^naa nyei dorn, En^kaa^naa se Yo^en nyei dorn, Yo^en se Aa^saa^li^yaa nyei dorn, Aa^saa^li^yaa se Se^fan^yaa nyei dorn,
Se^fan^yaa se Taa^hatc nyei dorn, Taa^hatc se Atc^si nyei dorn, Atc^si se E^mbi^yaa^saapc nyei dorn, E^mbi^yaa^saapc se Kolaa nyei dorn,
Kolaa se Itc^haa nyei dorn, Itc^haa se Ko^haatv nyei dorn, Ko^haatv se Lewi nyei dorn, Lewi se I^saa^laa^en nyei dorn.
Hemaan nyei bungh dauh youz, Aasaapc, yiem Hemaan nyei mbiaauc bung juangc gong. Aasaapc se Mbe^le^ki^yaa nyei dorn, Mbe^le^ki^yaa se Si^me^aa nyei dorn,
Si^me^aa se Mi^kaa^en nyei dorn, Mi^kaa^en se Mbaa^aa^se^yaa nyei dorn, Mbaa^aa^se^yaa se Man^ki^yaa nyei dorn,
Man^ki^yaa se Etc^ni nyei dorn, Etc^ni se Zelaa nyei dorn, Zelaa se Aa^ndaa^yaa nyei dorn,
Aa^ndaa^yaa se Etaan nyei dorn, Etaan se Simx^maa nyei dorn, Simx^maa se Si^me^i nyei dorn,
Si^me^i se Yaa^haatc nyei dorn, Yaa^haatc se Geson nyei dorn, Geson se Lewi nyei dorn.
Ninh nyei bungh dauh youz, Me^laa^li Mienh, yiem Hemaan nyei zaaix maengx juangc gong. Etaan se Kisi nyei dorn, Kisi se Apc^ndi nyei dorn, Apc^ndi se Manlukv nyei dorn,
Manlukv se Haa^saa^bi^yaa nyei dorn, Haa^saa^bi^yaa se Aa^maa^si^yaa nyei dorn, Aa^maa^si^yaa se Hin^ki^yaa nyei dorn,
Hin^ki^yaa se Amsi nyei dorn, Amsi se Mbaani nyei dorn, Mbaani se Qeme nyei dorn,
Qeme se Maali nyei dorn, Maali se Musi nyei dorn, Musi se Me^laa^li nyei dorn, Me^laa^li se Lewi nyei dorn.
Ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz, Lewi Mienh, yaac duqv mienh paaiv fu-sux zoux zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv nyei yietc zungv gong.

Mv baac Aalon caux ninh nyei zeiv-fun zorqv ga'naaiv mingh fongc horc an buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv nyei ziec-dorngh yaac an buov hung dieh. Ninh mbuo liuc leiz yiem Gauh Cing-Nzengc Jiex Wuov Qongx nyei yietc zungv gong tengx I^saa^laa^en Mienh fiqv zuiz, ziux Tin-Hungh nyei bou, Mose, paaiv nyei waac.
Naaiv se Aalon nyei zeiv-fun. Aalon nyei dorn se E^le^aa^saa, E^le^aa^saa nyei dorn se Fi^ne^hatc, Fi^ne^hatc nyei dorn se Aa^mbi^qu^waa,
Aa^mbi^qu^waa nyei dorn se Mbukc^ki, Mbukc^ki nyei dorn se Utc^si, Utc^si nyei dorn se Se^laa^hi^yaa,
Se^laa^hi^yaa nyei dorn se Me^laa^yotv, Me^laa^yotv nyei dorn se Aa^maa^li^yaa, Aa^maa^li^yaa nyei dorn se Aa^hi^tupv,
Aa^hi^tupv nyei dorn se Saax^ndokc, Saax^ndokc nyei dorn se Aa^hi^maa^atc,

Naaiv se ninh mbuo yiem nyei dorngx ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc paaiv bun ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun. (Se paaiv bun Aalon nyei zeiv-fun, Ko^haatv Mienh, nyei buonc ndau, weic zuqc dingc maengc mangc ndortv zuqc ninh mbuo duqv ndaangc jiex.)
Ninh mbuo duqv yiem Yu^ndaa Deic nyei He^mbo^lon Zingh caux weih gormx nyei miev-ciangv.
Mv baac weih gormx wuov norm zingh nyei lingh deic caux fiuv-laangz zorqv bun Ye^fun^ne nyei dorn, Kaalepv.
Aalon nyei zeiv-fun duqv wuov norm siex maengc zingh, He^mbo^lon, aengx bun Lipv^naa, Yaatv^ti, Etc^te^mo^aa,
Hilen, Nde^mbi,
Aaqan, Yutv^taa, caux Mbetc Semetv caux naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.

Yiem Mben^yaa^min Mienh nyei buonc ndau ninh mbuo duqv Gi^mbe^on, Ge^mbaa, Aa^le^metv caux Aa^naa^totv caux naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv. Naaiv se ninh mbuo bun Ko^haatv Mienh nyei bungh buonc duqv daaih nyei zingh. Yietc zungv maaih ziepc faam norm zingh.
Zengc njiec nyei Ko^haatv Mienh dingc maengc mangc, duqv yiem Maa^natv^se ndaamv-fingx mienh nyei buonc ndau nyei ziepc norm zingh.
Geson Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc duqv yiem Itc^saax^kaa, Aa^se, Napv^taa^li caux Maa^natv^se ndaamv-fingx mienh nyei Mbaasaan Deic nyei ziepc faam norm zingh.
Me^laa^li nyei zeiv-fun ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc duqv yiem Lu^mben, Gaatc caux Se^mbu^lun nyei deic nyei ziepc nyeic norm zingh.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziouc zorqv naaiv deix zingh caux naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv bun Lewi Mienh.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh dingc maengc mangc paaiv bun ninh mbuo duqv yiem Yu^ndaa Fingx, Si^me^on Fingx caux Mben^yaa^min Fingx nyei buonc ndau, dongh gorngv jiex wuov deix zingh nyei mbuox.
Maaih deix Ko^haatv Mienh nyei bungh buonc duqv deix yiem E^faa^im Fingx nyei zingh weic benx ninh mbuo nyei buonc ndau.
Yiem E^faa^im nyei mbong-aiv dorngx ninh mbuo duqv norm siex maengc zingh, mbuox heuc Sekem, yaac duqv Gese,
Yokv^me^am, Mbetc Holon,
Ai^yaa^lon, Gatc Limmon caux jienv naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh zorqv Aa^ne caux Mbi^le^am caux jienv naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv, jiu bun zengc njiec nyei Ko^haatv Mienh.
Geson Mienh duqv naaiv deix. Yiem Maa^natv^se ndaamv-fingx mienh nyei ndau ninh mbuo duqv Mbaasaan Deic nyei Golaan yaac duqv Atc^taa^lotv caux jienv naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.
Yiem Itc^saax^kaa Fingx ninh mbuo duqv Ke^ndetc, Ndaa^mbe^latv
Laamotv caux Aanem caux jienv naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.
Yiem Aa^se Fingx ninh mbuo duqv, Maasaan, Apc^ndon,
Hugorkc, Le^hopc, caux jienv naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.
Yiem Napv^taa^li Fingx ninh mbuo duqv yiem Gaa^li^li nyei Ke^ndetc, Hammon caux Ki^li^yaa^taa^im caux jienv naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.
Me^laa^li Mienh, (se zengc njiec nyei Lewi Mienh), duqv naaiv deix. Yiem Se^mbu^lun Fingx ninh mbuo duqv daaih nyei zingh maaih Lim^mo^no caux Taa^mbo caux naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.
Yiem Lu^mben Fingx, jiex wuov ngaanc ziqc Jor^ndaen Ndaaih, Ye^li^ko nyei dong bung, ninh mbuo duqv zipv yiem deic-bung-huaang nyei Mbese caux Yaasaa,
Ke^nde^motv caux Me^faa^aatc caux naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.
Yiem Gaatc Fingx, ninh mbuo duqv zipv yiem Gi^le^aatc nyei Laamotv, Maa^haa^naa^im,
Hetv^mbon caux Yaase caux naaiv deix zingh nyei miev-ciangv.
Itc^saax^kaa maaih biei dauh dorn. Maaih Tolaa, Pu^aa, Yaasupv caux Simlon.

Tolaa nyei dorn maaih Utc^si, Le^fai^yaa, Ye^li^en, Yaamai, Ipc^samx, caux Saa^mu^en. Ninh mbuo zoux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv. Yiem Ndaawitv zoux hungh nyei ziangh hoc, Tolaa nyei zeiv-fun, dongh haih zoux duqv baeng mborqv jaax nyei mienh, maaih i waanc i cin luoqc baeqv dauh nyei mbuox yiem ninh mbuo nyei douh zong daan.
Utc^si nyei dorn maaih I^saa^laa^hi^yaa. I^saa^laa^hi^yaa nyei dorn maaih Mi^kaa^en, O^mbaa^ndi, Yo^en caux Itc^si^yaa. Naaiv deix biaa dorn-diex zoux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.
Ziux ninh mbuo nyei douh zong daan ninh mbuo maaih auv, maaih fu'jueiv camv, ziouc maaih buo waanc juqv cin dauh haih zoux duqv baeng mborqv jaax nyei mienh.
Yiem Itc^saax^kaa nyei bungh buonc, ziux faaux mbuox ninh mbuo nyei douh zong daan, maaih hietc waanc siec cin dauh haih zoux duqv baeng mborqv jaax henv nyei mienh.
Mben^yaa^min maaih buo dauh dorn, Mbelaa, Mbeke caux Ye^ndi^yaa^en.

Mbelaa maaih biaa dauh dorn. Maaih Etc^mbon, Utc^si, Utc^si^en, Ye^li^motv caux I^li. Ninh mbuo zoux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv. Ninh mbuo nyei douh zong daan faaux i waanc i cin caux faah ziepc feix dauh haih zoux duqv baeng mborqv jaax nyei mienh nyei mbuox.
Mbeke nyei dorn maaih Se^mi^laa, Yo^aatc, E^li^ye^se, E^li^o^nai, Omli, Ye^le^motv, Aa^mbi^yaa, Aa^naa^totv caux Aa^le^metv. Naaiv deix yietc zungv zoux Mbeke nyei dorn.
Ziux ninh mbuo nyei douh zong daan faaux nyei mbuox maaih ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv caux i waanc nyic baeqv dauh haih zoux duqv baeng mborqv jaax nyei mienh.
Ye^ndi^yaa^en nyei dorn maaih Mbin^haan. Mbin^haan nyei dorn maaih Ye^utc, Mben^yaa^min, E^hutv, Ke^naa^aa^naa, Setaan, Taansitv, caux Aa^hi^qaa^haa.

Naaiv deix yietc zungv se Ye^ndi^yaa^en nyei zeiv-fun yaac zoux bungh buonc nyei bieiv zeiv. Maaih yietc waanc siec cin nyic baeqv dauh haih zoux duqv baeng, liuc leiz ziangx mingh mborqv jaax nyei mienh.
Supv^bim Mienh caux Hupc^bim Mienh zoux I^laqv nyei zeiv-fun. Husim Mienh zoux Aa^he nyei zeiv-fun.
Napv^taa^li nyei dorn maaih Yaa^si^en, Guni, Yese caux Sinlem. Naaiv deix dorn se Mbin^haa nyei zeiv-fun.
Maa^natv^se nyei zeiv-fun maaih Atc^li^en. Se Maa^natv^se longc ninh nyei Silie Mienh jaav-zeih auv duqv daaih nyei zeiv-fun. Ninh yaac yungz Gi^le^aatc nyei die, Maaki.
Maaki tengx Hupc^bim caux Supv^bim lorz auv. Ninh nyei muoc nyei mbuox heuc Maa^aa^kaa. Maaki nyei da'nyeic dauh dorn heuc Se^lo^fe^hatc. Se^lo^fe^hatc kungx duqv sieqv hnangv.
Maaki nyei auv, Maa^aa^kaa, yungz duqv dauh dorn aengx cuotv mbuox heuc Belaetv. Ninh nyei youz heuc Qeletv. Belaetv nyei dorn maaih Ulaam caux Laakem.
Ulaam nyei dorn maaih Mbe^ndaan. Naaiv se Gi^le^aatc nyei zeiv-fun. Gi^le^aatc se Maaki nyei dorn. Maaki se Maa^natv^se nyei dorn.
Gi^le^aatc nyei muoc, Ham^mo^le^ketv, yungz Itc^hotv, Aa^mbi^ye^se caux Maa^haa^laa.
Se^mi^ndaa nyei dorn maaih Aa^hi^yan, Sekem, Likv^hi caux Aa^ni^yam.
E^faa^im nyei zeiv-fun maaih ninh nyei dorn, Su^te^laa, Su^te^laa nyei dorn se Mbeletv, Mbeletv nyei dorn se Taa^hatc, Taa^hatc nyei dorn se E^le^aa^ndaa,

E^le^aa^ndaa nyei dorn se Taa^hatc, Taa^hatc nyei dorn se Saax^mbaatc, Saax^mbaatc nyei dorn se Su^te^laa. Cuotv liuz Su^te^laa, E^faa^im aengx maaih i dauh dorn, E^se caux E^le^atc. Naaiv deix i dauh dorn mingh nimc Gatc Mienh nyei saeng-kuv wuov zanc zuqc Gatc nyei buonv-deic mienh daix.
Ninh mbuo nyei die, E^faa^im, weic ninh mbuo nzauh nyiemv ziex hnoi. Ninh nyei cien-ceqv daaih tengx ninh jaiv nzauh.

E^faa^im aengx caux ninh nyei auv bueix. Ninh nyei auv ziouc maaih jienv sin, yungz duqv dauh dorn. E^faa^im tengx ninh nyei dorn cuotv mbuox heuc Mbe^li^yaa, weic zuqc yiem ninh nyei hmuangv doic gu'nyuoz ninh mbuo buangh zuqc sic.
Ninh nyei sieqv, mbuox heuc Qe^e^laa, ceix Wuov Ndiev Nyei caux Wuov Jiex Nyei Mbetc Holon caux jienv Utc^sen Qe^e^laa.
E^faa^im aengx maaih dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Lefaa, Lefaa nyei dorn se Lesepv, Lesepv nyei dorn se Telaa, Telaa nyei dorn se Taa^han,
Taa^han nyei dorn se Laa^ndaan, Laa^ndaan nyei dorn se Am^mi^hutv, Am^mi^hutv nyei dorn se E^li^saa^maa,
E^li^saa^maa nyei dorn se Nun, Nun nyei dorn se Yo^su^waa.

E^faa^im nyei zeiv-fun duqv nzipc nyei ndau caux fiuv-laangz, maaih liemh Mbetc^en caux weih gormx Mbetc^en nyei fiuv-laangz. Yaac maaih yiem dong bung nyei Naa^aa^lan caux Gese fai bung nyei fiuv-laangz. Yaac maaih Sekem caux Sekem nyei fiuv-laangz cuotv mingh taux Aiyaa caux Aiyaa nyei fiuv-laangz.

Yiem Maa^natv^se nyei gapv-jaaix maaih Mbetc Saan, Taa^aa^naakv, Me^gitc^ndo, Ndo^aa caux naaiv deix yietc zungv nyei fiuv-laangz. I^saa^laa^en nyei dorn, Yosepv, nyei zeiv-fun yiem naaiv deix dorngx.
Aa^se nyei dorn maaih Imnaa, Itc^waa, Itc^wi caux Mbe^li^yaa. Ninh mbuo nyei muoc heuc Se^laa^aa.
Mbe^li^yaa nyei dorn maaih He^mbe caux Mbin^saa^itc nyei die, Man^ki^en.
He^mbe nyei dorn maaih Yaa^fe^letv, So^me, Hotaam. Ninh mbuo nyei muoc heuc Qu^aa.
Yaa^fe^letv nyei dorn maaih Baasakc, Mbim^haan caux Atc^waatv. Naaiv se Yaa^fe^letv nyei dorn.
Ninh nyei youz, So^me, nyei dorn maaih Aa^hi, Logaa, Ye^hupv^mbaa caux Aalam.
Yaa^fe^letv nyei youz, Helem, nyei dorn maaih Sofaa, Imnaa, Qe^e^letv caux Aaman.
Sofaa nyei dorn maaih Su^aa, Haan^ne^fe, Su^an, Mbeli, Imlaa
Mbese, Hotv, Sammaa, Sinsaa, Itc^laan caux Mbe^e^laa.
Ye^te nyei dorn maaih Ye^fun^ne, Bitc^baa caux Aalaa.
Unlaa nyei dorn maaih Aalaa, Han^ni^en caux Lisiex.

Naaiv deix yietc zungv se Aa^se nyei zeiv-fun. Ninh mbuo zoux bungh buonc nyei bieiv zeiv, se ginv daaih haih mborqv jaax gauh henv jiex nyei baeng, maaih mengh hoc nyei bieiv zeiv. Liuc leiz ziangx mborqv jaax nyei mienh, ziux faaux mbuox yiem ninh mbuo nyei douh zong daan, maaih i waanc juqv cin dauh.
Mben^yaa^min nyei dorn-hlo heuc Mbelaa. Da'nyeic dauh dorn heuc Atc^mben, da'faam dauh heuc Aa^haa^laa,
da'feix dauh heuc No^haa, da'hmz dauh Laafaa.
Mbelaa nyei dorn maaih Atc^ndaa, Gelaa, Aa^mbi^hutv
Aa^mbi^qu^waa, Naa^aa^maan, Aa^hox^aa
Gelaa, Se^fu^faan caux Hulaam.
Naaiv se E^hutv nyei zeiv-fun. Ninh mbuo zoux yiem Ge^mbaa wuov deix bungh buonc nyei bieiv zeiv yaac zuqc guaatv mingh taux Maa^naa^haatv. E^hutv nyei dorn maaih
Naa^aa^maan, Aa^hi^yaa caux Gelaa. Gelaa dorh ninh mbuo mingh ninh mbuo zuqc guaatv mingh nyei dorngx. Ninh zoux Utc^saa caux Aa^hi^hutv nyei die.
Saa^haa^laa^im leih ninh nyei i dauh auv, Husim caux Mbaa^aa^laa^aa. Nqa'haav yiem Mo^apc ninh duqv dorn.
Ninh nyei auv Ho^ndetc yungz Yo^mbapc, Si^mbie, Mesaa, Mankaam
Ye^utc^e, Saax^kie caux Minmaa. Naaiv se ninh nyei dorn yaac zoux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.
Ninh nyei auv, Husim, yungz duqv i dauh dorn, Aa^mbi^tupv caux En^baa^an, bun ninh.
En^baa^an nyei dorn maaih E^mbe, Mitv^am caux Semetv. Se Semetv liepc Ono caux Lotc naaiv deix i norm zingh caux weih gormx nyei fiuv-laangz.
