Aengx maaih Mbe^li^yaa caux Semaa, se yiem Ai^yaa^lon wuov deix mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv yaac zunc cuotv yiem Gatc nyei mienh.
Maaih Aa^hi^yo, Saasakv, Ye^le^motv,
Se^mbaa^ndi^yaa, Aalaatv, E^nde
Mi^kaa^en, Itc^baa caux Yo^haa zoux Mbe^li^yaa nyei dorn.
Se^mbaa^ndi^yaa, Me^sun^laam, Hitv^ki, He^mbe
Itc^me^lai, I^saa^li^yaa caux Yo^mbapc zoux En^baa^an nyei dorn.
Yaakim, Sikc^li, Sapc^ndi,
E^li^ye^nai, Sinx^le^tai, E^li^en
Aa^ndaa^yaa, Mbe^lai^aa caux Simlaatv zoux Si^me^i nyei dorn.
Itc^baan, E^mbe, E^li^en
Apc^ndon, Sikc^li, Haanan
Haa^nan^yaa, Elaam, An^to^ti^yaa
Ipc^ndai^yaa caux Be^nu^en zoux Saasakv nyei dorn.
Sam^se^lai, Se^haa^li^yaa, Aa^taa^li^yaa
Yaa^aa^le^si^yaa, E^li^yaa caux Sikc^li zoux Ye^lo^ham nyei dorn.
Naaiv deix mienh yietc zungv zoux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv ziux faaux mbuox yiem ninh mbuo nyei douh zong daan. Ninh mbuo yaac yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh.
Gi^mbe^on nyei die, Ye^i^en, yiem Gi^mbe^on. Ninh nyei auv nyei mbuox heuc Maa^aa^kaa.
Ninh nyei dorn-hlo heuc Apc^ndon, aengx maaih Sux^aa, Kitv, Mbaa^an, Ne, Naa^ndapc
Ge^ndo, Aa^hi^yo, Seke
caux Mikv^lotv. Mikv^lotv se Si^me^haa nyei die. Ninh mbuo yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nitv ninh mbuo nyei cien-ceqv.
Ne zoux Kitv nyei die, Kitv zoux Saulo nyei die. Saulo zoux Yo^naa^taan, Manki Suwaa, Aa^mbi^naa^ndapc caux Etc Mbaa^an nyei die.
Yo^naa^taan nyei dorn maaih Melipv Mbaa^an. Melipv Mbaa^an zoux Mikaa nyei die.
Mikaa nyei dorn maaih Biton, Melekv, Taalie caux Aa^hatc.
Aa^hatc zoux Ye^ho^atc^ndaa nyei die, Ye^ho^atc^ndaa zoux Aa^le^metv, Atc^maa^wetv caux Simx^li nyei die, Simx^li zoux Mosaa nyei die.
Mosaa zoux Mbi^ne^aa nyei die. Mbi^ne^aa nyei dorn, Laafaa, Laafaa nyei dorn, E^le^aa^saax, E^le^aa^saax nyei dorn, Aasen.
Aasen maaih juqv dauh dorn. Naaiv se ninh mbuo nyei mbuox. Maaih Atc^li^kam, Mbo^ke^lu, I^saa^maa^en, Se^aa^li^yaa, O^mbaa^ndi caux Haanan. Naaiv deix yietc zungv se Aasen nyei dorn.
Aasen nyei youz, Esekv, nyei dorn maaih ninh nyei dorn-hlo, Ulaam, da'nyeic dauh dorn, Ye^utc, da'faam dauh dorn, E^li^fe^letv.

Ulaam nyei dorn zoux mborqv jaax henv nyei baeng yaac zoux buonv juang-zinx nyei mienh. Ninh mbuo maaih dorn maaih fun camv nyei. Yietc zungv maaih yietc baeqv hmz ziepc dauh. Naaiv deix yietc zungv se Mben^yaa^min nyei zeiv-fun.
Zuangx I^saa^laa^en Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei douh zong faaux mbuox yiem I^saa^laa^en nyei hungh douh daan. Yu^ndaa Mienh zuqc guaatv mingh Mbaa^mbi^lon Guoqv weic zuqc ninh mbuo maiv ziepc zuoqv.

Yiem Mbaa^mbi^lon nzuonx daaih yiem ganh nzipc nyei buonc ndau caux buonv-deic zingh nyei daauh guanh maaih I^saa^laa^en Mienh, sai mienh, Lewi Mienh, caux yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv zoux gong nyei mienh.
Maaih deix Yu^ndaa Mienh, Mben^yaa^min Mienh, E^faa^im Mienh caux Maa^natv^se Mienh duqv yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh. Maaih
Am^mi^hutv nyei dorn, Utai. Am^mi^hutv se Omli nyei dorn, Omli se Imli nyei dorn, Imli se Mbaani nyei dorn, Mbaani se Beletv nyei zeiv-fun, Beletv se Yu^ndaa nyei dorn.
Silo Mienh maaih Silo nyei dorn-hlo, Aa^saax^yaa, caux Aa^saax^yaa nyei dorn mbuo.
Zelaa Mienh maaih Ye^u^en. Yu^ndaa Fingx nyei mienh maaih luoqc baeqv juov ziepc dauh.
Yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei Mben^yaa^min Mienh maaih Me^sun^laam nyei dorn, Sanx^lu. Me^sun^laam se Ho^ndaa^wi^yaa nyei dorn, Ho^ndaa^wi^yaa se Hatc^se^nu^aa nyei dorn,

Hatc^se^nu^aa se Ipc^ne^yaa nyei dorn, Ipc^ne^yaa se Ye^lo^ham nyei dorn, Ye^lo^ham se Elaa nyei dorn, Elaa se Utc^si nyei dorn, Utc^si se Mikv^li nyei dorn, Mikv^li se Me^sun^laam nyei dorn, Me^sun^laam se Se^faa^ti^yaa nyei dorn, Se^faa^ti^yaa se Le^u^en nyei dorn, Le^u^en se Ipc^ni^yaa nyei dorn.
Mben^yaa^min Mienh ziux faaux mbuox yiem ninh mbuo nyei douh zong daan, yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem maaih juov baeqv hmz ziepc luoqc dauh. Naaiv deix yietc zungv zoux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.
Yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei sai mienh maaih Ye^ndaa^yaa, Ye^ho^yaa^lipv caux Yaakin.

Maaih Hin^ki^yaa nyei dorn, Aa^saa^li^yaa, dongh gunv zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv wuov dauh. Hin^ki^yaa se Me^sun^laam nyei dorn, Me^sun^laam se Saax^ndokc nyei dorn, Saax^ndokc se Me^laa^yotv nyei dorn, Me^laa^yotv se Aa^hi^tupv nyei dorn,

Aa^hi^tupv se Aa^ndaa^yaa nyei dorn, Aa^ndaa^yaa se Ye^lo^ham nyei dorn, Ye^lo^ham se Baatc^he nyei dorn, Baatc^he se Man^ki^yaa nyei dorn, Man^ki^yaa se Maa^aa^saix nyei dorn, Maa^aa^saix se Aa^ndi^en nyei dorn, Aa^ndi^en se Yaa^se^laa nyei dorn, Yaa^se^laa se Me^sun^laam nyei dorn, Me^sun^laam se Me^sin^le^mitv nyei dorn, Me^sin^le^mitv se Imme nyei dorn.
Zoux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv nyei sai mienh yietc zungv maaih yietc cin cietv baeqv luoqc ziepc dauh. Ninh mbuo maaih banh zeic yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv zoux gong fu-sux.
Yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei Lewi Mienh maaih Hatc^supv nyei dorn, Se^mai^aa. Hatc^supv se Atc^li^kam nyei dorn, Atc^li^kam se Haa^saa^bi^yaa nyei dorn, dongh Me^laa^li nyei zeiv-fun.
Maaih Mbakc^mbakc^kaa, He^letv^se, Gaalaan caux Mikaa nyei dorn, Matv^taa^ni^yaa. Mikaa se Sikc^li nyei dorn, Sikc^li se Aasaapc nyei dorn.

Maaih Se^mai^aa nyei dorn, O^mbaa^ndi. Se^mai^aa se Gaalaan nyei dorn, Gaalaan se Ye^ndu^tun nyei dorn, Ye^ndu^tun se Mbe^le^ki^yaa nyei dorn, Mbe^le^ki^yaa se Aasaax nyei dorn, Aasaax se En^kaa^naa nyei dorn. Ninh mbuo yiem jienv Ne^to^faa Mienh nyei laangz.
Zuov gaengh nyei mienh maaih Sanlum, Akc^kupc, Tanmon, Aa^hi^maan caux ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz. Sanlum zoux ninh mbuo nyei bieiv zeiv,
zanc-zanc yiem Hungh Diex nyei Gaengh dong bung maengx nyei dorngx taux ih zanc. Naaiv deix mienh zinh ndaangc zoux Lewi Mienh nyei ciangv nyei zuov gaengh mienh.

Maaih Ko^le nyei dorn, Sanlum. Ko^le se E^mbi^yaa^saapc nyei dorn. Yaac maaih Sanlum nyei bungh buonc gorx-youz nyei Kolaa Mienh. Ninh mbuo gunv zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv nyei gong yaac zuov zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh nyei gaengh ndaangc hnangv zinh ndaangc ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix goux Ziouv nyei ciangv bieqc maengx nyei gaengh.
Zinh ndaangc E^le^aa^saa nyei dorn, Fi^ne^hatc, gunv zuov gaengh mienh. Ziouv yaac caux ninh yiem.
Se Me^se^le^mi^yaa nyei dorn, Se^kaa^li^yaa, zuov bieqc Wuic Buangh Ndopv-Liuh nyei gaengh.

Ginv daaih yiem gaengh ndaangc zuov gaengh nyei yietc zungv mienh maaih nyic baeqv ziepc nyeic dauh. Ninh mbuo yiem ninh mbuo ganh nyei laangz ziux ninh mbuo nyei douh zong faaux mbuox. Zinh ndaangc Ndaawitv Hungh caux gorngv zinh hoz waac wuov dauh Saa^mu^en paaiv ninh mbuo zoux zuov gaengh mienh.
Ninh mbuo caux ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun oix zuqc liuc leiz zuov zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei gaengh, se heuc Ndopv-Liuh wuov norm dorngx.
Zuov gaengh mienh yiem biei bung, se dong naamh fai baqv nyei gaengh.
Ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz yiem ninh mbuo ganh nyei laangz, mouz siec hnoi oix zuqc tiuv jienv daaih zuov gaengh.
Mv baac maaih biei dauh zuov gaengh mienh, se Lewi Mienh, ninh mbuo nyei gong se oix zuqc liuc leiz goux zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv nyei qongx-qongx caux siou jaaix nyei ga'naaiv nyei dorngx.
Lungh muonz zanc ninh mbuo oix zuqc yiem weih gormx zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv, weic zuqc ninh mbuo nyei gong se oix zuqc zuov naaiv norm biauv. Ndorm-ndorm ninh mbuo yaac oix zuqc koi gaengh.

Maaih deix Lewi Mienh oix zuqc goux yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv fu-sux nyei ziangh hoc longc nyei jaa-sic. Zorqv cuotv nyei ziangh hoc oix zuqc saauv. Fungx bieqc nyei ziangh hoc yaac oix zuqc saauv.
Aengx maaih deix ninh mbuo paaiv goux zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei jaa-dorngx caux yietc zungv cing-nzengc jaa-sic, liemh mbuonv, a'ngunc diuv, ga'lanv youh, hung caux laapc liuc.
Aengx maaih deix sai mienh nyei zeiv-fun liuc leiz peux ga'naaiv-ndaang nyei jauv.
Maaih dauh Lewi Mienh, Matv^ti^ti^yaa, dongh Kolaa Mienh, Sanlum, nyei dorn-hlo. Ninh nyei gong se oix zuqc zoux fongc horc ziec nyei njuov.
Maaih deix ninh mbuo Ko^haatv Mienh nyei bungh buonc oix zuqc liuc leiz gengx Tin-Hungh nyei njuov. Norm-norm Dingh Gong Hnoi ninh mbuo oix zuqc liuc leiz daaih mbenc jienv.

Naaiv se baaux nzung nyei mienh, se Lewi Mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv. Ninh mbuo yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv nyei qongx-qongx gen yaac maiv zuqc zoux ganh nyungc gong weic zuqc maiv gunv lungh hnoi lungh muonz ninh mbuo oix zuqc ziux ziangh hoc zoux naaiv nyungc gong.
Naaiv se yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei Lewi Mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv ziux ninh mbuo nyei douh zong.
Gi^mbe^on nyei die, Ye^i^en, yiem Gi^mbe^on. Ye^i^en nyei auv nyei mbuox heuc Maa^aa^kaa.
Ninh nyei dorn-hlo heuc Apc^ndon. Aengx maaih Sux^aa, Kitv, Mbaa^an, Ne, Naa^ndapc,
Ge^ndo, Aa^hi^yo, Se^kaa^li^yaa caux Mikv^lotv.
Mikv^lotv zoux Si^me^aa nyei die. Ninh mbuo yaac yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nitv jienv ninh mbuo juangc fingx nyei cien-ceqv.
Ne se Kitv nyei die, Kitv se Saulo nyei die, Saulo se Yo^naa^taan, Manki Suwaa, Aa^mbi^naa^ndapc caux Etc Mbaa^an nyei die.
Yo^naa^taan nyei dorn maaih Melipv Mbaa^an. Melipv Mbaa^an zoux Mikaa nyei die.
Mikaa nyei dorn maaih Biton, Melekv, Taalie caux Aa^hatc.
Aa^hatc zoux Yaalaa nyei die, Yaalaa zoux Aa^le^metv, Atc^maa^wetv caux Simx^li nyei die. Simx^li zoux Mosaa nyei die.
Mosaa zoux Mbi^ne^aa nyei die. Mbi^ne^aa nyei dorn se Le^fai^yaa, Le^fai^yaa nyei dorn se E^le^aa^saax, E^le^aa^saax nyei dorn se Aasen.
Aasen maaih juqv dauh dorn, mbuox heuc Atc^li^kam, Mbo^ke^lu, I^saa^maa^en, Se^aa^li^yaa, O^mbaa^ndi caux Haanan. Naaiv se Aasen nyei dorn.
Fi^li^saa^die Mienh mingh caux I^saa^laa^en Mienh mborqv jaax. I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem Fi^li^saa^die Mienh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx biaux, maaih camv nyei yiem Gin^mbo^aa Mbong zuqc daix daic.
Fi^li^saa^die Mienh zunc zaaic Saulo caux ninh nyei dorn, ziouc daix Yo^naa^taan, Aa^mbi^naa^ndapc, caux Manki Suwaa.
Mborqv jaax nyei jauv gunv zoux gunv hlo yaac gunv zoux gunv nitv Saulo. Buonv juang-zinx nyei mienh zunc zaaic, buonv ninh zuqc mun siang nyei.

Saulo mbuox tengx ninh dorh mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc wuov dauh, “Zorqv meih nyei nzuqc ndaauv nzopv tong yie maah! Nziex naaiv deix maiv jiex gaatv nyei leiz nyei mienh oix daaih a'hneiv nyei jatv yie.” Mv baac dorh mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc wuov dauh maiv zoux, weic zuqc ninh ba'laqc gamh nziex haic. Saulo ziouc zorqv ninh ganh nyei nzuqc ndaauv daaih orpv njiec nzuqc ndaauv gu'nguaaic.
Dorh mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc wuov dauh buatc Saulo daic mi'aqv, ninh fih hnangv nyei orpv njiec ninh ganh nyei nzuqc ndaauv gu'nguaaic daic mi'aqv.
Hnangv naaic Saulo caux ninh nyei buo dauh dorn, liemh ninh nyei yietc biauv mienh, yietc njiec daic nzengc mi'aqv.

Yiem wuov norm horngz nyei I^saa^laa^en Mienh yietc zungv buatc baeng biaux nzengc, Saulo caux ninh nyei buo dauh dorn yaac daic mi'aqv, ninh mbuo ziouc guangc jienv ninh mbuo nyei zingh biaux nzengc. Fi^li^saa^die Mienh ziouc daaih yiem jienv aqv.
Da'nyeic hnoi Fi^li^saa^die Mienh daaih tutv nzengc zuqc daix daic nyei mienh nyei nyungc-nyungc ga'naaiv, ninh mbuo buatc Saulo caux ninh nyei buo dauh dorn nyei sei yiem wuov Gin^mbo^aa Mbong.

Ninh mbuo tutv nqoi Saulo nyei ga'naaiv, zorqv ninh nyei m'nqorngv caux mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc. Ninh mbuo aengx paaiv douc fienx mienh mingh gormx Fi^li^saa^die Deic-Bung mbuox ninh mbuo nyei miuc-fangx caux baeqc fingx.
Ninh mbuo zorqv Saulo mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc an jienv ninh mbuo nyei zienh nyei biauv. Saulo nyei m'nqorngv ninh mbuo kuangx jienv Ndaagon nyei miuc-biauv.
Yiem Yaa^mbetc Gi^le^aatc nyei mienh haiz gorngv Fi^li^saa^die Mienh zoux bun Saulo nyei yietc zungv sic,

yietc zungv mborqv jaax henv nyei baeng ziouc mingh zorqv Saulo caux ninh nyei dorn nyei sei dorh nzuonx taux Yaa^mbetc. Ninh mbuo zorqv Saulo dorn-diex doic nyei mbungv biopv yiem Yaa^mbetc nyei yietc diuh mba'ong zuei ndiangx ga'ndiev yaac zei maiv nyanc haaix nyungc siec hnoi.

Saulo daic weic zuqc ninh dorngc Ziouv, maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux. Ninh maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei ei jienv Ziouv hatc nyei waac. Ninh yaac oix hiuv duqv oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor dorh jauv ziouc mingh lorz naaic dauh gaanv hei nyei m'sieqv dorn.
Ninh maiv lorz Ziouv nyei za'eix. Ziouv ziouc bun ninh zuqc daic yaac zorqv ninh nyei guoqv jiu bun Jetc^si nyei dorn, Ndaawitv.
Zuangx I^saa^laa^en Mienh mingh He^mbo^lon gapv zunv yiem Ndaawitv wuov. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo m'daaih juangc meih nyei nziaamv-fei.

Zinh ndaangc, maiv gunv Saulo zoux hungh gunv yie mbuo nyei ziangh hoc, se dongh meih dorh I^saa^laa^en Mienh bieqc cuotv mborqv jaax. Ziouv, meih nyei Tin-Hungh, gorngv mbuox meih, ‘Meih zungv oix goux yie nyei baeqc fingx, I^saa^laa^en Mienh, hnangv goux ba'gi yungh nyei mienh nor. Meih yaac duqv zoux hlo gunv ninh mbuo.’+”

I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei zuangx mienh gox daaih taux He^mbo^lon, Ndaawitv Hungh wuov. Ndaawitv ziouc yiem He^mbo^lon dorng jienv Ziouv caux ninh mbuo liepc jiez ngaengc waac. Ninh mbuo yaac longc youh orn Ndaawitv zoux I^saa^laa^en nyei hungh hnangv Ziouv longc Saa^mu^en gorngv nyei waac.
Ndaawitv caux I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh mingh Ye^lu^saa^lem, se mingh Ye^mbutc wuov. Yiem naaic nyei Ye^mbutc Mienh
gorngv mbuox Ndaawitv, “Meih mbuo zungv maiv duqv bieqc naaiv norm dorngx.” Mv baac Ndaawitv mborqv duqv wuov norm weih wuonv nyei dorngx, Si^on, se Ndaawitv nyei Zingh.
Ndaawitv gorngv, “Haaix dauh dorh jauv bieqc mingh mborqv Ye^mbutc Mienh, wuov dauh duqv zoux domh baeng-bieiv.” Se^lu^yaa nyei dorn, Yo^aapc, mingh ndaangc ziouc duqv zoux domh baeng-bieiv.
Ndaawitv mingh yiem jienv wuov norm weih wuonv nyei dorngx gu'nyuoz. Wuov norm dorngx ziouc duqv mbuox heuc Ndaawitv nyei Zingh.
Ndaawitv aengx ceix wuov norm zingh, yiem Minlo jiez gorn ceix huing gormx. Zengc njiec wuov deix, Yo^aapc ceix.
Ndaawitv yietc hnoi beiv yietc hnoi henv jienv faaux, weic zuqc Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv caux ninh yiem.

Yiem naaiv mingh se gan Ndaawitv nyei henv haic nyei jun-zeiv mienh nyei bieiv zeiv. Ninh mbuo caux jienv I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh tengx qaqv Ndaawitv, weic bun ninh haih gunv gormx guoqv, ei jienv Ziouv gorngv taux I^saa^laa^en nyei waac.

Naaiv se Ndaawitv henv jiex nyei jun-zeiv mienh nyei soux mouc. Maaih Hakv^mo^ni Mienh, Yaa^so^mbe^am, zoux wuov deix “Buo Dauh” jun-zeiv mienh nyei bieiv. Ninh mborqv yietc nzunc jaax ninh longc ninh nyei cang daix faam-baeqv dauh mienh.
Aa^hox^hai Mienh, Ndo^ndo, nyei dorn, E^le^aa^saa, se wuov deix “Buo Dauh” nyei yietc dauh.

Ninh caux Ndaawitv yiem Batc Ndammim doix Fi^li^saa^die Mienh gapv zunv yiem naaic oix mborqv jaax. Yiem naaic maaih nzong ndeic zuangx mbiauh mbaali buangv nzengc. Zuangx mienh yaac biaux Fi^li^saa^die Mienh.
Mv baac E^le^aa^saa caux ninh nyei mienh souv jienv naaiv nzong ndeic mbu'ndongx beu jienv ndeic, daix Fi^li^saa^die Mienh. Ziouv bun ninh mbuo za'gengh! hingh jiex.

Yiem naaiv deix henv haic nyei faah ziepc dauh bieiv zeiv gu'nyuoz nyei buo dauh njiec taux Aa^ndun^lam mbaengx-kuotv nyei domh la'bieiv-zorng doix zuqc yietc guanh Fi^li^saa^die Mienh liepc ciangv yiem Le^faa^im Horngz.
Wuov zanc Ndaawitv yiem weih wuonv nyei dorngx gu'nyuoz. Maaih guanh Fi^li^saa^die Mienh yiem Mbetc^le^hem.

Ndaawitv haiz ngorc yiem Mbetc^le^hem nyei wuom ziouc gorngv cuotv nzuih, “Feix duqv maaih mienh haih ndamv deix yiem nitv Mbetc^le^hem nyei zingh laatc gaengh nyei wuom-kuotv nyei wuom bun yie hopv.”

Naaiv deix “Buo Dauh” ziouc nimc bieqc Fi^li^saa^die Mienh beu nyei dorngx, ndamv deix yiem Mbetc^le^hem nyei zingh laatc gaengh ga'hlen nyei wuom dorh nzuonx bun Ndaawitv. Mv baac Ndaawitv maiv kangv hopv. Ninh dox cuotv fongc horc bun Ziouv.

Ndaawitv gorngv, “Tov Tin-Hungh hatc jienv maiv bun yie hopv. Naaiv deix wuom se hnangv naaiv deix “Buo Dauh” nyei nziaamv, weic zuqc ninh mbuo maiv longc maengc mingh tengx yie ndamv.” Weic zuqc ninh mbuo maiv longc maengc nyei mingh lorz daaih, Ndaawitv maiv kangv hopv. Naaiv se wuov deix buo dauh jun-zeiv mienh zoux nyei jauv-louc.

Yo^aapc nyei youz, Aa^mbi^qai, zoux wuov deix “Faah Ziepc Dauh” nyei bieiv zeiv. Ninh longc ninh nyei cang caux faam-baeqv dauh mienh mborqv jaax yaac daix nzengc ninh mbuo. Ninh ziouc duqv mengh dauh ndongc wuov deix “Buo Dauh” hlo.
Ninh duqv mengh dauh gauh hlo jiex wuov deix “Faah ziepc dauh” yaac duqv zoux ninh mbuo nyei bieiv zeiv. Mv baac ninh nyei mengh dauh corc maiv ndongc wuov deix Buo Dauh.

Ye^ho^yaa^ndaa nyei dorn, Mbe^nai^yaa, se yietc dauh yiem Kapc^se^en daaih mborqv jaax henv nyei jun-zeiv mienh. Ninh daix i dauh Mo^apc Mienh mborqv jaax henv haic nyei baeng. Aengx maaih nzunc doix duih sorng nyei ziangh hoc ninh njiec norm kuotv daix dauh sienh daic.

Ninh aengx daix dauh I^yipv Mienh. Wuov dauh mienh sin hlang biaa ndorqc. Maiv gunv wuov dauh I^yipv Mienh nanv jienv cang lomh ndatv ndie nyei biaav hlo, Mbe^nai^yaa longc ndiangx-ndonx bieqc mingh mborqv. Ninh caangv wuov dauh nyei cang daaih, longc wuov diuh cang daix wuov dauh aqv.
Naaiv se Ye^ho^yaa^ndaa nyei dorn, Mbe^nai^yaa, zoux nyei sic. Ninh yaac duqv mengh dauh ndongc wuov deix buo dauh henv haic nyei jun-zeiv mienh hlo.
Ninh yaac duqv mengh dauh gauh hlo wuov deix Faah Ziepc Dauh mv baac maiv duqv funx bieqc caux wuov deix Buo Dauh. Ndaawitv yaac paaiv ninh zoux ninh nyei sin-hlen mienh nyei bieiv zeiv.
Henv haic nyei jun-zeiv mienh maaih hnangv naaiv, Yo^aapc nyei youz, Aa^saax^hen, Mbetc^le^hem Mienh, Ndo^ndo nyei dorn, En^haa^nan,
Haalotv Mienh, Sammotv, Belon Mienh, He^letv^te,
Te^ko^aa Mienh, Ikc^ketc nyei dorn, I^laa, Aa^naa^totv Mienh, Aa^mbi^ye^se,
Husaa Mienh, Sipc^mbe^kai, Aa^hox^hai Mienh, I^lai,
Ne^to^faa Mienh, Maa^haa^lai, Ne^to^faa Mienh, Mbaa^aa^naa nyei dorn, Heletv,
Mben^yaa^min Fingx nyei Gi^mbe^aa Mienh, Li^mbai nyei dorn, I^tai, Bi^laa^ton Mienh, Mbe^nai^yaa,
Gaa^atc Horngz nyei mienh, Hulai, Aan^mbaa Mienh, Aa^mbi^en,
Mbaa^hu^lim Mienh, Atc^maa^wetv, Saa^an^mbon Mienh, E^li^yaa^mbaa,
Gimso Mienh, Haasem, nyei dorn, Haalaa Mienh, Saagi nyei dorn, Yo^naa^taan,
Haalaa Mienh, Saax^kaa nyei dorn, Aa^hi^yam, U^aa nyei dorn, E^li^fan,
Me^ke^laa Mienh, Hefe, Belon Mienh, Aa^hi^yaa,
Kaanmen Mienh, Hetv^lo, Etc^mbai nyei dorn, Naa^aa^lai,
Naatan nyei youz, Yo^en, Haagi nyei dorn, Mipv^haa,
Ammon Mienh, Selekv, Mbe^e^lotv Mienh, Naa^haa^lai, se tengx Se^lu^yaa nyei dorn, Yo^aapc, dorh mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc wuov dauh.
Itc^lai Mienh, I^laa, Itc^lai Mienh, Gaalepv,
Hitv^tai Mienh, U^li^yaa, Akc^lai nyei dorn, Saax^mbaatc,
Lu^mben Mienh, Si^saa^aa nyei dorn, Aa^ndi^naa. Ninh zoux Lu^mben Fingx nyei yietc dauh bieiv zeiv, ninh caux faah ziepc dauh mienh.
Maa^aa^kaa nyei dorn, Haanan, Mitv^ne Mienh, Yo^saa^fatv,
Atc^taa^lotv Mienh, Utc^si^yaa, Aa^lo^e Mienh, Sammaa nyei dorn, Ye^i^en caux Hotaam.
Simli nyei dorn, Ye^ndi^yaa^en, caux ninh nyei youz, Tisai Mienh, Yo^haa,
Maa^haa^wai Mienh, E^li^en, En^naa^am nyei dorn, Ye^li^mbai caux Yo^saa^wi^yaa, Mo^apc Mienh, Itc^maa,
E^li^en, O^mbetc, caux Me^so^mbai Mienh, Yaa^aa^si^en.
Ndaawitv mingh yiem Sikc^laakv weic biaux Kitv nyei dorn, Saulo Hungh. Naaiv se mingh Sikc^laakv gan ninh wuov deix mienh. Ninh mbuo zoux mborqv jaax henv nyei baeng,

haih buonv juang-zinx nyei mienh. Ninh mbuo haih longc zaaix jieqv mbiaauc jieqv buoz nanv ndopv-hlaang bungx la'bieiv fai buonv juang-zinx yaac duqv. Ninh mbuo yietc zungv se caux Saulo juangc fingx nyei Mben^yaa^min Mienh.

Maaih ninh mbuo nyei bieiv zeiv, Aa^hi^ye^se, caux ninh nyei youz Yo^aatc, se Gi^mbe^aa Mienh, Se^maa^aa, nyei dorn. Aengx maaih Atc^maa^wetv nyei dorn, Ye^si^en caux Peletc. Maaih Mbe^laa^kaa, maaih Aa^naa^totv Mienh, Ye^hu,

caux Gi^mbe^on Mienh, Itc^mai^aa, dongh wuov deix Faah Ziepc Dauh henv haic nyei jun-zeiv mienh nyei yietc dauh, yaac zoux wuov deix Faah Ziepc Dauh nyei yietc dauh bieiv zeiv. Maaih Ye^le^mi, Yaa^haa^si^en, Yo^haa^nan, caux Ge^nde^laa Mienh, Yo^saa^mbaatc,
E^lu^sai, Ye^li^motv, Mbe^an^yaa, Se^maa^li^yaa, caux Haalupv Mienh, Se^faa^ti^yaa,
En^kaa^naa, Itc^si^yaa, Aa^saa^len, Yo^e^se, caux Kolaa Mienh, Yaa^so^mbe^am,
yaac maaih Ge^ndo Mienh, Ye^lo^ham nyei dorn, Yo^e^laa, caux Se^mbaa^ndi^yaa.

Maaih deix Gaatc Mienh biaux mingh Ndaawitv yiem wuov norm wuonv nyei dorngx, deic-bung-huaang wuov. Ninh mbuo se haih mborqv jaax henv nyei baeng, haih longc torngv-baaih caux cang liouc nyei. Ninh mbuo nyei hmien hnangv sienh nyei hmien, yaac haih tiux siepv hnangv yiem mbong nyei njaih nor.
E^se zoux bieiv zeiv, O^mbaa^ndi zoux da'nyeic, E^li^apc zoux da'faam,
Mitv^man^naa zoux da'feix, Ye^le^mi zoux da'hmz,
Atc^tai zoux da'luoqc, E^li^en zoux da'cietv,
Yo^haa^nan zoux da'betv, En^saa^mbaatc zoux da'juov,
Ye^le^mi zoux da'ziepc, Makv^mban^nai zoux ziepc yietv wuov dauh.
Naaiv deix Gaatc Mienh zoux baeng-bieiv. Zoux gauh faix wuov deix div duqv yietc baeqv dauh. Zoux hlo wuov deix div duqv yietc cin dauh.
Se dongh naaiv deix baeng-bieiv jiex Jor^ndaen Ndaaih doix zuqc zih hlaax wuom hlo buangv kamx, ziouc bun ndoqv-hlen nyei mienh dong dauh fai dauh nyei biaux nzaanx nzengc.
Aengx maaih deix Mben^yaa^min Mienh caux Yu^ndaa Mienh mingh taux Ndaawitv weih wuonv nyei dorngx wuov.

Ndaawitv cuotv mingh zipv ninh mbuo yaac gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Se gorngv meih mbuo daaih zoux longx, tengx yie, yie a'hneiv caux meih mbuo jiu zuoqc. Mv baac se gorngv meih mbuo oix zorqv yie maaic bun win-wangv maiv gunv yie maiv maaih zuiz nor, tov mbuo nyei ong-taaix nyei Tin-Hungh mangc buatc yaac dingc meih mbuo nyei zuiz.”

Wuov zanc Singx Lingh njiec wuov deix “Faah Ziepc Dauh” nyei bieiv zeiv, Aa^maa^saix. Ninh ziouc gorngv, O Ndaawitv aac, yie mbuo se meih nyei. Jetc^si nyei dorn aac, yie mbuo caux meih yiem. Tov bun meih duqv baengh orn, za'gengh baengh orn. Yaac tov bun tengx meih wuov deix duqv baengh orn, weic zuqc meih nyei Tin-Hungh tengx meih. Ndaawitv ziouc zipv ninh mbuo aengx liepc ninh mbuo zoux jun-baeng nyei baeng-bieiv.

Maaih deix Maa^natv^se Mienh yaac biaux mingh bieqc Ndaawitv, dongh ninh caux Fi^li^saa^die Mienh cuotv mingh mborqv Saulo wuov zanc. (Mv baac Ndaawitv mbuo maiv duqv tengx Fi^li^saa^die Mienh, weic zuqc Fi^li^saa^die Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv caangh laangh liuz ziouc gorngv, “Se gorngv ninh mbuo guangc mbuo, biaux mingh tengx Saulo nor, nziex Ndaawitv mbuo zorqv mbuo nyei m'nqorngv maaic bun Saulo.”)

Ndaawitv mingh Sikc^laakv nyei ziangh hoc, naaiv se biaux mingh gan ninh wuov deix Maa^natv^se Mienh. Maaih yiem Maa^natv^se gunv yietc cin dauh baeng nyei baeng-bieiv, Atc^naa, Yo^saa^mbaatc, Ye^ndi^yaa^en, Mi^kaa^en, Yo^saa^mbaatc, E^li^hu caux Sinx^le^tai.
Naaiv deix mienh tengx Ndaawitv mborqv guanh guanh zaqc baeng, weic zuqc ninh mbuo yietc zungv se henv haic nyei mborqv jaax baeng, yaac zoux ninh nyei baeng-bieiv.
Hnoi-hnoi maaih mienh daaih tengx Ndaawitv, taux ninh maaih domh baeng-guanh hnangv Tin-Hungh nyei baeng-guanh nor.
Naaiv se maaih nzoih mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc mingh He^mbo^lon lorz Ndaawitv wuov deix baeng nyei soux mouc. Ninh mbuo oix zorqv Saulo nyei guoqv jiu bun Ndaawitv ziux Ziouv gorngv nyei waac.
Yu^ndaa Mienh nanv torngv-baaih caux cang liuc leiz ziangx mborqv jaax, maaih juqv cin betv baeqv dauh.
Si^me^on Mienh mborqv jaax henv haic nyei baeng, maaih siec cin yietc baeqv dauh.
Lewi Mienh, maaih biei cin luoqc baeqv dauh,
liemh Aalon nyei douh zong nyei bieiv zeiv, Ye^ho^yaa^ndaa, caux gan ninh wuov deix buo cin cietv baeqv dauh.
Aengx maaih dauh hnyangx-jeiv lunx, mborqv jaax henv nyei mienh, mbuox heuc Saax^ndokc, aengx caux ninh juangc fingx nyei baeng-bieiv nyic ziepc nyeic dauh.
Caux Saulo juangc fingx nyei Mben^yaa^min Mienh maaih buo cin dauh. Naaiv deix gauh camv jiex zinh ndaangc tengx Saulo.
E^faa^im Fingx henv haic nyei baeng, se yiem ninh mbuo ganh nyei bungh buonc maaih mengh dauh nyei mienh, maaih i waanc betv baeqv dauh.
Maa^natv^se nyei ndaamv-fingx, dongh ziux mbuox paaiv mingh liepc Ndaawitv zoux hungh wuov deix, maaih yietc waanc hietc cin dauh.

Itc^saax^kaa Mienh, dongh haih samx duqv cuotv wuov jaax lungh ndiev nyei ziangh hoc yaac hiuv duqv I^saa^laa^en Mienh oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor zoux, maaih nyic baeqv dauh bieiv zeiv caux yiem naaiv deix bieiv zeiv nyei buoz-ndiev nyei juangc fingx mienh.

Se^mbu^lun Mienh maaih biaa waanc dauh hoqc liuz yaac liuc leiz ziangx cuotv mingh mborqv jaax. Ninh mbuo maaih nzoih nyungc-nyungc mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc. Ninh mbuo maaih nduqc diuc hnyouv tengx Ndaawitv.
Napv^taa^li Mienh maaih yietc cin dauh baeng-bieiv caux jienv buo waanc siec cin dauh nanv torngv-baaih caux cang mborqv jaax nyei baeng.
Ndaan Fingx maaih mbenc ziangx mborqv jaax nyei mienh i waanc hietc cin luoqc baeqv dauh.
Aa^se Fingx hoqc liuz mbenc ziangx mborqv jaax nyei mienh maaih biei waanc dauh.

Yiem Jor^ndaen Ndaaih dong bung maengx nyei Lu^mben Mienh, Gaatc Mienh caux Maa^natv^se nyei ndaamv-fingx mienh maaih jienv nyungc-nyungc mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc nyei baeng, maaih yietc sinx i waanc dauh.

Naaiv deix yietc zungv baeng liuc leiz ziangx mborqv jaax. Ninh mbuo daaih taux He^mbo^lon buangv hnyouv oix liepc Ndaawitv zoux hungh, gunv nzengc I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung. Zengc njiec nyei I^saa^laa^en Mienh yietc zungv fih hnangv nyei yaac dongh hnyouv oix liepc Ndaawitv zoux hungh.
Ninh mbuo caux Ndaawitv yiem wuov buo hnoi, nyanc nyei hopv nyei, weic zuqc ninh mbuo nyei muoz-doic mbenc ziangx bun ninh mbuo.

Yiem nitv fatv ninh mbuo nyei mienh caux yiem go nyei mienh, se yiem Itc^saax^kaa, Se^mbu^lun caux Napv^taa^li wuov deix, longc maaz-li caux lorh caux lorh torh caux ngongh tor jienv nyanc hopv daaih. Maaih mbuonv, ngongh nyorx biouv-nqaai, a'ngunc biouv-nqaai, a'ngunc diuv, ga'lanv youh, ngongh caux ba'gi yungh, weic zuqc I^saa^laa^en Mienh njien-youh haic.
Ndaawitv caux ninh nyei gunv yietc cin dauh nyei baeng-bieiv caux gunv yietc baeqv dauh nyei baeng-bieiv yietc zungv caangh laangh.

Ninh yaac gorngv mbuox yietc zungv gapv zunv nyei I^saa^laa^en Mienh, “Se gorngv meih mbuo buatc horpc, yaac se gorngv ziux Ziouv, mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, nyei za'eix nor, mbuo oix zuqc paaiv mienh mingh gormx I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung mbuox mbuo zengc njiec nyei gorx-youz caux yiem ninh mbuo nyei mungv caux miev-ciangv nyei Lewi Mienh caux sai mienh, heuc ninh mbuo daaih gapv zunv mbuo naaiv.
Bun mbuo dorh mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nzuonx mbuo naaiv daaih, weic zuqc Saulo zoux hungh nyei ziangh hoc mbuo liemh maiv naaic taux.”
Gapv zunv nyei zuangx mienh dongh hnyouv dingc hnangv naaiv nor zoux, weic zuqc yietc zungv buatc se horpc nyei.

Ndaawitv ziouc bun I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh gapv zunv yiem I^yipv nyei Si^hox Ndaaih taux Haamatv nyei jauv-kuv wuov weic dorh Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang yiem Ki^li^yaatv Ye^aa^lim nzuonx.

Ndaawitv caux I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh mingh Yu^ndaa nyei Mbaa^aa^laa Zingh, se Ki^li^yaatv Ye^aa^lim, oix yiem wuov norm dorngx dorh Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang, se gan Ziouv nyei Mbuox heuc nyei faang, yaac maaih Ziouv nyei yiem wuov deix i dauh ke^lu^mbim mbu'ndongx nyei weic.
Ninh mbuo yiem Aa^mbi^naa^ndapc nyei biauv dorh Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang cuotv daaih an jienv yietc jaax siang-ngongh cie tor. Utc^saa caux Aa^hi^yo dorh jauv.
Ndaawitv caux I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien longc nzengc qaqv zoux jorm, baaux nzung patv domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah, mborqv nzoz, nqaapv caauh zeiv, biomv nzatc.
Ninh mbuo daaih taux Ki^ndon nyei mborqv mbiauh ciangv, Utc^saa sung buoz baav jienv Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang, weic zuqc tor cie nyei ngongh kaav deix ndorpc.
Ziouv qiex jiez! haic Utc^saa, ziouc daix ninh aqv, weic zuqc Utc^saa sung buoz kuatv zuqc Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang. Utc^saa ziouc yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien daic.
Ndaawitv qiex jiez haic Ziouv weic zuqc Ziouv ga'qiex baetv cuotv zoux bun Utc^saa. Wuov norm dorngx ziouc heuc Beletv Utc^saa taux ih jaax hnoi.
Wuov hnoi Ndaawitv gamh nziex Tin-Hungh ziouc gorngv, “Yie hnangv haaix nor haih dorh Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang taux yie nyei dorngx?”
Ndaawitv ziouc maiv dorh Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang mingh Ndaawitv nyei Zingh. Ninh dorh mingh Gatc Mienh, O^mbetc E^ndom, nyei biauv.
Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang yiem O^mbetc E^ndom nyei biauv buo hlaax nyieqc. Ziouv ceix fuqv bun O^mbetc E^ndom nyei biauv caux ninh maaih nyei yietc zungv.
Tailaqv nyei hungh, Hilaam, paaiv deix douc fienx mienh mingh Ndaawitv wuov, yaac fungx si^ndaa zongh ndiangx caux la'bieiv-zaangc caux ndiangx-zaangc weic zoux hungh dinc bun Ndaawitv.
Ndaawitv ziouc hiuv duqv Ziouv liepc ninh zoux hungh gunv I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung. Weic ninh nyei baeqc fingx I^saa^laa^en Mienh, Tin-Hungh bun mienh za'gengh! taaih Ndaawitv nyei guoqv.
Yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem, Ndaawitv aengx longc auv camv nyei, aengx duqv dorn duqv sieqv.
Naaiv se Ndaawitv yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem duqv daaih nyei fu'jueiv nyei mbuox. Maaih Sam^mu^waa, So^mbapc, Naatan, Saa^lo^morn,
Ipc^haa, E^li^su^waa, En^pe^letv,
Nogaa, Nefekv, Yaafie,
E^li^saa^maa, Mbe^en^yaa^ndaa caux E^li^fe^letv.

Fi^li^saa^die Mienh muangx haiz mienh liepc Ndaawitv zoux hungh gunv nzengc I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung, Fi^li^saa^die nyei zuangx mienh ziouc cuotv mingh lorz Ndaawitv. Ndaawitv hiuv duqv ziouc cuotv mingh caux ninh mbuo mborqv jaax.
Fi^li^saa^die Mienh zungv daaih luv Le^faa^im Horngz mi'aqv.

Ndaawitv ziouc naaic Tin-Hungh, “Yie oix zuqc mingh mborqv Fi^li^saa^die Mienh fai? Meih oix zorqv ninh mbuo jiu bun yie fai?” Ziouv dau ninh, “Gunv mingh mborqv aqv. Yie oix zorqv ninh mbuo jiu bun yiem meih nyei buoz-ndiev.”

Ndaawitv caux ninh nyei mienh ziouc mingh Mbaa^an Be^laa^sim, yiem naaic mborqv hingh Fi^li^saa^die Mienh. Ninh gorngv, “Tin-Hungh longc yie nyei buoz mborqv baaic yie nyei win-wangv hnangv wuom-beqv congx tong mingh nor.” Weic naaiv wuov norm dorngx mienh heuc Mbaa^an Be^laa^sim
Fi^li^saa^die Mienh zorqv ninh mbuo nyei miuc-fangx guangc jienv wuov biaux, Ndaawitv ziouc hatc mienh longc douz buov guangc nzengc.
Fi^li^saa^die Mienh aengx daaih luv nzunc Le^faa^im Horngz.

Ndaawitv ziouc aengx naaic nzunc Tin-Hungh. Tin-Hungh aengx dau, “Maiv dungx baengh zaqc faaux. Oix zuqc huing mingh taux ninh mbuo nyei nqa'haav nqaang, yiem yienh zouc lomc doix-ngaanc mborqv ninh mbuo.

Meih mbuo yietv haiz baeng-guanh yangh jauv mbui nyei qiex yiem yienh zouc lomc nyei ndiangx gu'nguaaic, gunv cuotv mingh mborqv aqv, weic zuqc naaiv bun cing Tin-Hungh cuotv meih mbuo nyei wuov ndaangc maengx mborqv Fi^li^saa^die Mienh nyei baeng-guanh.”
Ndaawitv ei jienv Tin-Hungh paaiv nyei waac zoux. Ninh mbuo ziouc yiem Gi^mbe^on mborqv jienv Fi^li^saa^die Mienh mingh taux Gese.
Ndaawitv nyei mengh dauh ziouc sing buangv norm-norm guoqv. Ziouv yaac bun maanc fingx gamh nziex Ndaawitv.
Ndaawitv yiem Ndaawitv Zingh weic ganh ceix ziangx hungh dinc, ninh ziouc liuc leiz dorngx aengx corng ndopv-liuh an Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang.

wuov zanc Ndaawitv gorngv, “Cuotv liuz Lewi Mienh, maiv maaih haaix dauh maaih leiz gaeng Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang, weic zuqc Ziouv ginv ninh mbuo gaeng Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang yaac yietc liuz fu-sux ninh.”
Ndaawitv ziouc heuc I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh gapv zunv yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem weic dorh Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang daaih an ninh liuc leiz ziangx nyei dorngx.
Ninh heuc Aalon nyei zeiv-fun caux Lewi Mienh daaih gapv zunv.
Yiem Ko^haatv nyei zeiv-fun daaih maaih U^li^en zoux bieiv zeiv yaac maaih yietc baeqv nyic ziepc dauh ninh nyei bungh buonc mienh.
Yiem Me^laa^li nyei zeiv-fun daaih maaih Aa^saax^yaa zoux bieiv zeiv yaac maaih nyic baeqv nyic ziepc dauh ninh nyei bungh buonc mienh.
Yiem Geson Mienh nyei zeiv-fun daaih maaih Yo^en zoux bieiv zeiv yaac maaih yietc baeqv faah ziepc dauh ninh nyei bungh buonc mienh.
Yiem E^li^saa^faan nyei zeiv-fun daaih maaih Se^mai^aa zoux bieiv zeiv yaac maaih nyic baeqv dauh ninh nyei bungh buonc mienh.
Yiem He^mbo^lon nyei zeiv-fun daaih maaih E^li^en zoux bieiv zeiv yaac maaih betv ziepc dauh ninh nyei bungh buonc mienh.
Yiem Utc^si^en nyei zeiv-fun daaih maaih Am^mi^naa^ndapc zoux bieiv zeiv yaac maaih yietc baeqv ziepc nyeic dauh ninh nyei bungh buonc mienh.
Ndaawitv aengx heuc sai mienh, Saax^ndokc caux Aa^mbi^yaa^taa, yaac heuc Lewi Mienh, U^li^en, Aa^saax^yaa, Yo^en, Se^mai^aa, E^li^en caux Am^mi^naa^ndapc.

Ndaawitv gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo se Lewi Mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv. Meih mbuo caux meih mbuo juangc fingx nyei gorx-youz oix zuqc saax ganh cing-nzengc, meih mbuo ziouc haih dorh Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang taux yie liuc leiz ziangx nyei dorngx.

Se laaix meih mbuo Lewi Mienh zinh ndaangc wuov nzunc maiv mingh gaeng naaiv norm Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang daaih, Ziouv, mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, cingx daaih qiex jiez mbuo, weic zuqc mbuo maiv naaic ninh oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor ei dingc daaih nyei leiz zoux.”
Sai mienh caux Lewi Mienh ziouc saax ganh cing-nzengc weic dorh Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang daaih.
Lewi Mienh longc gaeng Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nyei ndiangx gaeng Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang ziux Ziouv longc Mose paaiv nyei waac.

Ndaawitv mbuox Lewi Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv paaiv ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz zoux baaux nzung nyei mienh, longc ziex nyungc zoux nzung nyei jaa-sic, patv domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah, nqaapv caauh zeiv, zoux njien-youh nyei qiex mbui.
Lewi Mienh ziouc paaiv Yo^en nyei dorn, Hemaan, caux dauh ninh nyei gorx-youz, Mbe^le^ki^yaa nyei dorn, Aasaapc, caux ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz Me^laa^li Mienh, Ku^saa^yaa nyei dorn, Etaan.

Ninh mbuo aengx ginv deix ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz weic tengx ninh mbuo. Maaih Se^kaa^li^yaa, Yaa^aa^si^en, Se^mi^laa^motv, Ye^hi^en, Unni, E^li^apc, Mbe^nai^yaa, Maa^aa^se^aa, Matv^ti^ti^yaa, E^li^fe^le^hu, Mikv^ne^yaa, caux zuov gaengh mienh O^mbetc E^ndom caux Ye^hi^en.
Baaux nzung nyei mienh, Hemaan, Aasaapc caux Etaan oix zuqc nqaapv dongh siqv caauh zeiv.
Se^kaa^li^yaa, Aa^si^en, Se^mi^laa^motv, Ye^hi^en, Unni, E^li^apc, Maa^aa^se^aa caux Mbe^nai^yaa oix zuqc patv daanh baah ziux aa^laa^motv.
Matv^ti^ti^yaa, E^li^fe^le^hu, Mikv^ne^yaa, O^mbetc E^ndom, Ye^i^en caux Aa^saa^si^yaa oix zuqc patv daanh baah dorh nzung ziux se^me^nitv.
Lewi Mienh nyei bieiv zeiv Ke^naa^ni^yaa, se dorh nzung nyei bieiv, dorh ninh mbuo baaux nzung weic zuqc ninh haih haic.
Mbe^le^ki^yaa caux En^kaa^naa zoux zuov gaengh mienh zuov Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang.

Qe^mbaa^ni^yaa, Yo^saa^fatv, Ne^tan^en, Aa^maa^saix, Se^kaa^li^yaa, Mbe^nai^yaa, E^li^ ye^se, caux sai mienh oix zuqc yiem Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nza'hmien biomv nzatc. O^mbetc E^ndom caux Ye^hi^yaa yaac zoux Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nyei zuov gaengh mienh.
Ndaawitv caux I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei mienh gox caux gunv yietc cin dauh baeng nyei baeng-bieiv ziouc mingh O^mbetc E^ndom nyei biauv, njien-youh nyei dorh Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang daaih.
Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh tengx gaeng Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nyei Lewi Mienh, ninh mbuo longc siec dauh ngongh gouv caux siec dauh yungh gouv ziec.

Ndaawitv zuqv jienv la'maah ndie-muonc zoux daaih nyei lui-ndaauv. Gaeng Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nyei Lewi Mienh caux baaux nzung mienh nyei bieiv, Ke^naa^ni^yaa, caux baaux nzung nyei yietc zungv mienh, fih hnangv nyei zuqv jienv la'maah ndie-muonc. Ndaawitv yaac zuqv jienv la'maah ndie-muonc nyei efotv.

I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh ziouc njien-youh nyei heuc mbui, biomv jorng biomv nzatc, nqaapv caauh zeiv, aengx patv domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah zoux cuotv qiex mbui dorh Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang daaih.

Dorh Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang daaih taux Ndaawitv nyei Zingh nyei ziangh hoc, Saulo nyei sieqv, Mikaan, mangc cuotv fong muonh, buatc Ndaawitv Hungh zoux nauc nyitc cangx heix, ninh ziouc yiem hnyouv mangc piex Ndaawitv.

Zuangx mienh dorh Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang bieqc daaih an jienv Ndaawitv corng nyei ndopv-liuh gu'nyuoz. Ninh mbuo ziouc yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien dorh ga'naaiv fongc horc buov ziec yaac ziec weic jiu tong.
Ndaawitv fongc horc buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv caux ziec weic jiu tong nyei ga'naaiv liuz, ninh dengv Ziouv nyei mbuox tengx baeqc fingx tov fuqv.
Ninh aengx bun njuov I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh, maiv gunv m'jangc m'sieqv. Mouz dauh duqv norm njuov caux ndunh orv-ziqv caux ndunh a'ngunc biouv-nqaai.
Ndaawitv paaiv deix Lewi Mienh yiem Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nza'hmien maengx fu-sux, tengx baeqc fingx tov, yaac laengz zingh, ceng Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh.

Aasaapc zoux bieiv zeiv, Se^kaa^li^yaa zoux da'nyeic, aengx maaih Ye^i^en, Se^mi^laa^motv, Ye^hi^en, Matv^ti^ti^yaa, E^li^apc, Mbe^nai^yaa, O^mbetc E^ndom caux Ye^i^en. Ninh mbuo oix zuqc patv domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah. Aasaapc oix zuqc nqaapv caauh zeiv.
Sai mienh, Mbe^nai^yaa caux Yaa^haa^si^en, oix zuqc yiem Tin-Hungh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang zanc-zanc biomv nzatc.
Dongh wuov hnoi Ndaawitv paaiv Aasaapc caux ninh nyei gorx-youz baaux naaiv diuh singx nzung dor-ziec Ziouv.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv, jouh ninh nyei mengh, yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx zunh yaangh ninh zoux nyei sic.
Oix zuqc dorng jienv ninh baaux nzung, baaux nzung ceng ninh. Oix zuqc zunh yaangh ninh zoux yietc zungv mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Oix zuqc weic ninh nyei cing-nzengc mbuox bungx waac-maux, bun zimh lorz Ziouv wuov deix mienh nyei hnyouv njien-youh a'hneiv.
Oix zuqc zimh lorz Ziouv caux ninh nyei qaqv, zanc-zanc oix yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien.

O ninh nyei bou, I^saa^laa^en, nyei hoz doic, ninh ginv daaih nyei mienh, Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun aah! Oix zuqc jangx jienv ninh zoux liuz wuov deix mbuoqc horngh nyei sic, caux ninh zoux peix fuc nyei sic, caux ninh nyei nzuih siemv nyei waac.
Ninh se Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Ninh siemv nyei waac yiem gormx lungh ndiev.
Ninh jangx jienv ninh laengz nyei ngaengc waac taux yietc liuz, ninh hatc nyei waac weic yietc cin doic,
se caux Apc^laa^ham liepc nyei ngaengc waac, dongh ninh houv jienv laengz bun I^sakc nyei ngaengc waac.
Ninh zorqv naaiv deix ngaengc waac caux Yaakopv liepc benx leiz-latc, jiu bun I^saa^laa^en weic zoux yietc liuz nyei ngaengc waac.
Ninh gorngv, “Yie oix zorqv Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung jiu bun meih zoux meih ganh nzipc nyei buonc.”
Ninh mbuo mienh zoqc wuov zanc, se mienh za'gengh zoqc nyei, kungx dingh zepv yiem Kaa^naa^an hnangv,
ninh mbuo yiem naaiv norm deic-bung jiex wuov norm deic-bung, yiem yietc norm guoqv mingh taux ganh fingx mienh.
Ninh maiv bun haaix dauh mienh zeix ninh mbuo, weic ninh mbuo nyei gorn ninh hemx ziex dauh hungh diex.
Ninh gorngv, “Maiv dungx zoux haaix nyungc bun yie longc youh orn daaih nyei mienh, yaac maiv dungx hoic yie nyei douc waac mienh.”
Gormx lungh ndiev aah! Oix zuqc baaux nzung ceng Ziouv. Hnoi-hnoi zunh yaangh ninh nyei njoux en.
Yiem maanc guoqv zunh yaangh ninh nyei njang-laangc, yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx gorngv ninh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Weic zuqc Ziouv se hlo haic, horpc zuqc camv-camv nyei ceng. Oix zuqc taaih ninh gauh camv maanc zienh.
Weic zuqc zuangx fingx nyei yietc zungv zienh benx miuc-fangx hnangv, mv baac Ziouv zeix lungh.
Maaih njang-laangc caux haangh daauh yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien, ninh yiem nyei dorngx maaih qaqv caux njien-youh.
O mienh maanh nyei maanc fingx aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv nyei qaqv caux njang-laangc.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv puix ninh njang-laangc nyei mbuox, dorh fongc horc nyei ga'naaiv daaih yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien. Zaangc Ziouv nyei ziangh hoc oix zuqc zuqv cing-nzengc nyei lui-houx.
Gormx lungh ndiev oix zuqc sin zinx jienv yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien, baamh gen liepc duqv wuonv, maiv maaih haaix nyungc haih ndanc dongz.
Lungh aah! Oix zuqc njien-youh. Ndau aah! Oix zuqc orn-lorqc. Tov bun yiem maanc guoqv mbu'ndongx gorngv, “ Ziouv zoux hungh.”
Koiv caux yiem koiv nyei ga'naaiv oix zuqc qom qaau nyei mbui. Lingh deic caux yiem lingh deic nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv, oix zuqc njien-youh a'hneiv.
Wuov zanc lomc zaangc nyei yietc zungv ndiangx oix baaux nzung, oix yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien njien-youh nyei baaux, weic zuqc Ziouv daaih siemv lungh ndiev.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic zuqc ninh se longx haic, ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.

Yaac oix zuqc gorngv, “O yie mbuo nyei Njoux Ziouv, Tin-Hungh aah! Tov njoux yie mbuo. Tov meih zorqv yie mbuo gapv zunv daaih bun yie mbuo biaux ndutv maanc guoqv mienh, weic bun yie mbuo dor-ziec meih nyei cing-nzengc mbuox, yaac nauc nyitc nyei ceng meih.”
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh, yiem yietc liuz taux yietc liuz. Zuangx baeqc fingx ziouc gorngv, “ Aamen,” yaac gorngv, “Ceng Ziouv. ”
Ndaawitv bun Aasaapc caux ninh juangc fingx nyei gorx-youz yiem Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang nza'hmien zanc-zanc fu-sux ziux hnoi-hnoi nyei buonc gong.
Ninh yaac bun O^mbetc E^ndom caux ninh nyei luoqc ziepc betv dauh gorx-youz caux jienv ninh mbuo fu-sux. Ye^ndu^tun nyei dorn, O^mbetc E^ndom, caux jienv Hosaax, zoux zuov gaengh mienh.
Ndaawitv bun Saax^ndokc sai mienh caux ninh juangc zoux sai mienh nyei gorx-youz, yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx, Gi^mbe^on wuov, yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nza'hmien.
Ninh mbuo oix zuqc yiem buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv nyei ziec-dorngh ndorm-ndorm muonz-muonz ei fiev jienv Ziouv bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Leiz-Latc Sou fongc horc buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv.
Ninh mbuo aengx maaih Hemaan caux Ye^ndu^tun caux zengc njiec ginv daaih nyei mienh, dongh faaux jienv mbuox laengz zingh Ziouv, “Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.”
Hemaan caux Ye^ndu^tun liuc leiz nzatc caux caauh zeiv caux nyungc-nyungc nzung nyei jaa-sic weic longc baaux nzung ceng nyei ziangh hoc. Ye^ndu^tun nyei zeiv-fun duqv zoux zuov gaengh nyei mienh.
Zuangx mienh ziouc nzuonx. Gorqv-mienh nzuonx gorqv-mienh nyei biauv. Ndaawitv yaac nzuonx ganh nyei biauv weic buang waac bun ninh nyei hmuangv doic.

Ndaawitv duqv yiem jienv ganh nyei hungh dinc, ninh gorngv mbuox douc waac mienh, Naatan, “Mangc maah! Yie yiem jienv si^ndaa zongh ndiangx nyei biauv mv baac Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang corc yiem ndopv-liuh gu'nyuoz.”
Naatan dau Ndaawitv, “Yiem meih nyei hnyouv meih oix zoux haaix nyungc, gunv zoux maah! Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh caux meih yiem.”
Dongh wuov muonz Naatan duqv zipv Ziouv nyei waac gorngv,
“Mingh mbuox yie nyei bou, Ndaawitv, ‘ Ziouv hnangv naaiv nor gorngv. “Meih maiv dungx gomv biauv bun yie yiem oc.

Yiem yie dorh I^saa^laa^en Mienh cuotv I^yipv Deic-Bung taux ih hnoi yie maiv yiem jiex yietc norm biauv. Yie yiem jiex yietc norm ndopv-liuh ciangv suiv jiex ganh norm ndopv-liuh ciangv, yiem yietc norm dorngx suiv jiex ganh norm dorngx.

Da'faanh yie caux I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh suiv jiex nyei dorngx, yie maiv duqv mbuox jiex I^saa^laa^en nyei domh jien, dongh yie paaiv ziangx goux yie nyei baeqc fingx nyei haaix dauh, “Meih weic haaix diuc maiv longc si^ndaa zongh ndiangx ceix norm biauv bun yie?”+’

“Ih zanc mbuox yie nyei bou, Ndaawitv, ‘Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, “Yie zorqv meih yiem yungh ciangv bungx ba'gi yungh nyei ziangh hoc cuotv daaih, liepc meih zoux yie nyei baeqc fingx, I^saa^laa^en Mienh, nyei hungh.

Maiv gunv meih mingh haaix, yie caux meih yiem. Yiem meih nyei wuov ndaangc maengx nyei yietc zungv win-wangv yie pai guangc mi'aqv. Yie oix bun meih duqv mengh dauh hlo, ndongc lungh ndiev maaih mengh dauh hlo jiex nyei mienh.

Yie oix bun norm dorngx yie nyei baeqc fingx, I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem, yaac liepc ninh mbuo yiem wuov weic benx ninh mbuo ganh nyei dorngx, maiv zuqc aengx hnyouv lunc. Mienh waaic mienh yaac maiv duqv aengx daaih hoic ninh mbuo hnangv zinh ndaangc wuov nor,

yaac maiv hnangv yie paaiv domh jien gunv I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei ziangh hoc. Yie yaac oix hingh jiex meih nyei yietc zungv win-wangv. “+‘Maiv daan mbuoqc naaiv. Yie yaac mbuox meih, Ziouv oix ceix hoz doic zeiv-fun bun meih.
Meih nyei hnoi-nyieqc buangv, meih guei seix wuov zanc, yie oix bun meih nyei dorn, se meih ganh nyei cien dorn, duqv nzipc jienv meih zoux hungh. Yie yaac oix liepc ninh nyei guoqv wuonv.
Ninh zungv oix gomv norm biauv bun yie yiem. Yie yaac oix liepc ninh nyei weic taux yietc liuz.

Yie oix zoux ninh nyei die. Ninh yaac oix zoux yie nyei dorn. Yie oix yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv ninh, maiv zorqv nzuonx hnangv yie zorqv nzuonx, maiv hnamv dongh zoux hungh ndaangc meih wuov dauh Saulo.
Yie zungv oix liepc ninh yietc liuz gunv yie nyei baeqc fingx caux yie nyei guoqv. Ninh nyei hungh weic zungv oix liepc taux yietc liuz.”+’+”
Naatan zorqv Tin-Hungh laauc yaangh bun ninh naaiv deix yietc zungv sic gorngv mbuox Ndaawitv.

Ndaawitv Hungh ziouc bieqc mingh zueiz jienv Ziouv nyei nza'hmien gorngv, “O Ziouv Tin-Hungh aac, yie se dongh haaix dauh, yie nyei hmuangv doic yaac funx benx haaix nyungc, meih cingx daaih zoux ndongc naaiv longx bun yie?
O Tin-Hungh aac, ziux meih mangc, naaiv se faix-fiuv sic. Meih yaac gorngv taux meih nyei bou nyei hoz doic zeiv-fun. O Ziouv Tin-Hungh aac, meih mangc yie hnangv yie zoux dauh hlo jiex nyei mienh.
“Meih ndongc naaiv taaih meih nyei bou, yie, Ndaawitv, haih jaa gorngv haaix nyungc? Weic zuqc meih hiuv duqv yie, meih nyei bou.
O Ziouv aac, weic meih nyei bou yaac ziux meih ganh nyei eix, meih zoux naaiv deix yietc zungv hlo haic nyei sic, yaac laauc yaangh naaiv deix yietc zungv hlo haic nyei sic cuotv daaih.
“O Ziouv aac, ziux yie mbuo ganh nyei m'normh haiz, maiv maaih haaix dauh hnangv meih. Cuotv liuz meih, maiv maaih ganh dauh Tin-Hungh.

Aengx maaih haaix fingx hnangv meih nyei baeqc fingx, I^saa^laa^en Mienh? Yiem lungh ndiev se dongh naaiv fingx, Tin-Hungh zuoqc nzuonx zoux ganh nyei baeqc fingx. Weic bun meih ganh duqv mengh dauh hlo, meih yaac zoux domh mbuoqc horngh nyei sic, zunc cuotv ganh fingx mienh yiem meih nyei baeqc fingx nyei wuov ndaangc maengx biaux cuotv I^yipv.
Meih bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh yietc liuz zoux meih ganh nyei baeqc fingx. O Ziouv aac, meih duqv zoux ninh mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.
“O Ziouv aac, tov zorqv meih weic yie, meih nyei bou, caux yie nyei zeiv-fun laengz nyei waac liepc wuonv taux yietc liuz. Tov meih ei jienv meih gorngv nyei waac zoux.

Meih nyei mengh ziouc liepc wuonv yaac maaih mienh yietc liuz ceng weih hlo. Ninh mbuo ziouc gorngv, ‘Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv se gunv I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh. Ninh zoux I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh.’ Ndaawitv nyei douh zong yaac duqv yiem meih nyei nza'hmien liepc wuonv.

“Yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, meih laauc yaangh bun yie, meih nyei bou, hiuv duqv meih oix liepc yie nyei hoz doic zeiv-fun. Weic naaiv yie, meih nyei bou, daamv hlo nyei yiem meih nyei nza'hmien daux gaux.
Ziouv aac, meih se Tin-Hungh. Meih laengz naaiv deix longx nyei sic bun yie, meih nyei bou.

Weic naaiv tov meih a'hneiv ceix fuqv bun yie, meih nyei bou, nyei zeiv-fun weic bun ninh mbuo yietc liuz duqv yiem meih nyei nza'hmien. Ziouv aac, meih zungv ceix fuqv bun ninh mbuo yaac oix ceix fuqv ninh mbuo taux yietc liuz.”

Hoz daaih Ndaawitv mingh mborqv hingh Fi^li^saa^die Mienh, zorqv ninh mbuo yiem ninh nyei buoz-ndiev. Ninh yaac caangv duqv Fi^li^saa^die Mienh nyei Gatc Mungv caux huing gormx wuov norm mungv nyei fiuv-laangz.
Ndaawitv yaac mborqv hingh Mo^apc Mienh. Ninh mbuo ziouc zuqc yiem ninh nyei buoz-ndiev yaac cuotv nzou bun ninh.
Ndaawitv aengx mingh mborqv So^mbaa nyei hungh, Haa^ndatc^e^se, aengx mborqv jienv mingh taux Haamatv, doix Haa^ndatc^e^se cuotv mingh weic oix caangv oix gunv Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih hlen nyei dorngx.

Ndaawitv caangv duqv ninh mbuo mborqv jaax nyei maaz-cie yietc cin jaax, zaangv maaz-cie nyei baeng siec cin dauh, caux yangh ndau nyei baeng i waanc dauh. Ninh hngaqv maaz nyei domh luangc jaan dangx, kungx liouh mborqv jaax cie nyei maaz yietc baeqv dauh hnangv.
Ndaa^matv^gatc nyei Silie Mienh cuotv daaih tengx So^mbaa nyei hungh, Haa^ndatc^e^se, Ndaawitv daix ninh mbuo i waanc i cin dauh baeng daic.

Nqa'haav Ndaawitv liepc baeng-ciangv yiem Silie Mienh nyei deic, Ndaa^matv^gatc Zingh. Silie Mienh ziouc zuqc yiem Ndaawitv nyei buoz-ndiev yaac cuotv nzou bun ninh. Maiv gunv Ndaawitv mingh haaix, Ziouv bun ninh hingh jiex.
Ndaawitv yaac caangv Haa^ndatc^e^se nyei jien nanv jienv nyei jiem-torngv-baaih dorh mingh Ye^lu^saa^lem.

Ndaawitv aengx mingh Haa^ndatc^e^se nyei i norm zingh, Te^mbaa caux Kun, caangv duqv dongh siqv camv haic. Nqa'haav Saa^lo^morn longc zoux domh dongh siqv bunh caux domh ndiouh caux ziex nyungc dongh siqv nyei jaa-sic.
Haamatv nyei hungh, To^u, haiz gorngv Ndaawitv mborqv hingh So^mbaa nyei hungh, Haa^ndatc^e^se, nyei yietc zungv jun-baeng,

ninh paaiv ninh nyei dorn, Haa^ndo^lam, mingh wuic buangh Ndaawitv Hungh, gorngv waac tengx ninh a'hneiv weic ninh duqv mborqv hingh Haa^ndatc^e^se, weic zuqc Haa^ndatc^e^se zanc-zanc mingh caux To^u mborqv jaax. Haa^ndo^lam yaac dorh jienv longc jiem nyaanh caux dongh siqv zoux daaih nyei nyungc-nyungc jaa-sic fungx bun Ndaawitv.

Ndaawitv Hungh zorqv naaiv deix jaa-sic fungx bun Ziouv caux jienv ninh zorqv yiem maanc guoqv, se yiem E^ndom, Mo^apc, Ammon Mienh, Fi^li^saa^die Mienh caux Aa^maa^lekv Mienh caangv daaih nyei jiem nyaanh fungx bun Ziouv.
Se^lu^yaa nyei dorn, Aa^mbi^qai, yiem Nzauv-Horngz daix E^ndom Mienh yietc waanc hietc cin dauh.
Ninh liepc baeng-ciangv yiem E^ndom. E^ndom Mienh ziouc zuqc yiem Ndaawitv nyei buoz-ndiev. Maiv gunv ninh mingh haaix, Ziouv bun Ndaawitv hingh jiex.
Hnangv naaic, Ndaawitv gunv gormx nzengc I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung yaac weic ninh nyei zuangx baeqc fingx zoux horpc, zoux baengh fim.
Se^lu^yaa nyei dorn, Yo^aapc, zoux gauh hlo jiex nyei domh baeng-bieiv. Aa^hi^lutv nyei dorn, Ye^ho^saa^fatv, zoux fiev sou-daan nyei jien.
Aa^hi^tupv nyei dorn, Saax^ndokc, caux Aa^mbi^yaa^taa nyei dorn, Aa^hi^me^lekv, zoux sai mienh. Saa^waa^saa zoux sou-biuv.
Ye^ho^yaa^ndaa nyei dorn, Mbe^nai^yaa, gunv Ke^le^ti Mienh caux Peletv Mienh. Ndaawitv nyei dorn mbuo duqv zoux gauh hlo jiex nyei jien.
Hoz daaih Ammon Mienh nyei hungh, Naa^haatc, daic mi'aqv. Ninh nyei dorn nzipc jienv zoux hungh.

Ndaawitv gorngv, “Yie oix caux Naa^haatc nyei dorn, Haanun, zoux longx weic zuqc ninh nyei die zoux longx bun yie.” Ndaawitv ziouc paaiv deix douc fienx mienh mingh tengx ninh jaiv nzauh, weic zuqc ninh nyei die daic. Ndaawitv nyei douc fienx mienh mingh Ammon Deic, Haanun wuov, oix tengx ninh jaiv nzauh wuov zanc,

zoux hlo nyei Ammon Mienh gorngv mbuox Haanun, “Meih hnamv daaih Ndaawitv paaiv mienh daaih tengx meih jaiv nzauh se weic taaih meih nyei die fai? Ninh nyei mienh maiv zeiz daaih caaiv juoqv, zaah deic-bung, oix mbienv naaiv norm deic-bung fai?”
Haanun ziouc zorqv Ndaawitv nyei mienh, teix ninh mbuo nyei siaam yaac japv ninh mbuo nyei lui-houx nangv taux ndaamv-guh kuotv-norm, aengx bungx ninh mbuo nzuonx.

Maaih mienh zorqv naaiv deix mienh nyei sic mingh mbuox Ndaawitv wuov zanc, Ndaawitv paaiv mienh mingh zipv ninh mbuo, weic zuqc ninh mbuo za'gengh! nyaiv haic aqv. Hungh diex gorngv, “Gunv yiem Ye^li^ko zuov siaam aengx ndaauv cingx nzuonx.”

Ammon Mienh hiuv duqv Ndaawitv qiex jiez ninh mbuo, Haanun caux Ammon Mienh mingh fungx i waanc yietc cin joih nyaanh mingh Me^so^bo^de^mie, Aalam Maa^aa^kaa caux So^mbaa cingv ninh mbuo mborqv jaax nyei maaz-cie caux zaangv maaz-cie nyei baeng.

Ninh mbuo cingv duqv buo waanc i cin norm mborqv jaax nyei maaz-cie, caux jienv Maa^aa^kaa nyei hungh caux ninh nyei baeng. Ninh mbuo cuotv daaih liepc ciangv yiem Me^nde^mbaa. Ammon Mienh yaac diuc nzoih ninh mbuo nyei zingh gu'nyuoz nyei baeng cuotv daaih gapv zunv mborqv jaax.
Ndaawitv muangx haiz naaiv deix sic, ninh paaiv Yo^aapc caux ninh nyei yietc zungv mborqv jaax henv nyei baeng cuotv mingh.
Ammon Mienh cuotv daaih yiem ninh mbuo nyei zingh ziux mborqv jaax nyei yietc nyeic mbaih jienv. Daaih tengx ninh mbuo wuov deix hungh ganh yiem norm dorngx nyei ndau-huaang.

Yo^aapc buatc mborqv jaax nyei mienh yiem ninh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx caux ninh nyei nqa'haav nqaang, ninh ziouc ginv ziangx yiem I^saa^laa^en gauh henv jiex nyei baeng yaac bun ninh mbuo doix Silie Mienh mbaih jienv.
Zengc njiec nyei baeng ninh jiu bun ninh nyei youz, Aa^mbi^qai, gunv. Aa^mbi^qai yaac bun ninh mbuo doix Ammon Mienh mbaih jienv.

Yo^aapc gorngv, “Se gorngv meih buatc Silie Mienh nyei qaqv gauh henv jiex yie, meih oix zuqc gaanv daaih tengx yie. Mv baac se gorngv Ammon Mienh nyei qaqv gauh henv jiex meih, yie ziouc gaanv mingh tengx meih.
Oix zuqc henv yaac oix zuqc weic mbuo nyei mienh caux mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei zingh zoux jun-zeiv mienh. Tov Ziouv zoux ziux ninh buatc horpc zuqc zoux nyei.”
Yo^aapc caux gan ninh wuov deix baeng cuotv mingh mborqv Silie Mienh. Silie Mienh ziouc yiem Yo^aapc nyei wuov ndaangc maengx tiux biaux.
Ammon Mienh buatc Silie Mienh tiux biaux, ninh mbuo yaac yiem Yo^aapc nyei youz, Aa^mbi^qai, nyei wuov ndaangc maengx biaux bieqc zingh gu'nyuoz. Yo^aapc ziouc nzuonx Ye^lu^saa^lem.

Silie Mienh buatc ninh mbuo ganh suei I^saa^laa^en Mienh, ninh mbuo ziouc paaiv douc fienx mienh mingh lorz Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih dong bun maengx nyei Silie Mienh daaih. Haa^ndatc^e^se nyei jun-baeng nyei domh baeng-bieiv, Sofaakv, dorh ninh mbuo.

Maaih mienh gorngv mbuox Ndaawitv, Ndaawitv ziouc heuc I^saa^ laa^en nyei zuangx mienh gapv zunv jiex wuov ngaanc ziqc Jor^ndaen Ndaaih, mingh caux Silie Mienh doix hmien ziux mborqv jaax nyei yietc nyeic mbaih jienv. Ndaawitv mbaih ziangx baeng ziouc mingh mborqv Silie Mienh. Silie Mienh aengx caux ninh mbuo mborqv.

Mv baac Silie Mienh yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx biaux. Ndaawitv yaac daix Silie Mienh zaangv mborqv jaax nyei maaz-cie nyei baeng siec cin dauh caux yangh ndau nyei baeng biei waanc dauh, aengx daix Silie nyei jun-baeng-bieiv, Sofaakv.

Yiem Haa^ndatc^e^se nyei buoz-ndiev wuov deix hungh buatc ninh mbuo zuqc I^saa^laa^en Mienh mborqv baaic, ninh mbuo ziouc caux Ndaawitv gorngv horpc, aengx yiem ninh nyei buoz-ndiev. Weic naaiv yiem naaiv mingh Silie Mienh maiv kangv tengx Ammon Mienh.

Taux cun-gen hnoi, dongh zuangx hungh diex yietc gau dorh jun-baeng cuotv mingh mborqv jaax nyei ziangh hoc, Yo^aapc dorh jun-baeng cuotv mingh mborqv baaic Ammon Mienh nyei deic-bung, aengx mingh weih jienv oix mborqv Lapv^mbaa Zingh. Mv baac Ndaawitv corc yiem jienv Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei. Yo^aapc aengx mborqv Lapv^mbaa Zingh aengx baaic waaic nzengc mi'aqv.

Ndaawitv muonx ninh mbuo nyei hungh diex ndongx nyei jiem-ningv. Naaiv norm hungh ningv maaih hniev-daauh nyic ziepc yietv joih. Yiem wuov norm hungh ningv maaih norm jaaix haic nyei la'bieiv. Mienh aengx zorqv naaiv norm hungh ningv ndongx jienv Ndaawitv nyei m'nqorngv. Ninh yaac caangv duqv wuov norm zingh nyei ga'naaiv camv nyei,

aengx dorh yiem zingh gu'nyuoz nyei mienh cuotv daaih hatc ninh mbuo longc njoux, longc porng caux bouv zoux gong. Ndaawitv yaac fih hnangv nyei zoux bun Ammon Mienh nyei norm-norm zingh nyei mienh. Nqa'haav Ndaawitv caux ninh nyei zuangx jun-baeng nzuonx Ye^lu^saa^lem.

Hoz daaih I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem Gese Zingh caux Fi^li^saa^die Mienh mborqv jaax. Wuov zanc Husaa Mienh, Sipc^mbe^kai, daix dauh hlo hlang mienh nyei zeiv-fun, Sipc^bai. Fi^li^saa^die Mienh yaac zuqc suei mi'aqv.

Aengx maaih nzunc I^saa^laa^en Mienh caux Fi^li^saa^die Mienh mborqv jaax, maaih Jaa^i nyei dorn, En^haa^nan, daix Gatc Mienh, Go^li^atc, nyei youz, Laami. Naaiv dauh mienh nyei cang-baengx lomh nzenc suix ndatv ndie nyei biaav hlo.

Aengx maaih nzunc yiem Gatc Zingh mborqv jaax. Yiem wuov maaih dauh hlo hlang nyei mienh, yietc jieqv buoz maaih juqv norm buoz-ndoqv, i jieqv fih hnangv nyei. Zaux yietc bung maaih juqv norm zaux-ndoqv, i bung fih hnangv nyei. Liemh buoz liemh zaux maaih nyic ziepc feix norm. Ninh yaac zoux loz-hnoi hlo hlang nyei mienh nyei zeiv-fun.
Ninh huotv I^saa^laa^en Mienh wuov zanc, Ndaawitv nyei gorx, Si^me^aa nyei dorn, Yo^naa^taan, cuotv mingh daix ninh aqv.
Naaiv se yiem Gatc Zingh hlo hlang mienh nyei zeiv-fun. Ninh mbuo zuqc yiem Ndaawitv caux ninh nyei bou nyei buoz-ndiev zuqc daix.
Saadaan jiez daaih oix hoic I^saa^laa^en, ziouc coqv Ndaawitv saauv I^saa^laa^en Mienh.

Ndaawitv ziouc gorngv mbuox Yo^aapc caux zuangx domh baeng-bieiv, “Meih mbuo oix zuqc mingh saauv I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem Mbe^e^qe^mbaa mingh taux Ndaan. Saauv liuz, nzuonx daaih mbuox yie weic bun yie hiuv duqv maaih mbu'ziex dauh.”

Mv baac Yo^aapc gorngv, “Tov Ziouv bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx jaa hiaangx camv ih zanc maaih nyei yietc baeqv gouv. O yie nyei ziouv, hungh diex aah! Ninh mbuo yietc zungv m'daaih benx meih nyei bou maiv zeiz? Yie nyei ziouv weic haaix diuc oix hnangv naaiv nor zoux? Weic haaix diuc oix bun naaiv deix zuiz hoic zuqc I^saa^laa^en Mienh?”
Mv baac Yo^aapc maiv haih ngaengc maiv duqv hungh diex nyei waac. Ninh ziouc cuotv mingh gormx I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung, nqa'haav nzuonx taux Ye^lu^saa^lem.

Yo^aapc ziouc mingh mbuox Ndaawitv ninh saauv baeqc fingx nyei soux mouc. I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx mienh, haih zoux duqv baeng wuov deix, maaih ziepc yietv sinx dauh. Yiem Yu^ndaa Mienh zoux duqv baeng wuov deix, maaih biei sinx siec waanc dauh.
Mv baac Yo^aapc maiv saauv Lewi caux Mben^yaa^min Fingx nyei mienh, weic zuqc Yo^aapc youx haic hungh diex paaiv nyei waac.
Tin-Hungh maiv horpc hnyouv naaiv deix saauv baeqc fingx nyei sic, ninh ziouc dingc I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei zuiz.
Ndaawitv gorngv mbuox Tin-Hungh, “Yie zoux naaiv deix sic za'gengh dorngc zuiz hlo haic. Mv baac tov meih guangc yie, meih nyei bou nyei zuiz. Yie zoux naaiv deix sic za'gengh hngongx haic aqv.”
Ziouv mbuox Ndaawitv nyei douc waac mienh, Gaatc,
“Mingh mbuox Ndaawitv, ‘ Ziouv hnangv naaiv gorngv, “Yie maaih buo nyungc bun meih ginv.” Meih ginv haaix nyungc yie ziouc zoux wuov nyungc bun meih.’+”
Gaatc ziouc mingh lorz Ndaawitv yaac gorngv mbuox ninh, “ Ziouv hnangv naaiv gorngv, ‘Sueih meih ginv aqv.

Longc buo hnyangx nyei domh ngorc fai buo hlaax nyieqc zuqc win-wangv nyei nzuqc ndaauv zunc meih mbuo fai buo hnoi zuqc Ziouv nyei nzuqc ndaauv, se zuqc domh wuon-baengc, hoic I^saa^laa^en Mienh yaac zuqc Ziouv nyei fin-mienh yiem I^saa^laa^en norm-norm dorngx zoux mietc.’ Ih zanc meih hnamv mangc gaax, yie oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor dau paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh.”

Ndaawitv gorngv mbuox Gaatc, “Yie gengh haiz aqc haic aqv. Yie tov yiem Ziouv nyei buoz weic zuqc ninh za'gengh korv-lienh haic mienh. Mv baac tov maiv dungx bun yie zuqc yiem baamh mienh nyei buoz-ndiev.”
Ziouv ziouc bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh zuqc domh wuon-baengc. Maaih siec waanc dauh I^saa^laa^en Mienh daic.

Tin-Hungh yaac paaiv fin-mienh mingh mietc Ye^lu^saa^lem. Mv baac fin-mienh njiec buoz mietc nyei ziangh hoc, Ziouv buatc ziouc goiv za'eix, maiv zoux naaiv deix ciouv nyei sic. Ninh mbuox mietc mienh wuov dauh fin-mienh, “Gaux aqv! Hluotv meih nyei buoz maah!” Wuov zanc Ziouv nyei fin-mienh souv jienv yiem Ye^mbutc Mienh, Aa^laau^naa, nyei mborqv mbiauh ciangv.

Ndaawitv cau hmien mangc, buatc Ziouv nyei fin-mienh yiem lungh caux ndau mbu'ndongx. Buoz nanv jienv baeng cuotv paiv nyei nzuqc ndaauv sung jiez Ye^lu^saa^lem gu'nguaaic. Wuov zanc Ndaawitv caux mienh gox zuqv jienv la'maah ndie-cou mbaapv njiec hmien taux ndau.

Ndaawitv gorngv mbuox Tin-Hungh, “Heuc saauv baeqc fingx se dongh yie maiv zeiz? Se dongh yie baamz zuiz zoux naaiv deix waaic sic. Naaiv deix ba'gi yungh maiv zoux haaix nyungc. O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, tov bun meih nyei buoz zuqc yie caux yie ganh nyei hmuangv doic hnangv. Maiv dungx bun naaiv deix domh wuon-baengc hoic meih nyei baeqc fingx aqv.”
Ziouv nyei fin-mienh mbuox Gaatc, “Mingh mbuox Ndaawitv mingh Ye^mbutc Mienh, Aa^laau^naa, nyei mborqv mbiauh ciangv ceix norm ziec-dorngh weic Ziouv.
Ndaawitv ziouc ziux Gaatc dengv Ziouv nyei mbuox gorngv nyei waac mingh zoux.

Aa^laau^naa caux ninh nyei biei dauh dorn yiem mborqv mbiauh ciangv mborqv jienv mbiauh wuov zanc, Aa^laau^naa huin nzuonx buatc wuov dauh fin-mienh. Aa^laau^naa nyei biei dauh dorn ziouc bingx mi'aqv.
Aa^laau^naa mangc buatc Ndaawitv hungx jienv ninh daaih, ninh ziouc yiem mborqv mbiauh ciangv cuotv mingh mbaapv njiec, hmien taux ndau.

Ndaawitv gorngv mbuox Aa^laau^naa, “Tov meih zorqv meih nyei mborqv mbiauh ciangv nyei ndau maaic bun yie, yaac maaic buangv jaax-zinh. Yie oix weic Ziouv ceix norm ziec-dorngh bun baeqc fingx butv naaiv deix domh wuon-baengc dingh.”

Aa^laau^naa gorngv mbuox Ndaawitv, “Meih gunv longc aqv. Sueih yie nyei ziouv, hungh diex, zoux ziux meih buatc horpc zuqc zoux nyei. Yie zorqv naaiv deix ngongh weic zoux buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv, zorqv mborqv mbiauh nyei jaa-sic weic zoux zaangh buov, yaac zorqv naaiv deix mbiauh weic zoux fongc horc ziec nyei laangh ziqc. Naaiv deix yietc zungv yie fungx bun meih aqv.”

Mv baac Ndaawitv gorngv mbuox Aa^laau^naa, “Maiv zeiz lorqc. Oix zuqc bun buangv maaic nyei jaax-zinh. Yie maiv longc meih nyei ga'naaiv fongc horc bun Ziouv, yaac maiv longc baeqc baeqc duqv daaih nyei ga'naaiv weic buov ziec.”
Ndaawitv ziouc nziang biei joih ziepc feix lungz jiem bun Aa^laau^naa weic maaiz wuov norm dorngx nyei ndau.

Ndaawitv ziouc yiem naaic weic Ziouv ceix norm ziec-dorngh yaac ziec fongc horc buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv caux ziec weic jiu tong nyei ga'naaiv. Ninh tov Ziouv, Ziouv yaac dau ninh, bun douz yiem lungh njiec daaih yiem buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv nyei ziec-dorngh gu'nguaaic.
Ziouv ziouc hatc fin-mienh, fin-mienh zorqv ninh nyei nzuqc tapv jienv paiv.
Wuov zanc Ndaawitv buatc Ziouv yiem Ye^mbutc Mienh, Aa^laau^naa, nyei mborqv mbiauh ciangv dau ninh, ninh ziouc yiem wuov zorqv ga'naaiv fongc horc ziec.
Mose yiem deic-bung-huaang zoux zaangc Ziouv nyei ndopv-liuh caux buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv nyei ziec-dorngh se yiem Gi^mbe^on hlang nyei dorngx.
Mv baac Ndaawitv maiv haih mingh wuov naaic Tin-Hungh weic zuqc ninh gamh nziex Ziouv nyei fin-mienh nyei nzuqc ndaauv.
Ndaawitv gorngv, “Zaangc Ziouv Tin-Hungh nyei biauv oix zuqc yiem naaiv. Weic I^saa^laa^en Mienh buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv nyei ziec-dorngh yaac oix zuqc yiem naaiv.”

Ndaawitv hatc yiem I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung nyei ganh fingx mienh daaih zunv. Yiem ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx ninh paaiv deix zoux zuqc la'bieiv-zaangc liuc leiz la'bieiv weic ceix zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv.
Ndaawitv aengx liuc leiz hlieqv camv nyei weic zoux laatc gaengh nyei ding caux hlieqv-njapv, yaac liuc leiz dongh siqv camv nyei, zungv nziang maiv hingh.
Ninh aengx liuc leiz si^ndaa zongh ndiangx camv haic, zungv saauv maiv hingh aqv, weic zuqc Sai^ndorn caux Tailaqv Mienh dorh ndiangx camv! haic bun Ndaawitv.

Ndaawitv gorngv, “Yie nyei dorn, Saa^lo^morn, hnyangx-jeiv corc lunx nyei, yaac maiv gaengh duqv hoqc hiuv haaix nyungc camv. Oix weic Ziouv ceix wuov norm biauv yaac oix zuqc za'gengh zoux nzueic, maaih njang-laangc, maaih mengh dauh longx gormx lungh ndiev maanc guoqv. Weic naaiv yie oix liuc leiz ziangx ga'naaiv ceix wuov norm biauv.” Ndaawitv maiv gaengh guei seix ninh ziouc mbenc ziangx ga'naaiv camv nyei.
Ndaawitv heuc ninh nyei dorn, Saa^lo^morn, daaih jaa waac mbuox ninh, ninh oix zuqc weic Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, ceix norm biauv.
Ndaawitv gorngv mbuox ninh nyei dorn, Saa^lo^morn, “Yie nyei dorn aac, yie maaih hnyouv weic Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh, nyei Mengh ceix norm biauv.

Mv baac yie duqv Ziouv nyei waac gorngv mbuox yie, ‘Meih bun mienh nyei nziaamv liouc cuotv camv haic yaac mborqv domh jaax camv-nzunc. Meih maiv duqv weic yie nyei Mengh ceix norm biauv weic zuqc meih yiem yie nyei nza'hmien liouc mienh nyei nziaamv cuotv njiec ndau-beih camv haic.

Mangc maah! Meih oix duqv dauh dorn, se zoux taaix-baengh nyei dorn. Yie oix bun ninh taaix-baengh nyei yiem, maiv zuqc weih gormx nyei win-wangv hoic. Ninh nyei mbuox oix heuc Saa^lo^morn. Ninh gunv nyei hnoi-nyieqc yie oix bun I^saa^laa^en baengh orn taaix-baengh nyei yiem.
Ninh oix weic yie nyei Mengh ceix norm biauv. Ninh oix zoux yie nyei dorn, yie yaac oix zoux ninh nyei die. Yie oix liepc ninh nyei hungh weic yiem I^saa^laa^en taux yietc liuz.’
“Yie nyei dorn aac, tov Ziouv caux meih yiem, bun meih zoux duqv tong yaac weic Ziouv, meih nyei Tin-Hungh, ceix norm biauv, hnangv ninh gorngv meih oix zoux nor.
Tov Ziouv ceix cong-mengh bun meih haih mengh baeqc weic ninh bun meih gunv I^saa^laa^en Deic-Bung wuov zanc meih haih ei jienv Ziouv, meih nyei Tin-Hungh, nyei leiz-latc.

Hnangv naaic se gorngv meih gan longx Ziouv longc Mose jiu bun I^saa^laa^en nyei leiz-latc caux leiz meih ziouc zoux duqv tong. Meih oix zuqc henv yaac daamv hlo. Maiv dungx gamh nziex fai hnyouv namx.

“Yie zoux duqv kouv nyei, liuc leiz zoux Ziouv nyei biauv. Maaih jiem nyic ziepc yietv sinx joih, nyaanh nyic baeqv ziepc sinx joih, dongh siqv caux hlieqv camv! haic, zungv maiv haih nziang. Yie yaac liuc leiz ndiangx caux la'bieiv. Meih corc aengx oix jaa deix duqv nyei.
Meih yaac maaih zaangc mienh camv haic. Maaih zuqc la'bieiv nyei zaangc, ceix biauv nyei zaangc, ndiangx-zaangc caux maaih banh zeic zoux nyungc-nyungc gong nyei zaangc mienh
longc jiem nyaanh, dongh siqv caux hlieqv zoux nyungc-nyungc. Ih zanc jiez gorn aqv maah! Tov Ziouv caux meih yiem.”
Ndaawitv aengx paaiv I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei zuangx bieiv zeiv tengx ninh nyei dorn, Saa^lo^morn.

Ninh gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “ Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, caux meih mbuo yiem maiv zeiz? Ninh yaac bun meih mbuo feix bung taaix-baengh nyei maiv zeiz? Weic zuqc ninh zorqv naaiv norm deic-bung nyei baeqc fingx jiu bun yiem yie nyei buoz-ndiev. Naaiv norm deic-bung caux naaiv norm deic-bung nyei mienh ziouc yiem Ziouv caux ninh nyei baeqc fingx nyei buoz-ndiev.

Ih zanc meih mbuo oix zuqc liepc fiem liepc eix lorz Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Jiez gorn ceix Ziouv Tin-Hungh nyei singx dinc aqv. Hnangv naaic meih mbuo haih dorh Ziouv nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang caux Tin-Hungh nyei cing-nzengc jaa-sic bieqc daaih an jienv weic Ziouv nyei Mengh liepc daaih nyei biauv.”
Ndaawitv hnyangx-jeiv gox haic aqv, ninh liepc ninh nyei dorn, Saa^lo^morn, zoux I^saa^laa^en nyei hungh.
Ndaawitv heuc I^saa^laa^en nyei zuangx bieiv zeiv caux sai mienh caux Lewi Mienh daaih zunv.
Ninh mbuo saauv Lewi Mienh faah ziepc hnyangx faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn, yietc zungv maaih buo waanc hietc cin dauh.
Ndaawitv gorngv, “Yiem naaiv deix mienh gu'nyuoz oix zuqc maaih i waanc biei cin dauh gunv zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei gong. Maaih juqv cin oix zuqc zoux jien caux domh jien.
Maaih biei cin dauh oix zuqc zoux zuov gaengh mienh, aengx maaih biei cin dauh oix zuqc longc yie liuc leiz ziangx zoux nzung nyei jaa-sic ceng Ziouv. ”
Ndaawitv zorqv Lewi Mienh bun nqoi ziux Lewi nyei dorn, Geson, Ko^haatv caux Me^laa^li nyei bungh buonc.
Geson maaih i dauh dorn Laa^ndaan caux Si^me^i.
Laa^ndaan maaih buo dauh dorn. Dorn-hlo heuc Ye^hi^en aengx maaih Setaam caux Yo^en.
Si^me^i maaih buo dauh dorn. Maaih Se^lo^motv, Haa^si^en caux Haalaan. Naaiv se Laa^ndaan nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.
Si^me^i maaih biei dauh dorn. Maaih Yaa^haatc, Zizaa, Ye^utc caux Mbe^li^yaa. Naaiv deix biei dauh zoux Si^me^i nyei dorn.
Yaa^haatc zoux dorn-hlo, Zisaa dorn-da'naix. Mv baac Ye^utc caux Mbe^li^yaa maiv maaih dorn camv ziouc funx benx yietc bungh yaac ziux yietc bungh mienh paaiv gong.
Ko^haatv maaih biei dauh dorn. Maaih Amlaam, Itc^haa, He^mbo^lon caux Utc^si^en.

Amlaam nyei dorn maaih Aalon caux Mose. Aalon caux ninh nyei zeiv-fun ganh ca'lengc duqv ginv cuotv daaih weic yietc liuz goux gauh cing-nzengc jiex nyei ga'naaiv, weic yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien buov hung fu-sux ninh, dengv ninh nyei mengh buang waac taux yietc liuz.
Tin-Hungh nyei mienh, Mose, nyei zeiv-fun funx bieqc Lewi Fingx.
Mose nyei dorn maaih Gesom caux E^li^ye^se.
Gesom nyei dorn-hlo, Se^mbu^en.
E^li^ye^se nyei dorn-hlo, Le^hapc^yaa. E^li^ye^se maiv maaih ganh dauh dorn mv baac Le^hapc^yaa maaih dorn camv! nyei.
Itc^haa nyei dorn hlo, Se^lo^mitv.
He^mbo^lon nyei dorn maaih Ye^li^yaa zoux dorn-hlo, Aa^maa^li^yaa zoux da'nyeic dauh, Yaa^si^en zoux da'faam, Ye^kaa^me^am zoux da'feix.
Utc^si^en nyei dorn maaih Mikaa zoux dorn-hlo, Itc^si^yaa zoux da'nyeic.
Me^laa^li nyei dorn maaih Maali caux Musi. Maali nyei dorn maaih E^le^aa^saa caux Kitv.
E^le^aa^saa maiv maaih dorn, ninh daic mi'aqv. Ninh kungx maaih sieqv hnangv. Ninh mbuo nyei baeqv-muoz doic, Kitv, nyei dorn longc ninh mbuo zoux auv.
Musi maaih buo dauh dorn. Maaih Maali, E^nde caux Ye^le^motv.

Naaiv se Lewi nyei zeiv-fun ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc, se ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv, ziux mouz dauh mienh nyei mbuox nyei soux mouc fiev jienv nyic ziepc hnyangx faaux maengx nyei m'jangc dorn, yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv fu-sux wuov deix.
Ndaawitv gorngv, “Weic zuqc Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh, bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx duqv baengh orn, ninh ziouc duqv yietc liuz yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem.
Lewi Mienh ziouc maiv zuqc gaeng zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh caux yiem ndopv-liuh longc nyei jaa-sic.”
Ziux Ndaawitv paaiv nyei setv mueiz waac, oix zuqc saauv Lewi Mienh nyei m'jangc dorn yiem nyic ziepc hnyangx faaux maengx.

Lewi Mienh nyei gong se oix zuqc tengx Aalon nyei zeiv-fun zoux ninh mbuo fu-sux zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei gong. Maaih gong liuc leiz laatc gu'nyuoz nyei dorngx caux weih gormx nyei qongx-qongx, yaac oix zuqc saax yietc zungv cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv yaac zoux nyungc-nyungc gong weic fu-sux zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv.

Ninh mbuo oix zuqc liuc leiz gengx nyei njuov, fongc horc ziec nyei laangh ziqc nyei mbuonv-muonc, maiv maaih bingv nyei njuov-bieqc, ziqv daaih nyei njuov, zorpc jienv ga'lanv youh nyei njuov, aengx liuc leiz nyungc-nyungc hlaau caux ndorqc nyei ga'naaiv.
Ninh mbuo oix zuqc ndorm-ndorm souv jienv laengz zingh ceng Ziouv. Muonz-muonz fih hnangv nyei zoux.

Taux Dingh Gong Hnoi caux Siang-Hlaax caux yietc zungv dingc daaih nyei zipv, haaix zanc dorh buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv fongc horc bun Ziouv nyei ziangh hoc, yaac oix zuqc laengz zingh, ceng Ziouv ziux dingc daaih qiemx longc nyei mienh camv zoqc nyei soux mouc weic zanc-zanc yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien fu-sux.
Hnangv naaic Lewi Mienh ziouc goux Wuic Buangh nyei Ndopv-Liuh caux cing-nzengc nyei dorngx yaac tengx ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz, Aalon nyei zeiv-fun, zoux zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv fu-sux nyei gong.
Naaiv se Aalon nyei zeiv-fun ziux ninh mbuo bun nqoi nyei jauv. Aalon nyei dorn maaih Naa^ndapc, Aa^mbi^hu, E^le^aa^saa caux I^taa^maa.
Mv baac Naa^ndapc caux Aa^mbi^hu daic ndaangc ninh mbuo nyei die, yaac maiv maaih fu'jueiv. E^le^aa^saa caux I^taa^maa ziouc zoux sai mienh nyei gong.

E^le^aa^saa nyei zeiv-fun, Saax^ndokc, caux I^taa^maa nyei zeiv-fun, Aa^hi^me^lekv, tengx Ndaawitv zorqv ninh mbuo juangc fingx nyei gorx-youz bun nqoi benx yietc guanh yietc guanh ziux paaiv ziangx oix zuqc fu-sux nyei gong.

Yiem E^le^aa^saa nyei zeiv-fun maaih bungh buonc nyei bieiv zeiv gauh camv yiem I^taa^maa nyei zeiv-fun. Ninh mbuo ziux naaic bun nqoi. E^le^aa^saa nyei zeiv-fun maaih ziepc luoqc dauh bieiv zeiv, I^taa^maa nyei zeiv-fun maaih hietc dauh.
Ninh mbuo ziouc dingc maengc mangc, bun nqoi gong fih hnangv nzengc weic zuqc E^le^aa^saa nyei zeiv-fun caux I^taa^maa nyei zeiv-fun maaih singx dinc nyei bieiv zeiv caux Tin-Hungh nyei bieiv zeiv.

Lewi Mienh, Ne^tan^en nyei dorn, Se^mai^aa sou-biuv, dorng jienv hungh diex caux jien fiev ninh mbuo nyei mbuox. Maaih Saax^ndokc sai mienh caux Aa^mbi^yaa^taa nyei dorn, Aa^hi^me^lekv, caux Lewi Mienh caux sai mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv mangc jienv. Ninh mbuo tiuv jienv ginv dauh E^le^aa^saa wuov jauv nyei bieiv zeiv aengx ginv dauh I^taa^maa wuov jauv nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv.
Dingc maengc mangc ginv da'yietv dauh maaih Ye^ho^yaa^lipv, da'nyeic dauh, Ye^ndaa^yaa,
da'faam dauh, Haalim, da'feix dauh, Se^o^lim,
da'hmz dauh, Man^ki^yaa, da'luoqc dauh, Mi^yaa^min,
da'cietv dauh, Hakv^kotc, da'betv dauh, Aa^mbi^yaa,
da'juov dauh, Ye^su^aa, da'ziepc dauh, Se^kaa^ni^yaa,
ziepc yietv wuov dauh, E^li^yaa^sipv, ziepc nyeic wuov dauh, Yaakim,
ziepc faam wuov dauh, Hupc^baa, ziepc feix wuov dauh, Ye^se^mbe^apc,
ziepc hmz wuov dauh, Mbin^gaa, ziepc luoqc wuov dauh, Imme,
ziepc cietv wuov dauh, Hesi, ziepc betv wuov dauh, Hapc^bitc^setv,
ziepc juov wuov dauh, Be^taa^hi^yaa, nyic ziepc wuov dauh, Ye^he^se^ken,
nyic ziepc yietv wuov dauh, Yaakin, nyic ziepc nyeic wuov dauh, Gaamun,
nyic ziepc faam wuov dauh, Nde^lai^yaa, nyic ziepc feix wuov dauh, Maa^aa^si^yaa.

Naaiv deix mienh se ziux paaiv daaih nyei gong-buonc bieqc zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv fu-sux. Ninh mbuo ei ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix, Aalon, liepc daaih nyei leiz, se ziux Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, hatc ninh nyei waac.
Naaiv se Lewi Mienh zengc njiec nyei zeiv-fun. Amlaam nyei zeiv-fun maaih Se^mbu^en, Se^mbu^en nyei zeiv-fun maaih Ye^nde^yaa.
Le^hapc^yaa nyei zeiv-fun da'yietv dauh, Itc^si^yaa.
Itc^haa Mienh nyei zeiv-fun maaih Se^lo^motv, Se^lo^motv nyei zeiv-fun maaih Yaa^haatc.
He^mbo^lon nyei zeiv-fun, maaih Ye^li^yaa zoux da'yietv, Aa^maa^li^yaa zoux da'nyeic, Yaa^haa^si^en zoux da'faam, Ye^kaa^me^am zoux da'feix.
Utc^si^en nyei zeiv-fun maaih Mikaa, Mikaa nyei zeiv-fun maaih Saami.
Mikaa nyei youz se Itc^si^yaa, Itc^si^yaa nyei zeiv-fun maaih Se^kaa^li^yaa.
Me^laa^li nyei dorn maaih Maali caux Musi. Yaa^aa^si^yaa nyei dorn maaih Mbeno.
Me^laa^li nyei zeiv-fun maaih Yaa^aa^si^yaa nyei zeiv-fun Mbeno, So^ham, Sakc^ge caux Ipc^li.
Maali nyei zeiv-fun maaih E^le^aa^saa. E^le^aa^saa maiv maaih dorn.
Maaih Kitv nyei dorn, Ye^laa^me^en.
Musi nyei zeiv-fun maaih Maali, E^nde caux Ye^li^motv. Naaiv se Lewi Mienh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bungh buonc.

Dorn-hlo caux dorn-faix nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv fih hnangv ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz, Aalon nyei zeiv-fun, dorng jienv Ndaawitv Hungh, Saax^ndokc, Aa^hi^me^lekv caux Lewi Fingx nyei zuangx mienh caux sai mienh nyei bungh buonc bieiv zeiv dingc maengc mangc.

Ndaawitv caux zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei jien ganh ca'lengc paaiv deix Aasaapc, Hemaan caux Ye^ndu^tun nyei zeiv-fun patv domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah, nqaapv caauh zeiv, douc Tin-Hungh nyei waac.
Maaih Aasaapc nyei biei dauh dorn. Maaih Sakc^ge, Yosepv, Ne^taa^ni^yaa caux Aa^qaa^le^laa. Aasaapc dorh ninh mbuo. Aasaapc yaac douc Tin-Hungh nyei waac ziux hungh diex paaiv.

Maaih Ye^ndu^tun nyei juqv dauh dorn Ge^ndaa^li^yaa, Seli, Ye^saa^yaa, Si^me^i, Haa^saa^bi^yaa caux Matv^ti^ti^yaa. Ninh mbuo nyei die, Ye^ndu^tun, dorh ninh mbuo. Ye^ndu^tun douc Tin-Hungh nyei waac, longc daanh baah laengz zingh yaac ceng Ziouv.

Maaih Hemaan nyei ziepc feix dauh dorn Mbukc^ki^yaa, Matv^taa^ni^yaa, Utc^si^en, Se^mbu^en, Ye^li^motv, Haa^nan^yaa, Haa^naa^ni, E^li^yaa^taa, Gitc^ndaan^ti Lo^mam^ti E^se, Yotv^mbe^kaa^saa, Man^lo^ti, Hoti caux Maa^haa^si^otc.
Naaiv deix yietc zungv zoux hungh diex nyei douc waac mienh, Hemaan, nyei dorn. Tin-Hungh ziux ninh laengz taaih Hemaan nyei waac ceix bun Hemaan duqv ziepc feix dauh dorn, buo dauh sieqv.

Naaiv deix yietc zungv mienh maaih ninh mbuo nyei die dorh weic nqaapv caauh zeiv, patv domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah, baaux nzung yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv, yiem Tin-Hungh nyei biauv fu-sux. Aasaapc, Ye^ndu^tun caux Hemaan yaac ziux hungh diex paaiv nyei waac zoux.
Ninh mbuo caux ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz, dongh hoqc duqv nzung nyei jauv liouc nyei weic ceng Ziouv, yietc zungv maaih nyic baeqv betv ziepc betv dauh.
Naaiv deix yietc zungv maiv gunv gox lunx, fin-saeng fai horqc saeng, dingc maengc mangc weic bun nqoi gong.

Dingc da'yietv nzunc, se Aasaapc nyei buonc, ndortv zuqc Yosepv, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh. Da'nyeic nzunc ndortv zuqc Ge^ndaa^li^yaa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Da'faam nzunc ndortv zuqc Sakc^ge, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Da'feix nzunc ndortv zuqc I^saa^li, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Da'hmz nzunc ndortv zuqc Ne^taa^ni^yaa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Da'luoqc nzunc ndortv zuqc Mbukc^ki^yaa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Da'cietv nzunc ndortv zuqc Ye^saa^le^laa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Da'betv nzunc ndortv zuqc Ye^saa^yaa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Da'juov nzunc ndortv zuqc Matv^taa^ni^yaa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Da'ziepc nzunc ndortv zuqc Si^me^i, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc yietv wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Aa^saa^len, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc nyeic wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Haa^saa^bi^yaa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc faam wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Su^mbaa^en, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc feix wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Matv^ti^ti^yaa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc hmz wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Ye^le^motv, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc luoqc wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Haa^nan^yaa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc cietv wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Yotv^mbe^kaa^saa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc betv wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Haa^naa^ni, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Ziepc juov wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Man^lo^ti, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Nyic ziepc wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc E^li^yaa^taa, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Nyic ziepc yietv wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Hoti, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Nyic ziepc nyeic wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Gitc^ndaan^ti, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Nyic ziepc faam wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Maa^haa^si^otc, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Nyic ziepc feix wuov nzunc ndortv zuqc Lo^mam^ti E^se, caux ninh nyei dorn, ninh nyei gorx-youz, ziepc nyeic dauh.
Zuov gaengh nyei guanh guanh mienh maaih hnangv naaiv. Kolaa Mienh maaih Ko^le nyei dorn, Me^se^le^mi^yaa, se yietc dauh Aasaapc nyei zeiv-fun.
Me^se^le^mi^yaa maaih dorn nyei. Dorn-hlo, Se^kaa^li^yaa, da'nyeic dauh, Ye^ndi^yaa^en, da'faam dauh, Se^mbaa^ndi^yaa, da'feix dauh, Yaatv^ni^en,
da'hmz dauh, Elaam, da'luoqc dauh, Ye^ho^haa^nan, da'cietv dauh, E^li^ho^nai.
O^mbetc E^ndom yaac maaih dorn nyei. Dorn-hlo, Se^mai^aa, da'nyeic dauh, Ye^ho^saa^mbaatc, da'faam dauh, Yo^aa, da'feix dauh, Saax^kaa, da'hmz dauh, Ne^tan^en
da'luoqc dauh, Am^mi^en, da'cietv dauh, Itc^saax^kaa, da'betv dauh, Be^un^le^tai, weic zuqc Tin-Hungh ceix fuqv bun O^mbetc E^ndom.
Ninh nyei dorn, Se^mai^aa, yaac maaih dorn nyei. Ninh mbuo gunv ninh mbuo nyei die nyei jaa-dingh weic zuqc ninh mbuo haih haic.
Se^mai^aa nyei dorn maaih Otc^ni, Le^faa^en, O^mbetc caux En^saa^mbaatc. Ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz, E^li^hu caux Se^maa^ki^yaa, yaac zoux maaih banh zeic nyei mienh.

Naaiv deix yietc zungv se O^mbetc E^ndom nyei zeiv-fun. Ninh mbuo caux ninh mbuo nyei dorn caux ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz maaih banh zeic, maaih qaqv puix zoux singx dinc nyei gong. O^mbetc E^ndom nyei zeiv-fun yietc zungv maaih luoqc ziepc nyeic dauh.
Me^se^le^mi^yaa maaih dorn caux gorx-youz zoux maaih banh zeic nyei mienh yietc zungv maaih ziepc betv dauh.
Me^laa^li nyei zeiv-fun, Hosaax, maaih dorn nyei. Da'yietv dauh Simli, (maiv gunv ninh maiv zeiz dorn-hlo, ninh nyei die paaiv ninh zoux bieiv zeiv),
da'nyeic dauh Hin^ki^yaa, da'faam dauh Te^mbaa^li^yaa, da'feix dauh Se^kaa^li^yaa. Hosaax nyei dorn caux gorx-youz yietc zungv maaih ziepc faam dauh.
Naaiv deix zuov gaengh nyei guanh ziux ninh mbuo nyei bieiv zeiv maaih gong yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv fu-sux hnangv ninh mbuo nyei gorx-youz nor.
Maiv gunv hlo faix, ninh mbuo ziux bungh buonc dingc maengc mangc gaax haaix dauh zuov haaix dauh gaengh.

Ndortv zuqc Se^le^mi^yaa zuov Dong Bung Gaengh. Ninh mbuo yaac weic ninh nyei dorn, Se^kaa^li^yaa, dingc maengc mangc, se yietc dauh caangh laangh nyei mienh guai mienh, maaih cong-mengh nyei mienh. Ndortv zuqc ninh oix zuqc zuov Baqv Bung Gaengh.
Ndortv zuqc O^mbetc E^ndom zuov Naamh Bung Gaengh. Ndortv zuqc ninh nyei dorn zuov siou ga'naaiv nyei biauv.
Ndortv zuqc Supv^bim caux Hosaax zuov Fai Bung Gaengh caux yiem faaux wuov jiex nyei jauv nyei San^le^ketv Gaengh. Ninh mbuo zuov gaengh yietc guanh jiex yietc guanh.
Mouz hnoi zuov zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv dong bung maaih juqv dauh, baqv bung maaih biei dauh, naamh bung maaih biei dauh. Yaac maaih i dauh zuov siou ga'naaiv wuov biauv.
Yiem fai bung maengx, maaih biei dauh zuov wuov jauv, maaih i dauh zuov yiem biauv nyei ga'nyiec maengx, laatc gu'nyuoz.
Naaiv se Kolaa caux Me^laa^li nyei zeiv-fun ziux ninh mbuo bun nqoi zoux zuov gaengh nyei guanh.
