Ninh zoux hlo nyei sic zungv hnamv maiv zaaic, yaac zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic zungv saauv maiv hingh.
Ninh bun mbiungc njiec ndau-beih, bun wuom yungz liangx-ndeic.
Ninh zorqv zoux faix nyei mienh bouh faaux hlang, yaac bun nzauh nyiemv nyei mienh duqv yiem longx.
Ninh porx waaic guv guaix mienh daav nyei za'eix, ninh mbuo nyei buoz ziouc zoux maiv cuotv haaix nyungc.
Ninh bun cong-mengh mienh zuqc ninh mbuo ganh nyei za'eix hlopv ninh mbuo, yaac bun guv guaix mienh nyei za'eix siepv-siepv nyei zuqc mietc.
Yiem lungh hnoi zanc ninh mbuo buangh zuqc hmuangx, lungh aanx zanc huaax naaiv huaax wuov hnangv lungh muonz zanc nor.
Mv baac Tin-Hungh njoux mienh jomc mienh biaux ndutv, maiv zuqc mienh zeix. Bun dangx-donx nyei mienh biaux ndutv mienh henv mienh nyei buoz.
Hnangv naaic mienh jomc mienh maaih lamh hnamv dorngx, maiv baengh fim nyei mienh yaac nqapc jienv nzuih.
“Tin-Hungh gorngv-njaaux nyei mienh maaih orn-lorqc. Weic naaiv maiv dungx mangc piex Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh mborqv njaaux
weic zuqc Tin-Hungh bun zuqc mun, mv baac ninh beu jienv, ninh mborqv, mv baac ninh nyei buoz zorc longx.
Ninh oix njoux meih biaux ndutv juqv nzunc zeqc naanc, taux siec nzunc zeqc naanc, maiv maaih haaix nyungc hoic meih.
Ngorc hnaangx nyei ziangh hoc, ninh njoux meih biaux ndutv, maiv zuqc daic. Mborqv jaax nyei ziangh hoc ninh njoux biaux ndutv nzuqc ndaauv nyei qaqv.
Ninh beu jienv meih, maiv bun zuqc gorngv waac-huv nyei mienh hoic. Zuqc mietc nyei ziangh hoc taux, meih yaac maiv gamh nziex.
Meih buangh zuqc mietc nyei sic caux ngorc hnaangx meih ziouc kuh jatv. Meih yaac maiv gamh nziex ndau-beih nyei hieh zoih.
Weic zuqc meih zoux nyei ndeic zungv maiv maaih la'bieiv, yiem ndeic nyei hieh zoih yaac oix caux meih horpc.
Meih ziouc hiuv duqv meih nyei ndopv-liuh yiem longx nyei. Meih zaah mangc meih nyei ba'gi yungh laanh yaac buatc maiv caa haaix nyungc.
Meih zungv oix hiuv duqv meih nyei fun-faqv oix hiaangx camv, meih nyei zeiv-fun yaac ndongc ndau-beih nyei miev.
Meih nyei siouc nyuonh ndaauv, hnyangx-jeiv gox meih cingx taux zouv, hnangv mbiauh zeiv taux ziangh hoc siou.”
“Naaiv deix yietc zungv yie mbuo longx-longx nyei zaah mangc liuz aqv. Muangx maah! Oix zuqc hiuv duqv se weic tengx meih duqv longx.”
Yopv ziouc dau,
“Feix duqv haih zorqv yie nzauh faanh nyei jauv daaih nziang, yie nyei yietc zungv kouv naanc an jienv tin-baengh nziangx,
zungv gauh hniev koiv nyei saa-ziou. Weic naaiv yie nyei waac beqv nyei,
weic zuqc Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh nyei forng-cang yiem yie nyei sin, forng-cang nyei ndie-doqc biaux gormx sin, yie zuqc Tin-Hungh longc nyungc-nyungc haeqv yie.
Hieh lorh maaih miev nyanc, ninh heuc nyei fai? Ngongh maaih mbiauh nqaauv nyanc, ninh heuc nyei fai?
Maiv maaih mueix nyei ga'naaiv maiv an nzauv haih nyanc duqv nyei fai? Jaux-orv maaih haaix nyungc mueix doc fai?
Weic yie naaiv se gamh nziev nyei ga'naaiv, yie nyei hnyouv siouc maiv duqv.
“Feix duqv ziux yie tov nyei yie gengh haih duqv, Tin-Hungh yaac oix ceix bun dongh yie oix duqv nyei.
Feix duqv Tin-Hungh hlienx yie huv muonc, sung ninh nyei buoz pai yie guangc.
Hnangv naaic zoux haih orn yie nyei hnyouv, maiv gunv yie nyei baengc siem yie zungv njien-youh nyei tiux, weic zuqc yie maiv ngaengc Cing-Nzengc Wuov Dauh nyei waac.
“Yie maaih haaix nyungc qaqv bun yie corc haih zuov jienv? Yie nyei setv mueiz hnangv haaix nor, yie cingx daaih oix zuqc maaih noic diev?
Yie nyei qaqv se la'bieiv nyei qaqv fai? Yie nyei orv sin benx dongh siqv fai?
Yie ganh zungv maiv maaih qaqv tengx yie ganh aqv. Yie yaac jomc za'eix mi'aqv.
“Haaix dauh duqv-eix maiv zoux longx bun ninh nyei loz-gaeng doic, wuov dauh guangc, maiv taaih Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh.
Yie nyei gorx-youz nduov yie hnangv wuom-seix, aengx hnangv ndoqv-zuonx haih nqaai nzengc.
Ndoqv gitv sorng ziouc hmuangx, sorng yaac ndui gu'nguaaic torngv jienv.
Yuoqv nyei ziangh hoc sorng yuqc mi'aqv. Nyutc jorm ziouc mitc nzengc, maiv yiem ninh nyei dorngx.
Gapv doic cuotv jauv nyei mienh leih ninh mbuo nyei jauv, ninh mbuo bieqc deic-bung-huaang ziouc zuqc mietc.
Yiem Temaa Deic gapv doic cuotv jauv nyei mienh lorz wuom, Qe^mbaa nyei jiex jauv saeng-eix mienh maaih lamh hnamv.
Ninh mbuo maaih lamh hnamv haih duqv mv baac maiv duqv aqv. Mingh taux wuov ninh mbuo ziouc hnyouv lunc nzengc.
Ih zanc meih mbuo weic yie se hnangv naaic aqv. Meih mbuo buatc yie zuqc kouv nyei sic ziouc haeqv meih mbuo gamh nziex.
Yie gorngv jiex ‘Tov meih mbuo bun zingh nyeic yie’? Fai ‘Longc meih mbuo nyei zinh zoih nzuiz nyaanh hmuangx bun yie’?
Fai yie gorngv jiex ‘Njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei win-wangv nyei buoz-ndiev’? Fai ‘Zuoqc yie yiem zeix mienh nyei mienh nyei buoz-ndiev cuotv daaih’?
“Njaaux yie maah! Yie ziouc maiv ko lo. Tov bun yie bieqc hnyouv yie hnangv haaix nor zoux dorngc.
Zingx nyei waac maaih hatc maaz hlo, meih mbuo gorngv-hemx mv baac gorngv-hemx haaix nyungc?
Maiv lamh hnamv nyei mienh gorngv nyei waac se hnangv nziaaux nor, wuov nyungc meih mbuo weic haaix diuc oix dau wuov deix waac?
Meih mbuo zungv dingc maengc mangc weic duqv guh hanh fu'jueiv, yaac maaic ganh nyei loz-gaeng doic weic duqv nyaanh.
“Ih zanc tov meih mbuo mangc yie, yie maiv dorng jienv meih mbuo gorngv-baeqc.
Tov meih mbuo aengx hnamv nzunc. Maiv dungx zoux maiv baengh fim. Ih zanc tov aengx hnamv nzunc. Oix zuqc bun cing yie zoux duqv zingx nyei.
Yie gorngv nyei waac maaih haaix nyungc dorngc fai? Meih mbuo hnamv daaih yie maiv haih seix maiv cuotv zeqc naanc?
“Baamh mienh yiem lungh ndiev kungx zuqc zoux kouv, ninh nyei hnoi-nyieqc hnangv zuqc maaic gong nyei mienh,
hnangv nouh za'gengh oix lorz dorngx bingx laangh, hnangv maaic gong nyei mienh zuov ninh nyei gong-zinh.
Fih hnangv nyei, yie hlaax jiex hlaax ziangh jienv maiv lamh longc, yaac muonz jiex muonz zuqc diev kouv.
Yie bueix njiec nyei ziangh hoc, yie gorngv, ‘Yie taux haaix zanc cingx duqv jiez sin?’ Mv baac lungh muonz zanc ndaauv haic. Yie kungx mbienv mingh mbienv daaih, noic maiv duqv lungh njang.
Yie nyei sin butv gaeng buangv nzengc, nie-mbung yaac dorngx lui zuqv. Yie nyei ndopv butv faang, aengx nzaeqv, butv nongc.
“Yie nyei hnoi-nyieqc gauh siepv nzenc suix ndatv ndie nyei biaav, taux setv mueiz yaac maiv lamh hnamv dorngx aqv.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov jangx jienv oc, yie nyei maengc se hnangv tauv yietc nzunc qiex. Yie nyei m'zing maiv duqv aengx buatc longx nyei jauv.
Ih zanc mangc jienv yie wuov dauh nyei m'zing maiv duqv aengx buatc yie. Meih oix lorz yie, mv baac yie maiv yiem aqv.
“Hnangv mbuonx nzaanx mitc nzengc, mienh njiec yiemh gen maiv haih aengx faaux daaih.
Ninh maiv aengx nzuonx ganh nyei biauv. Ninh yiem nyei dorngx nyei mienh yaac la'kuqv ninh mi'aqv.
“Weic naaiv yie ziouc maiv nqapc yie nyei nzuih, yie nyei hnyouv mun jienv oix gorngv aqv. Yie hnyouv kouv haic ziouc oix zuqc gorngv.
Yie zoux koiv fai koiv nyei domh mbiauz meih cingx oix zuqc bun mienh zuov jienv yie?
Yie gorngv, ‘Yie nyei coux haih tengx yie kuh yiem. Yie bueix nyei dorngx haih jaiv deix yie nyei kouv naanc.’
Mv baac meih bun yie mbeix buatc haeqv yie, longc hinc yaangh nyei sic bun yie gamh nziex haic.
Weic naaiv yie oix ginv goh jaang daic gauh longx yiem jienv yie naaiv norm sin.
Yie youx yie nyei maengc, maiv oix yietc liuz ziangh. Bungx yie, sueih yie ganh yiem, weic zuqc yie nyei hnoi-nyieqc kungx hnangv tauv yietc nzunc qiex.
“Baamh mienh benx haaix nyungc meih cingx funx longc jienv yaac hietv hnyouv ninh?
Meih ndorm-ndorm mingh zaah mangc ninh, mouz buon ziangh hoc yaac kauv ninh.
Aengx ndongc haaix lauh meih cingx huin ganh bung maiv mangc yie, fai bungx yie ganh yiem taux haih duqv naqv aax yie nyei wuom-nzuih?

Mangc mienh nyei Tin-Hungh aah? Se gorngv yie baamz zuiz yie hnangv haaix nor hoic zuqc meih? Meih weic haaix diuc zorqv yie dorngx meih nyei forng-cang nyei mbaeqc? Yie weic haaix diuc benx meih oix zuqc ndaam hniev nyei ga'naaiv?
Meih weic haaix diuc maiv guangc yie dorngc nyei dorngx, yaac zorqv nqoi yie nyei zuiz? Weic zuqc maiv lauh yie oix bueix nie-mbung gu'nyuoz. Meih oix lorz yie mv baac yie maiv yiem aqv.”
Quwaa Mienh, Mbin^ndatc, ziouc dau,
“Naaiv deix waac meih oix gorngv taux haaix zanc? Meih nyei waac hnangv nziaaux buonc nor.
Tin-Hungh haih zoux baengh fim nyei jauv pien fai? Fai Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh haih bun zoux horpc nyei jauv pien mingh fai?
Se gorngv meih nyei fu'jueiv baamz zuiz dorngc Tin-Hungh, ninh ziux ninh mbuo zoux nyei sic bun ninh mbuo zuqc dingc zuiz.
Se gorngv meih jienh lorz Tin-Hungh yaac jouh Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh,
se gorngv meih cing-nzengc, hnyouv zingx nyei, ninh zungv oix weic meih jiez daaih, aengx bun meih nyei jaa-dingh nzuonx daaih hnangv loz wuov nor.
Maiv gunv meih jiez gorn wuov zanc meih faix nyei, setv mueiz nyei hnoi-nyieqc meih ziouc duqv zoux hlo.
“Yie tov meih, naaic loz-hnoi mienh yaac hnamv mangc gaax ong-taaix mbuo lorz buatc haaix nyungc,
weic zuqc yie mbuo a'hnoi koqv hoqc cuotv seix, maiv hiuv haaix nyungc. Yie mbuo yaac yiem baamh gen hnangv dongh linh nor.
Ninh mbuo oix njaaux meih, mbuox meih, ziux ninh mbuo mengh baeqc gorngv cuotv maiv zeiz?
Maiv maaih njaangh, cie-doix yienh miev haih cuotv nyei fai? Maiv maaih wuom, luoqc diqc haih hiaangx nyei fai?
Corc maeng nyei ziangh hoc maiv gaatv nor, beiv ganh nyungc miev, ninh nqaai ndaangc jiex.
Da'faanh la'kuqv Tin-Hungh nyei mienh yaac hnangv wuov nor. Maiv gan Tin-Hungh nyei mienh maaih lamh hnamv nyei, zungv oix zuqc mietc.
Ninh kaux nyei jauv dangx mi'aqv. Ninh kaux nyei se hnangv gaeng-nyorc mbiorngz nor.
Ninh bangc ninh nyei biauv, mv baac biauv yiem maiv jienv. Ninh nanv jienv biauv mv baac biauv maiv wuonv.
Ninh se hnangv miev, nyutc njang nyei ziangh hoc hiaangx daaih, ninh nyei luangh louc buangv ninh nyei huingx.
Ninh nyei nzungh nzenc jienv la'bieiv, aengx njiec mingh bieqc la'bieiv-qangx.
Mv baac se gorngv ninh yiem wuov norm dorngx zuqc baeng cuotv, wuov norm dorngx ziouc maiv nyiemc ninh aengx gorngv, ‘Yie zungv maiv buatc jiex meih.’
Mangc maah! Naaiv se ninh nyei jauv nyei njien-youh. Ganh deix mienh oix yiem wuov ndau cuotv daaih.
“Mangc maah! Tin-Hungh zungv maiv guangc maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei mienh. Yaac maiv tengx zoux orqv nyei mienh.
Ninh oix bun meih nyei nzuih aengx a'hneiv nyei jatv, yaac bun meih nyei nzuih njien-youh nyei heuc.
Nzorng meih wuov deix oix zuqc baaic hmien nyaiv, orqv mienh nyei ndopv-liuh yangh naaiv jiex maiv maaih aqv.”
Yopv ziouc dau,
“Yie za'gengh hiuv duqv se hnangv naaic. Mv baac mienh hnangv haaix nor haih yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien benx zoux duqv horpc nyei mienh?
Se gorngv haaix dauh maaih hnyouv oix caux ninh nzaeng, ninh gorngv yietc cin nzunc, mienh yaac maiv haih dau yietc nzunc.
Tin-Hungh nyei hnyouv maaih cong-mengh, ninh nyei qaqv yaac henv. Haaix dauh haih ngaengc Tin-Hungh yaac ngaengc duqv hingh?
“Ninh qiex jiez wuov zanc, ninh zorqv mbong mbienv nzuonx daaih. Ninh suiv mbong, mbong zungv maiv hiuv.
Tin-Hungh nqamv baamh gen dongz cuotv ninh nyei dorngx, ndau nyei ndiouh yaac dongz nzengc.
Ninh hatc mba'hnoi, mba'hnoi ziouc maiv cuotv, ninh aengx buang jienv zuangx hleix.
Ninh ganh nduqc dauh corng lungh, yaac caaiv koiv nyei wuom-laangc.
Ninh zeix Ba'dauv Hleix caux Siec Muoz-Sieqv Hleix, Faam-Cing Hleix caux naamh bung nyei hleix.
Ninh zoux hlo haic nyei sic jiex ndaangc yie mbuo haih mengh baeqc, zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic zungv saauv maiv hingh.
Tin-Hungh yangh yie nyei ga'hlen jiex, yie yaac mangc maiv buatc. Ninh yangh nza'hmien maengx jiex, yie yaac maiv hiuv.
Ninh zorqv ninh oix longc nyei, maiv maaih haaix dauh haih laanh ninh. Haaix dauh gaamv naaic ninh, ‘Meih zoux haaix nyungc?’
Tin-Hungh maiv bun ninh nyei ga'qiex fiu, ninh bun tengx Laa^hapc wuov deix zuqc yiem ninh nyei zaux-ndiev.
“Wuov nyungc yie hnangv haaix nor haih dau ninh? Yie hnangv haaix nor haih ginv waac caux ninh luonx?
Maiv gunv yie maiv zoux dorngc, yie yaac maiv haih dau ninh. Yie oix zuqc tov siemv yie wuov dauh korv-lienh yie.
Se gorngv yie heuc ninh, ninh yaac dau yie, yie zungv maiv sienx ninh muangx yie nyei qiex.
Ninh longc domh nziaaux buonc mborqv yie, bun yie zuqc mun nyei dorngx camv jienv faaux yaac maiv maaih gorn-baengx.
Ninh zungv maiv bun yie tauv qiex, daaux nzuonx bun yie nyei maengc kouv taux ndiev.
Se gorngv saaix qaqv, mangc maah! Ninh ndongc haaix henv! Se gorngv weic siemv zuiz nyei jauv, haaix dauh haih heuc ninh daaih?
Maiv gunv yie maiv dorngc, yie ganh nyei nzuih oix dingc yie maaih zuiz. Maiv gunv yie maiv maaih dorngx nqemh, ninh oix bun cing yie dorngc.
“Yie maiv maaih dorngx nqemh, mv baac yie maiv gunv ganh aqv. Yie youx haic yie nyei maengc.
Yietc zungv fih hnangv nzengc. Weic naaiv yie gorngv, maiv gunv maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei mienh caux orqv mienh, ninh mietc nzengc mi'aqv.
Mienh zuqc zeqc naanc liemh zeih daic, Tin-Hungh jatv maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh buangh nyei zeqc naanc.
Tin-Hungh zorqv baamh gen jiu bun yiem orqv mienh nyei buoz-ndiev. Ninh buang jienv baamh gen siemv zuiz mienh nyei hmien. Se gorngv maiv zeiz ninh, benx haaix dauh?
“Yie nyei hnoi-nyieqc jiex siepv hnangv saaix tiux nyei mienh tiux nor. Yie nyei hnoi liemh zeih jiex mi'aqv, yaac maiv buatc haaix nyungc longx.
Yie nyei hnoi jiex siepv hnangv siepv haic nyei nzangv nor, hnangv domh jaangv njiec siepv zorqv ga'naaiv nyanc.
Se gorngv yie gorngv, ‘Yie oix la'kuqv yie ngopv nyei sic, yie oix guangc nqoi hmien nzauh nyei jauv, zoux njien-youh aqv,’
yie ziouc gamh nziex yie nyei yietc zungv kouv naanc, weic zuqc yie hiuv duqv meih maiv funx yie maiv maaih dorngc nyei dorngx.
Yie zungv zuqc dingc zuiz. Wuov nyungc yie weic haaix diuc baeqc baeqc zoux kouv?
Se gorngv yie longc sorng nzaaux sin, longc nzie nyei wuom nzaaux buoz,
mv baac meih zoi yie ndortv kuotv, liemh yie nyei lui-houx oix youx yie.
“Tin-Hungh maiv zeiz baamh mienh hnangv yie nor, yie ziouc maiv haih caux ninh zoux sic.
Feix duqv maaih dauh yiem yie mbuo mbu'ndongx tengx muangx, yaac haih tengx yie mbuo i bung dunx sic.
Tov Tin-Hungh zorqv nqoi ninh nyei biaav maiv mborqv yie, yaac tov maiv dungx zoux gamh nziex nyei sic haeqv yie.
Wuov nyungc yie ziouc gorngv waac yaac maiv gamh nziex ninh, weic zuqc yie hiuv duqv yie nyei hnyouv maiv hnangv naaic.
“Yie youx haic yie nyei maengc, yie ziouc sueih jienv gorngv yie nyei naanc zingh. Yie hnyouv gu'nyuoz kouv ziouc oix gorngv aqv.
Yie oix gorngv mbuox Tin-Hungh, maiv dungx dingc yie maaih zuiz. Tov bun yie hiuv meih weic haaix diuc caux yie nzaeng.
Meih zeix mienh aengx mangc piex meih nyei buoz zeix daaih nyei ga'naaiv, yaac ceng orqv mienh nyei za'eix, naaiv deix sic meih haiz horpc nyei fai?
Meih nyei m'zing hnangv baamh mienh nyei m'zing fai? Meih buatc hnangv baamh mienh buatc fai?
Meih nyei hnoi hnangv baamh mienh nyei hnoi fai? Meih nyei hnyangx yaac hnangv mienh nyei hnyangx fai?
Hnangv naaic meih cingx daaih lorz yie zoux dorngc nyei sic, aengx zimh lorz yie nyei zuiz,
maiv gunv meih hiuv duqv yie maiv maaih dorngc nyei dorngx, yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh njoux yie biaux ndutv meih nyei buoz-ndiev.
“Meih nyei buoz nanv yie, zeix yie cuotv daaih, ih zanc meih daaux nqaang daaih oix mietc yie.
Tov jangx jienv meih longc ba'naih nie zeix yie, meih corc oix bun yie nzuonx benx nie-mbung fai?
Meih dox yie cuotv daaih hnangv nyorx, aengx bun yie gitv daaih hnangv nyorx-hmei-ngaengc maiv zeiz?
Meih longc ndopv caux orv benx lui bun yie zuqv, yaac longc mbungv caux jaan daaux jienv.
Meih bun yie maaih maengc ziangh yaac ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie. Meih yaac longx-longx nyei beu jienv yie nyei maengc.
“Mv baac naaiv deix sic meih bingx jienv yiem hnyouv, yie yaac hiuv duqv naaiv se meih nyei za'eix aqv.
Se gorngv yie baamz zuiz meih mangc jienv yie. Meih zungv oix dingc yie nyei zuiz, maiv bungx guangc.
Se gorngv yie zoux orqv, yie zuqc kouv aqv. Se gorngv yie zoux horpc, yie cau maiv jiez m'nqorngv. Yie za'gengh! nyaiv nzengc, yaac mangc jienv yie ganh nyei kouv naanc.
Se gorngv yie bouh yie ganh faaux, meih zunc yie hnangv sienh zunc nor. Meih aengx zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic hoic yie.
Meih aengx jaa liepc zorng-zengx mienh daaih gox yie, yaac jaa qiex jiez yie. Meih dorh siang-jun-baeng tiuv jienv mborqv yie.
“Tin-Hungh aah! Meih weic haaix diuc dorh yie cuotv maa nyei ga'sie? Feix duqv yie daic ndaangc mienh nyei m'zing buatc yie,
ziouc hnangv maiv maaih jiex yie, se yiem maa nyei ga'sie mingh taux zouv mi'aqv.
Yie ziangh seix nyei hnoi-nyieqc zoqc haic maiv zeiz? Tov bungx yie ganh yiem, bun yie duqv deix njien-youh
ndaangc yie mingh maiv nzuonx nyei dorngx, se mingh yiemh gen, mapv hmuangx nyei deic-bung.
Naaiv norm deic-bung se hmuangx haic, lunc nzengc, yiem wuov nyei njang yaac hmuangx mi'aqv.”
Naa^aa^me Mienh, Sofaa, ziouc dau gorngv,
“Gorngv waac ndongc naaic camv maiv zuqc dau fai? Gorngv waac camv nyei mienh oix zuqc funx ninh horpc nyei fai?
Meih gorngv nyei henh waac haih bun mienh sekv fai? Meih huotv mienh nyei ziangh hoc, maiv horpc zuqc maaih mienh bun meih nyaiv fai?
Weic zuqc meih gorngv, ‘Yie gorngv nyei doz-leiz se zien nyei, ziux Tin-Hungh mangc, yie yaac cing-nzengc nyei.’
Mv baac feix duqv Tin-Hungh caux meih gorngv. Feix duqv ninh morngx nqoi nzuih gorngv meih.

Ninh ziouc zorqv gem jienv nyei cong-mengh mbuox meih, weic zuqc ninh nyei cong-mengh maaih camv-bung. Meih oix zuqc hiuv aqv, Tin-Hungh dingc meih nyei zuiz, zungv gauh zoqc meih zoux dorngc horpc zuqc dingc nyei.
“Meih haih zaah duqv toux Tin-Hungh hnangv haaix nor fai? Meih haih hiuv duqv nzengc Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh fai?
Ninh nyei cong-mengh gauh hlang jiex lungh. Meih haih zoux haaix nyungc? Se gauh ndo jiex yiemh gen. Meih haih hiuv haaix nyungc?
Ndorqc mangc gaax, zungv gauh ndaauv ndau-beih, yaac gauh jangv koiv.
“Se gorngv Tin-Hungh jiex mingh yaac zorqv meih wuonx jienv, aengx heuc siemv zuiz, haaix dauh haih laanh ninh?
Tin-Hungh hiuv duqv maiv lamh longc nyei mienh. Ninh buatc ninh mbuo zoux nyei waaic sic, ninh yaac maiv zeiz oix samx mangc fai?
Mv baac hngongx nyei mienh haih maaih cong-mengh nor, hieh lorh haih njiec dorn benx dauh mienh aqv.
“Se gorngv meih mbenc sung hnyouv aengx sung jienv buoz hungx jienv ninh,
se gorngv meih maaih zuiz oix zuqc guangc go-go nyei, yaac maiv dungx bun waaic sic yiem meih nyei ndopv-liuh gu'nyuoz.
Wuov zanc meih duqv cau hmien yaac maiv lamh nqemh dorngx, meih ziouc yiem wuonv yaac maiv gamh nziex.
Meih ziouc la'kuqv meih nyei kouv naanc. Kungx jangx jienv hnangv benx liouc jiex mingh nyei wuom hnangv.
Meih ziangh seix zaangc nyei maengc oix gauh njang lungh aanx zanc nyei njang, maiv gunv maaih hmuangx, mv baac oix hnangv lungh ndorm nor.
Weic meih maaih lamh hnamv meih ziouc yiem duqv wuonv. Tin-Hungh oix beu jienv meih, bun meih duqv baengh orn nyei hitv kuonx.
Meih oix bueix njiec, maiv maaih mienh haeqv meih. Mienh camv yaac oix daaih tov meih tengx.
Mv baac orqv mienh nyei m'zing oix mbuov mingh, ninh mbuo lorz maiv buatc haaix nyungc jauv biaux. Ninh mbuo maaih lamh hnamv nyei se dangx qiex daic mi'aqv.”
Yopv ziouc dau,
“Zeiz aqv, meih mbuo za'gengh guai haic nyei mienh. Cong-mengh yaac oix caux meih mbuo yietc njiec daic.
Mv baac yie yaac maaih cong-mengh caux meih mbuo fih hnangv nyei. Yie maiv gauh aiv meih mbuo. Meih mbuo gorngv naaiv deix sic fungc maaih haaix dauh maiv hiuv laeh?
“Yie benx yie nyei doic jatv nyei ga'naaiv. Zinh ndaangc yie jouh Tin-Hungh, ninh yaac dau yie. Yie se baengh fim, maiv lamh nqemh dorngx nyei mienh, yaac zuqc mienh jatv aqv.
Orn-lorqc nyei mienh yiem hnyouv mangc piex zuqc zeqc naanc nyei mienh, zeqc naanc zungv zuov jienv zaux mbaqc piatv nyei mienh.
Janx-zaqc nyei ndopv-liuh baengh orn nyei, cuoqv Tin-Hungh nyei mienh yiem duqv wuonv, maiv gunv ninh mbuo longc ganh nyei qaqv dorngx zienh.
“Gunv naaic saeng-kuv, saeng-kuv ziouc njaaux meih. Naaic yiem lungh nyei norqc, ninh mbuo ziouc mbuox meih.
Caux ndau gorngv waac, ndau ziouc njaaux meih, yiem koiv nyei mbiauz yaac oix zunh mengh mbuox meih.
Yiem naaiv deix yietc zungv maaih haaix nyungc maiv hiuv duqv Ziouv nyei buoz hnangv naaiv zoux?
Da'faanh ziangh jienv maaih maengc nyei ga'naaiv caux zuangx baamh mienh tauv nyei qiex yiem ninh nyei buoz.
M'normh maiv zeiz haih seix waac hnangv mbietc seix nyanc hopv nyei mueix fai?
Mienh gox mienh maaih cong-mengh. Siouc nyuonh ndaauv nyei mienh gauh haih bieqc hnyouv.
“Tin-Hungh maaih cong-mengh caux qaqv. Ninh maaih za'eix yaac haih bieqc hnyouv.
Tin-Hungh caeqv nyei, maiv maaih haaix dauh haih ceix jiez. Ninh wuonx mienh, maiv maaih haaix dauh haih bungx.
Se gorngv ninh dangv jienv wuom, wuom ziouc nqaai. Se gorngv ninh bungx wuom cuotv, wuom ziouc yiemx ndau-beih.
Tin-Hungh maaih qaqv, maaih cong-mengh, zuqc nduov nyei caux nduov mienh nyei mienh yiem ninh nyei buoz-ndiev.
Ninh se zorqv nzengc caangh laangh mienh nyei cong-mengh, yaac bun siemv zuiz jien benx ga'naaiv-hngongx.
Ninh jaiv nqoi hungh diex ndoh mienh nyei limc, aengx longc hlaang sai jienv hungh nyei jaaiv.
Ninh zorqv sai mienh laengh gaengv nyei dorh mingh, yaac mbienv maaih lingc maaih qaqv nyei mienh.
Ninh bun ziepc zuoqv nyei mienh sekv nzieqc, maiv haih gorngv waac, yaac zorqv nqoi mienh gox nyei cong-mengh.
Ninh mangc piex zoux hlo nyei mienh, yaac zorqv nqoi henv wuov deix nyei qaqv.
Ninh bun yiem ndo, hmuangx nyei sic hinc cuotv, yaac dorh mapv hmuangx nyei dorngx bieqc njang.
Ninh bun guoqv henv, yaac mietc ninh mbuo. Ninh bun baeqc fingx hiaangx camv, aengx guaatv ninh mbuo mingh.
Ninh zorqv lungh ndiev baeqc fingx nyei bieiv zeiv nyei cong-mengh mingh mi'aqv, yaac bun ninh mbuo youh jienv gan maiv maaih jauv nyei deic-bung-huaang mingh.
Ninh mbuo yiem hmuangx gu'nyuoz huaax jienv mingh, maiv maaih njang. Ninh yaac bun ninh mbuo lungh lungh laih laih hnangv diuv nquin nyei mienh nor.
“Naaiv deix yietc zungv sic yie nyei m'zing duqv buatc jiex, yie nyei m'normh duqv haiz jiex yaac mengh baeqc.
Meih mbuo hiuv nyei, yie yaac hiuv. Yie maiv gauh aiv meih mbuo.
Mv baac yie oix caux Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh gorngv waac, yie oix caux Tin-Hungh luonx leiz.
Meih mbuo longc gorngv-baeqc nyei waac nzaatv jienv meih mbuo maiv hiuv nyei. Meih mbuo se hnangv maiv lamh longc nyei ndie-sai.
Feix duqv meih mbuo sekv nzieqc nyei. Naaiv ziouc benx meih mbuo nyei cong-mengh aqv.
“Ih zanc tov muangx yie luonx nyei jauv yaac muangx yie sux nyei waac.
Meih mbuo oix weic Tin-Hungh gorngv jaav nyei waac fai? Meih mbuo oix weic ninh gorngv-baeqc?
Meih mbuo oix tengx Tin-Hungh wuov bung nzaeng fai? Meih mbuo oix weic ninh luonx leiz?
Se gorngv ninh zaah mangc meih mbuo, meih mbuo haih duqv longx fai? Meih mbuo haih nduov Tin-Hungh hnangv mienh nduov mienh fai?
Se gorngv meih mbuo bingx jienv tengx yietc bung, ninh ndongc haaix zungv oix gorngv-hemx meih mbuo.
Ninh nyei haangh daauh bun meih gamh nziex, zungv haeqv meih mbuo mau nzengc saah?
Meih mbuo nyei waac-puix hnangv saaiv maiv lamh longc, meih mbuo luonx nyei leiz ndongc wuom-bamc mau nor.
“Tov meih mbuo sekv dangh maah! Yie oix gorngv. Nqa'haav maiv gunv benx haaix nyungc, sueih yie benx aqv.
Maiv gunv hnangv haaix nor yie oix zoux aqv, yie maiv funx maengc nyei gorngv.
Maiv gunv ninh daix yie, yie corc maaih lamh hnamv, mv baac yie yaac oix yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien biux mengh yie nyei jauv.
Naaiv oix benx yie nyei njoux en, weic zuqc maiv taaih Tin-Hungh nyei mienh maiv duqv mingh yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien.
“Tov longx-longx nyei muangx yie gorngv nyei waac, yaac bun yie sux nyei waac bieqc meih nyei m'normh.
Yie liuc leiz ziangx yie nyei sic aqv. Yie hiuv duqv zungv biux mengh yie maiv dorngc.
Maaih haaix dauh oix gox yie? Maaih nor, yie ziouc sekv yaac daic.
“Kungx tov bun i nyungc yie hnangv, yie ziouc maiv bingx meih nyei hmien.
Tov hluotv meih nyei buoz leih go yie, yaac tov maiv dungx zoux gamh nziex nyei sic haeqv yie.
Tin-Hungh aac, gunv heuc, yie ziouc dau. Fai bun yie gorngv, meih yaac dau yie.
Yie nyei zuiz caux zoux dorngc nyei sic maaih mbu'ziex? Tov bun yie hiuv duqv yie zoux dorngc nyei jauv caux yie baamz nyei zuiz.
“Meih weic haaix diuc bingx meih nyei hmien, yaac funx yie zoux meih nyei win-wangv?
Meih oix haeqv yietc kuaaiv zuqc nziaaux buonc nyei ndiangx-normh yaac zunc mbiauh nqaauv nqaai fai?
Meih fiev jienv hniev haic nyei sic gox yie, aengx bun yie ndaam-dorng yie lunx nyei ziangh hoc zoux nyei zuiz.
Meih zorqv ndiangx gapc jienv yie nyei zaux, aengx mangc jienv yie nyei diuh diuh jauv meih yaac dingc ziangx yie nyei zaux-benv caaiv duqv taux nyei dorngx.
“Mienh gunv zoux gunv zitc hnangv ga'naaiv-huv, hnangv zuqc gaeng ngaatc waaic nyei lui-houx.
“Mienh yiem m'sieqv dorn cuotv seix nyei hnoi-nyieqc zoqc nyei, kungx maaih kuonx naanh buangv nzengc.
Ninh cuotv daaih hnangv biangh nor, yaac ziec mi'aqv. Ninh hnangv dongh linh nor jiex, maiv yiem aqv.
Hnangv yie naaiv nyungc mienh meih bungx m'zing mangc jienv ninh aengx dorh ninh daaih yiem meih nyei nza'hmien zuqc siemv fai?
Haaix dauh haih dorh cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv yiem maiv cing-nzengc nyei ga'naaiv cuotv? Maiv maaih yietc dauh.
Ninh ziangh nyei hnoi-nyieqc jaa-ndaangc dingc ziangx aqv, ninh nyei hlaax-soux se yiem meih dingc. Meih dingc ziangx ninh ziangh nyei soux mouc, ninh yaac maiv haih jiex ndaangc.
Tov huin ganh bung, maiv dungx mangc ninh weic bun ninh duqv henh, bun ninh a'hneiv hnangv maaic gong mienh jiex yietc norm hnoi.
“Se gorngv ndiangx zuqc goix, corc maaih lamh hnamv haih cuotv cunx. Cunx yaac ndaauv jienv mingh, maiv dingh aqv.
Maiv gunv ninh nyei nzungh yiem ndau-ndiev gox, ninh nyei gorn yiem ndau daic,
yietv duqv wuom nyei qiex ninh ziouc cuotv cunx, yaac cuotv nquaah hnangv ndiangx-lunx nor.
Mv baac mienh daic, bueix jienv zaqc nyei. Ninh dangx qiex ninh ziouc yiem haaix?
Hnangv koiv nyei wuom nqaai, ndaaih nyei wuom haapv yaac nqaai,
mienh daic mingh maiv aengx nangh daaih, taux lungh jiex nzengc ninh maiv nyie, nqamv ninh, ninh yaac maiv haih nyie.
“Feix duqv meih zorqv yie bingx jienv yiemh gen. Feix duqv meih torngv jienv yie, zuov meih nyei ga'qiex fiu. Feix duqv meih dingc ziangx ziangh hoc weic jangx yie.
Se gorngv mienh daic mingh, ninh aengx haih nangh daaih fai? Yie zuov jienv naaiv deix yietc zungv nyei hnoi-nyieqc jiex, taux yie duqv bungx nqoi nyei ziangh hoc.
Meih oix heuc, yie ziouc dau meih. Meih oix a'hneiv duqv buatc meih nyei buoz zoux daaih nyei ga'naaiv.
Taux wuov zanc meih oix saauv yie nyei zaux-mbiec, mv baac meih maiv zuov jienv zorqv yie zoux dorngc nyei zuiz.
Yie zoux dorngc nyei sic meih dapv jienv mbuoqc aengx mborqv jienv yienx. Meih yaac buang jienv yie nyei zuiz.
“Mv baac mbong mbaang huv mi'aqv. La'bieiv-zorng yaac suiv nqoi leih ninh nyei dorngx.
Wuom congx la'bieiv, la'bieiv ziouc jie nzengc, domh mbiungc yaac guaatv ndau-beih nyei nie mingh. Meih fih hnangv nyei mietc baamh mienh maaih lamh hnamv nyei dorngx.
Meih yietc liuz hingh jiex mienh, ninh ziouc guei seix mi'aqv. Meih tiuv ninh nyei hmien yaac bun ninh mingh mi'aqv.
Ninh nyei dorn mbuo duqv mienh taaih, ninh yaac maiv hiuv. Ninh mbuo ndortv njiec aiv, ninh yaac maiv buatc.
Ninh kungx haiz ninh ganh nyei sin zaangc mun, yaac weic ninh ganh nzauh nyiemv.”
Temaan Mienh, E^li^fatv, dau Yopv,
“Cong-mengh mienh longc maiv lamh longc nyei wuonh zaang dau, yaac bun dong bung nyei nziaaux buangv nzengc ziangh sin se horpc nyei fai?
Ninh longc maiv maaih eix leiz nyei waac fai tengx maiv duqv haaix nyungc nyei waac jaiv sin fai?
Mv baac taaih Tin-Hungh wuov nyungc hnyouv meih guangc mi'aqv, yaac dangv jienv maiv duqv yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien fei-fangv nyei jauv.
Weic zuqc meih nyei zuiz njaaux meih nyei nzuih gorngv waac, meih yaac ginv longc guv guaix mienh nyei mbietc.
Meih ganh nyei nzuih dingc meih zoux dorngc, maiv zeiz yie. Meih ganh nyei joux-joux waac zoux zorng-zengx gox meih.
“Meih dongh cuotv seix ndaangc nyei daauh dauh baamh mienh fai? Meih cuotv seix ndaangc Tin-Hungh zeix mbong fai?
Tin-Hungh caangh laangh nyei wuic gapv zunv nyei ziangh hoc meih haiz nyei fai? Meih liouh jienv cong-mengh weic meih ganh longc fai?
Maaih haaix nyungc meih hiuv, yie mbuo maiv hiuv? Maaih haaix nyungc meih mengh baeqc, yie mbuo maiv mengh baeqc?
Yiem yie mbuo mbu'ndongx maaih mba'biei baeqc nyei mienh caux hnyangx-jeiv gox nyei mienh, zungv gauh gox meih nyei die.
Tin-Hungh longc suonc nyei waac orn meih nyei hnyouv. Meih haiz se maiv gaengh gaux fai?
Meih weic haaix diuc sueih ganh nyei hnyouv, meih nyei m'zing weic haaix diuc cuotv douz,
bun meih nyei hnyouv ngaengc Tin-Hungh yaac bun naaiv nyungc waac yiem meih nyei nzuih cuotv?
“Baamh mienh hnangv haaix nor ninh cingx daaih haih cing-nzengc? Fai yiem m'sieqv dorn cuotv seix nyei mienh hnangv haaix nor haih benx zoux horpc nyei mienh?
Tin-Hungh zungv maiv bungx hnyouv ninh nyei cing-nzengc fin-mienh. Ziux Tin-Hungh mangc, lungh yaac maiv cing-nzengc.
Wuov nyungc waaic haic, youx haic nyei mienh, se hopv zuiz dorngx wuom nyei mienh, gauh fatv maiv haih cing-nzengc.
“Muangx yie maah! Yie oix mbuox meih. Yie buatc jiex nyei, yie oix gorngv,
dongh cong-mengh mienh gorngv jiex, yiem ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix nzipc jienv daaih yaac maiv bingx.
(Naaiv norm deic-bung kungx ninh mbuo ganh duqv nzipc, yaac maiv maaih ganh fingx mienh yangh ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx jiex.)
Orqv mienh yiem seix zaangc nyei yietc zungv hnoi-nyieqc zuqc siouc kouv. Se zeix mienh nyei mienh waaic mienh ziux ninh nyei yietc zungv hnyangx-soux.
Za'gengh! gamh nziex haic nyei qiex yiem ninh nyei m'normh, baengh orn nyei ziangh hoc, janx-zaqc ziouc daaih caangv aqv.
Ninh maiv sienx ninh haih yiem hmuangx gu'nyuoz nzuonx. Ninh zungv oix zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix.
Ninh youh jienv mingh lorz nyanc yaac gorngv, ‘Yiem haaix maaih nyanc hopv?’ Ninh hiuv duqv hmuangx nyei hnoi-nyieqc yiem ninh nyei buoz ga'hlen.
Ninh oix zuqc zeqc naanc kuonx kouv bun ninh gamh nziex, yaac hingh jiex ninh hnangv hungh diex liuc leiz mborqv jaax nor.
Weic zuqc ninh nyuotv buoz-juonh bun Tin-Hungh, yaac ngaengc jienv Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh,
ziouc nanv jienv hoz nyei torngv-baaih ngaengc jienv bieqc mingh mborqv ninh.
“Weic zuqc ninh nyei hmien junc haic, ninh nyei jaaiv benx orv-junc,
ninh duqv yiem zingh huaang, yiem mienh maiv horpc zuqc yiem nyei biauv, se dingc daaih oix zuqc benx mbaang waaic nyei ga'naaiv-ndui.
Ninh ziouc maiv duqv butv zoih. Ninh nyei zinh zoih yaac maiv duqv yiem lauh. Ninh nyei jaa-dingh maiv duqv yiem deic-bung hiaangx.
Mienh biaux maiv ndutv hmuangx. Douz yaac oix buov nqaai ninh nyei cunx. Tin-Hungh nyei qiex yaac oix biomv ninh mingh mi'aqv.
Maiv dungx bun ninh kaux maiv lamh longc nyei haaix nyungc nduov ganh, weic zuqc maiv lamh longc nyei oix winh nzuonx bun ninh.
Ninh nyei hnoi-nyieqc maiv gaengh taux ninh ziouc zuqc winh sung, ninh nyei nquaah yaac maiv maeng aqv.
Ninh yaac hnangv a'ngunc hmei maiv gaengh zuoqc nyei biouv bioh ndortv nzengc, yaac hnangv ga'lanv ndiangx nyei biangh nqoi daaih bioh mi'aqv.
Maiv taaih Tin-Hungh wuov deix maiv maaih hoz doic zeiv-fun, a'hneiv kaux nyaanh hmuangx wuov deix nyei ndopv-liuh yaac oix zuqc douz buov qui.
Ninh mbuo hnamv cuotv orqv sic hnangv maaih gu'nguaaz faaux sin, yungz cuotv benx waaic sic hnangv. Ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv liuc leiz nduov mienh.”
Yopv ziouc dau,
“Naaiv nyungc waac yie haiz camv! haic aqv. Meih mbuo dauh dauh oix orn hnyouv mv baac meih mbuo bun mienh jaa nzauh.
Meih maiv dingh maiv hitv nyei gorngv waac maiv haih jomc fai? Maaih haaix nyungc cuoqv zuqc meih dau waac?

Se gorngv meih mbuo caux yie tiuv dorngx yiem, yie mv baac haih gorngv hnangv meih mbuo nor. Yie haih borqv jienv yietc kang jiex yietc kang nyei waac gorngv meih mbuo, aengx dorng jienv meih mbuo huangx m'nqorngv.
Mv baac yie haih longc yie nyei nzuih ceix meih mbuo henv jiez daaih, yie nyei nzuih meix yaac oix orn meih mbuo nyei you-nzauh.
“Maiv gunv yie gorngv waac, yie mun nyei jauv maiv sienc. Se gorngv yie nyienz jienv maiv gorngv, yie mun nyei dorngx maiv haih gauh longx.
Tin-Hungh aac, ih zanc meih zungv bun yie kuonx kouv. Meih bun yie nyei biauv zong mienh zuqc baaic nzengc.
Meih bun yie soqv, jaic nzengc, yie ndongc naaiv jaic ziouc zoux zorng-zengx gox yie.
Tin-Hungh qiex jiez jienv betv yie yaac nzorng yie, dorng jienv yie ngaatc nyaah. Yie nyei win-wangv njatc m'zing mangc yie.
Ninh mbuo morngx nzuih bun yie. Ninh mbuo mbaix yie nyei hmien huotv yie. Ninh mbuo gapv zunv daaih oix zoux bun yie.
Tin-Hungh zorqv yie jiu bun orqv mienh, yaac zoi yie yiem mienh waaic mienh nyei buoz-ndiev.
Yie kuh yiem nyei ziangh hoc ninh zorqv yie wuotv nauv. Ninh nanv jienv yie nyei jaang guaeqv yie muonc nzengc. Ninh zorqv yie zoux ninh nyei mbaeqc.
Ninh nyei buonv juang-zinx mienh weih gormx yie. Ninh buonv tong yie nyei nyutc zeiv yaac maiv korv-lienh, yaac dox yie nyei daamv cuotv njiec ndau.
Ninh mborqv yie yietc nzunc jiex yietc nzunc, ninh tiux daaih mborqv hnangv mborqv jaax henv nyei baeng.
“Yie lunh la'maah ndie-cou nitv jienv yie nyei ndopv, yie suei nzengc ziouc bueix jienv nie-mbung.
Weic zuqc yie nyiemv, hmien siqv nzengc, m'zing-ndopv yaac hmuangx,
maiv gunv yie nyei buoz maiv zoux haaix nyungc doqc, yie daux gaux nyei waac yaac cing-nzengc.
“Ndau aah! Maiv dungx buang yie nyei nziaamv. Maiv dungx bun yie heuc nyei qiex maaih dorngx hitv.
Ih zanc maaih dauh yiem tin-dorngh tengx yie zoux zorng-zengx, beu yie wuov dauh yiem hlang nyei dorngx.
Yie nyei loz-gaeng doic huotv yie, yie nyei m'zing liouc wuom-mueic bun Tin-Hungh.
Tov bun ninh tengx mienh jouh Tin-Hungh, hnangv mienh tengx ninh nyei loz-gaeng doic jouh nor.
“Weic zuqc aengx jiex liuz i ziex hnyangx, yie ziouc gan maiv nzuonx nyei jauv mingh.
“Yie nyei mba'nziu yuqc, yie nyei hnoi-nyieqc yaac jiex mi'aqv. Zouv yaac zuov jienv yie.
Zien nyei, maaih jatv yie nyei mienh weih gormx yie, yie nyei m'zing yaac mangc jienv ninh mbuo cuoqv yie.
“Tin-Hungh aac, tov meih zoux buv-jaa beu yie. Cuotv liuz meih, maaih haaix dauh oix weic yie zoux buv-jaa?
Meih bun ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv maiv haih mengh baeqc. Weic naaiv meih ziouc maiv bun ninh mbuo hingh jiex.
Mienh maaic ganh nyei gorx-youz weic duqv zinh nyaanh, ninh nyei fu'jueiv oix zuqc siouc kouv.
“Tin-Hungh bun yie yiem baeqc fingx mbu'ndongx zoux gouv gorngv. Ninh mbuo yaac tuiv wuom-nzuih naetv yie nyei hmien.
Laaix nzauh kouv yie nyei m'zing maiv njang aqv. Yie nyei buoz-zaux hnangv dongh linh nor.
Hnyouv zingx nyei mienh laaix naaiv deix sic za'gengh! gamh nziex haic. Maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh jiez daaih gorngv yie maiv gan Tin-Hungh.
Kuv mienh gan longx ninh yangh nyei jauv. Buoz cing-nzengc nyei mienh gunv zoux gunv henv jienv faaux.
“Mv baac meih mbuo, se meih mbuo yietc zungv, gunv aengx daaih nzunc. Yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx yie zungv lorz maiv buatc yietc dauh cong-mengh mienh.
“Yie nyei hnoi-nyieqc jiex mi'aqv. Yie daav nyei za'eix, se yiem hnyouv hnamv nyei, dangx mi'aqv.
Yie nyei loz-gaeng doic bun lungh muonz zanc benx lungh hnoi zanc. Ninh mbuo gorngv, ‘Njang se nitv fatv hmuangx.’
Se gorngv yie maaih lamh hnamv yiemh gen benx yie nyei biauv, se gorngv yie bueix njiec hmuangx nyei dorngx,
se gorngv yie mbuox zouv, ‘Meih zoux yie nyei die,’ yaac mbuox gaeng-mau, ‘Meih se yie nyei maa,’ fai ‘Yie nyei dorc,’
wuov nyungc yie maaih lamh hnamv nyei yiem haaix? Yie maaih lamh hnamv nyei haaix dauh duqv buatc?
Yie maaih lamh hnamv nyei oix njiec taux yiemh gen nyei gaengh fai? Yie mbuo lomh nzoih oix njiec nie-mbung fai?”
Quwaa Mienh, Mbin^ndatc, dau,
“Meih oix gorngv naaiv gorngv wuov ndongc haaix lauh? Hnamv longx maah! Yie mbuo ziouc caux meih gorngv waac.
Weic haaix diuc funx yie mbuo hnangv saeng-kuv? Ziux meih mangc, yie mbuo benx ga'naaiv-hngongx fai?
Meih qiex jiez hoic ganh mun nyei mienh aah! Ndau-beih laaix meih oix zuqc guangc benx ndau-huaang fai? La'bieiv oix zuqc suiv nqoi ninh nyei dorngx fai?
“Orqv mienh nyei njang zungv zuqc hnangv dang nor daic mi'aqv. Ninh nyei douz-mbietc yaac maiv ziux njang.
Yiem ninh nyei ndopv-liuh nyei njang benx hmuangx, yiem ninh gu'nguaaic nyei dang yaac daic mi'aqv.
Ninh henv nyei zaux-mbiec ih zanc laamx duqv nangv. Ninh ganh daav nyei za'eix zungv hoic ninh ndiqv zuqc ndorpc.
Ninh ganh nyei zaux dorh ninh mingh zuqc mungz nzenc, ninh yangh zaeng hlaang nyei kuotv jiex.
Hlaang ziouc hlopv jienv ninh nyei zaux-nqo, aengx naeqc jienv zietc nyei.
Maaih hlaang weic ninh bingx jienv ga'ndiev ndau, zaeng jienv yiem ninh yangh nyei jauv.
Haeqv ninh gamh nziex haic nyei sic weih jienv biei bung, yaac zunc jienv ninh nyei zaux-nqo mingh.
Laaix ngorc, ninh nyei qaqv piex jienv njiec. Zeqc naanc yiem ninh nyei ga'hlen zuov jienv ninh.
Ninh nyei ndopv butv ciouv nyei baengc huv nzengc. Doqc haic nyei wuon-baengc naqv ninh nyei buoz-zaux.
Yiem ninh kaux nyei ndopv-liuh ninh zuqc baeng cuotv, aengx zuqc dorh mingh taux gamh nziex haic nyei hungh diex.
Dongh maiv zeiz ninh nyei ga'naaiv yiem ninh nyei ndopv-liuh, yaac maaih hungh hiaamx jienv ninh yiem nyei dorngx.
Ninh nyei nzungh nqaai mingh, ninh nyei nquaah nyaux nzengc.
Yiem lungh ndiev maiv maaih haaix dauh jangx ninh, yiem deic-bung ninh nyei mbuox zutc mi'aqv.
Ninh yiem njang zuqc zunc bieqc hmuangx gu'nyuoz, se zuqc zunc cuotv yaangh gen.
Yiem ninh nyei douh zong maiv maaih ninh nyei hoz doic zeiv-fun. Ninh yiem jiex nyei dorngx maiv maaih yietc dauh cuotv singx maengc.
Fai bung mienh muangx haiz ninh nyei setv mueiz zuqc nyei sic ziouc hnyouv waaic nzengc. Dong bung mienh yaac gamh nziex haic aqv.
Orqv mienh yiem nyei dorngx zungv hnangv naaiv. Maiv hiuv Tin-Hungh nyei mienh yaac hnangv naaiv aqv.”
Yopv ziouc dau,
“Meih mbuo oix zoux bun yie nyei hnyouv kouv, yaac longc waac morc yie ndongc haaix lauh?
Meih mbuo gorngv doqc yie maiv zeiv ziepc nzunc aqv. Meih mbuo dorngc yie, meih mbuo maiv nyaiv fai?
Se gorngv yie za'gengh zoux dorngc, yie zoux dorngc nyei kungx ndortv zuqc yie ganh hnangv.
Se gorngv meih mbuo ceng meih mbuo ganh gauh hlo yie, yaac funx yie buangh nyei kouv naanc bun cing yie zoux dorngc,
wuov nyungc meih mbuo oix zuqc hiuv duqv se Tin-Hungh hnangv naaiv zoux bun yie, yaac longc ninh nyei mungz nzenc jienv yie.
“Yie heuc jienv gorngv, ‘Zuqc zoux doqc aav loh!’ yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh dau. Yie heuc jienv tov tengx, mv baac maiv duqv baengh fim nyei jauv.
Tin-Hungh dangv jienv yie nyei jauv yie ziouc jiex maiv duqv. Ninh yaac bun yie nyei jauv hmuangx mingh.
Ninh zorqv nqoi yie nyei njang-laangc, yaac zorqv nqoi yie ndongx nyei ningv.
Ninh weih jienv yie biei bung mborqv yie, yie ziouc baaic nzengc mi'aqv. Yie maaih lamh hnamv nyei, ninh baeng cuotv hnangv baeng diuh ndiangx nor.
Ninh qiex jiez, nouz haic yie, yaac funx yie benx ninh nyei win-wangv.
Ninh nyei jun-baeng guanh lomh nzoih daaih. Ninh mbuo liuc leiz jauv mborqv yie, yaac liepc ciangv weih gormx yie.
Tin-Hungh bun yie nyei gorx-youz guangc yie, dongh yie zuoqc nyei mienh maiv laengz yie aqv.
Yie nyei cien-ceqv leih nqoi yie, yie nyei loz-gaeng doic la'kuqv yie mi'aqv.
Yiem yie nyei biauv nyei kaeqv mienh caux m'sieqv bou funx yie zoux ga'nyiec nyei mienh. Ziux ninh mbuo nyei m'zing mangc, yie zungv benx ganh fingx mienh.
Yie heuc yie nyei bou mv baac ninh maiv dau, yie oix zuqc longc nzuih jouh ninh mbuo.
Yie nyei auv youx yie nyei nzuih nyei qiex. Yie ganh nyei cien gorx cien youz gamh nziev yie.
Liemh faix nyei fu'jueiv mangc piex yie. Yie jiez sin ninh mbuo gorngv yie.
Yie zuoqc jiex nyei yietc zungv loz-gaeng doic youx yie, dongh yie hnamv nyei mienh yaac mbienv hmien bun yie.
Yie nyei ndopv naetv jienv mbungv, yie biaux cuotv singx maengc ndongc yietc norm hmeiv-nauv.
“Loz-gaeng aah! Korv-lienh yie maah! Tov korv-lienh yie, weic zuqc Tin-Hungh nyei buoz mborqv yie.
Meih mbuo weic haaix diuc oix hoic yie hnangv Tin-Hungh hoic? Meih mbuo corc zoux doqc bun yie maiv gaengh gaux?
“Feix duqv yie gorngv nyei waac duqv fiev jienv, feix duqv faaux jienv yiem sou-daan.
Feix duqv longc hlieqv-jaa-sic zuqc la'bieiv, aengx longc jungz dox zuqc liuz nyei dorngx, bun yietc liuz yiem.
Weic zuqc yie hiuv duqv Zuoqc yie Wuov Dauh ziangh jienv, setv mueiz ninh oix daaih souv jienv ndau-beih.
Zuov yie ndopv huv nzengc, yiem yie nyei orv sin yie zungv duqv buatc Tin-Hungh.
Yie ganh duqv buatc ninh, yie ganh nyei m'zing duqv mangc ninh, yaac maiv zeiz ganh dauh. Yie nyei hnyouv mau kouv haic.
“Se gorngv meih mbuo gorngv, ‘Yie mbuo hnangv haaix nor haih hoic ninh?’ Yaac gorngv, ‘Cuoqv sic nyei gorn-baengx yiem ninh ganh,’
meih mbuo oix zuqc gamh nziex nzuqc ndaauv, weic zuqc Tin-Hungh qiex jiez, ninh longc nzuqc ndaauv dingc zuiz. Meih mbuo ziouc hiuv duqv maaih dauh siemv zuiz.”
Naa^aa^me Mienh, Sofaa, ziouc dau,
“Yopv aah! Meih nyei waac bun yie hnyouv maiv longx, nyienz maiv jienv, oix zuqc dau aqv.
Yie haiz meih gorngv-hemx nyei waac gorngv doqc yie, mv baac yie ganh nyei hnyouv hiuv duqv hnangv haaix nor dau.
“Meih maiv hiuv fai? Yiem loz! hnoi daaih, dongh baamh mienh coqv hoqc duqv yiem baamh gen wuov zanc,
orqv mienh duqv hingh nyei ziangh hoc se nangv nyei, maiv gan Tin-Hungh nyei mienh nyei njien-youh yaac weic dangh baav hnangv.
Maiv gunv ninh duqv zoux hlo, mbaengc gu'nguaaic lungh, ninh nyei m'nqorngv taux mbuonx,
ninh oix yietc liuz zuqc mietc, hnangv ninh ganh nyei nqaiv. Buatc jiex ninh nyei mienh oix gorngv, ‘Ninh jiex haaix mi'aqv?’
Ninh hnangv norm mbeix jiex mi'aqv, lorz maiv buatc aqv, yaac hnangv lungh muonz zanc hinc yaangh nyei sic ninh mitc mi'aqv.
Buatc jiex ninh nyei mienh yietc liuz maiv duqv aengx buatc, ninh yiem nyei dorngx yaac maiv duqv aengx buatc ninh.
Ninh nyei dorn-jueiv oix zuqc jaauv sung mienh jomc mienh. Ganh nyei buoz oix zuqc tuix nzuonx ninh nyei zinh zoih.
Ninh nyei mbungv maaih mienh lunx mienh nyei qaqv, mv baac oix zuqc caux ninh njiec benx nie-mbung.
“Maiv gunv orqv sic yiem ninh nyei nzuih se gaam nyei, yaac maiv gunv ninh fapv jienv ninh nyei mbietc ga'ndiev,
maiv gunv ninh maiv kangv liev cuotv, corc njorm jienv nzuih gu'nyuoz,
ninh nyanc nyei ga'naaiv yiem ga'sie tiuv mi'aqv, yiem hnyouv gu'nyuoz benx naang-jieqv nyei ndie-doqc.
Orqv mienh naqv zinh zoih aengx lov cuotv, Tin-Hungh zoux bun wuov deix ga'naaiv yiem ninh nyei ga'sie baetv cuotv daaih.
Ninh oix sorqv naang-jieqv nyei ndie-doqc, naang-doqc oix nyorqv ninh daic.
Ninh maiv duqv mangc ndoqv, se maaih mueiz-dorngh caux ngongh nyorx liouc cuotv nyei ndoqv.
Ninh cuotv qaqv duqv daaih nyei ga'naaiv oix zuqc tuix nzuonx, yaac maiv duqv a'hneiv ninh maaiz maaic zornc daaih nyei ga'naaiv.
Weic zuqc ninh zeix mienh jomc mienh aengx guangc ninh mbuo, yaac caangv maiv zeiz ninh ganh ceix daaih nyei biauv.
“Weic zuqc ninh mauv nyei jauv maiv haih dingh, ninh a'hneiv nyei ga'naaiv yietc nyungc yaac maiv liouh aqv.
Ninh nyanc liuz, maiv zengc haaix nyungc aqv. Weic naaiv ninh nyei fuqv-loqc maiv duqv yietc liuz yiem.
Ninh gauh benx jiex nyei ziangh hoc, ninh zuqc ndortv njiec kouv, yietc zungv siem nyei zeqc naanc ziouc daaih hoic ninh.
“Orqv mienh nyanc beuv, buangv ga'sie nyei ziangh hoc, Tin-Hungh nyei ga'qiex ziouc baetv cuotv bun ninh, yaac hnangv mbiungc nor njiec ninh nyei sin.
Ninh oix biaux hlieqv-jaa-sic, dongh siqv forng ziouc buonv tong ninh.
Ninh baeng forng cuotv, forng ziouc yiem ninh nyei sin cuotv daaih. Forng-cang dueiv-mueiz guoqv jienv daamv nyei wuom aengv cuotv njang, haeqv ninh gamh nziex! haic.
Ninh siou nyei zinh zoih oix zuqc mietc nzengc. Maiv zeiz mienh biomv nyei douz oix zorqv ninh buov qui. Yiem ninh nyei ndopv-liuh zengc njiec nyei ga'naaiv yaac zuqc buov mietc nzengc.
Lungh oix bun cing ninh zoux nyei zuiz, ndau oix zoux zorng-zengx dingc ninh.
Ninh nyei jaa-dingh zungv zuqc dorh mingh nzengc aqv, yiem Tin-Hungh qiex jiez nyei hnoi zuqc guaatv mingh aqv.
Naaiv se orqv mienh yiem Tin-Hungh duqv nyei buonc, se Tin-Hungh paaiv bun ninh nzipc.”
Yopv ziouc dau,
“Tov meih mbuo longx-longx nyei muangx yie nyei waac, hnangv naaic meih mbuo ziouc orn yie nyei hnyouv.
Tov diev jienv muangx yie gorngv. Yie gorngv liuz sueih meih mbuo jatv aqv.
“Yie aeqv, yie maiv zeiz caux baamh mienh nzaeng. Wuov nyungc yie weic haaix diuc maiv zuqc hnyouv beqv?
Mangc yie maah! Ziouc haeqv meih mbuo gamh nziex, yaac longc buoz buang jienv nzuih.
Yie haaix zanc jangx taux, gamh nziex gau, ziangh sin zinx nzengc aqv.
“Tin-Hungh weic haaix diuc bun orqv mienh duqv ziangh jienv, duqv siouc nyuonh ndaauv, maaih qaqv henv jienv faaux?
Ninh mbuo nyei dorn-jueiv dorng jienv ninh mbuo liepc wuonv, ninh mbuo nyei m'zing duqv buatc ninh mbuo nyei fun-faqv hlo daaih.
Ninh mbuo nyei biauv baengh orn nyei, maiv zuqc gamh nziex nyei sic. Tin-Hungh nyei biaav yaac maiv mborqv ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo nyei ngongh gouv douc buonv maiv dangx, ngongh nyeiz njiec dorn, dorn yaac maiv mbaang.
Ninh mbuo bun ninh mbuo nyei fu'jueiv-faix cuotv hnangv ba'gi yungh guanh, ninh mbuo nyei naamh nyouz cangx heix.
Ninh mbuo gan nzoz caux daanh baah nyei qiex baaux nzung, aengx longc hlauv-ndongh nux nyei qiex zoux nauc nyitc.
Ninh mbuo yiem seix zaangc nyei hnoi-nyieqc duqv longx, ninh mbuo baengh orn nyei njiec yiemh gen.
Ninh mbuo gorngv mbuox Tin-Hungh, ‘Leih nqoi yie mbuo maah! Yie mbuo maiv oix hiuv meih nyei jauv-louc.
Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh se haaix dauh, yie mbuo cingx daaih oix zuqc fu-sux ninh? Se gorngv yie mbuo jouh ninh yie mbuo duqv haaix nyungc longx?’
Ninh mbuo duqv longx se ninh mbuo kaux ninh mbuo ganh nyei qaqv. Orqv mienh caangh laangh nyei za'eix yie simv nqoi.
“Orqv mienh nyei dang zuqc daic ndongc haaix maqc? Ninh mbuo zuqc kuonx naanh nyei sic ndongc haaix maqc? Ninh mbuo zuqc Tin-Hungh qiex jiez, bun zeqc naanc ninh mbuo ndongc haaix maqc?
Ninh mbuo hnangv zuqc nziaaux buonc nyei mbiauh nqaauv, yaac hnangv mbieqv nor, zuqc domh nziaaux buonc ndongc haaix maqc?
Meih mbuo gorngv, ‘Tin-Hungh siou jienv orqv mienh nyei zuiz weic bun ninh mbuo nyei fu'jueiv zuqc dingc.’ Tov Tin-Hungh winh bun orqv mienh ganh, weic bun ninh mbuo ganh hiuv.
Tov bun ninh mbuo ganh nyei m'zing buatc ninh mbuo ganh zuqc mietc. Bun ninh mbuo hiuv duqv Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh qiex jiez haic ninh mbuo.
Ninh ziangh nyei hlaax-nyieqc buangv, ninh corc haih jangx ganh nyei hmuangv doic fai?
“Maaih haaix dauh haih zorqv wuonh zaang njaaux Tin-Hungh? Weic zuqc ninh zungv siemv yiem hlang wuov deix.
Maaih laanh mienh daic nyei ziangh hoc, sin zaangc wangc siangx, henv nyei, kuh yiem, baengh orn nyei.
Ninh nyei sin henv, ndin nyei, ninh nyei mbungv-fim nyiemz nyei.
Aengx maaih laanh mienh daic nyei ziangh hoc, hnyouv maiv maaih yietc deix orn-lorqc. Ziangh seix maiv duqv haaix nyungc longx.
Ninh mbuo fih hnangv nyei daic, bueix jienv nie-mbung gu'nyuoz, maaih gaeng-mau buang jienv ninh mbuo.
“Yie hiuv duqv meih mbuo nyei hnyouv hnangv haaix nor hnamv, caux meih mbuo daav maiv benx nyei za'eix hoic yie.
Weic zuqc meih mbuo gorngv, ‘Zoux hlo wuov dauh nyei biauv ih zanc yiem haaix? Orqv mienh yiem jiex nyei ndopv-liuh yiem haaix?’
Meih mbuo maiv duqv naaic jiex jauv nyei mienh fai? Meih mbuo maiv hiuv duqv ninh mbuo zoux nyei zorng-zengx,
se zuqc zeqc naanc nyei hnoi orqv mienh duqv njoux, Tin-Hungh qiex jiez nyei hnoi yaac duqv biaux ndutv.
Haaix dauh dorng jienv orqv mienh gorngv ninh? Ziux ninh zoux nyei haaix dauh winh bun ninh?
Gaeng ninh mingh taux zouv wuov zanc, zungv maaih mienh zuov jienv ninh nyei zouv aqv.
Weic ninh wuov norm horngz nyei nie heng nyei. Zuangx mienh gan jienv ninh mingh, mingh ndaangc nyei mienh saauv maiv hingh.
“Meih mbuo ni? Meih mbuo kungx hnamv longc kungx-waac orn yie nyei hnyouv? Meih mbuo dau nyei waac maiv maaih haaix nyungc cuotv liuz nduov mienh nyei waac.”
Temaan Mienh, E^li^fatv, ziouc dau,
“Mienh haih weic Tin-Hungh maaih lamh longc nyei fai? Cong-mengh mienh weic ninh maaih lamh longc nyei fai?
Se gorngv meih zoux kuv mienh, haih zoux bun Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh a'hneiv fai? Fai se gorngv meih zoux dunh yunh nyei mienh, haih bun Tin-Hungh duqv haaix nyungc?
“Se weic zuqc meih taaih ninh, ninh cingx gorngv meih yaac siemv meih nyei zuiz fai?
Se meih zoux nyei orqv sic hlo haic maiv zeiz? Meih zoux nyei zuiz yaac maiv maaih jomc nyei dorngx.
Meih aapv gorx-youz an dorngx-daauh yaac maiv maaih gorn-baengx. Zungv zorqv nzengc ninh mbuo nyei lui-houx bun ninh mbuo laengh gaengv nyei yiem.
Kouv nyei mienh meih maiv bun wuom ninh mbuo hopv, hnyouv sie nyei mienh meih yaac maiv bun hnaangx nyanc.
Meih longc meih nyei hatc maaz duqv lingh deic, maaih mengh dauh nyei mienh duqv yiem naaic.
Meih zunc auv-guaav kungx-buoz baeqc zaux nyei nzuonx yaac zoux doqc guh hanh fu'jueiv.
Weic naaiv maaih mungz zaeng weih gormx meih. Meih jangx maiv zaaic nyei ziangh hoc liemh zeih zuqc gamh nziex nyei sic.
Hmuangx om jienv meih, meih ziouc mangc maiv buatc, wuom yaac yiemx jienv meih.
“Tin-Hungh maiv zeiz yiem gu'nguaaic lungh hlang nyei dorngx fai? Mangc hlang jiex nyei hleix, ninh mbuo ndongc haaix hlang!
Meih corc gorngv, ‘Tin-Hungh hiuv duqv haaix nyungc? Ndongc naaic hmuangx, Tin-Hungh hnangv haaix nor haih mangc duqv tong siemv zuiz?
Mbuonx-hoz om jienv ninh, ninh ziouc mangc maiv buatc. Ninh yaac youh lungh gu'nguaaic.’
“Meih corc oix gan loz-jauv fai? Naaiv se orqv mienh yangh jiex nyei jauv.
Maiv gaengh taux daic nyei ziangh hoc, ninh mbuo zuqc zorqv mingh mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo nyei gorn-ndoqv zuqc wuom guaatv mingh.
Ninh mbuo gorngv mbuox Tin-Hungh, ‘Leih nqoi yie mbuo maah!’ yaac gorngv, ‘Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh haih zoux haaix nyungc bun yie mbuo?’
Mv baac Tin-Hungh corc bun longx nyei ga'naaiv buangv nzengc ninh mbuo nyei biauv. Orqv mienh hnamv nyei jauv yie yaac maiv haih mengh baeqc.
“Kuv mienh buatc ninh mbuo zuqc baaic ziouc a'hneiv, maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh yaac kuh jatv
gorngv, ‘Mbuo nyei win-wangv ndongc haaix zungv zuqc pai guangc. Ninh mbuo zengc njiec nyei ga'naaiv zuqc douz buov qui nzengc.’
“Yopv aac, meih oix zuqc caux Tin-Hungh zoux horpc, caux ninh baengh orn, Tin-Hungh ziouc bun meih duqv longx.
Oix zuqc zipv ninh nyei nzuih njaaux nyei waac, siou ninh nyei waac yiem meih nyei hnyouv gu'nyuoz.
Se gorngv meih nzuonx daaih lorz Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh meih ziouc duqv ceix jiez hnangv loz wuov nor. Se gorngv meih guangc orqv sic leih meih nyei ndopv-liuh go,
se gorngv meih zorqv jiem guangc jienv nie-mbung, zorqv Ofi nyei zien jiem guangc wuov ndoqv-zuonx nyei la'bieiv-qangx,
se gorngv Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh benx meih nyei jiem, yaac benx meih jaaix haic nyei nyaanh,
hnangv naaiv meih ziouc a'hneiv Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh yaac cau hmien lorz Tin-Hungh.
Meih ziouc daux gaux jouh ninh, ninh yaac oix muangx meih. Meih yaac jaauv sung meih laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Meih dingc hnyouv zoux haaix nyungc, meih ziouc haih zoux duqv cuotv nyei. Njang yaac oix ziux meih nyei jauv.
Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh zatv jienv zoux maux nyei mienh, mv baac njoux nyiemc ganh zoux faix nyei mienh.
Liemh zoux dorngc nyei mienh ninh yaac oix njoux. Se gorngv meih zoux duqv horpc meih ziouc duqv njoux.”
Yopv ziouc dau,
“Ih hnoi yie corc ngaengc jienv ngopv Tin-Hungh, maiv gunv yie njunh jienv yiem, ninh nyei buoz zatv jienv yie.
Feix duqv yie haih hiuv mingh haaix ndau lorz ninh, feix duqv yie haih mingh taux ninh yiem nyei dorngx.
Yie ziouc yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien sux yie nyei sic. Yie oix gorngv nzengc yie nyei diuh diuh jauv.
Yie oix hiuv duqv ninh hnangv haaix nor dau yie, yaac oix mengh baeqc ninh caux yie gorngv nyei waac.
Tin-Hungh oix longc ninh nyei domh qaqv caux yie nzaeng fai? Maiv zeiz! Ninh zungv oix muangx yie gorngv nyei waac.
Yiem ninh wuov, hnyouv zingx nyei mienh haih caux ninh nzaeng leiz, siemv zuiz jien ziouc dingc yie yietc liuz maiv dorngc.
“Yie mingh dong bung lorz Tin-Hungh mv baac ninh maiv yiem naaic. Mingh fai bung, mv baac maiv buatc ninh.
Ninh yiem baqv bung zoux gong nyei ziangh hoc yie mangc maiv buatc ninh. Yie huin mingh naamh bung mv baac maiv duqv buatc ninh.
Mv baac ninh hiuv duqv yie yangh nyei jauv. Ninh seix liuz yie, yie ziouc hnangv jiem nor.
Yie nyei zaux yangh nitv jienv ninh nyei zaux-mbiec mingh. Yie gan jienv ninh nyei jauv, yaac maiv mingh pien.
Yie maiv simv ninh nyei nzuih hatc nyei waac. Yie funx yiem ninh nyei nzuih cuotv nyei waac gauh jaaix jiex yie qiemx longc nyei nyanc hopv.
“Tin-Hungh yietc liuz maiv goiv yienc. Maaih haaix dauh haih tiuv ninh nyei za'eix? Ninh oix zoux nyei ninh ziouc zoux.
Ninh weic yie dingc nyei za'eix oix zoux ziangx, ninh corc maaih naaiv nyungc za'eix camv nyei.
Weic naaiv yie yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien gamh nziex sin-zinx. Yie hnamv taux ninh yie ziouc gamh nziex haic.
Tin-Hungh bun yie hnyouv mau. Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh bun yie gamh nziex haic aqv,
weic zuqc hmuangx weih gormx yie, mapv maengh mapv hmuangx nyei buang jienv yie nyei hmien.
“Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh weic haaix diuc maiv dingc siemv zuiz nyei hnoi? Hiuv duqv ninh wuov deix weic haaix diuc maiv duqv buatc ninh dingc daaih nyei hnoi?
Mienh suiv ndeic-nqenx nyei dongc, ninh mbuo caangv ba'gi yungh caux yungh dorh mingh yungz.
Ninh mbuo zorqv guh hanh fu'jueiv nyei lorh, yaac zorqv auv-guaav nyei ngongh zoux dorngx-daauh.
Ninh mbuo fongv guh hanh fu'jueiv cuotv jauv-hlen, lungh ndiev nyei mouz laanh mienh jomc mienh bingx nzengc.
Hnangv yiem deic-bung-huaang nyei hieh lorh, mienh jomc mienh cuotv mingh jiex naaiv jiex wuov lorz nyanc. Ninh mbuo kaux deic-bung-huaang uix ninh mbuo nyei fu'jueiv.
Ninh mbuo mingh mienh nyei ndeic nzauz mbiauh dorngc, yaac mingh orqv mienh nyei a'ngunc huingx nzauz gaeqv liuz zengc njiec nyei biouv.
Ninh mbuo laengh gaengv nyei bueix jiex muonz, maiv maaih lui-houx zuqv. Juangv nyei ziangh hoc maiv maaih haaix nyungc homc.
Ninh mbuo yiem mbong zuqc mbiungc liemh ndorn, ziouc qam la'bieiv weic zuqc maiv maaih dorngx bingx.
Orqv mienh caangv maiv maaih die nyei guh hanh fu'jueiv yiem maa nyei la'kuotv mingh, zorqv mienh jomc mienh nyei gu'nguaaz zoux dorngx-daauh.
Mienh jomc mienh jiex naaiv jiex wuov laengh gaengv nyei yiem, maiv maaih lui-houx zuqv, ninh mbuo hnyouv sie jienv tengx mienh ndaam mbiauh zeiv.

Ninh mbuo yiem orqv mienh nyei yietc liouz yietc liouz ga'lanv ndiangx mbu'ndongx zaax ga'lanv youh, yaac yiem nyueih a'ngunc biouv nyei zorngh nyueih biouv, mv baac ninh mbuo jaang nqaatv jienv yiem.
Yiem zingh gu'nyuoz maaih aav lamh daic nyei mienh njunh nyei qiex cuotv, zuqc mun nyei mienh heuc jienv tov tengx, mv baac Tin-Hungh maiv muangx ninh mbuo daux gaux tov nyei waac.
“Aengx maaih mienh nqemh njang, ninh mbuo maiv zuoqc njang nyei jauv, yaac maiv gan njang nyei jauv yangh.
Lungh maiv gaengh njang, daix mienh nyei mienh jiez sin, weic mingh daix mienh jomc mienh caux dangx-donx nyei mienh. Lungh muonz zanc ninh zoux zaqc nimc ga'naaiv.
Hienx auv nyei mienh zuov jienv nziemx-yaangh nyei ziangh hoc taux. Ninh gorngv, ‘Maiv maaih haaix dauh nyei m'zing duqv buatc yie.’ Ninh yaac buang jienv ninh nyei hmien.
Lungh muonz zanc janx-zaqc mborqv tong kuotv bieqc biauv, lungh hnoi zanc ninh mbuo bingx, ninh mbuo maiv hiuv duqv njang.
Mapv maengh mapv hmuangx nyei ziangh hoc weic ninh mbuo yietc zungv se hnangv lungh ndorm nyei njang, weic zuqc ninh mbuo guenx lungh muonz zanc gamh nziex nyei sic.
“Orqv mienh hnangv wuom-mbiaauz siepv-siepv mbiouh jienv gan wuom-minc mingh. Ninh mbuo yiem deic-bung duqv nyei buonc zuqc zioux. Ninh mbuo maiv duqv mingh ninh mbuo nyei a'ngunc huingx.
Lungh haanz, nyutc doqc bun sorng yuqc mingh nzengc. Yiemh gen fih hnangv nyei bun baamz zuiz wuov deix zutc nzengc mi'aqv.
Ninh mbuo nyei maa zungv la'kuqv ninh mbuo, gaeng-mau nyanc nzengc ninh mbuo nyei sei haiz gaam nyei. Maiv maaih haaix dauh jangx duqv ninh nyei mbuox. Orqv mienh hnangv ndiangx nor, nauv ndutv.
Ninh mbuo pienx maiv yungz jiex gu'nguaaz nyei m'sieqv dorn, yaac maiv zoux longx bun auv-guaav.
Mv baac Tin-Hungh longc ninh nyei qaqv mietc nzengc henv haic nyei mienh. Tin-Hungh yietv dongz sin ninh mbuo ziouc daic nzengc.
Tin-Hungh ceix baengh orn bun ninh mbuo, bun ninh mbuo maaih dorngx kaux, mv baac ninh nyei m'zing zanc-zanc mangc jienv ninh mbuo zoux nyei jauv.
Ninh mbuo duqv mienh taaih se weic caamx baav hnangv, ziang naaic maiv buatc mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo hnangv miev nor, nyaux nqaai, yaac hnangv zuqc gaatv nyei mbiauh dorv nor.
“Se gorngv maiv zeiz hnangv naaic, haaix dauh haih bun cing yie gorngv-baeqc? Haaix dauh haih bun cing yie gorngv nyei waac se maiv zien?”
Quwaa Mienh, Mbin^ndatc, ziouc gorngv,
“Tin-Hungh maaih hlo jiex nyei lingc gunv. Maanc mienh oix zuqc taaih ninh. Ninh yiem ninh hlang nyei dorngx liepc baengh orn.
Maaih haaix dauh haih saauv duqv hingh ninh nyei tin-baeng? Ninh nyei njang cuotv daaih maaih haaix dauh ninh ziux maiv taux?
Wuov nyungc baamh mienh hnangv haaix nor haih yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien zoux duqv horpc? Yiem m'sieqv dorn cuotv seix nyei mienh hnangv haaix nor haih cing-nzengc?
Ziux Tin-Hungh mangc, liemh hlaax maiv njang, hleix yaac maiv cing-nzengc.
Wuov nyungc, baamh mienh kungx hnangv gaeng-mau, mienh yaac hnangv naang-nzung, gauh fatv maiv cing-nzengc.”
Yopv ziouc dau,
“Meih gengh! tengx yie, dongh maiv maaih qaqv nyei mienh orqc? Meih gengh njoux duqv mau haic nyei mienh orqc?
Meih tengx maiv maaih cong-mengh nyei mienh caangh laangh duqv longx haic, yaac bun cing meih maaih hlo haic nyei wuonh zaang orqc?
Haaix dauh tengx meih gorngv cuotv naaiv deix waac? Maaih haaix dauh dongz zuqc meih hnangv naaiv nor gorngv?
“Yiem yiemh gen nyei mienh, se yiem wuom-ndiev caux wuom gu'nyuoz nyei mienh nyanh nyanh nyei.
Yiemh gen yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien buatc duqv nqaengc nyei, zuqc mietc nyei dorngx maiv maaih haaix nyungc torngv.
Tin-Hungh zorqv baqv bung nyei lungh corng kungx nyei dorngx gu'nguaaic, yaac zorqv baamh gen kuangx jienv maiv maaih haaix nyungc nyei dorngx.
Ninh beu wuom yiem buangv mbuonx-hoz gu'nyuoz, wuom yaac maiv zoux bun mbuonx mbaaix.
Ninh bun mbuonx torngv jienv ninh nyei weic, zorqv ninh nyei mbuonx corng daaih buang jienv.
Ninh yiem wuom-minc guetv huing gormx, yiem njang caux hmuangx gapv nyei dorngx.
Ninh hemx lungh nyei ndiouh, ninh mbuo ziouc gamh nziex nyanh nyanh nyei.
Ninh longc ninh nyei qaqv bun koiv sekv, yaac longc ninh nyei wuonh zaang mborqv hingh Laa^hapc.
Ninh bun ninh nyei nziaaux buonc lungh nzang, ninh longc ninh nyei buoz nzopv daic siepv nyei domh naang.

Mv baac naaiv se gorngv deix baav Tin-Hungh nyei jauv-louc. Yie mbuo kungx haiz diqv dien waac-sapv gorngv taux ninh hnangv. Mv baac ninh nyei domh qaqv mbui hnangv mba'ong nor, haaix dauh haih bieqc hnyouv?”
Yopv aengx borqv jienv gorngv ninh nyei jauv-louc. Ninh gorngv,
“Yie ziangv jienv yietc liuz ziangh nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh maiv bun yie duqv baengh fim nyei leiz, se ziangv jienv Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh bun yie hnyouv mun wuov dauh, houv waac,
da'faanh yie corc maaih qiex tauv, yaac maaih Tin-Hungh nyei qiex yiem yie nyei mba'zorng,
yie nyei nzuih meix zungv maiv gorngv jaav nyei waac, yie nyei mbietc yietc liuz maiv gorngv-baeqc.
Yie ndongc haaix zungv maiv gorngv meih mbuo horpc, taux yie daic yie corc ngaengc jienv gorngv yie maiv zoux dorngc.
Yie ngaengc jienv gorngv yie zoux duqv horpc, maiv bungx guangc. Da'faanh yie yiem seix zaangc nyei hnoi-nyieqc, yie nyei hnyouv maiv nqemh yie ganh.
“Tov bun yie nyei win-wangv hnangv orqv mienh nor, yaac bun caux yie doix-dekc wuov deix hnangv maiv baengh fim nyei mienh.
Maiv taaih Tin-Hungh nyei mienh zuqc Tin-Hungh pai guangc, se zorqv ninh nyei maengc nyei ziangh hoc, ninh maaih haaix nyungc maaih lamh hnamv?
Ninh zuqc zeqc naanc nyei ziangh hoc, Tin-Hungh oix muangx ninh tov nyei waac fai?
Ninh ziouc a'hneiv Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh fai? Ninh oix zanc-zanc heuc Tin-Hungh fai?
“Yie oix njaaux meih mbuo hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh nyei qaqv ndongc haaix hlo, Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh nyei za'eix yie yaac maiv bingx.
Naaiv meih mbuo yietc zungv buatc jiex. Wuov nyungc meih mbuo weic haaix diuc gorngv cuotv maiv lamh longc nyei waac?
“Naaiv se Tin-Hungh bun orqv mienh duqv nyei buonc, se Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh bun zeix mienh wuov deix nzipc nyei buonc.
Maiv gunv ninh nyei fu'jueiv hiaangx camv, se weic bun zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix. Ninh nyei fun-faqv yaac yietc liuz maiv duqv nyanc beuv.
Ninh zengc njiec nyei mienh zungv zuqc wuon-baengc daic, ninh mbuo nyei auv-guaav yaac maiv nyiemv.
Maiv gunv orqv mienh zornc nyaanh ndui jienv hnangv nie-mbung, maaih lui-houx camv zungv zuqv maiv hingh,
maiv gunv ninh ndui jienv, mv baac kuv mienh duqv zuqv, maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh duqv bun nqoi ninh nyei nyaanh.
Orqv mienh zoux biauv hnangv gaeng-nyorc mbiorngz, hnangv siouv gaeng mienh zoux nyei liuh.
Ninh bueix njiec nyei ziangh hoc ninh butv zoih nyei, mv baac jiex mingh maiv duqv hnangv naaic, ninh nungx nqoi m'zing, maiv buatc nzengc ninh nyei zinh zoih mi'aqv.
Ninh zuqc gamh nziex haic nyei sic hnangv wuom yiemx nor. Lungh muonz zanc nziaaux-zunc hlorv ninh mingh mi'aqv.
Dong bung nyei nziaaux hlorv ninh mingh, ninh ziouc mingh mi'aqv. Nziaaux guaatv ninh mingh leih nqoi ninh nyei dorngx.
Nziaaux zorqv ninh zoi mingh yaac maiv korv-lienh. Ninh njiec qaqv biaux nziaaux nyei qaqv.
Mienh mbaix buoz haav-haav nyei jatv, zunc ninh cuotv ninh nyei loz-dorngx.
“Zien aqv, maaih wetv nyaanh nyei ciangv, yaac maaih dorngx sinx jiem.
Hlieqv yiem ndau-ndiev wetv cuotv daaih, dongh yaac yiem la'bieiv sinx daaih.
Mienh bun hmuangx nyei dorngx tiuv benx njang. Ninh mbuo zimh lorz yiem go jiex nyei dorngx, yiem mapv hmuangx nyei dorngx wetv cuotv la'bieiv.

Ninh mbuo yiem leih mienh nyei dorngx go nyei, wetv ndau-ndiev nyei kuotv, jiex jauv nyei mienh zungv maiv jangx ninh mbuo. Ninh mbuo leih duqv mienh go, yiem kuotv gu'nyuoz nanv jienv hlaang ndioux mingh ndioux daaih.
Ndau-beih aeqv, cuotv laangh ziqc, mv baac ndau-ndiev lunc nzengc hnangv zuqc douz buov nor.
Ndau-ndiev nyei la'bieiv maaih la'bieiv-jaaix mbuov nyei, la'bieiv gu'nyuoz yaac maaih jiem-mbuonv.
“Wuov diuh jauv maiv maaih haaix norm domh jaangv hiuv, domh jaangv-ngongh nyei m'zing yaac maiv buatc jiex.
Ciouv nyei hieh zoih maiv caaiv jiex, sienh yaac maiv yangh jiex wuov.
“Mienh sung buoz mborqv ngaengc haic nyei la'bieiv, wetv mbong njiec taux gorn.
Ninh yiem la'bieiv-mbaengx gu'nyuoz wetv jauv, ninh nyei m'zing duqv buatc nyungc-nyungc jaaix nyei ga'naaiv.
Ninh zaeqv jienv wuom-nyuonh, maiv bun wuom saamx cuotv, bun bingx jienv nyei ga'naaiv cuotv daaih yiem njang.
“Mv baac cong-mengh aeqv, oix zuqc mingh haaix ndau lorz? Wuonh zaang nyei dorngx yiem haaix?
Mienh maiv hiuv duqv cong-mengh nyei jaax-zinh, yiem yaangh gen lorz maiv buatc.
Ndau-ndiev nyei wuom gorngv, ‘Cong-mengh maiv yiem yie gu'nyuoz.’ Koiv yaac gorngv, ‘Cong-mengh maiv caux yie yiem.’
“Longc jiem maaiz yaac maiv duqv, yaac maiv haih nziang nyaanh zic ninh nyei jaax-zinh.
Ofi nyei jiem caux jaaix haic nyei la'bieiv-jieqv baeqc fai mbuov nyei la'bieiv-jaaix yaac maaiz maiv ndutv,
jiem caux jaaix nyei gingx yaac beiv maiv taux. Yaac maiv haih longc zien jiem nyei jaa-sic maaiz ndutv.
Liemh maiv zuqc gorngv taux yiem koiv jaaix nyei la'bieiv fai nzang jiex nyei gingx, cong-mengh nyei jaax-zinh se gauh jaaix jiex jaaix nyei la'bieiv-zou.
E^ti^o^bie yangh ungv nyei la'bieiv-jaaix yaac maiv haih beiv maiv taux, zien jiem nyei jaax-zinh yaac beiv maiv zaaic aqv.
Wuov nyungc cong-mengh yiem haaix daaih? Wuonh zaang nyei dorngx yiem haaix?
Cong-mengh se bingx jienv yietc zungv maaih maengc nyei ga'naaiv nyei m'zing, yaac gem jienv yiem ndaamv-lungh nyei norqc.
Zuqc mietc nyei dorngx caux yiemh gen gorngv, ‘Yie mbuo nyei m'normh haiz deix waac-nziaaux gorngv taux cong-mengh.’
“Tin-Hungh mengh baeqc lorz cong-mengh wuov diuh jauv, yaac hiuv duqv cong-mengh yiem nyei dorngx.
Weic zuqc ninh mangc taux jomc ndau-beih, yaac buatc yiem lungh ndiev nyei nyungc-nyungc.
Tin-Hungh bun nziaaux maaih hniev-daauh wuov zanc, yaac longc ga'naaiv hlaau wuom,
ninh paaiv ziangx mbiungc nyei soux mouc, yaac dingc mba'lingc douz nyei jauv,
wuov zanc ninh buatc cong-mengh yaac gorngv se longx nyei. Ninh liepc jiez yaac zaah mangc.
Tin-Hungh gorngv mbuox mienh, ‘Oix zuqc taaih Ziouv, naaiv se cong-mengh. Yaac oix zuqc guangc orqv sic, naaiv se wuonh zaang.’+”
Yopv aengx borqv jienv gorngv ninh nyei jauv-louc. Ninh gorngv,
“O feix duqv yie nyei maengc haih nzuonx daaih hnangv zinh ndaangc nyei hlaax-nyieqc, hnangv Tin-Hungh goux jienv yie wuov deix hnoi.
Wuov zanc ninh nyei dang ziux jienv yie nyei m'nqorngv gu'nguaaic, ninh nyei njang ziux yie yangh hmuangx nyei dorngx.
Wuov zanc yie lunx, henv nyei ziangh hoc, Tin-Hungh zoux yie nyei doic yaac beu jienv yie nyei ndopv-liuh.
Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh corc caux yie yiem, yie nyei naamh nyouz yaac weih gormx yie.
Yie yangh nyei jauv zungv maaih ngongh nyorx nzaaux zaux, la'bieiv yaac weic yie liouc cuotv ga'lanv youh hnangv ndoqv nor.
“Yie cuotv taux zingh gaengh nyei ziangh hoc, yiem domh zuangx zaamc zueiz jienv yie nyei weic,
mienh lunx mienh buatc yie ziouc simv nqoi, mienh gox mienh souv jiez daaih.
Baeqc fingx nyei bieiv zeiv maiv ko lo, longc buoz buang jienv ganh nyei nzuih.
Maaih mengh dauh nyei mienh yaac sekv nzieqc nyei, ninh mbuo nqapc jienv nzuih, maiv ko lo.
“Da'faanh m'normh haiz nyei mienh, ninh mbuo gorngv yie maaih orn-lorqc, m'zing buatc wuov deix yaac taaih yie,
weic zuqc yie tengx heuc jienv tov nyei mienh jomc mienh caux maiv maaih mienh tengx nyei guh hanh fu'jueiv.
Aav lamh zuqc mietc nyei mienh buang waac bun yie, yie yaac bun auv-guaav nyei hnyouv duqv njien-youh nyei baaux nzung.
Yie longc zoux horpc nyei jauv dorngx lui zuqv, yie zoux baengh fim nyei sic dorngx domh lui-ndaauv caux m'nqorngv-beu.
Yie zoux m'zing maengh mienh nyei m'zing, yaac zoux zaux mbai mienh nyei zaux.
Yie dorngx mienh jomc mienh nyei die, yaac tengx dongh yie maiv hiuv nyei mienh mbenc ninh mbuo nyei sic.
Yie mborqv nauv mienh waaic mienh nyei nyaah ngau, yaac aapv ninh bungx guangc nyaah ngaatc jienv nyei ga'naaiv.
“Wuov zanc yie hnamv, ‘Yie duqv yiem yie ganh nyei biauv daic, aengx jaa yie nyei hnoi-nyieqc ndongc saa-ziou camv.
Yie hnangv diuh ndiangx maaih nzungh ndaauv jienv mingh taux wuom, yaac maaih mbiungc-suiv ziangh muonz yiem yie nyei nquaah.
Mienh zanc-zanc taaih yie, yie nyei qaqv yaac zanc-zanc henv, maiv tuix.’
“Mienh muangx yie yaac zuov jienv, sekv nzieqc nyei muangx yie caangh laangh nyei waac.
Yie gorngv liuz ninh mbuo maiv ko lo, yie nyei waac hnangv mbiungc-suiv nor, ndiepv ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo zuov yie hnangv zuov mbiungc, yaac morngx nqoi nzuih hnangv zuov cun-gen mbiungc.
Ninh mbuo hnyouv mau nyei ziangh hoc, yie zoux hmien njang nyei jatv. Ninh mbuo buatc yie nyei hmien njang, jatv, ziouc tengx ninh mbuo maiv nzauh.

Yie zoux ninh mbuo nyei bieiv zeiv, yaac ginv jauv bun ninh mbuo yangh. Yie hnangv hungh diex yiem ninh nyei jun-baeng guanh mbu'ndongx, yaac hnangv dauh orn hnyouv nyei mienh orn nzauh nyiemv nyei mienh nyei hnyouv.
“Mv baac gauh lunx yie wuov deix mienh jatv yie. Naaiv deix mienh nyei die yie buatc maiv zic duqv caux zuov yie nyei ba'gi yungh guanh nyei juv yiem.
Ninh mbuo nyei buoz nyei qaqv haih tengx haaix nyungc yie? Ninh mbuo nyei qaqv-leqc nzengc mi'aqv.
Laaix jomc kouv yaac ngorc, lungh muonz zanc yiem ndau-huaang ninh mbuo nyanc miev-nzungh nqaai.
Ninh mbuo gaeqv yiem deic-bung-huaang nyei ndiangx-normh, caux maiv maaih mueix nyei ndiangx-nzungh zoux nyanc hopv.
Ninh mbuo yiem mienh mbu'ndongx zuqc zunc cuotv, mienh heuc jienv zunc hnangv zunc janx-zaqc nor.
Ninh mbuo zuqc yiem ndoqv-zuonx nqaai yaac yiem ndau-kuotv caux mbaengx-ngaamh.
Ninh mbuo yiem ndau-huaang hnangv hieh zoih nor heuc, yaac mbengx jienv yiem ndiangx-dorn-fomv ga'ndiev.
Ninh mbuo benx yietc guanh maiv lamh longc nyei haac horngh mienh, zuqc biaav-bin mborqv zunc cuotv deic-bung.
“Ih zanc naaiv deix mienh dorh yie benx nzung baaux, yaac dorh yie benx gouv gorngv.
Ninh mbuo youx yie, simv yie go, yietv buatc yie ziouc tuiv wuom-nzuih naetv yie.
Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh bun yie mau, tengx maiv duqv ganh, ninh mbuo ziouc dorng jienv yie sueih eix zoux.
Naaiv deix ceux lunc nyei mienh yiem yie nyei mbiaauc maengx jiez daaih, ninh mbuo fongv yie cuotv mingh. Ninh mbuo liuc leiz jauv mietc yie.
Ninh mbuo bun yie biaux nyei jauv dangx, aengx jaa zeqc naanc bun yie, yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh dangv ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo ndutc ndutc nyei daaih hnangv bieqc zingh laatc tong nyei dorngx. Yiem baaic waaic nyei dorngx ninh mbuo wuz-wuz nyei daaih.
Gamh nziex haic nyei sic hoic yie kouv haic, yie nyei njang-laangc jiex hnangv nziaaux buonc mingh nor, yie nyei fuqv-loqc yaac hnangv mbuonx jiex mi'aqv.
“Ih zanc yie nyei hnyouv za'gengh kouv haic, zuqc kouv nyei hnoi-nyieqc zorqv jienv yie.
Lungh muonz zanc yie nyei mbungv hlam, nziuv-nziuv nyei mun yaac maiv maaih ziangh hoc dingh.
Tin-Hungh nyei domh qaqv dorngx hnangv yie nyei lui, aengx hnangv lui-jaang nor naeqc jienv yie.
Tin-Hungh zorqv yie zoi njiec wuom-bamc ndorngh, yie ziouc benx nie-mbung caux saaiv mi'aqv.
“Tin-Hungh aac, yie heuc jienv meih, meih yaac maiv dau yie, yie souv jiez daaih, meih kungx bungx m'zing mangc hnangv.
Meih tiuv hnyouv zoux doqc yie, longc meih henv haic nyei buoz zeix yie.
Meih bouh yie faaux yiem nziaaux gu'nguaaic, bun yie geh jienv nziaaux mingh, meih bun yie yiem domh nziaaux zuqc mbeu mingh mbeu daaih.
Yie hiuv duqv meih dorh yie mingh zuqc daic, se taux dingc ziangx dauh dauh ziangh jienv nyei mienh oix zuqc mingh nyei dorngx.
“Mv baac mienh yiem baaic waaic nyei ga'naaiv-ndui sung buoz, yaac yiem ninh zuqc nyei zeqc naanc heuc jienv tov tengx maiv zeiz?
Mienh ndortv naanc nyei ziangh hoc yie maiv zeiz weic ninh mbuo nyiemv fai? Yie nyei hnyouv maiv zeiz weic mienh jomc mienh nzauh fai?
Yie hnamv jienv oix duqv longx mv baac duqv ciouv. Yie zuov jienv njang mv baac hmuangx daaih taux.
Yie nyei hnyouv faan-fei lunc, maiv dingh yietc dangh, kouv naanc nyei hnoi-nyieqc morh jienv yie yiem.
Yie nzauh, hmien hmuangx yaac maiv maaih nyutc ziux, yie souv jienv gapv zunv nyei wuic, heuc jienv tov tengx.
Yie caux hieh juv benx muoz-doic, yaac caux norqc lorh torh zoux doic.
Yie nyei ndopv jieqv yaac nqorqv mi'aqv, yie nyei mbungv jorm hnangv douz buov nor.
Weic naaiv yie nyei daanh baah nyei qiex tiuv benx nzauh nyei qiex. Yie nyei hlauv-ndongh nux nyei qiex tiuv benx mienh nyiemv nyei qiex.
“Yie caux yie nyei m'zing laengz jiez ngaengc waac. Wuov nyungc yie hnangv haaix nor haih hanc cing-nzengc nyei sieqv?
Yiem gu'nguaaic nyei Tin-Hungh oix bun yie duqv nyei buonc se haaix nyungc? Yiem hlang nyei dorngx Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh oix bun yie duqv nzipc haaix nyungc?
Ninh maiv zeiz oix bun zoux maiv horpc nyei mienh zuqc zeqc naanc, yaac bun baamz zuiz nyei mienh zuqc sic fai?
Ninh maiv zeiz mangc yie mingh nyei jauv yaac saauv yie nyei norm-norm zaux-mbiec fai?
“Se gorngv yie zoux jaav nyei jauv, yie nyei zaux yaac siepv-siepv nyei mingh nduov mienh,
tov Tin-Hungh nziang yie yiem baengh fim nyei tin-baengh nziangx, ninh ziouc hiuv duqv yie maiv zoux dorngc.
“Se gorngv yie nyei zaux-mbiec yangh pien zien jauv, yie nyei hnyouv yaac gan yie nyei m'zing, se gorngv yie nyei buoz maaih haaix nyungc zuiz guoqv jienv,
gunv bun yie zuangx yaac bun ganh dauh nyanc, yaac tov weic yie cuotv daaih nyei gaeng-zuangx liemh nzungh baeng cuotv.
“Se gorngv yie nyei hnyouv zuqc baeng mingh lorz m'sieqv dorn, yie yaac bingx jienv yiem yie nyei juangc laangz mienh nyei gaengh ndaangc zuov,
gunv bun yie nyei auv weic ganh dauh m'jangc dorn morc mbuonv, yaac bun ninh caux ganh dauh m'jangc dorn bueix.
Hnangv naaic za'gengh waaic nyei sic, siemv zuiz jien zungv oix zuqc dingc zuiz,
weic zuqc naaiv nyungc zuiz benx douz buov taux zuqc mietc nyei dorngx, yaac bun yie duqv daaih nyei yietc zungv zuqc buov qui.
“Se gorngv yie nyei nouh gauv nouh beiz daaih gox yie, yie mangc piex maiv muangx ninh mbuo gox nyei waac,
wuov nyungc Tin-Hungh jiez daaih naaic yie oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor zoux? Ninh zaah naaic yie nyei ziangh hoc yie oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor dau?
Zeix yie yiem maa nyei ga'sie wuov dauh fih hnangv nyei zeix ninh maiv zeiz? Yaac dongh naaiv dauh Tin-Hungh bun yie mbuo yiem maa nyei ga'sie zeix daaih maiv zeiz?
“Se gorngv yie ngaengc jienv maiv tengx dongh mienh jomc mienh oix duqv nyei, fai bun auv-guaav nyei m'zing baeqc baeqc mangc,
se gorngv yie ganh nyanc yie maaih nyei diqv dien, guh hanh fu'jueiv yaac maiv duqv nyanc,
(weic zuqc ninh lunx nyei ziangh hoc yie dorh ninh hlo daaih hnangv benx ninh nyei die nor, ninh yiem maa nyei ga'sie cuotv daaih yie goux ninh),
se gorngv yie buatc haaix dauh daic laaix maiv maaih lui-houx zuqv, fai buatc dangx-donx nyei mienh maiv maaih haaix nyungc torngv sin,
se gorngv yie maiv bun ninh duqv yie nyei ba'gi yungh nyei biei tengx ninh siouv, ninh nyei hnyouv ziouc maiv buang waac bun yie,
se gorngv yie hiuv duqv yiem zingh gaengh ndaangc nyei sic dorngh maaih mienh tengx yie, yie ziouc sung buoz zeix guh hanh fu'jueiv,
tov bun yie nyei mba'dauh caux mbungv-zeih ndutv mingh, yaac bun yie nyei buoz yiem mbungv-daaux nauv ndutv,
weic zuqc Tin-Hungh bun daaih nyei zeqc naanc bun yie gamh nziex haic. Yaac weic ninh nyei haangh daauh yie maiv haih zoux naaiv nyungc sic.
“Se gorngv yie longc jiem zoux yie kaux nyei dorngx, aengx mbuox zien jiem, ‘Meih benx yie kaux wuonv nyei dorngx,’
se gorngv yie weic yie maaih zinh zoih bungx-zuoqc, fai weic yie nyei buoz zornc duqv camv njien-youh,
se gorngv yie buatc mba'hnoi ziux cuotv njang, fai buatc hlaax nyei njang-laangc jiex gu'nguaaic,
yie nyei hnyouv beic ndiev zuqc yuoqc, yie nyei nzuih zom yie nyei buoz bun cing taaih ninh mbuo,
naaiv yaac benx siemv zuiz jien oix zuqc dingc nyei zuiz, weic zuqc yie maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux bun Yiem Hlang Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh.
“Se gorngv yie buatc nzorng yie wuov deix zuqc baaic, buatc ninh mbuo zuqc orqv sic ziouc njien-youh a'hneiv,
(Yie zungv maiv bun yie nyei nzuih baamz zuiz, zioux bun ninh zuqc daic),
se gorngv yiem yie nyei ndopv-liuh nyei mienh maiv gorngv, ‘Maaih haaix dauh maiv duqv nyanc ninh nyei ziouv nyei nyanc hopv beuv?’
(yiem go daaih nyei mienh maiv zuqc yiem hei-horngc jiex muonz, yie nyei gaengh koi nqoi zipv jiex jauv nyei mienh),
se gorngv yie bingx yie baamz nyei zuiz hnangv Aa^ndam, zorqv zuiz bingx jienv yie nyei hnyouv,
weic zuqc yie gamh nziex zuangx mienh camv, yaac gamh nziex douh zong mienh mangc piex yie, yie ziouc maiv ko lo yaac maiv cuotv gaengh ka'ndau.
“O feix duqv maaih dauh muangx yie. (Naaiv yie faaux yie nyei mbuox. Tov Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh dau yie.) Tov gox yie wuov dauh zorqv gox nyei waac fiev jienv.
Yie ziouc an jienv yie nyei mba'dauh, yaac ndongx jienv hnangv hungh ningv.
Yie oix gorngv mengh mbuox Tin-Hungh yie zoux nyei yietc zungv, yie ziouc hnangv zoux hlo nyei mienh bieqc taux ninh nyei nza'hmien.
“Se gorngv yie nyei ndau gox yie, laih nyei ndau-zuonx lomh nzoih nyiemv,
se gorngv yie nyanc ndau nyei gaeng-zuangx yaac maiv cuotv nyaanh, bun loz-ndau-ziouv guangc maengc,
tov bun njimv cuotv div mbiauh witv, bun miev-zueix cuotv div mbiauh mbaali.” Yopv gorngv nyei waac nzengc mi'aqv.
Naaiv deix buo laanh mienh ziouc dingh njiec, maiv dau Yopv, weic zuqc ziux Yopv mangc, ninh ganh zoux kuv mienh.
Mv baac maaih dauh Laam Fingx, Mbusi Mienh, Mbaa^laa^ken nyei dorn, E^li^hu, qiex jiez. Ninh qiex jiez Yopv weic zuqc Yopv gorngv ninh ganh zoux duqv horpc, maiv zeiz Tin-Hungh.
Ninh yaac qiex jiez Yopv nyei buo dauh doic, weic zuqc ninh mbuo lorz maiv duqv waac dau, maiv gunv ninh mbuo gorngv Yopv dorngc.
E^li^hu zuov jienv oix caux Yopv gorngv weic zuqc wuov deix gauh gox ninh.
E^li^hu buatc naaiv deix buo laanh mienh maiv maaih waac dau ninh ziouc qiex jiez haic.
Mbusi Mienh, Mbaa^laa^ken nyei dorn, E^li^hu, ziouc dau, “Yie hnyangx-jeiv lunx, meih mbuo gox. Weic naaiv yie daamv faix, maiv gaamv gorngv yie hnamv cuotv nyei waac bun meih mbuo muangx.
Yie gorngv, ‘Hnyangx-jeiv gox oix zuqc gorngv, bun siouc nyuonh ndaauv nyei longc cong-mengh njaaux mienh.’
Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh nyei qiex bun baamh mienh nyei hnyouv maaih banh zeic haih mengh baeqc.
Se maiv zeiz laaix hnyangx-jeiv hlang, mienh cingx maaih cong-mengh, fai siouc nyuonh ndaauv cingx bun ninh mbuo mengh baeqc haaix nyungc se horpc.
Weic naaiv yie gorngv. Muangx yie maah! Tov bun yie ziux yie nyei hnyouv hnamv nyei gorngv.
“Yie zuov jienv muangx meih mbuo gorngv nyei waac. Yie muangx meih mbuo hnamv cuotv nyei za'eix, yaac zuov jienv meih mbuo lorz waac gorngv.
Yie longc hnyouv muangx meih mbuo, yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh dau duqv horpc Yopv. Meih mbuo maiv maaih yietc laanh haih dau Yopv nzaeng nyei waac.
Faix fim, maiv dungx gorngv, ‘Yie mbuo lorz duqv cong-mengh. Bun Tin-Hungh ganh dau ninh, maiv zeiz mienh.’
Yopv maiv zeiz zueih yietv zueih nyeic doix yie gorngv, yie zungv maiv longc waac hnangv meih mbuo nor dau.
“Ninh mbuo gamh nziex, maiv aengx dau aqv, zungv maiv maaih waac dau.
Ninh mbuo maiv gorngv waac, yie corc oix zuqc zuov fai? Weic zuqc ninh mbuo souv jienv wuov, yaac maiv maaih waac aengx dau.
Yie ganh yaac oix dau, yie oix ziux yie hnamv nyei jauv gorngv.
Weic zuqc yie maaih waac camv, nyienz maiv jienv, yie nyei hnyouv aapv yie gorngv.
Yie nyei hnyouv hnangv a'ngunc diuv dapv mbuoqc, maiv maaih dorngx bun qiex cuotv. Yaac hnangv siang-ndopv-mbuoqc haih zungx mbaaix.
Yie hnangv haaix oix zuqc gorngv cingx duqv kuh yiem, yie oix zuqc morngx nqoi nzuih dau.
Yie maiv mangc haaix dauh nyei hmien, maiv la'guaih ceng haaix dauh.
Weic zuqc yie maiv hiuv duqv hnangv haaix nor la'guaih ceng, se gorngv yie la'guaih ceng, Zeix Yie Wuov Dauh oix siepv-siepv nyei mietc yie.
“Yopv aac, ih zanc tov muangx yie gorngv, muangx longx yie gorngv nyei yietc zungv waac.
Mangc maah! Ih zanc yie oix gorngv, yie liuc leiz ziangx gorngv aqv.
Yie nyei waac bun cing yie nyei hnyouv zingx, ziux yie hiuv nyei jauv yie nyei nzuih meix gorngv.
Tin-Hungh nyei Singx Lingh zeix yie, Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh nyei qiex bun yie maaih maengc.
Se gorngv meih haih dau yie, dau maah! Liuc leiz ziangx meih nyei waac yaac souv jienv yie nyei nza'hmien.
Ziux Tin-Hungh mangc, yie caux meih fih hnangv, ninh yaac longc ndunh nie zeix yie daaih fih hnangv nyei.
Weic naaiv meih maiv zuqc gamh nziex yie, yie maiv zeiz oix longc qaqv zatv jienv meih.
“Meih gorngv nyei waac yie haiz mi'aqv. Meih gorngv waac nyei qiex bieqc yie nyei m'normh.
Meih gorngv, ‘Yie se cing-nzengc, maiv maaih zuiz. Yie cing-nzengc nyei, maiv dorngc haaix nyungc.
Mv baac Tin-Hungh lorz sic hoic yie, yaac funx yie benx ninh nyei win-wangv.
Ninh zorqv ndiangx gapc jienv yie nyei zaux, aengx zuov jienv yie nyei diuh diuh jauv.’
“Yopv aac, hnangv naaic meih dorngc mi'aqv. Yie oix dau meih. Tin-Hungh se gauh hlo jiex baamh mienh.
Meih weic haaix diuc caux ninh nzaeng gorngv, ‘Ninh maiv dau yie nyei haaix joux waac’?
Tin-Hungh longc naaiv nyungc za'eix gorngv, longc wuov nyungc za'eix gorngv, mv baac mienh maiv longc hnyouv muangx.
Lungh muonz zanc mienh bueix jienv coux, m'njormh ndo nyei ziangh hoc, mbeix mbeix, buatc hinc yaangh nyei sic,
Tin-Hungh bun ninh mbuo nyei m'normh muangx duqv haiz, yaac longc donv nyei waac haeqv ninh mbuo.
weic bun mienh leih nqoi zoux orqv nyei sic, yaac bun ninh mbuo maiv ceng-hlo zoux maux.
Ninh dangv jienv bun mienh maiv zuqc bieqc yiemh gen, njoux ninh mbuo nyei maengc maiv zuqc daic.
“Mienh yaac zuqc mborqv njaaux bueix jienv coux diev mun, ninh nyei mbungv yaac zanc-zanc mun.
Ninh nyei nzuih ziouc youx nyanc hopv, liemh kuv jiex nyei ga'naaiv yaac youx mi'aqv.
Ninh jaic gau, sin zaangc soqv nzengc, mangc maiv buatc orv, zinh ndaangc maiv buatc nyei mbungv, ih zanc mbong cuotv daaih aqv.
Ninh nyei lingh wuonh taux fatv yiemh gen, ninh nyei maengc taux fatv mietc maengc wuov deix.
“Se gorngv maaih dauh fin-mienh daaih tengx ninh zoux mbu'ndongx mienh, se cin-waanc dauh nyei yietc dauh, bun mienh hiuv duqv zoux horpc nyei jauv.
Wuov dauh fin-mienh korv-lienh ninh ziouc gorngv, ‘Tov njoux ninh, maiv dungx bun ninh mingh yiemh gen, yie lorz duqv zuoqc nyei jaax mi'aqv.’
Ninh nyei sin ziouc nzuonx lunx daaih hnangv fu'jueiv nyei, yaac henv jiez daaih hnangv mienh lunx mienh nyei hnoi-nyieqc nor.
Ninh daux gaux jouh Tin-Hungh, Tin-Hungh ziouc zipv ninh, ninh njien-youh nyei mingh yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien. Tin-Hungh aengx bun ninh nzuonx daaih zoux kuv mienh hnangv loz wuov nor.
Ninh yiem mienh nyei nza'hmien baaux nzung gorngv, ‘Yie baamz zuiz, buatc zoux dorngc nyei sic benx zoux horpc nyei jauv. Mv baac Tin-Hungh maiv ziux yie zoux nyei winh bun yie.
Ninh njoux yie, bun yie maiv zuqc njiec taux yiemh gen, yie nyei maengc ziouc duqv buatc njang.’
“Tin-Hungh zoux naaiv deix yietc zungv sic bun mienh, i nzunc, buo nzunc.
Ninh njoux mienh leih ndutv yiemh gen, bun ninh duqv a'hneiv nyei ziangh jienv.
“O Yopv aac, baeng m'normh muangx yie gorngv oc. Tov maiv dungx ko lo, yie ziouc gorngv.
