Se gorngv meih maaih waac gorngv, dau yie maah! Gunv gorngv aqv. Yie a'hneiv muangx weic laengz meih se maiv dorngc.
Se gorngv meih maiv gorngv, tov muangx yie gorngv. Maiv dungx ko lo, yie ziouc zorqv cong-mengh nyei jauv njaaux meih.”
E^li^hu aengx gorngv,
“Meih mbuo cong-mengh nyei mienh aah! Muangx yie nyei waac maah! Meih mbuo maaih wuonh zaang nyei mienh, tov baeng m'normh muangx yie,
weic zuqc m'normh seix waac hnangv mbietc seix nyanc hopv nyei mueix.
Mbuo oix zuqc ginv haaix nyungc se horpc nyei, mbuo ganh oix zuqc dingc haaix nyungc se longx nyei.
“Yopv gorngv, ‘Yie maiv zoux dorngc, mv baac Tin-Hungh maiv bun yie duqv baengh fim nyei leiz.
Maiv gunv yie zoux duqv horpc, yie zuqc funx benx gorngv-baeqc nyei mienh. Maiv gunv yie maiv maaih zuiz, yie zuqc mun, zorc maiv haih longx.’
Maaih haaix laanh mienh hnangv Yopv diev duqv mienh huotv ndongc hopv wuom hec.
Ninh caux orqv mienh zoux doic, yaac caux mienh waaic mienh juangc jauv yangh.
Weic zuqc ninh gorngv, ‘Mienh a'hneiv gan Tin-Hungh haih tengx ninh duqv haaix nyungc longx?’
“Weic naaiv meih mbuo mienh guai mienh aah! Muangx yie maah! Tin-Hungh za'gengh! maiv haih zoux orqv sic. Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh zungv maiv haih zoux dorngc.
Ninh ziux mienh zoux nyei winh bun ninh mbuo, bun mienh duqv puix ninh mbuo zoux nyei jauv.
Zien nyei, Tin-Hungh zungv maiv zoux waaic sic. Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh maiv aaux baengh fim nyei jauv pien.
Haaix dauh orn Tin-Hungh gunv ndau-beih? Fai haaix dauh paaiv ninh gunv gormx lungh ndiev?
Se gorngv Tin-Hungh dingc hnyouv siou ninh bun mienh maaih maengc nyei qiex nzuonx guei ninh ganh,
da'faanh maaih maengc nyei ga'naaiv ziouc liemh zeih daic, baamh mienh zuqc nzuonx benx nie-mbung.
“Se gorngv meih mengh baeqc, muangx yie nyei waac maah! Tov muangx yie gorngv.
Haaix dauh nzorng baengh fim nyei jauv horpc zuqc gunv nyei fai? Meih oix dingc baengh fim nyei, maaih domh qaqv nyei Tin-Hungh maaih zuiz fai?
Tin-Hungh gorngv mbuox hungh diex, ‘Meih se maiv lamh longc,’ yaac gorngv mbuox zoux hlo nyei mienh, ‘Meih se orqv haic.’
Ninh maiv mangc domh jien nyei hmien, yaac maiv funx butv-zoih mienh gauh longc jienv mienh jomc mienh, weic zuqc ninh mbuo yietc zungv se Tin-Hungh nyei buoz zeix daaih nyei.
Ndaamv muonz nyei ziangh hoc, nduqc dangh hnangv mienh ziouc daic. Baeqc fingx zuqc ndanc dongz, zuqc mietc nzengc mi'aqv. Henv wuov deix zuqc zorqv mingh yaac maiv zeiz baamh mienh nyei buoz zoux.
Tin-Hungh mangc jienv mienh nyei jauv, yaac buatc mienh nyei norm-norm zaux-mbiec.
Maiv maaih hmatv jieqv fai mapv hmuangx nyei dorngx bun zoux orqv nyei mienh bingx duqv mbueiz.
Tin-Hungh zungv maiv zuqc dingc ziangh hoc bun mienh mingh yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien zuqc siemv.
Ninh mborqv baaic maaih qaqv nyei mienh yaac maiv zuqc zaah naaic ndaangc. Ninh aengx liepc ganh deix mienh div ninh mbuo.
Hnangv naaic, ninh hiuv duqv ninh mbuo zoux nyei sic ziouc lungh muonz zanc tuix ninh mbuo nyei weic mietc nzengc mi'aqv.
Laaix ninh mbuo zoux nyei orqv sic ninh dorng jienv zuangx mienh mborqv ninh mbuo,
weic zuqc ninh mbuo mingh pien maiv gan ninh, yaac maiv taaih yietc deix ninh nyei doz-leiz.
Weic naaiv ninh mbuo bun mienh jomc mienh nyei qiex mingh taux Tin-Hungh wuov. Zuqc kouv heuc nyei mienh nyei qiex, ninh yaac haiz mi'aqv.

Se gorngv ninh sekv nzieqc, haaix dauh haih dingc ninh maaih zuiz? Ninh buang jienv ninh nyei hmien, haaix dauh haih mangc duqv buatc ninh? Maiv gunv ninh zoux bun yietc guoqv fai yietc laanh mienh, zungv fih hnangv nyei,
weic bun maiv gan Tin-Hungh nyei mienh maiv duqv gunv, yaac maiv duqv zaeng koux hlopv baeqc fingx.
“Se gorngv maaih dauh mienh gorngv mbuox Tin-Hungh ‘Yie zuqc mborqv njaaux liuz, yiem naaiv mingh yie maiv zoux dorngc.
Yie mangc maiv buatc nyei tov meih njaaux yie. Se gorngv yie zoux zuiz, yiem naaiv mingh yie maiv zoux aqv.’
Tin-Hungh oix zuqc ziux meih oix nyei winh bun meih, weic zuqc meih nqemh ninh zoux nyei sic. Meih ganh oix zuqc ginv, maiv zeiz yie. Weic naaiv ziux meih hiuv nyei gunv gorngv aqv.
“Cong-mengh mienh oix gorngv mbuox yie, muangx yie wuov deix mienh guai mienh oix gorngv,
“Yopv gorngv waac yaac maiv hiuv haaix nyungc, ninh nyei waac maiv maaih gorn-baengx.
Feix duqv bun Yopv zuqc seix taux ndiev. Weic zuqc ninh dau nyei waac hnangv orqv mienh nor.
Ninh ngaengc Tin-Hungh aengx jaa ninh nyei zuiz, ninh yiem yie mbuo mbu'ndongx mbaix buoz gorngv waac camv nyei huotv Tin-Hungh.”
E^li^hu aengx gorngv,
“Meih hnamv daaih naaiv se baengh fim nyei fai? Meih gorngv, ‘Yie gauh baengh fim Tin-Hungh?’
meih cingx daaih naaic Tin-Hungh, ‘Yie duqv haaix nyungc longx? Yie maiv baamz zuiz yie duqv haaix nyungc gauh longx baamz zuiz wuov deix?’
“Yie oix dau meih yaac dau caux meih yiem nyei loz-gaeng doic.
“Cau hmien mangc wuov lungh! Mangc yiem meih gu'nguaaic hlang nyei mbuonx.
Se gorngv meih baamz zuiz, meih zoux haaix nyungc hoic Tin-Hungh? Se gorngv meih dorngc zuiz camv jienv faaux, meih nyei zuiz hnangv haaix nor zoux bun ninh?
Se gorngv meih zoux kuv mienh, meih jaa haaix nyungc bun ninh? Fai ninh yiem meih nyei buoz zipv haaix nyungc?
Meih zoux orqv sic kungx hoic baamh mienh hnangv meih nor. Meih zoux kuv mienh kungx tengx baamh mienh duqv longx.
“Mienh laaix zuqc zeix camv ziouc heuc, ninh mbuo tov tengx biaux ndutv henv wuov deix nyei buoz.
Mv baac maiv maaih haaix dauh gorngv, ‘Zeix yie daaih Wuov Dauh Tin-Hungh, se bun mienh lungh muonz zanc baaux nzung wuov dauh, yiem haaix?
Ninh njaaux yie mbuo gauh camv njaaux ndau-beih nyei hieh zoih, yaac bun yie mbuo maaih cong-mengh gauh camv yiem lungh nyei norqc.’
Ninh mbuo heuc jienv tov tengx mv baac Tin-Hungh maiv dau, weic zuqc orqv mienh maux haic.
Ninh mbuo baeqc baeqc heuc, Tin-Hungh zungv maiv muangx. Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh maiv guen maiv sic nyei.
“Wuov nyungc, meih gorngv meih mangc maiv buatc Tin-Hungh, ninh ziouc gauh fatv maiv oix mangc meih. Meih yaac gorngv meih nyei sic yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien, meih yaac zuov jienv ninh.
Ih zanc meih hnamv daaih, maiv gunv Tin-Hungh qiex jiez, ninh maiv dingc zuiz, mienh baamz zuiz ninh maiv gunv aqv.
Weic naaiv Yopv gorngv jienv maiv lamh longc nyei waac mingh, gorngv waac camv yaac maiv hiuv ninh gorngv haaix nyungc.”
E^li^hu aengx nzipc jienv gorngv,
“Tov aengx diev jienv muangx yie gorngv diqv dien, yie ziouc bun meih hiuv, weic zuqc yie corc maaih waac tengx Tin-Hungh gorngv.
Yie oix zorqv yie hiuv nyei jauv yiem go nyei dorngx daaih, yie oix gorngv mengh Zeix Yie Daaih Wuov Dauh se baengh fim nyei.
Za'gengh zien nyei, yie nyei waac maiv jaav, maaih wuonh zaang dunh yunh wuov dauh caux meih yiem.
“Tin-Hungh se henv haic yaac maiv mangc piex haaix dauh, maiv maaih haaix nyungc ninh maiv hiuv.
Ninh maiv bun orqv mienh duqv ziangh jienv, mv baac ninh bun zuqc kouv nyei mienh duqv baengh fim.
Ninh zanc-zanc mangc jienv kuv mienh, liepc ninh mbuo zueiz weic hnangv hungh diex, bun ninh mbuo yietc liuz duqv mienh taaih.
Se gorngv ninh mbuo zuqc limc ndoh jienv yaac zuqc siouc kouv nyei hlaang nzenc jienv,
Tin-Hungh bun ninh mbuo hiuv duqv ninh mbuo zoux nyei sic, caux ninh mbuo nyei zuiz, se bun ninh mbuo hiuv duqv ninh mbuo zoux maux.
Ninh bun ninh mbuo nyei m'normh muangx duqv haiz ninh njaaux nyei waac, yaac hatc ninh mbuo guangc nqoi orqv nyei jauv.

Se gorngv ninh mbuo muangx Tin-Hungh yaac fu-sux ninh, ninh mbuo duqv bungx-zuoqc nyei ziangh jienv yiem buangv ninh mbuo nyei hnoi-nyieqc, duqv orn-lorqc nyei yiem buangv ninh mbuo nyei hnyangx-daauh.
Mv baac se gorngv ninh mbuo maiv muangx, ninh mbuo ziouc zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix, ninh mbuo daic yaac maiv hiuv haaix nyungc.
“Maiv maaih hnyouv taaih Tin-Hungh nyei mienh zanc-zanc qiex jiez. Ninh mbuo zuqc dingc zuiz, ninh mbuo maiv heuc jienv tov tengx.
Lunx nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo daic mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo nyei setv mueiz nyei maengc zuqc nyaiv.
Tin-Hungh longc siouc kouv nyei jauv njoux siouc kouv nyei mienh. Ninh longc zuqc zeix nyei sic koi nqoi ninh mbuo nyei m'normh.
“Tin-Hungh yienz meih cuotv kuonx naanh nyei jauv, bun meih yiem jangv nyei dorngx, maiv maaih haaix nyungc laanh, bun mbenc jienv buangv meih nyei dieh wuov deix nyanc hopv maaih kuv nyei mueix doc.
Mv baac meih zungv zuqc dingc zuiz hnangv orqv mienh, meih yaac biaux maiv ndutv baengh fim nyei zuqc siemv dingc zuiz nyei jauv.
Faix fim oc. Maiv dungx bun zinh zoih yuoqc meih mingh dorngc jauv, yaac maiv dungx bun nyaanh hmuangx camv nduov meih mingh pien.
Meih heuc jienv tov nyei haih tengx meih biaux ndutv kouv naanc fai? Meih ganh nyei yietc zungv qaqv haih tengx duqv meih nyei fai?
Maiv dungx hnamv oix buatc lungh muonz zanc taux, se maanc fingx mienh yiem ninh mbuo nyei dorngx zuqc pai guangc nyei ziangh hoc.
Faix fim, maiv dungx huin mingh lorz zuiz nyei jauv, weic zuqc meih ginv zuiz gauh camv ginv longc kouv naanc.
“Jangx jienv Tin-Hungh nyei qaqv ndongc haaix hlo! Maiv maaih haaix dauh zoux fin-saeng hnangv ninh.
Haaix dauh paaiv Tin-Hungh zoux nyei jauv? Haaix dauh haih gorngv mbuox ninh, ‘Meih zoux maiv horpc’?
Meih oix zuqc jangx jienv ceng ninh zoux nyei sic se hlo haic, dongh mienh baaux nzung ceng nyei sic.
Maanc mienh duqv buatc ninh zoux nyei sic, baamh mienh yiem go nyei dorngx mangc.
“Tin-Hungh za'gengh hlo, mbuo hiuv maiv nzengc. Mbuo maiv haih funx maiv taux ninh nyei hnyangx-soux.
Ninh baeng wuom-ndiepv faaux, bun mouc gapv zunv benx mbiungc,
lungh ziouc duih njiec, camv-camv nyei bun maanc mienh.
Maaih haaix dauh mengh baeqc mbuonx hnangv haaix nor mingh mingh daaih daaih, fai yiem Tin-Hungh yiem nyei dorngx mba'ong hnangv haaix nor mbui?
Ninh bun mba'lingc faatv nzaanx ziux gormx ninh ganh, yaac torngv jienv koiv-ndoqv.
Weic zuqc ninh longc naaiv deix siemv maanc fingx, yaac ceix bungx-zuoqc nyei laangh ziqc bun ninh mbuo.
Ninh longc mba'lingc buang jienv ninh nyei buoz, yaac hatc mba'ong piqv ninh dingc daaih nyei dorngx.
Mba'ong mbui nyei qiex biux mengh ninh zoux nyei sic, saeng-kuv yaac hiuv duqv domh mbiungc-nziaaux oix taux.
“Naaiv deix sic bun yie nyei mba'nziu dongz mbokc mbokc nyei, ndanc zuqc yie nyei wuonh ndaix, daamv mapv nzengc.
Muangx maah! Muangx Tin-Hungh nyei qiex mbui hnangv mba'ong nor, muangx yiem ninh nyei nzuih cuotv njunh njunh nyei qiex.
Ninh bungx mba'lingc cuotv buangv lungh ndiev, ninh nyei mba'lingc mingh jomc lungh gorn.
Nqa'haav maaih ninh nyei qiex njunh jienv daaih, ninh maaih haangh daauh nyei qiex hnangv mba'ong nor mbui, ninh nyei qiex mbui wuov zanc, ninh maiv dangv jienv mba'lingc.
Tin-Hungh nyei qiex mbui cuotv haiz mbuoqc horngh haic. Ninh zoux hlo haic nyei sic, yie mbuo zungv maiv haih bieqc hnyouv.
Weic zuqc ninh mbuox sorng, ‘Duih njiec ndau-beih maah!’ Yaac mbuox mbiungc caux mbiungc-nziaaux, ‘Oix zuqc henv aqv.’
Ninh bun dauh dauh mienh nyei buoz dingh njiec, weic bun zeix daaih nyei maanc mienh hiuv duqv ninh nyei gong.
Hieh zoih bieqc ninh mbuo nyei zunh, yaac yiem ninh mbuo nyei kuotv gu'nyuoz.
Nziaaux-jieqv yiem naamh bung cuotv daaih, juangv nyei qiex yiem baqv bung nyei nziaaux cuotv.
Tin-Hungh nyei qiex bun wuom gitv sorng, wuom-taan yaac gitv ngaengc nzengc.
Ninh bun mbuonx-hoz maaih wuom buangv nzengc, bun mba'lingc yiem mbuonx faatv cuotv.
Ziux Tin-Hungh paaiv, ninh mbuo guinh mingh guinh daaih, youh gormx lungh ndiev zoux ziangx ei jienv ninh hatc nyei yietc zungv.
Ninh bun naaiv deix jauv cuotv daaih weic dingc zuiz fai weic yungz ndau-beih, fai weic zuqc ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
“Yopv aah! Dingh jienv longx-longx nyei muangx taux Tin-Hungh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Meih hiuv nyei fai? Tin-Hungh hnangv haaix nor hatc naaiv deix ga'naaiv, bun mba'lingc yiem mbuonx gu'nyuoz ziux cuotv?
Meih hiuv duqv mbuonx hnangv haaix nor mbiouh jienv ndaamv-lungh nyei fai? Se maaih dunh yunh nyei wuonh zaang wuov dauh zoux nyei mbuoqc horngh sic.
Naamh bung nyei nziaaux bun ndau jorm zongc-zongc nyei, meih yuoqv, lui-houx hnangv douz nor jorm.
Meih haih hnangv Tin-Hungh corng lungh, yaac bun lungh ngaengc hnangv nzaatv daaih nyei dongh siqv gingx fai?
“Tov njaaux yie mbuo, yie mbuo oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor caux Tin-Hungh gorngv. Yie mbuo hnyouv hngongx, hnamv maiv cuotv waac gorngv.
Oix zuqc mbuox ninh, yie oix caux ninh gorngv waac fai? Maaih haaix laanh mienh ganh oix tov zuqc mietc?
Ih zanc nziaaux buonc mbuonx mingh, lungh ziouc nzang, njang aengv jienv, baamh mienh ziouc maiv haih mangc lungh nyei njang.
Yiem baqv bung maaih njang-laangc cuotv hnangv jiem nor, Tin-Hungh daaih yaac maaih gamh nziex nyei haangh daauh.
“Yie mbuo maiv haih mingh nitv fatv Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh. Ninh maaih domh qaqv, maaih baengh fim, ninh zoux duqv horpc haic, yaac maiv zeix mienh.
Weic naaiv mienh taaih ninh. Da'faanh ceng ganh maaih cong-mengh nyei mienh ninh maiv taaih aqv.”
Wuov zanc Ziouv yiem nziaaux-zunc dau Yopv nyei waac. Ninh gorngv,
“Naaiv dongh haaix dauh longc maiv maaih wuonh zaang nyei waac bun yie nyei za'eix muangh mingh?
Meih oix zuqc liuc leiz ziangx hnangv dauh jun-zeiv mienh. Yie oix naaic meih, meih yaac oix zuqc dau yie.
“Yie liepc baamh gen nyei gorn-ndoqv wuov zanc, meih yiem haaix? Se gorngv meih hiuv, mbuox yie maah!
Haaix dauh dingc ndau lomh haaix hlo? Daaix meih hiuv nyei saah? Haaix dauh baeng hlaang ndorqc?
Ndau nyei gorn-ndoqv liepc yiem haaix nyungc gu'nguaaic? Haaix dauh an baamh gen nyei gorqv gauh longc jienv jiex wuov norm la'bieiv?
Wuov zanc lungh ndorm nyei hleix lomh nzoih baaux nzung, zuangx fin-mienh njien-youh nyei heuc.
“Koiv nyei wuom baetv cuotv hnangv gu'nguaaz cuotv maa nyei ga'sie wuov zanc, haaix dauh guon gaengh dangv jienv koiv?
Se yie longc mbuonx buang jienv koiv, yaac longc hmuangx hoz beu jienv ninh.
Yie dingc koiv nyei gapv-jaaix, an jienv gaengh caux gaengh sorn,
yaac gorngv, ‘Meih daaih taux naaiv hnangv, maiv dungx jiex ndaangc, meih henv haic nyei wuom-laangc oix zuqc dingh njiec naaiv.’
“Yopv aac, yiem meih nyei seix zeiv meih duqv hatc jiex lungh ndorm, yaac bun lungh ndorm nziouv hiuv duqv ninh nyei dorngx,
weic bun ninh haih ziux jomc lungh gorn, yaac zunc orqv mienh cuotv ninh bingx nyei dorngx?
Ndau-beih goiv yienc hnangv mborqv jienv yienx nyei ba'naih nie, maanc muotc hinc cuotv mengh nyei hnangv lui-houx nor.
Orqv mienh nyei njang zuqc zorqv nqoi, ziouc dangv jienv maiv bun ninh mbuo zoux doqc nyei sic.
“Meih bieqc jiex taux koiv nyei nyuonh, fai yangh jiex koiv-ndoqv ndo jiex nyei dorngx fai?
Maaih haaix dauh bun meih hiuv duqv zuqc daic nyei gaengh? Yiemh gen hmuangx nyei dorngx nyei gaengh meih buatc jiex nyei fai?
Meih hiuv duqv ndau-beih ndongc haaix jangv fai? Meih hiuv duqv naaiv deix yietc zungv nor, gorngv mbuox yie maah!
“Njang yiem nyei dorngx yangh haaix mingh? Hmuangx yiem nyei dorngx yiem haaix?
Meih haih dorh ninh mingh taux ninh nyei dorngx, weic bun meih hiuv duqv mingh ninh nyei biauv wuov diuh jauv fai?
Meih za'gengh hiuv nyei, weic zuqc zeix baamh gen wuov zanc meih zungv cuotv seix daaih aqv. Meih yiem nyei hnoi-nyieqc gengh camv haic.
“Meih bieqc jiex sorng nyei lamz, fai buatc jiex borqc nyei lamz fai?
Yie liouh jienv sorng caux borqc weic zeqc naanc nyei ziangh hoc, weic mborqv jaax caux mborqv domh jaax nyei hnoi.
Mingh taux njang bun nqoi nyei dorngx yiem haaix? Fai mingh taux dong bung nyei nziaaux bun nzaanx buangv ndau-beih nyei dorngx yiem haaix?
“Haaix dauh weic domh mbiungc wetv wuom-zuonx, yaac koi jauv bun mba'lingc douz?
Haaix dauh bun mbiungc duih njiec maiv maaih mienh yiem nyei ndau, caux maiv maaih mienh yiem nyei deic-bung-huaang?
Haaix dauh bun ndau-huaang ndau-nqaai duqv wuom gaux weic yungz ndau cuotv miev-maeng?
Mbiungc maaih die nyei fai? Fai haaix dauh yungz mbiungc-suiv ndiepv?
Haaix dauh zoux sorng nyei maa? Lungh zaangc nyei mbiungc-suiv gitv, haaix dauh yungz daaih?
Wuom ngaengc mingh hnangv la'bieiv, koiv nyei wuom-minc yaac gitv benx sorng.
“Meih haih zorqv Siec Muoz-Sieqv Hleix ndoh jienv, fai jaiv nqoi Faam-Cing Hleix nyei hlaang fai?
Meih haih dorh hleix-guanh ziux ninh mbuo nyei gueix, fai dorh Ba'dauv Hleix caux gan ninh nyei hleix fai?
Meih hiuv duqv lungh nyei leiz-latc fai? Meih haih bun naaiv deix leiz-latc gunv lungh ndiev fai?
“Meih haih heuc mbuonx duih mbiungc njiec yiemx jienv meih fai?
Meih haih paaiv mba'lingc njiec, mba'lingc ziouc mbuox meih, ‘Yie mbuo yiem naaiv’?
Haaix dauh bun mienh nyei hnyouv maaih cong-mengh, yaac bun hnyouv maaih wuonh zaang?
Haaix dauh maaih cong-mengh saauv mbuonx? Fai haaix dauh haih dox cuotv lungh nyei wuom-ongx,
bun nie-mbung gitv benx ndunh, nie-ndunh yaac gitv jienv jaax?
“Sienh mbaapv jienv yiem ninh mbuo nyei kuotv fai yiem mbueiz nyei dorngx zuov, meih haih lorz ga'naaiv bun nyanc, fai bun sienh lunx duqv nyanc beuv?
Norqc aa laaix maiv maaih ga'naaiv nyanc jiex naaiv jiex wuov, ninh nyei dorn heuc tov Tin-Hungh tengx. Haaix dauh lorz ga'naaiv bun norqc aa nyanc?
“La'bieiv-mbaengx nyei hieh yungh haaix zanc njiec dorn, meih hiuv nyei fai? Njaih nyeiz njiec dorn meih buatc jiex nyei?
Ninh maaih jienv dorn nyei hlaax-nyieqc meih haih saauv nyei fai? Haaix zanc njiec dorn meih hiuv nyei?
Meih hiuv duqv ninh mbuo haaix zanc mbaapv njiec, bun ninh mbuo nyei dorn ndortv ndau fai?
Ninh mbuo nyei dorn henv jienv faaux, yiem lomc-huaang hlo daaih. Ninh mbuo guangc maa mingh yaac maiv nzuonx.
“Haaix dauh bungx hieh lorh? Haaix dauh jaiv ninh nyei hlaang?
Yie zorqv ndau-huaang benx ninh nyei biauv, bun ndau-nzaaih benx ninh yiem nyei dorngx.
Ninh jatv zingh coh coh nyei qiex, maiv haiz zunc saeng-kuv nyei mienh heuc nyei qiex mbui.
Ninh youh gormx mbong benx ninh nyei miev-ciangv, ninh qaqv lorz nyungc-nyungc miev-maeng nyanc.
“Hieh ngongh kangv fu-sux meih fai? Ninh oix yiem meih nyei miev-zoh ga'hlen bueix jiex muonz fai?
Meih haih longc hlaang ndoh jienv hieh ngongh laih ndau fai? Ninh oix gan meih baah yuonh komv nyei dorngx fai?
Weic zuqc ninh maaih qaqv henv meih haih kaux ninh fai? Meih zorqv meih nyei gong-hniev jiu bun ninh zoux?
Meih bungx hnyouv ninh dorh meih nyei laangh ziqc nzuonx daaih? Yaac siou meih nyei mbiauh taux mborqv mbiauh nyei ciangv?
“Norqc lorh torh njien-youh nyei yaapv ndaatv, mv baac sin nyei biei caux ndaatv nyei biei beiv maiv taux norqc nyieh nyei.
Norqc lorh torh ndauc jaux guangc wuov ndau, bun ndau tengx ninh nyei jaux siouv.
Ninh maiv hnamv taux haih zuqc zaux caaiv huv, fai hieh zoih haih caaiv waaic.
Ninh zoux doqc bun ninh nyei dorn, hnangv maiv zeiz benx ninh ganh nyei dorn nor. Maiv gunv ninh ndortv qaqv, ninh yaac maiv korv-fiqv,
weic zuqc Tin-Hungh maiv bun ninh maaih cong-mengh, yaac maiv bun ninh haih bieqc hnyouv.
Mv baac ninh yang jienv ndaatv tiux wuov zanc, ninh jatv maaz caux geh maaz nyei mienh.
“Yopv aac, se meih bun maaz henv fai? Se meih bun maaz nyei jaang maaih nzong ndaauv fai?
Meih bun ninh biu hnangv jopv-nyeic, bun ninh tauv qiex mbui haeqv mienh gamh nziex?
Ninh yiem wuov horngz nyaaiv ndau, yaac a'hneiv ninh nyei qaqv, ninh cuotv mingh buangh dorh jienv wuoqc ginc nyei baeng.
Ninh jatv gamh nziex nyei sic, ninh ganh maiv gamh nziex, buatc nzuqc ndaauv, ninh yaac maiv tuix nzuonx.
Geh maaz mienh buix nyei forng-ndongh saev-saev nyei mbui, yaac maaih cang-ndaauv cang-nangv njapc njapc nyei.
Ninh ciouv-ciouv nyei nyaaiv ndau yaac tiux jienv mingh, yietv haiz jorng nyei qiex mbui ninh souv dingc maiv duqv aqv.
Jorng nyei qiex haaix zanc mbui ninh heuc, ‘Haev haev,’ ninh yiem go nyei hnomv zuqc mborqv jaax nyei qiex, yaac haiz jun-baeng-bieiv caux heuc nyei qiex mbui.
“Domh jaangv yang ndaatv ndaix, hungx jienv naamh bung mingh, naaiv se bangc meih nyei cong-mengh zoux fai?
Se meih paaiv domh jaangv ndaix faaux, yiem hlang nyei dorngx zoux lauz fai?
Ninh yiem hlang jiex nyei mbaengx zoux ninh nyei biauv, bangc mbaengx-ningv zoux ninh wuonv nyei dorngx.
Yiem naaiv ninh mangc jienv zorqv ga'naaiv nyanc, ninh nyei m'zing mangc duqv buatc go nyei.
Ninh nyei dorn sorqv nziaamv, zuqc daix nyei mienh nyei sei yiem haaix, domh jaangv-ngongh yaac yiem wuov.”
Ziouv aengx gorngv mbuox Yopv,
“Yopv aah! Daanh nyei mienh oix caux Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh nzaeng nyei fai? Caux Tin-Hungh nzaeng nyei mienh dau ninh maah!”
Yopv ziouc dau Ziouv. Ninh gorngv,
“ Ziouv aac, yie se ziangh maiv benx haaix nyungc mienh, yie hnangv haaix nor haih dau meih? Yie zungv longc buoz buang jienv nzuih.
Yie gorngv nzunc liuz, yie ziouc maiv dau, gorngv i nzunc, yie ziouc maiv aengx jaa gorngv aqv.”
Wuov zanc Ziouv yiem nziaaux-zunc dau Yopv nyei waac. Ninh gorngv,
“Meih oix zuqc liuc leiz ziangx hnangv jun-zeiv mienh nor. Yie oix naaic meih, meih oix zuqc dau yie.
“Meih oix bun cing yie maiv baengh fim fai? Meih oix dingc yie zoux dorngc weic bun meih ganh horpc fai?
Meih maaih buoz hnangv Tin-Hungh nyei buoz henv fai? Meih maaih qiex ndomh ndomh nyei mbui hnangv ninh nyei qiex mbui fai?
Wuov nyungc, oix zuqc longc njang-laangc zorng nzueic, yaac longc njang-laangc nyei haangh daauh dorngx lui zuqv.
Zoux maux nyei mienh meih qiex jiez, nouz haic, gunv zatv ninh mbuo njiec aiv.
Mangc dauh dauh ceng-hlo nyei mienh yaac baeng ninh mbuo ndortv njiec, zorqv orqv mienh caaiv njiec ninh mbuo yiem nyei dorngx.
Zorqv ninh mbuo yietc zungv biopv jienv nie-mbung, yaac ndoh ninh mbuo yiem yiemh gen.
Hnangv naaic yie ziouc nyiemc bun meih, meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz haih njoux duqv ganh.
“Mangc Mbe^he^motv maah! Yie zeix ninh hnangv yie zeix meih. Ninh nyanc miev hnangv ngongh nor.
Ninh nyei qaqv yiem ninh nyei jaaiv, ninh nyei ga'sie nyei orv yaac maaih qaqv henv.
Ninh bun ninh nyei dueiv ngaengc hnangv si^ndaa zongh ndiangx, ninh nyei camh zuih nyei jaan ciqv jienv jaax.
Ninh nyei mbungv hnangv dongh siqv ndongh, ninh nyei buoz-zaux hnangv hlieqv-biaav.
Ninh se Tin-Hungh zeix daaih nyei da'yietv dauh, kungx Zeix Ninh Daaih Wuov Dauh haih hingh ninh.
Zuangx mbong cuotv nyanc nyei ga'naaiv bun ninh, benx yietc zungv hieh zoih nziaauc nyei dorngx.
Ninh bueix njiec ndiangx-njimv ga'ndiev, yiem njaangh nyei luoqc diqc lomc gu'nyuoz.
Weic zuqc ndiangx-njimv tengx ninh bingx laangh, ndoqv-hlen nyei suiv-liemh ndiangx weih gormx ninh.
Maiv gunv wuom seix, ninh maiv gamh nziex, maiv gunv Jor^ndaen Ndaaih nyei wuom congx zuqc ninh nyei nzuih baengx, ninh yaac maiv huaang.
Haaix dauh haih buang jienv ninh nyei m'zing zorqv ninh? Haaix dauh haih zorqv ninh aengx cunx tong ninh nyei mba'zorng?
“Yopv aah! Meih haih longc diux zorqv Le^wi^aa^taan, fai longc hlaang ndoh ninh nyei mbietc fai?
Meih haih longc hlaang cunx ninh nyei mba'zorng, fai longc ngau kuangx ninh nyei haah baah fai?
Ninh oix qaqv tov meih korv-lienh nyei fai? Ninh oix longc suonc nyei waac caux meih gorngv?
Ninh oix caux meih liepc ngaengc waac, laengz yietc liuz zoux meih nyei nouh?
Meih haih zorqv ninh dorngx norqc longc a'nziaauc, fai ndoh jienv hlaang ken nduov meih nyei sieqv-lunx a'hneiv fai?
Zorqv mbiauz mienh dorh ninh daaih gorngv jaax-zinh, saeng-eix mienh ziouc zorqv ninh bun nqoi fai?
Meih haih longc cang-fou cunx ninh nyei ndopv, fai longc nzopv mbiauz cang nzopv ninh nyei m'nqorngv fai?
Longc meih nyei buoz muoqv ninh, haaix zanc jangx zuqc meih caux ninh mborqv jaax, meih yietc liuz maiv aengx zoux aqv.
Mienh maaih lamh hnamv oix zorqv ninh mv baac maiv zeiz aqv, daan buatc ninh hnangv, daamv mapv aqv, king njiec ndau.
Maiv maaih haaix dauh ciouv gaux cuoqv ninh. Wuov nyungc, haaix dauh haih yiem yie nyei nza'hmien souv duqv wuonv?
Maaih haaix dauh bun haaix nyungc yie, dongh yie oix zuqc winh bun ninh? Lungh ndiev nyei maanc muotc yietc zungv se yie nyei.
“Yie yaac maiv nyienz jienv maiv gorngv taux ninh nyei buoz-zaux, fai ninh nyei domh qaqv fai ninh nyei sin liouc.
Haaix dauh haih ciev ninh nyei ga'nyiec wuov yiemc lui? Haaix dauh haih nzopv bieqc ninh nyei i yiemc hlieqv-lui?
Haaix dauh haih maeqv nqoi ninh nyei nzuih baengx? Huing gormx ninh nyei nzuih nyei nyaah haeqv mienh gamh nziex haic.
Ninh nyei diqc daanz nyei jiex benx yietc liouz yietc liouz hnangv torngv-baaih nor, nitv jienv jaax maqc nyei, gapv jienv ndipc nyei hnangv la'bieiv nor ngaengc.
Naaiv deix jiex yietc kuaaiv gapv yietc kuaaiv ndipc haic, qiex zungv maiv haih jiex mbu'ndongx-qangx.
Jiex gitv jienv jaax, yietc kuaaiv lapv yietc kuaaiv, maiv haih maeqv maiv nqoi.
Ninh ciuv ziouc maaih njang njapc dangh cuotv daaih. Ninh nyei m'zing hnangv lungh ndorm nziouv nyei njang-laangc.
Ninh nyei nzuih cuotv douz hnangv douz-baav, yaac maaih douz-fing ndaix cuotv.
Ninh nyei mba'zorng cuotv douz-sioux, hnangv caeng mbueix caux zieqc jienv nyei luoqc diqc guaengv nor.
Ninh biomv qiex bun douz-taanx zieqc, ninh nyei nzuih cuotv douz-mbietc.
Ninh nyei jaang za'gengh henv haic, da'faanh buangh ninh wuov deix gamh nziex! haic.
Ninh nyei orv-nziu ciqv jienv jaax zietc nyei, ngaengc nyei, hnangv dox daaih nyei hlieqv nor, nqamv maiv dongz.
Ninh nyei hnyouv ngaengc hnangv la'bieiv, hnangv ga'ndiev maengx morc.
Ninh jiez sin, mienh henv mienh gamh nziex, ninh zoux ciouv, ninh mbuo hnyouv waaic nzengc.
Maiv gunv longc nzuqc ndaauv nzopv, yaac hoic maiv zuqc ninh, liemh nzopv nyei cang caux biu nyei cang yaac hoic maiv zuqc ninh.
Weic ninh nor, hlieqv dorngx mbiauh nqaauv, dongh siqv dorngx ndiangx-latv.
Forng haeqv maiv duqv ninh biaux, bungx la'bieiv nyei ndopv-hlaang weic ninh dorngx mbiauh nqaauv gorn.
Ndiangx-ndonx dorngx mbiauh nqaauv gorn, ninh yaac jatv biu cang nyei qiex mbui.
Ga'sie ndoqv nyei jiex laic hnangv nie-mor huv. Ninh luih jienv gan wuom-bamc jiex hnangv nyueih mbiauh nyei jaa-sic.
Ninh bun ndo nyei wuom mbueix hnangv caeng mbueix, bun koiv hnangv caeng gu'nyuoz nyei ndie-youh.
Ninh jiex mingh nyei jauv nqa'haav maengx cuotv njang njapc njapc nyei, mienh ziouc hnamv daaih koiv ndo nyei dorngx maaih mba'biei baeqc.
Yiem lungh ndiev maiv maaih haaix nyungc hnangv ninh. Ninh benx zeix cuotv nyei ga'naaiv, yaac maiv gamh nziex haaix nyungc.
Ninh mangc nyungc-nyungc yiem hlang nyei ga'naaiv. Ninh zoux zuangx hieh zoih nyei hungh.”
Yopv ziouc dau Ziouv,
“Yie hiuv duqv maanc sic meih haih zoux nyei, meih nyei za'eix maiv maaih haaix nyungc haih dangv duqv jienv.

Meih naaic, ‘Naaiv haaix dauh longc maiv maaih wuon-zaang nyei mienh gem jienv yie nyei za'eix?’ Weic naaiv yie gorngv yie maiv mengh baeqc nyei sic, se mbuoqc horngh haic nyei sic, zungv jiex ndaangc yie haih hiuv nyei.
Meih gorngv, ‘Muangx yie maah! Yie oix gorngv. Yie oix naaic meih, tov meih dau yie.’
Zinh ndaangc yie nyei m'normh haiz mienh gorngv taux meih, mv baac ih zanc yie nyei m'zing duqv buatc meih.
Weic naaiv yie youx yie ganh, yaac goiv hnyouv zueiz jienv nie-mbung caux saaiv-ndui.”

Ziouv caux Yopv gorngv liuz naaiv deix waac, Ziouv gorngv mbuox Temaan Mienh, E^li^fatv, “Yie qiex jiez meih caux meih nyei i dauh loz-gaeng doic, weic zuqc meih mbuo gorngv yie wuov deix waac se maiv horpc, maiv hnangv yie nyei bou, Yopv, gorngv nor.

Ih zanc meih mbuo oix zuqc dorh siec dauh ngongh gouv caux siec dauh yungh gouv mingh taux yie nyei bou, Yopv, wuov, weic meih mbuo ganh fongc horc buov ziec. Yie nyei bou, Yopv, ziouc weic meih mbuo daux gaux, weic zuqc yie oix zipv ninh daux gaux nyei waac, maiv ziux meih mbuo zoux hngongx nyei jauv winh bun meih mbuo. Weic zuqc meih mbuo gorngv yie wuov deix waac se maiv horpc, maiv hnangv yie nyei bou, Yopv, gorngv nor.”
Temaan Mienh, E^li^fatv, caux Quwaa Mienh, Mbin^ndatc, caux Naa^aa^me Mienh, Sofaa, ziouc ei jienv Ziouv paaiv nyei waac zoux. Ziouv yaac zipv Yopv daux gaux nyei waac.
Yopv weic ninh nyei loz-gaeng doic daux gaux liuz, Ziouv aengx bun Yopv duqv longx hnangv loz wuov nor. Ziouv aengx jaa tipv bun ninh gauh camv zinh ndaangc i gouv.

Yopv nyei muoz-doic caux zinh ndaangc hiuv duqv ninh wuov deix mienh yietc zungv daaih lorz ninh yaac yiem ninh nyei biauv caux ninh nyanc hnaangx. Ninh mbuo yaac weic Ziouv bun ninh zuqc orqv nyei yietc zungv zeqc naanc bun cing ninh mbuo korv-lienh ninh yaac orn ninh nyei hnyouv. Mouz dauh mienh bun norm nyaanh caux norm jiem-buoz-ndoqv-nzaeng.

Ziouv ceix fuqv bun Yopv setv mueiz nyei hnoi duqv gauh camv zinh ndaangc nyei hnoi-nyieqc. Ninh maaih ba'gi yungh yietc waanc biei cin dauh, lorh torh juqv cin dauh, ngongh yietc cin doix, lorh nyeiz yietc cin dauh.
Ninh aengx maaih siec dauh dorn, buo dauh sieqv.
Ninh tengx sieqv-hlo cuotv mbuox heuc Ye^mi^maa, da'nyeic dauh sieqv nyei mbuox heuc Ke^si^yaa, da'faam dauh sieqv nyei mbuox heuc Kelen Hapc^bukc.
Yiem gormx wuov norm deic-bung lorz maiv duqv ndongc Yopv nyei sieqv nzueic. Yopv yaac bun ninh nyei sieqv duqv caux ninh mbuo nyei gorx, ninh mbuo nyei nauz, nzipc ninh nyei jaa-dingh.
Nqa'haav Yopv aengx ziangh jienv yietc baeqv feix ziepc hnyangx yaac duqv buatc ninh nyei dorn caux ninh nyei fun-faqv njiec taux biei doic mienh.
Yopv ziangh duqv siouc nyuonh ndaauv, hnyangx-jeiv gox ninh guei seix mi'aqv.
Maaih orn-lorqc nyei mienh se maiv muangx mienh waaic mienh nyei za'eix, maiv yangh zuiz-mienh nyei zaux-mbiec, yaac maiv caux huotv Tin-Hungh nyei mienh juangc jauv yangh.
Daaux nzuonx ninh a'hneiv Ziouv nyei leiz-latc, ziu yiex fei-fangv ninh nyei leiz.
Ninh se hnangv diuh ndiangx zuangx wuov ndoqv-hlen, ziux ziangh hoc cuotv biouv, normh yaac maiv nqaai. Yiem ninh zoux nyei nyungc-nyungc duqv longx.
Mv baac mienh waaic mienh zungv maiv hnangv naaic. Ninh mbuo se hnangv mbieqv zuqc nziaaux buonc nzaanx mingh nor.
Taux siemv zuiz nyei ziangh hoc mienh waaic mienh oix zuqc Tin-Hungh dingc zuiz, zuiz-mienh yaac maiv duqv caux gapv zunv nyei kuv mienh yiem.
Weic zuqc Ziouv ziux goux kuv mienh nyei jauv, mv baac orqv mienh nyei jauv-louc zungv oix zuqc mietc.
Maanc guoqv nyei mienh weic haaix diuc faanv lunc? Maanc fingx mienh weic haaix diuc daav maiv lamh longc nyei za'eix?
Lungh ndiev nyei zuangx hungh diex dongh hnyouv caangh laangh, gunv maanc guoqv nyei mienh lomh nzoih daav za'eix ngaengc Ziouv caux ninh longc youh orn daaih nyei hungh diex.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Mbuo oix zuqc cutv dangx ninh mbuo ndoh nyei limc, yaac jaiv nqoi ninh mbuo ndoh mbuo nyei hlaang.”
Ziouv yiem gu'nguaaic lungh zueiz jienv weic jatv ninh mbuo, yaac huotv ninh mbuo.
Ninh qiex jiez jienv caux ninh mbuo gorngv waac, ninh nouz haic ziouc haeqv ninh mbuo gamh nziex. Ninh gorngv,
“Yie zungv liepc yie ginv daaih nyei hungh, yiem yie nyei cing-nzengc mbong, Si^on.”
Hungh diex gorngv, “Yie oix zunh Ziouv njiec nyei lingc. “Ninh gorngv mbuox yie, ‘Meih zoux yie nyei dorn, ih hnoi yie benx meih nyei die.
Gunv tov yie maah! Yie ziouc zorqv maanc guoqv jiu bun meih nzipc, zorqv nzengc lungh ndiev jiu benx meih nyei buonc.
Meih ziouc longc hlieqv-biaav mborqv ninh mbuo huv, yaac zong ninh mbuo hnangv zong nie-mor huv muonc nzengc nor.’+”
O zuangx hungh diex aah! Hnangv naaic oix zuqc maaih cong-mengh. O gunv lungh ndiev nyei mienh aah! Oix zuqc muangx naaiv deix donv nyei waac.
Oix zuqc gamh nziex jienv fu-sux Ziouv, oix zuqc za'gengh taaih ninh.

Oix zuqc puoqv njiec ninh nyei nza'hmien. Maiv zei aeqv, nziex ninh qiex jiez, meih mbuo ziouc haih zuqc mietc, weic zuqc ninh nyei ga'qiex haih siepv-siepv nyei baetv cuotv. Da'faanh ndaauh kaux ninh wuov deix maaih orn-lorqc.
O Ziouv aac, yie nyei win-wangv ndongc naaiv camv! Oix hoic yie wuov deix jaa camv jienv faaux.
Maaih mienh camv hnangv naaiv gorngv yie, “Tin-Hungh maiv tengx ninh aqv.”
Mv baac Ziouv aac, meih zoux yie nyei torngv-baaih weih gormx yie. Meih zoux yie nyei njang-laangc, tengx yie cau duqv m'nqorngv jiez.
Yie heuc jienv tov Ziouv. Ninh yaac yiem ninh nyei cing-nzengc mbong dau yie.
Yie bueix njiec m'njormh mingh, yie aengx nyie daaih, weic zuqc Ziouv beu jienv yie.
Maiv gunv maaih waanc-waanc dauh win-wangv weih gormx yie, yie yaac maiv gamh nziex.
O Ziouv aah! Daaih maah! O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Njoux yie maah! Weic zuqc meih mbaix yie nyei yietc zungv win-wangv nyei kamx-bui, mborqv orqv mienh nyei nyaah nauv.
Njoux en se yiem Ziouv daaih, tov ceix fuqv bun meih nyei baeqc fingx.

O yie nyei baengh fim nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Yie heuc nyei ziangh hoc tov meih dau yie. Yie buangh zuqc kuonx naanh nyei ziangh hoc, meih bun yie maaih jauv cuotv. Tov korv-lienh yie, muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac.
O meih mbuo naaiv deix mienh aah! Meih mbuo oix mangc piex bun yie zuqc nyaiv taux haaix zanc? Meih mbuo oix longc maiv lamh longc nyei waac yaac lorz gorngv-baeqc nyei jauv taux haaix zanc?
Oix zuqc hiuv duqv Ziouv ginv cuotv gan longx Tin-Hungh nyei mienh weic ninh ganh. Yie heuc Ziouv nyei ziangh hoc, ninh yaac muangx yie.
Qiex jiez nyei ziangh hoc maiv dungx baamz zuiz. Bueix jienv coux sekv nzieqc nyei, yiem hnyouv longx-longx nyei hnamv.
Oix zuqc fongc horc dongh horpc zuqc fongc horc ziec nyei ga'naaiv, yaac sienx kaux Ziouv.
Maaih mienh camv gorngv, “Haaix dauh haih bun yie mbuo buatc haaix nyungc longx?” O Ziouv, tov bun meih nyei hmien nyei njang ziux yie mbuo.
Meih bun yie nyei hnyouv orn-lorqc gauh camv duqv mbiauh caux siang-a'ngunc diuv camv nyei mienh.
Yie oix baengh orn nyei bueix njiec m'njormh weic zuqc Ziouv aac, kungx meih ganh bun yie duqv yiem longx.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih baeng m'normh muangx yie nyei waac. Tov muangx haiz yie njunh nyei qiex.
Yie nyei Hungh, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov muangx yie heuc jienv nyei qiex weic zuqc yie dorng jienv meih daux gaux.
O Ziouv aac, lungh ndorm meih muangx duqv haiz yie nyei qiex, lungh ndorm nziouv yie jouh meih yaac zuov meih dau yie.
Meih se maiv zeiz a'hneiv waaic sic nyei Tin-Hungh. Orqv mienh maiv haih caux meih yiem.
Ceng-hlo nyei mienh maiv duqv souv meih nyei nza'hmien. Da'faanh zoux orqv nyei mienh meih nzorng haic.
Meih mietc nzengc gorngv-baeqc nyei mienh. Daix mienh nyei mienh caux nduov mienh nyei mienh, Ziouv youx haic.
Mv baac yie ganh aeqv, weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv haic mienh, yie ziouc duqv bieqc meih nyei biauv. Yie oix taaih meih, yaac hungx jienv meih nyei cing-nzengc biauv baaix.
O Ziouv aac, laaix yie nyei win-wangv, tov meih yienz yie gan meih zoux horpc nyei jauv. Tov bun yie yangh meih weic yie liuc leiz nyei jauv.

Win-wangv nyei nzuih maiv maaih zien waac. Ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv kungx oix zoux mietc. Ninh mbuo nyei jaang-hoh hnangv wetv tong nyei janx-daic zouv nor, ninh mbuo longc mbietc gorngv waac nduov mienh hnangv.

O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov dingc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz, bun ninh mbuo daav nyei za'eix hoic ninh mbuo ganh. Laaix ninh mbuo baamz nyei zuiz camv, zorqv ninh mbuo zunc cuotv mingh, weic zuqc ninh mbuo ngaengc meih.

Mv baac da'faanh kaux meih wuov deix oix zuqc orn-lorqc, bun ninh mbuo zanc-zanc njien-youh nyei baaux nzung. Tov beu jienv ninh mbuo, weic bun hnamv meih nyei mengh wuov deix kaux meih duqv njien-youh.
O Ziouv aac, meih ceix fuqv bun zoux horpc nyei mienh. Meih korv-lienh, beu jienv ninh mbuo hnangv torngv-baaih nor.
O Ziouv aah! Tov maiv dungx nouz jienv gorngv-hemx yie. Maiv dungx qiex jiez jienv dingc yie nyei zuiz.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih korv-lienh yie, weic zuqc yie za'gengh mau haic. O Ziouv aac, tov zorc yie, weic zuqc yie maiv maaih yietc aax qaqv.
Yie nyei hnyouv za'gengh kouv haic. O Ziouv aac, yie oix zuqc zuov taux haaix zanc meih cingx daaih tengx?
O Ziouv aac, tov meih huin nzuonx daaih njoux yie nyei maengc, weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie, tov njoux yie.
Mienh daic mingh, maiv maaih haaix dauh haih jangx duqv meih. Yiem yiemh gen maaih haaix dauh haih ceng meih?
Yie njunh jienv yiem, haiz kouv haic. Yie muonz-muonz nyiemv, wuom-mueic yiemx coux, yie nyei nzomz-dauh zuqc wuom-mueic dapc ndorn nzengc.
Nzauh gau, yie nyei m'zing zungv maiv njang. Laaix win-wangv yie nyiemv, m'zing mbuov mi'aqv.
Meih mbuo yietc zungv zoux orqv nyei mienh aah! Biaux nqoi yie, weic zuqc Ziouv muangx haiz yie nyiemv nyei qiex.
Ziouv muangx haiz yie jouh nyei waac, yie daux gaux nyei waac Ziouv yaac dau.
Yie nyei yietc zungv win-wangv oix zuqc nyaiv, gamh nziex duqv kouv haic. Ninh mbuo oix zuqc tuix nzuonx, ndongc nziepv dangh m'zing zuqc nyaiv aqv.
O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, meih se yie ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx. Tov njoux yie biaux ndutv zunc yie nyei mienh. Tov njoux yie cuotv daaih.
Nziex ninh mbuo hnangv sienh nor betv yie, tor yie mingh yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh njoux.
O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, se gorngv yie hnangv naaiv zoux, se gorngv yie nyei buoz zoux dorngc haaix nyungc,
se gorngv yie zoux waaic bun caux yie horpc nyei mienh, fai luv yie nyei win-wangv yaac maiv maaih gorn-baengx,
tov bun win-wangv zunc zaaic yie, zorqv yie nyei maengc caaiv njiec ndau, bun yie nyei sin-sei yiem nie-mbung.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih qiex jiez jienv jiez daaih, mborqv yie nyei ciouv haic nyei win-wangv. O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov tengx yie. Se meih ganh dingc ziangx siemv zuiz.
Tov bun maanc fingx gapv zunv weih gormx meih, tov meih yiem gu'nguaaic gunv ninh mbuo.
Ziouv siemv maanc fingx. O Ziouv aac, tov ziux yie zoux horpc nyei caux yie hnyouv zingx nyei siemv yie.
Meih se zoux horpc nyei Tin-Hungh. Meih zaah mienh nyei hnyouv caux eix. Tov bun zoux orqv nyei mienh nyei jauv dangx, yaac liepc kuv mienh wuonv.
Tin-Hungh se yie nyei torngv-baaih beu jienv yie, ninh njoux hnyouv zaqc nyei mienh.
Tin-Hungh se baengh fim nyei siemv zuiz jien, Tin-Hungh yaac hnoi-hnoi dingc orqv mienh nyei zuiz.
Se gorngv haaix dauh maiv goiv hnyouv, Tin-Hungh oix nzioux laic ninh nyei nzuqc ndaauv, yaac liuc leiz ziangx juang-zinx.
Ninh mbenc ziangx daix mienh nyei wuoqc ginc, liuc leiz ninh maaih douz nyei forng-cang.
Orqv mienh kungx hnamv cuotv orqv sic, maaih orqv nyei sic yiem hnyouv beiv mienh maaih gu'nguaaz, yungz cuotv daaih benx gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh nyei sic hnangv.
Ninh wetv ziangx kuotv, wetv ndo nyei, ninh ganh yaac ndortv njiec ninh ganh wetv nyei kuotv.
Ninh zoux nyei waaic sic daaux nzuonx daaih hoic ninh ganh. Ninh zoux doqc nyei sic kungx ndortv zuqc ninh ganh hnangv.
Yie oix dor-ziec Ziouv weic zuqc ninh baengh fim nyei. Yie oix baaux nzung ceng Ziouv, Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh, nyei mengh.
O Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Ziouv aac, meih nyei mengh gengh hlo haic buangv lungh ndiev. Mienh ceng meih nyei njang-laangc, taux gu'nguaaic lungh.
Fu'jueiv caux gu'nguaaz heuc jienv ceng Ziouv. Laaix meih nyei win-wangv meih liepc dorngx wuonv nyei, bun ngaengc meih caux oix jaauv siouh wuov deix dingh njiec.
Yie cau hmien mangc lungh, buatc meih longc buoz zeix daaih nyei ga'naaiv, buatc hlaax caux hleix, se meih ganh bun ninh mbuo maaih ganh nyei dorngx yiem.
Meih funx baamh mienh benx haaix nyungc cingx jangx taux ninh? Funx seix zaangc mienh benx haaix nyungc cingx daaih goux ninh?
Meih bun ninh zoux gauh aiv deix meih ganh, aengx taaih ninh, bun ninh maaih njang-laangc weic zoux hungh ningv.
Meih paaiv ninh gunv meih nyei buoz zeix daaih nyei nyungc-nyungc, yaac orn ninh zoux ziouv gunv maanc muotc,
se gunv yietc zungv ngongh caux yungh, caux yiem lomc nyei hieh zoih,
yiem ndaamv-lungh nyei norqc, yiem koiv nyei mbiauz, caux yiem koiv mingh mingh daaih daaih nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv.
O Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Ziouv aac, meih nyei mbuox gengh hlo! haic buangv lungh ndiev.
Yie oix longc nzengc hnyouv dor-ziec Ziouv, yie oix zunh meih zoux yietc zungv mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Yie oix weic meih a'hneiv njien-youh. O Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh aac, yie oix baaux nzung ceng meih nyei mengh.
Yie nyei win-wangv daaux sin tuix nzuonx nyei ziangh hoc, ninh mbuo yiem meih nyei nza'hmien ndiqv zuqc ndorpc yaac zuqc mietc.
Meih zueiz jienv siemv zuiz nyei weic baengh fim nyei siemv, meih yaac baengh fim siemv bun yie duqv longx.
Meih hemx ganh fingx mienh, bun orqv mienh zuqc mietc. Meih sortv ninh mbuo nyei mbuox guangc taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Win-wangv zuqc baaic zuqc mbaang taux yietc liuz, meih baaic waaic ninh mbuo nyei yietc zungv zingh hnangv liemh nzungh baeng cuotv nor, liemh maiv maaih haaix dauh jangx ninh mbuo.
Mv baac Ziouv yietc liuz zueiz jienv ninh nyei weic gunv, ninh liepc ninh nyei weic daaih siemv zuiz.
Ninh baengh fim nyei siemv lungh ndiev mienh, hnyouv zingx nyei siemv maanc fingx.
Ziouv zoux wuonv nyei dorngx bun zuqc zeix zuqc hoic nyei mienh kaux, zuqc kuonx naanh nyei ziangh hoc maaih lamh kaux dorngx.
O Ziouv aac, nyiemc meih nyei mbuox wuov deix oix kaux meih, weic zuqc meih maiv guangc lorz meih wuov deix mienh.
Oix zuqc baaux nzung ceng yiem Si^on nyei Ziouv, oix zuqc yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx zunh ninh zoux nyei jauv-louc.
Weic zuqc ninh zoux jaauv mienh maengc win wuov dauh, yaac jangx ninh mbuo. Ninh maiv la'kuqv zuqc zeix zuqc hoic, heuc jienv tov nyei mienh.
O Ziouv aah! Tov meih korv-lienh yie. Tov meih mangc nzorng yie wuov deix mienh bun yie zuqc nyei kouv naanc. Se meih njoux yie yiem zuqc daic nyei gaengh cuotv daaih,
weic bun yie yiem Si^on nyei zingh gaengh, zunh yaangh ceng meih nyei sic, yaac orn-lorqc haic weic zuqc meih njoux yie.
Maanc fingx mienh ndortv njiec ninh mbuo ganh wetv nyei kuotv. Ninh mbuo nyei zaux yaac zuqc ninh mbuo ganh zaeng nyei mungz nzenc jienv.
Ziouv bun mienh hiuv duqv ninh ganh, ninh baengh fim nyei siemv zuiz. Orqv mienh nyei buoz zoux nyei sic hlopv jienv ninh mbuo ganh. Hikv^gai^on,
Orqv mienh, se la'kuqv Tin-Hungh nyei fingx-fingx mienh, zungv zuqc mingh yiem yiemh gen.
Ninh maiv zeiz yietc liuz la'kuqv dangx-donx nyei mienh. Mienh jomc mienh maiv zeiz yietc liuz maiv lamh hnamv dorngx.
O Ziouv aah! Daaih maah! Maiv dungx bun baamh mienh duqv hingh. Tov bun maanc fingx yiem meih nyei nza'hmien zuqc siemv.
O Ziouv aah! Tov bun ninh mbuo gamh nziex. Tov bun maanc fingx zieqv duqv ninh mbuo benx baamh mienh hnangv.
Ziouv aah! Meih weic haaix diuc leih yie mbuo ndongc naaiv go? Yie mbuo zuqc kouv naanc meih weic haaix diuc bingx?
Orqv mienh zoux maux zeix mienh jomc mienh. Tov bun ninh mbuo daav cuotv nyei za'eix hoic zuqc ninh mbuo ganh.
Orqv mienh ceng ganh hnyouv hanc zoux nyei sic, mauv ga'naaiv nyei mienh zioux yaac mangc piex Ziouv.
Mienh waaic mienh hnyouv maux ziouc maiv lorz ninh. Orqv mienh kungx hnamv maiv maaih Tin-Hungh.
Orqv mienh zoux nyei jauv zanc-zanc duqv longx, meih siemv zuiz nyei jauv hlang haic, orqv mienh maiv bieqc hnyouv. Ninh huotv ninh nyei yietc zungv win-wangv.
Ninh yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Yie yietc liuz maiv zuqc kouv, doic jiex doic yie maiv buangh zeqc naanc.”
Zioux mienh, nduov mienh, hoic mienh nyei waac buangv nzengc ninh nyei nzuih. Yiem ninh nyei mbietc ga'ndiev maaih doqc nyei, orqv nyei waac.
Ninh yiem laangz gu'nyuoz mbueiz nyei dorngx, yiem bingx nyei dorngx daix maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh. Ninh nyei m'zing cienh mangc maiv maaih dorngx kaux nyei mienh.
Ninh bingx jienv yiem mbueiz nyei dorngx, hnangv sienh yiem ninh nyei kuotv. Ninh bingx jienv oix caangv doh naanc mienh, ninh baeng ninh nyei mungz guaatv mienh jomc mienh mingh.
Maiv maaih dorngx kaux nyei mienh zuqc zatv njiec, ninh mbuo zuqc orqv mienh nyei qaqv hoic ninh mbuo ndortv jienv njiec.
Orqv mienh yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Tin-Hungh la'kuqv mi'aqv. Ninh bingx jienv ninh nyei hmien, yietc liuz maiv mangc aqv.”
O Ziouv aah! Daaih maah! Tov meih sung buoz tengx, maiv dungx la'kuqv kouv naanc nyei mienh.
Orqv mienh weic haaix diuc nqemh Tin-Hungh? Orqv mienh yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Ninh maiv longc yie nyei sic.”

Mv baac meih buatc nyei, meih zungv hiuv duqv mienh zuqc kouv naanc, hnyouv nzauh nyei sic, ziouc njiec buoz tengx. Maiv lamh kaux dorngx nyei mienh zorqv ganh jiu bun meih, weic zuqc meih m'daaih tengx guh hanh fu'jueiv.
Tov meih wuotv mienh waaic mienh caux orqv mienh nyei buoz nauv. Tov wetv cuotv ninh nyei waaic sic taux maiv maaih yietc deix.
Ziouv yietc liuz zoux hungh taux maanc gouv maanc doic. Maanc fingx mienh yiem ninh nyei ndau-beih zuqc mietc nzengc.
O Ziouv aac, meih muangx haiz nyiemc ganh zoux faix nyei mienh oix jouh nyei waac. Meih oix liepc wuonv ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv yaac baeng m'normh muangx ninh mbuo tov nyei waac,
weic bun guh hanh fu'jueiv caux zuqc zeix wuov deix duqv baengh fim, weic bun baamh mienh maiv haih zoix aengx haeqv ninh mbuo gamh nziex.
Yie ndaauh kaux Ziouv, wuov nyungc, meih mbuo hnangv haaix nor haih gorngv mbuox yie, “Meih oix zuqc hnangv norm norqc biaux mingh taux meih nyei mbong.”
Mangc maah! Orqv mienh baeng juang-zinx, zorqv forng paanx jienv hlaang, oix yiem hmuangx nyei dorngx, buonv hnyouv zingx nyei mienh.
Se gorngv gorn-ndoqv zuqc baaic waaic, kuv mienh haih zoux haaix nyungc?”
Ziouv yiem ninh nyei cing-nzengc biauv gu'nyuoz, Ziouv nyei weic yiem gu'nguaaic lungh. Ninh nyei m'zing zaah mangc baamh mienh, ziouc hiuv duqv ninh mbuo zoux nyei sic.
Ziouv kauv kuv mienh caux orqv mienh, ninh nzorng haic a'hneiv zoux doqc nyei mienh.
Ninh oix zorqv zieqc jienv nyei douz-taanx caux hungh bungx njiec mienh waaic mienh gu'nguaaic, yaac bun nziaaux-jorm benx ninh mbuo nyei buonc.
Weic zuqc Ziouv zoux duqv horpc, ninh yaac a'hneiv mienh zoux horpc nyei sic. Hnyouv zingx nyei mienh ziouc duqv buatc ninh nyei hmien.
O Ziouv aah! Tov meih tengx yie mbuo, weic zuqc maiv maaih kuv mienh aqv. Yiem baamh mienh mbu'ndongx ziepc zuoqv nyei mienh zutc nzengc mi'aqv.
Dauh dauh gorngv-baeqc nduov ganh nyei juangc laangz mienh. Ninh mbuo nyei nzuih gorngv waac mbiaangc ceng mienh, yaac maaih i diuc hnyouv.
Tov Ziouv gaatv guangc ceng weic nduov mienh a'hneiv nyei yietc zungv nzuih meix caux bungx waac-maux, ceng-hlo wuov deix mienh nyei mbietc.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo haih bangc yie mbuo nyei mbietc hingh jiex. Yie mbuo nyei nzuih meix benx yie mbuo ganh nyei. Haaix dauh zoux yie mbuo nyei ziouv?”

Ziouv gorngv, “Yie ih zanc oix jiez daaih weic zuqc jomc nyei mienh zuqc zeix, doh naanc mienh njunh jienv yiem. Yie oix bun ninh mbuo baengh orn nyei yiem dongh ninh mbuo maaih lamh hnamv oix duqv yiem nyei dorngx.”
Ziouv nyei waac se cing-nzengc nyei waac, hnangv longc louh douz sinx jiex siec nzunc zien haic nyei nyaanh nor.
O Ziouv aac, meih zungv beu jienv yie mbuo, meih oix goux jienv yie mbuo, bun yie mbuo biaux ndutv naaiv doic mienh.
Baamh mienh ceng orqv nyei, waaic nyei jauv wuov zanc, orqv mienh youh jienv mingh faam-bung feix louc.
O Ziouv aac, meih oix la'kuqv yie taux haaix zanc? Oix yietc liuz la'kuqv fai? Meih oix buang jienv hmien maiv mangc yie taux haaix zanc?
Yie oix zuqc yiem hnyouv diev mun ndongc haaix lauh? Yie nyei hnyouv oix zuqc nzauh taux haaix zanc? Yie nyei win-wangv oix hingh jiex yie taux haaix zanc?
O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov mangc yie yaac dau yie. Tov bun yie maaih qaqv hnangv loz wuov nor. Maiv zei aeqv, nziex yie zuqc daic.
Nziex yie nyei win-wangv gorngv, “Yie hingh jiex ninh mi'aqv.” Nziex yie nyei win-jaa njien-youh a'hneiv weic zuqc yie zuqc ndortv.
Mv baac yie kaux meih weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie. Yie nyei hnyouv weic meih nyei njoux en orn-lorqc haic.
Yie oix baaux nzung ceng Ziouv, weic zuqc ninh za'gengh zoux longx bun yie.
Mienh hngongx mienh yiem hnyouv gorngv, “Maiv maaih Tin-Hungh lorqc.” Ninh mbuo yietc zungv waaic nzengc, ninh mbuo zoux orqv haic, waaic haic nyei sic. Maiv maaih yietc dauh zoux longx.
Ziouv yiem tin-dorngh mangc njiec, mangc baamh mienh, oix mangc gaax, maaih haaix dauh maaih cong-mengh, maaih haaix dauh lorz Tin-Hungh.
Ninh mbuo yietc zungv yangh pien jauv, dauh dauh fih hnangv nyei waaic nzengc. Maiv maaih haaix dauh zoux longx, yietc dauh yaac maiv maaih.
Yietc zungv zoux orqv nyei mienh maiv hiuv haaix nyungc fai? Ninh mbuo naqv yie nyei baeqc fingx hnangv ninh mbuo nyanc hnaangx. Ninh mbuo yaac maiv tov Ziouv.
Mv baac ninh mbuo yiem wuov gengh! gamh nziex haic, weic zuqc Tin-Hungh caux kuv mienh yiem.
Meih mbuo zoux orqv nyei mienh oix bun mienh jomc mienh nyei za'eix ndortv, mv baac Ziouv zoux ninh mbuo ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx.

Tov bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei njoux en yiem Si^on cuotv daaih. Ziouv bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx nzuonx daaih duqv longx hnangv zinh ndaangc wuov zanc, Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun ziouc maaih orn-lorqc, I^saa^laa^en Mienh oix njien-youh.
O Ziouv aac, haaix dauh haih yiem zaangc meih nyei ndopv-liuh? Haaix dauh haih yiem meih nyei cing-nzengc mbong?
Dongh yiem seix zaangc zoux nyei sic maiv maaih dorngx daanh wuov dauh. Ninh haaix zanc yaac kungx zoux horpc hnangv. Ninh hnyouv zingx gorngv zien waac nyei mienh.
Ninh maiv longc ninh nyei mbietc gorngv doqc mienh, maiv zoux dorngc ninh nyei gorx-youz, yaac maiv zunh mienh nyei mengh dauh waaic.

Ninh mangc piex waaic haic, orqv haic nyei mienh, mv baac taaih dongh taaih Ziouv wuov deix. Ninh haaix zanc ei ninh laengz nyei ngaengc waac zoux, maiv gunv kuei zuqc ninh ganh, ninh yaac maiv hnamv-nzuonx.
Ninh bungx zaeqv, maiv longc leic zinh, yaac maiv nyanc nyaanh hmuangx maaic maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh nyei m'nqorngv. Zoux naaiv deix sic nyei mienh yietc liuz nqamv maiv dongz.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov meih beu jienv yie, weic zuqc yie ndaauh kaux meih.
Yie gorngv mbuox Ziouv, “Meih zoux yie nyei Ziouv, cuotv liuz meih yie maiv maaih haaix nyungc longx.”
Yiem baamh gen nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx, se gauh longx jiex, dongh yie gauh a'hneiv jiex nyei mienh.
Ginv gan nyiec nyei zienh wuov deix jaa nzauh camv. Ninh mbuo dox ziec zienh nyei nziaamv, yie maiv dox. Yie nyei nzuih meix yaac maiv gorngv cuotv naaiv deix zienh nyei mbuox.
Ziouv se yie nzipc nyei buonc, dongh meih paaiv ziangx bun yie nyei buonc. Yie oix duqv nyei buonc meih tengx yie goux.
Longc hlaang ndorqc bun yie nyei gapv-jaaix ndortv zuqc kuh yiem nyei dorngx. Yie duqv nzipc longx haic nyei buonc.
Yie oix ceng Ziouv weic zuqc ninh dorh yie. Lungh muonz zanc yie nyei hnyouv yaac njaaux yie.
Yie zanc-zanc bun Ziouv yiem yie nyei nza'hmien. Weic zuqc ninh yiem yie nyei mbiaauc maengx maiv maaih haaix nyungc ging-dongz yie.
Weic naaiv yie nyei hnyouv njien-youh a'hneiv haic. Yie nyei sin yaac yiem duqv wuonv nyei,
weic zuqc meih maiv guangc yie yiem yiemh gen, yaac maiv bun meih nyei Cing-Nzengc Mienh zuqc huv.
Meih oix bun yie hiuv duqv ziangh maengc nyei jauv. Yiem meih nyei nza'hmien meih bun yie maaih njien-youh taux daauh. Yiem meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz maaih yietc liuz nyei orn-lorqc.

O Ziouv aah! Tov meih muangx haiz yie tov baengh fim nyei jauv. Tov muangx yie heuc jienv gorngv. Baeng m'normh muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac, se maiv zeiz yiem gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac.
Tov meih bun cing yie se maiv dorngc, tov bun meih nyei m'zing mangc buatc haaix nyungc se horpc.
Meih zungv kauv yie nyei hnyouv, lungh muonz zanc yaac zaah yie, meih seix liuz yie, meih maiv buatc yie dorngc haaix nyungc. Yie nyei nzuih yaac maiv gorngv orqv nyei sic.
Gorngv taux mienh zoux nyei sic, yie bangc meih nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac. Yie simv jienv, maiv gan zoux doqc nyei mienh nyei jauv.
Yie nyei zaux-mbiec kungx gan meih nyei jauv mingh, yie nyei zaux yaac maiv caaiv piatv.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Yie jouh meih weic zuqc meih zungv oix dau yie. Tov baeng m'normh muangx yie nyei waac.
Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, tov bun meih hnamv nyei jauv hinc cuotv daaih. Meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz njoux ndaauh kaux meih wuov deix biaux ndutv ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv.
Tov beu yie hnangv beu meih nyei m'zing-mienh nor, tov bun yie bingx yiem meih nyei ndaatv-ndiev,
bun yie biaux ndutv zeix yie wuov deix orqv mienh nyei buoz-ndiev caux weih gormx oix hoic yie nyei maengc wuov deix win-wangv.
Ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv maiv korv-lienh mienh, ninh mbuo nyei nzuih gorngv waac-maux.
Ninh mbuo zimh jienv yie mingh, ih zanc weih gormx yie. Ninh mbuo bungx m'zing cienh mangc, fongv yie king njiec ndau.
Ninh mbuo hnangv sienh nor, oix betv yie, yaac hnangv sienh lunx bingx jienv mbueiz nyei dorngx oix hoic yie.
Ziouv aah! Tov daaih caux ninh mbuo mborqv jaax, bun ninh mbuo zuqc suei. Tov longc meih nyei nzuqc ndaauv njoux yie nyei maengc biaux ndutv orqv mienh.

O Ziouv aah! Tov longc meih nyei buoz njoux yie leih ndutv dongh yiem naaiv seix zaangc duqv liuz ninh mbuo nyei buonc nyei mienh. Tov bun dongh meih weic ninh mbuo siou daaih nyei buangv ninh mbuo nyei ga'sie. Tov bun ninh mbuo nyei dorn-jueiv duqv gaux nzengc. Zengc njiec wuov deix liouh njiec bun ninh mbuo nyei fu'jueiv.
Mv baac yie ganh zoux duqv horpc ziouc duqv buatc meih nyei hmien. Yie nyie daaih nyei ziangh hoc, yie duqv buatc meih ziouc buangv hnyouv aqv.
O Ziouv aac, meih zoux yie nyei qaqv. Yie hnamv meih.

Ziouv zoux yie nyei la'bieiv, yie kaux wuonv nyei dorngx caux njoux yie wuov dauh. Yie nyei Tin-Hungh, se yie nyei la'bieiv, dongh yie ndaauh kaux wuov dauh. Ninh zoux yie nyei torngv-baaih, zoux qaqv njoux yie, zoux wuonv nyei dorngx beu yie.
Yie heuc Ziouv, dongh puix duqv mienh ceng wuov dauh. Ninh yaac njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei win-wangv.
Maaih haih daic nyei qaqv hnangv hlaang nzenc jienv yie, zuqc mietc nyei jauv hnangv wuom-laangc beqv yiemx jienv yie.
Yiemh gen nyei hlaang nzenc jienv yie, haih daic nyei qaqv hnangv mungz nor zaaux jienv yie.

Zuqc kouv nyei ziangh hoc yie heuc jienv tov Ziouv. Yie heuc jienv tov yie nyei Tin-Hungh tengx. Ninh yiem ninh nyei singx dinc gu'nyuoz muangx haiz yie nyei qiex. Yie heuc jienv ninh nyei qiex bieqc taux ninh nyei m'normh.
Wuov zanc ndau-beih zuqc mbungh mbungh mbienv-mbienv nyei, mbong nyei gorn-ndoqv yaac zuqc ndanc dongz nyanh nyanh nyei, weic zuqc ninh qiex jiez.
Douz-sioux yangh ninh nyei mba'zorng cuotv. Ninh nyei nzuih cuotv haih buov qui nyei douz, douz-taanx yaac zuqc wuov deix douz zieqc jienv.
Ninh bun lungh nqoi ziouc njiec daaih, maaih mbuonx-jieqv yiem ninh nyei zaux-ndiev.
Ninh geh ke^lu^mbim ndaix mingh, ninh bangc nziaaux nyei qaqv siepv-siepv nyei daaih.
Ninh bun hmuangx om ninh nyei sin, maaih wuom nyei mbuonx-jieqv torngv jienv ninh.
Yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien nyei njang, maaih borqc caux zieqc jienv douz nyei taanx cunx tong ninh nyei mouc.
Ziouv yiem gu'nguaaic lungh gorngv cuotv hnangv mba'ong mbui. Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh heuc cuotv ziouc maaih borqc caux zieqc jienv douz nyei douz-taanx.
Ninh buonv cuotv ninh nyei forng-cang zoux bun win-wangv nzaanx. Ninh borngz mba'lingc njapc njapc nyei, haeqv win-wangv lunc nzengc.
O Ziouv aac, meih hatc hniev nyei, meih biomv meih nyei qiex yangh meih nyei mba'zorng cuotv. Koiv-ndoqv ziouc hinc cuotv daaih, ndau nyei gorn-ndoqv yaac cuotv daaih nqaengc nyei.
Ninh yiem gu'nguaaic hlang nyei dorngx sung buoz zorqv yie, yiem wuom-ndo nyei dorngx baeng cuotv daaih.
Ninh njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei henv haic nyei win-wangv caux nzorng yie wuov deix mienh, weic zuqc ninh mbuo gauh henv jiex yie.
Yie zuqc zeqc naanc nyei hnoi-nyieqc ninh mbuo daaih hoic yie, mv baac Ziouv zoux yie kaux nyei dorngx.
Ninh dorh yie cuotv daaih taux norm jangv nyei dorngx. Ninh njoux yie weic zuqc ninh a'hneiv yie.
Ziux yie zoux duqv horpc, Ziouv bun zingh nyeic yie. Ziux yie maiv zoux dorngc, ninh winh bun yie.
Weic zuqc yie gan nzengc Ziouv nyei doz yie maiv zoux waaic ngaengc yie nyei Tin-Hungh.
Ninh nyei yietc zungv leiz yiem yie nyei nza'hmien, yie yaac maiv guangc ninh nyei leiz-nyeic.
Yie yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien maiv maaih dorngc nyei dorngx. Yie yaac goux longx ganh, maiv zoux dorngc zuiz.
Weic naaiv, ziux yie zoux duqv horpc, yaac ziux ninh mangc, buatc yie cing-nzengc, Ziouv winh bun yie.
Weic ziepc zuoqv nyei mienh meih ziepc zuoqv nyei daaix ninh mbuo. Weic maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei mienh, meih bun cing meih ganh maiv maaih dorngx nqemh.
Weic cing-nzengc wuov deix, meih bun cing meih ganh cing-nzengc. Weic hnyouv njuotv nyei mienh, meih yaac bun cing meih ngaengc ninh mbuo.
Meih njoux nyiemc ganh zoux faix nyei baeqc fingx, mv baac m'zing-jaax hlang wuov deix, meih zatv ninh mbuo njiec.
Meih diemv zieqc yie nyei dang. Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh, ziux yie hmuangx nyei dorngx njang daaih.
Yie bangc meih ziouc haih mborqv duqv jun-baeng. Yie kaux yie nyei Tin-Hungh haih biu jiex zingh laatc.
Naaiv dauh Tin-Hungh, ninh nyei doz dunh yunh nyei. Ziouv laengz nyei waac, buatc za'gengh zien nyei. Ninh zoux torngv-baaih weic yietc zungv ndaauh kaux ninh nyei mienh.
Cuotv liuz Ziouv, haaix dauh zoux Tin-Hungh? Cuotv liuz mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, haaix dauh benx wuov norm La'bieiv?
Naaiv dauh Tin-Hungh bun yie maaih qaqv yaac bun yie nyei jauv baengh orn.
Ninh bun yie nyei zaux hnangv njaih nyeiz nyei deih nor caaiv duqv jienv, yaac bun yie haih yiem hlang nyei dorngx souv duqv wuonv.
Ninh njaaux yie hoqc linc mborqv jaax, yie nyei buoz cingx daaih haih baeng dongh siqv juang-zinx.
Meih bun meih nyei njoux en weic zoux yie nyei torngv-baaih. Meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz baav jienv yie. Meih tengx yie, bun yie duqv zoux hlo.
Meih bun yie nyei zaux caaiv nyei dorngx jangv, yie nyei zaux ziouc maiv piatv.
Yie zunc yie nyei win-wangv yaac zunc zaaic ninh mbuo. Yie maiv daaux sin nzuonx taux ninh mbuo zuqc baaic nzengc.
Yie mborqv ninh mbuo, ninh mbuo ziouc maiv haih jiez sin. Ninh mbuo king njiec yie nyei zaux-hlen.
Weic zuqc meih bun yie maaih qaqv mborqv jaax, meih bun daaih mborqv yie wuov deix zuqc yiem yie nyei buoz-ndiev.
Meih yaac bun yie nyei win-wangv huin nqaang biaux. Yie duqv mietc nzengc nzorng yie wuov deix.
Ninh mbuo heuc jienv tov tengx, mv baac maiv maaih mienh njoux ninh mbuo. Ninh mbuo heuc Ziouv, mv baac ninh maiv dau ninh mbuo.
Yie mborqv ninh mbuo muonc hnangv nziaaux buonc nyei nie-mbung. Yie zorqv ninh mbuo zoi guangc hnangv jauv zaangc nyei wuom-bamc ndorngh nor.
Meih njoux yie biaux ndutv, maiv zuqc baeqc fingx fiuv-nzaeng nyei sic. Meih bun yie zoux maanc guoqv nyei bieiv zeiv. Dongh yie maiv hiuv jiex nyei baeqc fingx fu-sux yie.
Ninh mbuo yietv muangx haiz yie nyei mengh dauh ninh mbuo muangx yie. Ganh fingx mienh daaih mbaapv njiec yie nyei nza'hmien.
Ganh fingx mienh hnyouv mau nzengc, sin zinx nyanh nyanh nyei yiem ninh mbuo wuonv nyei dorngx cuotv daaih.
Ziouv ziangh jienv. Oix zuqc ceng yie nyei La'bieiv. Oix zuqc taaih yie nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh njoux yie wuov dauh.
Se naaiv dauh Tin-Hungh tengx yie jaauv win, yaac bun maanc fingx zuqc yiem yie nyei buoz-ndiev.
Ninh njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei win-wangv, yaac bouh yie faaux gauh hlang jiex yie nyei win-jaa, meih njoux yie biaux ndutv doqc nyei mienh.
O Ziouv aac, weic naaiv yie ziouc yiem maanc fingx mienh mbu'ndongx ceng meih, yaac baaux nzung ceng meih nyei mengh.
Ninh ceix hlo haic nyei njoux en bun ninh nyei hungh diex, yaac bun cing ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv ninh longc youh orn daaih wuov dauh, se Ndaawitv caux ninh nyei hoz doic taux yietc liuz.
Lungh zunh yaangh Tin-Hungh nyei njang-laangc, lungh zaangc biux mengh ninh nyei buoz-dauh.
Yietc hnoi zunh mbuox jiex yietc hnoi, yietc muonz zunh wuonh zaang jiex yietc muonz.
Mouc nyinh mouc waac, mouc sing-qiex maiv haiz,
mv baac ninh nyei fienx mingh gormx baamh gen, ninh nyei nyinh nyouz mingh jomc lungh ndiev. Tin-Hungh yiem wuov lungh weic mba'hnoi corng ndopv-liuh.
Mba'hnoi cuotv daaih hnangv siang-laangh yiem ninh nyei gen cuotv. Yaac hnangv saaix tiux nyei mienh henv mienh njien-youh nyei gan saaix nyei jauv mingh.
Mba'hnoi yiem naaiv bung lungh cuotv daaih, aengx youh taux wuov bung lungh. Maiv maaih haaix nyungc haih bingx duqv ninh jorm nyei qiex.
Ziouv nyei leiz-latc se dunh yunh nyei, bun mienh nyei hnyouv fingv jiez daaih. Ziouv nyei leiz-nyeic se kaux duqv wuonv nyei, bun maiv maaih cong-mengh nyei mienh maaih cong-mengh.
Ziouv hatc nyei waac horpc nyei, bun gan nyei mienh maaih njien-youh. Ziouv nyei lingc cing-nzengc nyei, bun mienh haih mengh baeqc.
Mienh taaih Ziouv se longx haic, oix zuqc taaih taux maanc gouv maanc doic. Ziouv nyei leiz se zien nyei, diuh diuh baengh fim nyei.
Se gauh jaaix jiex jiem, zungv gauh jaaix zien jiem. Yaac gauh gaam jiex mueiz-dorngh, dongh yiem mueiz-pengx liouc cuotv nyei mueiz-dorngh.
Naaiv deix leiz-latc kuinx meih nyei bou. Mienh ei jienv naaiv deix waac zoux ziouc maaih domh zingh nyeic.
Haaix dauh haih zieqv duqv ganh zoux dorngc nyei jauv? Tov guangc nqoi yie zoux dorngc, zieqv maiv duqv nyei sic.
Tov dangv jienv bun meih nyei bou maiv dungx duqv-eix baamz zuiz. Maiv dungx bun naaiv deix zuiz gunv yie. Hnangv naaic yie ziouc maiv maaih dorngx nqemh, yaac biaux duqv ndutv domh zuiz.
O Ziouv aac, meih zoux yie nyei La'bieiv, yaac zoux Zuoqc Yie Wuov Dauh. Tov bun yie nyei nzuih gorngv cuotv nyei waac, caux yie yiem hnyouv hnamv nyei jauv, ziux meih mangc haih zoux duqv horpc.
Meih buangh zuqc kouv naanc nyei hnoi-nyieqc tov Ziouv dau, tov Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh beu jienv meih.
Tov ninh yiem singx dinc tengx meih, yaac yiem Si^on Mbong beu jienv meih.
Tov ninh jangx meih fongc horc nyei nyungc-nyungc ga'naaiv, yaac a'hneiv meih buov ziec nyei yietc zungv.
Tov ninh bun meih duqv ziux meih nyei hnyouv oix nyei, yaac ei jienv meih nyei yietc zungv za'eix zoux ziangx.
Yie mbuo ziouc njien-youh nyei heuc weic meih hingh jiex, yie mbuo yaac dengv yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei mbuox liepc yie mbuo nyei geh. Tov Ziouv dau meih tov nyei yietc zungv waac.
Ih zanc yie hiuv duqv Ziouv oix tengx ninh longc youh orn daaih wuov dauh. Ninh oix yiem ninh cing-nzengc nyei tin-dorngh dau. Ninh longc ninh nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz nyei domh qaqv tengx hingh jiex.
Maaih deix kaux ninh mbuo nyei mborqv jaax cie, maaih deix kaux ninh mbuo nyei maaz, mv baac yie mbuo kaux Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.
Ninh mbuo ziouc ndorpc, king njiec, mv baac yie mbuo duqv jiez sin souv wuonv.
O Ziouv aac, tov tengx hungh diex hingh jiex. Yie mbuo heuc nyei ziangh hoc, tov dau yie mbuo.
Ziouv aac, hungh diex a'hneiv haic weic meih ceix bun nyei qaqv. Ninh orn-lorqc haic weic zuqc meih tengx ninh hingh jiex.
Ziux ninh nyei hnyouv oix nyei meih ceix bun ninh. Ziux ninh nyei nzuih tov nyei waac meih yaac dau.
Meih ceix longx haic nyei fuqv bun ninh, meih zorqv zien jiem nyei ningv ndongx jienv ninh nyei m'nqorngv.
Ninh tov meih bun ninh maaih siouc nyuonh, meih yaac ceix bun ninh, bun ninh nyei siouc nyuonh ndaauv yietc liuz taux yietc liuz.
Weic meih tengx ninh, ninh duqv domh njang-laangc. Meih yaac ceix bun ninh duqv mengh hoc yaac maaih haangh daauh.
Meih bun ninh maaih fuqv taux yietc liuz, weic zuqc meih caux ninh yiem ninh duqv njien-youh orn-lorqc.
Hungh diex sienx kaux Ziouv, weic Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv ninh, ninh liemh maiv zuqc ndanc dongz.
Meih nyei buoz oix lorz buatc meih nyei yietc zungv win-wangv. Meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz haih lorz buatc nzorng meih nyei mienh.
Meih hinc cuotv nyei ziangh hoc meih ziouc bun ninh mbuo hnangv jorm haic nyei douz-louh. Ziouv nouz ninh mbuo ziouc oix naqv ninh mbuo. Douz yaac oix buov ninh mbuo qui nzengc.
Meih ziouc bun ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun yiem lungh ndiev zutc nzengc, yiem baamh mienh mbu'ndongx mietc nzengc ninh mbuo nyei hoz doic.
Maiv gunv ninh mbuo daav za'eix hoic meih, maiv gunv ninh mbuo hnamv cuotv zoux waaic sic, ninh mbuo maiv haih zoux maiv ziangx.
Weic zuqc meih baeng meih nyei juang-zinx hungx jienv ninh mbuo nyei hmien, meih ziouc bun ninh mbuo daaux nqaang biaux.
O Ziouv aac, yie mbuo ceng meih weic zuqc meih henv haic. Yie mbuo oix baaux nzung ceng meih nyei qaqv.
Yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Yie nyei Tin-Hungh! Meih weic haaix diuc guangc yie? Meih weic haaix diuc leih go, maiv njoux yie, maiv haiz yie njunh nyei waac?
O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Lungh hnoi zanc yie heuc, meih yaac maiv dau yie. Lungh muonz zanc yie maiv dingh liouh nyei heuc yaac maiv duqv hitv kuonx.
Mv baac meih zueiz weic benx Cing-Nzengc Wuov Dauh. Meih se I^saa^laa^en Mienh ceng wuov dauh.
Yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix kaux meih, ninh mbuo bangc meih, meih yaac njoux ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo heuc meih, ziouc duqv njoux aqv. Ninh mbuo kaux meih, ninh mbuo yaac maiv piatv.
Mv baac yie se hnangv norm gaeng-mau, maiv zeiz mienh. Yie zuqc mienh huotv, zuqc mienh mangc piex.
Da'faanh buatc yie nyei mienh jatv yie, ninh mbuo zuo nzuih baengx bun yie, yaac huangx m'nqorngv gorngv,
“Ninh kaux Ziouv, bun Ziouv njoux ninh maah! Bun Ziouv tengx ninh, weic zuqc Ziouv a'hneiv haic ninh.”
Se dongh meih bun yie yiem maa nyei ga'sie cuotv seix, yie hopv maa nyei nyorx nyei ziangh hoc, meih yaac goux jienv yie.
Yiem yie cuotv seix daaih yie kaux meih. Yiem yie nyei maa yungz yie daaih, meih zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh.
Tov meih maiv dungx leih go yie, weic zuqc zeqc naanc taux fatv aqv, yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh tengx.
Win-wangv camv hnangv ngongh gouv nor weih gormx yie, yaac hnangv Mbaasaan henv haic nyei ngongh gouv ninh mbuo weih jienv biei bung.
Ninh mbuo se hnangv njunh jienv nyei sienh morngx nzuih baengx oix betv yie.
Yie zuqc dox cuotv hnangv wuom nor. Yie nyei yietc zungv mbungv-daaux piatv nzengc. Yie nyei mba'nziu se hnangv mueiz-nzing, yiem yie nyei la'kuotv yuqc nzengc.
Yie nyei qaqv nqaai nzengc hnangv hlengx nie-mor-huv nor, yie nyei mbietc naetv jienv nzuih dungz. Meih zorqv yie guangc jienv hnangv ga'naaiv-daic.
Maaih guanh orqv mienh huing jienv yie, hnangv guanh juv weih gormx yie nor. Ninh mbuo yaac nzopv yie nyei buoz-zaux.
Yie nyei mbungv yie zungv haih saauv nzengc, ninh mbuo bungx m'zing nuqv-nuqv nyei mangc yaac jatv yie.
Ninh mbuo bun nqoi yie nyei lui-houx, yaac weic yie nyei lui ndouv mangc gaax haaix dauh duqv.
O Ziouv aah! Tov meih maiv dungx leih go yie. Tengx yie wuov dauh Ziouv aah! Siepv-siepv nyei daaih tengx yie.
Tov njoux yie nyei maengc biaux ndutv nzuqc ndaauv. Tov njoux yie nyei maengc leih ndutv naaiv deix juv.
Tov njoux yie biaux ndutv sienh nyei nzuih baengx, njoux yie leih ndutv hieh ngongh nyei jorng.
Yie oix zunh meih nyei mengh mbuox yie nyei gorx-youz. Yie oix yiem gapv zunv nyei wuic mbu'ndongx ceng meih.
Gamh nziex Ziouv nyei mienh aah! Oix zuqc ceng ninh. Yaakopv nyei zuangx zeiv-fun aah! Oix zuqc taaih ninh. I^saa^laa^en nyei yietc zungv hoz doic zeiv-fun aah! Oix zuqc gamh nziex ninh.

Weic zuqc ninh maiv mangc piex yaac maiv youx siouc kouv nyei mienh zuqc siouc nyei kouv naanc. Ninh maiv buang jienv hmien maiv mangc ninh mbuo, mienh heuc jienv tov nyei ziangh hoc, ninh yaac muangx.
Yiem mienh camv gapv zunv nyei dorngx yie ceng nyei waac yiem meih daaih. Yiem taaih meih nyei mienh nyei nza'hmien yie oix jaauv sung yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Mienh jomc mienh duqv nyanc beuv. Haaix dauh lorz Ziouv zungv oix ceng ninh. Tov bun meih mbuo yietc liuz ziangh jienv.
Jomc lungh ndiev norm-norm dorngx nyei mienh oix jangx Ziouv ziouc huin nzuonx daaih lorz ninh. Maanc guoqv nyei maanc fingx oix yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien baaix ninh.
Ziouv maaih hungh lingc, yaac gunv maanc guoqv.

Yiem lungh ndiev zoux maux nyei mienh oix yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien gueic njiec baaix. Da'faanh nzuonx benx nie-mbung nyei mienh, se maiv haih tengx ganh maaih maengc ziangh nyei mienh, oix gueic njiec baaix ninh.
Doic-doic zeiv-fun oix fu-sux ninh. Mienh oix zorqv Ziouv nyei sic gorngv mbuox hoz doic mienh.
Ninh mbuo oix zunh ninh zoux baengh fim nyei jauv mbuox maiv gaengh cuotv seix nyei mienh, “Ninh njoux ninh nyei mienh aqv.”
Ziouv goux yie hnangv goux ba'gi yungh nyei mienh goux ninh nyei ba'gi yungh nor, yie ziouc maiv caa haaix nyungc.
Ninh bun yie bueix njiec miev nyiemz nyei dorngx, dorh yie yiem wuom sienc nyei ndoqv-hlen.
Ninh bun yie nyei hnyouv fingv jiez daaih. Weic ninh ganh nyei mbuox ninh yienz yie yangh zoux horpc nyei jauv.

Maiv gunv yie yangh zuqc daic nyei dongh linh, hmuangx nyei horngz mingh, yie maiv gamh nziex zuqc haaix nyungc hoic, weic zuqc meih caux yie yiem. Meih longc biaav-mbiaac caux ndaangh ngau goux jienv yie.
Meih yiem yie nyei win-wangv nyei nza'hmien meih mbenc nyanc hopv bun yie. Meih longc youh hietv yie nyei m'nqorngv, yie nyei zaanv buangv mienz nzengc.
Yie hiuv dingc Ziouv yietc seix korv-lienh yaac zoux longx bun yie. Yie yaac duqv yiem Ziouv nyei biauv taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Ndau-beih caux yiem ndau-beih nyei maanc muotc benx Ziouv nyei. Lungh ndiev caux lungh ndiev nyei maanc mienh yaac ninh nyei.
Ninh ceix baamh gen jiez daaih yiem koiv gu'nguaaic, se liepc jienv yiem wuom gu'nguaaic.
Haaix dauh maaih leiz faaux Ziouv nyei mbong? Haaix dauh haih souv jienv yiem ninh nyei cing-nzengc dorngx?
Se dongh zoux nyei sic caux hnamv nyei jauv cing-nzengc nyei mienh, dongh maiv jiez hnyouv zoux jaav nyei sic, yaac maiv la'guaih houv jaav waac.
Ninh oix duqv Ziouv ceix fuqv. Njoux ninh wuov dauh Tin-Hungh yaac oix bun cing ninh zoux duqv horpc.
Se dongh naaiv nyungc mienh daaih lorz ninh, daaih yiem Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien.
Koi nqoi laatc gaengh maah! Koi nqoi loz-hnoi nyei gaengh. Maaih njang-laangc nyei Hungh oix bieqc daaih.
Naaiv dauh njang-laangc nyei Hungh dongh haaix dauh? Se dongh maaih qaqv henv haic nyei Ziouv, dongh mborqv jaax henv nyei Ziouv.
Koi nqoi laatc gaengh maah! Koi nqoi loz-hnoi nyei gaengh. Maaih njang-laangc nyei Hungh oix bieqc daaih.
Naaiv dauh njang-laangc nyei Hungh dongh haaix dauh? Se Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv. Dongh naaiv dauh zoux njang-laangc nyei Hungh.
O Ziouv aac, yie bungx dingc hnyouv kaux meih.
O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, yie kaux meih. Tov maiv dungx bun yie zuqc nyaiv, yaac maiv dungx bun yie nyei win-wangv hingh jiex yie.
Da'faanh zuov jienv meih nyei mienh yietc liuz maiv zuqc nyaiv. Mv baac ngaengc jienv meih yaac maiv maaih gorn-baengx wuov deix zungv oix zuqc nyaiv aqv.
O Ziouv aac, tov bun yie hiuv duqv meih nyei za'eix yaac njaaux yie hiuv duqv meih nyei jauv.
Tov meih dorh yie gan meih nyei zien leiz yaac njaaux yie, weic zuqc meih zoux njoux yie wuov dauh Tin-Hungh. Yie ziangh hnoi ziangh muonz zuov meih.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih jangx jienv meih korv-lienh mienh yaac ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, weic zuqc loz-hnoi m'daaih hnangv naaic.
Maiv dungx jangx yie lunx nyei ziangh hoc zoux dorngc, baamz nyei zuiz. O Ziouv aac, ziux meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh tov meih jangx yie, weic zuqc meih se longx haic.
Ziouv se longx nyei, baengh fim nyei, ninh ziouc njaaux zuiz-mienh yangh horpc nyei jauv.
Ninh dorh nyiemc ganh zoux faix nyei mienh zoux horpc nyei sic, yaac njaaux ninh mbuo hiuv duqv ninh nyei jauv.
Da'faanh ei jienv Ziouv nyei ngaengc waac caux ninh gorngv nyei waac nyei mienh ninh hnamv yaac ziepc zuoqv nyei dorh.
O Ziouv aah! Weic meih ganh nyei mengh tov guangc yie nyei zuiz, weic zuqc yie nyei zuiz hlo haic.
Haaix dauh taaih Ziouv, ninh oix njaaux wuov dauh ginv yangh horpc nyei jauv.
Yiem ninh nyei seix zeiv ninh duqv siouc fuqv-loqc, ninh nyei hoz doic yaac duqv nzipc naaiv norm deic-bung.
Ziouv caux taaih ninh wuov deix zoux doic. Ninh bun ninh mbuo hiuv duqv ninh laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Yie nyei m'zing zanc-zanc mangc Ziouv, weic zuqc kungx ninh ganh haih tengx yie nyei zaux leih ndutv, maiv zuqc mungz nzenc.
Tov meih huin nzuonx daaih mangc yie, korv-lienh yie, weic zuqc yie ndoqc yaac kuonx naanh.
Yie nyei hnyouv nzauh duqv kouv haic. Tov tengx yie biaux ndutv yie nyei kouv naanc.
Tov meih tengx corngh yie nyei kouv naanc caux naanc zingh, aengx guangc yie nyei yietc zungv zuiz.
Tov meih hnamv mangc gaax, yie nyei win-wangv ndongc haaix camv, yaac mangc gaax ninh mbuo nzorng duqv yie doqc haic.
Tov meih beu jienv yie nyei maengc aengx njoux yie, bun yie maiv zuqc nyaiv, weic zuqc yie ndaauh kaux meih.
Meih hnyouv zaqc hnyouv zingx nyei ziouc tov meih beu jienv yie, weic zuqc yie zuov jienv meih.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov meih njoux I^saa^laa^en mienh biaux ndutv ninh mbuo nyei yietc zungv kouv naanc.
Ziouv aac, tov meih siemv bun cing yie maiv zoux dorngc, weic zuqc yie kungx zoux zingx nyei sic hnangv. Yie kaux Ziouv, hnyouv yaac maiv mbungh mbienv.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih zaah mangc yie yaac seix yie, tov kauv yie nyei hnyouv caux yie hnamv nyei sic.
Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie yaac dorh yie, yie yaac zanc-zanc ei jienv meih nyei zien leiz yangh.
Yie yaac maiv caux nduov mienh nyei mienh juangc jauv yangh, yaac maiv caux beih zaqc hnyouv njuotv nyei mienh zoux doic.
Yie nzorng haic gapv zunv nyei orqv mienh, yaac simv nqoi mienh waaic mienh.
O Ziouv aac, yie nzaaux yie nyei buoz bun cing yie maiv zoux dorngc. Yie yaac yangh huing meih nyei ziec-dorngh.
Yie baaux nzung dor-ziec meih, nzamc jienv gorngv meih zoux nyei yietc zungv mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
O Ziouv aac, yie hnamv meih yiem nyei biauv, dongh meih nyei njang-laangc yiem nyei dorngx.
Tov meih maiv dungx zorqv yie caux zuiz-mienh yietc njiec guaatv mingh. Yaac maiv dungx zorqv yie nyei maengc caux daix mienh nyei mienh zuqc daic.
Ninh mbuo nyei buoz zanc-zanc zoux orqv sic. Ninh mbuo nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz kungx nzuiz nyaanh hmuangx hnangv.
Mv baac yie ganh kungx zoux hnyouv zingx. Tov meih njoux yie, korv-lienh yie.
Yie nyei zaux souv jienv ndau-baengh nyei dorngx, yiem zuangx mienh gapv zunv nyei dorngx yie oix ceng Ziouv.
Ziouv zoux yie nyei njang caux njoux yie wuov dauh, yie oix zuqc gamh nziex haaix dauh? Ziouv se yie nyei maengc kaux wuonv nyei dorngx, yie oix zuqc gamh nziex haaix dauh?
Zoux orqv nyei mienh daaih hoic yie, oix nyanc yie nyei orv nyei ziangh hoc, se yie nyei win-jaa win-wangv daaih wuov zanc, ninh mbuo oix ndiqv zuqc ndorpc.
Maiv gunv maaih jun-baeng daaih weih gormx yie, yie nyei hnyouv maiv gamh nziex. Maiv gunv zuqc mborqv domh jaax, yie corc kaux Tin-Hungh.

Yie tengx Ziouv tov nduqc nyungc hnangv, wuov nyungc yie oix lorz, se yie yietc liuz yietc seix oix yiem Ziouv nyei biauv, yiem wuov mangc jienv Ziouv ndongc naaic longx yaac yiem ninh nyei biauv jouh ninh.
Yie zuqc kouv nyei ziangh hoc ninh oix beu jienv yie yiem ninh ganh nyei dorngx. Se zorqv yie bingx jienv yiem ninh nyei ndopv-liuh gu'nyuoz, ninh oix zorqv yie an jienv la'bieiv-zorng gu'nguaaic.

Ih zanc yie oix cau jiez m'nqorngv, yiem weih gormx yie wuov deix win-wangv gu'nguaaic. Yie oix yiem Tin-Hungh nyei ndopv-liuh gu'nyuoz, njien-youh nyei heuc jienv fongc horc ziec. Yie oix baaux nzung, oix baaux nzung ceng Ziouv.
O Ziouv aah! Yie heuc nyei ziangh hoc tov muangx yie, tov korv-lienh yie, yaac dau yie.
Meih gorngv mbuox yie, “Daaih lorz yie maah!” Yie nyei hnyouv gorngv mbuox meih, “ Ziouv aac, yie za'gengh oix lorz meih.”

Tov maiv dungx bingx meih nyei hmien maiv mangc yie. Maiv dungx qiex jiez jienv zunc meih nyei bou biaux nqoi, weic zuqc meih m'daaih zoux tengx yie wuov dauh. O yie nyei Njoux Ziouv, Tin-Hungh aah! Maiv dungx leih yie, maiv dungx guangc yie.
Yie nyei diex maac guangc yie, mv baac Ziouv oix zipv yie.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih njaaux yie yangh meih nyei jauv, yaac dorh yie gan jauv-baengh mingh, weic zuqc yie maaih win-wangv camv.

Tov meih maiv dungx zorqv yie jiu bun win-wangv. Maiv dungx sueih win-wangv nyei eix zoux bun yie. Weic zuqc zoux jaav zorng-zengx nyei mienh cuotv daaih, ninh mbuo gorngv cuotv nyei waac hoic yie kouv.
Yie sienx dingc yie corc yiem yaangh gen nyei ziangh hoc, yie oix duqv buatc Ziouv zoux longx.
Oix zuqc zuov Ziouv, oix zuqc henv yaac zungx jienv daamv, zungv oix zuqc zuov Ziouv.
O Ziouv aah! Yie heuc jienv meih, yie nyei La'bieiv aah! Tov meih muangx yie, maiv dungx zoux hnangv m'normh ndung. Nziex meih maiv dau yie, yie ziouc hnangv njiec yiemh gen wuov deix mienh nor.
Tov muangx haiz yie daux gaux heuc jienv tov meih tengx, dongh yie sung jienv buoz hungx jienv meih Gauh Cing-Nzengc Jiex nyei Singx Dinc tov nyei ziangh hoc.

Tov maiv dungx zorqv yie caux mienh waaic mienh caux zoux orqv nyei mienh yietc njiec dingc zuiz. Ninh mbuo caux juangc laangz mienh gorngv baengh orn nyei waac, mv baac hnyouv gu'nyuoz ninh mbuo oix zoux doqc.
Tov meih ei ninh mbuo zoux nyei jauv, yaac ziux ninh mbuo zoux nyei orqv sic winh bun ninh mbuo. Ziux ninh mbuo nyei buoz zoux nyei, yaac ziux ninh mbuo horpc zuqc duqv nyei, tov winh bun ninh mbuo.
Weic zuqc ninh mbuo maiv maaih hnyouv taaih Ziouv zoux nyei gong, fai ninh nyei buoz zoux daaih nyei, ninh oix baaic waaic ninh mbuo, yaac maiv ceix ninh mbuo jiez aqv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv, weic zuqc ninh muangx haiz yie tov nyei waac.
Ziouv se yie nyei qaqv caux yie nyei torngv-baaih, yie nyei hnyouv kaux ninh, ninh ziouc tengx yie. Yie nyei hnyouv yaac njien-youh haic, yie ziouc baaux nzung dor-ziec ninh.
Ziouv se ninh nyei baeqc fingx nyei qaqv, ninh se wuonv nyei dorngx njoux ninh longc youh orn daaih zoux hungh wuov dauh.
Tov njoux meih nyei baeqc fingx, yaac ceix fuqv bun meih nzipc nyei mienh. Tov meih goux ninh mbuo hnangv goux ba'gi yungh mienh goux ninh mbuo nyei yungh nor. Tov yietc liuz dorh ninh mbuo.
Yiem lungh nyei zuangx fin-mienh aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv nyei njang-laangc caux qaqv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv puix ninh njang-laangc nyei mbuox. Oix zuqc zaangc Ziouv weic ninh cing-nzengc nyei mbuox njang-laangc haic.
Ziouv nyei sing-qiex yiem wuov koiv gu'nguaaic. Njang-laangc nyei Tin-Hungh nyei qiex mbui hnangv mba'ong mbui nor, Ziouv nyei sing-qiex aengv buangv koiv.
Ziouv nyei sing-qiex maaih domh qaqv, Ziouv nyei sing-qiex maaih haangh daauh hlo haic.
Ziouv nyei qiex wuotv nauv si^ndaa zongh ndiangx. Ziouv wuotv nauv Le^mbaa^norn nyei si^ndaa zongh ndiangx.
Ninh bun Le^mbaa^norn Geh dongz hnangv ngongh dorn ndiuh lungh, yaac bun Si^li^on Mbong dongz hnangv hieh ngongh gouv caan biu nor.
Ziouv nyei sing-qiex njopc cuotv benx douz-mbietc.
Ziouv nyei sing-qiex ndanc dongz deic-bung-huaang. Ziouv nqamv dongz Kaa^ndetc nyei deic-bung-huaang.
Ziouv nyei qiex ndanc domh mba'ong zuei ndiangx, yaac bun lomc nyei ndiangx-normh bioh nzengc. Yiem ninh nyei singx dinc nyei yietc zungv mienh yaac heuc jienv, “Njang-laangc!”
Ziouv zueiz jienv weic gunv mbiungc-suiv-imx. Ziouv zueiz jienv weic, yietc liuz zoux hungh.
Tov Ziouv ceix qaqv bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx. Tov Ziouv ceix fuqv bun ninh nyei mienh duqv baengh orn.
Ziouv aac, yie ceng meih weic zuqc meih zorqv yie yiem ndo nyei dorngx cuotv daaih, maiv bun yie nyei win-wangv jatv yie.
O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Yie heuc jienv meih tengx, meih yaac zorc yie longx.
O Ziouv aac, meih njoux yie yiem yiemh gen cuotv daaih, bun yie duqv maengc ziangh, maiv zuqc njiec yiemh gen.
O Ziouv nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx aah! Oix zuqc baaux nzung ceng ninh. Oix zuqc dor-ziec ninh nyei cing-nzengc mbuox.
Ninh nouz mienh se weic nduqc dangh hnangv, mv baac ninh nyei en-zingh se weic yietc seix. Maiv gunv ziangh muonz nyiemv, mv baac taux lungh ndorm njien-youh aqv.
Yie ganh aeqv, yiem maanc sic bungx-zuoqc nyei ziangh hoc yie gorngv, “Yie yietc liuz maiv zuqc ging-dongz.”
O Ziouv aac, meih nyei en-zingh liepc yie hnangv norm wuonv nyei mbong nor. Mv baac meih buang meih nyei hmien maiv mangc yie, yie ziouc gamh nziex haic.
O Ziouv aah! Yie heuc jienv meih. Yie dorng jienv Ziouv tov meih tengx.
“Se gorngv yie daic aengx zuqc mingh yiem yiemh gen, maaih haaix nyungc maaih lamh longc? Nie-mbung haih ceng meih nyei fai? Haih gorngv meih ziepc zuoqv nyei jauv fai?
O Ziouv aah! Tov meih muangx yie yaac korv-lienh yie. O Ziouv aah! Tov meih tengx yie.
Yie nzauh nyiemv, meih bun yie cangx heix, meih jaiv nqoi yie nyei la'maah ndie-cou nyei lui, goiv benx njien-youh,
bun yie nyei hnyouv haih ceng meih, zungv maiv haih sekv. O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Yie oix zongc zingh meih taux yietc liuz.
Ziouv aac, yie ndaauh kaux meih. Tov bun yie yietc liuz maiv zuqc nyaiv. Meih se baengh fim nyei Tin-Hungh, tov meih njoux yie.
Tov baeng m'normh muangx yie, siepv-siepv nyei njoux yie. Tov zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei la'bieiv, zoux weih jienv wuonv nyei dorngx njoux yie.
Meih zoux yie nyei la'bieiv caux yie wuonv nyei dorngx. Weic meih ganh nyei mengh tov dorh yie, yienz yie nyei jauv.
Tov bun yie biaux ndutv mienh weic yie zaeng nyei mungz, weic zuqc meih zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx.
Yie zorqv yie nyei lingh wuonh jiu bun yiem meih nyei buoz gu'nyuoz. O Ziouv, ziepc zuoqv nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Meih zungv zuoqc yie daaih aqv.
Meih nzorng haic baaix maiv lamh longc nyei miuc-fangx wuov deix, mv baac yie kaux Ziouv.
Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie, yie ziouc njien-youh a'hneiv, weic zuqc meih buatc yie nyei kouv naanc, yaac hiuv duqv yie nyei hnyouv nzauh nyei jauv.
Meih yaac maiv zorqv yie jiu bun yiem win-wangv nyei buoz-ndiev. Meih bun yie nyei zaux caaiv jienv jangv nyei dorngx.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih korv-lienh yie, weic zuqc yie kouv haic. Yie nzauh nyiemv, m'zing zungv maiv njang aqv. Yie nyei sin caux hnyouv kouv nzengc.
Yie nyei maengc zuqc nzauh kouv hnangv, hnyangx jiex hnyangx kungx njunh jienv yiem. Laaix yie zuqc nyei kouv naanc yie nyei qaqv mau jienv njiec, zungv kouv taux mbungv nqaai.
Yie nyei yietc zungv win-wangv huotv yie, yie nyei juangc laangz mienh mangc piex yie. Hiuv duqv yie wuov deix gengh! gamh nziex yie. Liemh yiem jauv zaangc buangh yie wuov deix yaac biaux yie.
Ninh mbuo la'kuqv yie, maiv jangx yie hnangv yie daic mi'aqv nor. Yie hnangv mborqv huv nyei nie-mor.
Yie haiz mienh camv nyei gorngv waac-sapv, maaih gamh nziex haic nyei sic weih gormx yie. Ninh mbuo caangh laangh hoic yie, daav za'eix zorqv yie nyei maengc.
Mv baac Ziouv aac, yie kaux meih. Yie gorngv, “Meih zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh.”
