Yie ziangh nyei hnoi-nyieqc yiem meih nyei buoz, tov njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei win-wangv caux zeix yie wuov deix mienh nyei buoz-ndiev.
Tov bun meih nyei hmien nyei njang ziux yie, meih nyei bou, weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie, tov njoux yie.
O Ziouv aac, tov bun yie maiv zuqc nyaiv, weic zuqc yie heuc meih. Tov bun orqv mienh zuqc nyaiv, sekv nzieqc nyei mingh yiem yiemh gen.
Tov bun gorngv-baeqc mienh nyei nzuih, dongh ninh mbuo ceng-hlo, bungx waac-maux, gorngv doqc kuv mienh wuov deix nyei nzuih hngongx mingh, maiv haih gorngv waac.
Meih za'gengh longx haic. Meih siou longx nyei ga'naaiv yaac bungx-zuoqc, aengx yiem baamh mienh nyei nza'hmien bun taaih meih, ndaauh kaux meih nyei mienh.

Meih dorh ninh mbuo bingx jienv meih nyei nza'hmien mbueiz nyei dorngx, biaux ndutv mienh daav waaic nyei za'eix. Meih bun ninh mbuo yiem norm dorngx beu jienv ninh mbuo, biaux ndutv gorngv doqc nzaeng jaax nyei waac.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv, weic zuqc yie yiem zuqc weih jienv nyei zingh nyei ziangh hoc, meih bun cing meih za'gengh! ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie.
Yie zuqc haeqv gamh nziex nyei ziangh hoc yie gorngv, “Yie yiem meih nyei nza'hmien zuqc zunc leih go.” Mv baac yie heuc jienv tov meih tengx, meih yaac haiz yie tov nyei waac.
Ziouv nyei zuangx cing-nzengc baeqc fingx aah! Oix zuqc hnamv Ziouv. Ninh beu jienv ziepc zuoqv nyei mienh, mv baac hniev-hniev nyei winh bun zoux maux nyei mienh.
Da'faanh zuov jienv Ziouv nyei mienh oix zuqc henv, zungx jienv daamv.
Haaix dauh zoux dorngc zuiz mv baac duqv Tin-Hungh guangc nqoi,, se duqv ninh nyei zuiz sortv guangc, wuov dauh maaih orn-lorqc.
Ziouv funx maiv maaih zuiz nyei mienh, se ganh nyei hnyouv maiv maaih haaix nyungc nduov mienh, wuov dauh maaih orn-lorqc.
Yie nyienz jienv maiv nyiemc yie nyei zuiz wuov zanc, yie nyei sin hei jienv njiec, weic zuqc yie ziangh hnoi njunh jienv yiem.
Meih nyei buoz ziangh hnoi ziangh muonz ngatv jienv yie, yie nyei qaqv ziouc zitc nzengc, hnangv nqaai gorng yuoqv nyei ziangh hoc nor.

Yie ziouc nyiemc yie nyei zuiz bun meih aqv. Yie maiv bingx yie zoux dorngc nyei sic. Yie gorngv, “Yie oix dorng jienv Ziouv nyiemc yie zoux dorngc nyei sic.” Meih ziouc guangc nqoi yie zoux dorngc nyei zuiz.
Tov bun gan longx meih wuov deix mienh dorng jienv meih daux gaux. Doix zuqc buangh kuonx naanh nyei ziangh hoc, hnangv wuom yiemx wuov zanc ziouc yiemx maiv taux ninh wuov.
Meih zoux yie bingx nyei dorngx. Meih beu jienv yie leih ndutv kouv naanc, meih bun weih gormx yie nyei mienh baaux njoux en nyei nzung.
Yie oix njaaux meih, bun meih hiuv duqv horpc zuqc yangh nyei jauv. Yie oix bungx m'zing mangc jienv tengx meih caangh laangh.
Maiv dungx zoux hnangv maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei lorh maaz. Oix zuqc longc hlieqv fapv jienv nzuih, ndoh jienv hlaang, ninh cingx daaih mbuoqc meih gunv.
Orqv mienh zuqc siouc kouv camv, mv baac kaux Ziouv nyei mienh zungv oix duqv Ziouv ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv, goux jienv ninh.
Meih mbuo kuv mienh aah! Oix zuqc kaux Ziouv njien-youh orn-lorqc. Meih mbuo hnyouv zingx nyei zuangx mienh aah! Oix zuqc njien-youh nyei heuc mbui.
Kuv mienh aah! Oix zuqc kaux Ziouv orn-lorqc. Hnyouv zingx nyei mienh horpc zuqc ceng ninh.
Oix zuqc patv daanh baah ceng Ziouv, longc maaih ziepc diuh finx nyei daanh baah patv nzung ceng ninh.
Dorng jienv ninh baaux diuh siang-nzung, patv daanh baah liouc nyei, yaac heuc mbui nyei.
Weic zuqc Ziouv nyei waac se zien nyei, ninh zoux nyei yietc zungv gong ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux.
Haaix nyungc horpc nyei, baengh fim nyei, ninh hnamv. Ziouv ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv gormx lungh ndiev ndau-beih.
Ziouv longc ninh nyei waac zeix cuotv lungh, yaac longc ninh nyei nzuih nyei qiex zeix cuotv mba'hnoi caux hlaax caux hleix.
Ninh zorqv koiv nyei wuom siou zunv hnangv dapv gingx-baengh, zorqv ndo haic nyei koiv zaangh jienv yiem siou ga'naaiv nyei dorngx.
Tov bun gormx lungh ndiev taaih Ziouv. Tov bun lungh ndiev mienh gamh nziex ninh.
Weic zuqc ninh yietv gorngv, baamh gen ziouc maaih daaih aqv. Ninh yietv hatc, maanc muotc ziouc cuotv daaih.
Ziouv bun zuangx fingx caangh laangh nyei jauv maiv lamh longc, ninh bun maanc fingx nyei za'eix zoux maiv cuotv haaix nyungc.
Ziouv caangh laangh nyei waac yietc liuz yiem, ninh yiem hnyouv hnamv cuotv nyei za'eix yiem taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Maaih Ziouv zoux ninh mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh wuov norm guoqv nyei mienh maaih orn-lorqc. Se ninh ginv daaih zoux ninh ganh nzipc nyei wuov deix baeqc fingx maaih orn-lorqc.
Ziouv yiem gu'nguaaic lungh mangc njiec, ninh buatc nzengc yietc zungv baamh mienh.
Ninh yiem ninh zueiz nyei weic mangc njiec lungh ndiev maanc mienh yietc zungv.
Ninh se zeix ziangx ninh mbuo zuangx mienh nyei hnyouv, ninh mengh baeqc ninh mbuo zoux nyei yietc zungv sic.
Hungh diex maiv zeiz weic kaux baeng camv duqv hingh. Mborqv jaax henv nyei baeng maiv zeiz weic qaqv hlo duqv njoux.
Kaux mborqv jaax nyei maaz weic hingh jiex se maiv lamh hnamv aqv. Maiv gunv maaz nyei qaqv hlo, maiv haih njoux mienh.
Mv baac Ziouv nyei m'zing mangc jienv gamh nziex ninh, taaih ninh wuov deix, dongh kaux ninh ziepc zuoqv hnamv mienh nyei hnyouv wuov deix.
Ninh oix njoux ninh mbuo, bun ninh mbuo maiv zuqc daic, ngorc hnaangx nyei ziangh hoc yaac bun ninh mbuo maaih maengc ziangh jienv.
Yie mbuo nyei hnyouv maaih lamh hnamv zuov jienv Ziouv. Ninh tengx mbuo yaac zoux mbuo nyei torngv-baaih.
Yie mbuo nyei hnyouv zungv kaux ninh njien-youh, weic zuqc yie mbuo kaux ninh nyei cing-nzengc mbuox.
Ziouv aac, tov meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie mbuo, weic zuqc yie mbuo kaux meih maaih lamh hnamv dorngx.
Yie maiv dingh liouh nyei oix ceng Ziouv. Ceng ninh nyei waac zanc-zanc yiem yie nyei nzuih.
Yie nyei hnyouv oix weic Ziouv bungx waac-maux, bun zuqc zeix nyei mienh muangx haiz ziouc a'hneiv.
Tov caux yie ceng Ziouv weih hlo. Tov bun mbuo lomh nzoih taaih ninh nyei mengh.
Yie daux gaux tov Ziouv, ninh ziouc dau yie. Yaac njoux yie biaux ndutv yietc zungv gamh nziex nyei sic.
Zuqc zeix nyei mienh mangc jienv ninh, hmien ziouc njang-laangc aqv. Ninh mbuo maiv zuqc buang hmien diev nyaiv.
Naaiv dauh mienh jomc mienh heuc jienv tov, Ziouv yaac haiz mi'aqv, yaac njoux ninh biaux ndutv ninh nyei yietc zungv kouv naanc.
Ziouv nyei fin-mienh beu jienv taaih Ziouv nyei mienh yaac njoux ninh mbuo.
Gunv seix mueix ziouc hiuv duqv Ziouv se longx haic. Ndaauh kaux ninh nyei mienh maaih orn-lorqc.
Ziouv nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx aah! Oix zuqc taaih ninh, weic zuqc taaih ninh wuov deix maiv caa haaix nyungc.
Liemh sienh lunx haih dangx haih ngorc nyanc nyei ga'naaiv, mv baac lorz Ziouv nyei mienh maiv caa haaix nyungc longx nyei ga'naaiv.
Yie nyei naamh nyouz aac, daaih muangx yie nyei waac maah! Yie oix njaaux meih mbuo taaih Ziouv.
Haaix dauh baamh mienh oix ziangh jienv, oix duqv siouc nyuonh ndaauv yaac duqv longx?
Oix zuqc faix fim, maiv dungx bun mbietc gorngv orqv nyei waac. Nzuih meix yaac maiv dungx gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh.
Orqv nyei oix zuqc simv nqoi, kungx zoux longx nyei jauv. Oix zuqc longc hnyouv zimh lorz baengh orn nyei jauv.
Ziouv nyei m'zing mangc jienv kuv mienh. Ninh nyei m'normh yaac muangx ninh mbuo heuc jienv tov nyei waac.
Ziouv ngaengc jienv zoux orqv nyei mienh, bun yiem naaiv lungh ndiev maiv maaih haaix dauh jangx duqv ninh mbuo.
Kuv mienh heuc jienv tov, Ziouv muangx haiz mi'aqv, bun ninh mbuo biaux ndutv yietc zungv kuonx naanh.
Ziouv yiem nitv fatv hnyouv mun nyei mienh, yaac njoux hnyouv mun, mba'nziu yuqc nyei mienh.
Kuv mienh buangh kuonx naanh camv nyei, mv baac Ziouv njoux ninh biaux ndutv nzengc.
Ninh beu jienv kuv mienh nyei sin, maiv bun yietc diuh mbungv nauv.
Orqv mienh oix zuqc orqv nyei sic daic, hanc kuv mienh nyei mienh oix zuqc dingc zuiz.
Ziouv yaac njoux ninh nyei bou nyei maengc. Ndaauh kaux ninh wuov deix, maiv maaih haaix dauh zuqc dingc zuiz.
O Ziouv aac, caux yie doix-dekc nyei mienh, tov meih caux ninh mbuo doix-dekc. Caux yie mborqv jaax nyei mienh, tov meih caux ninh mbuo mborqv.
Tov nanv jienv domh torngv-baaih, fiuv-torngv-baaih daaih tengx yie.
Yaamh jiez cang caux mborqv jaax nyei bouv mborqv zunc yie wuov deix mienh. Tov meih caux yie nyei hnyouv gorngv waac, “Yie se dongh njoux meih wuov dauh.”
Tov bun oix zorqv yie nyei maengc wuov deix zuqc nyaiv, zuqc baaic. Tov bun daav za'eix hoic yie wuov deix tuix nzuonx yaac zuqc nyaiv.
Tov bun ninh mbuo hnangv zuqc nziaaux buonc nyei mbieqv nor, maaih Ziouv nyei fin-mienh zunc jienv ninh mbuo mingh.
Tov bun ninh mbuo nyei jauv youc hmuangx youc mbiaangc, yaac maaih Ziouv nyei fin-mienh zunc ninh mbuo.
Weic zuqc ninh mbuo zaeng mungz zorqv yie yaac maiv maaih gorn-baengx. Ninh mbuo yaac wetv kuotv ndo nyei oix zorqv yie nyei maengc, yaac maiv maaih gorn-baengx.

Ninh mbuo jangx maiv zaaic nyei ziangh hoc, tov bun ninh mbuo zuqc mietc, bun ninh mbuo zaeng nyei mungz hlopv ninh mbuo ganh, yaac bun ninh mbuo ndortv njiec ninh mbuo ganh wetv nyei kuotv zuqc mietc.
Yie nyei hnyouv ziouc kaux Ziouv njien-youh haic, yaac orn-lorqc weic zuqc ninh njoux yie.

Yie oix longc nzengc hnyouv gorngv, “O Ziouv aac, haaix dauh hnangv meih? Meih tengx mau nyei mienh biaux ndutv gauh henv ninh mbuo wuov deix, yaac njoux mau nyei, dangx-donx nyei mienh biaux ndutv luv ninh mbuo wuov deix.”
Hiuang orqv nyei mienh cuotv daaih zoux zorng-zengx, gorngv taux yie liemh maiv hiuv nyei sic.
Weic yie zoux nyei kuv sic ninh mbuo winh orqv bun yie, yie nyei hnyouv ndoqc kouv.
Yie ganh aeqv, dongh ninh mbuo butv baengc nyei ziangh hoc, yie zuqv la'maah ndie-cou, zei maiv nyanc haaix nyungc, ndoqv m'nqorngv njiec daux gaux,
hnangv yie weic yie nyei loz-gaeng doic fai yie nyei muoz-doic nzauh fai hnangv mienh weic ganh nyei cien-maa nzauh nyiemv, yie ndoqv m'nqorngv nyiemv.
Yie buangh zuqc kouv ninh mbuo lomh nzoih a'hneiv. Ninh mbuo gapv zunv jatv yie. Dongh yie maiv hiuv nyei mienh maiv dingh liouh nyei gorngv doqc yie.
Hnangv maiv hiuv Tin-Hungh nyei mienh ninh mbuo huotv yie, ninh mbuo ngaatc jienv nyaah mangc yie.
O Ziouv aah! Meih oix mangc jienv yaac maiv tengx yie ndongc haaix lauh? Tov meih njoux yie biaux ndutv maiv zuqc ninh mbuo zoux doqc hoic, njoux yie nyei maengc leih ndutv naaiv deix sienh.
Yie oix yiem gapv zunv nyei domh wuic dor-ziec meih, yie oix yiem mienh camv nyei mbu'ndongx ceng meih.
Tov meih maiv dungx bun zoux win-wangv mv baac maiv maaih gorn-baengx wuov deix a'hneiv nyei jatv yie. Maiv dungx bun nzorng yie yaac maiv maaih gorn-baengx wuov deix nzuei kamx-bui bun yie.
Ninh mbuo maiv gorngv baengh orn nyei waac. Daaux nzuonx ninh mbuo hnamv cuotv nduov mienh nyei waac hoic yiem deic-bung sekv nyei mienh.
Ninh mbuo morngx nqoi nzuih mangc jienv yie gorngv, “Haav, haav! Yie mbuo nyei m'zing zungv buatc liuz aqv.”
O Ziouv aac, meih buatc liuz aqv. Tov meih maiv dungx sekv-sekv nyei yiem. O Ziouv aac, tov meih maiv dungx leih go yie.
Yie nyei Tin-Hungh, yie nyei Ziouv aah! Tov nyie, dongz sin daaih tengx yie mbenc sung yie nyei sic.
Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, meih se baengh fim nyei. Tov bun cing yie maiv zoux dorngc zuiz. Maiv dungx bun ninh mbuo a'hneiv nyei jatv yie.

Tov maiv dungx bun ninh mbuo yiem ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv hnamv cuotv daaih gorngv, “Haav, haav! Ziux yie mbuo oix duqv daaih yie mbuo duqv aqv.” Yaac maiv dungx bun ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo duqv naqv ninh mi'aqv.”
Tov bun a'hneiv yie zuqc kouv naanc wuov deix yietc zungv zuqc nyaiv, zuqc la'nyauv nyei sic. Tov bun ceng ganh gauh hlo yie wuov deix zuqc nyaiv, zuqc baaic hmien.
Tov bun a'hneiv yie zuqc siemv dingc maiv maaih zuiz wuov deix njien-youh orn-lorqc nyei heuc. Tov bun ninh mbuo zanc-zanc gorngv, “ Ziouv se hlo haic. Ninh a'hneiv ninh nyei bou duqv longx.”
Yie oix zunh gorngv meih se baengh fim nyei, yie oix ziangh hnoi ceng meih.
Zuiz yiem orqv mienh nyei hnyouv ndo nyei dorngx caux orqv mienh gorngv. Ziux ninh nyei m'zing mangc, ninh maiv zuqc gamh nziex Tin-Hungh.
Ninh ceng ninh ganh nyei haah baah buang, laaic maiv maaih haaix dauh haih hiuv fai nzorng ninh nyei zuiz.
Ninh nyei nzuih gorngv orqv nyei waac, gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh. Cong-mengh nyei jauv caux kuv sic ninh dingh, maiv zoux aqv.
Ninh bueix jienv coux hnamv cuotv zoux waaic nyei sic. Ninh dingc hnyouv zoux maiv benx nyei jauv, ninh yaac maiv nqemh zoux orqv nyei sic.
O Ziouv aac, meih ziepc zuoqv hnamv mienh nyei hnyouv se mbaengc lungh hlang. Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv mbaengc ndaamv-lungh.
Meih se baengh fim hnangv Tin-Hungh nyei zuangx mbong. Meih dunx sic se hnangv ndo haic nyei koiv. O Ziouv aac, mienh maanh caux saeng-kuv meih yaac njoux.
O Tin-Hungh aac, meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh se za'gengh jaaix haic. Baamh mienh hlo-hlo faix-faix yiem meih nyei ndaatv-ndiev nyei dongh linh.
Ninh mbuo nyanc yiem meih nyei biauv bungx-zuoqc nyei ga'naaiv beuv, meih yaac bun ninh mbuo hopv meih nyei orn-lorqc ndaaih nyei wuom.
Weic zuqc yiem wuov maaih ziangh maengc nyei wuom-zingv. Yiem meih nyei njang yie mbuo duqv buatc njang.
Tov meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv jienv mingh dongh hiuv duqv meih wuov deix, yaac baengh fim nyei zoux bun hnyouv zingx nyei mienh.
Tov maiv dungx bun zoux maux nyei mienh nyei zaux caaiv yie, yaac maiv dungx bun mienh waaic mienh nyei buoz zunc yie biaux.
Mangc maah! Zoux orqv nyei mienh king njiec bueix jienv wuov. Ninh mbuo zuqc fongv ndorpc mingh, maiv haih aengx jiez sin daaih.
Maiv dungx weic zoux orqv nyei mienh guaax hnyouv. Yaac maiv dungx mueic jieqv zoux dorngc nyei mienh.
Weic zuqc ninh mbuo hnangv miev nor, siepv-siepv nyei nyaux mingh. Yaac hnangv miev-maeng nor, nqaai nzengc.
Oix zuqc kaux Ziouv yaac zoux kuv sic, meih ziouc duqv baengh orn nyei yiem naaiv norm deic-bung.
Oix zuqc a'hneiv lorz Ziouv nyei orn-lorqc, ninh ziouc ziux meih nyei hnyouv oix nyei ceix bun meih.
Oix zuqc zorqv meih nyei jauv fungx bun Ziouv, yaac kaux ninh, ninh ziouc tengx meih zoux ziangx.
Ninh oix bun meih zoux baengh fim nyei jauv hnangv njang nor ziux cuotv daaih, bun meih nyei gong-fim hnangv lungh aanx zanc nyei njang.
Oix zuqc yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien sekv-sekv nyei longc noic zuov ninh. Maiv dungx weic ei ganh nyei jauv duqv longx fai ei waaic nyei za'eix zoux wuov deix guaax hnyouv.
Maiv dungx qiex jiez, oix zuqc guangc nqoi nouz mienh nyei hnyouv. Maiv dungx guaax hnyouv, naaiv kungx dorh mienh mingh zoux orqv sic hnangv.
Zoux orqv nyei mienh oix zuqc pai guangc mingh, mv baac zuov jienv Ziouv wuov deix duqv nzipc naaiv norm deic-bung.
Maiv lauh maiv maaih orqv mienh aqv. Maiv gunv meih longx-longx nyei mangc ninh yiem nyei dorngx, ninh maiv yiem naaic aqv.
Mv baac nyiemc ganh zoux faix wuov deix oix duqv nzipc naaiv norm deic-bung. Ninh mbuo yaac bungx-zuoqc, baengh orn nyei yiem.
Mienh waaic mienh daav za'eix hoic kuv mienh, yaac dorng jienv ninh mbuo ngaatc nyaah.
Ziouv kuh jatv haic zoux waaic nyei mienh weic zuqc ninh hiuv duqv ninh mbuo zuqc mietc nyei ziangh hoc oix taux aqv.
Orqv mienh baeng cuotv nzuqc ndaauv yaac baeng juang-zinx, oix hoic mienh jomc mienh caux dangx-donx nyei mienh, yaac daix zoux horpc nyei mienh.
Mv baac ninh mbuo nyei nzuqc ndaauv oix nzopv ninh mbuo ganh nyei mba'nziu, ninh mbuo nyei juang-zinx yaac oix zuqc wuotv nauv.
Kuv mienh maaih nyei deix baav ga'naaiv, corc gauh longx mienh waaic mienh maaih nyei yietc zungv zinh zoih.
Weic zuqc mienh waaic mienh nyei buoz oix zuqc nauv, mv baac Ziouv zoux longx bun kuv mienh.
Ziouv hiuv duqv maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei mienh nyei hnoi-nyieqc. Ninh mbuo nzipc nyei buonc oix yietc liuz yiem.
Ninh mbuo yiem kuonx naanh nyei hnoi-nyieqc maiv zuqc nyaiv, ngorc hnaangx nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo duqv nyanc beuv.
Mv baac mienh waaic mienh oix zuqc mietc. Ziouv nyei win-wangv se hnangv lomc nyei miev-biangh nyei njang-laangc ziec nzengc, hnangv douz-sioux nor, mitc mi'aqv.
Mienh waaic mienh gaav mingh yaac maiv jaauv, mv baac kuv mienh hnyouv jangv, fungx zingh nyeic bun mienh.
Weic zuqc Ziouv ceix fuqv nyei mienh oix duqv nzipc naaiv norm deic-bung, mv baac zuqc ninh zioux wuov deix oix zuqc pai guangc.
Ziouv liepc wuonv mienh yangh nyei zaux-caaiv. Ninh yaac a'hneiv wuov dauh yangh nyei jauv.
Maiv gunv ninh ndorpc, ninh maiv ziangh dauh king njiec, weic zuqc Ziouv nyei buoz baav jienv ninh.
Zinh ndaangc yie lunx, ih zanc yie gox aqv, mv baac yie maiv buatc jiex kuv mienh zuqc guangc, yaac maiv buatc jiex ninh nyei zeiv-fun tov nyanc.
Ninh zoux hnyouv jangv yaac a'hneiv bun mienh gaav, ninh nyei fun-faqv bun ninh duqv fuqv.
Oix zuqc leih nqoi orqv sic, zoux kuv sic, meih ziouc duqv yietc liuz yiem.

Weic zuqc Ziouv a'hneiv baengh fim nyei jauv, ninh yaac maiv guangc ninh nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx. Ninh oix yietc liuz beu jienv kuv mienh, mv baac mienh waaic mienh nyei zeiv-fun oix zuqc pai guangc.
Kuv mienh zungv oix nzipc naaiv norm deic-bung, yaac duqv yiem naaiv weic yietc liuz.
Kuv mienh nyei nzuih gorngv cong-mengh nyei waac, ninh nyei mbietc gorngv baengh fim nyei jauv.
Tin-Hungh nyei leiz-latc yiem ninh nyei hnyouv, ninh nyei zaux maiv caaiv piatv.
Mienh waaic mienh cienh kuv mienh, oix lorz qangx daix ninh.
Ziouv maiv guangc ninh yiem win-wangv nyei buoz-ndiev, fai zuqc siemv nyei ziangh hoc yaac maiv bun ninh zuqc dingc zuiz.
Zuov jienv Ziouv, ei jienv ninh nyei jauv zoux, ninh ziouc taaih meih, bun meih duqv nzipc naaiv norm deic-bung, mienh waaic mienh zuqc pai guangc wuov zanc, meih ziouc duqv buatc aqv.
Yie buatc jiex mienh waaic mienh maaih hatc maaz hlo haic, hnangv Le^mbaa^norn Mbong nyei yietc diuh hlang jiex nyei domh si^ndaa zongh ndiangx nor.
Mv baac yie aengx yangh naaic jiex, ninh zitc mi'aqv. Maiv gunv yie lorz ninh, yaac lorz maiv buatc.
Samx mangc maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei mienh, yaac mangc longx kuv mienh, weic zuqc hnamv baengh orn nyei mienh maaih hoz doic zeiv-fun,
mv baac baamz zuiz nyei mienh zungv oix zuqc mietc nzengc. Orqv mienh nyei zeiv-fun oix zuqc pai guangc mingh.
Kuv mienh duqv njoux se yiem Ziouv daaih, zuqc kouv naanc nyei ziangh hoc, ninh zoux ninh mbuo ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx.
Ziouv tengx ninh mbuo, njoux ninh mbuo. Ninh tengx ninh mbuo biaux ndutv mienh waaic mienh yaac njoux ninh mbuo, weic zuqc ninh mbuo ndaauh kaux ninh.
O Ziouv aah! Maiv dungx qiex jiez, hemx yie, yaac maiv dungx nouz yie, dingc yie nyei zuiz.
Weic zuqc meih nyei forng-cang buonv bieqc yie gu'nyuoz, meih nyei buoz njiec daaih ngatv jienv yie.
Weic zuqc meih nouz yie, yie nyei sin cingx maiv wangc siangx. Laaix yie nyei zuiz yie benx baengc mi'aqv.
Yie zoux dorngc nyei zuiz yiemx gauh hlang jiex yie nyei m'nqorngv, yaac hnangv ga'naaiv hniev jiex ndaangc yie nyei qaqv.
Laaix yie zoux hngongx nyei sic yie mun nyei dorngx zueix yaac huv.
Yie zuqc kouv, ndoqv njiec, zungv mbaapv njiec ndau. Ziangh hnoi ziangh muonz nzauh nyiemv jienv yiem.
Yie nyei jaaiv jorm hnangv douz buov jienv nor, yie nyei sin maiv maaih yietc norm dorngx wangc siangx.
Yie suei nzengc, kouv taux ndiev. Yie nyei hnyouv mun, njunh jienv yiem.
Ziouv aah! Yie nyei hnyouv oix longc nyei meih hiuv nzengc mi'aqv. Yie njunh jienv nyei qiex bingx maiv mbueiz meih.
Yie nyei mba'nziu dongz seix nyei, yie nyei qaqv yaac mau jienv njiec. Liemh yie nyei m'zing zungv maiv njang aqv.
Laaix yie nyei zeqc naanc yie nyei doic caux gorx-youz simv yie go, yie nyei cien-ceqv yaac simv yie go haic.
Oix zorqv yie nyei maengc wuov deix zaeng ninh mbuo nyei mungz. Oix hoic yie wuov deix kungx gorngv hnangv haaix nor haih bun yie zuqc baaic, ninh mbuo ziangh hnoi daav za'eix nduov yie.
Mv baac yie hnangv m'normh ndung nyei mienh muangx maiv haiz. Yaac hnangv ga'naaiv-hngongx, maiv haih gorngv waac.
Yie hnangv yietc dauh muangx maiv haiz nyei mienh, nzuih maiv haih dau.
O Ziouv aah! Yie zuov jienv meih. O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Meih zungv oix dau yie.
Weic zuqc yie daux gaux gorngv, “Yie nyei zaux caaiv piatv nyei ziangh hoc, maiv dungx bun ninh mbuo jatv yie fai ceng-hlo.”
Weic zuqc yie zungv oix ndorpc haic aqv. Yie yaac zanc-zanc mun jienv yiem.
Yie nyiemc yie nyei zuiz, yie weic yie nyei zuiz nzauh.
Yie nyei win-wangv youc camv youc henv. Nzorng yie mv baac maiv maaih gorn-baengx nyei mienh yaac maaih camv.
Longc orqv sic jaauv yie zoux nyei kuv sic wuov deix caux yie doix-dekc, weic zuqc yie kungx lorz zoux horpc nyei jauv hnangv.
O Ziouv aah! Tov maiv dungx guangc yie. O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Maiv dungx leih go yie.
Njoux yie wuov dauh Ziouv aah! Tov siepv-siepv nyei daaih tengx yie.
Yie gorngv, “Yie oix mbungh yie nyei jauv, weic bun yie nyei nzuih maiv baamz zuiz. Da'faanh orqv mienh yiem yie nyei nza'hmien yie oix nqapc jienv yie nyei nzuih, maiv ko lo.
Yie sekv nzieqc nyei, maiv ko lo. Yie maiv gorngv waac mv baac maiv tengx haaix nyungc yie. Yie nyei hnyouv nzauh kouv jienv faaux.
Yie nyei hnyouv gu'nyuoz za'gengh nzauh duqv kouv haic. Yie hnamv nyei ziangh hoc hnangv douz zieqc jienv yie nyei hnyouv nor, yie ziouc gorngv cuotv waac.
O Ziouv aah! Tov bun yie hiuv duqv yie setv mueiz nyei hnoi-nyieqc. Yie haih ziangh duqv ndongc haaix lauh? Tov bun yie hiuv duqv yie nyei maengc oix jiex ndongc haaix siepv.

Meih bun yie ziangh nyei hnoi-nyieqc ndongc i ziex buoz-zaangv jangv. Ziux meih mangc yie yietc seix nyei maengc se hnangv maiv maaih haaix nyungc aqv. Gorqv-mienh nyei maengc kungx hnangv tauv nzunc qiex nor.

Baamh mienh mingh mingh daaih daaih hnangv dongh linh nor, ninh mbuo lunc jienv yiem yaac maiv lamh longc. Baamh mienh zornc daaih nyei ga'naaiv ndui jienv mv baac maiv hiuv duqv haaix dauh duqv siou.
“Ziouv aah! Yie ih zanc zuov haaix nyungc? Yie kaux meih maaih lamh hnamv dorngx.
Tov njoux yie leih ndutv yie nyei yietc zungv zuiz, maiv dungx bun mienh hngongx mienh jatv yie.
Yie sekv nzieqc nyei, maiv gorngv waac, weic zuqc se meih ganh bun yie hnangv naaiv siouc kouv.
Tov meih zorqv nqoi meih bun yie zuqc nyei zeqc naanc. Yie zuqc meih nyei buoz mborqv taux aav lamh daic aqv.

Laaix mienh zoux zuiz meih gorngv-hemx weic mborqv njaaux. Meih mietc mienh hnamv nyei ga'naaiv hnangv gaeng ngaatc waaic nzengc nor. Dauh dauh baamh mienh nyei maengc se hnangv tauv yietc nzunc qiex hnangv.

“O Ziouv aah! Tov muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac. Tov muangx yie heuc jienv jouh nyei waac. Yie nyei wuom-mueic liouc jienv tov maiv dungx zoux hnangv maiv haiz nor. Weic zuqc yie zoux hnangv meih nyei jiex jauv nyei kaeqv mienh, dingh zepv dangh baav hnangv yie nyei zuangx ong-taaix nor.
Tov huin ganh bung maiv mangc yie weic bun yie aengx duqv deix orn-lorqc. Yie cingx daaih leih nqoi, maiv yiem aqv.”
Yie longc noic zuov jienv Ziouv, ninh bungx m'normh muangx haiz yie tov nyei waac.
Ninh cie yie yiem zuqc mietc nyei kuotv cuotv daaih, se ndo haic, nyouh haic nyei wuom-bamc, bun yie nyei zaux souv wuonv yiem la'bieiv-zorng gu'nguaaic, bun yie nyei zaux-mbiec caaiv duqv wuonv.
Ninh bun yie nyei nzuih baaux diuh siang-nzung, se ceng yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei nzung. Maaih mienh camv nyei duqv buatc ziouc gamh nziex aengx sienx kaux Ziouv.
Haaix dauh sienx kaux Ziouv, maiv huin mingh lorz zoux maux, ceng-hlo nyei mienh, caux dorngc jauv gan jaav zienh nyei mienh, wuov dauh duqv orn-lorqc aqv.

O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Meih weic yie mbuo zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic camv. Meih weic yie mbuo hnamv cuotv nyei za'eix maiv maaih haaix dauh haih beiv duqv taux meih. Se gorngv yie mingh zunh mbuox mienh, zungv maiv haih saauv maiv zienz.

Meih maiv zeiz oix mienh buov ziec caux fongc horc nyei ga'naaiv, meih maiv zeiz lorz ziangh dauh buov ziec nyei saeng-kuv fai fiqv zuiz nyei ga'naaiv, mv baac meih bun yie maaih m'normh muangx duqv haiz meih nyei qiex.
Yie ziouc gorngv, “Mangc maah! Yie daaih aqv. Yiem wuov sou-njunc fiev jienv yie nyei jauv-louc.”
O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Meih nyei leiz-latc yiem yie nyei hnyouv gu'nyuoz. Yie a'hneiv ei jienv meih nyei eix zoux.
Yie yiem mienh camv gapv zunv nyei dorngx zunh njoux en nyei kuv fienx. O Ziouv aah! Meih hiuv duqv yie nyei nzuih meix maiv dingh liouh nyei zunh.

Yie maiv zorqv meih tengx yie mbuo nyei njoux en bingx jienv yie nyei hnyouv. Yie gorngv meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv caux meih nyei njoux en. Yie yiem mienh camv gapv zunv nyei dorngx, maiv gem jienv meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh caux hnyouv zingx nyei jauv.
Ziouv aac, tov meih maiv dungx ngaengc jienv maiv korv-lienh yie. Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie yaac bun meih nyei zien leiz zanc-zanc beu jienv yie.

Maaih ciouv nyei zeqc naanc, zungv saauv maiv hingh, weih gormx yie, yie nyei zuiz zunc zaaic yie, taux yie mangc maiv buatc haaix nyungc. Zuiz gauh camv jiex yie nyei m'nqorngv nyei mba'biei, yie nyei mba'nziu yuqc nzengc.
O Ziouv aah! Tov meih nqoi eix njoux yie. Tov Ziouv siepv-siepv nyei tengx yie.
Tov bun oix zorqv yie nyei maengc wuov deix mienh zuqc nyaiv zuqc lunc. Tov bun dongh a'hneiv yie zuqc kouv wuov deix tuix nzuonx nqa'haav yaac zuqc baaic hmien.
Tov bun gorngv, “Haav, haav!” bun yie wuov deix zuqc nyaiv, zuqc baaic.
Tov bun yietc zungv daaih lorz meih wuov deix, njien-youh orn-lorqc. Tov bun hnamv meih nyei njoux en wuov deix, maiv dingh liouh nyei gorngv, “ Ziouv za'gengh hlo haic.”
Mv baac yie se kouv, jomc haic, tov Ziouv jangx yie. Meih se dongh tengx yie, njoux yie wuov dauh. O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov meih maiv dungx ngaih.
Maaih hnyouv jangx mienh jomc mienh, wuov dauh maaih njien-youh aqv. Zuqc kouv nyei hnoi-nyieqc Ziouv oix njoux ninh.

Ziouv beu jienv ninh, bun ninh maaih maengc ziangh. Yiem wuov norm deic-bung mienh oix heuc ninh zoux “Duqv fuqv nyei mienh.” Tov maiv dungx zorqv ninh jiu bun win-wangv sueih ganh nyei hnyouv hanc zoux.
Ninh butv baengc bueix jienv coux nyei ziangh hoc Ziouv oix goux ninh. Maaih baengc wuov zanc meih zungv oix zorc ninh longx daaih.
Yie gorngv, “O Ziouv aah! Tov korv-lienh yie, tov zorc yie longx, weic zuqc yie baamz zuiz dorngc meih.
Yie nyei win-wangv gorngv doqc yie. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Ninh taux haaix zanc cingx daic ni? Ninh nyei mbuox taux haaix zanc cingx zuqc mietc?”
Haaix dauh daaih mangc yie, kungx gorngv jaav waac hnangv. Ninh nyei hnyouv nzauz maiv benx nyei jauv. Cuotv mingh taux haaix, ninh zunh jienv mingh.
Nzorng yie wuov deix yietc zungv longc waac-sapv gorngv taux yie, ninh mbuo laaic yie duqv buangh gauh ciouv jiex nyei sic.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Ninh zuqc ciouv haic nyei baengc hoic ninh aqv. Ninh bueix jienv coux yietc liuz maiv duqv aengx jiez sin.”
Liemh yie gauh zuoqc jiex nyei loz-gaeng doic, se yie bungx hnyouv wuov dauh, dongh caux yie juangc hnaangx nyanc nyei mienh, yaac mbienv hnyouv bun yie.
O Ziouv aah! Tov meih korv-lienh yie, bun yie longx, tengx yie jiez sin daaih, haih jaauv win bun ninh mbuo.
Yie ziouc hiuv duqv meih a'hneiv yie, weic zuqc yie nyei win-wangv maiv haih hingh jiex yie.
Meih baav jienv yie weic zuqc yie hnyouv zingx, meih yaac bun yie yietc liuz yiem meih nyei nza'hmien.
Ceng Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh. Oix zuqc ceng yiem loz-hnoi taux maanc gouv maanc doic. Aamen caux Aamen.
O Tin-Hungh aac, yie nyei hnyouv ngorc meih hnangv njaih ngorc ndoqv nyei wuom-daaih nor.
Yie nyei hnyouv ngorc Tin-Hungh, se ziangh jienv nyei Tin-Hungh. Yie taux haaix zanc cingx duqv mingh buatc Tin-Hungh nyei hmien?
Yie ziangh hnoi ziangh muonz nyanc wuom-mueic dorngx hnaangx. Mienh yaac maiv dingh liouh nyei naaic yie, “Meih nyei Tin-Hungh yiem haaix?”

Yie jangx zuqc naaiv deix ziex nyungc sic yie hnyouv mun jienv yiem. Yie jangx zuqc zinh ndaangc caux mienh camv mingh. Yie dorh jienv ninh mbuo bieqc zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv. Zuangx mienh lomh nzoih jiex zipv, heuc jienv baaux nzung laengz zingh.

Yie weic haaix diuc ndongc naaiv nzauh? Yie nyei hnyouv weic haaix diuc paan-paan puoqv-puoqv nyei? Oix zuqc kaux Tin-Hungh maaih lamh hnamv dorngx weic zuqc yie aengx duqv ceng ninh, dongh njoux yie yaac zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh.
Yie nyei hnyouv za'gengh mun haic, yie ziouc yiem Jor^ndaen Deic, caux Hemon Mbong caux Misaa Mbong jangx zuqc meih.
Wuom ndortv meih nyei domh mbaengx hnangv mba'ong nor, njunh njunh nyei mbui. Ndo nyei dorngx aengv bieqc ndo nyei dorngx. Meih nyei domh wuom-laangc nqomz jiex yie gu'nguaaic.
Lungh hnoi zanc Ziouv laauc yaangh ninh ziepc zuoqv hnamv nyei jauv, lungh muonz zanc bun yie baaux ninh nyei nzung daux gaux bun yie nyei ziangh maengc nyei Tin-Hungh.
Yie gorngv mbuox yie nyei La'bieiv, se Tin-Hungh, “Meih weic haaix diuc la'kuqv yie?” Yie weic haaix diuc oix zuqc zanc-zanc nzauh nyiemv, laaix win-wangv hoic jienv yie?
Yie nyei win-wangv huotv yie hnangv zoux bun yie nyei mbungv nauv nzengc. Ninh mbuo maiv dingh liouh nyei naaic, “Meih nyei Tin-Hungh yiem haaix?”

Yie nyei hnyouv weic haaix diuc ndongc naaiv nzauh? Yie nyei hnyouv weic haaix diuc paan-paan puoqv-puoqv nyei? Oix zuqc kaux Tin-Hungh maaih lamh hnamv dorngx weic zuqc yie aengx duqv ceng ninh, dongh njoux yie yaac zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh.

O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov meih siemv bun cing yie maiv dorngc. Tov tengx yie caengx sic, bun maiv gan Tin-Hungh wuov deix guoqv nyei mienh zuqc suei. Tov njoux yie leih ndutv nduov mienh wuov deix caux maiv baengh fim nyei mienh.
Weic zuqc meih zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei Tin-Hungh. Meih weic haaix diuc guangc yie? Yie weic haaix diuc oix zuqc zanc-zanc nzauh nyiemv, laaix win-wangv hoic jienv yie?
Tov bun meih nyei njang caux zien leiz cuotv daaih yienz yie, dorh yie nzuonx taux meih nyei cing-nzengc mbong, yaac taux meih yiem nyei dorngx.
Yie ziouc mingh taux Tin-Hungh nyei ziec-dorngh, taux bun yie gauh orn-lorqc jiex nyei Tin-Hungh wuov. O Tin-Hungh, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Yie oix patv daanh baah ceng meih.

Yie nyei hnyouv weic haaix diuc ndongc naaiv nzauh? Yie nyei hnyouv weic haaix diuc paan-paan puoqv-puoqv nyei? Oix zuqc kaux Tin-Hungh maaih lamh hnamv dorngx weic zuqc yie aengx duqv ceng ninh, dongh njoux yie yaac zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh.
Tin-Hungh aah! Yie mbuo ganh nyei m'normh duqv haiz jiex, yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix mbuox jiex yie mbuo, loz-hnoi yiem ninh mbuo nyei seix zeiv meih zoux jiex hlo haic nyei sic.

Meih longc meih ganh nyei buoz zunc cuotv yiem wuov nyei norm-norm guoqv nyei mienh, yaac liepc yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix yiem wuov. Meih bun wuov deix ganh fingx zuqc kouv, mv baac bun yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix zoux bungx nqoi nyei mienh.

Weic zuqc ninh mbuo maiv zeiz weic ganh nyei nzuqc ndaauv duqv wuov norm deic-bung, yaac maiv zeiz ninh mbuo ganh nyei buoz tengx ninh mbuo duqv hingh, mv baac se weic meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz caux meih nyei hmien nyei njang-laangc, weic zuqc meih a'hneiv ninh mbuo.
Meih zoux yie nyei Hungh caux yie nyei Tin-Hungh. Tov paaiv bun Yaakopv duqv hingh.
Yie mbuo kaux meih fongv yie mbuo nyei win-wangv njiec. Yie mbuo kaux meih nyei mengh caaiv jienv caux yie mbuo mborqv jaax wuov deix.
Yie maiv kaux yie nyei juang-zinx, yie nyei nzuqc ndaauv yaac maiv haih njoux yie,
mv baac meih njoux yie mbuo leih ndutv yie mbuo nyei win-wangv, bun nzorng yie mbuo wuov deix zuqc nyaiv.
Yie mbuo ziangh hnoi weic Tin-Hungh bungx waac-maux. Yie mbuo yaac oix yietc liuz dor-ziec meih nyei mbuox.
Mv baac ih zanc meih guangc yie mbuo, bun yie mbuo zuqc suei. Meih maiv caux yie mbuo nyei zuangx jun-baeng cuotv.
Meih bun yie mbuo tuix nzuonx biaux win-wangv. Nzorng yie mbuo wuov deix win-jaa caangv yie mbuo nyei ga'naaiv.
Meih bun yie mbuo hnangv zuqc daix nyanc nyei ba'gi yungh, yaac bun yie mbuo nzaanx mingh yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx.
Meih laanh zaanc maaic meih nyei baeqc fingx hnangv maiv maaih jaax-zinh nyei ga'naaiv. Ziux maaic nyei jaax-zinh zungv maiv duqv yietc deix leic.
Meih bun yie mbuo zuqc laangz zaangc mienh ki, zuqc weih gormx nyei mienh jatv yaac mangc piex.
Meih bun yie mbuo yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx zoux gouv gorngv, yiem fingx-fingx mbu'ndongx zuqc ninh mbuo huangx m'nqorngv jatv yie mbuo.
Yie ziangh hnoi zuqc diev nyaiv, yaac zuqc baaic hmien,
laaix mienh gorngv doqc gorngv ki, yaac laaix buatc win-wangv caux jaauv win nyei mienh.
Yie mbuo zuqc naaiv deix yietc zungv sic maiv gunv yie mbuo maiv la'kuqv meih fai ngaengc meih caux yie mbuo laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Yie mbuo nyei hnyouv maiv daaux nqaang. Yie mbuo nyei zaux yaac maiv caaiv piatv meih nyei jauv.
Mv baac meih zaax jienv yie mbuo, bun yie mbuo benx hieh juv yiem nyei dorngx, bun zuqc daic nyei dongh linh gomv jienv yie mbuo.
Se gorngv yie mbuo la'kuqv yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei mbuox, fai sung yie mbuo nyei buoz cuotv zaangc nyiec nyei zienh,
Tin-Hungh maiv zeiz haih zaah cuotv naaiv deix sic fai? Weic zuqc ninh hiuv duqv mienh nyei hnyouv gem jienv nyei sic.
Weic meih yie mbuo ziangh hnoi zuqc mienh daix jienv yiem. Mienh funx yie mbuo hnangv benx oix zuqc daix nyei ba'gi yungh nor.
O Ziouv aah! Nyie daaih maah! Meih weic haaix diuc m'njormh? Jiez sin aqv, maiv dungx yietc liuz guangc yie mbuo.
Meih weic haaix diuc buang meih nyei hmien maiv mangc yie? Meih weic haaix diuc la'kuqv yie mbuo zuqc kouv naanc, zuqc seix nyei sic.
Yie mbuo zuqc mbaapv njiec taux nie-mbung, ziangh sin naetv jienv ndau-beih.
Tov meih daaih tengx yie mbuo. Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, tov njoux yie mbuo.
Yie nyei hnyouv maaih longx haic nyei jauv mienz cuotv. Yie weic hungh diex doqc naaiv diuh nzung. Yie nyei mbietc hnangv fiev nzaangc liouc nyei mienh nyei batv nor.
Beiv lungh ndiev mienh, meih gauh nzueic jiex. Meih gorngv waac mbiaangc, kuh muangx. Weic naaiv Tin-Hungh yietc liuz ceix fuqv bun meih.
Henv haic nyei hungh diex aah! Zorqv meih nyei nzuqc ndaauv tapv paiv sai jienv jaaiv. Meih zoux hlo yaac maaih njang-laangc.
Weic zien leiz caux suonc nyei jauv caux baengh fim nyei sic meih zoux hlo geh jienv maaz cuotv mingh hingh jiex. Tov bun meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz zoux cuotv mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Meih nyei forng laic, yaac yiem meih nyei hungh diex nyei win-wangv nyei mba'nziu. Fingx-fingx mienh king njiec meih nyei zaux-ndiev.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih nyei weic oix yietc liuz yiem taux maanc gouv maanc doic. Meih oix baengh fim nyei gunv meih nyei baeqc fingx.
Zoux kuv sic nyei meih hnamv, zoux orqv nyei meih nzorng. Weic naaiv, Tin-Hungh, dongh meih nyei Tin-Hungh, ginv meih daaih ceix orn-lorqc bun meih gauh camv jiex meih nyei yietc zungv doic.
Meih nyei lui ndaang haic, maaih mu^yorc caux aa^lo ndie-ndaang caux gaan^mbun nyei qiex ndaang. Yiem zaangz-nyaah zorng nyei hungh dinc mienh patv daanh baah bun meih a'hneiv.
Maaih deix hungh diex nyei sieqv yiem meih taaih nyei m'sieqv dorn mbu'ndongx. Hungh maac zorng jienv yiem Ofi daaih nyei jiem souv jienv hungh diex nyei mbiaauc maengx.
O sieqv aah! Meih oix zuqc hnamv longx yaac baeng m'normh muangx. Maiv dungx jangx meih ganh nyei mienh fai meih nyei die nyei biauv.
Weic zuqc meih nzueic haic hungh diex oix meih aqv. Ninh se meih nyei ziouv, meih ziouc oix zuqc mbuoqc ninh gunv.
Tailaqv Mienh oix daaih fungx zingh nyeic tov meih tengx. Baeqc fingx gu'nyuoz gauh butv zoih jiex nyei mienh oix longc nyungc-nyungc jaaix nyei ga'naaiv bun meih a'hneiv.
Hungh sieqv yiem gu'nyuoz zorng jienv njang-laangc haic. Ninh nyei zorng-zuqv longc jiem-finx zorpc jienv ndatv daaih.

Ninh zuqv jienv longc ziex nyungc setv congx daaih nyei lui-ndaauv, mienh ziouc dorh ninh mingh taux hungh diex wuov. Mbienz doic wuov deix maiv bueix jiex dorn nyei sieqv-dorn doic yaac gan jienv ninh mingh hungh diex nyei nza'hmien.
Mienh dorh ninh mbuo njien-youh orn-lorqc nyei bieqc hungh diex nyei dinc.
Meih oix duqv dorn camv nzipc jienv meih nyei ong-taaix nyei weic, meih oix liepc ninh mbuo gunv gormx deic-bung.
Yie nyei nzung oix bun doic jiex doic ceng meih nyei mengh. Zuangx mienh ziouc yietc liuz ceng meih taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Tin-Hungh zoux yie mbuo ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx yaac zoux yie mbuo nyei qaqv. Yie mbuo haaix zanc buangh zuqc kouv naanc ninh yaac tengx.
Weic naaiv, yie mbuo maiv gamh nziex maiv gunv lungh ndiev goiv yienc, mbong yaac dongz, ndortv njiec taux koiv-ndoqv,
maiv gunv wuom jiez laangc njunh njunh zoz-zoz nyei, zungv ndanc zuqc mbong dongz.
Maaih diuh ndaaih bun njiec nyei ndoqv liouc mingh bun Tin-Hungh nyei zingh a'hneiv. Naaiv norm zingh se Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh nyei dinc.
Tin-Hungh yiem naaiv norm zingh gu'nyuoz, zingh ziouc maiv zuqc ndanc dongz, lungh ndorm yietv njang Tin-Hungh oix tengx naaiv norm zingh.
Maanc fingx mbiouh mbiouh nyei lunc nzengc, maanc guoqv dongz nzengc, Tin-Hungh heuc cuotv qiex, ndau-beih yuqc nzengc.
Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv caux yie mbuo yiem. Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh zoux yie mbuo ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx.
Daaih maah! Daaih mangc Ziouv zoux nyei sic. Mangc gaax ninh hnangv haaix nor zoux bun ndau huaang nzengc.
Ninh bun mborqv jaax nyei jauv dingh taux jomc lungh ndiev, wuotv nauv juang-zinx, bun cang muonc nzengc, longc douz buov mborqv jaax cie.
Dingh njiec aqv, yaac hiuv duqv yie se Tin-Hungh. Yie yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx duqv mienh taaih. Yiem gormx lungh ndiev yie yaac duqv mienh taaih.
Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv caux yie mbuo yiem. Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh zoux yie mbuo ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx.
Maanc fingx mienh aah! Oix zuqc mbaix buoz longc njien-youh nyei qiex heuc Tin-Hungh.
Oix zuqc gamh nziex Ziouv, dongh Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh. Ninh zoux domh Hungh Diex gunv gormx lungh ndiev.
Ninh bun maanc fingx yiem yie mbuo nyei buoz-ndiev. Bun maanc guoqv yiem yie mbuo nyei zaux-ndiev.
Ninh weic yie mbuo ginv yie mbuo nzipc nyei buonc. Se Yaakopv, dongh ninh hnamv wuov dauh, a'hneiv nyei buonc.
Mienh heuc mbui houc Tin-Hungh faaux weic. Nzatc nyei qiex mbui houc Ziouv faaux.
Oix zuqc baaux nzung ceng Tin-Hungh, baaux nzung ceng. Oix zuqc baaux nzung ceng yie mbuo nyei Hungh Diex, baaux nzung ceng maah!
Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh zoux Hungh gunv gormx lungh ndiev, oix zuqc baaux diuh singx nzung ceng ninh.
Tin-Hungh gunv maanc guoqv. Tin-Hungh zueiz jienv ninh nyei cing-nzengc weic.
Gunv maanc guoqv nyei jien gapv zunv caux jienv Apc^laa^ham nyei Tin-Hungh nyei baeqc fingx. Weic zuqc lungh ndiev nyei torngv-baaih benx Tin-Hungh nyei. Oix zuqc taaih ninh zoux hlo jiex.
Ziouv za'gengh weih hlo, yaac puix duqv mienh camv-camv nyei ceng yiem yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei zingh, se yiem ninh nyei cing-nzengc mbong.
Mangc naaiv norm mbong youc hlang youc nzueic, bun lungh ndiev nyei zuangx mienh njien-youh. Se Domh Hungh Diex nyei zingh, Si^on Mbong, yiem baqv bung go nyei dorngx,
Tin-Hungh yiem zingh gu'nyuoz yietc norm wuonv nyei dorngx, bun cing ninh ganh benx wuonv nyei dorngx.
Mangc maah! Zuangx hungh diex gapv zunv daaih, lomh nzoih cuotv mingh oix mborqv naaiv norm zingh.
Ninh mbuo yietv buatc naaiv norm zingh ninh mbuo mbuoqc horngh haic. Gamh nziex gau, huaang-huaang zaang-zaang nyei biaux.
Ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic, sin zinx nzengc, kouv gau, hnangv m'sieqv dorn mun gu'nguaaz nor,
yaac hnangv Taansitv nyei nzangv zuqc dong bung nyei domh nziaaux buonc waaic.

Yie mbuo haiz jiex hnangv haaix nor, ih zanc yie mbuo buatc hnangv wuov nor, yiem Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv nyei zingh, se yiem yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei zingh. Naaiv norm zingh Tin-Hungh liepc taux yietc liuz.
O Tin-Hungh aac, yie mbuo yiem meih nyei biauv jangx zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
O Tin-Hungh aac, hnangv meih nyei mengh zunh jomc lungh ndiev, mienh yaac hnangv wuov nor ceng meih taux lungh gorn. Meih longc baengh fim nyei jauv gunv.
Tov bun Si^on Mbong nyei mienh a'hneiv, bun Yu^ndaa Zingh nyei mienh njien-youh, weic zuqc meih baengh fim nyei siemv.
Yangh gormx Si^on maah! Huing gormx nzengc. Saauv zingh nyei laauh.
Samx mangc zingh nyei zingh laatc, zaah mangc zingh wuonv jiex nyei dorngx, weic gorngv mbuox hoz doic mienh.
Weic zuqc naaiv dauh Tin-Hungh, se yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh taux maanc gouv maanc doic. Ninh yietc liuz yietc seix dorh yie mbuo.
Maanc mienh aah! Muangx naaiv deix waac oc. Lungh ndiev mienh aah! Oix zuqc baeng m'normh muangx,
maiv gunv zoux hlo zoux faix, butv zoih fai mienh jomc mienh.
Yie nyei nzuih oix gorngv cong-mengh nyei waac. Yie nyei hnyouv hnamv duqv tong, oix gorngv cuotv mengh nyei.
Yie oix bungx m'normh muangx waac-beiv, yie oix patv daanh baah porv mengh eix leiz.
Buangh zuqc kouv naanc nyei ziangh hoc yie maiv gamh nziex, dongh zoux doqc hoic yie wuov deix win-wangv, weih gormx yie.
Se kaux ninh mbuo nyei zinh zoih yaac bungx waac-maux gorngv zinh zoih camv nyei mienh.
Maiv maaih haaix dauh haih zuoqc ninh nyei gorx-youz nzuonx, fai tengx ninh cuotv zuoqc nyei jaax-zinh bun Tin-Hungh,
weic zuqc yietc diuh maengc se jaaix haic. Bun mbu'ziex yaac maiv haih gaux,
weic bun ninh yietc liuz ziangh jienv, maiv zuqc mingh yiem yiemh gen.
Ninh buatc cong-mengh mienh fih hnangv nyei daic, hngongx caux maiv hiuv nyei mienh yaac daic, guangc ninh mbuo nyei zinh zoih bun ganh dauh.

Ninh mbuo nyei zouv benx ninh mbuo yietc liuz yiem nyei biauv, dongh ninh mbuo yiem nyei dorngx taux maanc gouv maanc doic. Maiv gunv ninh mbuo longc ninh mbuo ganh nyei mbuox cuotv bun ninh mbuo nyei ndau.
Mienh butv zoih mv baac maiv tengx ninh mbuo maiv zuqc daic. Ninh ziouc hnangv saeng-kuv zuqc mietc mi'aqv.
Naaiv se kaux ganh hngongx nyei jauv nyei mienh, caux gan jienv ninh mbuo, a'hneiv ninh mbuo gorngv nyei waac wuov deix oix zuqc buangh nyei sic.

Ninh mbuo hnangv dingc ziangx daix nyei ba'gi yungh. Zuqc daic nyei qaqv yaac oix zoux ninh mbuo goux yungh nyei mienh. Taux lungh ndorm kuv mienh oix gunv jienv ninh mbuo. Ninh mbuo nyei sin oix huv jienv njiec. Yiemh gen yaac oix zoux ninh mbuo nyei biauv.
Mv baac Tin-Hungh oix njoux yie nyei maengc leih ndutv yiemh gen nyei qaqv, weic zuqc ninh oix zipv yie.
Meih buatc mienh butv zoih, benx jienv faaux, maiv dungx gamh nziex,
weic zuqc ninh daic nyei ziangh hoc ninh maiv haih dorh haaix nyungc mingh, ninh nyei njang-laangc maiv haih gan ninh njiec mingh.
Maiv gunv ninh ziangh jienv nyei ziangh hoc, ninh funx ninh maaih orn-lorqc, yaac maiv gunv maaih mienh ceng weic zuqc ninh butv zoih jienv faaux,
ninh oix zuqc guei seix hnangv ninh nyei ong-taaix mbuo nor, yietc liuz maiv duqv buatc njang.
Mienh butv zoih mv baac maiv tengx ninh maiv zuqc daic. Ninh m'daaih caux saeng-kuv fih hnangv nyei zuqc mietc mi'aqv.
Ziouv, Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh, gorngv. Ninh gorngv heuc lungh ndiev yiem mba'hnoi cuotv taux mba'hnoi muotv nyei dorngx.
Yiem gauh nzueic jiex nyei Si^on Zingh, Tin-Hungh ziux cuotv ninh nyei njang.
Yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh daaih, ninh yaac maiv zeiz sekv-sekv nyei, maaih douz yiem ninh wuov ndaangc maengx buov qui nzengc, maaih domh nziaaux-jieqv weih gormx ninh.
Ninh heuc lungh caux ndau zoux zorng-zengx, weic ninh oix siemv ninh nyei baeqc fingx.
Ninh gorngv, “Dorh yie ziepc zuoqv nyei baeqc fingx daaih yie naaiv, dongh longc ziec nyei ga'naaiv caux yie liepc jiez ngaengc waac nyei mienh.”
Zuangx lungh bun cing Tin-Hungh se baengh fim nyei, weic zuqc ninh se siemv zuiz jien.
“O yie nyei baeqc fingx aah! Muangx maah! Yie ziouc gorngv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh aah! Yie oix zoux zorng-zengx gox meih mbuo aqv. Yie se Tin-Hungh, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.
Yie maiv zeiz weic meih mbuo ziec nyei ga'naaiv gorngv-hemx meih mbuo. Meih mbuo buov ziec bun yie nyei ga'naaiv zanc-zanc yiem yie nyei nza'hmien.
Yie maiv qiemx zuqc yietc dauh yiem meih mbuo nyei ngongh laanh nyei ngongh gouv, fai yiem meih mbuo nyei yungh guanh nyei yungh gouv.
Weic zuqc yiem lomc nyei yietc zungv hieh zoih benx yie nyei, liemh yietc cin norm mbong nyei saeng-kuv yaac benx yie nyei.
Yiem lungh nyei yietc zungv norqc yie yaac hiuv nyei, yiem ndau maaih maengc nyei ga'naaiv benx nzengc yie nyei.
Se gorngv yie hnyouv sie, yie maiv mbuox meih, weic zuqc baamh gen caux yiem baamh gen nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv benx yie nyei.
Yie nyanc ngongh nyei orv fai? Yie hopv yungh nyei nziaamv fai?
Oix zuqc longc dor-ziec nyei waac benx fongc horc ziec bun Tin-Hungh nyei ga'naaiv, yaac jaauv sung meih caux Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Buangh zuqc kouv naanc nyei ziangh hoc oix zuqc tov yie. Yie ziouc njoux meih, meih yaac oix taaih yie.
Mv baac Tin-Hungh gorngv mbuox orqv mienh, “Meih maaih haaix nyungc leiz zunh gorngv yie nyei leiz-nyeic, fai bun meih nyei nzuih laengz yie nyei ngaengc waac?
Meih nzorng yie mborqv njaaux nyei waac, yaac zorqv yie nyei waac zoi guangc meih nyei nqa'haav nqaang.
Se gorngv meih buatc dauh janx-zaqc, meih a'hneiv caux ninh zoux doic. Meih yaac caux hienx auv hienx nqox nyei mienh zoux doic.
Meih nyei nzuih sueih gorngv orqv nyei waac, meih nyei mbietc hec duqv gorngv-baeqc.
Meih zueiz jienv sueih binc gorngv ganh nyei muoz-doic, yaac gorngv waac-huv hoic cien maa nyei fu'jueiv.
Meih zoux naaiv deix sic, yie yaac maiv ko lo. Meih hnamv daaih yie hnangv meih nor, mv baac ih zanc yie oix hemx meih, zorqv naaiv deix sic baaiv jienv meih nyei nza'hmien.
“Meih mbuo la'kuqv Tin-Hungh nyei mienh aah! Longx-longx nyei hnamv mangc gaax! Maiv zei aeqv, yie oix zorqv meih mbuo mietc nzengc, yaac maiv maaih mienh haih njoux.
Haaix dauh dor-ziec weic zoux fongc horc ziec nyei ga'naaiv bun yie, wuov dauh taaih yie. Haaix dauh liepc dingc hnyouv yangh horpc nyei jauv, yie oix bun ninh duqv Tin-Hungh nyei njoux en.
Tin-Hungh aah! Tov meih korv-lienh yie, ziux meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh. Ziux meih ndongc naaic korv-lienh mienh, tov sortv guangc yie zoux dorngc nyei zuiz.
Tov meih nzaaux nzengc yie nyei zuiz-nipc, tov saax nzengc zuiz bun yie cing-nzengc daaih.
Yie zieqv duqv yie zoux dorngc nyei sic, yaac zanc-zanc jangx zuqc yie nyei zuiz.
Yie baamz zuiz dorngc meih, kungx dorngc meih hnangv, yaac ziux meih buatc, yie zoux orqv sic. Weic naaiv meih dingc yie nyei zuiz se baengh fim nyei, meih dunx yie nyei sic yaac dunx duqv horpc.
Yie cuotv seix daaih benx zuiz-mienh, yiem maa nyei ga'sie wuov zanc zungv maaih jienv zuiz.
Meih oix nyei se mienh hnyouv zingx, weic naaiv tov meih njaaux yie, bun yie maaih cong-mengh yiem hnyouv ndo nyei dorngx.
Tov longc husopc miev saax yie, yie ziouc cing-nzengc daaih. Tov nzaaux yie, yie ziouc gauh baeqc jiex sorng.
Tov bun yie aengx muangx duqv haiz njien-youh, a'hneiv nyei qiex. Maiv gunv meih bun yie zuqc kouv, tov bun yie aengx maaih orn-lorqc.
Tov meih buang jienv hmien, maiv dungx mangc yie nyei zuiz, yaac tov sortv guangc yie zoux nyei yietc zungv zuiz-nipc.
Tin-Hungh aah! Tov yiem yie gu'nyuoz zeix cing-nzengc nyei hnyouv, yaac bun yie maaih ziepc zuoqv nyei siang-hnyouv.
Maiv dungx zunc yie biaux, leih nqoi meih nyei nza'hmien, yaac maiv dungx zorqv yiem yie nyei Singx Lingh cuotv.
Tov bun yie duqv meih nyei njoux en nyei njien-youh hnangv loz nor. Yaac bun yie maaih hnyouv oix gan longx meih.
Yie ziouc zorqv meih nyei jauv njaaux zuiz-mienh, ninh mbuo zungv oix nzuonx daaih lorz meih.
O Tin-Hungh aac, meih zoux njoux yie wuov dauh Tin-Hungh. Tov njoux yie leih ndutv daix mienh nyei zuiz. Yie nyei mbietc ziouc baaux nzung gorngv meih se baengh fim nyei.
O Ziouv aac, tov tengx yie nyei nzuih haih gorngv waac, yie ziouc longc yie nyei nzuih ceng meih.
Meih maiv zeiz a'hneiv fongc horc ziec nyei ga'naaiv. Se gorngv yie fongc horc buov ziec ga'naaiv, meih yaac maiv horpc hnyouv.
Tin-Hungh oix nyei ga'naaiv-ziec se mienh hnyouv mun, hiuv duqv ganh zoux dorngc. O Tin-Hungh aac, hnyouv mun, hiuv duqv ganh zoux dorngc nyei mienh, meih maiv mangc piex.
Tov ziux meih nyei kuv za'eix bun Si^on Zingh duqv longx. Tov ceix jiez Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei zingh laatc.
Wuov zanc meih ziouc a'hneiv mienh ziec duqv horpc nyei ga'naaiv, caux buov ziec caux ziangh dauh buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv. Mienh yaac oix zorqv ngongh gouv an meih nyei ziec-dorngh gu'nguaaic buov.
Mienh henv mienh aah! Meih weic haaix diuc bungx waac-maux meih zoux nyei orqv sic? Tin-Hungh ziangh hnoi ziangh muonz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Meih daav za'eix mietc mienh. Meih nyei mbietc hnangv teix-do nor laic, kungx longc weic gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh hnangv.
Meih hnamv orqv sic gauh camv kuv sic, hnamv gorngv-baeqc nyei waac gauh camv gorngv zien leiz.
O meih gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh nyei mbietc aah! Meih hnamv yietc zungv hoic mienh nyei waac.

Mv baac Tin-Hungh oix bun meih zuqc mietc taux yietc liuz. Ninh oix zorqv meih yiem ndopv-liuh gu'nyuoz ciev cuotv daaih. Ninh oix yiem yaangh gen baeng meih cuotv hnangv liemh nzungh baeng cuotv nor.
Kuv mienh duqv buatc yaac gamh nziex. Ninh mbuo oix jatv ninh yaac gorngv,
mangc maah! Maiv ndaauh kaux Tin-Hungh nyei mienh, kungx kaux ganh bungx-zuoqc nyei zinh zoih, yaac bangc zoux waaic nyei jauv liepc ganh wuonv.
Mv baac yie se hnangv zungh ga'lanv ndiangx nyiemz yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv gu'nyuoz. Yie kaux Tin-Hungh, dongh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Yie oix dor-ziec meih taux yietc liuz weic meih zoux nyei sic. Yie oix dorng jienv meih nyei baeqc fingx zunh meih nyei mengh, weic zuqc meih nyei mengh se longx haic.
Mienh hngongx mienh yiem hnyouv gorngv, “Maiv maaih Tin-Hungh lorqc.” Ninh mbuo waaic haic, zoux gamh nziev haic nyei zuiz, maiv maaih yietc dauh zoux longx.
Tin-Hungh yiem tin-dorngh mangc njiec, mangc baamh mienh. Oix mangc gaax, maaih haaix dauh maaih cong-mengh, maaih haaix dauh lorz Tin-Hungh.
Mouz dauh mienh tuix nqaang, dauh dauh fih hnangv nyei waaic nzengc. Maiv maaih haaix dauh zoux longx, yietc dauh yaac maiv maaih.
Zoux orqv nyei mienh maiv hiuv haaix nyungc fai? Ninh mbuo naqv yie nyei baeqc fingx hnangv ninh mbuo nyanc hnaangx nor. Ninh mbuo yaac maiv tov Tin-Hungh.

Ninh mbuo yiem wuov za'gengh! gamh nziex haic. Maiv maaih jiex ndongc naaiv gamh nziex. Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh oix zorqv dongh liepc ciangv daaih mborqv meih wuov deix mienh nyei mbungv faatv nzaanx nzengc. Meih oix bun ninh mbuo zuqc nyaiv weic zuqc Tin-Hungh nqemh ninh mbuo.

Tov bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei njoux en yiem Si^on cuotv. Tin-Hungh bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx nzuonx daaih duqv longx hnangv zinh ndaangc wuov zanc, Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun ziouc maaih orn-lorqc, I^saa^laa^en Mienh oix njien-youh.
Tin-Hungh aah! Tov longc meih nyei mengh njoux yie. Tov longc meih nyei domh qaqv bun cing yie maiv dorngc.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov meih muangx yie daux gaux, muangx haiz yie nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac.
Weic zuqc maaih deix ceng-hlo nyei mienh cuotv daaih mborqv yie. Mienh doqc mienh oix zorqv yie nyei maengc. Ninh mbuo yaac maiv gamh nziex Tin-Hungh.
Tin-Hungh se dongh tengx yie wuov dauh. Ziouv yaac baav jienv yie nyei maengc.
Tov Tin-Hungh ziux win-wangv zoux nyei orqv sic winh bun ninh mbuo. Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei, tov mietc ninh mbuo.
Yie oix cuotv fim zorqv fongc horc ziec nyei ga'naaiv bun meih. O Ziouv aac, yie oix ceng meih nyei mengh, weic zuqc meih nyei mengh se longx haic.
Meih njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei yietc zungv kouv naanc. Yie ganh nyei m'zing yaac buatc jienv yie nyei win-wangv zuqc suei.
Tin-Hungh aah! Tov baeng m'normh muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac. Maiv dungx bingx, maiv muangx yie tov nyei waac.
Tov muangx yie yaac dau yie oc. Yie hnyouv faanv lunc nzengc.
Weic haiz win-wangv nyei qiex, yaac weic orqv mienh zeix yie, weic zuqc ninh mbuo zorqv zeqc naanc jaa bun yie, ninh mbuo qiex jiez, nzorng yie.
Yie nyei hnyouv gu'nyuoz za'gengh! mun haic. Zuqc daic nyei jauv haeqv yie gamh nziex gau.
Yie gengh! gamh nziex, sin zinx nyanh nyanh nyei. Gamh nziex gau, siangx cuotv hanc-namx nyei.
Yie gorngv, “Feix duqv yie maaih ndaatv hnangv baeqc gopv nor, yie ziouc ndaix mingh lorz dorngx hitv.
Yie oix youh jienv mingh go nyei dorngx, mingh yiem wuov deic-bung-huaang.
Yie oix gaanv jienv lorz dorngx bingx, biaux ndutv domh nziaaux-jieqv caux mbiungc.”
O Ziouv aah! Tov bun ninh mbuo nyei za'eix waaic aengx bun ninh mbuo nyei waac lunc nzengc, weic zuqc yie buatc yiem zingh gu'nyuoz maaih qangv maanh zoux doqc nyei sic.
Ninh mbuo ziangh hnoi ziangh muonz yiem zingh laatc gu'nguaaic youh jienv mingh huing gormx. Yiem zingh gu'nyuoz maaih baamz zuiz nyei sic caux waaic sic buangv nzengc.
Yiem zingh gu'nyuoz maaih zoux waaic nyei jauv. Hei zaangc maaih hoic mienh, pienx mienh nyei sic buangv nzengc.
Se maiv zeiz win-wangv jatv yie. Hnangv naaic yie diev duqv nyei. Yaac maiv zeiz nzorng yie nyei mienh ceng-hlo cuoqv yie. Hnangv naaic yie haih bingx ninh.
Mv baac se meih, dongh caux yie wuov horngh mienh, se caux yie zoux doic mienh, zuoqc haic nyei loz-gaeng doic.
Zinh ndaangc yie mbuo laanh caux laanh gorngv waac zuoqc haic, yie mbuo caux mienh camv yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv yangh jiex mingh jiex daaih.

Ninh mbuo jangx maiv zaaic nyei ziangh hoc tov bun ninh mbuo zuqc mietc. Bun ninh mbuo liemh nangh nyei zuqc njiec mingh yiem yiemh gen, weic zuqc ninh mbuo nyei biauv gu'nyuoz caux ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv orqv haic.
Mv baac yie jouh Tin-Hungh, Ziouv zungv oix njoux yie.
Maiv gunv lungh ndorm lungh muonz fai lungh aanx yie njunh jienv gorngv yie kouv nyei jauv, ninh zungv muangx haiz yie nyei qiex.
Ninh njoux yie nyei maengc leih ndutv caux yie mborqv jaax nyei mienh, bun yie duqv baengh orn, weic zuqc caux yie mborqv jaax wuov deix camv haic.

Tin-Hungh, dongh yiem loz-hnoi zueiz jienv weic gunv wuov dauh, oix baeng m'normh muangx yie aengx zatv ninh mbuo njiec, weic zuqc ninh mbuo maiv kangv goiv hnyouv yienc eix, yaac maiv gamh nziex Tin-Hungh.
Caux yie zoux doic nyei mienh sung ninh nyei buoz mborqv ninh nyei loz-gaeng doic, yaac baamz ninh laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Ninh nyei nzuih gauh mbiaangc jiex ngongh nyorx hmei, mv baac hnyouv gu'nyuoz mborqv jienv jaax yiem. Ninh nyei waac gauh mau jiex hmei, mv baac hnangv baeng cuotv daaih nyei nzuqc ndaauv nor.
Zorqv meih nyei kouv naanc fungx bun Ziouv, ninh zungv oix baav jienv meih. Ninh yietc liuz maiv bun kuv mienh zuqc ndanc dongz.

Mv baac Tin-Hungh aah! Meih oix zorqv orqv mienh zoi njiec taux yiemh gen. Daix mienh nyei mienh caux maaic mienh nyei mienh zungv maiv ziangh taux ndaamv-seix. Mv baac yie ganh aeqv, yie oix kaux meih.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov korv-lienh yie, weic zuqc mienh caaiv yie. Ninh mbuo ziangh hnoi mborqv yie, zeix yie.
Yie nyei win-wangv ziangh hnoi ki yie, weic zuqc ceng-hlo, mborqv yie nyei mienh camv haic.
Yie gamh nziex nyei ziangh hoc yie kaux meih.
Yie kaux Tin-Hungh, dongh yie ceng ninh nyei waac wuov dauh, yie kaux Tin-Hungh, yie zungv maiv gamh nziex. Baamh mienh haih zoux haaix nyungc bun yie?
Ninh mbuo ziangh hnoi mbienv yie nyei waac. Ninh mbuo hnamv nyei jauv yietc zungv kungx oix hoic yie hnangv.
Ninh mbuo gapv zunv bingx jienv cienh mangc yie zoux nyei nyungc-nyungc jauv, zuov jienv oix zorqv yie nyei maengc.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov dingc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz weic ninh mbuo zoux nyei orqv sic. Tov meih qiex jiez jienv bun wuov deix zuangx mienh zuqc baaic njiec.
Yie buangh nyei kuonx naanh meih saauv jienv. Yie nyei wuom-mueic meih yaac dapv jienv meih nyei ndopv-mbuoqc. Naaiv maiv zeiz fiev jienv meih nyei sou-daan fai?
Yie heuc jienv tov nyei hnoi-nyieqc, yie nyei win-wangv oix tuix nzuonx nqa'haav. Yie hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh za'gengh oix tengx yie.
Yie kaux Tin-Hungh, dongh yie ceng ninh nyei waac. Yie kaux Ziouv, dongh yie ceng ninh nyei waac wuov dauh.
Yie kaux Tin-Hungh zungv maiv gamh nziex. Baamh mienh haih zoux haaix nyungc bun yie?
O Tin-Hungh aah! Yie oix zuqc jaauv sung yie caux meih laengz nyei ngaengc waac. Yie oix zorqv ziec weic laengz zingh nyei ga'naaiv fongc horc bun meih.
Weic zuqc meih njoux yie nyei maengc biaux ndutv zuqc daic nyei jauv, yaac bun yie nyei zaux maiv zuqc ndorpc, weic bun yie yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien, maaih ziangh maengc nyei njang ziux jienv.
Tin-Hungh aah! Tov korv-lienh yie. Tov! korv-lienh yie maah! Weic zuqc yie ndaauh kaux meih. Yie ndaauh kaux meih, yiem meih nyei ndaatv-ndiev nyei dongh linh zuov domh zeqc naanc jiex nzengc.
Yie heuc Yiem Hlang Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh, se weic yie zoux ziangx nyungc-nyungc sic nyei Tin-Hungh.
Ninh oix yiem gu'nguaaic lungh dau yie, njoux yie. Ninh oix bun zeix yie wuov deix zuqc nyaiv. Tin-Hungh oix bun cing ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie yaac zoux hnyouv zingx.
Yie bueix jienv sienh mbu'ndongx, se naqv baamh mienh nyei sienh. Ninh mbuo nyei nyaah se hnangv cang caux forng nor. Ninh mbuo nyei mbietc yaac hnangv nzuqc ndaauv nor laic.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov bun mienh taaih meih gauh hlang jiex lungh. Tov bun meih nyei njang-laangc yiem buangv lungh ndiev.
Ninh mbuo zaeng mungz yie nyei zaux caaiv nyei dorngx. Yie zuqc naanc zingh ngatv jienv yie nyei hnyouv. Ninh mbuo wetv kuotv yie yangh nyei jauv, mv baac ninh mbuo ganh ndortv njiec.
O Tin-Hungh aac, yie nyei hnyouv kaux wuonv. Yie nyei hnyouv kaux wuonv. Yie oix baaux nzung, oix baaux nzung ceng meih.
Yie nyei hnyouv aah! Nyie daaih maah! Domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah aah! Nyie daaih maah! Yie oix bun mba'hnoi nyie daaih.
O Ziouv aac, yie oix yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx dor-ziec meih, yie oix yiem maanc guoqv mbu'ndongx baaux nzung ceng meih.
Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh mbaengc lungh hlang. Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv yaac mbaengc mbuonx hlang.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov bun mienh taaih meih gauh hlang jiex lungh. Tov bun meih nyei njang-laangc yiem buangv lungh ndiev.
Meih mbuo zoux hlo nyei mienh aah! Meih mbuo baengh fim nyei gorngv fai? Meih mbuo hnyouv zingx nyei siemv baamh mienh fai?
Zungv maiv zeiz! Meih mbuo nyei hnyouv kungx hnamv zoux orqv nyei sic hnangv. Meih mbuo yiem ndau-beih longc buoz zoux cuotv doqc haic nyei sic.
Zoux orqv nyei mienh cuotv seix daaih m'daaih yangh orqv nyei jauv. Yiem ninh mbuo cuotv seix daaih ninh mbuo kungx gorngv-baeqc hnangv.
Ninh mbuo nyei doqc qiex hnangv naang nyei ndie-doqc. Ninh mbuo zotv jienv m'normh hnangv m'normh ndung nyei naang-jieqv,
ninh mbuo ziouc muangx maiv haiz zoux faatv bun naang hngongx nyei mienh nyei qiex maiv gunv zoux faatv ndongc haaix guv guaix.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov mborqv nquaqv ninh mbuo nyei nzuih nyei nyaah. O Ziouv aac, tov baeng naaiv deix sienh lunx nyei nyaah ngau cuotv.
Tov bun ninh mbuo zutc nzengc hnangv wuom liouc mingh nzengc nor. Ninh mbuo baeng jienv juang-zinx oix buonv wuov zanc, tov bun ninh mbuo nyei forng-cang nauv ndutv.
Tov bun ninh mbuo hnangv korng gueiv manc-manc huv yuqc nzengc. Yaac bun ninh mbuo hnangv gu'nguaaz-mbaang nor, maiv duqv buatc mba'hnoi.
Longc njimv buov douz, maiv gunv njimv nyiemz fai nqaai, caeng zungv maiv gaengh haiz jorm, ninh ziouc guaatv orqv mienh mingh nzengc mi'aqv.
Kuv mienh buatc orqv mienh zuqc jaauv win, ninh mbuo a'hneiv. Ninh mbuo yaac longc orqv mienh nyei nziaamv nzaaux zaux.
Mienh ziouc gorngv, “Kuv mienh ndongc haaix zungv oix duqv zingh nyeic. Ndongc haaix zungv maaih dauh Tin-Hungh siemv lungh ndiev.”
Yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei win-wangv. Tov beu yie biaux ndutv oix mborqv yie wuov deix mienh.
Njoux yie biaux ndutv zoux orqv sic wuov deix, se njoux yie biaux ndutv daix mienh nyei mienh.
Mangc maah! Ninh mbuo bingx jienv zuov oix zorqv yie nyei maengc. Ciouv nyei mienh gapv zunv oix mborqv yie. O Ziouv aah! Maiv zeiz weic yie zoux dorngc fai yie zoux nyei haaix nyungc zuiz,
maiv gunv yie maiv zoux haaix nyungc dorngc, ninh mbuo tiux daaih liuc leiz mborqv yie. Tov gaanv daaih tengx yie. Tov daaih mangc maah!
Ziouv, Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh, zoux I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh. Tov jiez daaih dingc maanc fingx nyei zuiz. Maiv dungx korv-lienh daav orqv za'eix nyei mienh.
Ninh mbuo hnoi-hnoi lungh maanz-hmuangx nzuonx daaih, hnangv juv nor njunh, yaac saau gormx zingh gu'nyuoz.
Ninh mbuo nyei nzuih qaqv gorngv maiv benx nyei waac. Ninh mbuo hnangv maaih nzuqc ndaauv yiem ninh mbuo nyei nzuih meix, weic zuqc ninh mbuo hnamv, “Haaix dauh haih muangx haiz yie mbuo?”
Mv baac Ziouv aah! Meih jatv ninh mbuo. Meih huotv maanc fingx.
Meih zoux yie nyei Qaqv. Yie zuov jienv meih. O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih zoux yie wuonv haic nyei dorngx.
Yie nyei Tin-Hungh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie, oix daaih tengx yie. Yie nyei Tin-Hungh oix bun yie duqv buatc yie nyei win-wangv suei.
O Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei torngv-baaih aah! Maiv dungx daix ninh mbuo. Nziex yie nyei baeqc fingx haih la'kuqv. Tov longc meih nyei qaqv bun ninh mbuo faatv nzaanx, bun ninh mbuo zuqc baaic.
Laaix ninh mbuo nyei nzuih nyei zuiz, caux ninh mbuo nyei nzuih meix gorngv nyei waac, tov bun ninh mbuo zoux maux nyei sic benx hlaang hlopv ninh mbuo. Laaix ninh mbuo zioux caux gorngv-baeqc,
tov meih qiex jiez, bun ninh mbuo zuqc mietc, mietc taux ninh mbuo zutc nzengc. Zuangx mienh ziouc hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh gunv I^saa^laa^en Mienh, zungv gunv taux jomc lungh gorn.
Ninh mbuo hnoi-hnoi lungh maanz-hmuangx nzuonx daaih, hnangv juv nor njunh, yaac saau gormx zingh gu'nyuoz.
Ninh mbuo hnangv juv nor, saau jienv mingh lorz hnaangx nyanc. Se gorngv maiv duqv nyanc beuv ninh ziangh muonz njunh.

Mv baac yie oix baaux nzung ceng meih nyei qaqv. Lungh ndorm yie oix baaux nzung mbui nyei ceng meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh. Weic zuqc meih zoux yie wuonv haic nyei dorngx, yie zuqc zeqc naanc nyei hnoi-nyieqc meih zoux yie kaux nyei dorngx.
O yie nyei Qaqv aah! Yie oix baaux nzung ceng meih. O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih zoux yie wuonv nyei laauh, dongh bun cing meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie wuov dauh Tin-Hungh.
Tin-Hungh aah! Meih guangc yie mbuo, mborqv baaic yie mbuo mi'aqv. Meih qiex jiez yie mbuo, tov bun yie mbuo nzuonx daaih hnangv loz wuov nor.
Meih bun ndau dongz, mbaaix nqoi mi'aqv. Tov zorc mbaaix nyei dorngx weic zuqc ndau lungh lungh laih laih nyei.
Meih bun meih nyei baeqc fingx zuqc diev kouv. Meih bun yie mbuo hopv diuv nquin, yangh jauv lingh lingh king-king nyei.
Meih cie jienv geh bun taaih meih wuov deix mienh daaih gapv zunv leih buonv juang-zinx nyei mienh.
Tov dau yie mbuo, longc meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz njoux yie mbuo, tengx meih hnamv nyei mienh duqv njoux.
Tin-Hungh yiem ninh nyei singx dinc gorngv, “Yie oix a'hneiv nyei zorqv Sekem bun nqoi, yaac ndorqc Sukc^kotv Horngz paaiv bun nqoi.
Gi^le^aatc se yie nyei, Maa^natv^se yaac yie nyei. E^faa^im se yie mborqv jaax nyei muoc. Yu^ndaa se yie nyei hungh biaav.
Mo^apc se yie nyei nzaaux buoz-zaux bunh. Yie yaac zoi yie nyei heh njiec E^ndom. Yie heuc jienv gorngv, ‘Fi^li^saa^die aah! Yie hingh jiex meih aqv.’+”
Haaix dauh oix dorh yie mingh taux wuov norm weih wuonv nyei zingh? Haaix dauh oix dorh yie mingh taux E^ndom Deic-Bung?
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih maiv zeiz guangc yie mbuo fai? O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih maiv caux yie mbuo nyei jun-baeng guanh cuotv mingh mborqv jaax fai?
Tov meih tengx yie mbuo mborqv win-wangv, weic zuqc baamh mienh tengx se maiv lamh longc.
Yie mbuo kaux Tin-Hungh yie mbuo ziouc duqv hingh jiex. Se dongh ninh oix caaiv yie mbuo nyei win-wangv njiec.
Tin-Hungh aah! Tov muangx yie heuc nyei qiex. Tov muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac.
Yie nyei hnyouv maiv lamh hnamv nyei ziangh hoc, yie yiem jomc lungh ndiev heuc meih. Tov dorh yie mingh taux gauh hlang jiex yie nyei la'bieiv.
Weic zuqc meih zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx, zoux yie wuonv haic nyei laauh weic biaux ndutv win-wangv.
Tov bun yie yietc liuz yiem meih nyei ndopv-liuh. Tov bun yie yiem meih nyei ndaatv ga'ndiev bingx jienv.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih muangx haiz yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac. Meih zorqv dongh taaih meih nyei mienh nzipc nyei buonc ceix bun yie.
Tov jaa hungh diex nyei siouc nyuonh ndaauv, bun ninh nyei hnyangx-jeiv ziangh duqv maanc doic.
Tov bun ninh yietc liuz zueiz weic yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien. Tov meih hnyouv zingx caux ziepc zuoqv hnamv nyei jauv beu jienv ninh.
Hnangv naaic, yie oix yietc liuz baaux nzung ceng meih nyei mengh, yaac hnoi jiex hnoi jaauv sung yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Yie nyei hnyouv sekv nzieqc nyei zuov Tin-Hungh ganh nduqc dauh hnangv. Yie nyei njoux en yiem ninh daaih.
Kungx ninh ganh zoux yie nyei La'bieiv yaac zoux yie nyei Njoux En. Ninh se yie wuonv nyei dorngx, yie maiv zuqc ndanc dongz.
Meih mbuo zuangx mienh oix mborqv oix baaic waaic yietc laanh mienh ndongc haaix lauh? Ninh hnangv zingh laatc laih mingh, yaac hnangv laatc nor tong huv nzengc.
Ninh mbuo daav za'eix oix tuix ninh nyei baaih njiec. Ninh mbuo a'hneiv gorngv-baeqc. Ninh mbuo nyei nzuih gorngv buang nyei waac mv baac hnyouv gu'nyuoz kungx zioux hnangv.
Yie nyei hnyouv sekv nzieqc nyei zuov Tin-Hungh ganh nduqc dauh hnangv, weic zuqc se ninh bun yie maaih lamh hnamv dorngx.
Kungx ninh ganh zoux yie nyei la'bieiv yaac zoux yie nyei njoux en. Ninh se yie wuonv nyei dorngx, yie maiv zuqc ndanc dongz.
Tin-Hungh se yie nyei njoux en caux yie nyei njang-laangc. Tin-Hungh yaac zoux yie henv haic nyei la'bieiv, zoux ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx.
O meih mbuo zuangx baeqc fingx aah! Oix zuqc zanc-zanc kaux Tin-Hungh. Zorqv ganh nyei hnyouv yietc zungv mbuox Ninh. Ninh zoux yie mbuo ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx.

Haac horngh mienh beiv tauv yietc nzunc qiex. Zaangc horngh mienh yaac kungx jaav nyei hnangv. Longc tin-baengh dangv nziang ninh mbuo yaac maiv maaih hniev-daauh. I nyungc gapv daaih gauh heng tauv yietc nzunc nyei qiex.
Maiv dungx bangc niouv mienh nyei sic weic duqv nyaanh, yaac maiv dungx hnamv kaux caangv daaih nyei ga'naaiv. Se gorngv butv zoih camv jienv faaux yaac maiv dungx bungx hnyouv.
Tin-Hungh gorngv nzunc, yie duqv haiz i nzunc, se domh qaqv benx Tin-Hungh nyei.
O Ziouv aah! Se dongh meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh. Weic zuqc meih ziux gorqv-mienh zoux nyei winh zingh nyeic bun mienh.

Tin-Hungh aah! Meih zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh, yie longc hnyouv zimh lorz meih. Yie nyei hnyouv ngorc haic meih, yie za'gengh! oix haic meih hnangv yiem deic-bung-haanz mborngx nqaai, maiv maaih wuom nyei dorngx nor.
Yie yiem singx dinc buatc jiex meih, buatc meih nyei qaqv caux njang-laangc.
Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh se gauh longx ziangh maengc, yie nyei nzuih ziouc oix ceng meih.
Da'faanh corc maaih maengc nyei ziangh hoc yie oix ceng meih. Yie oix dengv meih nyei mengh sung yie nyei buoz daux gaux.
Yie nyei hnyouv hnangv nyanc beuv yinh wuic nyei lai-hnaangx. Yie nyei nzuih yaac oix njien-youh nyei ceng meih.
Yie bueix jienv coux jangx taux meih, lungh muonz zanc yaac fei-fangv taux meih.
Weic zuqc meih zanc-zanc tengx yie, yie yiem meih nyei ndaatv-ndiev nyei dongh linh njien-youh nyei baaux nzung.
Yie nyei hnyouv kaux wuonv meih. Meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz baav jienv yie.
Oix hoic yie nyei maengc wuov deix mienh zungv oix ndortv njiec yiemh gen.
Ninh mbuo oix zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix, zuqc hieh juv betv nyanc.
Mv baac hungh diex oix kaux Tin-Hungh njien-youh. Da'faanh ziangv jienv ninh houv waac nyei mienh oix ceng ninh, weic zuqc gorngv-baeqc wuov deix zungv zuqc nqapc jienv nzuih.
Tin-Hungh aah! Yie tauv domh qiex nyei ziangh hoc tov muangx yie nyei qiex. Tov meih beu jienv yie nyei maengc, maiv zuqc win-wangv hoic.
Tov meih tengx yie bingx jienv beic ndiev daav za'eix wuov deix orqv mienh, caux wuov guanh ceux lunc nyei mienh.
Ninh mbuo nzioux ganh nyei mbietc hnangv nzuqc ndaauv nor laic, ninh mbuo gorngv cuotv im haic nyei waac hnangv ziangx haic nyei forng.
Ninh mbuo bingx jienv buonv maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh, liemh zeih buonv ninh, ninh mbuo yaac maiv gamh nziex.
Ninh mbuo laanh kuinx laanh ei ninh mbuo waaic nyei za'eix zoux. Ninh mbuo beic ndiev caangh laangh zaeng hlaang hlopv mienh. Ninh mbuo hnamv daaih, “Haaix dauh haih mangc duqv buatc yie mbuo?”
Haaix dauh haih wetv cuotv yie mbuo zoux nyei waaic sic? Yie mbuo hnamv cuotv guaix haic nyei za'eix.” Mienh nyei hnyouv caux eix za'gengh ndo haic.
Mv baac Tin-Hungh oix longc forng-cang buonv ninh mbuo, ninh mbuo ziouc liemh zeih zuqc mun.
Weic zuqc ninh mbuo ganh nyei mbietc oix hoic ninh mbuo zuqc baaic. Da'faanh buatc ninh mbuo nyei mienh ziouc huangx m'nqorngv.
Zuangx mienh ziouc gamh nziex haic, oix zunh yaangh Tin-Hungh zoux nyei gong, yaac hnamv taux ninh zoux nyei sic.
Kuv mienh ziouc kaux Ziouv njien-youh yaac oix ndaauh kaux ninh. Hnyouv zingx nyei mienh yaac oix ceng ninh.
Tin-Hungh aah! Yie mbuo horpc zuqc yiem Si^on ceng meih, yaac jaauv sung yie mbuo laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Meih muangx baamh mienh daux gaux nyei waac. Baamh mienh yietc zungv oix daaih lorz meih
weic mienh baamz zuiz. Yie mbuo nyei zuiz-nipc hingh yie mbuo nyei ziangh hoc meih zungv guangc mi'aqv.

Meih ginv dorh daaih yiem nitv fatv meih wuov deix, se bun yiem meih nyei singx dinc nyei laatc gu'nyuoz nyei mienh, duqv orn-lorqc. Yie mbuo ziouc buangv eix weic yiem meih nyei biauv, se yiem meih cing-nzengc nyei singx dinc, duqv nyungc-nyungc longx.
O yie mbuo njoux en nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Meih longc mbuoqc horngh nyei sic njoux yie mbuo, dau yie mbuo. Yiem jomc lungh ndiev caux go jiex nyei koiv nyei mienh kaux meih maaih lamh hnamv dorngx.
Meih longc meih nyei qaqv liepc mbong jiez daaih, bun cing meih henv haic.
Meih bun koiv mbui nyei qiex caux wuom-laangc nyei qiex sekv, yaac bun maanc fingx nauc nyei qiex sekv mi'aqv.
Yiem lungh ndiev go jiex nyei dorngx nyei mienh ziouc weic meih zoux nyei jangx-hoc gamh nziex. Meih bun mba'hnoi cuotv caux mba'hnoi muotv wuov deix dorngx nyei mienh njien-youh nyei heuc.

Meih goux ndau-beih yaac bun mbiungc njiec daaih bun ndau junc haic. Tin-Hungh nyei ndaaih maaih wuom buangv nzengc. Meih yaac bun mienh duqv laangh ziqc weic zuqc meih hnangv naaic liuc leiz ziangx ndau.
Meih bun lungh duih mbiungc njiec laih ziangx nyei ndau, bun laih liuz nyei nie yuonh nzengc. Meih duih mbiungc-mbuonv njiec bun ndau mau, ceix fuqv bun ga'naaiv-zuangx hlo.
Meih bun hnyangx-daauh bungx-zuoqc, maiv gunv meih mingh taux haaix, yaac maaih siou-sengh.
Yiem deic-bung-huaang nyei miev-ciangv nyiemz haic, mbong-aiv yaac njien-youh, orn-lorqc nzengc.
Miev-ciangv hnangv maaih yungh guanh zorng jienv, horngz yaac maaih mbiauh cuotv buangv, nyungc-nyungc lomh nzoih njien-youh nyei heuc yaac baaux nzung.
Lungh ndiev nyei zuangx mienh aah! Oix zuqc njien-youh nyei heuc jienv ceng Tin-Hungh.
Baaux nzung ceng ninh njang-laangc nyei mbuox. Ceng ninh bun cing ninh njang-laangc haic.
Oix zuqc mbuox Tin-Hungh, “Meih zoux nyei sic za'gengh mbuoqc horngh haic. Meih nyei qaqv henv haic, meih nyei win-wangv ziouc nyiemc faix aengx puoqv njiec meih nyei nza'hmien.
Lungh ndiev nyei zuangx mienh baaix meih. Ninh mbuo baaux nzung ceng meih. Ninh mbuo baaux nzung ceng meih nyei mengh.”
Daaih mangc Tin-Hungh zoux nyei sic maah! Ninh yiem baamh mienh mbu'ndongx zoux domh mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Ninh tiuv koiv benx ndau-nqaai, yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix yangh jauv jiex ndaaih. Yie mbuo yiem wuov weic ninh zoux nyei sic njien-youh.
Ninh longc domh qaqv yietc liuz gunv, ninh nyei m'zing zanc-zanc mangc jienv maanc fingx. Oix ngaengc Tin-Hungh wuov deix maiv dungx ceng ganh hlo.
Maanc fingx mienh aah! Oix zuqc ceng yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, bun mienh muangx duqv haiz ceng ninh nyei qiex mbui.
Ninh beu jienv bun yie mbuo maaih maengc ziangh, yaac maiv bun yie mbuo nyei zaux caaiv piatv.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih kauv yie mbuo. Meih sinx yie mbuo hnangv sinx nyaanh nor.
Meih bun yie mbuo zuqc mungz zaaux jienv, bun yie mbuo zuqc siouc kouv hnangv zorqv hniev nyei ga'naaiv bun yie mbuo nyiex.
Meih bun mienh geh mborqv jaax cie nganx yie mbuo nyei m'nqorngv. Yie mbuo zuqc jiex wuom jiex douz, mv baac meih dorh yie mbuo taux norm bungx-zuoqc nyei deic-bung.
Yie oix dorh buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv bieqc meih nyei biauv. Yie oix jaauv sung yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac
ziux zuqc kuonx naanh nyei ziangh hoc caux yie nyei nzuih meix gorngv cuotv nyei waac, se yie nyei nzuih laengz nyei.
Yie oix fongc horc junc nyei saeng-kuv zoux buov ziec nyei ga'naaiv caux jienv ba'gi yungh gouv zoux ndaang nyei qiex. Yie longc ngongh gouv caux yungh gouv fongc horc bun meih.
Da'faanh taaih Tin-Hungh nyei mienh gunv daaih muangx maah! Yie ziouc mbuox meih mbuo ninh weic yie zoux nyei sic.
Yie heuc jienv tov ninh, yie longc yie nyei mbietc ceng ninh, taaih ninh.
Se gorngv yie sueih zuiz yiem yie nyei hnyouv, Ziouv zungv maiv muangx yie.
Mv baac Tin-Hungh za'gengh muangx yie. Ninh baeng m'normh muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac.
Ceng Tin-Hungh weic zuqc ninh maiv nqemh yie daux gaux nyei waac. Ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie, maiv guangc yie.
Tov Tin-Hungh korv-lienh yie mbuo, ceix fuqv bun yie mbuo. Tov zoux longx bun yie mbuo,
weic bun lungh ndiev mienh hiuv duqv meih nyei jauv-louc, yaac bun maanc guoqv haih hiuv duqv meih nyei njoux en.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov bun fingx-fingx mienh ceng meih. Tov bun maanc fingx ceng meih.
Tov bun maanc guoqv a'hneiv, njien-youh nyei baaux nzung, weic zuqc meih baengh fim nyei siemv maanc fingx, yaac dorh lungh ndiev nyei maanc guoqv.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov bun fingx-fingx mienh ceng meih. Tov bun maanc fingx ceng meih.
Ndau cuotv gaeng-zuangx. Tin-Hungh, se yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, ceix fuqv bun yie mbuo.
Tin-Hungh ceix fuqv bun yie mbuo. Tov bun yiem jomc lungh ndiev nyei maanc mienh taaih ninh.
Tov Tin-Hungh jiez daaih, bun ninh nyei win-wangv nzaanx nzengc. Tov bun nzorng ninh wuov deix yiem ninh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx tiux biaux.
Tov zunc ninh mbuo biaux, hnangv douz-sioux zuqc nziaaux buonc nzaanx mingh nor. Tov bun orqv mienh yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien zuqc mietc hnangv mueiz-nzing zuqc douz buov yuqc nor.
Mv baac tov bun kuv mienh a'hneiv, bun ninh mbuo yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien, za'gengh njien-youh orn-lorqc haic.
Baaux nzung ceng Tin-Hungh, baaux ceng ninh nyei mengh. Ceng geh jienv mbuonx wuov dauh, ninh nyei mbuox heuc Ziouv, oix zuqc yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien njien-youh.
Tin-Hungh yiem ninh nyei cing-nzengc dorngx zoux guh hanh fu'jueiv nyei die yaac beu jienv auv-guaav.
Tin-Hungh bun kou-ndoqc mienh maaih biauv yiem, bun zuqc wuonx nyei mienh cuotv daaih duqv longx. Mv baac ngaengc ninh nyei mienh oix zuqc yiem deic-bung-haanz, ndau nqaai nzengc nyei dorngx.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih yiem meih nyei baeqc fingx nyei wuov ndaangc maengx cuotv mingh yangh jiex deic-bung-huaang wuov zanc,
ndau dorng jienv Tin-Hungh dongz, lungh yaac duih mbiungc njiec. Sinaai Mbong yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien, se I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien, dongz.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih bun lungh duih domh mbiungc njiec. Meih nzipc nyei buonc ndau nqaai, meih bun nyiemz daaih.
Meih nyei baeqc fingx liepc nguaaz-gorn yiem wuov. O Tin-Hungh aah! Weic zuqc meih longx haic, meih liuc leiz ziangx bun mienh jomc mienh.
Ziouv hatc waac, maaih domh guanh m'sieqv dorn dorh naaiv deix kuv fienx mingh zunh gorngv,
“Gunv jun-baeng nyei hungh tiux biaux nzengc. Biaux nzengc aqv loh!” Yiem biauv wuov deix m'sieqv dorn bun nqoi caangv daaih nyei ga'naaiv.
Maiv gunv ninh mbuo corc bueix ba'gi yungh laanh mbu'ndongx, baeqc gopv nyei ndaatv buang jienv nyaanh, ndaatv nyei biei nzaatv jienv zien jiem youc-youc wuov.
Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh bun yiem deic-bung wuov deix hungh diex nzaanx mingh nyei ziangh hoc, ninh bun sorng duih njiec Sanx^mon Mbong.
Mbaasaan Mbong benx hlo hlang nyei domh mbong. Mbaasaan Mbong maaih ziex norm mbong-ningv.
Ningv camv nyei mbong aah! Meih weic haaix diuc mangc buatc korv-fiqv Tin-Hungh oix longc benx ninh yiem nyei dorngx, se dongh Ziouv oix yietc liuz yiem nyei mbong?
Ziouv yiem Sinaai Mbong dorh jienv cin-cin waanc-waanc norm mborqv jaax cie bieqc cing-nzengc nyei dorngx.

Meih faaux hlang nyei dorngx wuov zanc meih dorh zuqc caangv nyei mienh gan jienv mingh, yaac yiem mienh mbu'ndongx zipv zingh nyeic, liemh yiem hnyouv ngaengc nyei mienh zipv daaih, bun Ziouv Tin-Hungh yiem wuov norm dorngx.
Ceng Ziouv, dongh hnoi-hnoi ndaam mbuo nyei kouv naanc wuov dauh. Se dongh Tin-Hungh njoux yie mbuo.
Yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh se njoux yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Se Ziouv Tin-Hungh, njoux yie mbuo biaux ndutv maiv zuqc daic.
Mv baac Tin-Hungh oix mborqv huv ninh nyei win-wangv nyei m'nqorngv, se dongh maaih mba'biei nyei m'nqorngv-baengh, zanc-zanc baamz jienv zuiz nyei mienh.
Ziouv gorngv, “Yie oix dorh ninh mbuo yiem Mbaasaan nzuonx daaih, yaac bun ninh mbuo yiem ndo haic nyei koiv nzuonx,
weic bun meih mbuo comx jienv meih mbuo nyei win-wangv nyei nziaamv gu'nyuoz, meih mbuo nyei juv yaac duqv mbiec ninh mbuo nyei nziaamv.”
O Tin-Hungh aac, mienh buatc meih nyei mienh mbaih jienv yangh jauv. Yie nyei Tin-Hungh, yie nyei Hungh Diex nyei mienh mingh bieqc singx dinc.
Baaux nzung nyei mienh yiem wuov ndaangc maengx, patv daanh baah nyei mienh yiem nqa'haav, mborqv nzoz nyei m'sieqv dorn yiem mbu'ndongx.
“O I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei zeiv-fun aah! Oix zuqc yiem mienh camv gapv zunv nyei wuic mbu'ndongx ceng Tin-Hungh, se ceng Ziouv. ”
Gauh faix jiex nyei Mben^yaa^min Fingx mingh ndaangc. Gan nqa'haav daaih maaih Yu^ndaa Fingx nyei bieiv zeiv, maaih Se^mbu^lun nyei bieiv zeiv caux Napv^taa^li nyei bieiv zeiv.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov bun meih nyei qaqv cuotv. O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov longc meih nyei qaqv tengx yie mbuo hnangv meih weic yie mbuo zoux jiex nor.
Weic meih yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem nyei biauv zuangx hungh diex dorh zingh nyeic bun meih.

Tov meih hemx I^yipv, dongh yiem luoqc diqc lomc gu'nyuoz nyei hieh zoih. Hemx ngongh gouv caux ngongh dorn, se fingx-fingx mienh. Caaiv njiec mauv aapv mienh fungx nyaanh bun ninh mbuo wuov deix, bun a'hneiv mborqv jaax nyei fingx-fingx mienh nzaanx nzengc.
Maaih gong-zoh oix yiem I^yipv daaih. E^ti^o^bie Mienh oix siepv-siepv nyei sung buoz jouh Tin-Hungh.
O lungh ndiev maanc guoqv aah! Oix zuqc baaux nzung ceng Tin-Hungh, oix zuqc baaux nzung ceng Ziouv.
Ceng geh jienv gu'nguaaic lungh wuov dauh, se geh jienv yiem loz-hnoi daaih nyei lungh. Mangc maah! Ninh bungx ninh nyei qiex cuotv, se hlo haic nyei qiex.
Zunh gorngv Tin-Hungh maaih qaqv, zoux hlo gunv I^saa^laa^en Mienh. Ninh nyei qaqv yaac yiem wuov lungh.
O Tin-Hungh aac, meih yiem meih nyei singx dinc za'gengh mbuoqc horngh haic, se I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh, ninh bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx maaih qaqv henv. Oix zuqc ceng Tin-Hungh.
Tin-Hungh aah! Tov meih njoux yie. Wuom hlo jienv faaux, yiemx taux yie nyei jaang-ndiev.
Yie zemh njiec ndo haic nyei wuom-bamc gu'nyuoz, maiv maaih dorngx bun zaux souv duqv wuonv. Yie bieqc wuom ndo nyei dorngx, wuom yaac yiemx jienv yie.
Yie heuc jienv tov gau kouv nzengc, jaang-hoh nqaai mi'aqv. Yie zuov jienv Tin-Hungh tengx. Mangc gau, m'zing zungv maiv njang aqv.

Nzorng yie yaac maiv maaih gorn-baengx wuov deix mienh gauh camv yie nyei m'nqorngv nyei mba'biei. Maiv maaih gorn-baengx mv baac oix hoic yie nyei maengc wuov deix win-wangv henv haic, maiv zeiz yie nimc nyei ga'naaiv ih zanc yie oix zuqc fungx nzuonx fai?
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih hiuv duqv yie ndongc haaix hngongx. Yie zoux dorngc nyei sic yaac bingx maiv mbueiz meih.

O Ziouv, Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov maiv dungx bun kaux meih wuov deix laaix yie zuqc nyaiv. O I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov maiv dungx bun lorz meih wuov deix laaix yie zuqc baaic hmien.
Se weic meih yie cingx zuqc mienh gorngv doqc, oix zuqc buang hmien diev nyaiv.
Yie nyei gorx-youz buatc yie benx ninh mbuo maiv hiuv nyei mienh. Caux yie juangc maa nyei muoz-doic yaac funx yie benx ganh fingx mienh.
Yie weic meih nyei biauv jorm hnyouv hnangv douz zieqc jienv yie nor. Mienh gorngv doqc meih mv baac ninh mbuo nyei waac gorngv zuqc yie.
Yie zei maiv nyanc haaix nyungc weic zatv ganh zoux faix, yie zuqc mienh jatv yie.
Yie zuqv la'maah ndie-cou dorngx lui, ninh mbuo dorh yie zoux gouv gorngv.
Zueiz jienv zingh gaengh ndaangc nyei mienh kuanv yie, diuv nquin nyei mienh yaac dorh yie zoux nzung baaux.

Mv baac Ziouv aah! Yie daux gaux tov meih. O Tin-Hungh aah! Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, tov meih dau yie ziux meih buatc horpc nyei ziangh hoc, weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei tengx mienh.
Tov njoux yie maiv zuqc zemh njiec wuom-bamc gu'nyuoz. Tov tengx yie biaux ndutv yie nyei win-wangv caux ndo nyei wuom.
Tov maiv dungx bun wuom yiemx yie, fai bun wuom-ndo naqv yie, fai bun yie zuqc yiem yiemh gen.
O Ziouv aah! Tov dau yie, weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh se longx haic. Ziux meih korv-lienh haic mienh tov huin nzuonx daaih mangc yie.
Maiv dungx bingx meih nyei hmien, maiv mangc meih nyei bou. Yie zuqc kouv, tov siepv-siepv nyei dau yie.
Tov daaih nitv fatv yie, zuoqc yie, njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei win-wangv.
Meih hiuv duqv yie zuqc mienh huotv, zuqc nyaiv, zuqc baaic hmien. Meih yaac hiuv duqv yie nyei yietc zungv win-wangv.
Yie zuqc mienh huotv, yie nyei hnyouv za'gengh mun haic, yie ziouc haiz suei aqv. Yie lorz mienh korv-lienh yie, yaac maiv maaih yietc dauh. Lorz mienh orn hnyouv, yaac lorz maiv duqv haaix dauh.
Ninh mbuo zorqv daamv dorngx nyanc hopv bun yie. Yie jaang nqaatv ninh mbuo bun a'ngunc diuv-sui yie hopv.
Tov bun ninh mbuo nyei yinh wuic benx koux hlopv ninh mbuo, bun ninh mbuo baengh orn yiem nyei ziangh hoc zoux hlaang hlopv ninh mbuo.
Tov bun ninh mbuo nyei m'zing mbuov, mangc maiv buatc, yaac bun ninh mbuo nyei jaaiv yietc liuz jutv mingh.
Meih bun mienh nyei ga'qiex baetv cuotv bun ninh mbuo. Tov bun meih qiex jiez, nouz nyei sic zunc zaaic ninh mbuo.
Tov bun ninh mbuo yiem nyei ciangv benx ndau-huaang, bun ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh maiv maaih mienh yiem.
