Weic zuqc ninh mbuo hoic meih mborqv nyei mienh, yaac gorngv meih bun zuqc mun wuov deix mienh nyei kouv naanc.
Tov meih dingc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz aengx jaa dingc, yaac maiv dungx guangc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz.
Tov sortv ninh mbuo nyei mbuox cuotv ziangh maengc daan, yaac maiv dungx faaux ninh mbuo nyei mbuox yiem kuv mienh nyei daan.
Mv baac yie zuqc kouv naanc yaac zuqc mun. O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov bun meih nyei njoux en bouh yie faaux hlang.
Yie oix baaux nzung ceng Tin-Hungh nyei mengh, yie oix dor-ziec, ceng ninh weih hlo.
Hnangv naaic ziouc bun Ziouv gauh horpc hnyouv fongc horc ngongh gouv, fai fongc horc maaih jorng, maaih deih nyei ngongh gouv.
Zuqc zeix nyei mienh buatc liuz ziouc a'hneiv. Lorz Tin-Hungh nyei mienh aah! Tov bun meih nyei hnyouv fingv jiez daaih maah!
Weic zuqc Ziouv muangx dangx-donx nyei mienh, ninh maiv mangc piex ninh nyei baeqc fingx, se zuqc wuonx loh wuov deix.
Tov lungh caux ndau caux koiv caux yiem naaiv deix yietc zungv gu'nyuoz haih dongz nyei ga'naaiv ceng ninh.
Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh oix njoux Si^on, aengx liepc Yu^ndaa nyei zingh jiez daaih. Ninh nyei baeqc fingx oix yiem naaic weih benx ninh mbuo nyei buonc.
Ninh nyei bou nyei zeiv-fun oix duqv nzipc wuov norm deic-bung. Hnamv ninh nyei mengh nyei mienh yaac oix duqv yiem wuov.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov gaanv daaih njoux yie. O Ziouv aah! Tov siepv-siepv nyei tengx yie.
Tov bun oix zorqv yie nyei maengc wuov deix mienh zuqc nyaiv zuqc lunc. Tov bun dongh a'hneiv yie zuqc kouv wuov deix zuqc tuix nzuonx nqa'haav yaac zuqc baaic hmien.
Tov bun gorngv, “Haav! Haav!” wuov deix, zuqc nyaiv zuqc baaic.
Tov bun yietc zungv daaih lorz meih wuov deix, njien-youh orn-lorqc, tov bun hnamv meih nyei njoux en wuov deix, zanc-zanc gorngv, “Tin-Hungh za'gengh hlo haic.”
Mv baac yie kouv yaac jomc haic. O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov siepv-siepv nyei daaih yie naaiv. Meih se dongh tengx yie, njoux yie wuov dauh. O Ziouv aah! Tov maiv dungx ngaih.
O Ziouv aah! Yie ndaauh kaux meih. Tov bun yie yietc liuz maiv zuqc nyaiv.
Weic zuqc meih maaih gong-fim nyei, tov njoux yie, tengx yie. Tov bungx m'normh muangx yaac njoux yie.
Tov meih zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei la'bieiv, zoux yie wuonv haic nyei dorngx njoux yie, weic zuqc meih zoux yie nyei la'bieiv, zoux wuonv nyei dorngx beu yie.
O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov njoux yie biaux ndutv orqv mienh nyei buoz-ndiev, biaux ndutv hnyouv njuotv, doqc haic nyei mienh.
O Ziouv aah! Meih zoux yie maaih lamh hnamv nyei dorngx. Ziouv aah! Yiem yie lunx taux ih zanc yie kaux meih hnangv.
Yiem yie cuotv seix taux ih zanc yie bangc meih, se dongh meih bun yie cuotv maa nyei ga'sie, yie zanc-zanc ceng meih.
Mienh camv nyei mbuoqc horngh haic yie mv baac meih zoux yie kaux wuonv nyei dorngx.
Yie ziangh hnoi longc yie nyei nzuih ceng meih, yaac zunh meih nyei njang-laangc.
Yie gox nyei ziangh hoc, tov maiv dungx guangc yie. Sin zaangc nyei qaqv nzengc, maiv dungx leih nqoi yie.
Yie nyei win-wangv lorz jauv gorngv yie, dongh zuov jienv oix zorqv yie nyei maengc wuov deix, lomh nzoih caangh laangh.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Tin-Hungh guangc ninh mi'aqv. Zunc jienv zorqv ninh maah! Weic zuqc maiv maaih haaix dauh njoux ninh aqv.”
O Tin-Hungh aah! Maiv dungx leih go yie. O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Siepv-siepv nyei daaih tengx yie.
Tov bun yie nyei win-wangv zuqc nyaiv zuqc baaic nzengc. Tov bun lorz jauv hoic yie wuov deix baaic hmien diev nyaiv.
Mv baac yie nor, oix zanc-zanc kaux meih maaih lamh hnamv dorngx, yaac oix jaa ceng meih camv jienv faaux.
Yie nyei nzuih oix gorngv meih zoux nyei kuv sic, oix ziangh hnoi gorngv taux meih nyei njoux en, maiv gunv yie hiuv maiv toux naaiv deix jauv nyei soux mouc.
Ziouv Tin-Hungh aah! Yie oix dorh meih zoux henv haic nyei sic daaih gorngv, yie oix ceng meih zoux horpc nyei jauv, kungx meih ganh nyei hnangv.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Yie yiem hnyangx-jeiv lunx taux ih zanc meih njaaux yie. Yie corc zunh meih zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.

O Tin-Hungh aah! Yie taux hnyangx-jeiv gox, mba'biei baeqc nyei ziangh hoc, tov maiv dungx guangc yie. Zuov yie zorqv meih zoux henv haic nyei sic mbuox hoz doic, yaac zunh meih nyei qaqv mbuox nqa'haav cuotv seix nyei mienh.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih zoux horpc nyei jauv mbaengc lungh hlang. O Tin-Hungh aah! Se meih zoux hlo haic nyei sic. Haaix dauh haih hnangv meih?
Meih bun yie zuqc domh kouv naanc, mv baac oix bun yie aengx fingv jiez daaih. Meih oix yiem ndau, ndo haic nyei dorngx, aengx zorqv yie cuotv.
Meih oix taaih yie zoux gauh hlo zinh ndaangc yaac aengx orn nzunc yie nyei hnyouv.

O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Yie yaac oix longc daanh baah ceng meih, oix ceng meih weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei. I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Cing-Nzengc Ziouv aah! Yie oix longc ziepc diuh finx nyei daanh baah ceng meih.
Yie baaux nzung ceng meih nyei ziangh hoc yie nyei nzuih meix oix njien-youh nyei heuc. Yie nyei hnyouv yaac oix njien-youh nyei heuc, weic zuqc meih zuoqc yie.
Yie nyei mbietc ziangh hnoi oix gorngv meih zoux horpc nyei jauv tengx mienh, weic zuqc oix lorz jauv hoic yie wuov deix zuqc nyaiv zuqc baaic mi'aqv.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov ceix bun hungh diex baengh fim nyei siemv hnangv meih nor, yaac bun hungh dorn hnangv meih nor, zoux duqv horpc.
Tov bun ninh longc gong-fim siemv meih nyei baeqc fingx, yaac baengh fim nyei siemv meih nyei mienh jomc mienh.
Weic baeqc fingx zoux horpc nyei jauv tov bun domh mbong fiuv-mbong duqv bungx-zuoqc.
Tov bun hungh diex baengh fim nyei tengx baeqc fingx mbu'ndongx nyei mienh jomc mienh, njoux dangx-donx nyei mienh yaac zatv jienv zeix ninh mbuo wuov deix.
Mba'hnoi caux hlaax corc yiem jienv nyei ziangh hoc, tov bun ninh mbuo taaih meih taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Tov bun hungh diex hnangv mbiungc duih njiec mbietv liuz miev nyei ndau, yaac hnangv mbiungc-mbuonv puonx ndau-beih nor.
Ninh yiem nyei hnoi-nyieqc, tov bun kuv mienh hiaangx jienv faaux, yaac maaih baengh orn camv ndongc maaih hlaax yiem.
Tov bun ninh gunv nyei guoqv yiem naaiv bung koiv taux wuov bung koiv, yiem Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih taux jomc lungh ndiev.
Tov bun yiem deic-bung-huaang nyei mienh yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien gueic njiec baaix, yaac bun ninh nyei win-wangv mbiec nie-mbung.
Tov bun Taansitv caux zuangx koiv-nzou nyei hungh diex cuotv korx-zinh bun ninh. Yaac bun Qe^mbaa caux Se^mbaa nyei hungh diex dorh zingh nyeic bun ninh.
Tov bun zuangx hungh diex puoqv njiec ninh nyei nza'hmien, yaac bun maanc guoqv fu-sux ninh.
Weic zuqc dangx-donx nyei mienh heuc jienv tov nyei ziangh hoc ninh njoux, yaac njoux mienh jomc mienh caux maiv maaih haaix dauh tengx nyei mienh.
Ninh korv-lienh mau nyei mienh caux mienh jomc mienh, yaac njoux jomc kouv mienh nyei maengc.
Ninh zuoqc ninh mbuo nyei maengc leih ndutv zuqc zeix, zuqc zoux doqc nyei jauv. Ziux ninh mangc, ninh mbuo nyei maengc funx jaaix nyei.
Tov bun hungh diex ziangh duqv ndaauv. Tov bun ninh duqv Qe^mbaa nyei jiem. Tov bun mienh maiv dingh liouh nyei weic ninh daux gaux, yaac tov Tin-Hungh ziangh hnoi ceix fuqv bun ninh.

Tov bun deic-bung nyei ndau cuotv laangh ziqc bungx-zuoqc, yiem mbong gu'nguaaic jiex laangc paan-paan nyei, cuotv daaih gitv yaac jauh nyei hnangv Le^mbaa^norn nyei gemh, yaac bun zingh gu'nyuoz nyei mienh hiaangx hnangv lomc huaang nyei miev nor.

Tov bun hungh diex nyei mbuox yietc liuz yiem, ninh nyei mengh hoc yiem jienv ndongc mba'hnoi lauh. Maanc guoqv mienh oix weic hungh diex duqv fuqv, maanc fingx mienh yaac heuc ninh zoux maaih fuqv nyei mienh.
Ceng Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Tin-Hungh. Kungx ninh ganh haih zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Oix zuqc yietc liuz ceng ninh njang-laangc nyei mbuox, tov bun ninh nyei njang-laangc buangv lungh ndiev. Aamen caux Aamen.
Jetc^si nyei dorn, Ndaawitv, daux gaux nyei waac dorng mi'aqv.
Tin-Hungh za'gengh! zoux longx bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh, zoux longx bun maaih hnyouv cing-nzengc nyei mienh.
Mv baac yie ganh aeqv, yie nyei zaux aav lamh ndiqv zuqc ndorpc, yie nyei zaux-caaiv kaav deix piatv.
Weic zuqc yie buatc orqv mienh duqv longx wuov zanc, yie ziouc mueic jieqv zoux maux nyei mienh.
Ninh mbuo daic nyei ziangh hoc maiv zuqc diev mun, ninh mbuo nyei sin yaac wangc siangx, henv nyei.
Ninh mbuo maiv zuqc siouc kouv hnangv nyiec nyei mienh, yaac maiv hnangv nyiec nyei mienh zuqc zeqc naanc.
Weic naaiv ninh mbuo zoux maux nyei jauv beiv jiem-limc dangh jienv jaang. Zoux doqc nyei sic buang jienv ninh mbuo hnangv zuqv lui nor.
Ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv ngaengc, kungx zoux waaic nyei sic hnangv. Ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv hnamv cuotv orqv nyei za'eix camv haic.
Ninh mbuo jatv mienh, gorngv doqc ki mienh. Ninh mbuo ceng-hlo, gorngv oix zeix mienh.
Ninh mbuo nyei nzuih gorngv doqc yiem gu'nguaaic lungh nyei Tin-Hungh. Ninh mbuo nyei mbietc zoux maux gorngv doqc lungh ndiev mienh.
Weic naaiv baeqc fingx huin nzuonx ceng ninh mbuo, lorz maiv duqv dorngx nqemh ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Tin-Hungh hnangv haaix nor haih hiuv? Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh maaih wuonh zaang nyei fai?”
Mangc maah! Orqv mienh se hnangv naaiv nor. Ninh mbuo zanc-zanc kuh yiem kuh nyanc, gunv zoux gunv benx jienv faaux.
Wuov nyungc yie goux longx yie nyei hnyouv cing-nzengc yaac maiv baamz zuiz se maiv lamh longc.
Weic zuqc yie ziangh hnoi kungx zuqc kouv hnangv, ndorm-ndorm yaac zuqc dingc zuiz.
Se gorngv yie gorngv, “Yie oix hnangv naaiv nor gorngv,” yie ziouc zuqc zoux maiv zingx bun meih nyei zuangx baeqc fingx.
Yie hnamv mangc gaax hnangv haaix nor haih bieqc hnyouv naaiv deix sic, mv baac yie gengh haiz aqc haic,
taux yie bieqc Tin-Hungh nyei singx dinc, yie ziouc mengh baeqc orqv mienh nyei setv mueiz hnoi.
Meih za'gengh bun ninh mbuo yiem mbiaangc nyei dorngx, bun ninh mbuo ndorpc, zuqc mietc nzengc.
Ninh mbuo nduqc dangh hnangv zuqc mietc mi'aqv. Zuqc gamh nziex haic nyei sic guaatv ninh mbuo mingh nzengc.
Hnangv mienh mbeix buatc liuz nyie daaih maiv buatc mi'aqv. O Ziouv aah! Meih nyie daaih meih la'kuqv ninh mbuo nyei fangx mi'aqv.
Yie nyei hnyouv kouv wuov zanc, yie haiz hnangv mba'nziu zuqc baqv jienv mun nor.
Yie ziouc hngongx, maiv hiuv haaix nyungc, hnangv dauh hieh zoih yiem meih nyei nza'hmien.
Mv baac yie zanc-zanc caux meih yiem. Meih nanv jienv yie nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz.
Meih tengx yie caangh laangh weic dorh yie nyei jauv. Nqa'haav meih oix zipv yie, bun yie duqv njang-laangc.
Yiem wuov gu'nguaaic lungh, cuotv liuz meih, yie maiv maaih haaix dauh. Yiem naaiv lungh ndiev, cuotv liuz meih, yie maiv oix longc haaix nyungc.
Yie nyei sin caux yie nyei hnyouv haih mau jienv njiec, mv baac Tin-Hungh se yie nyei hnyouv nyei qaqv yaac yietc liuz zoux yie nyei buonc.
Mangc maah! Leih meih go nyei mienh zungv oix zuqc mietc. Meih oix mietc nzengc maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux bun meih wuov deix mienh.
Mv baac yie nor, yie yiem nitv Tin-Hungh fatv se longx haic. Yie bun Ziouv Tin-Hungh zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx, weic bun yie zunh gorngv ninh zoux nyei yietc zungv sic.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih weic haaix diuc yietc liuz guangc yie mbuo? Meih weic haaix diuc qiex jiez meih nyei yungh ciangv nyei ba'gi yungh hnangv cuotv douz-sioux?
Tov meih jangx jienv meih loz-hnoi ginv daaih nyei baeqc fingx, dongh meih zuoqc nzuonx weic zoux meih ganh nzipc nyei buonc. Jangx jienv Si^on Mbong, dongh meih yiem jiex nyei dorngx.
Tov meih laamx mingh mangc naaiv deix yietc liuz baaic huaang nyei dorngx. Win-wangv mietc nzengc yiem singx dinc nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv.
Meih nyei win-wangv yiem meih nyei wuic dorngh qaqv heuc. Ninh mbuo cie ninh mbuo ganh nyei geh faaux weic zoux jangx-hoc.
Buatc ninh mbuo hnangv mienh yiem lomc yaamh bouv hngaqv ndiangx nor.
Yiem singx dinc gu'nyuoz yietc zungv diu daaih nyei ndiangx, ninh mbuo longc bouv longc zueih mborqv waaic nzengc.
Ninh mbuo longc douz buov meih nyei singx dinc njiec taux ndau, ninh mbuo bun meih nyei Mengh yiem nyei dorngx maaih uix.
Ninh mbuo yiem hnyouv hnamv, “Yie mbuo oix hingh jiex nzengc ninh mbuo.” Ninh mbuo ziouc zorqv yiem gormx deic-bung, Tin-Hungh nyei norm-norm wuic dorngh, buov nzengc.
Yie mbuo maiv buatc yie mbuo nyei jangx-hoc, yaac maiv zengc yietc dauh douc waac mienh, yiem yie mbuo mbu'ndongx yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh hiuv duqv oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor ndongc haaix lauh.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Win-jaa oix huotv ndongc haaix lauh? Win-wangv oix yietc liuz gorngv doqc meih nyei mengh fai?
Meih weic haaix diuc nyuotv jienv buoz, se meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz. Meih weic haaix diuc maiv zorqv buoz yiem la'kuotv sung cuotv daaih mietc ninh mbuo?
Mv baac Tin-Hungh aac, yiem loz-hnoi daaih meih zoux yie nyei hungh. Meih yiem lungh ndiev zoux gong weic njoux mienh.
Meih longc meih nyei domh qaqv zorqv koiv bun nqoi, mborqv yiem koiv gu'nyuoz nyei jung-hungh nyei m'nqorngv huv.
Meih zienv Le^wi^aa^taan nyei m'nqorngv huv, yaac zorqv ninh jiu bun yiem deic-bung-huaang nyei hieh zoih nyanc.
Meih bun wuom-zingv caux ndoqv nyei wuom liouc cuotv. Zanc-zanc maaih wuom liouc jienv nyei ndaaih meih bun nqaai mingh.
Lungh hnoi zanc benx meih nyei, lungh muonz zanc yaac meih nyei. Meih liuc leiz hlaax caux mba'hnoi.
Ndau-beih nyei yietc zungv gapv-jaaix se meih dingc daaih. Meih yaac bun maaih haac gueix caux dong gueix.
O Ziouv aah! Tov meih jangx jienv win-wangv ndongc haaix huotv meih. Mienh hngongx mienh yaac gorngv doqc meih nyei mengh.
Maiv dungx zorqv meih nyei norqc nqo nyei maengc jiu bun hieh zoih. Tov maiv dungx yietc liuz la'kuqv meih nyei mienh jomc mienh nyei maengc.
Tov jangx jienv meih liepc nyei ngaengc waac weic zuqc ndau-beih norm-norm hmuangx nyei dorngx maaih zoux doqc hoic mienh nyei sic buangv nzengc.
Tov maiv dungx bun zuqc zeix nyei mienh zuqc nyaiv. Tov bun mienh jomc mienh caux dangx-donx nyei mienh ceng meih nyei mengh.
O Tin-Hungh aah! Tov meih jiez daaih maah! Tov weic ganh caengx sic. Jangx jienv mienh hngongx mienh hnangv haaix nor ziangh hnoi huotv meih.
Maiv dungx la'kuqv meih nyei win-wangv qaqv heuc nyei qiex. Se meih nyei win-jaa maiv dingh liouh nyei nauc jienv heuc mbui nyei qiex.
O Tin-Hungh aac, yie mbuo dor-ziec meih aqv. Yie mbuo dor-ziec meih, weic zuqc meih yiem nitv fatv. Yie mbuo zunh yaangh meih zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Tin-Hungh gorngv, “Ziux yie dingc daaih nyei ziangh hoc yie oix baengh fim nyei siemv zuiz.
Baamh gen caux yiem baamh gen nyei yietc zungv mienh lungh lungh laih laih wuov zanc, se yie ganh baav jienv baamh gen nyei ndiouh.
Yie gorngv mbuox ceng-hlo nyei mienh, “Maiv dungx ceng-hlo.” Yaac gorngv mbuox orqv mienh, “Maiv dungx bungx waac-maux.
Maiv dungx taaih ganh hlo, bungx waac-maux, fai ngorngz jienv jaang gorngv waac.”
Bouh mienh faaux hlang maiv zeiz yiem dong bung fai bung daaih, yaac maiv zeiz yiem deic-bung-huaang daaih.
Se Tin-Hungh dunx sic. Ninh zatv yietc dauh njiec aiv, bouh yietc dauh faaux hlang.
Weic zuqc yiem Ziouv nyei buoz maaih norm zaanv, dapv buangv maaih mbiaauz nyei diuv, peux duqv longx nyei. Ninh oix dox cuotv daaih, baamh gen nyei yietc zungv orqv mienh oix hopv nqaai nzengc.
Mv baac yie nor, yie oix yietc liuz zunh yaangh naaiv deix sic. Yie oix baaux nzung ceng Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh.
Yie oix zoux waaic orqv mienh nyei qaqv, mv baac bun kuv mienh nyei qaqv henv jienv faaux.
Yiem Yu^ndaa Deic mienh hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh. Yiem I^saa^laa^en ninh nyei mengh hlo haic.
Yiem Saalem ninh liepc ninh nyei ndopv-liuh, ninh yiem nyei dorngx se Si^on.
Yiem wuov ninh wuotv nauv maaih douz nyei forng-cang, torngv-baaih, nzuqc ndaauv caux yietc zungv mborqv jaax nyei wuoqc ginc.
O Tin-Hungh aac, meih za'gengh njang-laangc haic. Meih gauh hlo gauh njang-laangc jiex yietc liuz yiem nyei mbong.
Ninh mbuo hnyouv henv nyei mienh nyei ga'naaiv zungv zuqc caangv nzengc. Ninh mbuo daic nzengc mi'aqv. Mborqv jaax nyei zuangx mienh, maiv maaih haaix dauh haih cau duqv buoz jiez aqv.
O Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh aac, meih hatc ninh mbuo wuov zanc ninh mbuo nyei maaz caux geh maaz mienh ziouc daic mi'aqv.
Mv baac mienh gamh nziex nyei se kungx meih ganh hnangv. Meih qiex jiez nyei ziangh hoc haaix dauh haih yiem meih nyei nza'hmien?
Meih yiem gu'nguaaic lungh gorngv siemv zuiz nyei waac, lungh ndiev gamh nziex, yaac sekv nzieqc nyei,
dongh Tin-Hungh daaih dingc zuiz, oix njoux yietc zungv yiem baamh gen zuqc zeix nyei mienh.
Baamh mienh qiex jiez, haih bun mienh gauh oix ceng meih. Zuqc meih nouz zengc njiec nyei mienh, oix yiem nitv fatv meih.

Meih mbuo oix zuqc laengz ngaengc waac bun Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, yaac ei jienv naaiv deix laengz nyei waac zoux. Oix zuqc bun weih gormx nyei mienh dorh zingh nyeic daaih bun mienh oix zuqc taaih nyei Ziouv.
Ninh zatv jienv zoux hlo wuov deix nyei hnyouv, bun lungh ndiev nyei hungh diex gamh nziex ninh.
Yie heuc jienv jouh Tin-Hungh. Yie heuc jienv tov, ninh zungv oix muangx yie.
Yie zuqc kouv naanc nyei hnoi-nyieqc yie lorz Ziouv, yie ziangh muonz sung jienv buoz maiv dingh liouh nyei daux gaux, mv baac maiv duqv orn hnyouv.
Yie hnamv taux Tin-Hungh ziouc tauv domh qiex. Yie jangx taux naaiv deix jauv, haiz hnyouv mau nzengc aqv.
Meih bun yie maiv haih m'njormh. Yie hnyouv nzauh kouv haic, zungv maiv haih gorngv waac.
Yie hnamv taux jiex daaih nyei hnoi-nyieqc, yaac jangx zuqc loz-hnoi nyei hnyangx-daauh.
Yie lungh muonz zanc yiem hnyouv hnamv, yie yiem hnyouv fei-fangv yaac naaic gaax ganh,
“Ziouv oix yietc liuz guangc yie mbuo, yietc liuz maiv aengx a'hneiv yie mbuo fai?
Ninh yietc liuz maiv aengx hnamv yie mbuo fai? Ninh laengz nyei waac yietc liuz yietc seix baac nzengc mi'aqv fai?
Tin-Hungh la'kuqv ceix en bun yie mbuo fai? Ninh qiex jiez ziouc maiv korv-lienh fai?”
Yie aengx gorngv, “Bun yie hnyouv nzauh nyei se Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz goiv yienc mi'aqv.
Yie oix jangx taux Ziouv zoux jiex nyei sic, za'gengh oix jangx meih loz-hnoi zoux wuov deix mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Yie yiem hnyouv buih meih zoux nyei yietc zungv gong, yie oix longx-longx nyei hnamv taux meih zoux jiex maaih qaqv nyei sic.
O Tin-Hungh aac, meih zoux nyei jauv-louc se cing-nzengc haic, maiv maaih haaix dauh zienh ndongc yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh hlo.
Meih se zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic wuov dauh Tin-Hungh. Meih yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx bun ninh mbuo buatc meih nyei domh qaqv.
Meih longc meih nyei qaqv njoux meih nyei mienh, se njoux Yaakopv caux Yosepv nyei zeiv-fun.
O Tin-Hungh aac, wuom buatc meih, wuom buatc meih wuov zanc ziouc gamh nziex. Ndo haic nyei koiv yaac dongz.
Mbuonx dox cuotv wuom, yiem wuov lungh maaih mba'ong mbui. Mba'lingc yaac njapc njapc nyei biei bung.
Mba'ong yiem domh nziaaux-zunc mbui cuotv. Meih nyei mba'lingc bun lungh ndiev njang nzengc. Ndau-beih ndanc dongz nzengc.
Meih nyei jauv se yiem koiv jiex, meih mingh nyei jauv gan domh wuom mingh, mv baac meih nyei zaux-mienv maiv maaih mienh buatc.
Meih dorh meih nyei baeqc fingx hnangv goux yungh mienh dorh ba'gi yungh guanh nor, yaac bangc Mose caux Aalon nyei buoz dorh.
O yie nyei baeqc fingx aah! Meih mbuo oix zuqc muangx yie njaaux nyei jauv, oix zuqc baeng m'normh muangx yie nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac.
Yie oix gorngv waac-beiv, yaac oix gorngv cuotv loz-hnoi gem jienv nyei sic.
Se yie mbuo duqv haiz duqv hiuv nyei jauv, dongh yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix gorngv mbuox yie mbuo nyei sic.

Yie mbuo maiv zorqv naaiv deix sic bingx yie mbuo nyei dorn-jueiv, zungv oix mbuox jiex mingh wuov doic. Oix gorngv Ziouv zoux puix duqv ceng nyei sic, yaac gorngv taux ninh nyei qaqv caux ninh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Ninh yiem Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun mbu'ndongx liepc leiz-nyeic, yiem I^saa^laa^en njiec lingc, dongh ninh hatc yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix oix zuqc njaaux ninh mbuo nyei fun-faqv,
weic bun nqa'haav wuov doic zeiv-fun, dongh maiv gaengh cuotv seix wuov deix, hiuv duqv ziouc nzipc jienv gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo ganh nyei dorn-jueiv zeiv-fun.
Hnangv naaic ninh mbuo ziouc kaux Tin-Hungh maaih lamh hnamv dorngx, yaac maiv la'kuqv Tin-Hungh zoux nyei sic, mv baac ei jienv ninh nyei leiz-latc zoux.

Ninh mbuo ziouc maiv hnangv ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix nor, dongh hnyouv ngaengc faanv lunc wuov doic mienh. Wuov doic mienh maiv kaux wuonv Tin-Hungh, ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv yaac maiv ziepc zuoqv gan Tin-Hungh.
E^faa^im Mienh nanv jienv juang-zinx forng-cang, mv baac taux mborqv jaax nyei hnoi-nyieqc tuix nqaang nzuonx.
Ninh mbuo maiv ei Tin-Hungh liepc nyei ngaengc waac, yaac maiv kangv gan ninh nyei leiz-latc.
Ninh mbuo la'kuqv ninh zoux jiex nyei sic, caux ninh bun ninh mbuo buatc jiex wuov deix mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung, So^an nyei ndau-baengh, Tin-Hungh dorng jienv ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Ninh zorqv koiv bun nqoi, bun ninh mbuo jiex mingh, aengx bun wuom ndui jienv hnangv zingh laatc nor.
Lungh hnoi zanc ninh longc mbuonx, ziangh muonz longc douz nyei njang dorh ninh mbuo.
Ninh yiem deic-bung-huaang mborqv mbaaix la'bieiv, bun wuom camv-camv nyei ninh mbuo hopv, hnangv yiem ndo haic nyei dorngx cuotv.
Ninh bun wuom yiem la'bieiv mbeux cuotv benx ndoqv, bun wuom liouc njiec hnangv ndaaih nor.
Mv baac ninh mbuo corc baamz zuiz dorngc Tin-Hungh. Ninh mbuo yiem deic-bung-huaang ngaengc jienv Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh.
Ninh mbuo yiem hnyouv duqv-eix seix Tin-Hungh, ngaengc jienv ceuv ninh mbuo ngorc oix nyanc nyei ga'naaiv.
Ninh mbuo gorngv doqc Tin-Hungh ziouc gorngv, “Yiem naaiv deic-bung-huaang Tin-Hungh haih bun nyanc hopv fai?”
Ninh mborqv la'bieiv-zorng bun wuom baetv cuotv, wuom liouc mingh benx ndoqv buangv mienz nzengc. Ninh aengx haih ceix laangh ziqc fai lorz orv juang ninh nyei baeqc fingx fai?
Ziouv muangx haiz ninh mbuo nyei waac ziouc qiex jiez haic. Ninh longc douz buov Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun. Ninh yietc zei gauh fatv qiex jiez I^saa^laa^en Mienh,
weic zuqc ninh mbuo maiv sienx Tin-Hungh yaac maiv kaux ninh nyei njoux en.
Mv baac ninh hatc lungh, yaac koi nqoi lungh gaengh.
Ninh bun maa^naa duih njiec bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx nyanc, yaac bun lungh nyei laangh ziqc ninh mbuo.
Baamh mienh duqv nyanc fin-mienh nyei laangh ziqc, Tin-Hungh bun ninh mbuo duqv nyanc hopv bungx-zuoqc.
Tin-Hungh bun dong bung nyei nziaaux yiem wuov lungh buonc daaih, aengx longc ninh nyei qaqv dorh naamh bung nyei nziaaux cuotv daaih.
Ninh bun orv njiec ndongc nie-mbung camv, se bun norqc ndaix daaih ndongc saa-ziou camv.
Ninh bun norqc ndortv njiec ninh mbuo nyei ciangv mbu'ndongx, huing gormx ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh.
Ninh mbuo ziouc nyanc yaac nyanc duqv beuv. Tin-Hungh ziux ninh mbuo ngorc nyanc nyei ceix bun ninh mbuo.
Mv baac ninh mbuo nyanc ngorc nyei ga'naaiv maiv gaengh gaux, corc yiem jienv ninh mbuo nyei nzuih nyei ziangh hoc,
Tin-Hungh qiex jiez! haic ninh mbuo, ninh yiem ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx daix ninh mbuo gauh henv jiex nyei mienh, mborqv baaic I^saa^laa^en nyei mienh lunx mienh.
Maiv gunv maaih naaiv deix sic, ninh mbuo corc baamz zuiz. Maiv gunv ninh zoux naaiv deix mbuoqc horngh nyei sic, ninh mbuo maiv sienx kaux ninh.
Ninh ziouc zoux bun ninh mbuo setv mueiz nyei hnoi-nyieqc maiv lamh longc, bun ninh mbuo setv mueiz nyei hnyangx-daauh zuqc domh heiv sic.
Tin-Hungh daix ninh mbuo nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo ziouc lorz ninh aqv. Ninh mbuo goiv hnyouv, qaqv lorz Tin-Hungh.
Ninh mbuo jangx zuqc Tin-Hungh se ninh mbuo nyei La'bieiv. Yiem Hlang Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh dongh Zuoqc Ninh Mbuo Wuov Dauh.
Ninh mbuo longc nzuih gorngv waac-gaam ceng ninh, yaac longc mbietc gorngv-baeqc nduov ninh hnangv.
Ninh mbuo maiv liepc dingc hnyouv kaux ninh, yaac maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei ei jienv ninh laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Mv baac ninh corc korv-lienh ninh mbuo, guangc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz, yaac maiv mietc ninh mbuo. Ninh qiex jiez mv baac ninh nyienz jienv ziex nzunc. Ninh zatv jienv ga'qiex, maiv nouz taux daauh.
Ninh jangx ninh mbuo kungx benx haih daic nyei baamh mienh, yaac hnangv gorng nziaaux nor, buonc mingh maiv nzuonx.
Yiem deic-bung-huaang ninh mbuo ngaengc ninh ndongc wuov camv, yiem ndau-huaang ninh mbuo bun ninh hnyouv mun.
Ninh mbuo seix ninh yietc nzunc jiex yietc nzunc. Ninh mbuo cuoqv I^saa^laa^en nyei Cing-Nzengc Tin-Hungh.
Ninh mbuo maiv jangx ninh nyei domh qaqv, fai zuoqc ninh mbuo leih ndutv win-wangv nyei hnoi,
dongh yiem I^yipv ninh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei jangx-hoc, se yiem So^an Ndau-Baengh zoux nyei sic.
Ninh zorqv ninh mbuo nyei ndaaih goiv benx nziaamv, ninh mbuo nyei ndoqv zungv maiv haih hopv.
Ninh bun mungz faanv daaih hoic, aengx bun gaengv hoic ninh mbuo kouv.
Ninh zorqv ninh mbuo nyei gaeng-zuangx bun jopv-nyeic lunx, yaac zorqv ninh mbuo ndortv qaqv duqv daaih nyei buonc bun domh jopv-nyeic hoic.
Ninh bun borqc mborqv waaic ninh mbuo nyei a'ngunc hmei, yaac longc sorng hoic waaic ninh mbuo nyei ngongh nyorx ndiangx.
Ninh zorqv ninh mbuo nyei ngongh bun borqc mborqv, aengx bun ninh mbuo nyei ba'gi yungh guanh zuqc mba'ong piqv.
Ninh nyei ga'qiex biuih cuotv, ninh qiex jiez haic, nouz haic, bun ninh mbuo zuqc ciouv nyei sic, bun ninh mbuo zuqc guanh zoux mietc nyei fin-mienh.
Ninh liuc leiz ziangx bun qiex jiez nyei jauv cuotv. Ninh maiv liouh ninh mbuo nyei maengc, zungv jiu bun ninh mbuo butv domh wuon-baengc.
Yiem I^yipv ninh daix mouz dauh dorn-la'gauv, se Haam nyei dauh dauh zeiv-fun nyei daauh toi dorn.
Nqa'haav ninh dorh ninh nyei baeqc fingx cuotv daaih hnangv ba'gi yungh. Ninh dorh ninh mbuo jiex deic-bung-huaang hnangv yungh guanh nor.
Ninh dorh longx ninh mbuo, ninh mbuo ziouc maiv gamh nziex, mv baac koiv nyei wuom yiemx daic ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv.
Ninh dorh ninh mbuo mingh taux ninh cing-nzengc deic-bung nyei gapv-jaaix dorngx, taux ninh nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz duqv daaih nyei mbong.

Ninh zunc fingx-fingx mienh yiem ninh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx cuotv mingh. Ninh ndorqc ndau bun nqoi weic benx ninh mbuo nzipc nyei buonc, yaac bun fingx-fingx I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem jienv ninh mbuo nyei ndopv-liuh.
Mv baac ninh mbuo corc seix yaac ngaengc jienv Yiem Hlang Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh, maiv ei jienv ninh nyei leiz-latc zoux.
Daaux nzuonx ninh mbuo ngaengc hnangv ninh mbuo nyei ong-taaix, maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux. Ninh mbuo goiv yienc hnangv juang-zinx nor ngau.
Ninh mbuo ceix yiem hlang zaangc zienh nyei dorngx cuoqv ninh qiex jiez haic. Laaix ninh mbuo zoux miuc-fangx, cuoqv ninh hanc haic ninh mbuo.
Tin-Hungh muangx haiz ziouc qiex jiez! haic, guangc nzengc I^saa^laa^en Mienh aqv.
Yiem Silo, Tin-Hungh guangc ninh nyei ndopv-liuh yiem nyei dorngx, se ninh yiem baamh mienh mbu'ndongx corng nyei ndopv-liuh.
Ninh zorqv ninh nyei Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang jiu bun mienh caangv mingh, bun ninh nyei njang-laangc yiem win-wangv nyei buoz-ndiev.
Ninh qiex jiez haic ninh nzipc nyei baeqc fingx, ziouc jiu bun ninh mbuo zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix.
Douz mietc nzengc ninh mbuo nyei houh saeng, ninh mbuo nyei sieqv lorz maiv duqv jaa dorng.
Ninh mbuo nyei sai mienh zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix, ninh mbuo nyei auv-guaav maiv haih nzauh nyiemv.
Wuov zanc Ziouv nyie hnangv mienh m'njormh mingh nyie daaih nor, ninh heuc mbui hnangv mienh henv mienh hopv diuv heuc nor.
Ninh mborqv ninh nyei win-wangv tuix nzuonx, bun ninh mbuo yietc liuz zuqc nyaiv.
Ninh nqemh Yosepv nyei zeiv-fun, ninh yaac maiv ginv E^faa^im Fingx.
Mv baac ninh ginv Yu^ndaa Fingx, ninh hnamv nyei se Si^on Mbong.
Ninh ceix ninh nyei singx dinc hnangv hlang haic nyei lungh, yaac hnangv ninh liepc yietc liuz yiem nyei ndau-beih.
Ninh ginv ninh nyei bou, Ndaawitv, yiem ba'gi yungh ciangv dorh ninh cuotv daaih.

Ndaawitv goux dorh jienv dorn nyei ba'gi yungh nyeiz wuov zanc, Tin-Hungh heuc ninh daaih goux ninh nyei baeqc fingx, Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun, se Tin-Hungh nzipc nyei buonc, I^saa^laa^en Mienh, hnangv goux ba'gi yungh nor.
Ndaawitv longc hnyouv zingx nyei goux ninh mbuo, yaac longc cong-mengh dorh ninh mbuo.
O Tin-Hungh aac, ganh fingx mienh daaih bieqc meih ganh nzipc nyei deic-bung. Ninh mbuo bun meih nyei cing-nzengc biauv maaih uix, bun Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh mbaang nzengc.
Ninh mbuo zorqv meih nyei bou nyei sei zoux lungh zaangc norqc nyei nyanc hopv, zorqv meih nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx nyei orv bun ndau-beih nyei hieh zoih nyanc.
Ninh mbuo bun meih nyei baeqc fingx nyei nziaamv liouc cuotv hnangv wuom nor, gormx nzengc Ye^lu^saa^lem. Zungv maiv maaih mienh biopv sei.
Yie mbuo zuqc juangc laangz mienh ki yie mbuo, zuqc weih gormx nyei mienh jatv yaac huotv yie mbuo.
O Ziouv aac, meih oix qiex jiez yie mbuo ndongc haaix lauh? Taux yietc liuz fai? Meih oix qiex jiez hanc haic hnangv douz buov jienv taux haaix zanc?
Tov bun maiv nyiemc meih wuov deix fingx-fingx mienh caux maiv heuc meih nyei mbuox wuov deix maanc guoqv, zuqc meih nyei ga'qiex baetv cuotv bun ninh mbuo.
Weic zuqc ninh mbuo naqv nzengc Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun, yaac bun ninh yiem nyei dorngx benx ndau-huaang.

Tov meih maiv dungx jangx yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix zoux nyei zuiz, bun yie mbuo maiv zuqc laaix ninh mbuo dingc zuiz. Tov siepv-siepv nyei korv-lienh yie mbuo weic zuqc yie mbuo kouv taux ndiev, maiv lamh hnamv dorngx.
O yie mbuo nyei Njoux Ziouv, Tin-Hungh aac, tov meih weic meih nyei mengh nyei njang-laangc tengx yie mbuo. Tov weic meih nyei mengh njoux yie mbuo, yaac guangc yie mbuo nyei zuiz.

Ganh fingx mienh weic haaix diuc naaic, “Meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh yiem haaix?” Tov bun yie mbuo ganh nyei m'zing buatc meih jaauv maanc guoqv mienh nyei win, weic zuqc ninh mbuo bun meih nyei bou nyei nziaamv liouc cuotv.
Tov meih muangx haiz zuqc wuonx nyei mienh njunh nyei qiex, yaac ziux meih nyei domh qaqv beu jienv wuov deix oix zuqc daic nyei mienh.
O Ziouv aac, tov bun gorngv doqc ki meih wuov deix weih gormx nyei fingx-fingx mienh aengx zuqc jaa hniev taux siec gouv.
Hnangv naaic yie mbuo, meih nyei baeqc fingx, oix yietc liuz dor-ziec meih. Yie mbuo oix ceng meih taux maanc gouv maanc doic.

O goux I^saa^laa^en nyei Ziouv aac, dongh dorh Yosepv nyei zeiv-fun hnangv dorh ba'gi yungh wuov dauh aah! Tov baeng m'normh muangx. Meih yiem wuov deix i dauh ke^lu^mbim mbu'ndongx nyei weic, tov aengv cuotv meih nyei njang,
yiem E^faa^im, Mben^yaa^min caux Maa^natv^se Fingx nyei nza'hmien. Tov longc meih nyei domh qaqv daaih njoux yie mbuo.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov bun yie mbuo aengx duqv longx hnangv loz wuov nor. Tov bun meih nyei hmien aengv cuotv njang, weic bun yie mbuo duqv njoux.
O Ziouv, Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Meih oix qiex jiez meih nyei baeqc fingx daux gaux nyei waac ndongc haaix lauh?
Meih zorqv wuom-mueic dorngx hnaangx bun ninh mbuo nyanc, aengx hlaau wuom-mueic camv nyei bun ninh mbuo hopv.
Meih bun weih gormx yie mbuo wuov deix fingx-fingx mienh nzaeng yie mbuo nyei deic-bung. Yie mbuo nyei win-wangv lomh nzoih jatv.
O Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh aac, tov bun yie mbuo aengx duqv longx hnangv loz wuov nor. Tov bun meih nyei hmien aengv cuotv njang, weic bun yie mbuo duqv njoux.
Meih dorh diuh a'ngunc hmei cuotv I^yipv, meih zunc cuotv fingx-fingx mienh, zorqv naaiv diuh hmei zuangx jienv.
Meih fioux ndau bun nzungh njiec ndo, hmei mbiorngz buangv deic-bung nzengc.
Naaiv diuh hmei nzie jienv geh zorng, hmei nyei nquaah nzie jiex domh si^ndaa zongh ndiangx.
Hmei nyei nquaah mbiorngz mingh taux domh koiv, hmei nyei cunx mingh taux Yu^fe^ditc Ndaaih.
Meih weic haaix diuc mborqv waaic naaiv norm laatc? Jiex jauv nyei yietc zungv mienh ziouc gaeqv biouv.
Hieh dungz yiem lomc cuotv daaih caaiv waaic, yiem lomc-huaang nyei yietc zungv hieh zoih daaih nyanc aqv.
O Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh aac, tov meih huin nzuonx. Tov yiem wuov lungh mangc buatc, aengx goux naaiv diuh a'ngunc hmei,
dongh meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz zuangx nyei a'ngunc hmei, se meih weic ganh bun hlo daaih henv nyei.
Ninh mbuo longc douz buov naaiv diuh hmei yaac hngaqv njiec nzengc. Tov bun ninh mbuo buatc meih nyei hmien qiex jiez, ziouc mietc ninh mbuo.
Tov bun meih nyei buoz maan jienv yiem meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz nyei mienh, se dongh meih ganh liepc daaih henv wuov dauh baamh mienh.
Hnangv naaic yie mbuo ziouc yietc liuz maiv tuix nzuonx leih nqoi meih. Tov bun yie mbuo duqv maengc ziangh, yie mbuo ziouc jouh meih, kaux meih nyei mbuox.
O Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv Tin-Hungh aac, tov bun yie mbuo aengx duqv longx hnangv loz wuov nor. Tov bun meih nyei hmien aengv cuotv njang, weic bun yie mbuo duqv njoux.
Baaux nzung ceng Tin-Hungh, yie mbuo nyei qaqv. Njien-youh nyei heuc jienv ceng Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh.
Jiez gorn baaux nzung, mborqv nzoz, longc domh daanh baah caux fiuv-daanh baah patv kuh muangx nyei nzung.
Siang-Hlaax caux ziepc hmz, dongh hlaax junh wuov hnoi, jiex zipv oix zuqc biomv nzatc.
Naaiv se weic I^saa^laa^en benx diuh leiz-nyeic, benx Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh nyei leiz.
Ninh cuotv mingh mborqv I^yipv Deic-Bung wuov zanc, ninh yiem Yosepv nyei zeiv-fun mbu'ndongx liepc naaiv diuh lingc. Yiem wuov yie mbuo duqv haiz yie mbuo muangx maiv mengh baeqc nyei waac gorngv,
“Yie zorqv meih mbuo nyiex hniev nyei ga'naaiv bouh njiec, yaac zorqv meih mbuo nyei buoz bouh nyei ndaan bungx njiec mingh.
Zuqc naanc zingh nyei ziangh hoc meih mbuo heuc, yie yaac njoux meih mbuo. Yie yiem mbuonx-jieqv, mba'ong bingx nyei dorngx, dau meih mbuo. Yie yiem Me^li^mbaa Wuom seix meih mbuo.
“O yie nyei baeqc fingx aah! Muangx yie kuinx meih mbuo. O I^saa^laa^en Mienh aah! Feix duqv meih mbuo muangx yie gorngv nyei waac.
Yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx maiv dungx maaih nyiec nyei zienh, maiv dungx gueic njiec baaix ganh fingx nyei zienh.
Yie se Ziouv, meih mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh dorh meih mbuo cuotv I^yipv wuov dauh. Meih mbuo oix zuqc morngx nzuih hlo nyei, yie ziouc uix meih mbuo beuv.
“Mv baac yie nyei mienh maiv muangx yie nyei waac. I^saa^laa^en Mienh zungv maiv longc yie.
Yie ziouc sueih binc ninh mbuo ziux ninh mbuo hnyouv ngaengc nyei eix zoux. Sueih ninh mbuo ei ninh mbuo ganh nyei za'eix.
“Feix duqv yie nyei baeqc fingx muangx yie nyei waac. Feix duqv I^saa^laa^en Mienh yangh yie nyei jauv.
Yie ziouc siepv-siepv nyei hingh jiex ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv, huin nzuonx cau buoz mborqv ninh mbuo nyei win-jaa.
Nzorng Ziouv nyei mienh zungv zuqc mbaapv njiec ninh nyei nza'hmien, ninh mbuo yaac zuqc dingc zuiz taux yietc liuz.
Ziouv oix zorqv gauh longx jiex nyei mbiauh bun meih mbuo nyanc, yaac zorqv yiem la'bieiv-mbaengx nyei mueiz-dorngh bun meih mbuo buangv hnyouv.
Tin-Hungh yiem lungh zaangc nyei wuic zueiz ninh nyei weic, yiem zuangx zienh mbu'ndongx dunx sic. Ninh gorngv,
“Meih mbuo oix longc maiv baengh fim nyei leiz siemv yaac bouc orqv mienh nyei leiz ndongc haaix lauh?
Oix zuqc baengh fim nyei tengx mau nyei mienh caux guh hanh fu'jueiv yaac bouc doh naanc caux guh hanh fu'jueiv nyei leiz.
Oix zuqc njoux mau nyei caux jomc kouv nyei mienh, tengx ninh mbuo biaux ndutv orqv mienh nyei buoz-ndiev.
“Ninh mbuo maiv hiuv yaac maiv mengh baeqc, ninh mbuo yiem hmuangx yangh mingh yangh daaih. Baamh gen nyei gorn-ndoqv zungv zuqc ndanc dongz nzengc.
“Yie gorngv, ‘Meih mbuo se zienh. Meih mbuo yietc zungv zoux Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh nyei dorn.’
Mv baac meih mbuo oix zuqc daic hnangv baamh mienh nor, yaac king njiec hnangv zuangx jien mbu'ndongx nyei yietc dauh.”
O Tin-Hungh aac. Tov meih daaih siemv lungh ndiev, weic zuqc maanc guoqv benx meih nyei.
Tin-Hungh aac, tov meih maiv dungx sekv-sekv nyei yiem. O Tin-Hungh aac, tov maiv dungx kungx nqapc jienv nzuih, maiv ko lo.
Mangc maah! Meih nyei win-wangv faanv. Nzorng meih wuov deix cau jiez m'nqorngv daaih aqv.
Ninh mbuo daav guv guaix nyei za'eix hoic meih nyei baeqc fingx. Ninh mbuo lomh nzoih caangh laangh zoux bun meih beu jienv nyei mienh.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Daaih maah! Mbuo zorqv ninh mbuo yietc guoqv mienh mietc nzengc, ziouc maiv maaih haaix dauh haih jangx duqv I^saa^laa^en wuov norm mbuox.”
Ninh mbuo dongh hnyouv daav za'eix, yaac liepc jiez ngaengc waac caux meih doix-dekc.
Se maaih E^ndom Mienh caux I^saa^maa^en Mienh, Mo^apc Mienh caux Haagaa Mienh,
maaih Ge^mbaan Mienh, Ammon Mienh, caux Aa^maa^lekv Mienh, maaih Fi^li^saa^die Mienh caux Tailaqv Mienh.
Atc^si^lie Mienh yaac caux ninh mbuo gapv jienv doic. Ninh mbuo tengx qaqv Lotv nyei zeiv-fun.
Tov zoux bun ninh mbuo hnangv meih zoux bun Mi^ndien Mienh, yaac hnangv yiem Kison Ndaaih zoux bun Si^se^laa caux Yaa^mbin,
dongh yiem En^ndo zuqc mietc, benx ndau nyei buonx.
Tov bun ninh mbuo zoux hlo nyei mienh zuqc hnangv Olepv caux Se^epc, ninh mbuo nyei zuangx hungh dorn yaac zuqc hnangv Ze^mbaa caux Saanx^mun^naa.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Mbuo oix zuqc zorqv Tin-Hungh nyei miev-ciangv weic benx mbuo ganh nyei buonc.”
O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, tov bun ninh mbuo hnangv nziaaux-zunc nyei nie-mbung, yaac hnangv cuqv-maux zuqc nziaaux buonc nor.
Hnangv douz buov qui gemh, yaac hnangv douz-mbietc zieqc jienv mbong,
tov hnangv naaic longc meih nyei domh nziaaux zunc ninh mbuo, yaac longc meih nyei domh mbiungc-nziaaux haeqv ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic.
O Ziouv aac, tov bun ninh mbuo zuqc baaic hmien nyaiv nzengc weic bun ninh mbuo daaih lorz meih.
Tov bun ninh mbuo yietc liuz nyaiv yaac gamh nziex, bun ninh mbuo baaic hmien yaac zuqc mietc.
Tov bun ninh mbuo hiuv duqv kungx meih ganh hnangv, dongh maaih mbuox heuc Ziouv, se Yiem Hlang Jiex gunv lungh ndiev Wuov Dauh.
O Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv aac, yie hnamv haic meih yiem nyei dorngx.
Yie nyei hnyouv ndongc haaix oix yiem Ziouv nyei biauv, laatc gu'nyuoz, zungv haiz ngorc jienv yiem. Yie nyei sin caux hnyouv njien-youh nyei baaux nzung ceng ziangh jienv nyei Tin-Hungh.
O Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv, yie nyei Hungh, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, yiem meih nyei ziec-dorngh ga'hlen, norqc meix lorz duqv dorngx yiem, mba'hinx yaac weic ganh lorz dorngx zoux lauz buoc dorn.
Yiem meih nyei biauv wuov deix mienh maaih orn-lorqc, zanc-zanc baaux nzung ceng meih.
Kaux meih duqv qaqv wuov deix, se liepc dingc hnyouv mingh Si^on Mbong nyei mienh, maaih orn-lorqc.
Ninh mbuo jiex Mbaakaa Horngz, naaiv norm horngz tiuv benx wuom-zingv nyei dorngx. Ciou gueix mbiungc yaac bun wuov norm dorngx, zaangh wuom buangv nzengc.
Mingh nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo gunv mingh gunv henv, dauh dauh ziouc mingh taux Si^on, yiem Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien.
O Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv Tin-Hungh aah! Tov muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac. O Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov baeng m'normh muangx.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov meih mangc yie mbuo nyei torngv-baaih, tov meih mangc meih longc youh orn daaih wuov dauh nyei hmien.
Yiem meih nyei biauv nyei laatc gu'nyuoz yietc hnoi se gauh longx yiem ganh norm dorngx yietc cin hnoi. Yie yiem yie nyei Tin-Hungh nyei biauv zuov gaengh se gauh longx yiem orqv mienh nyei biauv.
Ziouv Tin-Hungh se mba'hnoi caux torngv-baaih, ninh ceix en caux njang-laangc. Maiv maaih haaix nyungc longx nyei, Ziouv ngaengc jienv maiv ceix bun zoux horpc nyei mienh.
O Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv aac, sienx kaux meih wuov deix maaih orn-lorqc.
Ziouv aac, meih ceix en bun meih nyei deic-bung. Meih bun Yaakopv nzuonx daaih duqv longx hnangv loz wuov nor.
Meih guangc meih nyei baeqc fingx nyei zuiz-nipc, zorqv nqoi ninh mbuo zoux dorngc nyei yietc zungv zuiz.
Meih dingh njiec, maiv qiex jiez ninh mbuo, meih huin nzuonx, maiv nouz ninh mbuo aqv.
Yie mbuo nyei Njoux Ziouv, Tin-Hungh aah! Tov bun yie mbuo duqv longx hnangv loz wuov nor. Tov guangc nqoi maiv dungx qiex jiez yie mbuo.
Meih oix qiex jiez yie mbuo taux yietc liuz fai? Oix nouz yie mbuo taux maanc gouv maanc doic fai?
Meih maiv bun yie mbuo aengx fingv jiez daaih weic bun yie mbuo kaux meih duqv njien-youh fai?
O Ziouv aac, tov bun cing meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie mbuo, aengx zorqv meih nyei njoux en ceix bun yie mbuo.

Yie oix muangx Ziouv Tin-Hungh gorngv nyei waac. Se gorngv ninh nyei baeqc fingx, se ninh nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx, maiv aengx nzuonx mingh zoux hngongx nyei jauv, ninh laengz bun ninh mbuo duqv baengh orn.
Ninh nyei njoux en ndongc haaix zungv yiem nitv fatv taaih ninh wuov deix mienh, weic bun ninh nyei njang-laangc yiem yie mbuo nyei deic-bung.
Ziepc zuoqv hnamv nyei jauv caux hnyouv zingx nyei jauv oix faang-buangh, baengh fim caux baengh orn oix zom jaax.
Ziepc zuoqv nyei jauv oix yiem ndau cuotv, baengh fim nyei jauv oix yiem wuov lungh mangc njiec.
Ziouv oix zorqv longx nyei ga'naaiv bun yie mbuo. Yie mbuo nyei deic-bung ziouc aengx cuotv gaeng-zuangx longx.
Baengh fim nyei jauv oix yiem ninh nyei wuov ndaangc mingh, weic liuc leiz jauv bun ninh nyei zaux caaiv.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih baeng m'normh muangx yie yaac dau yie, weic zuqc yie jomc yaac dangx-donx.
Tov beu yie nyei maengc weic zuqc yie gan longx meih. Tov njoux yie, meih nyei bou. Yie sienx kaux meih. Meih zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh.
O Ziouv aac, tov korv-lienh yie, weic zuqc yie ziangh hnoi heuc jienv tov meih.
O Ziouv aac, tov bun yie, meih nyei bou, nyei hnyouv maaih njien-youh, weic zuqc yie nyei hnyouv kaux meih maaih lamh hnamv dorngx.
O Ziouv aac, meih se longx haic yaac maaih hnyouv guangc mienh nyei zuiz. Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei zien-zien hnamv yietc zungv heuc jienv jouh meih nyei mienh.
O Ziouv aac, tov baeng m'normh muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac. Tov muangx haiz yie qaqv heuc jienv jouh nyei sing-qiex.
Buangh zuqc kouv naanc nyei hnoi-nyieqc yie heuc meih, weic zuqc meih dau yie.
O Ziouv aac, yiem yietc zungv zienh mbu'ndongx, maiv maaih haaix dauh hnangv meih. Meih zoux nyei gong, maiv maaih haaix nyungc haih beiv duqv.
O Ziouv aac, meih zeix daaih nyei maanc guoqv maanc fingx oix daaih yiem meih nyei nza'hmien gueic njiec baaix, yaac oix ceng meih nyei mengh.
Weic zuqc meih za'gengh hlo haic yaac zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic. Kungx meih ganh se Tin-Hungh.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih njaaux yie hiuv duqv meih nyei jauv weic bun yie haih ei meih nyei zien leiz yangh. Tov bun yie zunv dingc hnyouv, weic taaih meih nyei mbuox.
O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, yie longc nzengc hnyouv dor-ziec meih. Yie oix yietc liuz ceng meih nyei mbuox.
Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv hnamv mienh nyei hnyouv se hlo haic. Meih yaac njoux yie, bun yie maiv zuqc mingh yiemh gen, ndo haic nyei dorngx.
Tin-Hungh aac, zoux maux nyei mienh cuotv daaih oix hoic yie. Maaih guanh mienh doqc mienh oix zorqv yie nyei maengc. Ninh mbuo yaac maiv zorqv meih an jienv ninh mbuo nyei nza'hmien.
Mv baac Ziouv aac, meih se korv-lienh mienh, ceix en bun mienh nyei Tin-Hungh. Meih maiv qiex jiez siepv, maaih hnyouv zien-zien hnamv mienh, yaac ziepc zuoqv nyei.
Tov huin nzuonx korv-lienh yie, tov ceix meih nyei qaqv bun yie, meih nyei bou, yaac njoux meih nyei m'sieqv bou nyei dorn.
Tov biux mengh meih zoux longx weic bun nzorng yie wuov deix mienh buatc ziouc nyaiv. Weic zuqc Ziouv aac, meih tengx yie yaac orn yie nyei hnyouv.
Ziouv liepc nyei zingh yiem cing-nzengc mbong gu'nguaaic.
Ninh hnamv Si^on nyei zingh gaengh, gauh camv Yaakopv yiem nyei norm-norm dorngx.
O Tin-Hungh nyei zingh aac, mienh nuqv jienv gorngv meih njang-laangc nyei jauv.

Mangc maah! Yiem hiuv duqv yie nyei mienh yie lengc jeiv oix tih taux Laa^hapc caux Mbaa^mbi^lon. Fi^li^saa^die caux Tailaqv caux jienv E^ti^o^bie. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Naaiv laanh mienh yiem Si^on cuotv seix.”
Ninh mbuo oix zorqv Si^on nyei jauv-louc daaih gorngv, “Naaiv laanh caux wuov laanh yiem naaic cuotv seix,” weic zuqc Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh ganh oix liepc naaiv norm zingh.
Ziouv faaux maanc fingx nyei mienh hoz daan nyei ziangh hoc ninh fiev jienv, “Naaiv laanh yiem Si^on cuotv seix.”
Baaux nzung caux cangx heix nyei mienh oix gorngv, “Yie nyei yietc zungv wuom-zingv yiem meih gu'nyuoz.”
O Ziouv, yie nyei njoux en nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Yie lungh hnoi lungh muonz yiem meih nyei nza'hmien heuc jienv jouh meih.
Tov bun yie daux gaux nyei waac daaih taux meih nyei nza'hmien. Tov baeng m'normh muangx yie heuc jienv tov nyei waac.
Weic zuqc yie nyei hnyouv maaih kuonx naanh buangv nzengc. Yie nyei maengc yiem nitv fatv yiemh gen.
Yie funx caux aav lamh bieqc yiemh gen wuov deix fih hnangv nyei. Yie yaac hnangv maiv maaih qaqv nyei mienh.

Yie hnangv zuqc guangc yiem janx-daic mbu'ndongx nyei mienh nor, hnangv zuqc daix daic nyei mienh bueix jienv zouv gu'nyuoz, dongh meih maiv zoix jangx nyei mienh, yaac nqaeqv ndutv maiv duqv meih tengx.
Meih zorqv yie dapv ndo jiex nyei kuotv, youc hmuangx youc ndo nyei dorngx.
Meih nouz yie hnangv ngatv jienv yie nyei sin, yaac hnangv wuom-laangc nqomz jienv yie nor.
Meih bun yie nyei loz-gaeng doic guangc yie, yaac bun ninh mbuo gamh nziev yie. Yie zuqc kuonx jienv, maiv haih biaux maiv ndutv.
Laaix nzauh kouv yie nyei m'zing maiv njang. O Ziouv aac, yie hnoi-hnoi heuc jienv tov meih. Yie sung buoz hungx jienv meih daux gaux.
Meih weic daic mingh nyei mienh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic fai? Ninh mbuo haih jiez sin ceng meih fai?
Yiem zouv gu'nyuoz ninh mbuo gorngv meih ziepc zuoqv hnamv mienh nyei fai? Yiem zuqc mietc nyei dorngx gorngv taux meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv fai?
Yiem hmuangx nyei dorngx ninh mbuo fungc hiuv duqv meih zoux nyei mbuoqc horngh sic? Yiem la'kuqv mienh nyei dorngx ninh mbuo haih hiuv duqv meih ziepc zuoqv nyei jauv fai?
Mv baac Ziouv aac, yie heuc jienv jouh meih. Lungh ndorm yie daux gaux tov meih.
O Ziouv aac, meih weic haaix diuc guangc yie? Weic haaix diuc buang meih nyei hmien, maiv mangc yie?
Yiem yie lunx taux ih zanc yie zuqc zeqc naanc morh, kaav deix daic mi'aqv. Yie diev jienv meih zoux bun yie gamh nziex nyei sic, yie kouv taux ndoqv.
Meih qiex jiez nouz hnangv ngatv jienv yie. Meih bun yie zuqc gamh nziex nyei sic zorqv yie mietc nzengc.
Naaiv deix ziangh hnoi weih jienv yie, hnangv wuom yiemx nor, yiem biei bung dangv jienv yie.
Meih zorqv yie hnamv nyei doic caux yie nyei loz-gaeng doic leih guangc yie. Kungx maaih hmuangx zoux yie nyei doic hnangv.
O Ziouv aac, yie oix yietc liuz baaux nzung ceng meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh. Yie oix longc yie nyei nzuih zunh meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv gorngv mbuox yietc doic jiex yietc doic.
Yie oix gorngv meih oix yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh. Meih maaih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv ndongc lungh wuonv.
Meih gorngv, yie caux yie ginv daaih nyei mienh liepc jiez ngaengc waac, yie caux yie nyei bou, Ndaawitv, houv jienv waac
gorngv, “Yie oix liepc meih nyei zeiv-fun taux yietc liuz, liepc meih nyei hungh weic taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
O Ziouv aac, tov bun lungh ceng meih zoux wuov deix mbuoqc horngh nyei sic, yaac bun cing-nzengc wuov deix yiem gapv zunv nyei dorngx ceng meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv.
Yiem wuov lungh maaih haaix dauh haih hnangv Ziouv? Yiem lungh zaangc wuov deix maaih haaix dauh haih ndongc Ziouv?
Se yiem cing-nzengc wuov deix nyei wuic gu'nyuoz ninh mbuo taaih nyei Tin-Hungh. Yiem weih gormx ninh nyei yietc zungv ninh gauh hlo gauh peix fuc jiex.
O Nernh Jiex nyei Ziouv Tin-Hungh aac, maiv maaih haaix dauh ndongc meih henv. O Ziouv aac, meih zoux nyei yietc zungv se ziepc zuoqv nyei.
Meih gunv seix haic nyei koiv. Koiv jiez domh laangc meih bun sekv nzengc.
Meih mborqv huv Laa^hapc hnangv daix daic nyei mienh, meih longc meih henv haic nyei buoz mborqv meih nyei win-wangv nzaanx nzengc.
Lungh benx meih nyei. Ndau yaac meih nyei. Baamh gen caux yiem baamh gen nyei maanc muotc meih zeix daaih.
Naamh bung caux baqv bung meih zeix daaih. Taa^mbo Mbong caux Hemon Mbong njien-youh nyei ceng meih nyei mengh.
Meih nyei buoz maaih qaqv henv haic. Meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz yaac sung faaux hlang.
Zoux horpc nyei jauv caux baengh fim nyei sic zoux meih nyei weic nyei gorn-ndoqv. Meih zoux nyei yietc zungv se meih hnamv mienh yaac ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux.
O Ziouv aac, hiuv duqv njien-youh nyei heuc wuov deix mienh maaih orn-lorqc, se yiem meih nyei nza'hmien nyei njang yangh nyei mienh.
Ninh mbuo weic meih nyei mbuox ziangh hnoi njien-youh. Ninh mbuo yaac ceng meih weic meih zoux horpc nyei jauv.
Meih se ninh mbuo nyei qaqv nyei njang-laangc. Meih ceix en bun yie mbuo nyei qaqv henv jienv faaux.
Yie mbuo nyei torngv-baaih benx Ziouv nyei, yie mbuo nyei hungh diex guei I^saa^laa^en nyei Cing-Nzengc Tin-Hungh.

Zinh ndaangc lauh aqv, meih yiem laauc yaangh nyei sic gorngv mbuox meih nyei ziepc zuoqv baeqc fingx, “Yie bun qaqv yietc dauh mborqv jaax henv nyei mienh. Yie yiem baeqc fingx mbu'ndongx ginv dauh yaac taaih ninh zoux hlo.
Yie lorz buatc yie nyei bou, Ndaawitv, yaac longc yie nyei cing-nzengc youh orn ninh.
Yie nyei buoz oix liepc ninh wuonv, yaac oix bun qaqv ninh henv.
Win-wangv zungv maiv haih noic maiv duqv ninh, orqv mienh yaac maiv haih bun ninh zuqc baaic.
Yie oix yiem ninh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx mborqv muonc ninh nyei win-wangv, yaac daix nzengc yietc zungv nzorng ninh wuov deix mienh.
Yie oix hnamv ninh yaac ziepc zuoqv nyei caux ninh yiem. Weic yie nyei mengh ninh nyei qaqv oix henv jienv faaux.
Yie oix bun ninh nyei buoz sung koiv gu'nguaaic, ninh nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz yaac sung ndaaih gu'nguaaic.
Ninh oix heuc jienv mbuox yie, “Meih se yie nyei die, yie nyei Tin-Hungh, caux bun yie duqv njoux nyei La'bieiv.”
Yie oix bun ninh zoux yie nyei dorn-la'gauv, yiem lungh ndiev zoux gauh hlo jiex nyei hungh.
Yie oix ziepc zuoqv nyei yietc liuz hnamv ninh, yie caux ninh liepc nyei ngaengc waac yaac yietc liuz wuonv nyei.
Yie oix liepc ninh nyei hungh douh taux yietc liuz, yaac bun ninh nyei hungh weic ndongc lungh nyei hnoi-nyieqc lauh.
Se gorngv ninh nyei zeiv-fun guangc yie nyei leiz-latc, maiv gan yie nyei leiz,
se gorngv ninh mbuo baamz yie nyei leiz-nyeic, yaac maiv gan yie nyei lingc,
yie ziouc longc biaav dingc ninh mbuo baamz nyei zuiz, longc biaav-bin mborqv weic ninh mbuo zoux dorngc nyei sic.
Mv baac yie ziepc zuoqv hnamv nyei hnyouv yie maiv zorqv nzuonx, yaac maiv guangc yie ziepc zuoqv zoux nyei jauv.
Yie maiv bungx ndortv yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac, yaac maiv goiv yie nyei nzuih gorngv cuotv nyei waac.
Yie ziangv jienv yie nyei cing-nzengc mbuox houv nzunc dorngx yietc liuz, yie maiv gorngv-baeqc nduov Ndaawitv.
Ninh nyei hungh douh oix yietc liuz yiem, ninh nyei hungh weic oix yiem yie nyei nza'hmien ndongc mba'hnoi lauh,
aengx hnangv hlaax nor, liepc daaih taux yietc liuz, yaac yiem wuonv ndongc lungh lauh.
Mv baac meih qiex jiez meih longc youh orn daaih wuov dauh ziouc guangc aengx nqemh ninh.
Meih tuix meih caux meih nyei bou liepc nyei ngaengc waac. Meih zorqv ninh nyei hungh ningv zoi njiec nie-mbung bun maaih uix.
Meih caeqv nzengc ninh nyei yietc zungv zingh laatc, bun ninh weih jienv wuonv nyei dorngx baaic waaic nzengc.
Da'faanh jiex jauv nyei mienh caangv ninh nyei ga'naaiv, laangz zaangc mienh yaac huotv ninh.
Meih bun ninh nyei win-wangv duqv hingh jiex, bun ninh nyei yietc zungv win-jaa njien-youh.
Meih zungv bun ninh nyei nzuqc ndaauv nyei nza'hmien mbienv mi'aqv, yaac bun ninh yiem mborqv jaax ciangv zuqc suei.
Meih bun ninh nyei njang-laangc zitc nzengc, yaac zorqv ninh nyei hungh weic fongv njiec ndau.
Meih jamv ninh lunx nyei ziangh hoc zoqc njiec, yaac bun ninh buang hmien diev nyaiv.
O Ziouv aac, ndongc haaix lauh? Meih oix zorqv meih ganh bingx taux yietc liuz fai? Meih oix qiex jiez hnangv douz buov jienv taux haaix zanc?
O Ziouv aac, tov jangx jienv yie nyei maengc ndongc haaix nangv. Meih zeix mienh maanh daaih bun ninh mbuo ndongc naaic maiv lamh longc yietc deix.
Maaih haaix dauh ziangh yaac maiv zuqc daic? Fai haaix dauh haih njoux ninh ganh leih ndutv yiemh gen nyei qaqv?
Ziouv aac, meih zinh ndaangc ziepc zuoqv hnamv nyei hnyouv jiex haaix? Se meih ziepc zuoqv nyei caux Ndaawitv laengz jiex nyei waac yiem haaix?
O Ziouv aac, tov jangx jienv meih nyei bou hnangv haaix nor zuqc mienh huotv, yaac jangx jienv yie nyei hnyouv hnangv haaix nor diev maanc mienh ki.
O Ziouv aac, meih nyei win-wangv huotv meih longc youh orn daaih wuov dauh. Maiv gunv mingh taux haaix ninh mbuo jatv ninh.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv taux yietc liuz. Aamen caux Aamen.
Ziouv aac, maanc gouv maanc doic meih zoux yie mbuo yiem nyei dorngx.
Zinh ndaangc meih maiv gaengh zeix cuotv mbong, yaac maiv gaengh zeix ndau-beih caux baamh gen, yiem loz! hnoi taux nqa'haav hingv meih m'daaih zoux Tin-Hungh taux yietc liuz.
Meih bun mienh nzuonx benx nie-mbung. Meih gorngv, “Baamh mienh nyei naamh nyouz aac, oix zuqc nzuonx benx nie-mbung.”
Weic zuqc ziux meih mangc, yietc cin hnyangx se hnangv jiex liuz nyei yietc hnoi, fai hnangv lungh muonz zanc yietc gaeng nor.
Meih guaatv mienh mingh mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo hnangv mbeix norm mbeix nor, yaac hnangv lungh ndorm nziouv cuotv daaih nyei miev,
lungh ndorm nziouv baetv cuotv hlo daaih, lungh maanz-hmuangx nyaux, kou nqaai mi'aqv.
Yie mbuo zuqc meih qiex jiez, mietc nzengc yie mbuo. Zuqc meih nouz ziouc haeqv yie mbuo gamh nziex haic.
Meih zorqv yie mbuo nyei zuiz baaiv jienv meih nyei nza'hmien, zorqv yie mbuo bingx jienv zoux nyei zuiz an meih nyei nza'hmien, njang nyei dorngx.
Yie mbuo ziangh jienv nyei yietc zungv hnoi-nyieqc zuqc meih nouz. Yie mbuo ziangh nyei hnyangx-daauh jiex liuz hnangv tauv nzunc qiex-ndoqc nor.

Yie mbuo nyei hnyangx-daauh ziangh duqv taux cietv ziepc, henv nyei nor, haih ziangh taux betv ziepc, mv baac naaiv deix ziangh hoc gu'nyuoz kungx laauh luic, nzauh kouv hnangv, maiv lauh jiex liuz aqv. Yie mbuo yaac fih hnangv nyei jiex mi'aqv.
Haaix dauh mengh baeqc meih qiex jiez nyei qaqv? Haaix dauh hiuv meih nouz nyei jauv hnangv taaih meih nyei mienh?
Tov njaaux yie mbuo saauv ganh nyei hnoi-nyieqc, weic bun yie mbuo haih maaih cong-mengh nyei hnyouv.
O Ziouv aac, meih oix qiex jiez ndongc haaix lauh? Tov huin nzuonx daaih. Tov korv-lienh meih nyei bou.
Tov bun yie mbuo ndorm-ndorm buangv eix meih ziepc zuoqv hnamv nyei hnyouv, weic bun yie mbuo yietc seix njien-youh a'hneiv.
Tov bun yie mbuo duqv njien-youh ndongc meih bun yie mbuo zuqc kouv nyei hnoi-nyieqc lauh, yaac ndongc yie mbuo zuqc ciouv nyei zeqc naanc nyei hnyangx-daauh.
Tov bun meih nyei bou buatc meih zoux nyei sic, yaac bun ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun buatc meih nyei njang-laangc nyei qaqv.
Tov Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, bun yie mbuo duqv longx. Tov liepc wuonv yie mbuo nyei buoz zoux nyei gong. Tov za'gengh liepc wuonv yie mbuo nyei buoz zoux nyei gong.
Haaix dauh yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh nyei torngv laangh dorngx, se zanx yiem Nernh Jiex Wuov Dauh nyei dongh linh gu'nyuoz,
wuov dauh ziouc gorngv mbuox Ziouv, “Meih se yie ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx, caux weih wuonv nyei dorngx, yie nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh yie kaux wuov dauh.”
Ninh oix njoux meih simv ndutv zaeng norqc mienh nyei koux, caux doqc haic nyei wuon-baengc.

Ninh zungv longc ninh nyei ndaatv gomv jienv meih. Yiem ninh nyei ndaatv ga'ndiev ziouc bun meih maaih ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx. Ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv zoux domh torngv-baaih, fiuv-torngv-baaih beu jienv.
Meih yaac maiv zuqc gamh nziex lungh muonz-zanc nyei heiv sic, fai lungh hnoi zanc buonv daaih nyei forng-cang,
fai lungh muonz zanc daaih nyei domh wuon-baengc, fai lungh aanx zanc bun mienh zuqc mietc nyei zeqc naanc.
Nziex haih maaih yietc cin dauh mienh king njiec meih nyei ga'hlen, yietc waanc dauh king njiec meih nyei mbiaauc maengx, mv baac naaiv deix sic maiv daaih nitv fatv meih.
Meih ganh nyei m'zing ziouc mangc buatc winh bun orqv mienh zuqc dingc nyei zuiz.
Weic zuqc meih bun Ziouv, zoux meih ndaauh kaux wuov dauh, se Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh, benx meih yiem nyei dorngx,
maiv maaih haaix nyungc ciouv nyei sic ndortv zuqc meih. Maiv maaih haaix nyungc siem nyei zeqc naanc daaih nitv fatv meih nyei biauv,
weic zuqc Tin-Hungh oix paaiv ninh nyei fin-mienh goux jienv meih, beu jienv meih maiv gunv meih mingh taux haaix.
Ninh mbuo oix longc buoz bouh jienv meih, maiv bun meih nyei zaux zong zuqc la'bieiv.
Meih oix caaiv sienh caux naang-jieqv, oix ndamc sienh lunx caux domh naang.
Tin-Hungh gorngv, “Weic zuqc ninh longc hnyouv hnamv yie, yie ziouc dau ninh. Yie oix beu jienv ninh, weic zuqc ninh nyiemc yie nyei mbuox.
Se gorngv ninh heuc yie, yie ziouc dau ninh. Ninh buangh zuqc haaix nyungc naanc zingh, yie oix caux ninh yiem. Yie oix njoux ninh yaac taaih ninh.
Yie oix bun ninh buangv eix duqv siouc nyuonh ndaauv, yaac bun ninh buatc yie nyei njoux en.”
O Yiem Hlang Jiex nyei Ziouv aac, mienh dor-ziec, baaux nzung ceng meih nyei mengh se longx haic.
Lungh ndorm zunh yaangh meih ziepc zuoqv hnamv mienh, lungh muonz zanc zunh yaangh meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv.
Longc ziepc diuh finx patv nyei jaa-sic caux domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah patv puix nzung nyei pou.
O Ziouv aac, meih zoux nyei sic bun yie a'hneiv, meih nyei buoz zoux nyei gong bun yie njien-youh nyei baaux nzung.
O Ziouv aac, meih zoux nyei gong za'gengh hlo haic, meih nyei hnyouv hnamv nyei sic yaac ndo.
Mienh hnam mienh maiv haih hiuv, mienh hngongx mienh maiv haih mengh baeqc,
maiv gunv mienh waaic mienh hnangv miev baetv cuotv, yietc zungv orqv mienh yaac duqv longx jienv faaux, ninh mbuo za'gengh oix zuqc mietc taux yietc liuz.
Mv baac Ziouv aac, meih yietc liuz duqv zoux hlo jiex.
O Ziouv aac, meih nyei win-wangv, meih nyei win-jaa zungv oix zuqc mietc. Orqv mienh yietc zungv oix zuqc nzaanx.
Meih bun yie henv hnangv hieh ngongh nor, meih longc siang-youh dox jienv yie.
Yie nyei m'zing duqv buatc yie nyei win-wangv suei. Yie nyei m'normh muangx haiz oix mborqv yie wuov deix orqv mienh zuqc mietc.
Kuv mienh oix hnangv daau nor hiaangx, yaac hlo daaih hnangv yiem Le^mbaa^norn nyei si^ndaa zongh ndiangx nor.
Ninh mbuo hnangv zuangx yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv nyei ndiangx, yiem yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei laatc gu'nyuoz hiaangx jiez daaih.
Ninh mbuo hnyangx-jeiv gox mv baac corc ziangh biouv, haaix zanc yaac nyiemz, maeng nyei,
weic bun cing Ziouv se zien nyei. Ninh se yie nyei La'bieiv, yiem ninh maiv maaih haaix nyungc maiv horpc.
Ziouv zoux hungh. Haangh daauh benx ninh nyei zorng-zuqv. Ziouv zuqv jienv aengx longc domh qaqv sai jienv. Baamh gen liepc duqv wuonv, maiv haih zuqc ndanc dongz.
Meih nyei weic yiem dongh cor liepc daaih, loz-hnoi meih m'daaih yietc liuz yiem.
O Ziouv aac, domh wuom jiez laangc seix, domh wuom cuotv qiex mbui, domh wuom mbui zoz-zoz nyei.
Yiem Hlang Jiex nyei Ziouv maaih domh qaqv, gauh henv jiex domh wuom nyei qiex mbui, gauh henv jiex koiv nyei domh wuom-laangc.
O Ziouv aac, meih nyei lingc se wuonv nyei. Meih nyei biauv puix duqv cing-nzengc, taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
O Ziouv aac, meih se jaauv win nyei Tin-Hungh. Jaauv win nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov ziux cuotv njang daaih maah!
Siemv lungh ndiev nyei Jien aah! Daaih maah! Daaih bun zoux maux nyei mienh duqv ziux ninh mbuo horpc zuqc duqv nyei buonc.
Ziouv aac, orqv mienh oix a'hneiv ndongc haaix lauh? Oix ndongc haaix lauh?
Ninh mbuo bungx waac-maux. Yietc zungv zoux orqv nyei mienh ceng-hlo.
O Ziouv aac, ninh mbuo njiec qaqv zeix meih nyei baeqc fingx yaac hoic meih nzipc nyei buonc.
Ninh mbuo daix auv-guaav caux yiem deic-bung nyei ganh fingx mienh, yaac daix guh hanh fu'jueiv.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “ Ziouv maiv buatc. Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh maiv hnamv taux.”
Yiem baeqc fingx mbu'ndongx nyei mienh hngongx mienh aah! Oix zuqc hiuv aqv. Meih mbuo mbanc haic nyei mienh aah! Meih mbuo taux haaix zanc cingx guai?
Tin-Hungh zeix m'normh, ninh ganh muangx maiv haiz fai? Ninh zeix m'zing, ninh ganh mangc maiv buatc?
Ninh mborqv njaaux maanc guoqv mienh, ninh maiv zeiz oix dingc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz? Ninh njaaux baamh mienh, ninh ganh maiv maaih wuonh zaang fai?
Ziouv hiuv duqv baamh mienh hnamv nyei sic kungx hnangv tauv yietc nzunc qiex.
O Ziouv aac, meih mborqv njaaux nyei mienh maaih orn-lorqc, se meih longc meih nyei leiz-latc njaaux nyei mienh.
Yiem ninh zuqc kouv nyei hnoi-nyieqc meih bun ninh duqv fong deix, zuov wetv ziangx kuotv bun orqv mienh zuqc mietc.
Weic zuqc Ziouv zungv maiv guangc ninh ganh nyei baeqc fingx, ninh maiv leih guangc ninh nzipc daaih nyei buonc.
Siemv nyei jauv ziouc aengx nzuonx daaih gan baengh fim nyei leiz. Yietc zungv hnyouv zingx nyei mienh yaac oix gan.
Maaih haaix dauh weic yie jiez daaih ngaengc orqv mienh? Haaix dauh weic yie ngaengc jienv zoux orqv nyei mienh?
Se gorngv Ziouv maiv tengx yie, yie zungv siepv-siepv nyei mingh yiem sekv nzieqc nyei deic-bung.
Yie gorngv, “Yie nyei zaux caaiv piatv mi'aqv.” O Ziouv aac, wuov zanc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie ziouc baav jienv yie.
Yie maaih you-nzauh kuonx hnyouv nyei sic camv nyei ziangh hoc, meih orn yie nyei hnyouv bun yie njien-youh.
Waaic haic nyei gunv sic jien haih caux meih jiu tong nyei fai? Ninh mbuo longc leiz-nyeic zoux waaic nyei sic.
Ninh mbuo gapv zunv hoic kuv mienh nyei maengc yaac dingc daix maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh.
Mv baac Ziouv se yie kaux wuonv nyei dorngx, yie nyei Tin-Hungh, se yie ndaauh kaux nyei la'bieiv.
Ninh oix ziux ninh mbuo zoux dorngc nyei zuiz winh bun ninh mbuo, weic ninh mbuo zoux nyei orqv sic mietc ninh mbuo. Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, oix mietc nzengc ninh mbuo.
Daaih maah! Mbuo oix zuqc daaih baaux nzung ceng Ziouv. Mbuo njien-youh nyei heuc jienv ceng njoux yie mbuo nyei La'bieiv.
Mbuo oix zuqc daaih yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien dor-ziec ninh, yaac oix zuqc njien-youh nyei heuc jienv baaux nzung ceng ninh.
Weic zuqc Ziouv se hlo haic nyei Tin-Hungh, yaac zoux domh Hungh Diex, gauh hlo jiex maanc zienh.
Ndau-ndiev ndo jiex nyei dorngx yiem ninh nyei buoz gu'nyuoz. Hlang jiex nyei mbong yaac benx ninh nyei.
Koiv benx ninh nyei, weic zuqc ninh ganh zeix daaih. Ninh nyei buoz zeix cuotv ndau-beih.
Daaih maah! Mbuo oix zuqc puoqv njiec baaix ninh. Mbuo oix zuqc gueic njiec Zeix Mbuo Daaih Wuov Dauh Ziouv nyei nza'hmien.
Weic zuqc ninh benx mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Mbuo se ninh nyei miev-ciangv nyei baeqc fingx, yiem ninh nyei buoz-ndiev nyei ba'gi yungh. Tov meih mbuo ih hnoi muangx ninh nyei qiex.
Maiv dungx zoux hnyouv ngaengc hnangv zinh ndaangc yiem Me^li^mbaa, yaac hnangv yiem deic-bung-huaang, Matv^saax, wuov hnoi nor.
Wuov zanc meih mbuo nyei ong-taaix seix yie yaac cuoqv yie, maiv gunv ninh mbuo buatc yie zoux nyei sic.
Feix ziepc hnyangx gu'nyuoz yie nouz haic naaic doic mienh. Yie gorngv, “Ninh mbuo benx yietc fingx hnyouv maiv zingx nyei mienh. Ninh mbuo yaac maiv bieqc hnyouv yie nyei jauv.”
Weic naaiv yie qiex jiez ziouc houv jienv gorngv, “Ninh mbuo yietc liuz maiv duqv bieqc yie nyei hitv kuonx dorngx.”
Oix zuqc baaux diuh siang-nzung bun Ziouv. Lungh ndiev oix zuqc baaux nzung bun Ziouv.
Baaux nzung bun Ziouv, baaux ceng ninh nyei mengh, hnoi-hnoi zunh yaangh ninh nyei njoux en.
Yiem maanc guoqv zunh yaangh ninh nyei njang-laangc. Yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx gorngv ninh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Weic zuqc Ziouv se hlo haic, horpc zuqc camv-camv nyei ceng, oix zuqc taaih ninh gauh camv maanc zienh.
Weic zuqc zuangx fingx nyei yietc zungv zienh benx miuc-fangx hnangv, mv baac Ziouv zeix lungh.
Maaih njang-laangc caux haangh daauh yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien, yiem ninh nyei singx dinc bun cing ninh maaih qaqv yaac nzueic haic.
O maanc fingx mienh aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv nyei njang-laangc caux qaqv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv puix ninh njang-laangc nyei mbuox, dorh fongc horc nyei ga'naaiv daaih bieqc ninh nyei singx dinc nyei laatc gu'nyuoz.
Zaangc Ziouv nyei ziangh hoc oix zuqc zuqv cing-nzengc nyei lui-houx. Lungh ndiev mienh aah! Oix zuqc sin zinx jienv yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien.
Yiem maanc guoqv mbu'ndongx oix zuqc gorngv, “ Ziouv zoux hungh.” Baamh gen liepc duqv wuonv, maiv maaih haaix nyungc haih ndanc duqv dongz. Ninh yaac oix baengh fim nyei siemv maanc fingx.
Lungh aah! Oix zuqc njien-youh. Ndau aah! Oix zuqc orn-lorqc. Koiv caux yiem koiv nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv oix zuqc zoz-zoz nyei mbui.
Lingh deic caux yiem lingh deic gu'nyuoz nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv, oix zuqc njien-youh a'hneiv. Wuov zanc lomc zaangc nyei yietc zungv ndiangx ziouc njien-youh nyei baaux nzung,
yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien, weic zuqc ninh oix daaih siemv lungh ndiev. Ninh oix baengh fim nyei siemv baamh gen, yaac longc ninh nyei zien leiz siemv maanc fingx.
Ziouv zoux hungh, bun lungh ndiev ndau-beih njien-youh, bun zuangx koiv-nzou a'hneiv.
Maaih mbuonx caux hmatv jieqv nyei hmuangx weih gormx ninh, zoux horpc nyei jauv caux baengh fim nyei jauv zoux ninh nyei weic nyei gorn-ndoqv.
Maaih douz yiem ninh nyei wuov ndaangc maengx buov qui weih gormx ninh wuov deix win-wangv.
Ninh nyei mba'lingc bun lungh ndiev njang nzengc. Ndau-beih buatc ziouc dongz nzengc.
Mbong yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien yuqc hnangv mueiz-nzing nor, se yiem lungh ndiev nyei Ziouv nyei nza'hmien.
Lungh bun cing Tin-Hungh se baengh fim nyei, maanc fingx yaac buatc ninh nyei njang-laangc.
Bun yietc zungv baaix miuc-fangx nyei mienh zuqc nyaiv, dongh ceng maiv lamh longc nyei miuc-fangx nyei mienh. Bun maanc zienh puoqv njiec Tin-Hungh nyei nza'hmien.
O Tin-Hungh aac, Si^on muangx haiz meih dunx nyei sic ziouc a'hneiv. Yu^ndaa Mienh yaac orn-lorqc.
O Ziouv aac, meih se Yiem Hlang Jiex, gunv lungh ndiev Wuov Dauh. Meih yaac yiem gauh hlang jiex maanc zienh.
Meih mbuo hnamv Ziouv nyei mienh oix zuqc nzorng orqv nyei sic. Ninh beu jienv ninh nyei cing-nzengc mienh nyei maengc. Ninh njoux ninh mbuo biaux ndutv orqv mienh nyei buoz-ndiev.
Njang ziux jienv kuv mienh, hnyouv zingx nyei mienh maaih njien-youh.
Meih mbuo kuv mienh aah! Oix zuqc kaux Ziouv njien-youh, yaac oix zuqc dor-ziec ninh nyei cing-nzengc mengh.
Oix zuqc baaux diuh siang-nzung ceng Ziouv weic zuqc ninh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic. Ninh nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz caux cing-nzengc qaqv bun ninh duqv hingh jiex.
Ziouv bun mienh hiuv duqv ninh hingh jiex ninh bun maanc fingx hiuv duqv ninh baengh fim nyei.
Ninh jangx taux ninh weic I^saa^laa^en Mienh maaih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv yaac hnamv ninh mbuo. Gormx lungh ndiev duqv buatc mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh duqv hingh jiex.
Lungh ndiev mienh aah! Oix zuqc njien-youh nyei heuc jienv ceng Ziouv. Cuotv qiex njien-youh nyei baaux nzung ceng ninh.
Patv daanh baah baaux nzung ceng Ziouv, longc daanh baah patv puix nzung nyei sing-qiex.
Longc nzatc caux jorng nyei qiex, cuotv njien-youh nyei qiex mbui fungx bun Ziouv, mbuo nyei Hungh Diex.
Koiv caux yiem koiv nyei ga'naaiv, lungh ndiev caux yiem lungh ndiev nyei ga'naaiv oix zuqc cuotv qiex mbui.
Bun zuangx ndaaih mbaix ninh mbuo nyei buoz, zuangx mbong oix zuqc lomh nzoih njien-youh nyei baaux nzung
yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien, weic zuqc ninh oix daaih siemv lungh ndiev. Ninh oix baengh fim nyei siemv baamh gen, yaac longc gong-fim siemv maanc fingx.
Ziouv zoux hungh. Oix zuqc bun maanc fingx sin zinx. Ninh yiem wuov deix i dauh ke^lu^mbim mbu'ndongx nyei weic, bun ndau-beih zuqc ndanc dongz.
Ziouv yiem Si^on zoux hlo, ninh zungv zoux gauh hlo jiex maanc fingx.
Dauh dauh oix zuqc ceng meih hlo haic caux mbuoqc horngh nyei mbuox. Ninh se cing-nzengc.
Henv nyei Hungh Diex aah! Meih hnamv baengh fim nyei jauv yaac liepc gong-fim. Yiem I^saa^laa^en Mienh mbu'ndongx meih zoux horpc caux baengh fim nyei sic.
Ceng Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Yiem ninh lorngx zaux nyei dorngx baaix ninh. Ninh se cing-nzengc nyei.
Yiem ninh nyei sai mienh mbu'ndongx maaih Mose caux Aalon. Saa^mu^en yaac benx dauh jouh ninh nyei mbuox nyei mienh. Ninh mbuo heuc Ziouv, ninh yaac dau ninh mbuo.
Ninh yiem mbuonx-ndiouh gu'nyuoz caux ninh mbuo gorngv waac. Ninh mbuo ei jienv ninh gorngv nyei waac caux jiu bun ninh mbuo nyei leiz-nyeic.
O Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh aac, meih dau ninh mbuo. Meih se guangc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz nyei Tin-Hungh, mv baac ziux ninh mbuo zoux dorngc nyei jauv meih winh bun ninh mbuo.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Yiem ninh nyei cing-nzengc mbong zaangc ninh, weic zuqc Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, se cing-nzengc nyei.
Lungh ndiev nyei zuangx mienh aah! Oix zuqc njien-youh nyei heuc jienv ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc a'hneiv nyei fu-sux Ziouv, oix zuqc baaux jienv nzung daaih yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien.
Oix zuqc hiuv duqv Ziouv se Tin-Hungh, se dongh ninh zeix mbuo daaih, mbuo yaac benx ninh nyei, mbuo benx ninh nyei baeqc fingx, ninh nyei miev-ciangv nyei ba'gi yungh.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec jienv bieqc ninh nyei singx dinc nyei laatc gaengh, ceng jienv bieqc laatc gu'nyuoz. Oix zuqc dor-ziec ninh, ceng ninh nyei mengh,
weic zuqc Ziouv za'gengh longx haic. Ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh. Ninh maaih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Yie oix baaux nzung gorngv ziepc zuoqv nyei caux baengh fim nyei jauv. O Ziouv aac, yie oix baaux nzung bun meih.
Yie oix longc hnyouv yangh maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei jauv. Meih taux haaix zanc cingx daaih yie naaiv? Yie oix hnyouv zingx nyei yiem yie nyei biauv.
Orqv haic nyei ga'naaiv yie zungv maiv bun doix hmien doix minc. Yie nzorng leih Tin-Hungh nyei mienh zoux nyei sic, yie zungv maiv bun guoqv zuqc yie.
Yie yaac maiv nyiemc hnyouv njuotv nyei mienh, maiv bun haaix nyungc orqv sic guen zuqc yie.
Haaix dauh beic ndiev gorngv doqc ninh juangc laangz nyei gorx-youz yie oix mietc nzengc. Zoux maux, ceng-hlo nyei mienh yie diev maiv duqv.
Yie nyei m'zing oix mangc jienv yiem deic-bung ziepc zuoqv nyei mienh, weic bun ninh mbuo duqv caux yie yiem. Haaix dauh yangh maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei jauv, ziouc duqv fu-sux yie.
Haaix dauh zoux nduov mienh nyei mienh maiv duqv yiem yie nyei biauv. Haaix dauh gorngv-baeqc, maiv duqv yiem yie nyei nza'hmien.
Ndorm-ndorm yie oix mietc yiem deic-bung nyei yietc zungv orqv mienh. Yie oix zorqv dauh dauh zoux waaic sic nyei mienh pai guangc, maiv bun yiem Ziouv nyei zingh.
O Ziouv aac, tov muangx yie daux gaux nyei waac. Tov bun yie heuc jienv jouh nyei waac taux meih nyei m'normh.
Yie zuqc kouv naanc nyei ziangh hoc, tov maiv dungx buang meih nyei hmien maiv mangc yie. Tov baeng m'normh muangx yie. Yie haaix zanc heuc tov siepv-siepv nyei dau yie.
Weic zuqc yie nyei hnoi-nyieqc hnangv douz-sioux mitc nzengc. Yie nyei mbungv yaac hnangv douz buov jienv nor.
Yie nyei hnyouv zuqc siang hnangv miev nor nyaux nqaai, yie zungv maiv jangx nyanc hnaangx.
Laaix yie njunh duqv mbui, yie nyei sin ziouc kungx ndopv buang jienv mbungv hnangv.
Yie hnangv yiem deic-bung-huaang nyei domh jaangv, hnangv yiem lomc-huaang nyei norqc guv long nor.
Yie bueix maiv njormh, yie hnangv norm norqc ndoqc yiem biauv-ngorh gu'nguaaic.
Yie nyei win-wangv ziangh hnoi huotv yie. Ki yie wuov deix longc yie nyei mbuox zioux mienh.
Yie nyanc saaiv dorngx hnaangx, yie hopv nyei ga'naaiv yaac zorpc jienv wuom-mueic,
weic zuqc meih qiex jiez nouz yie, meih zungv zorqv yie daaih aengx zoi guangc mingh.
Yie nyei hnoi-nyieqc se hnangv nziemx-yaangh nyei dongh linh. Yie hnangv miev nor nyaux nqaai.
Mv baac Ziouv aac, meih yietc liuz zueiz weic. Doic jiex doic oix jangx meih nyei mengh.
Meih oix jiez daaih korv-lienh Si^on weic zuqc korv-lienh ninh nyei ziangh hoc taux aqv. Dingc daaih nyei ziangh hoc zungv taux aqv.
Meih nyei bou hnamv Si^on Zingh nyei la'bieiv, korv-lienh ninh zuqc baaic njiec nyei nie-mbung.
Maanc fingx oix gamh nziex Ziouv nyei mengh, lungh ndiev nyei hungh oix gamh nziex meih nyei njang-laangc.
Weic zuqc Ziouv oix ceix Si^on. Ninh oix yiem ninh nyei njang-laangc hinc cuotv daaih.
Ninh oix muangx jomc kouv nyei mienh daux gaux. Ninh maiv mangc piex ninh mbuo jouh nyei waac.
Oix zuqc zorqv naaiv deix sic fiev jienv weic hoz doic zeiv-fun, bun maiv gaengh cuotv seix nyei mienh hiuv duqv ceng Ziouv.
“ Ziouv yiem ninh hlang jiex nyei cing-nzengc dorngx mangc njiec, yiem lungh gu'nguaaic mangc lungh ndiev,
weic muangx zuqc wuonx nyei mienh njunh nyei qiex, weic bungx nqoi zuqc dingc daix daic nyei mienh,”
weic bun mienh yiem Si^on zunh Ziouv nyei mengh, yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem yaac ceng ninh.
Wuov zanc maanc fingx caux maanc guoqv ziouc gapv zunv zaangc Ziouv.
Yie corc lunx nyei ziangh hoc ninh bun yie mau, ninh jamv yie nyei siouc nyuonh nangv.
Yie gorngv, “O yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, yie ziangh taux ndaamv-seix hnangv, tov maiv dungx gaengh dorh yie mingh. Meih ganh nyei hnyangx-daauh yietc liuz yiem taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Dongh cor meih liepc ndau nyei gorn-ndoqv, lungh meih ganh nyei buoz zeix daaih.
Lungh ndau zungv oix zuqc mietc, mv baac meih corc yiem jienv. Lungh caux ndau oix hnangv lui-houx nor, pei nzengc. Meih oix yienc lungh ndau hnangv yienc lui-houx, lungh ndau ziouc jiex nzengc aqv.
Mv baac meih zanc-zanc hnangv loz nor, meih nyei hnyangx-daauh yietc liuz maiv haih nzengc.
Meih nyei bou nyei dorn-jueiv oix duqv yiem longx. Ninh mbuo nyei hoz doic oix liepc wuonv yiem meih nyei nza'hmien.
Yie nyei hnyouv aac, oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Yie longc nzengc hnyouv ceng ninh nyei cing-nzengc mbuox.
Yie nyei hnyouv oix ceng Ziouv, yaac maiv dungx la'kuqv ninh nyei yietc zungv en-zingh.
Ninh guangc yie nyei yietc zungv zuiz, yaac zorc yie nyei yietc zungv baengc.
Ninh zuoqc yie nyei maengc leih ndutv ndo haic nyei kuotv, ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie, korv-lienh yie.
Ninh ceix longx nyei ga'naaiv bun yie buangv eix, yie ziouc nzuonx-lunx daaih hnangv domh jaangv nor henv.
Ziouv zoux kuv sic yaac baengh fim nyei tengx zuqc zeix nyei mienh.
Ninh bun Mose hiuv duqv ninh nyei za'eix, bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh hiuv duqv ninh zoux nyei sic.
Ziouv korv-lienh mienh, ceix en bun mienh, ninh maiv qiex jiez siepv, yaac maaih hnamv mienh nyei hnyouv buangv nzengc.
Ninh maiv zanc-zanc hemx, yaac maiv yietc liuz qiex jiez.
Ninh maiv ziux mbuo zoux nyei zuiz dingc, yaac maiv ziux mbuo zoux dorngc nyei jauv winh bun.
Lungh leih ndau ndongc haaix hlang, ninh hnamv taaih ninh wuov deix ndongc wuov hlo.
Dong bung leih fai bung ndongc haaix go, ninh zorqv mbuo zoux dorngc nyei zuiz guangc ndongc wuov go.
Die hnangv haaix nor korv-lienh ninh nyei fu'jueiv, Ziouv yaac hnangv wuov nor korv-lienh taaih ninh nyei mienh,
weic zuqc ninh hiuv duqv mbuo nyei sin zaangc, jangx duqv mbuo benx nie-mbung.
Baamh mienh aeqv, ninh nyei hnoi-nyieqc hnangv miev nor, ninh hnangv lomc-huaang nyei miev-biangh,
zuqc nziaaux buonc, ziang naaic maiv maaih aqv. Ninh nyei loz-dorngx yaac maiv nyiemc ninh aqv.
Mv baac Ziouv ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv taaih ninh wuov deix yietc liuz taux yietc liuz, ninh baengh fim nyei jauv yaac njiec taux ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun zeiv-faqv,
se ei jienv ninh nyei ngaengc waac caux jangx ninh nyei leiz-latc wuov deix.
Ziouv yiem gu'nguaaic lungh liepc ninh nyei weic, ninh nyei guoqv gunv maanc muotc.
Meih mbuo, ninh nyei fin-mienh aah! Dongh ei jienv ninh hatc nyei waac, se muangx ninh nyei waac, maaih domh qaqv nyei fin-mienh, oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Ninh nyei zuangx baeng, se fu-sux ninh, ei jienv ninh nyei eix nyei bou aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Meih mbuo yietc zungv zeix daaih nyei maanc muotc aah! Yiem ninh gunv nyei norm-norm dorngx, oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. O yie nyei hnyouv aac, oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Yie nyei hnyouv aac, oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aac, meih za'gengh hlo! haic. Meih maaih njang-laangc caux mengh hoc zuqv jienv zoux meih nyei lui.
Meih buix jienv njang hnangv buix lui-ndaauv. Meih corng lungh hnangv corng ndopv-liuh wuov nor.
Yiem lungh gu'nguaaic maengx nyei wuom meih liepc meih yiem nyei dorngx. Meih longc mbuonx zoux meih nyei cie, yaac bangc nziaaux nyei ndaatv mingh.
Meih longc nziaaux zoux meih nyei douc fienx mienh, longc douz-mbietc zoux meih nyei bou.
Meih zorqv ndau liepc yiem gorn-ndoqv gu'nguaaic, weic bun yietc liuz maiv dongz.
Meih longc ndo nyei wuom yiemx ndau-beih gu'nguaaic hnangv lui nor, wuom jiex mbong gu'nguaaic.
Meih yietv hatc, wuom ziouc biaux. Yietv haiz meih nyei qiex mbui, wuom ziouc mingh nzengc.
Geh zorng baetv faaux, horngz biopc njiec taux meih dingc bun ninh mbuo yiem nyei dorngx.
Meih dingc ziangx gapv-jaaix bun wuom maiv haih jiex ndaangc, weic maiv bun wuom aengx buang jienv ndau-beih.
Meih bun wuom-zingv yiem horngz baetv cuotv, liouc njiec mbong mbu'ndongx,
bun zuangx hieh zoih duqv hopv, bun hieh lorh jaiv nqaatv.
Yiem wuom-hlen maaih norqc zoux lauz, yiem ndiangx-nquaah maaih norqc heuc.
Yiem lungh gu'nguaaic meih bun mbiungc duih njiec mbong, weic meih zoux nyei yietc zungv gong, ndau-beih duqv bungx-zuoqc.
Meih bun miev-maeng cuotv daaih yungz saeng-kuv, bun lai-coix cuotv daaih bun mienh longc, bun ndau cuotv gaeng-zuangx ga'naaiv bun mienh nyanc.
Aengx cuotv a'ngunc diuv tengx mienh njien-youh, yaac duqv hmei tengx ninh nyei hmien njang, duqv laangh ziqc weic bun sin zaangc henv.
Ziouv nyei ndiangx duqv wuom gaux, se yiem Le^mbaa^norn ninh zuangx nyei si^ndaa zongh ndiangx.
Norqc zoux lauz yiem wuov deix ndiangx. Norqc nyieh yiem zongh ndiangx zoux ninh nyei biauv.
Mbong-hlang benx hieh yungh nyei dinc, la'bieiv-mbaengx zoux naauz nyei ndaauh kaux dorngx.
Meih zeix hlaax weic dingc gueix, mba'hnoi hiuv duqv ziangh hoc muotv.
Meih zeix hmuangx benx lungh muonz zanc, lomc gu'nyuoz yietc zungv hieh zoih ziouc cuotv daaih.
Sienh lunx heuc jienv mingh lorz nyanc, lorz Tin-Hungh ceix bun nyei ga'naaiv.
Mba'hnoi cuotv nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo ziouc mingh aqv. Mingh bueix ninh mbuo ganh nyei kuotv.
Mienh ziouc cuotv mingh zoux ninh mbuo nyei gong, yaac zoux jienv mingh taux lungh hmuangx.
O Ziouv aac, meih zoux nyei gong camv haic, yietc zungv se meih longc cong-mengh zeix daaih. Meih zeix daaih nyei maanc muotc buangv nzengc ndau-beih.
Yiem wuov maaih koiv youc hlo youc jangv. Koiv gu'nyuoz maaih haih dongz nyei ga'naaiv saauv maiv hingh, se maaih maengc nyei ga'naaiv hlo-hlo faix-faix.
Yiem wuov maaih nzangv mingh daaih, aengx maaih meih zeix daaih nyei Le^wi^aa^taan yiem wuov nyienx.
Naaiv deix yietc zungv kaux meih ziux ziangh hoc bun ga'naaiv ninh mbuo nyanc.
Meih bun ninh mbuo, ninh mbuo ziouc zorqv daaih, meih sung meih nyei buoz ninh mbuo ziouc duqv longx nyei ga'naaiv beuv.
Meih buang hmien maiv mangc ninh mbuo, ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic. Meih zorqv cuotv ninh mbuo tauv nyei qiex ninh mbuo daic mi'aqv, nzuonx mingh benx nie-mbung.
Meih bun meih nyei Singx Lingh cuotv mingh wuov zanc ninh mbuo duqv zeix cuotv daaih aqv. Meih yaac bun ndau-beih goiv yienc siang daaih.
Tov Ziouv nyei njang-laangc yietc liuz yiem. Tov Ziouv a'hneiv ninh zeix daaih nyei ga'naaiv.
Ninh mangc ndau, ndau ziouc dongz, ninh hluo zuqc mbong, mbong ziouc cuotv douz-sioux.
Yie yietc seix oix baaux nzung ceng Ziouv. Yie corc ziangh jienv nyei ziangh hoc, yie oix baaux nzung bun yie nyei Tin-Hungh.
Tov ninh weic yie buih nyei waac horpc hnyouv, weic zuqc Ziouv bun yie njien-youh.
Tov bun zuiz-mienh yiem baamh gen zuqc mietc nzengc, yaac bun orqv mienh zutc nzengc. Yie nyei hnyouv aac, oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv, oix zuqc jouh ninh nyei mengh, yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx zunh yaangh ninh zoux nyei sic.
Oix zuqc dorng jienv ninh baaux nzung, baaux nzung ceng ninh. Oix zuqc zunh yaangh ninh zoux yietc zungv mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Oix zuqc weic ninh nyei cing-nzengc mbuox bungx waac-maux. Bun zimh lorz Ziouv nyei mienh nyei hnyouv njien-youh.
Oix zuqc zimh lorz Ziouv caux ninh nyei qaqv, zanc-zanc oix yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien.

Ninh nyei bou, Apc^laa^ham, nyei hoz doic, se ninh ginv daaih nyei mienh, Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun aah! Oix zuqc jangx jienv ninh zoux liuz wuov deix mbuoqc horngh nyei sic, caux ninh zoux peix fuc nyei sic, caux ninh nyei nzuih siemv nyei waac.
Ninh se Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh. Ninh siemv nyei waac yiem gormx lungh ndiev.
Ninh jangx ninh laengz nyei ngaengc waac taux yietc liuz, ninh paaiv nyei waac weic yietc cin doic,
se caux Apc^laa^ham liepc nyei ngaengc waac, dongh ninh houv jienv laengz bun I^sakc nyei ngaengc waac.
Ninh zorqv naaiv deix ngaengc waac caux Yaakopv liepc benx leiz-nyeic, jiu bun I^saa^laa^en weic zoux yietc liuz nyei ngaengc waac.
Ninh gorngv, “Yie oix zorqv Kaa^naa^an Deic-Bung jiu bun meih benx meih nzipc nyei buonc.”
Ninh mbuo mienh zoqc wuov zanc, se mienh za'gengh zoqc nyei, kungx dingh zepv yiem wuov norm deic-bung hnangv,
ninh mbuo yiem naaiv norm deic-bung jiex wuov norm deic-bung, yiem yietc norm guoqv mingh taux ganh norm guoqv.
Ninh maiv bun haaix dauh mienh zeix ninh mbuo, weic ninh mbuo nyei gorn ninh hemx ziex dauh hungh diex.
Ninh gorngv, “Maiv dungx zoux haaix nyungc bun yie longc youh orn daaih nyei mienh, yaac maiv dungx hoic yie nyei douc waac mienh.”
Ninh bun wuov norm deic-bung zuqc domh huaang domh ngorc, dongh ninh mbuo kaux nyei laangh ziqc dangx nzengc,
ninh paaiv laanh mienh mingh ndaangc ninh mbuo, se Yosepv, zuqc maaic mingh zoux nouh.
Yosepv nyei zaux zuqc hlieqv-limc ndoh jienv mun, yaac zuqc hlieqv-kou kou jienv jaang,
zuov taux ninh gorngv oix cuotv nyei sic cuotv daaih zien. Ziouv nyei waac seix ninh.
Hungh diex paaiv mienh mingh bungx nqoi ninh, gunv zuangx fingx wuov dauh bungx ninh cuotv,
liepc ninh zoux hungh dinc nyei ziouv, bun ninh gunv hungh dinc maaih nyei yietc zungv,
bun ninh sueih eix njaaux hungh diex nyei jien, njaaux hungh diex nyei mienh gox maaih cong-mengh.
Nqa'haav I^saa^laa^en daaih taux I^yipv, Yaakopv dingh zepv yiem Haam nyei deic-bung.
Ziouv bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx hiaangx camv, yaac bun ninh mbuo gauh henv jiex ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv.
Ninh bun win-wangv nyei hnyouv nzorng ninh nyei baeqc fingx, zoux guv guaix nyei sic hoic ninh nyei bou.
