Ninh paaiv ninh nyei bou, Mose, caux ninh ginv daaih wuov dauh Aalon.
Ninh mbuo yiem wuov deix mienh mbu'ndongx zoux jangx-hoc, yiem Haam nyei deic-bung zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Ninh bun hmuangx daaih om jienv deic-bung, I^yipv Mienh yaac ngaengc ninh nyei waac.
Ninh bun ninh mbuo nyei wuom benx nziaamv, bun ninh mbuo nyei mbiauz daic nzengc.
Yiem ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung, liemh ninh mbuo nyei hungh dinc gu'nyuoz maaih gaengv buangv nzengc.
Ninh gorngv ziouc maaih mungz faanv, maaih gaeng-mbung faanv buangv deic-bung.
Ninh bun borqc div mbiungc duih njiec, bun mba'lingc njapc njapc nyei gormx deic-bung.
Ninh mborqv waaic ninh mbuo nyei a'ngunc hmei caux ngongh nyorx ndiangx, mborqv ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung nyei ndiangx nauv nzengc.
Ninh gorngv yietc joux, jopv-nyeic ziouc daaih, jopv-nyeic lunx saauv maiv hingh,
nyanc ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung nyei nyungc-nyungc lai-coix, caux yiem lingh deic cuotv nyei gaeng-zuangx.
Ninh daix yiem ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung gu'nyuoz nyei yietc zungv dorn-la'gauv, se mouz buonc nyei daauh dauh dorn.
Nqa'haav ninh dorh I^saa^laa^en Mienh, caux jienv jiem nyaanh cuotv, yiem ninh mbuo nyei fingx-fingx maiv maaih haaix dauh mau.
Ninh mbuo biaux cuotv, I^yipv Mienh a'hneiv nyei, weic zuqc ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic I^saa^laa^en Mienh.
Tin-Hungh bun mbuonx om jienv, lungh muonz zanc bun douz ziux njang.
Ninh mbuo tov, ninh ziouc bun norqc mbunh ndaix daaih, yaac bun laangh ziqc yiem lungh daaih bun ninh mbuo nyanc beuv.
Ninh mborqv nqoi la'bieiv, wuom ziouc baetv cuotv liouc jiex deic-bung-huaang benx diuh ndaaih,
weic zuqc ninh jangx ninh caux ninh nyei bou, Apc^laa^ham, laengz nyei cing-nzengc waac.
Ninh dorh ninh nyei baeqc fingx njien-youh nyei cuotv, dorh jienv ninh ginv daaih nyei mienh baaux jienv nzung mingh.
Ninh zorqv ganh fingx mienh nyei deic-bung jiu bun ninh mbuo. Ninh mbuo duqv nzipc wuov deix mienh ndortv qaqv zoux nyei buonc
weic bun ninh mbuo gan ninh nyei leiz-nyeic yaac ei nzengc ninh nyei leiz-latc. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic zuqc ninh se longx haic, ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Haaix dauh haih gorngv Ziouv zoux hlo haic nyei sic? Fai haaix dauh haih biux mengh puix duqv ceng ninh nyei yietc zungv?
Da'faanh ei jienv baengh fim nyei jauv zoux wuov deix, se zanc-zanc zoux horpc nyei mienh, maaih orn-lorqc.
O Ziouv aac, meih zoux longx bun meih nyei baeqc fingx wuov zanc, tov jangx yie. Meih daaih njoux ninh mbuo nyei ziangh hoc tov tengx yie,
weic bun yie buatc meih ginv daaih nyei mienh duqv bungx-zuoqc, yaac bun yie a'hneiv meih nyei baeqc fingx duqv daaih nyei njien-youh, yaac duqv caux meih nzipc daaih nyei buonc juangc jienv ceng.
Yie mbuo caux yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix fih hnangv nyei baamz zuiz. Yie mbuo zoux dorngc, zoux orqv nyei sic.

Yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung wuov zanc, yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix maiv mengh baeqc meih zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic. Ninh mbuo maiv jangx taux meih ndongc haaix ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv ninh mbuo. Ninh mbuo zungv yiem wuov Koiv-Siqv ga'hlen, ngaengc Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh.
Maiv gunv hnangv naaic, ninh weic ganh nyei mengh njoux ninh mbuo, weic bun ninh mbuo hiuv duqv ninh nyei domh qaqv.
Ninh hatc Koiv-Siqv, koiv ziouc nqaai mi'aqv. Ninh dorh ninh mbuo jiex ndo nyei dorngx hnangv jiex deic-bung-huaang nor.
Ninh njoux ninh mbuo biaux ndutv ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv nyei buoz-ndiev, yiem win-jaa nyei buoz-ndiev njoux ninh mbuo cuotv daaih.
Wuom yiemx ninh mbuo nyei win-jaa, zungv maiv zengc yietc dauh aqv.
Wuov zanc ninh mbuo sienx ninh nyei waac, ninh mbuo yaac baaux nzung ceng ninh.
Mv baac maiv lauh ninh mbuo la'kuqv ninh zoux nyei sic, ninh mbuo maiv longc hnyouv zuov ninh njaaux nyei za'eix.
Yiem wuov deic-bung-huaang ninh mbuo cei duqv kouv haic, ziouc yiem wuov seix Tin-Hungh.
Ziux ninh mbuo tov nyei ninh ceix bun ninh mbuo, mv baac bun ninh mbuo butv baengc-ngaaiz.
Yiem ndopv-liuh ciangv gu'nyuoz mienh mueic jieqv Mose caux Ziouv nyei cing-nzengc mienh, Aalon, wuov zanc,
ndau nqoi, naqv Ndaataan yaac biopv ndipc Aa^mbi^lam yietc guanh mienh.
Maaih douz yiem ninh mbuo nyei guanh mbu'ndongx cuotv daaih, douz-mbietc buov nzengc orqv mienh.
Yiem Holepv Mbong ninh mbuo zoux dauh ngongh gouv dorn, yaac baaix dox daaih nyei miuc-fangx.
Ninh mbuo zorqv Tin-Hungh nyei njang-laangc tiuv nyanc miev nyei ngongh gouv nyei miuc-fangx.
Ninh mbuo la'kuqv ninh mbuo nyei Njoux Ziouv, Tin-Hungh, dongh yiem I^yipv zoux hlo haic nyei sic,
yiem Haam nyei deic zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei jauv, yiem Koiv-Siqv zoux peix fuc nyei sic.

Weic naaiv ninh gorngv ninh oix mietc ninh nyei baeqc fingx. Kaux bangc maaih ninh ginv daaih wuov dauh Mose dorng jienv Tin-Hungh tengx ninh mbuo gorngv, yaac bun ninh ga'qiex fiu, maiv mietc ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo yaac mangc piex wuov norm kuh yiem nyei deic-bung, ninh mbuo maiv sienx Tin-Hungh laengz nyei waac.
Ninh mbuo yiem ganh nyei ndopv-liuh ngopv, yaac maiv muangx Ziouv nyei waac.
Weic naaiv ninh sung jienv buoz houv waac gorngv ninh oix bun ninh mbuo yiem deic-bung-huaang ndortv nzengc.
Bun ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun nzaanx mingh yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx, bun ninh mbuo faatv nzaanx yiem buangv norm-norm guoqv.
Nqa'haav yiem Be^o ninh mbuo bieqc Mbaa^an zienh yaac nyanc ziec bun maiv maaih maengc nyei zienh nyei ga'naaiv.
Ninh mbuo zoux nyei sic cuoqv Ziouv qiex jiez haic, ziouc maaih domh wuon-baengc yiem ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx butv cuotv.
Wuov zanc Fi^ne^hatc souv jiez daaih dingc zoux dorngc nyei mienh nyei zuiz, domh wuon-baengc ziouc dingh mi'aqv.
Ninh hnangv naaiv zoux, Ziouv funx ninh zoux duqv horpc, yaac funx taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Ninh mbuo yiem Me^li^mbaa Wuom cuoqv Ziouv qiex jiez. Laaix ninh mbuo, Mose yaac zuqc kouv aqv.
Weic naaiv ninh mbuo bun Mose nyei hnyouv mun, ninh ziouc qiex beqv gorngv cuotv ninh maiv horpc zuqc gorngv nyei waac.
Ninh mbuo maiv ei Ziouv hatc nyei waac mietc wuov deix ganh fingx mienh.
Daaux nzuonx zorpc jienv caux wuov deix fingx yiem, yaac hoqc zoux hnangv ninh mbuo nor zoux.
Tin-Hungh nyei mienh fu-sux wuov deix mienh nyei miuc-fangx ziouc benx koux hlopv jienv ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo zorqv ninh mbuo ganh nyei naamh nyouz ziec bun mienv.

Ninh mbuo daix maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh, se bun ganh nyei naamh nyouz nyei nziaamv liouc cuotv, dongh ninh mbuo longc ziec bun Kaa^naa^an nyei miuc-fangx. Wuov deix nziaamv ziouc bun deic-bung maaih uix.
Hnangv naaic ninh mbuo ganh zoux nyei jauv bun ninh mbuo maaih uix, yiem ninh mbuo zoux nyei sic ninh mbuo hnangv maaic buonv-sin nyei m'sieqv dorn.
Weic naaiv Ziouv ziouc qiex jiez ninh nyei baeqc fingx, yaac youx haic ninh nzipc nyei buonc.
Ninh ziouc zorqv ninh mbuo jiu bun yiem camv-fingx mienh nyei buoz-ndiev, nzorng ninh mbuo wuov deix ziouc duqv gunv ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo nyei win-wangv yaac zeix ninh mbuo, ninh mbuo ziouc zuqc yiem ninh mbuo nyei hatc maaz ga'ndiev.
Ninh njoux ninh nyei baeqc fingx ziex nzunc, mv baac ninh mbuo duqv-eix ngaengc jienv Tin-Hungh ziouc laaix ganh nyei zuiz ndortv njiec aiv.
Maiv gunv hnangv naaic, ninh haiz ninh mbuo heuc jienv tov nyei waac, ninh ziouc jangx ninh mbuo nyei kouv naanc.
Ninh jangx jienv ninh laengz nyei ngaengc waac, ziux ninh ndongc naaic ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv ninh ziouc goiv za'eix.
Ninh bun yietc zungv caangv ninh nyei mienh wuov deix korv-lienh ninh mbuo.
O Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh aac, tov njoux yie mbuo. Tov siou yie mbuo yiem maanc guoqv mbu'ndongx nzuonx, weic bun yie mbuo haih dor-ziec meih nyei cing-nzengc mbuox, yaac a'hneiv nyei ceng.
Ceng Ziouv, I^saa^laa^en nyei Tin-Hungh, yiem yietc liuz taux yietc liuz. Zuangx mienh oix zuqc lomh nzoih gorngv, “ Aamen ”. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic zuqc ninh longx haic, ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh taux yietc liuz.
Tov bun Ziouv zuoqc nzuonx nyei mienh hnangv naaic nor gorngv, se dongh ninh yiem win-wangv nyei buoz-ndiev zuoqc nzuonx nyei mienh,
yaac yiem norm-norm deic-bung, se yiem dong naamh fai baqv bung siou nzuonx daaih nyei mienh.
Ninh mbuo yiem deic-bung-huaang, deic-bung haanz, youh jienv mingh, lorz maiv duqv jauv mingh horpc ninh mbuo yiem nyei zingh.
Ninh mbuo youc hnyouv sie youc jaang nqaatv, ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv mau nzengc mi'aqv.
Ninh mbuo yiem naanc zingh gu'nyuoz heuc jienv tov Ziouv, ninh ziouc njoux ninh mbuo biaux ndutv ninh mbuo nyei kouv naanc.
Ninh dorh ninh mbuo yangh diuh jauv-zaqc, taux horpc ninh mbuo yiem nyei zingh.
Ninh mbuo horpc zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, ninh yaac weic baamh mienh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Ninh bun jaang nqaatv nyei mienh jaiv nqaatv, bun hnyouv sie nyei mienh duqv longx nyei ga'naaiv nyanc beuv.
Maaih deix mienh yiem hmuangx zong, yiem-yiem nyei dorngx, se zuqc wuonx loh nyei caux zuqc limc ndoh nyei mienh,
weic zuqc ninh mbuo ngaengc Tin-Hungh nyei waac, mangc piex Yiem Hlang Jiex Wuov Dauh njaaux nyei za'eix.
Ninh bun ninh mbuo zuqc zoux gong kouv weic zatv ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv njiec. Ninh mbuo ndorpc, yaac maiv maaih haaix dauh tengx.
Ninh mbuo yiem naanc zingh gu'nyuoz heuc jienv tov Ziouv. Ninh ziouc njoux ninh mbuo biaux ndutv ninh mbuo nyei kouv naanc.
Ninh dorh ninh mbuo yiem hmuangx caux zuqc daic nyei dongh linh gu'nyuoz cuotv daaih, yaac cutv ninh mbuo zuqc ndoh nyei limc dangx.
Ninh mbuo horpc zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, ninh yaac weic baamh mienh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Ninh mborqv huv dongh siqv gaengh, yaac hngaqv ndutv hlieqv-gaengh sorn.
Maaih deix butv baengc laaix ninh mbuo zoux nyei zuiz, yaac laaix ninh mbuo zoux waaic sic zuqc siouc kouv.
Ninh mbuo youx haic nyungc-nyungc nyanc nyei ga'naaiv, yaac taux fatv zuqc daic nyei gaengh.
Ninh mbuo yiem naanc zingh gu'nyuoz heuc jienv tov Ziouv, ninh ziouc njoux ninh mbuo biaux ndutv ninh mbuo nyei kouv naanc.
Ninh gorngv cuotv waac zorc ninh mbuo longx, yaac njoux ninh mbuo biaux ndutv zuqc daic nyei kuotv.
Ninh mbuo horpc zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, ninh yaac weic baamh mienh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Oix zuqc bun ninh mbuo fongc horc ziec weic dor-ziec, yaac njien-youh nyei baaux nzung gorngv ninh zoux nyei sic.
Maaih deix bieqc nzangv, yiem domh wuom bangc nzangv lorz nyanc.
Ninh mbuo buatc Ziouv zoux nyei gong, se ninh yiem wuom ndo nyei dorngx zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Ninh yietv hatc, domh nziaaux buonc daaih bun koiv jiez laangc.
Ninh mbuo nyei nzangv faaux taux ndaamv-lungh, aengx ndortv njiec wuom-laangc taux ndo nyei dorngx. Ninh mbuo hnyouv waaic nzengc, laaix ninh mbuo zuqc gamh nziex nyei sic.
Ninh mbuo laih mingh laih daaih hnangv diuv nquin nyei mienh nor, ninh mbuo jomc za'eix aqv.
Ninh mbuo yiem naanc zingh gu'nyuoz heuc jienv tov Ziouv. Ninh ziouc tengx ninh mbuo biaux ndutv ninh mbuo nyei kouv naanc.
Ninh bun domh nziaaux dingh, bun koiv nyei wuom-laangc sekv nzengc.
Ninh mbuo ziouc a'hneiv weic zuqc sekv nzieqc nyei. Ninh yaac dorh ninh mbuo mingh taux ninh mbuo oix mingh nyei nzangv-bouc.
Ninh mbuo horpc zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic zuqc ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh. Ninh yaac weic baamh mienh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Ninh mbuo oix zuqc yiem baeqc fingx gapv zunv nyei dorngx zunh gorngv ninh zoux hlo, yaac yiem zuangx mienh gox mbu'ndongx ceng ninh.
Ninh bun ndaaih tiuv benx deic-bung-huaang, bun wuom-zingv tiuv benx mborngx nqaai nyei ndau,
bun ndau-junc tiuv benx ndau-nzaaih ndau-huaang, laaix yiem wuov nyei mienh waaic haic.
Ninh bun deic-bung-huaang benx wuom-domh, bun ndau-nqaai benx wuom-zingv.
Ninh bun ngorc nyei mienh yiem wuov, ninh mbuo yaac ceix norm zingh yiem.
Ninh mbuo zoux ndeic zuangx ga'naaiv, zuangx a'ngunc biouv, yaac duqv bungx-zuoqc nyei siou.
Ninh ceix fuqv bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx hiaangx camv, yaac maiv bun ninh mbuo nyei saeng-kuv zoqc njiec.
Baeqc fingx zuqc zeix, zuqc kouv, zuqc nzauh, ninh mbuo ziouc zoqc yaac ndortv njiec aiv nyei ziangh hoc,
ninh bun zeix ninh nyei baeqc fingx wuov deix zoux hlo nyei mienh zuqc mangc piex, yaac bun ninh mbuo youh jienv mingh maiv maaih jauv nyei deic-bung-huaang.
Mv baac ninh bouh mienh jomc mienh faaux hlaang, bun ninh mbuo leih ndutv kouv naanc, bun ninh mbuo nyei hmuangv doic hiaangx, hnangv yungh guanh nor camv.
Hnyouv zingx nyei mienh buatc ninh mbuo ziouc a'hneiv. Zoux orqv nyei mienh nqapc jienv nzuih, maiv maaih waac gorngv aqv.
Haaix dauh maaih cong-mengh oix zuqc longc hnyouv muangx naaiv deix sic, yaac oix zuqc samx mangc Ziouv ziepc zuoqv hnamv mienh nyei jauv.
O Tin-Hungh aac, yie nyei hnyouv kaux wuonv, yie nyei hnyouv kaux wuonv. Yie oix baaux nzung, oix baaux nzung ceng meih. Yie nyei hnyouv aah! Nyie daaih maah!
Domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah aah! Nyie daaih maah! Yie oix bun mba'hnoi nyie daaih.
O Ziouv aac, yie oix yiem maanc fingx mbu'ndongx dor-ziec meih. Yie oix yiem maanc guoqv mbu'ndongx baaux nzung ceng meih.
Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh gauh hlang jiex lungh. Meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnyouv yaac mbaengc mbuonx hlang.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov bun mienh taaih meih gauh hlang jiex lungh. Tov bun meih nyei njang-laangc yiem buangv lungh ndiev.
Tov dau yie mbuo, longc meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz njoux yie mbuo, weic bun meih hnamv nyei mienh duqv njoux.
Tin-Hungh yiem ninh nyei singx dinc gorngv, “Yie oix a'hneiv nyei zorqv Sekem bun nqoi, yaac ndorqc Sukc^kotv Horngz paaiv bun nqoi.
Gi^le^aatc se yie nyei, Maa^natv^se yaac yie nyei. E^faa^im se yie mborqv jaax nyei muoc. Yu^ndaa se yie nyei hungh biaav.
Mo^apc se yie nyei nzaaux buoz-zaux bunh. Yie yaac zoi yie nyei heh njiec E^ndom. Yie heuc jienv gorngv, ‘Fi^li^saa^die aah! Yie hingh jiex meih aqv.’+”
Haaix dauh oix dorh yie mingh taux wuov norm weih wuonv nyei zingh? Haaix dauh oix dorh yie mingh taux E^ndom Deic-Bung?
O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih maiv zeiz guangc yie mbuo fai? O Tin-Hungh aah! Meih maiv caux yie mbuo nyei jun-baeng cuotv mingh mborqv jaax fai?
Tov meih tengx yie mbuo mborqv win-wangv, weic zuqc baamh mienh tengx se maiv lamh longc.
Yie mbuo kaux Tin-Hungh yie mbuo ziouc duqv hingh jiex. Se dongh ninh oix caaiv yie mbuo nyei win-wangv njiec.
O yie ceng nyei Tin-Hungh aac, tov meih maiv dungx sekv-sekv nyei yiem,
weic zuqc orqv mienh caux guv guaix nyei mienh gorngv yie. Ninh mbuo longc gorngv-baeqc nyei waac hoic yie.
Ninh mbuo weih gormx yie gorngv nzorng nyei waac yaac mborqv yie mv baac maiv maaih gorn-baengx.
Maiv gunv yie hnamv ninh mbuo yaac weic ninh mbuo daux gaux, ninh mbuo gox yie.
Yie zoux longx nyei ninh mbuo winh orqv nyei bun yie, yie hnamv nyei ninh mbuo winh nzorng nyei.
Tov paaiv dauh orqv mienh daaih caux ninh doix-dekc, bun dauh ninh ganh nyei win-wangv gox ninh.
Siemv nyei ziangh hoc, tov bun ninh zuqc dingc zuiz, tov bun liemh ninh daux gaux nyei waac funx benx zuiz.
Tov bun ninh nyei siouc nyuonh nangv, bun ganh dauh duqv ninh nyei weic.
Tov bun ninh nyei fu'jueiv benx guh hanh fu'jueiv, bun ninh nyei auv benx auv-guaav.
Tov bun ninh nyei naamh nyouz benx njouh huaax mienh youh jienv mingh tov nyanc. Ninh mbuo yiem baaic waaic nyei dorngx, tov bun ninh mbuo zuqc zunc cuotv mingh.
Tov bun zaeqv-ziouv daaih zorqv ninh maaih nyei yietc zungv, tov bun dongh ninh maiv hiuv nyei mienh daaih caangv ninh ndortv qaqv duqv daaih nyei ga'naaiv.
Tov maiv dungx bun haaix dauh zoux longx bun ninh, yaac maiv dungx bun haaix dauh korv-lienh ninh nyei guh hanh fu'jueiv.
Tov bun ninh nyei hoz doic zeiv-fun zutc nzengc. Tov bun ninh nyei mbuox zuqc sortv guangc, maiv bun da'nyeic doic mienh jangx ninh.
Tov Ziouv jangx jienv ninh nyei ong-taaix mbuo zoux nyei zuiz. Yaac maiv dungx sortv ninh nyei maa nyei zuiz guangc.
Tov bun naaiv deix zuiz zanc-zanc yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien, mv baac bun yiem naaiv lungh ndiev maiv maaih haaix dauh jangx duqv ninh nyei mbuox.
Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz maiv hnamv taux zoux longx bun mienh, zungv zoux doqc hoic mienh jomc mienh, ndortv naanc mienh, caux hnyouv mun nyei mienh, bun ninh mbuo zuqc daic.
Ninh oix zioux, tov bun ninh zioux nyei waac ndortv zuqc ninh ganh. Ninh maiv oix buang waac bun mienh, tov bun fuqv leih ninh go.
Ninh zorqv zioux nyei waac dorngx lui zuqv, tov bun naaiv deix waac saamx bieqc ninh nyei sin hnangv wuom, yaac hnangv hmei saamx bieqc ninh nyei mbungv.
Tov bun zioux nyei waac hnangv domh lui buang jienv ninh, yaac hnangv houx-hlaang zanc-zanc sai jienv ninh nyei jaaiv.
Tov Ziouv bun gox yie caux gorngv doqc hoic yie nyei maengc wuov deix, hnangv naaiv nor zuqc daaih weic benx ninh mbuo nyei zingh nyeic.
Mv baac yie nyei Ziouv Tin-Hungh aac, tov weic meih nyei mengh zoux longx bun yie. Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh se longx haic, tov njoux yie.
Weic zuqc yie jomc, ga'naanh haic, yie nyei hnyouv gu'nyuoz za'gengh mun haic aqv.
Yie nyei maengc jiex jienv mingh hnangv lungh maanz-hmuangx nyei dongh linh nor, yie hnangv norm jopv-nyeic zuqc nziaaux buonc mingh.
Yie zei maiv nyanc haaix nyungc cingh mborqc ziouc mau. Yie nyei sin zaangc jaic jienv njiec.
Gox yie wuov deix kungx huotv yie hnangv. Ninh mbuo buatc yie, ninh mbuo huangx m'nqorngv.
O Ziouv, yie nyei Tin-Hungh aah! Tov tengx yie. Ziux meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, tov njoux yie.
Tov bun ninh mbuo hiuv duqv naaiv se meih nyei buoz zoux nyei. O Ziouv aac, naaiv se meih zoux nyei sic.
Sueih ninh mbuo zioux, mv baac tov meih ceix fuqv. Tov bun jiez daaih oix mborqv yie wuov deix zuqc nyaiv, yaac tov bun yie, meih nyei bou, a'hneiv.
Tov bun gox yie wuov deix zuqc buang hmien diev nyaiv, bun ninh mbuo baaic hmien beiv hnangv buix domh lui-ndaauv nor.
Yie oix longc yie nyei nzuih camv-camv nyei dor-ziec Ziouv. Yie oix yiem zuangx mienh camv nyei mbu'ndongx ceng ninh,
weic zuqc ninh souv jienv mienh jomc mienh nyei mbiaauc maengx, weic njoux ninh mbuo biaux ndutv dingc bun ninh mbuo zuqc daix daic wuov deix.
Ziouv gorngv mbuox yie nyei Ziouv, “Zueiz jienv yie nyei mbiaauc maengx bung, zuov yie bun meih nyei win-wangv zoux meih lorngx zaux nyei dorngx.”
Ziouv oix yiem Si^on sung cuotv meih nyei domh qaqv nyei biaav, bun meih yiem meih nyei win-wangv mbu'ndongx gunv.

Meih dorh meih nyei jun-baeng mingh cing-nzengc mbong gu'nguaaic wuov hnoi, meih nyei baeqc fingx a'hneiv zorqv ganh fungx bun meih. Hnangv lungh ndorm nyei mbiungc-suiv meih nyei mienh lunx mienh oix daaih lorz meih.
Ziouv laengz ngaengc waac gorngv, nqa'haav zungv maiv tiuv hnyouv, “Meih yietc liuz zoux sai mienh hnangv Men^ki^se^ndekc wuov nyungc sai mienh nor.”
Ziouv yiem meih nyei mbiaauc maengx. Taux ninh qiex jiez wuov hnoi, ninh oix mborqv baaic zuangx hungh.
Ninh oix dingc maanc guoqv mienh nyei zuiz, oix bun janx-daic nyei sei buangv nzengc naaiv deix guoqv. Ninh oix mborqv baaic ndau-beih norm-norm guoqv nyei hungh diex.
Ninh oix hopv jauv-hlen nyei ndoqv nyei wuom, ninh ziouc cau jiez m'nqorngv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Yie oix yiem hnyouv zingx nyei mienh gapv zunv nyei mbu'ndongx longc nzengc hnyouv dor-ziec Ziouv.
Ziouv zoux nyei sic za'gengh hlo haic, da'faanh a'hneiv nyei mienh longc hnyouv zaah.
Ninh zoux nyei sic maaih njang-laangc, maaih haangh daauh buangv nzengc. Ninh zoux horpc nyei jauv yietc liuz yiem.
Ninh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic bun mienh jangx, Ziouv ceix en yaac korv-lienh mienh.
Ninh ceix nyanc hopv bun taaih ninh wuov deix. Ninh yietc liuz jangx ninh laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Ninh bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx buatc ninh longc domh qaqv zoux nyei jauv, ninh zorqv ziex fingx nyei guoqv jiu bun ninh mbuo benx ninh mbuo nzipc nyei buonc.
Ninh nyei buoz zoux nyei gong se ziepc zuoqv baengh fim nyei, ninh hatc nyei yietc zungv waac kaux duqv wuonv nyei.
Naaiv deix hatc nyei waac liepc daaih wuonv taux yietc liuz, yaac ziepc zuoqv, hnyouv zingx nyei zoux.
Ninh zuoqc ninh nyei baeqc fingx yaac liepc ninh nyei ngaengc waac taux yietc liuz. Ninh nyei mengh se cing-nzengc, bun mienh gamh nziex nyei.
Taaih Ziouv zoux gorn bun mienh maaih cong-mengh. Da'faanh ei jienv ninh nyei lingc wuov deix haih mengh baeqc longx. Oix zuqc yietc liuz ceng ninh.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Taaih Ziouv nyei mienh, se za'gengh a'hneiv muangx ninh nyei lingc wuov deix, maaih orn-lorqc.
Ninh nyei hoz doic yiem deic-bung zungv oix henv, hnyouv zingx mienh nyei hoz doic oix duqv fuqv.
Ninh nyei biauv zong butv zoih, benx haic, ninh zoux horpc nyei jauv yietc liuz yiem.
Kuv mienh yiem hmuangx gu'nyuoz maaih njang cuotv daaih. Ziouv ceix en, maaih hnyouv korv-lienh mienh, yaac maaih gong-fim.
Zoux hnyouv jangv gaav ga'naaiv bun mienh wuov dauh duqv longx, ninh zoux nyei jauv yietc zungv baengh fim nyei.
Weic zuqc kuv mienh yietc liuz maiv zuqc ndanc dongz, mienh yietc liuz oix jangx ninh.
Ninh maiv gamh nziex ciouv nyei fienx, ninh bungx dingc hnyouv wuonv nyei kaux Ziouv.
Ninh zunv dingc hnyouv, maiv gamh nziex. Zuov taux buatc ninh nyei win-wangv zuqc suei nzengc.
Ninh zoux hnyouv jangv tengx mienh jomc mienh. Ninh zoux horpc nyei jauv yietc liuz yiem, ninh ziouc henv yaac duqv mienh taaih.
Orqv mienh buatc hnangv naaic ziouc qiex jiez, ngaatc jienv nyaah yaac baaic jienv njiec. Orqv mienh hnamv oix duqv nyei, ziang naaic baac mi'aqv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. O Ziouv nyei zuangx bou aah! Oix zuqc ceng, oix zuqc ceng Ziouv nyei mengh.
Yiem naaiv mingh oix zuqc ceng Ziouv nyei mbuox taux yietc liuz.
Yiem mba'hnoi cuotv taux mba'hnoi muotv nyei dorngx horpc zuqc ceng Ziouv nyei mengh.
Ziouv yiem gauh hlang jiex maanc fingx, ninh nyei njang-laangc gauh hlang jiex lungh.
Maiv maaih haaix dauh hnangv Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, dongh zueiz jienv gauh hlang jiex nyei dorngx wuov dauh.
Ninh mangc njiec aiv nyei dorngx, mangc lungh caux ga'ndiev ndau.
Ninh bouh mienh jomc mienh cuotv nie-mbung, aengx bouh dangx-donx nyei mienh cuotv saaiv-ndui,
bun ninh mbuo caux zoux hlo nyei mienh yiem, se caux ninh nyei baeqc fingx zoux hlo nyei mienh.
Ninh bun maiv haih maaih gu'nguaaz nyei m'sieqv dorn duqv biauv yiem, bun ninh duqv fu'jueiv ziouc orn-lorqc. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem I^yipv cuotv wuov zanc, se Yaakopv nyei zeiv-fun leih nqoi gorngv ganh nyungc waac nyei fingx,
Yu^ndaa benx Tin-Hungh nyei singx dinc, I^saa^laa^en benx ninh gunv nyei guoqv.
Koiv mangc buatc liuz ziouc biaux, Jor^ndaen Ndaaih yaac liouc daaux nqaang.
Zuangx mbong biu hnangv ba'gi yungh gouv nor, mbong-aiv tiux hnangv ba'gi yungh dorn.
O koiv aac, meih weic haaix diuc biaux? O Jor^ndaen Ndaaih aac, meih weic haaix diuc liouc daaux nqaang?
Domh mbong aac, meih weic haaix diuc biu hnangv ba'gi yungh gouv? Fiuv-mbong aac, meih weic haaix diuc tiux hnangv ba'gi yungh dorn?
Ndau-beih aac, oix zuqc yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien dongz, se dorng jienv Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh,
dongh bun la'bieiv tiuv benx wuom-domh, bun la'bieiv-mbaengx tiuv benx wuom-zingv wuov dauh.
O Ziouv aac, njang-laangc maiv zeiz bun yie mbuo, maiv zeiz bun yie mbuo, se oix zuqc bun meih ganh nyei mengh duqv njang-laangc, weic zuqc meih za'gengh hnamv mienh yaac ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux.
Maanc fingx mienh weic haaix diuc oix gorngv, “Ninh mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh yiem haaix?”
Yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh yiem gu'nguaaic lungh, ziux ninh buatc horpc nyei ninh ziouc zoux.
Ninh mbuo nyei miuc-fangx longc jiem longc nyaanh zoux daaih. Se mienh nyei buoz zoux cuotv daaih nyei.
Naaiv deix miuc-fangx maaih nzuih mv baac maiv haih gorngv waac, maaih m'zing mv baac mangc maiv buatc,
maaih m'normh mv baac muangx maiv haiz, maaih mba'zorng mv baac maiv haih hnomv,
maaih buoz mv baac maiv haih hluo, maaih zaux mv baac maiv haih yangh jauv. Ninh mbuo nyei jaang-hoh yaac maiv haih cuotv qiex mbui.
Zoux naaiv deix miuc-fangx nyei mienh ziouc hnangv naaiv deix miuc-fangx nor. Da'faanh kaux miuc-fangx nyei mienh yaac fih hnangv nyei.
O I^saa^laa^en Mienh aac, oix zuqc kaux Ziouv. Ninh tengx ninh mbuo yaac zoux ninh mbuo nyei torngv-baaih.
O Aalon nyei zeiv-fun aac, oix zuqc kaux Ziouv. Ninh tengx ninh mbuo yaac zoux ninh mbuo nyei torngv-baaih.
Taaih Ziouv nyei zuangx mienh aah! Oix zuqc kaux Ziouv. Ninh tengx ninh mbuo yaac zoux ninh mbuo nyei torngv-baaih.
Ziouv jangx yie mbuo. Ninh oix ceix fuqv bun yie mbuo. Ninh oix ceix fuqv bun I^saa^laa^en nyei zeiv-fun. Ninh oix ceix fuqv bun Aalon nyei zeiv-fun.
Ninh oix ceix fuqv bun taaih Ziouv nyei zuangx mienh, liemh zoux hlo zoux faix.
Tov Ziouv bun meih mbuo caux meih mbuo nyei zeiv-fun jaa hiaangx jienv faaux.
Tov bun meih mbuo duqv Ziouv nyei fuqv, se Zeix Lungh Zeix Ndau Wuov Dauh nyei fuqv.
Lungh se Ziouv nyei lungh, mv baac ndau ninh ceix bun baamh mienh.
Daic mingh nyei mienh maiv ceng Ziouv, njiec taux sekv nzieqc nyei dorngx wuov deix yaac maiv ceng.
Mv baac yie mbuo oix ceng Ziouv yiem naaiv mingh taux yietc liuz. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Yie hnamv Ziouv weic zuqc ninh muangx yie nyei qiex caux yie jouh nyei waac.
Ninh baeng m'normh muangx yie, yie ziouc yietc seix jouh ninh.
Zuqc daic nyei hlaang zaeng weih gormx yie. Yiemh gen zuqc kouv nyei jauv zorqv jienv yie. Yie buangh zuqc domh naanc zingh, zuqc nzauh kouv.
Wuov zanc yie heuc Ziouv nyei mbuox, “O Ziouv aac, tov meih njoux cuotv yie nyei maengc.”
Ziouv maaih en-zingh yaac baengh fim nyei. Yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh maaih hnyouv korv-lienh mienh.
Ziouv beu jienv maiv hiuv camv nyei mienh. Yie zuqc kouv haic nyei ziangh hoc ninh njoux yie.
O yie nyei hnyouv aac, meih oix zuqc aengx baengh orn aqv, weic zuqc Ziouv za'gengh zoux longx bun meih.
Ziouv aac, meih njoux yie maiv zuqc daic, bun yie nyei m'zing maiv liouc wuom-mueic, bun yie nyei zaux yaac maiv ndiqv zuqc ndorpc.
Yie yiem Ziouv nyei nza'hmien, yangh ziangh jienv nyei mienh nyei jauv.
Yie corc sienx maiv gunv yie gorngv, “Yie zuqc domh naanc zingh.”
Yie hnyouv lunc jienv nyei ziangh hoc yie gorngv, “Zuangx mienh kungx gorngv-baeqc hnangv.”
Yie haih zorqv haaix nyungc winh bun Ziouv weic ninh ceix nyei yietc zungv en?
Yie bouh jiez njoux en nyei zaanv, yaac heuc jienv Ziouv nyei mbuox.
Yie oix yiem ninh nyei zuangx baeqc fingx nyei nza'hmien jaauv sung yie caux Ziouv laengz nyei ngaengc waac.
Ziux Ziouv mangc, ninh nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx daic se weih jaaix.
O Ziouv aac, yie se meih nyei bou, yie se meih nyei bou, meih nyei m'sieqv bou nyei dorn. Meih jaiv nqoi ndoh yie nyei limc.
Yie oix dor-ziec weic fongc horc ziec bun meih, yaac oix heuc jienv gorngv Ziouv nyei mbuox.
Yie oix yiem ninh nyei zuangx baeqc fingx nyei nza'hmien jaauv sung yie caux Ziouv laengz nyei ngaengc waac,
se yiem zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv, laatc gu'nyuoz, Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh mbu'ndongx. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Maanc guoqv mienh aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Maanc fingx mienh aah! Oix zuqc ceng ninh.
Ziouv ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mbuo camv nyei, ninh yaac ziepc zuoqv taux yietc liuz. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic zuqc ninh longx haic. Ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh gorngv, “Ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.”
Bun Aalon nyei zeiv-fun gorngv, “Ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.”
Bun yietc zungv taaih Ziouv nyei mienh gorngv, “Ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.”
Zuqc kouv naanc wuov zanc yie heuc Ziouv. Ziouv dau yie yaac bungx nqoi yie.
Maaih Ziouv tengx yie, yie ziouc maiv gamh nziex. Baamh mienh haih zoux haaix nyungc bun yie?
Ziouv caux yie yiem yaac tengx yie, yie ziouc mangc buatc nzorng yie wuov deix win-wangv zuqc suei.
Ndaauh kaux Ziouv se gauh longx kaux baamh mienh.
Ndaauh kaux Ziouv se gauh longx kaux zoux hlo nyei mienh.
Maanc guoqv nyei mienh weih gormx yie. Yie dengv Ziouv nyei mbuox mietc ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo weih gormx yie, feix bung weih gormx yie. Yie dengv Ziouv nyei mbuox mietc ninh mbuo.
Ninh mbuo hnangv mueiz nor, weih gormx yie. Ninh mbuo hnangv buov njimv-lomc nyei douz daic siepv. Yie dengv Ziouv nyei mbuox mietc ninh mbuo.
Yie zuqc ninh mbuo fongv seix nyei, bun yie kaav deix ndorpc, mv baac Ziouv tengx yie.
Ziouv se yie nyei qaqv caux yie nyei nzung, ninh benx yie nyei njoux en.
Muangx maah! Yiem kuv mienh nyei ndopv-liuh maaih njien-youh caux hingh jiex nyei qiex aengv cuotv gorngv, “ Ziouv nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz tengx hingh jiex.
Ziouv sung ninh nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz faaux hlang. Ziouv sung ninh nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz tengx hingh jiex.”
Yie ziouc maiv daic mv baac duqv ziangh jienv yaac zunh Ziouv zoux nyei sic.
Ziouv dingc yie nyei zuiz hniev nyei mv baac maiv bun yie zuqc daic.
Tengx yie koi nqoi zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei gaengh weic bun yie haih bieqc mingh dor-ziec Ziouv.
Naaiv se Ziouv nyei gaengh. Kuv mienh duqv yangh naaiv bieqc.
Yie dor-ziec meih weic zuqc meih dau yie. Yaac benx yie nyei njoux en.
Gomv biauv zaangc nqemh cuotv wuov norm la'bieiv, zungv benx an biauv-gorqv gauh longc jienv jiex wuov norm.
Naaiv se Ziouv zoux nyei sic. Ziux yie mbuo nyei m'zing mangc, yie mbuo buatc mbuoqc horngh haic.
Naaiv se Ziouv liepc daaih nyei hnoi. Yie mbuo oix zuqc yiem naaiv norm hnoi njien-youh, a'hneiv.
O Ziouv aah! Njoux yie mbuo maah! O Ziouv aah! Tov tengx yie mbuo haih zoux duqv ziangx nyei.
Tov ceix fuqv bun dengv Ziouv nyei mbuox bieqc daaih nyei mienh. Yie mbuo yiem Ziouv nyei biauv tov Ziouv ceix fuqv bun meih mbuo.
Ziouv se dongh Tin-Hungh. Ninh yaac ceix njang bun yie mbuo. Longc hlaang ndoh jienv fongc horc ziec weic jiex zipv nyei saeng-kuv yaac dorh mingh taux ziec-dorngh nyei jorng.
Meih zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh. Yie oix dor-ziec meih. Meih zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh. Yie oix taaih meih weih hlo.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic zuqc ninh longx haic. Ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Da'faanh ninh mbuo zoux nyei jauv maiv maaih dorngx nqemh, se gan Ziouv nyei leiz-latc yangh wuov deix, maaih orn-lorqc.
Gan longx ninh gorngv nyei waac, se longc nzengc hnyouv lorz ninh wuov deix, maaih orn-lorqc.
Naaiv nyungc mienh maiv zoux dorngc haaix nyungc, ninh mbuo kungx yangh Ziouv nyei jauv hnangv.
Meih zorqv meih hatc nyei waac paaiv bun yie mbuo jienh ei jienv zoux.
Tov bun yie nyei jauv wuonv, haih gan longx meih nyei leiz-nyeic.
Yie nyei m'zing mangc jienv meih nyei yietc zungv lingc, yie ziouc maiv zuqc nyaiv.
Yie hoqc liuz meih baengh fim nyei leiz, yie ziouc longc cing-nzengc hnyouv ceng meih.
Yie oix gan meih nyei leiz-nyeic. Tov yietc liuz maiv dungx guangc ziangh yie. Mbetc
Houh saeng mienh oix zuqc hnangv haaix nor goux duqv ninh ganh nyei jauv cing-nzengc? Se oix zuqc ei jienv meih nyei waac zoux.
Yie longc nzengc hnyouv lorz meih. Tov bun yie maiv dungx leih nqoi meih nyei lingc.
Yie zorqv meih nyei waac zaangh jienv yie nyei hnyouv, weic bun yie maiv baamz zuiz dorngc meih.
O Ziouv aac, yie ceng meih. Tov njaaux meih nyei leiz-nyeic yie.
Yie oix longc yie nyei nzuih meix zunh yaangh meih nyei nzuih gorngv nyei yietc zungv leiz.
Yie a'hneiv meih gorngv nyei waac ndongc a'hneiv yietc zungv zinh zoih.
Yie oix fei-fangv meih hatc nyei waac yaac mangc dingc meih nyei jauv-louc.
Yie a'hneiv meih nyei leiz-nyeic, yie maiv haih la'kuqv meih nyei waac. Nqi^men
Tov zoux longx bun meih nyei bou, weic bun yie duqv ziangh jienv yaac gan meih nyei waac.
Tov bun yie nyei m'zing mangc duqv cuotv yiem meih nyei leiz-latc mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Yie yiem lungh ndiev zoux dingh zepv dangh baav nyei mienh, tov maiv dungx zorqv meih nyei lingc bingx yie.
Yie gengh! jorm hnyouv zanc-zanc jangx meih nyei leiz, taux mba'nziu zungv oix mbaaix nyei.
Meih hemx ceng ganh hlo, se zuqc zioux nyei mienh, dongh yangh pien, leih meih nyei lingc wuov deix.
Tov zorqv guangc yie zuqc nyaiv zuqc mienh mangc piex nyei sic, weic zuqc yie gan longx meih nyei waac.
