Yie yiem nzorng baengh orn nyei jauv wuov deix mienh mbu'ndongx lauh jiex ndaangc.
Yie oix taaix-baengh, mv baac yie gorngv nyei ziangh hoc, ninh mbuo oix mborqv jaax.
Yie cau hmien mangc mbong, tengx yie wuov dauh oix yiem haaix daaih?
Tengx yie wuov dauh se Ziouv, dongh Zeix Lungh Zeix Ndau Wuov Dauh.
Ninh zungv maiv bun meih nyei zaux caaiv piatv, beu meih wuov dauh maiv njormh da'hngatv.
Beu I^saa^laa^en wuov dauh zungv maiv njormh da'hngatv yaac maiv bueix m'njormh.
Ziouv beu jienv meih, Ziouv yiem meih nyei mbiaauc bung tengx meih torngv laangh.
Lungh hnoi zanc mba'hnoi maiv hoic meih, lungh muonz zanc hlaax yaac maiv hoic meih.
Ziouv oix beu jienv meih, maiv bun zuqc haaix nyungc zeqc naanc. Ninh oix beu jienv meih nyei maengc.
Meih bieqc bieqc cuotv-cuotv, Ziouv oix beu jienv meih yiem naaiv mingh taux yietc liuz.
Maaih mienh mbuox yie, “Mbuo mingh zaangc Ziouv nyei biauv orqc?” Yie ziouc njien-youh haic.
O Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh aac, yie mbuo nyei zaux souv jienv meih nyei zingh gaengh gu'nyuoz.
Ye^lu^saa^lem ceix daaih benx norm zingh zunv nyei, wuonv nyei.
Zuangx fingx, se Ziouv nyei fingx, daaih taux naaiv, ziux dingc daaih bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh zoux, weic dor-ziec Ziouv nyei mengh.
Yiem naaiv liepc siemv zuiz nyei weic, se Ndaawitv douh zong nyei weic.
Oix zuqc daux gaux tov bun Ye^lu^saa^lem duqv baengh orn, “Tov bun hnamv meih wuov deix duqv longx,
bun yiem meih nyei zingh laatc gu'nyuoz baengh orn, bun meih nyei hungh dinc taaix-baengh.”
Weic yie nyei gorx-youz caux loz-gaeng doic yie oix gorngv, “Tov yiem meih gu'nyuoz taaix-baengh.”
Weic Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei biauv, yie oix tengx meih duqv longx.
Yiem lungh gu'nguaaic zueiz weic nyei Ziouv aac, yie cau hmien mangc meih.
Hnangv m'jangc bou kaux ganh nyei ziouv, yaac hnangv m'sieqv bou kaux ganh nyei biauv-ziouv maac, yie mbuo hnangv wuov nor kaux Ziouv, yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh, zuov taux ninh korv-lienh yie mbuo.
O Ziouv aac, tov korv-lienh yie mbuo, tov korv-lienh yie mbuo oc, weic zuqc yie mbuo zuqc mienh mangc piex taux ndiev.
Yie mbuo zuqc butv zoih butv zieqv nyei mienh huotv yie mbuo, zuqc zoux maux nyei mienh mangc piex yie mbuo lauh haic.
Se gorngv Ziouv maiv caux yie mbuo yiem naaiv bung hnangv haaix nor? I^saa^laa^en Mienh dau maah!
Se gorngv Ziouv maiv caux yie mbuo yiem naaiv bung, win-wangv daaih mborqv yie mbuo wuov zanc,
se ninh mbuo qiex jiez yie mbuo hnangv njopc douz nor, ninh mbuo haih zorqv yie mbuo liemh nangh nyei naqv nzengc.
Wuom yiemx oix torngx yie mbuo mingh, wuom-seix oix yiemx yie mbuo gu'nguaaic,
domh wuom beqv yaac oix guaatv yie mbuo mingh.
Ceng Ziouv weic zuqc ninh maiv bun yie mbuo zuqc win-wangv hoic hnangv zuqc hieh ga'naaiv nyei nyaah betv nor.
Yie mbuo hnangv norqc yiem zaeng norqc mienh nyei koux biaux ndutv. Koux dangx, yie mbuo biaux ndutv daaih.
Tengx yie mbuo wuov dauh se Ziouv, dongh Zeix Lungh Zeix Ndau Wuov Dauh.
Da'faanh kaux Ziouv nyei mienh hnangv Si^on Mbong maiv zuqc ndanc dongz, zungv yiem taux yietc liuz.
Zuangx mbong hnangv haaix nor weih gormx Ye^lu^saa^lem, Ziouv hnangv wuov nor weih gormx ninh nyei baeqc fingx, yiem naaiv mingh taux yietc liuz.
Orqv mienh maiv duqv yietc liuz gunv paaiv bun kuv mienh nyei buonc deic-bung. Nzauh heix kuv mienh haih sung buoz zoux orqv sic.
O Ziouv aac, tov zoux longx bun longx nyei, caux hnyouv zingx nyei mienh.
Mv baac haaix dauh huin mingh gan hnyouv njuotv mienh nyei jauv, Ziouv oix dorh ninh mbuo caux jienv orqv mienh yietc jauv mingh. Tov bun I^saa^laa^en duqv baengh orn.
Ziouv bun Si^on nzuonx daaih duqv longx hnangv loz wuov zanc, yie mbuo hnangv mbeix buatc nor.
Yie mbuo nyei nzuih ziouc qaqv jatv, yie mbuo nyei mbietc yaac njien-youh nyei heuc. Wuov zanc maanc guoqv mienh gorngv, “ Ziouv weic ninh mbuo zoux hlo haic nyei sic.”
Ziouv weic yie mbuo zoux hlo haic nyei sic, yie mbuo ziouc njien-youh haic.
O Ziouv aac, tov bun yie mbuo nzuonx daaih duqv longx hnangv loz wuov nor, hnangv Negepc nyei wuom liouc njiec ndoqv-nzuonx.
Tov bun liouc jienv wuom-mueic zuangx nyei mienh duqv njien-youh nyei heuc jienv siou.
Liouc jienv wuom-mueic dorh nyim cuotv mingh zuangx nyei mienh, oix njien-njien youh youh nyei heuc, dorh jienv ninh nyei mbiauh zeiv nzuonx.
Se gorngv maiv zeiz Ziouv zoux biauv, zoux biauv nyei mienh baeqc baeqc ndortv qaqv. Se gorngv maiv zeiz Ziouv zuov zingh, zuov zingh nyei mienh maiv njormh mv baac maiv lamh longc.
Lungh ndorm jiez sin nziouv, lungh muonz zanc bueix hmuangx lauh, cuotv qaqv zoux kouv weic yungz maengc se maiv lamh longc, weic zuqc Ziouv bun ninh hnamv nyei mienh bueix duqv njormh.
Naamh nyouz se Ziouv bun nzipc nyei buonc, yungz daaih nyei fu'jueiv benx ninh nyei zingh nyeic.
Mienh hnyangx-jeiv lunx nyei ziangh hoc yungz nyei naamh nyouz, se hnangv forng-cang yiem mborqv jaax baeng nyei buoz.
Maaih forng buangv forng-ndongh nyei mienh orn-lorqc haic. Yiem zingh gaengh caux win-wangv dunx sic nyei ziangh hoc yaac maiv zuqc nyaiv.
Dauh dauh taaih Ziouv nyei mienh, dongh gan ninh nyei jauv yangh wuov deix, maaih orn-lorqc.
Meih duqv nyanc meih ganh nyei buoz zoux daaih nyei ga'naaiv, meih ziouc orn-lorqc yaac duqv fuqv-loqc.
Meih nyei auv oix yiem meih nyei biauv hnangv a'ngunc hmei ziangh biouv gitv nor. Meih nyei naamh nyouz oix weih gormx meih nyei dieh, hnangv ga'lanv ndiangx nyei cunx nor.
Mangc maah! Taaih Ziouv nyei mienh zungv oix hnangv naaic duqv fuqv.
Tov Ziouv yiem Si^on ceix fuqv bun meih. Tov bun meih yietc seix buatc Ye^lu^saa^lem duqv longx.
Yaac tov bun meih maaih maengc ziangh jienv duqv buatc meih nyei fun-faqv. Tov bun I^saa^laa^en duqv baengh orn.
Ninh mbuo hoic yie zuqc kouv yiem yie hnyangx-jeiv lunx taux ih zanc. I^saa^laa^en Mienh aah! Ih zanc gorngv maah!
Ninh mbuo hoic yie zuqc kouv yiem yie hnyangx-jeiv lunx taux ih zanc, mv baac ninh mbuo maiv hingh yie.
Ninh mbuo mborqv yie nyei diqc daanz butv mbiuz ndaauv nyei, hnangv laih ndau nyei mienh laih ndau nor.
Ziouv se baengh fim nyei. Ninh hngaqv ndutv orqv mienh ndoh nyei hlaang.
Tov bun nzorng Si^on wuov deix yietc zungv mienh zuqc nyaiv yaac zuqc tuix nzuonx nqa'haav.
Tov bun ninh mbuo hnangv yiem biauv-ngorh cuotv nyei miev, maiv gaengh hlo ziouc kou nqaai mi'aqv.
Gaatv mbiauh nyei mienh maiv zorqv daaih gaatv, sai mbiauh nyei mienh yaac maiv gaux yietc zeiv.
Jiex jauv nyei mienh maiv gorngv, “Tov Ziouv ceix fuqv bun meih mbuo. Yie mbuo dengv Ziouv nyei mbuox buang waac bun meih mbuo.”
O Ziouv aac, yie yiem siem nyei dorngx heuc jienv meih.
Ziouv aac, tov meih muangx yie nyei sing-qiex. Tov baeng m'normh muangx yie heuc jienv jouh nyei waac.
O Ziouv aac, se gorngv meih nipc jienv yie nyei zuiz, Ziouv aac, haaix dauh haih biaux duqv ndutv, maiv zuqc dingc zuiz?
Mv baac meih guangc mienh nyei zuiz weic bun mienh taaih meih.
Yie zuov Ziouv, yie nyei hnyouv zuov jienv. Yie yaac kaux ninh nyei waac maaih lamh hnamv dorngx.
Yie nyei hnyouv zuov Ziouv gauh camv jiex siouv gaeng mienh zuov lungh njang, gauh camv jiex siouv gaeng mienh zuov lungh njang.
O I^saa^laa^en Mienh aac, oix zuqc kaux Ziouv maaih lamh hnamv dorngx, weic zuqc Ziouv ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh, ninh yaac maaih hnyouv zuoqc mienh taux daauh.
Ninh yaac oix zuoqc I^saa^laa^en Mienh biaux ndutv yietc zungv zoux dorngc nyei zuiz.
O Ziouv aac, yie nyei hnyouv maiv ceng-hlo, m'zing yaac maiv mangc hlang. Yie maiv la'nyauv taux haaix nyungc hlo nyei sic fai jiex ndaangc yie haih bieqc hnyouv nyei mbuoqc horngh sic.

Mv baac yie bun yie nyei hnyouv sekv nzieqc, baengh orn nyei, hnangv guangc ndutv nyorx nyei gu'nguaaz yiem maa nyei la'kuotv sekv nzieqc, yie nyei hnyouv yiem yie gu'nyuoz baengh orn nyei hnangv dangx ndutv nyorx nyei gu'nguaaz.
O I^saa^laa^en Mienh aac, oix zuqc kaux Ziouv maaih lamh hnamv dorngx, yiem naaiv mingh taux yietc liuz.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih jangx jienv Ndaawitv, dongh ninh diev nyei yietc zungv kouv naanc.
Jangx jienv ninh hnangv haaix nor caux Ziouv houv jienv laengz waac, se caux Yaakopv nyei Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh.
“Yie zungv maiv bieqc yie nyei biauv yaac maiv faaux yie nyei coux.
Yie maiv bun yie nyei m'zing m'njormh, yaac maiv bun m'zing-ndopv njipv.
Zuov taux yie weic Ziouv lorz duqv dorngx yiem, se lorz dorngx bun Yaakopv nyei Nernh Jiex nyei Tin-Hungh.”
Muangx gaax, yie mbuo haiz gorngv Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang yiem E^faa^taa, yie mbuo lorz buatc yiem Yaa^aa nyei ndeic.
“Mbuo oix zuqc bieqc ninh yiem nyei dorngx, yiem ninh lorngx zaux nyei dorngx baaix.
Ziouv aac, daaih maah! Liemh meih caux biux mengh meih nyei qaqv wuov norm Laengz Ngaengc Waac Faang daaih bieqc meih hitv kuonx nyei dorngx.
Tov bun meih nyei sai mienh zanc-zanc zoux horpc, yaac tov bun meih nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx njien-youh nyei heuc.”
Tov weic meih nyei bou, Ndaawitv, maiv dungx nqemh guangc meih longc youh orn daaih wuov dauh.
Ziouv dorng jienv Ndaawitv ziepc zuoqv nyei laengz ngaengc waac, ninh yaac maiv haih tuix. Ninh gorngv, “Yie oix liepc dauh meih ganh nyei dorn zueiz jienv meih nyei weic.

Se gorngv meih nyei dorn mbuo ei jienv yie laengz nyei ngaengc waac, yaac gan yie oix njaaux ninh mbuo nyei yietc zungv waac, ninh mbuo nyei zeiv-fun ziouc duqv yietc liuz zueiz jienv meih nyei weic.”
Weic zuqc Ziouv ginv Si^on. Ninh oix longc weic zoux ninh yiem nyei dorngx.
Ninh gorngv, “Naaiv se yie yietc liuz hitv nyei dorngx, yie oix yiem naaiv. Naaiv se yie nyei eix.
Yie oix ceix fuqv bun naaiv norm zingh nyei laangh ziqc bungx-zuoqc, yaac bun naaiv norm zingh nyei mienh jomc mienh duqv nyanc beuv.
Yie oix bun ninh nyei sai mienh duqv njoux en. Ninh nyei baeqc fingx yaac oix njien-youh nyei heuc.
Yie oix bun Ndaawitv nyei yietc dauh zeiv-fun yiem wuov zoux hungh. Yie weic yie longc youh orn daaih wuov dauh liepc dauh nzipc jienv zoux hungh.
Yie oix bun ninh nyei win-wangv zuqc nyaiv, mv baac ninh ganh ndongx nyei hungh ningv oix aengv cuotv njang.
Mangc maah! Gorx-youz horpc fim dongh eix nyei yiem se za'gengh longx nyei, orn-lorqc haic.
Naaiv beiv jaaix haic nyei youh dox jienv Aalon nyei m'nqorngv aengx liouc njiec siaam, aengx liouc njiec taux ninh nyei lui-ndaauv nyei lui-jaang.
Se hnangv Hemon Mbong nyei mbiungc-suiv duih njiec Si^on Mbong. Weic zuqc yiem wuov maaih Ziouv ceix nyei fuqv, se yietc liuz ziangh nyei maengc.
Ziouv nyei zuangx bou daaih maah! Dongh lungh muonz zanc souv jienv Ziouv nyei biauv nyei mienh, meih mbuo gunv ceng Ziouv aqv.
Hungx jienv cing-nzengc nyei dorngx sung buoz ceng Ziouv.
Tov Ziouv, dongh Zeix Lungh Zeix Ndau Wuov Dauh, yiem Si^on ceix fuqv bun meih mbuo.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv nyei mengh. Ziouv nyei zuangx bou aah! Oix zuqc ceng,
se meih mbuo souv jienv Ziouv nyei biauv, yiem yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh nyei biauv nyei laatc gu'nyuoz nyei mienh.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv weic zuqc Ziouv se longx haic. Baaux nzung ceng ninh nyei mengh, weic zuqc ninh korv-lienh mienh.
Weic zuqc Ziouv ginv Yaakopv weic ninh ganh, ginv I^saa^laa^en benx ninh ganh nyei buonc.
Yie hiuv duqv Ziouv se hlo haic, yie mbuo nyei Ziouv se gauh hlo jiex zuangx zienh.
Ziouv yiem gu'nguaaic lungh, yiem ga'ndiev ndau, yiem koiv gu'nyuoz caux yietc zungv ndo nyei dorngx, sueih ganh nyei eix oix zoux haaix nyungc ziouc zoux aqv.
Ninh bun mbuonx yiem lungh gorn faaux, ninh bun mba'lingc gan mbiungc daaih, yaac dorh nziaaux yiem ninh siou nyei dorngx cuotv daaih.
Se dongh ninh daix yiem I^yipv Deic-Bung nyei daauh toi dorn, liemh mienh, liemh saeng-kuv.
O I^yipv Mienh aah! Ninh yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx zoux jangx-hoc caux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic dingc Faalo Hungh caux ninh nyei zuangx jien nyei zuiz.
Ninh mietc ziex! ziex fingx mienh, aengx daix henv haic nyei hungh diex.
Ninh daix Aa^mo^lai Mienh nyei Si^honx Hungh, caux Mbaasaan Deic nyei Okc Hungh, caux Kaa^naa^an nyei yietc zungv hungh diex.
Ninh yaac zorqv ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung jiu bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx, I^saa^laa^en Mienh, benx ninh mbuo nzipc nyei buonc.
O Ziouv aac, meih nyei mengh yietc liuz yiem. O Ziouv aac, mienh oix jangx meih nyei mengh dauh taux maanc doic.
Ziouv oix tengx ninh nyei baeqc fingx caengx sic, yaac korv-lienh ninh nyei zuangx bou.
Ganh fingx mienh nyei miuc-fangx longc jiem longc nyaanh zoux, se mienh nyei buoz zoux daaih.
Naaiv deix miuc-fangx maaih nzuih mv baac maiv haih gorngv waac, maaih m'zing mv baac mangc maiv buatc.
Ninh mbuo maaih m'normh mv baac ninh mbuo muangx maiv haiz, ninh mbuo nyei nzuih maiv maaih yietc deix tauv nyei qiex.
Zoux naaiv deix miuc-fangx nyei mienh ziouc hnangv naaiv deix miuc-fangx nor. Da'faanh kaux miuc-fangx nyei mienh yaac fih hnangv nyei.
O I^saa^laa^en nyei zeiv-fun aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. O Aalon nyei zeiv-fun aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
O Lewi nyei zeiv-fun aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Taaih Ziouv nyei mienh aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc yiem Si^on ceng Ziouv, se yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh nyei Ziouv. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Meih mbuo oix zuqc dor-ziec Ziouv weic zuqc ninh longx haic. Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec maanc zienh nyei Zienh, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec maanc ziouv nyei Ziouv, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Kungx ninh ganh zoux domh mbuoqc horngh nyei sic, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh longc ninh ganh nyei wuonh zaang zeix lungh, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh ceix ndau yiem wuom-minc gu'nguaaic, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh zeix domh njang cuotv daaih, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh zeix mba'hnoi gunv lungh hnoi zanc, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh zeix hlaax caux hleix gunv lungh muonz zanc, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh daix I^yipv Mienh nyei dorn-la'gauv, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh dorh I^saa^laa^en Mienh yiem ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx cuotv daaih, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh sung cuotv ninh domh qaqv nyei buoz, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh bun nqoi Koiv-Siqv nyei wuom, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh dorh I^saa^laa^en Mienh yangh koiv mbu'ndongx jiex Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh zorqv Faalo Hungh caux ninh nyei baeng-guanh mbienv njiec Koiv-Siqv. Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Mv baac ninh yienz ganh nyei baeqc fingx jiex deic-bung-huaang, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh daix domh hungh diex, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh daix ziex dauh maaih mengh hoc nyei hungh, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh daix Aa^mo^lai Mienh nyei Si^honx Hungh, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh aengx daix Mbaasaan Deic nyei Okc Hungh, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh zorqv ninh mbuo nyei deic-bung bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx nzipc, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Se jiu bun ninh nyei bou, I^saa^laa^en Mienh, nzipc nyei buonc, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Yie mbuo ndortv njiec zuqc kouv nyei ziangh hoc ninh jangx yie mbuo, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh njoux yie mbuo biaux ndutv win-wangv, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Ninh ceix nyanc hopv bun maaih maengc nyei ga'naaiv, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec lungh zaangc nyei Tin-Hungh, Weic zuqc ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv mienh.
Yie mbuo zueiz jienv Mbaa^mbi^lon nyei ndoqv-hlen, yietv jangx zuqc Si^on ziouc nyiemv.
Yie mbuo zorqv yie mbuo nyei daanh baah kuangx jienv yiem naaiv nyei suiv-liemh ndiangx,

weic zuqc caangv yie mbuo daaih wuov deix oix yie mbuo baaux nzung, hoic yie mbuo wuov deix oix yie mbuo tengx ninh mbuo zoux nauc nyitc ziouc gorngv, “Baaux diuh Si^on nyei nzung bun yie mbuo muangx maah!”
Yie mbuo yiem ganh fingx mienh nyei deic-bung, hnangv haaix nor haih baaux Ziouv nyei nzung?
O Ye^lu^saa^lem aah! Se gorngv yie la'kuqv meih, tov bun yie nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz hngongx mingh.
Se gorngv yie maiv jangx Ye^lu^saa^lem, yaac maiv funx Ye^lu^saa^lem weih bun yie gauh duqv njien-youh jiex, tov bun yie nyei mbietc naetv jienv yie nyei nzuih dungz.
O Ziouv aac, tov jangx E^ndom Mienh hnangv haaix nor zoux. Ye^lu^saa^lem mbaang wuov hnoi ninh mbuo gorngv, “Oix zuqc baaic, oix zuqc baaic aqv, oix zuqc caeqv njiec taux gorn-ndoqv.”
O Mbaa^mbi^lon aah! Weic meih zoux bun yie mbuo nyei sic, jaauv win bun meih wuov dauh oix zuqc orn-lorqc.
Zorqv meih nyei gu'nguaaz-faix guaeqv la'bieiv wuov dauh yaac maaih orn-lorqc aqv.
O Ziouv aac, yie longc nzengc hnyouv dor-ziec meih. Yie dorng jienv zuangx zienh nyei nza'hmien baaux nzung ceng meih.

Yie hungx jienv meih nyei singx dinc baaix, yaac dor-ziec meih, weic meih se ziepc zuoqv nyei yaac ziepc zuoqv hnamv meih nyei mienh, weic zuqc meih taaih meih nyei mengh caux meih nyei waac gauh hlo jiex maanc muotc.
Yie heuc meih wuov hnoi meih dau yie, meih longc meih nyei qaqv bun yie nyei hnyouv henv jiez daaih.
O Ziouv aac, lungh ndiev nyei zuangx hungh oix ceng meih, weic zuqc ninh mbuo haiz meih nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac.
Ninh mbuo oix baaux nzung ceng Ziouv zoux nyei jauv, weic zuqc Ziouv nyei njang-laangc gengh hlo haic.
Maiv gunv Ziouv yiem hlang, ninh ziux goux haac dangv nyei mienh, mv baac ninh yiem go nyei dorngx mangc duqv hiuv zoux maux nyei mienh.
Maiv gunv yie yiem naanc zingh gu'nyuoz, meih beu yie nyei maengc. Yie nyei win-wangv qiex jiez, meih sung meih nyei buoz cuotv mborqv hingh, meih nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz njoux yie.
Ziouv oix zoux ziangx nyungc-nyungc ziux ninh weic yie maaih nyei za'eix. O Ziouv aac, meih ziepc zuoqv hnamv mienh taux yietc liuz. Tov meih maiv dungx guangc meih nyei buoz zoux nyei gong.
O Ziouv aac, meih zaah mangc yie, yaac hiuv yie.
Yie zueiz njiec fai jiez sin meih hiuv nyei. Meih yiem go nyei dorngx hiuv duqv yie nyei hnyouv hnamv nyei jauv.
Yie bieqc cuotv fai bueix njiec meih mangc muonc nyei, yaac hiuv toux yie zoux nyei yietc zungv jauv.
O Ziouv aac, yie liemh maiv gaengh gorngv cuotv yietc joux waac meih zungv hiuv nzengc mi'aqv.
Meih yiem yie nyei nza'hmien maengx caux yie nyei nqa'haav nqaang, yaac longc meih nyei buoz maan jienv yie.
Meih ndongc naaiv hiuv yie, yie gengh! mbuoqc horngh haic, se gauh hlang yie haih bieqc hnyouv nyei.
Yie haih mingh haaix cingx haih biaux ndutv meih nyei Singx Lingh? Fai yie haih biaux mingh haaix cingx leih ndutv meih nyei hmien?
Se gorngv yie faaux lungh, meih yiem wuov. Se gorngv yie njiec yiemh gen, meih yaac yiem wuov.
Se gorngv yie ndaix mingh mba'hnoi cuotv nyei dorngx, fai yiem wuov bung ziqc koiv,
meih zungv yiem wuov dorh yie, yaac yiem wuov tengx yie.
Se gorngv yie gorngv, “Tov bun hmuangx torngv jienv yie, bun weih gormx yie nyei njang tiuv benx lungh muonz zanc.”
Weic meih nor, liemh hmuangx yaac maiv zeiz hmuangx, lungh muonz zanc yaac ndongc lungh hnoi zanc njang, weic meih aeqv, hmuangx se hnangv njang.
Meih zeix yiem yie gu'nyuoz nyei nyungc-nyungc. Yiem maa nyei ga'sie meih gapv yie daaih.
Yie ceng meih weic zuqc meih zeix yie cuotv daaih peix fuc haic, mbuoqc horngh haic. Meih zoux nyei nyungc-nyungc za'gengh peix fuc haic. Yie nyei hnyouv zien-zien hiuv duqv.
Yie yiem maa nyei ga'sie zeix cuotv, se yiem gem jienv nyei dorngx gapv yie nyei mbungv-qorng nyei ziangh hoc, zungv bingx meih maiv mbueiz.

Yie nyei sin maiv gaengh benx fangx zeiv, meih nyei m'zing zungv buatc yie mi'aqv. Yie liemh maiv gaengh maaih yietc norm hnoi wuov zanc, meih weic yie dingc daaih nyei hnoi-nyieqc yietc zungv fiev jienv meih nyei sou-daan.
O Tin-Hungh aac, meih hnamv nyei sic weic yie nor za'gengh jaaix haic. Gapv daaih nyei soux mouc ndongc haaix camv aqv.
Se gorngv yie saauv nor, maaih gauh camv saa-ziou. Yie nyie daaih nyei ziangh hoc, yie corc caux meih yiem.
O Tin-Hungh aac, feix duqv meih daix nzengc orqv mienh, feix duqv daix mienh nyei mienh leih nqoi yie.
Ninh mbuo gorngv orqv nyei waac daanh meih, yaac gorngv doqc meih nyei mengh.
O Ziouv aac, yie nzorng haic dongh nzorng meih wuov deix mienh. Yie yaac youx dongh ngaengc jienv meih wuov deix.
Yie nzorng ninh mbuo taux mbungv-fim, yaac funx ninh mbuo benx yie nyei win-wangv.
O Tin-Hungh aac, tov zaah mangc yie, seix yie yaac hiuv duqv yie hnyouv hnamv nyei jauv.
Mangc gaax yiem yie maaih haaix nyungc orqv nyei sic, yaac tov dorh yie yangh yietc liuz nyei jauv.
O Ziouv aac, tov njoux yie biaux ndutv orqv mienh. Tov beu jienv yie, maiv bun mienh doqc mienh hoic.
Ninh mbuo yiem hnyouv daav cuotv waaic nyei za'eix, yaac zanc-zanc coqv-huv mborqv jaax.
Ninh mbuo bun ninh mbuo nyei mbietc laic hnangv naang nyei mbietc laic nor. Ninh mbuo nyei nzuih meix maaih naang-jieqv nyei ndie-doqc.
O Ziouv aac, tov njoux yie biaux ndutv orqv mienh nyei buoz-ndiev, beu yie maiv zuqc doqc nyei mienh hoic, ninh mbuo daav za'eix bun yie nyei zaux ndiqv zuqc ndorpc.
Zoux maux nyei mienh bingx jienv zaeng koux zorqv yie, ninh mbuo longc hlaang corng mungz, yiem jauv-hlen zaeng koux hlopv yie.
Yie gorngv mbuox Ziouv, “Meih zoux yie nyei Tin-Hungh. O Ziouv aac, tov baeng m'normh muangx yie jouh nyei sing-qiex.
O Ziouv, yie nyei Ziouv, dongh maaih qaqv henv njoux yie wuov dauh aac, mborqv domh jaax nyei hnoi-nyieqc meih torngv jienv yie nyei m'nqorngv.
O Ziouv aac, tov maiv dungx ei jienv orqv mienh nyei eix zoux, maiv dungx bun ninh mbuo orqv nyei za'eix cuotv, nziex ninh mbuo haih ceng-hlo.
Tov maiv dungx bun weih jienv yie wuov deix mienh hingh jiex. Tov bun ninh mbuo nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac nzuonx daaih hoic ninh mbuo ganh.
Tov bun zieqc jienv douz nyei taanx ndortv njiec ninh mbuo. Tov bun ninh mbuo zuqc zoi njiec ndo nyei kuotv, yietc liuz maiv haih cuotv.
Tov maiv dungx bun gorngv waac-huv nyei mienh liepc nguaaz-gorn yiem deic-bung. Tov bun orqv nyei sic siepv-siepv zorqv jienv zoux doqc nyei mienh.
Yie hiuv duqv Ziouv baav jienv ndortv naanc nyei mienh, yaac baengh fim nyei dunx weic mienh jomc mienh.
Kuv mienh zungv oix ceng meih nyei mengh, hnyouv zingx nyei mienh yaac oix yiem meih nyei nza'hmien.
O Ziouv aac, yie heuc jienv meih. Tov siepv-siepv nyei daaih tengx yie. Yie heuc meih nyei ziangh hoc, tov baeng m'normh muangx yie nyei sing-qiex.
Tov bun yie daux gaux nyei waac hnangv hung yiem meih nyei nza'hmien. Yie sung jienv nyei buoz hnangv lungh maanz-hmuangx ziec nyei ga'naaiv.
O Ziouv aac, tov gunv yie nyei nzuih hnangv zuov gaengh mienh zuov gaengh nor. Tov goux jienv yie nyei nzuih meix nyei gaengh.
Tov bun yie maiv maaih hnyouv zoux orqv sic, bun yie maiv dungx caux zoux orqv nyei mienh juangc jienv zoux waaic sic, yaac maiv dungx bun yie nyanc ninh mbuo kuv haic nyei lai-hnaangx.

Tov bun kuv mienh mborqv yie. Naaiv se weih zoux longx. Tov bun ninh gorngv-hemx yie, se hnangv zorqv youh dox yie nyei m'nqorngv. Tov bun yie nyei m'nqorngv maiv nqemh. Weic zuqc yie daux gaux nyei waac zanc-zanc ngaengc jienv orqv mienh nyei orqv sic.
Ninh mbuo nyei siemv zuiz jien zuqc zoi njiec la'bieiv-mbaengx wuov zanc, mienh ziouc hoqc hiuv Ziouv nyei waac se zien nyei.
Hnangv mienh laih ndau cenv muonc nzengc, ninh mbuo nyei mbungv oix zuqc nzaanx mingh taux yiemh gen nyei kuotv-ndaangc.
O Ziouv Tin-Hungh aac, yie nyei m'zing mangc jienv meih. Yie ndaauh kaux meih. Maiv dungx guangc yie, bun yie maiv lamh kaux dorngx.
Tov beu jienv yie biaux ndutv ninh mbuo zaeng weic hlopv yie nyei koux, caux orqv mienh zaeng nyei hlaang.
Tov bun orqv mienh ndortv njiec ninh mbuo ganh zaeng nyei mungz, mv baac tov bun yie duqv biaux ndutv mingh.
Yie cuotv qiex heuc Ziouv, yie longc yie nyei sing-qiex jouh Ziouv.
Yie yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien qaqv gorngv yie nyei kouv-zingh kouv-latc, zorqv yie nyei kuonx naanh mbuox ninh.
Yie hnyouv mau jienv njiec nyei ziangh hoc, meih hiuv duqv yie nyei jauv-louc. Yiem yie yangh nyei jauv win-wangv zaeng hlaang oix hlopv yie.
Tov meih huin mbiaauc bung mangc, maiv maaih haaix dauh ciepv yie. Yie maiv maaih dorngx kaux, maiv maaih haaix dauh maaih hnyouv tengx yie.
O Ziouv aac, yie heuc jienv meih. Yie gorngv, “Meih zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx, yiem yaangh seix meih zoux yie nyei fuqv-buonc.”
Tov muangx yie heuc jienv jouh nyei waac, weic zuqc yie kouv taux ndiev. Tov njoux yie biaux ndutv zeix yie wuov deix, weic zuqc ninh mbuo gauh henv yie.
Tov dorh yie cuotv loh, weic bun yie haih dor-ziec meih nyei mengh. Kuv mienh oix weih gormx yie, weic zuqc meih za'gengh zoux longx bun yie.
O Ziouv aac, tov muangx yie daux gaux, tov baeng m'normh muangx yie jouh nyei waac. Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei, baengh fim nyei, tov dau yie.
Tov maiv dungx siemv yie, meih nyei bou, weic zuqc ziux meih mangc, maiv maaih yietc dauh ziangh jienv nyei mienh zoux duqv horpc nzengc.
Yie nyei win-wangv zunc yie, caaiv yie njiec taux ndau. Ninh bun yie yiem hmuangx nyei dorngx, hnangv daic mingh lauh haic nyei mienh nor.
Weic naaiv yie nyei hnyouv mau jienv njiec, yie nyei hnyouv gengh kouv taux ndiev.
Yie jangx taux loz-hnoi, yie fei-fangv meih zoux nyei yietc zungv sic, yaac hnamv taux meih nyei buoz zoux nyei gong.
Yie hungx jienv meih sung buoz. Yie ngorc meih ndongc ndau-nqaai ngorc mbiungc.

O Ziouv aac, tov siepv-siepv nyei dau yie. Yie nyei hnyouv maiv lamh hnamv dorngx. Tov meih maiv dungx bingx meih nyei hmien, maiv mangc yie, nziex yie haih hnangv mingh yiem yiemh gen wuov deix mienh.
Tov bun yie lungh ndorm nziouv duqv haiz meih ziepc zuoqv hnamv yie weic zuqc yie kaux meih. Tov meih bun yie hiuv duqv horpc yangh nyei jauv, weic zuqc yie daux gaux nyei waac faaux taux meih.
O Ziouv aac, tov meih njoux yie biaux ndutv yie nyei win-wangv. Yie bingx jienv meih weic zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx.
Tov meih njaaux yie ei meih nyei eix, weic zuqc meih se yie nyei Tin-Hungh. Tov bun meih longx haic nyei Singx Lingh dorh yie yangh baengh nyei jauv.
O Ziouv aac, tov weic meih nyei mengh beu yie nyei maengc. Tov longc meih baengh fim nyei za'eix dorh yie yiem kuonx naanh cuotv daaih.
Weic zuqc meih ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie, tov meih jamv guangc yie nyei win-wangv, yaac mietc nzengc yie nyei yietc zungv win-jaa, weic zuqc yie zoux meih nyei bou.
Ceng Ziouv, yie nyei La'bieiv. Ninh tengx yie hoqc linc mborqv jaax, njaaux yie haih mborqv domh jaax.

Ninh se ziepc zuoqv nyei hnamv yie wuov dauh Ziouv, zoux beu yie nyei dorngx, dongh yie kaux wuonv nyei dorngx, caux njoux yie wuov dauh. Ninh zoux yie nyei torngv-baaih, zoux yie ndaauh kaux nyei dorngx. Ninh bun ganh fingx zuqc yiem yie nyei buoz-ndiev.
O Ziouv aac, baamh mienh benx haaix nyungc meih cingx jangx taux ninh? Seix zaangc mienh benx haaix nyungc meih cingx hnamv taux ninh?
Mienh se hnangv tauv nzunc qiex. Ninh nyei hnoi-nyieqc jiex hnangv dongh linh siepv-siepv nyei jiex mingh nor.
O Ziouv aac, koi nqoi lungh njiec daaih, hluo mbong bun mbong cuotv sioux.
Tov borngz mba'lingc cuotv bun win-wangv nzaanx nzengc. Buonv meih nyei forng-cang bun ninh mbuo faatv nzaanx nyei biaux.
Tov meih yiem hlang nyei dorngx sung buoz cuotv daaih, njoux yie, baeng yie cuotv wuom ndo nyei dorngx, aengx njoux yie biaux ndutv ganh fingx nyei buoz-ndiev.
Ninh mbuo nyei nzuih kungx gorngv-baeqc hnangv, liemh sung mbiaauc jieqv buoz laengz waac yaac jaav nyei.
O Tin-Hungh aac, yie oix baaux diuh siang-nzung bun meih, oix longc ziepc diuh finx nyei daanh baah patv bun meih.
Meih bun hungh diex duqv hingh, yaac njoux meih nyei bou, Ndaawitv, biaux ndutv hoic maengc nyei nzuqc ndaauv.
Tov meih njoux yie, tengx yie biaux ndutv ganh fingx mienh nyei buoz-ndiev. Ninh mbuo nyei nzuih kungx gorngv-baeqc hnangv. Liemh sung mbiaauc jieqv buoz laengz waac yaac jaav nyei.
Tov bun yie mbuo nyei dorn yiem hnyangx-jeiv lunx nyei ziangh hoc hnangv ndiangx hlo dingc nor. Tov bun yie mbuo nyei sieqv hnangv zuqc daaih zoux hungh dinc biauv-gorqv nyei ndiouh.
Tov bun yie mbuo nyei lamz dapv buangv nyungc-nyungc laangh ziqc. Tov bun yie mbuo nyei ba'gi yungh yiem yie mbuo nyei ciangv njiec dorn cin-cin waanc-waanc.
Tov bun yie mbuo nyei ngongh njiec dorn camv, maiv waaic, maiv dingx laaih. Yaac tov bun yie mbuo nyei jaai-horngc maiv maaih zuqc kouv, nyiemv nyei sing-qiex.
Duqv naaiv nyungc fuqv nyei baeqc fingx maaih orn-lorqc. Maaih Ziouv zoux ninh mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh wuov deix baeqc fingx maaih orn-lorqc.
Yie nyei Tin-Hungh, yie nyei Hungh Diex aac, yie oix ceng meih weih hlo. Yie oix yietc liuz ceng meih nyei mengh taux maanc gouv maanc doic.
Yie oix hnoi-hnoi ceng meih. Yie oix ceng meih nyei mengh yietc liuz yietc seix.
Ziouv za'gengh hlo haic, horpc zuqc camv-camv nyei ceng. Ninh gengh! hlo haic, zungv hnamv maiv zaaic aqv.
Naaiv doic oix ceng meih zoux nyei sic bun wuov doic muangx, yaac oix zunh yaangh meih nyei domh qaqv zoux nyei sic.
Yie oix fei-fangv meih domh njang-laangc nyei haangh daauh caux zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei jauv.
Mienh oix zunh gorngv Ziouv zoux mbuoqc horngh, gamh nziex nyei sic, yaac zunh yaangh Ziouv za'gengh hlo haic.
Ninh mbuo oix zunh gorngv meih longx haic nyei jauv, yaac oix cuotv qiex baaux nzung gorngv meih se baengh fim nyei.
Ziouv ceix en yaac korv-lienh mienh. Ninh maiv qiex jiez siepv yaac maaih hnamv mienh nyei hnyouv buangv nzengc.
Ziouv zoux longx bun maanc mienh. Ninh yaac korv-lienh ninh zeix daaih nyei yietc zungv.
O Ziouv aac, meih zeix daaih nyei maanc muotc zungv oix dor-ziec meih. Meih nyei yietc zungv baeqc fingx yaac oix ceng meih.
Ninh mbuo oix zunh gorngv meih nyei guoqv nyei njang-laangc, yaac gorngv taux meih nyei domh qaqv,
weic bun zuangx mienh hiuv duqv meih zoux henv haic nyei sic, caux meih nyei guoqv nyei domh njang-laangc.

Meih nyei guoqv se yietc liuz nyei guoqv. Meih yietc liuz duqv gunv taux maanc gouv maanc doic. Ziouv ziepc zuoqv ei jienv ninh yietc zungv laengz nyei waac zoux. Yiem ninh zoux nyei yietc zungv sic ninh korv-lienh.
Ziouv oix baav jienv yietc zungv zuqc ndorpc nyei mienh. Zuqc kouv nyei mienh ninh yaac liepc jiez daaih.
Da'faanh maaih maengc nyei ga'naaiv mangc jienv meih, ziux horpc zuqc bun nyei ziangh hoc meih yaac bun nyanc hopv ninh mbuo.
Meih zoux hnyouv jangv bun nyungc-nyungc maaih maengc nyei ga'naaiv duqv nyanc beuv.
Ziouv yiem ninh zoux nyei diuc-diuc jauv baengh fim nyei. Yiem ninh zoux nyei yietc zungv sic ninh yaac korv-lienh.
Ziouv yiem nitv fatv dauh dauh heuc jienv jouh ninh nyei mienh, dongh yietc zungv longc hnyouv zingx nyei heuc wuov deix.
Ninh oix ei jienv taaih ninh wuov deix nyei hnyouv oix nyei zoux ziangx. Ninh yaac muangx haiz ninh mbuo heuc jienv tov ziouc njoux ninh mbuo.
Ziouv beu jienv yietc zungv hnamv ninh nyei mienh, mv baac da'faanh orqv mienh ninh oix mietc nzengc.
Yie nyei nzuih oix gorngv cuotv ceng Ziouv nyei waac. Zuangx mienh oix zuqc lomh nzoih yietc liuz ceng ninh nyei cing-nzengc mengh taux yietc liuz.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Yie nyei hnyouv aac, oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Da'faanh yie ziangh jienv nyei hnoi-nyieqc yie oix ceng Ziouv. Yie yietc seix oix baaux nzung ceng yie nyei Tin-Hungh.
Meih mbuo maiv dungx kaux zoux hlo nyei mienh, maiv dungx kaux baamh mienh, weic zuqc ninh mbuo maiv haih tengx maiv duqv.
Ninh yietv dangx qiex ziouc nzuonx benx nie. Dongh wuov hnoi ninh daav nyei za'eix zuqc mietc nzengc mi'aqv.
Maaih Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh tengx wuov dauh maaih orn-lorqc, se kaux Ziouv, ninh nyei Tin-Hungh, maaih lamh hnamv dorngx,
dongh zeix lungh zeix ndau zeix koiv, caux yiem naaiv deix gu'nyuoz nyei maanc muotc, ninh yietc liuz ziepc zuoqv ei jienv ninh nyei waac zoux.
Ninh baengh fim nyei siemv tengx zuqc zeix nyei mienh yaac ceix nyanc hopv bun hnyouv sie nyei mienh nyanc. Ziouv bun zuqc wuonx nyei mienh duqv bungx nqoi.
Ziouv bun m'zing maengh nyei mienh haih mangc duqv buatc. Zuqc kouv nyei mienh, Ziouv yaac liepc jiez. Ziouv hnamv kuv mienh.
Ziouv goux jienv yiem deic-bung nyei ganh fingx mienh, ninh tengx guh hanh fu'jueiv caux auv-guaav, mv baac ninh bun orqv mienh nyei za'eix hoic ninh mbuo zuqc baaic.
Ziouv yietc liuz zoux hungh. O Si^on aah! Meih nyei Tin-Hungh duqv gunv taux maanc gouv maanc doic. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Baaux nzung ceng yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh se za'gengh longx haic. Ceng ninh se za'gengh horpc yaac puix haic.
Ziouv ceix Ye^lu^saa^lem jiez daaih. Ninh siou zunv zuqc guaatv mingh nzaanx nzengc nyei I^saa^laa^en Mienh.
Zuqc hnyouv mun kouv nyei mienh ninh zorc longx yaac beu jienv ninh mbuo zuqc mun nyei dorngx.
Ninh dingc ziangx hleix nyei soux mouc, tengx norm-norm hleix cuotv mbuox.
Yie mbuo nyei Ziouv za'gengh hlo haic, maaih domh qaqv. Ninh nyei cong-mengh jiex ndaangc haih ndorqc duqv taux.
Ziouv bouh zuqc zeix nyei mienh faaux, zorqv orqv mienh zoi njiec ndau.
Oix zuqc dor-ziec, baaux nzung ceng Ziouv, longc daanh baah patv nzung bun yie mbuo nyei Tin-Hungh.
Ninh longc mbuonx om jienv lungh, ninh liuc leiz mbiungc duih njiec ndau, bun miev cuotv yiem mbong gu'nguaaic.
Ninh ceix nyanc hopv bun saeng-kuv, caux heuc jienv nyei norqc aa dorn.
Ninh a'hneiv nyei se maiv zeiz maaz nyei qaqv, yaac maiv zeiz a'hneiv baamh mienh nyei zaux.
Ziouv a'hneiv nyei se taaih ninh nyei mienh, dongh kaux ninh ziepc zuoqv hnamv mienh nyei hnyouv wuov deix.
O Ye^lu^saa^lem aah! Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. O Si^on aah! Oix zuqc ceng meih nyei Tin-Hungh.
Ninh bun meih nyei zingh laatc nyei gaengh sorn wuonv, ceix fuqv bun yiem meih gu'nyuoz nyei naamh nyouz.
Ninh bun meih nyei gapv-jaaix gu'nyuoz taaix-baengh, bun gauh longx jiex nyei mbiauh meih mbuo duqv nyanc beuv.
Ninh bun ninh nyei lingc cuotv mingh gormx lungh ndiev, ninh nyei waac mingh siepv nyei.
Ninh bun sorng hnangv ba'gi yungh biei, bun mbiungc-suiv gitv daaih nzaanx mingh hnangv saaiv nor.
Ninh bun duih borqc njiec hnangv la'bieiv-muonc nor. Ninh bun nziaaux-namx buonc daaih, haaix dauh haih diev duqv!
Ninh yietv gorngv cuotv waac, naaiv deix yuqc nzengc. Ninh bun ninh nyei nziaaux buonc daaih, wuom ziouc liouc.
Ninh zorqv ninh nyei waac bun Yaakopv, ninh nyei leiz-nyeic caux leiz jiu bun I^saa^laa^en.
Ninh maiv hnangv naaiv zoux weic ganh fingx mienh, ninh mbuo maiv hiuv duqv ninh nyei leiz. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc yiem gu'nguaaic lungh ceng Ziouv, yiem hlang nyei dorngx ceng ninh.
Ninh nyei zuangx fin-mienh oix zuqc ceng ninh. Ninh nyei zuangx fin-mienh baeng oix zuqc ceng ninh.
Mba'hnoi aah! Hlaax aah! Oix zuqc ceng ninh. Ziux njang nyei yietc zungv hleix aah! Oix zuqc ceng ninh.
Hlang jiex nyei lungh caux yiem lungh gu'nguaaic nyei wuom aah! Oix zuqc ceng ninh.
Tov bun naaiv deix yietc zungv ceng Ziouv nyei mengh, weic zuqc ninh yietv hatc ziouc cuotv daaih aqv.
Ninh liepc naaiv deix daaih yietc liuz taux yietc liuz. Ninh njiec nyei lingc yietc liuz maiv haih jiex.
Oix zuqc yiem ndau-beih ceng Ziouv. Koiv nyei domh mbiauz caux yiem koiv ndo nyei dorngx yietc zungv oix zuqc ceng.
Douz caux borqc, sorng caux mbuonx, caux ei jienv ninh nyei lingc nyei domh nziaaux,
domh mbong fiuv-mbong yietc zungv, ziangh biouv nyei ndiangx caux yietc zungv si^ndaa zongh ndiangx,
hieh zoih caux yietc zungv saeng-kuv, nyorng ndau nyei ga'naaiv caux haih ndaix nyei norqc oix zuqc ceng ninh.
Lungh ndiev nyei hungh diex caux maanc fingx mienh, zoux jien nyei caux yietc zungv zoux hlo nyei mienh,
houh saeng caux sieqv, mienh gox mienh caux fu'jueiv oix zuqc ceng ninh.
Tov bun naaiv deix yietc zungv ceng Ziouv nyei mengh, weic zuqc kungx maaih ninh nyei mbuox ganh hlo jiex hnangv. Ninh nyei njang-laangc yiem lungh caux ndau gu'nguaaic.
Ninh bun ninh nyei baeqc fingx henv weic bun ninh nyei cing-nzengc baeqc fingx ceng ninh, se dongh nitv ninh fatv nyei baeqc fingx, I^saa^laa^en Mienh. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc baaux diuh siang-nzung bun Ziouv. Oix zuqc yiem ninh ziepc zuoqv nyei baeqc fingx gapv zunv nyei dorngx ceng ninh.
Oix zuqc bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh weic Zeix Ninh Mbuo Daaih Wuov Dauh a'hneiv. Oix zuqc bun Si^on nyei baeqc fingx weic ninh mbuo nyei Hungh Diex orn-lorqc.
Oix zuqc bun ninh mbuo cangx heix ceng ninh nyei mengh, mborqv nzoz patv daanh baah ceng ninh.
Weic zuqc Ziouv a'hneiv ninh nyei baeqc fingx, ninh bun nyiemc ganh zoux faix nyei mienh duqv hingh jiex.
Tov bun gan longx ninh wuov deix weic ninh mbuo duqv hingh jiex nyei njang-laangc njien-youh. Tov bun ninh mbuo yiem ninh mbuo nyei coux njien-youh nyei baaux nzung.
Tov bun ninh mbuo baaux nzung mbui nyei ceng Tin-Hungh, yaac bun ninh mbuo nyei buoz nanv jienv i maengx laic nyei nzuqc ndaauv,
weic jaauv win bun maanc guoqv mienh, siemv dingc maanc fingx nyei zuiz,
weic zorqv ninh mbuo nyei hungh ndoh jienv, yaac longc hlieqv-limc ndoh ninh mbuo zoux hlo nyei mienh,
weic zoux ziangx ziux fiev jienv oix hnangv haaix nor dingc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz. Naaiv se Tin-Hungh nyei yietc zungv baeqc fingx duqv nyei njang-laangc. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc yiem ninh nyei singx dinc ceng Tin-Hungh, oix zuqc yiem ninh nernh haic nyei lungh ceng ninh.
Ceng ninh weic ninh zoux domh qaqv nyei sic. Ceng ninh weic zuqc ninh za'gengh! hlo haic.
Longc nzatc ceng ninh, longc domh daanh baah, fiuv-daanh baah ceng ninh.
Mborqv nzoz, cangx heix ceng ninh, patv daanh baah, biomv hlauv-ndongh nux ceng ninh.
Nqaapv caauh zeiv ceng ninh, longc caauh zeiv nqaapv qom-qaau nyei mbui ceng ninh.
Yietc zungv haih tauv qiex nyei ga'naaiv oix zuqc ceng Ziouv. Oix zuqc ceng Ziouv.
Naaiv se Ndaawitv nyei dorn, I^saa^laa^en nyei hungh, Saa^lo^morn, nyei cong-mengh waac. Naaiv deix cong-mengh waac se
weic bun mienh hiuv duqv cong-mengh caux njaaux nyei jauv, yaac bieqc hnyouv tengx mienh mengh baeqc nyei waac.
weic njaaux mienh yiem naaiv seix zaangc longc cong-mengh, zoux duqv horpc, zoux duqv baengh fim, hnyouv zingx nyei,
weic bun maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei mienh haih guai, yaac bun mienh lunx mienh guai, maaih hnyouv haih samx duqv cuotv,
weic bun cong-mengh mienh muangx yaac haih jaa hoqc hiuv camv, bieqc hnyouv nyei mienh yaac haih maaih banh zeic,
weic bun mienh haih mengh baeqc cong-mengh waac caux meiv jienv gorngv nyei waac, yaac bieqc hnyouv cong-mengh mienh nyei waac caux ninh mbuo nyei waac-ormv.
Wuonh zaang nyei gorn se oix zuqc taaih Ziouv. Mienh hngongx mienh mangc piex cong-mengh caux njaaux nyei waac.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Oix zuqc muangx meih nyei die kuinx nyei waac, yaac maiv dungx guangc meih nyei maa njaaux nyei jauv,
weic zuqc naaiv deix i nyungc benx nzueic haic nyei ningv ndongx jienv meih nyei m'nqorngv, yaac hnangv diuh jiem-limc dangh jienv meih nyei jaang nor.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Se gorngv zuiz-mienh yuoqc meih, maiv dungx gan ninh mbuo.
Se gorngv ninh mbuo gorngv, “Daaih maah! Caux yie mbuo mingh zuov jienv daix mienh, mbuo dangv jienv maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh.
Mbuo oix zorqv ninh mbuo liemh nangh naqv hnangv njiec yiemh gen, oix zorqv ninh mbuo ziangh dauh naqv hnangv njiec ndo haic nyei kuotv wuov deix mienh.
Mbuo ziouc duqv nyungc-nyungc jaaix nyei ga'naaiv, yaac zorqv luv daaih nyei ga'naaiv dapv buangv mbuo nyei biauv.
Meih gunv caux yie mbuo maaih buonc, mbuo ziouc juangc yietc norm nyaanh mbuoqc.”
Yie nyei dorn aah! Maiv dungx gan ninh mbuo mingh! Maiv dungx bun meih nyei zaux caaiv ninh mbuo yangh nyei jauv,
weic zuqc ninh mbuo nyei zaux tiux mingh zoux orqv, ninh mbuo beqv jienv oix daix mienh, bun nziaamv liouc cuotv.
Norqc buatc jienv mienh zaeng mungz se maiv lamh longc.
Naaiv deix mienh zuov jienv bun ganh zuqc daic, ninh mbuo zaeng mungz zorqv ganh nyei maengc.
Da'faanh longc orqv nyei jauv lorz zinh nyaanh yaac hnangv naaiv nor, zungv hoic nyaanh ziouv guangc maengc.
Cong-mengh se hnangv dauh m'sieqv dorn yiem jaai-horngc heuc, yiem domh zuangx zaamc ninh heuc qiex hlo nyei.
Ninh yiem nauc nyitc nyei jaai-daauh heuc, yaac yiem bieqc zingh gaengh nyei dorngx gorngv waac.

Ninh gorngv, “Meih mbuo maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei mienh aah! Meih mbuo oix a'hneiv maiv hiuv haaix nyungc taux haaix zanc? Huotv mienh nyei mienh a'hneiv huotv ndongc haaix lauh? Mienh hngongx mienh oix nzorng wuonh zaang ndongc haaix lauh?
Yie gorngv-njaaux meih mbuo, meih mbuo oix zuqc muangx, yie ziouc bun meih mbuo hiuv duqv yie hnamv nyei jauv, yaac bun meih mbuo hiuv duqv yie nyei waac.
Weic zuqc yie heuc meih mbuo, meih mbuo yaac maiv kangv muangx. Yie sung buoz yaapv, mienh yaac maiv guen maiv sic nyei.
Meih mbuo nqemh yie kuinx nyei yietc zungv waac. Yie gorngv-njaaux, meih mbuo yaac maiv kangv muangx.
Meih mbuo zuqc zeqc naanc yie ziouc jatv. Meih mbuo zuqc domh heiv sic haeqv meih mbuo, yie yaac huotv meih mbuo.
Meih mbuo zuqc domh heiv sic hnangv domh nziaaux, meih mbuo zuqc nyei zeqc naanc hnangv nziaaux-zunc. Meih mbuo zuqc kouv, zuqc hnyouv mun nyei ziangh hoc yie yaac huotv meih mbuo.
“Wuov zanc meih mbuo oix heuc yie, yie yaac maiv dau. Meih mbuo oix zimh lorz yie, yaac lorz maiv buatc,
weic zuqc meih mbuo nzorng wuonh zaang, meih mbuo yaac maiv ginv taaih Ziouv.
Yie kuinx nyei waac meih mbuo maiv muangx yietc deix, daaux nzuonx meih mbuo mangc piex yie gorngv-njaaux nyei yietc zungv waac.
Weic naaiv meih mbuo ziouc duqv puix meih mbuo zoux nyei sic, yaac zuqc ziux ganh daav nyei za'eix gaux haic aqv.
Maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei mienh nqemh cong-mengh ziouc zuqc daic, mienh hngongx mienh maiv guen maiv sic ziouc zuqc mietc.
Mv baac haaix dauh muangx yie, wuov dauh ziouc baengh orn nyei yiem. Ninh duqv yiem longx, maiv gamh nziex zuqc zeqc naanc.”
Yie nyei dorn aah! Se gorngv meih zipv yie nyei waac, goux longx yie hatc nyei lingc,
meih baeng m'normh muangx cong-mengh nyei waac, yaac za'gengh oix bieqc hnyouv.
Zeiz nyei, se gorngv meih heuc jienv tov oix mengh baeqc, yaac cuotv qiex tov bun bieqc hnyouv,
se gorngv meih lorz cong-mengh hnangv lorz nyaanh, zimh lorz cong-mengh hnangv zimh lorz bingx jienv nyei zinh zoih,
hnangv naaic meih ziouc mengh baeqc taaih Ziouv, yaac hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh.
Weic zuqc Ziouv ceix cong-mengh bun mienh, ninh nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac maaih wuonh zaang yaac bun mienh bieqc hnyouv.
Ninh siou cong-mengh weic tengx hnyouv zingx wuov deix, ninh hnangv torngv-baaih beu jienv ziepc zuoqv nyei mienh.
Ninh goux baengh fim mienh nyei jauv, yaac beu jienv gan longx ninh wuov deix nyei jauv-louc.
Wuov zanc meih ziouc mengh baeqc haaix nyungc horpc nyei, baengh fim nyei, zingx nyei, se yietc zungv longx nyei jauv,
weic zuqc cong-mengh oix bieqc meih nyei hnyouv, wuonh zaang yaac bun meih nyei hnyouv kuh yiem.
Guai nyei jauv oix beu jienv meih, bieqc hnyouv nyei jauv yaac goux jienv meih,
aengx njoux meih biaux ndutv orqv mienh nyei jauv caux gorngv-baeqc nyei mienh.
Naaiv nyungc mienh guangc zoux horpc nyei jauv, gan hmuangx nyei jauv-louc yangh.
Ninh mbuo a'hneiv zoux orqv sic, yaac oix haic orqv mienh zoux nyei jauv.
Ninh mbuo nyei jauv ngau njuotv, ninh mbuo zoux nyei jauv pien mi'aqv.
Meih ziouc duqv simv nqoi hienx nqox nyei auv, se biaux ndutv nzuih mbiaangc, yuoqc mienh nyei m'sieqv dorn.
Ninh guangc hnyangx-jeiv lunx nyei ziangh hoc longc daaih nyei nqox, yaac la'kuqv caux ninh nyei Tin-Hungh laengz jiex nyei ngaengc waac.
Se gorngv mingh ninh nyei biauv, meih ziouc gan zuqc daic nyei jauv. Mingh ninh wuov se hungx jienv yiemh gen mingh.
Da'faanh mingh ninh wuov nyei mienh maiv maaih yietc dauh duqv nzuonx, yaac maiv maaih yietc dauh duqv nzuonx taux ziangh maengc nyei jauv.
Weic naaiv meih oix zuqc yangh mienh longx mienh nyei jauv, gan longx zoux horpc nyei jauv-louc.
Weic zuqc hnyouv zingx nyei mienh duqv yiem deic-bung, maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei mienh yaac duqv yiem wuov.
Mv baac orqv mienh oix zuqc pai guangc, maiv duqv yiem deic-bung. Hoic mienh nyei mienh oix zuqc mietc hnangv baeng miev nyei gorn nor.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Maiv dungx la'kuqv yie njaaux nyei waac. Meih nyei hnyouv oix zuqc gan longx yie nyei leiz-latc.
meih yiem seix zaangc nyei hnoi-nyieqc caux hnyangx-soux ziouc haih ziangh duqv ndaauv, meih yaac haih duqv longx.
Maiv dungx guangc hnamv nyei, ziepc zuoqv nyei jauv. Oix zuqc zorqv daaih kuangx jienv meih nyei jaang, aengx fiev jienv meih nyei hnyouv gu'nyuoz.
Hnangv naaic ziux Tin-Hungh caux baamh mienh mangc, meih zoux duqv horpc yaac maaih mengh dauh longx.
Oix zuqc longc nzengc hnyouv kaux Ziouv, maiv dungx kaux ganh haih mengh baeqc.
Yiem meih zoux nyei diuh diuh jauv oix zuqc nyiemc ninh, ninh ziouc dorh meih yangh horpc nyei jauv-louc.
Maiv dungx hnamv ganh maaih cong-mengh, oix zuqc taaih Ziouv yaac leih nqoi orqv nyei sic.
Hnangv naaic ziouc hnangv longx haic nyei ndie zorc meih wangc siangx, sin yaac kuh yiem.
Oix zuqc longc meih nyei zinh zoih caux meih nyei yietc zungv gaeng-zuangx nyei daauh torngx biouv taaih Ziouv.
Hnangv naaic meih nyei lamz ziouc buangv nzengc, meih nyei diuv-ongx maaih a'ngunc diuv buangv mienz cuotv.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Maiv dungx mangc piex Ziouv mborqv njaaux nyei waac, yaac maiv dungx youx ninh gorngv-njaaux,
weic zuqc Ziouv hnamv wuov dauh ninh gorngv-njaaux wuov dauh, hnangv die gorngv-njaaux ninh a'hneiv nyei dorn.
Duqv cong-mengh yaac duqv bieqc hnyouv nyei mienh, za'gengh maaih orn-lorqc,
weic zuqc duqv cong-mengh nyei ndaauv-daauh se gauh longx jiex nyaanh, ninh duqv nyei leic gauh longx jiex jiem.
Cong-mengh gauh jaaix jiex la'bieiv-jaaix. Meih oix duqv nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv, maiv maaih yietc nyungc haih beiv duqv ninh.
Yiem ninh nyei mbiaauc jieqv buoz maaih siouc nyuonh ndaauv, yiem ninh nyei zaaix jieqv buoz maaih zinh zoih caux njang-laangc.
Ninh nyei jauv se bun mienh maaih orn-lorqc, ninh nyei yietc zungv jauv-louc bun mienh duqv baengh orn.
Cong-mengh beiv diuh ziangh maengc nyei ndiangx. Haaix dauh nanv jienv ninh, wuov dauh ziouc duqv mienh heuc orn-lorqc.
Ziouv longc cong-mengh liepc ndau, longc ninh nyei wuonh zaang liepc lungh.
Ninh nyei wuonh zaang bun ndau-ndiev nyei wuom mbeux cuotv, bun lungh maaih mbiungc-suiv ndiepv njiec.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Meih oix zuqc goux jienv cong-mengh caux haih samx duqv cuotv nyei jauv. Maiv dungx bun naaiv deix i nyungc leih nqoi meih nyei m'zing-ndaangc.
I nyungc ziouc bun meih ziangh duqv maengc ndaauv, yaac beiv dangh jaang nzueic nyei ga'naaiv.
Meih ziouc baengh orn nyei gan meih nyei jauv yangh, meih nyei zaux yaac maiv ndiqv zuqc ndorpc.
Meih bueix njiec nyei ziangh hoc maiv dungx gamh nziex, meih bueix njiec, meih ziouc m'njormh duqv kuv.
Liemh zeih zuqc heiv sic maiv dungx gamh nziex, orqv mienh zuqc baaic waaic, maiv dungx gamh nziex.
Weic zuqc Ziouv zoux meih kaux nyei dorngx, ninh oix goux jienv maiv bun meih nyei zaux caaiv zuqc hlaang hlopv.
Meih maaih banh zeic tengx mienh nyei ziangh hoc, maiv dungx ngaengc zoux longx nyei sic bun qiemx zuqc tengx nyei mienh.
Se gorngv meih ih zanc maaih jienv gaux tengx mienh nyei, maiv dungx gorngv mbuox juangc laangz mienh, “Mingh aqv, aengx daaih nzunc. Njang hnoi yie m'daaih bun meih.”
Maiv dungx daav za'eix hoic juangc laangz mienh, ninh yiem meih ga'hlen bungx hnyouv meih.
Se gorngv mienh maiv zoux haaix nyungc bun meih yaac maiv maaih haaix nyungc gorn-baengx, maiv dungx caux ninh nzaeng.
Maiv dungx mueic jieqv mienh doqc mienh, maiv dungx ginv ninh nyei haaix diuh jauv.
Ziouv youx haic buv longh buv dangv nyei mienh, mv baac ninh caux hnyouv zingx nyei mienh zuoqc haic.
Ziouv zioux orqv mienh nyei jaa-dingh, mv baac Ziouv ceix fuqv bun kuv mienh yiem nyei dorngx.
Ninh huotv zoux maux huotv mienh nyei mienh, mv baac ninh ceix en bun nyiemc ganh zoux faix nyei mienh.
Cong-mengh mienh duqv mienh taaih, mv baac mienh hngongx mienh zungv zuqc mienh mangc piex.
Zuangx fu'jueiv aac, oix zuqc muangx die njaaux nyei waac, oix zuqc longc hnyouv muangx ziouc haih mengh baeqc.
Yie njaaux meih mbuo se longx haic nyei leiz, maiv dungx guangc yie njaaux nyei waac.
Yie zoux fu'jueiv-faix caux yie nyei die yiem wuov zanc, yie se yie nyei maa hnamv nyei ndoqc dorn.
Yie nyei die njaaux yie yaac gorngv mbuox yie, “Oix zuqc longc hnyouv muangx longx die njaaux nyei waac, ei jienv yie hatc nyei waac ziouc duqv maengc ziangh.
Oix zuqc duqv cong-mengh, oix zuqc mengh baeqc, maiv dungx la'kuqv yaac maiv dungx leih guangc yie nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac.
Maiv dungx guangc cong-mengh, cong-mengh ziouc haih beu jienv meih. Oix zuqc hnamv ninh, ninh ziouc goux jienv meih.
Cong-mengh nyei gorn se hnangv naaiv. Oix zuqc duqv cong-mengh, yaac maiv gunv meih aengx duqv haaix nyungc, oix zuqc duqv haih mengh baeqc nyei jauv.
Oix zuqc taaih cong-mengh weih jaaix, ninh ziouc ceng meih. Se gorngv meih qam jienv ninh, ninh ziouc taaih meih.
Ninh oix zorqv norm nzueic nyei ningv bun meih ndongx, zorqv njang-laangc nyei ningv jiu bun meih.”
Yie nyei dorn aac, meih oix zuqc muangx yaac zipv yie nyei waac, weic bun meih ziangh nyei hnoi-nyieqc ndaauv.
Yie njaaux cong-mengh nyei jauv bun meih. Yie dorh meih yangh zoux horpc nyei jauv.
Meih yangh nyei ziangh hoc ziouc maiv maaih haaix nyungc torngv meih nyei zaux-mbiec. Se gorngv meih tiux meih yaac maiv ndorpc.
Oix zuqc zanc-zanc jangx jienv meih hoqc hiuv nyei jauv, maiv dungx bungx ndortv. Oix zuqc goux longx weic zuqc meih hoqc hiuv nyei jauv bun meih duqv maengc ziangh.
Maiv dungx yangh orqv mienh yangh nyei jauv, maiv dungx gan mienh waaic mienh nyei jauv-louc.
Oix zuqc simv nqoi, maiv dungx gan naaic mingh, oix zuqc wingc yangh ganh bung jiex.
Weic zuqc orqv mienh maiv duqv zoux orqv sic, ninh mbuo bueix maiv njormh. Maiv duqv hoic mienh ndiqv zuqc ndorpc, ninh mbuo bueix maiv orn.
Ninh mbuo zoux orqv sic weic benx ninh mbuo nyei hnaangx-donx, zoux doqc nyei sic benx ninh mbuo nyei a'ngunc diuv.
Mv baac kuv mienh nyei jauv se hnangv lungh ndorm nziouv nyei njang, gunv zoux gunv njang taux lungh ziangx aanx.
Orqv mienh nyei jauv mapv maengh mapv hmuangx nyei, ninh mbuo maiv hiuv duqv ninh mbuo ndiqv zuqc haaix nyungc ndorpc.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Muangx longx yie nyei waac, bungx m'normh muangx yie gorngv nyei nyinh nyouz.
Maiv dungx bun ninh mbuo leih nqoi meih nyei m'zing-ndaangc. Oix zuqc bun yiem meih nyei hnyouv jangx jienv.
Weic zuqc haaix dauh lorz buatc naaiv deix waac ziouc duqv maengc ziangh, yaac bun ninh nyei sin zaangc yietc zungv wangc siangx.
Oix zuqc faix fim, goux longx ganh nyei hnyouv, weic zuqc ziangh maengc nyei gorn yiem hnyouv cuotv daaih.
Meih oix zuqc guangc nzengc gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh nyei waac, bun jaav nyei waac leih nqoi meih nyei nzuih.
Oix zuqc bun meih nyei m'zing mangc zaqc wuov ndaangc. Oix zuqc bungx m'zing mangc ziangx wuov ndaangc mingh.
Oix zuqc bun meih nyei zaux yangh nyei jauv yuonh, meih mingh nyei diuh diuh jauv ziouc wuonv.
Maiv dungx pien mingh zaaix fai mbiaauc, oix zuqc bun meih nyei zaux leih nqoi orqv nyei jauv.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Oix zuqc longc hnyouv zipv yie cong-mengh nyei waac, baeng m'normh muangx yie bieqc hnyouv nyei waac.
Hnangv naaic meih haih ei jienv guai nyei jauv, meih nyei nzuih meix beu jienv wuonh zaang.
Weic zuqc hienx nqox nyei m'sieqv dorn nyei nzuih meix ndiepv jienv mueiz-dorngh. Ninh nyei waac gauh mbiaangc ga'lanv youh,
mv baac setv mueiz ninh ndongc yangh meuz im, yaac laic hnangv i maengx nzuqc laic.
Ninh nyei zaux njiec mingh zuqc daic, ninh nyei zaux-mbiec hungx jienv yiemh gen mingh.
Ninh yaac maiv hengx lorz duqv maengc ziangh nyei jauv. Ninh nyei jauv youh mingh youh daaih, ninh ganh yaac maiv hiuv.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Ih zanc muangx yie maah! Maiv dungx bungx ndortv yie nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac.
Meih nyei jauv oix zuqc leih go naaiv dauh m'sieqv dorn, maiv dungx mingh nitv fatv ninh nyei biauv nyei gaengh.
Nziex meih zorqv meih nyei njang-laangc jiu bun ganh dauh, zorqv meih nyei hnyangx-soux bun maiv korv-lienh nyei mienh.
Nziex maiv hiuv nyei mienh nyanc nzengc meih nyei qaqv, meih laauh luic duqv daaih nyei yaac bieqc ganh fingx mienh nyei biauv.
Taux meih nyei setv mueiz hnoi, orv caux sin yuqc nzengc, meih ziouc njunh jienv yiem.
Meih ziouc gorngv, “Zinh ndaangc yie nzorng haic mborqv njaaux nyei jauv, yie nyei hnyouv yaac mangc piex gorngv-njaaux nyei waac.
Yie maiv muangx yie nyei fin-saeng nyei waac yaac maiv bungx m'normh muangx njaaux yie wuov deix.
Yie yiem gapv zunv nyei zuangx mienh mbu'ndongx aav lamh zuqc baaic waaic.”
Meih oix zuqc hopv ganh nyei siou wuom-kuotv nyei wuom, hopv ganh nyei wuom-zingv nyei wuom-daaih.
Meih nyei wuom-zingv mienz cuotv ga'nyiec, meih nyei ndoqv liouc njiec jaai-horngc se horpc nyei fai?
Kungx oix zuqc weic meih ganh nduqc dauh hnangv, maiv dungx bun ga'nyiec nyei mienh juangc jienv longc.
Tov bun meih nyei wuom-zingv duqv fuqv, yaac a'hneiv meih lunx nyei ziangh hoc duqv daaih nyei auv.
Ninh se nzueic haic, ziangh duqv sung nyei m'sieqv dorn. Ninh nyei nyorx zanc-zanc bun meih buangv hnyouv. Ninh hnamv haic ziouc bun meih njien-youh taux daauh.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Meih fungc oix zuqc bun hienx nqox nyei m'sieqv dorn wakv meih? Weic haaix diuc qam jienv buangh liouh nyei auv?
Weic zuqc Ziouv nyei m'zing mangc jienv mienh nyei jauv, ninh zaah mangc mienh nyei yietc zungv jauv-louc.
Orqv mienh zoux nyei orqv sic hlopv zuqc ninh, ninh nyei zuiz hnangv hlaang nor ndoh jienv ninh.
Ninh maiv longc mienh njaaux nyei waac ziouc zuqc daic. Laaix ninh ba'laqc hngongx, ninh zuqc mingh dorngc jauv.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Se gorngv meih laengz waac beu meih nyei juangc laangz mienh nyei zaeqv, fai laengz zoux ndaam-daauh beu ganh dauh mienh nyei zaeqv,
se gorngv meih gorngv nyei waac hlopv zuqc meih, meih nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac ndoh jienv meih,

yie nyei dorn aah! Meih oix zuqc hnangv naaiv nor zoux njoux meih ganh, weic zuqc meih zuqc yiem meih nyei juangc laangz mienh nyei buoz-ndiev mi'aqv. Mingh aqv, mingh lorz meih nyei juangc laangz mienh aengx nyiemc ganh zoux faix qaqv tov.
Maiv dungx bun meih nyei m'zing njipv jienv m'njormh, maiv dungx bun m'zing-ndopv nyuix.
Oix zuqc njoux ndutv ganh hnangv njaih leih ndutv zaeng hlaang mienh nyei buoz, yaac hnangv norqc biaux ndutv zaeng koux mienh nyei buoz-ndiev.
Mienh lueic mienh aah! Meih oix zuqc mingh zaah mangc nziouv, hnamv taux nziouv zoux nyei jauv ziouc duqv cong-mengh.
Nziouv maiv maaih bieiv zeiv, maiv maaih jien, maiv maaih haaix dauh gunv,
mv baac nqaai gorng ninh liuc leiz nyanc hopv, gaatv gaeng-zuangx nyei ziangh hoc yaac siou nyanc nyei ga'naaiv.
Mienh lueic mienh aah! Meih oix bueix taux haaix zanc? Meih oix m'njormh taux haaix zanc cingx jiez sin daaih?
Aengx bueix dangh, m'njormh dangh, qopv jienv buoz m'njormh da'hngatv dangh,
jomc nyei jauv ziouc hnangv janx-zaqc liemh zeih taux. Dangx-donx nyei jauv daaih hnangv mienh dorh jienv wuoqc ginc daaih taux.
Maiv lamh longc nyei orqv mienh jiex naaiv jiex wuov gorngv-baeqc.
Ninh nyapc m'zing, fengx zaux, buoz yaac nuqv jienv,
hnyouv pien daav orqv nyei za'eix, zanc-zanc coqv-huv.
Weic naaiv ninh oix liemh zeih zuqc zeqc naanc, nduqc dangh hnangv zuqc baaic waaic nzengc, maiv haih zorc.
Ziouv nzorng nyei maaih juqv nyungc, ninh gamh nziev nyei, youx nyei maaih siec nyungc.
Maaih m'zing-jaax hlang, gorngv-baeqc nyei nzuih, buoz daix maiv zoux dorngc nyei mienh,
hnyouv daav orqv nyei za'eix, zaux tiux siepv nyei mingh lorz orqv nyei sic,
zoux jaav zorng-zengx nyei mienh tauv qiex kungx cuotv gorngv-baeqc nyei waac, caux mienh yiem ninh nyei gorx-youz mbu'ndongx coqv lunc mienh.
Yie nyei dorn aah! Oix zuqc gan longx meih nyei die hatc nyei waac, yaac maiv dungx guangc meih nyei maa njaaux nyei jauv-louc.
Oix zuqc zanc-zanc zaangh jienv meih nyei hnyouv, yaac kuangx jienv meih nyei jaang.
Meih yangh jauv, ninh mbuo ziouc dorh meih, meih bueix nyei ziangh hoc, ninh mbuo oix beu jienv meih. Meih nyie daaih, ninh mbuo yaac caux meih gorngv.
Weic zuqc naaiv deix hatc nyei waac zoux norm dang, njaaux nyei waac zoux njang. Gorngv-njaaux, mborqv njaaux se benx jauv bun mienh duqv maengc ziangh,
weic beu jienv meih, tengx meih simv nqoi orqv nyei m'sieqv dorn, leih nqoi buangh liouh nyei auv gorngv yuoqc mienh nyei nzuih mbiaangc.
Maiv dungx yiem hnyouv hanc ninh nzueic nyei jauv, yaac maiv dungx bun ninh nyei m'zing baeng zuqc meih.
Weic zuqc mienh haih longc yietc norm njuov nyei jaax-zinh cingv maaic sin nyei m'sieqv dorn, mv baac hienx nqox nyei auv zungv zorqv mienh jaaix mienh nyei maengc.
Mienh haih qam jienv douz yaac maiv bun ninh nyei lui zuqc douz buov duqv nyei fai?
Mienh haih yangh zieqc jienv douz nyei douz-taanx gu'nguaaic mingh, yaac maiv zuqc douz buov zaux fai?
Haaix dauh mingh caux ganh dauh mienh nyei auv yaac fih hnangv nyei. Maiv maaih haaix dauh hluo liuz ninh yaac maiv zuqc dingc zuiz.
Se gorngv mienh hnyouv sie ziouc nimc ga'naaiv tengx ninh beuv, mienh mangc piex ninh maiv zeiz?
Se gorngv ninh zuqc zorqv ninh oix zuqc buih siec gouv, zungv bun nzengc ninh nyei biauv zong maaih nyei ga'naaiv.
Mv baac mienh hienx auv ninh hnamv duqv hngongx haic. Haaix dauh hnangv naaiv zoux zungv bun ninh ganh zuqc mietc.
Ninh zuqc mun, zuqc nyaiv, ninh zuqc baaic hmien, yietc liuz maiv haih sortv guangc.
Weic zuqc m'jangc dorn hanc, ninh m'daaih qiex jiez, taux jaauv win nyei ziangh hoc ninh maiv nyaangc zingh aqv.
Ninh maiv longc haaix nyungc buih bun ninh. Bun zingh nyeic ndongc haaix camv ninh hnyouv maiv nqaai.
Yie nyei dorn aac, meih oix zuqc ei jienv yie nyei waac, oix zuqc zorqv yie hatc nyei waac siou jienv meih nyei hnyouv.
Oix zuqc ei jienv yie hatc nyei waac ziouc duqv maengc ziangh, goux longx yie njaaux nyei waac hnangv goux longx ganh nyei m'zing nor,
zorqv daaih ndoh jienv meih nyei buoz-ndoqv, aengx fiev jienv meih nyei hnyouv gu'nyuoz.
Oix zuqc gorngv mbuox cong-mengh, “Meih zoux yie nyei dorc,” yaac heuc mengh baeqc nyei jauv zoux meih nyei loz-gaeng doic.
Naaiv deix i nyungc ziouc tengx meih simv ndutv hienx nqox nyei auv, yaac biaux ndutv nzuih mbiaangc, buangh liouh nyei m'sieqv dorn.
Yie yiem yie nyei biauv nyei fong muonh, mangc cuotv laan jienv nyei piaeng nyei kuotv.
Yie buatc yiem maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei zuangx mienh gu'nyuoz, yiem mienh lunx mienh mbu'ndongx, maaih dauh mienh lunx mienh hnamv duqv hngongx haic.
Ninh gan jauv mingh taux bieqc wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn nyei biauv nyei jauv-caax, aengx yangh wuov diuh jauv mingh wuov dauh nyei biauv
doix lungh maanz-hmuangx, nziemx-yaangh, taux lungh muonz zanc hmuangx nyei ziangh hoc.
Mangc maah! Maaih dauh m'sieqv dorn daaih buangh ninh, ninh zorng sin hnangv maaic sin nyei m'sieqv dorn yaac maaih guv guaix nyei hnyouv.
Ninh liaa haic, maiv hiuv duqv nyaiv, ninh nyei zaux kungx oix mingh, maiv yiem dingc biauv.
Aav dangh yiem jaai-horngc, aav dangh yiem domh zuangx zaamc, yiem norm-norm jauv-caax ninh bingx jienv zuov.
Ninh zorqv jienv wuov dauh mienh lunx mienh zom ninh, caux ninh gorngv yaac maiv hiuv duqv nyaiv. Ninh gorngv,
“Yie fongc horc ziec weic jiu tong nyei ga'naaiv, ih hnoi yie yaac jaauv sung yie laengz jiex nyei ngaengc waac,
yie ziouc cuotv daaih lorz meih, qaqv lorz meih, ziouc lorz buatc aqv.
Yie longc yiem I^yipv daaih nyei ziex setv la'maah ndie-muonc, dimc ziangx yie nyei coux.
Yie longc mu^yorc, aa^lo ndie-ndaang, caux jieh louh ndopv bun yie nyei coux ndaang.
Daaih maah! Yie mbuo ziangh muonz hnamv taux beuv, yaac hnamv taux lungh ndorm. Yie mbuo haih njien-youh nyei laanh hnamv laanh,
weic zuqc yie nyei nqox maiv yiem biauv. Ninh cuotv jauv mingh go.
Ninh dorh yietc mbuoqc nyaanh mingh. Taux hlaax-junh ninh cingx nzuonx.”
Naaiv dauh hienx nqox nyei auv longc waac-gaam yuoqc ninh, longc nzuih mbiaangc baeng ninh mingh.
Wuov dauh mienh lunx mienh liemh zeih gan jienv ninh mingh aqv, hnangv ngongh gouv mingh zuqc daix daic, hnangv njaih zuqc hlaang hlopv jienv zietc nyei,
zuov taux forng-cang buonv bieqc ninh nyei hlan, fai hnangv norm norqc siepv-siepv nyei ndaix bieqc mungz gu'nyuoz. Ninh liemh maiv hiuv duqv ganh oix zuqc hoic maengc.
Dorn aah! Ih zanc oix zuqc muangx yie maah! Oix zuqc longc hnyouv muangx yie nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac.
Maiv dungx bun meih nyei hnyouv huin mingh wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn nyei jauv, maiv dungx bieqc ninh nduov nyei jauv-louc.
Zuqc wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn hoic nyei mienh maiv zeiz zoqc, zuqc ninh daix daic nyei mienh za'gengh camv! haic.
Ninh nyei biauv yiem mingh yiemh gen nyei jauv, se dorh mienh njiec zuqc daic nyei mienh yiem nyei dorngx.
Cong-mengh heuc jienv maiv zeiz? Mengh baeqc nyei jauv heuc qiex hlo nyei maiv zeiz?
Ninh yiem jauv-hlen hlang nyei dorngx, souv jienv jaapv-maaz jauv.
Ninh yiem bieqc zingh nyei laatc gaengh ga'hlen, yiem bieqc gaengh nyei dorngx heuc mbui nyei gorngv,
“Zuangx mienh aah! Yie heuc meih mbuo. Yie hungx jienv yietc zungv baamh mienh heuc.
Maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei mienh aah! Meih mbuo oix zuqc hoqc guai. Mienh hngongx mienh aah! Meih mbuo nyei hnyouv oix zuqc mengh baeqc.
Muangx maah! Yie oix gorngv longx haic nyei waac. Haaix nyungc horpc nyei oix yiem yie nyei nzuih cuotv,
weic zuqc yie nyei nzuih oix gorngv zien leiz, yie nyei nzuih meix gamh nziev haic orqv nyei jauv.
Yie nyei nzuih gorngv nyei yietc zungv waac horpc nyei, maiv maaih yietc deix ngau fai njuotv.
Weic haih bieqc hnyouv nyei mienh, naaiv deix yietc zungv waac se zaqc nyei. Weic duqv wuonh zaang nyei mienh, naaiv deix waac se horpc nyei.
Ginv longc yie njaaux nyei waac maiv zeiz nyaanh, ginv wuonh zaang maiv zeiz zien jiem,
weic zuqc cong-mengh se gauh longx jiex la'bieiv-jaaix, dongh meih oix nyei yietc zungv ga'naaiv maiv haih beiv duqv cong-mengh.
“Yie se cong-mengh. Yie bun mienh haih hnamv duqv tong, maaih wuonh zaang yaac guai.
Taaih Ziouv nyei jauv se nzorng orqv nyei sic. Yie nzorng ceng-hlo, zoux maux nyei sic, zoux orqv nyei jauv caux gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh nyei waac.
Yie haih tengx daav za'eix, maaih cong-mengh longx. Yie haih mengh baeqc yaac maaih qaqv.
Hungh diex bangc yie gunv. Zoux hlo nyei mienh bangc yie liepc baengh fim nyei leiz.
Mouz dauh bieiv zeiv caux zoux hlo nyei mienh bangc yie gunv lungh ndiev.
Hnamv yie wuov deix, yie yaac hnamv ninh mbuo, jienh lorz yie wuov deix yaac lorz duqv buatc.
Zinh zoih caux njang-laangc yiem yie, yaac maaih yiem duqv wuonv nyei fuqv-loqc caux gong-fim.
Meih yiem yie duqv daaih nyei se gauh longx jiex jiem, zungv gauh longx jiex zien haic nyei jiem, yie cuotv nyei yaac gauh longx jiex zien nyaanh.
Yie yangh zoux horpc nyei jauv, gan baengh fim nyei jauv-louc.
Yie bun hnamv yie wuov deix nzipc zinh zoih bun ninh siou jaaix nyei ga'naaiv nyei dorngx buangv nzengc.
“ Ziouv jiez gorn zoux ninh nyei gong wuov zanc, ninh zeix yie ndaangc jiex, se ninh loz-hnoi zoux daaih nyei daauh nyungc gong.
Yiem loz-hnoi dongh cor wuov, maiv gaengh maaih baamh gen wuov zanc ninh liepc yie jiez daaih.
Maiv gaengh maaih koiv, maiv gaengh maaih wuom camv nyei wuom-zingv yie cuotv seix daaih aqv.
Domh mbong maiv gaengh duqv yiem dingc, fiuv-mbong yaac maiv gaengh maaih, yie zungv cuotv seix.
Yie cuotv seix ndaangc Tin-Hungh zeix ndau caux lingh deic. Lungh ndiev diqv dien nyei nie-mbung yaac maiv gaengh maaih.
Ninh liepc lungh yaac guetv huing gormx koiv-minc nyei lungh gorn wuov zanc, yie yiem naaic.
Ninh bun lungh gu'nguaaic yiem duqv wuonv, yaac liepc ndau-ndiev nyei wuom-zingv wuov zanc,
ninh dingc koiv nyei gapv-jaaix weic bun wuom maiv jiex ndaangc ninh hatc nyei waac, ninh yaac liepc dingc ndau nyei gorn-ndoqv,
wuov zanc yie yiem ninh nyei ga'hlen hnangv dauh zaangc mienh. Ninh hnoi-hnoi weic yie a'hneiv, yie yaac zanc-zanc yiem ninh nyei nza'hmien njien-youh haic.
Yie a'hneiv ninh nyei baamh gen, yaac a'hneiv haic baamh mienh.
“Yie nyei dorn aac, ih zanc muangx yie maah! Ei jienv yie nyei jauv zoux wuov deix maaih orn-lorqc.
Oix zuqc muangx yie njaaux nyei waac ziouc duqv cong-mengh, maiv dungx bungx lorx.
Muangx yie nyei waac wuov dauh maaih orn-lorqc, ninh hnoi-hnoi yiem yie nyei gaengh ndaangc mangc, yiem yie nyei gaengh ga'hlen zuov.
Haaix dauh lorz buatc yie ziouc duqv maengc ziangh. Ziouv yaac horpc hnyouv ninh.
Mv baac haaix dauh lorz maiv buatc yie, ziouc hoic zuqc ganh. Nzorng yie wuov deix yietc zungv a'hneiv zuqc daic nyei jauv.”
Cong-mengh gomv ninh nyei biauv mi'aqv. Ninh liepc ninh nyei siec norm ndiouh.
Ninh daix ninh nyei saeng-kuv yaac peux ninh nyei a'ngunc diuv, aengx mbenc ninh nyei dieh.
Ninh paaiv ninh nyei m'sieqv bou cuotv mingh, yaac yiem zingh gu'nyuoz hlang jiex nyei dorngx heuc gorngv,
“Maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei mienh aah! Bieqc yie naaiv daaih maah!” Ninh aengx gorngv mbuox mienh hngongx mienh,
“Daaih maah! Daaih nyanc yie nyei hnaangx, hopv yie peux nyei a'ngunc diuv.
Oix zuqc guangc nqoi meih mbuo maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei jauv, meih mbuo ziouc duqv ziangh jienv, gan mengh baeqc nyei jauv yangh.
“Haaix dauh gorngv-hemx zoux maux, huotv mienh nyei mienh, ninh ganh oix zuqc mienh mangc piex. Haaix dauh kuinx orqv mienh, ninh ganh oix zuqc mun aqv.
Maiv dungx kuinx zoux maux, huotv mienh nyei mienh, ninh ziouc nzorng meih. Mv baac kuinx cong-mengh mienh nor, ninh ziouc hnamv meih.
Njaaux cong-mengh mienh ninh ziouc jaa maaih cong-mengh, njaaux zoux horpc nyei mienh ninh ziouc duqv hoqc hiuv camv jienv faaux.
“Cong-mengh nyei gorn se oix zuqc taaih Ziouv. Mienh zieqv duqv Cing-Nzengc Wuov Dauh ziouc haih jaa mengh baeqc.
Se gorngv meih kaux yie, meih nyei hnoi-nyieqc ziouc jaa camv, meih nyei hnyangx-soux aengx jaa tipv duqv siouc nyuonh ndaauv.
Se gorngv meih maaih cong-mengh, se weic meih ganh maaih lamh longc. Se gorngv meih huotv mienh, meih ganh oix zuqc ndaam-dorng.”
Hngongx nyei jauv beiv dauh qiex mbui, liaa haic, maiv hiuv duqv nyaiv nyei m'sieqv dorn.
Ninh zueiz jienv ninh nyei biauv nyei gaengh ndaangc, zueiz jienv zingh gu'nyuoz hlang nyei dorngx,
heuc jienv jiex jauv nyei mienh, dongh baeng zaqc gan ninh mbuo ganh nyei jauv nyei mienh gorngv,
“Maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei mienh aah! Gunv bieqc yie naaiv daaih maah!” Ninh aengx gorngv mbuox mienh hngongx mienh,
“Nimc daaih nyei wuom se gaam nyei, bingx jienv nyanc nyei njuov maaih mueix doc.”
Mv baac mienh maiv hiuv duqv zuqc daic nyei mienh yiem naaic. Ninh nyei kaeqv mienh yiem yiemh gen ndo nyei dorngx.
Naaiv se Saa^lo^morn nyei cong-mengh waac. Cong-mengh nyei dorn bun die duqv njien-youh, mv baac hngongx nyei dorn hoic maa nzauh.
Zoux maiv zingx duqv daaih nyei zinh zoih maiv lamh longc, mv baac zoux duqv horpc nyei sic haih njoux mienh maiv zuqc daic.
Ziouv maiv bun kuv mienh ngorc, mv baac ninh dangv jienv maiv bun orqv mienh duqv ninh mbuo cei nyei.
Buoz lueic bun mienh zuqc jomc, mv baac buoz jienh bun mienh butv zoih.
Guai nyei dorn taux nqaai gorng siou cun-gaeng, mv baac gaatv nyei ziangh hoc bueix m'njormh nyei dorn se zuqc nyaiv nyei dorn.
Kuv mienh duqv fuqv-loqc, mv baac orqv mienh nyei nzuih bingx jienv oix zoux doqc nyei sic.
Jangx kuv mienh haiz hnangv duqv fuqv, mv baac orqv mienh nyei mbuox mienh la'kuqv, hnangv benx ga'naaiv-huv nor.
Hnyouv cong-mengh nyei mienh oix ei jienv leiz-latc, mv baac la'guaih gorngv hngongx nyei jauv wuov deix, oix zuqc baaic.
Yangh ziepc zuoqv nyei jauv wuov deix duqv baengh orn nyei yangh, gan ngau njuotv nyei jauv wuov deix ziouc biux mengh cuotv daaih aqv.
Mienh nyapc m'zing zoux cuotv sic, mv baac bungx laangc nyei kuinx mienh wuov deix, liepc baengh orn.
Kuv mienh nyei nzuih benx ziangh maengc nyei wuom-zingv, mv baac orqv mienh nyei nzuih bingx oix zoux doqc nyei sic.
Nzorng nyei jauv coqv cuotv nzaeng jaax nyei sic, mv baac se gorngv hnamv mienh ziouc guangc yietc zungv zoux dorngc nyei sic.
Mengh baeqc nyei mienh nyei nzuih maaih wuonh zaang, mv baac maiv hiuv haaix nyungc nyei mienh puix duqv biaav mborqv diqc daanz.
Cong-mengh mienh siou jienv wuonh zaang, mv baac mienh hngongx mienh gorngv nyei waac bun baaic waaic nyei sic taux fatv.
Butv-zoih mienh nyei zinh zoih benx ninh wuonv nyei zingh. Mv baac mienh jomc mienh jomc nyei jauv bun ninh mbuo zuqc baaic waaic.
Kuv mienh nyei fin-kouv dorh mienh duqv maengc ziangh, mv baac orqv mienh duqv nyei buonc se dorh mienh baamz zuiz.
Ei jienv njaaux nyei waac wuov deix yiem ziangh maengc nyei jauv. Mv baac haaix dauh ngaengc jienv gorngv-njaaux nyei waac ziouc mingh dorngc jauv aqv.
Haaix dauh bingx jienv nzorng nyei sic maaih gorngv-baeqc nyei nzuih. Haaix dauh cuotv nzuih gorngv waac-huv benx mienh hngongx mienh.
Gorngv camv waac camv, simv maiv ndutv baamz zuiz nyei jauv, mv baac mienh guai mienh nyienz duqv ganh nyei nzuih.
Kuv mienh nyei waac hnangv zien nyaanh, orqv mienh nyei hnyouv hnamv nyei jauv maiv zic zinh.
Kuv mienh nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac yungz mienh camv, mv baac mienh hngongx mienh zuqc daic laaix maiv hiuv haaix nyungc.
Se Ziouv ceix fuqv bun mienh butv zoih, ninh yaac maiv jaa you-nzauh.
Mienh hngongx mienh zoux dorngc ninh mbuo haiz oix nyei, mv baac mengh baeqc nyei mienh a'hneiv cong-mengh nyei jauv.
Orqv mienh gamh nziex nyei zungv oix zunc zaaic ninh, mv baac kuv mienh oix duqv nyei zungv duqv aqv.
Nziaaux-jieqv jiex mingh, ziouc maiv maaih orqv mienh aqv, mv baac kuv mienh duqv liepc wuonv taux yietc liuz.
Paaiv mienh lueic mienh mingh zoux haaix nyungc, weic paaiv ninh wuov deix ninh se hnangv wuom-sui bun nyaah njienz, yaac hnangv douz-sioux bieqc m'zing.
Mienh taaih Ziouv bun ziangh nyei hnoi-nyieqc jaa ndaauv, mv baac orqv mienh nyei hnyangx-soux nangv njiec.
Kuv mienh maaih lamh hnamv nyei setv mueiz se njien-youh, mv baac orqv mienh hnamv oix duqv nyei, setv mueiz maiv duqv haaix nyungc aqv.
Ziouv zoux hnyouv zingx nyei mienh kaux wuonv nyei dorngx, mv baac bun zoux orqv sic nyei mienh zuqc mietc.
Kuv mienh yietc liuz maiv zuqc tuix cuotv, mv baac orqv mienh zungv maiv duqv yiem deic-bung.
Kuv mienh nyei nzuih gorngv cuotv cong-mengh nyei waac, mv baac buv longh buv dangv mienh nyei mbietc zungv oix gaatv guangc.
Kuv mienh nyei nzuih gorngv waac longx, mv baac orqv mienh nyei nzuih kungx gorngv gorngv-baeqc nyei waac hnangv.
Ziouv nzorng haic waengc mienh nyei nziangx, mv baac baengh fim nyei nziangx-dorh bun ninh a'hneiv.
Mienh zoux maux ziouc maaih nyaiv nyei sic gan jienv daaih, mv baac nyiemc ganh zoux faix nyei mienh maaih cong-mengh.
Hnyouv zingx nyei mienh maaih ziepc zuoqv nyei jauv dorh ninh mbuo, mv baac hnyouv ngau hnyouv njuotv nyei mienh zoux maiv ziepc zuoqv nyei sic bun ganh zuqc mietc.
Zuqc Tin-Hungh nouz nyei hnoi, zinh zoih tengx maiv duqv haaix nyungc, mv baac zoux duqv horpc nyei sic haih njoux mienh biaux ndutv maiv zuqc daic.
Maiv maaih dorngx nqemh nyei mienh zoux hnyouv zingx, ziouc dorh ninh yangh zaqc nyei jauv, mv baac orqv mienh laaix ninh zoux nyei orqv sic bun ninh ndorpc.
Hnyouv zingx nyei mienh zoux duqv horpc ziouc njoux duqv ninh, hnyouv maiv zingx nyei mienh hanc nyei sic hlopv jienv ninh.
Orqv mienh daic mingh, ninh maaih lamh hnamv nyei caux jienv zuqc mietc, mienh waaic mienh hnamv oix duqv nyei yaac baaic nzengc mi'aqv.
Kuv mienh duqv njoux biaux ndutv kuonx naanh, daaux nzuonx orqv mienh buangh zuqc kouv naanc.
Maiv kaux Tin-Hungh nyei mienh longc nzuih gorngv nyei waac baaic waaic ninh nyei juangc laangz mienh, mv baac kuv mienh nyei wuonh zaang haih njoux duqv ninh.
Kuv mienh duqv longx, zingh nyei mienh njien-youh, orqv mienh zuqc mietc zuangx mienh njien-youh nyei heuc.
Weic kuv mienh duqv fuqv, zingh ziouc duqv mienh taaih, mv baac laaix orqv mienh nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac, zingh zuqc mbienv nzengc.
Haaix dauh mangc piex juangc laangz mienh se hnamv maiv tong haaix nyungc nyei mienh. Mv baac bieqc hnyouv nyei mienh sekv nzieqc nyei.
Jiex naaiv jiex wuov gorngv henh waac nyei mienh gorngv cuotv gem jienv nyei jauv, mv baac bungx duqv hnyouv nyei mienh gem jienv maiv horpc zuqc gorngv nyei sic.
Maiv maaih mienh dorh, baeqc fingx ziouc zuqc baaic njiec, mv baac maaih caangh laangh nyei mienh camv, ziouc duqv baengh orn nyei yiem.
Haaix dauh beu ganh dauh mienh zungv oix zuqc kouv aqv. Mv baac haaix dauh nzorng beu mienh nyei jauv ziouc yiem duqv wuonv.
Hnyouv longx, nzueic nyei m'sieqv dorn duqv mienh taaih, zoux doqc nyei m'jangc dorn kungx duqv butv zoih.
Korv-lienh mienh nyei mienh tengx ganh duqv longx, mv baac zoux doqc nyei mienh hoic zuqc ganh.
Orqv mienh nyei gong-zinh setv mueiz se maiv duqv haaix nyungc, mv baac mienh zoux horpc nyei jauv, ndongc haaix zungv duqv zingh nyeic.
Haaix dauh liepc hnyouv zoux kuv sic ziouc duqv maengc ziangh, haaix dauh lorz orqv nyei sic ziouc zuqc daic.
Hnyouv buv longh buv dangv nyei mienh, Ziouv youx haic, mv baac zoux duqv horpc nyei mienh bun ninh a'hneiv.
Oix zuqc hiuv dingc, orqv mienh maiv haih biaux maiv ndutv zuqc dingc zuiz, mv baac kuv mienh zungv oix duqv njoux.
M'sieqv dorn nzueic mv baac zieqv maiv duqv haaix nyungc horpc se hnangv norm jiem-kuing cunx jienv dungz nyei mba'zorng.
Kuv mienh oix nyei, setv mueiz duqv longx, orqv mienh maaih lamh hnamv nyei, setv mueiz zuqc Tin-Hungh nouz.
Maaih laanh mienh zoux hnyouv jangv yaac gunv zoux gunv butv zoih. Maaih laanh zoux hnyouv hepc, horpc zuqc bun nyei ninh maiv bun, mv baac gunv zoux gunv jomc.
Hnyouv jangv nyei mienh oix duqv bungx-zuoqc. Haaix dauh bun wuom mienh hopv, mienh ziouc bun wuom ninh hopv.
Haaix dauh ngaengc jienv maiv maaic laangh ziqc, ninh zuqc mienh zioux. Haaix dauh laengz maaic ziouc duqv mienh buang waac.
Haaix dauh jienh lorz zoux longx nyei jauv ziouc duqv mienh taaih, mv baac haaix dauh lorz orqv nyei sic wuov dauh ziouc zuqc orqv sic.
Haaix dauh kaux ninh ganh nyei zinh zoih zungv zuqc ndorpc, mv baac kuv mienh oix wangc siangx hnangv ndiangx-normh nyiemz.
Haaix dauh zoux bun ganh nyei hmuangv doic zuqc kouv, setv mueiz maiv duqv haaix nyungc, mienh hngongx mienh yaac oix zuqc zoux cong-mengh mienh nyei bou.
Kuv mienh zoux nyei sic se bun mienh maaih maengc ziangh, mv baac mienh baamz leiz-latc ziouc hoic mienh guangc maengc.
Se gorngv kuv mienh yiem baamh gen ziux zoux nyei winh bun ninh, orqv mienh caux zuiz-mienh ziux zoux nyei zuqc winh bun ndongc haaix camv!
Haaix dauh a'hneiv muangx gorngv-njaaux nyei waac, wuov dauh hnamv wuonh zaang, mv baac haaix dauh nzorng gorngv-hemx nyei waac se hngongx nyei.
Kuv mienh bun Ziouv a'hneiv, mv baac daav orqv za'eix nyei mienh, Ziouv oix dingc zuiz.
Zoux orqv sic maiv tengx mienh liepc duqv wuonv, mv baac kuv mienh liepc duqv wuonv hnangv njiec nzungh ndo nor.
Ziangh horngh nyei auv se hnangv nqox nyei ningv, mv baac maiv hiuv duqv nyaiv nyei auv, se hnangv zoux bun ninh nyei nqox nyei mbungv latv.
Kuv mienh hnamv cuotv nyei jauv se baengh fim nyei, mv baac orqv mienh caangh laangh nyei waac se guv guaix nyei sic.
Orqv mienh nyei waac zuov jienv daix mienh, mv baac hnyouv zingx mienh nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac njoux duqv mienh.
Orqv mienh zuqc mietc ziouc baac mi'aqv, mv baac kuv mienh nyei zeiv-fun yiem duqv wuonv.
Mienh ziux ninh nyei cong-mengh duqv mienh ceng, mv baac hnyouv ngau hnyouv njuotv nyei mienh zuqc mienh mangc piex.
Benx pou-tong mienh weic ganh zoux gong yungz maengc, se gauh longx ceng ganh hlo mv baac maiv maaih hnaangx nyanc.
Kuv mienh korv-lienh ninh mbuo nyei saeng-kuv nyei maengc, mv baac orqv mienh korv-lienh nyei jauv se doqc nyei.
Haaix dauh laih ganh nyei lingh deic duqv laangh ziqc nyanc beuv, mv baac haaix dauh gan maiv lamh longc nyei jauv hnamv maiv tong haaix nyungc.
Orqv mienh oix longc mienh waaic mienh caangv daaih nyei ga'naaiv, mv baac kuv mienh nyei gorn yiem duqv wuonv.
Orqv mienh nyei nzuih gorngv dorngc nyei waac zoux koux hlopv zuqc ninh ganh, mv baac kuv mienh biaux ndutv zuqc kouv nyei jauv.
Mienh nyei nzuih gorngv nyei waac bun ganh duqv longx buangv hnyouv, mienh nyei buoz zoux nyei gong yaac winh bun ganh.
Mienh hngongx mienh zoux nyei sic ziux ganh nyei m'zing mangc zoux duqv horpc, mv baac cong-mengh mienh a'hneiv muangx mienh njaaux.
Mienh hngongx mienh yietv qiex jiez liemh zeih zieqv duqv aqv, mv baac guai nyei mienh zuqc mienh gorngv doqc corc hnangv maiv haiz nor.
Haaix dauh gorngv ziepc zuoqv nyei waac kungx gorngv duqv zingx nyei hnangv, mv baac zoux jaav zorng-zengx nyei mienh gorngv gorngv-baeqc nduov nyei waac.
Mienh nzuih siepv gorngv waac hnangv nzuqc ndaauv baqv mienh, mv baac cong-mengh mienh nyei waac haih hnangv ndie zorc mienh.
Mienh gorngv zien nyei waac, waac yietc liuz yiem, mv baac mienh gorngv gorngv-baeqc nyei waac se yiem nduqc dangh hnangv.
Daav orqv za'eix nyei mienh maaih gorngv-baeqc nduov mienh nyei hnyouv, mv baac daav longx nyei za'eix wuov deix duqv njien-youh.
Kuv mienh maiv zuqc haaix nyungc zeqc naanc hoic, orqv mienh zungv zuqc zeqc naanc camv aqv.
Mienh nyei nzuih gorngv-baeqc, Ziouv gamh nziev haic, mv baac ziepc zuoqv nyei zoux wuov deix, ninh a'hneiv haic.
Mienh guai mienh gem jienv ninh maaih nyei wuonh zaang, mv baac mienh hngongx mienh zunh cuotv hngongx nyei sic.
Mienh jienh mienh nyei buoz duqv gunv, mv baac mienh lueic mienh zuqc aapv zoux gong.
Mienh hnyouv nzauh faanh haiz hnangv ga'naaiv ngatv jienv hniev nyei, mv baac yietc joux longx nyei waac bun ninh haiz hnyouv longx.
Kuv mienh dorh ninh nyei juangc laangz mienh, mv baac orqv mienh nyei jauv bun mienh mingh dorngc.
Mienh lueic mienh maiv mingh buonv orv, mienh jienh mienh duqv jaaix nyei zinh zoih.
Yiem zoux horpc nyei jauv bun mienh maaih maengc ziangh, mv baac orqv nyei jauv bun mienh mingh zuqc daic.
Cong-mengh nyei dorn muangx ninh nyei die njaaux nyei waac, mv baac huotv mienh nyei mienh maiv muangx mienh gorngv-hemx ninh.
Weic mienh longx mienh gorngv nyei waac ninh duqv longx nyei jauv, mv baac oix hoic mienh nyei mienh kungx maaih hnyouv oix zoux doqc.
Haaix dauh goux ninh nyei nzuih duqv goux ganh nyei maengc, mv baac haaix dauh la'guaih gorngv, maiv hnamv ndaangc, zungv oix zuqc baaic aqv.
Mienh lueic mienh cei yaac maiv duqv haaix nyungc, mv baac mienh jienh mienh ziux ninh oix nyei duqv daaih buangv hnyouv.
Kuv mienh nzorng haic gorngv-baeqc nyei waac, mv baac orqv mienh zoux duqv nyaiv, gamh nziev haic.
Hnyouv zingx nyei mienh maaih zoux horpc nyei jauv beu jienv, mv baac zuiz bun orqv mienh zuqc baaic.
Maaih dauh zoux hnangv butv-zoih mv baac maiv maaih haaix nyungc, maaih dauh zoux hnangv jomc, mv baac maaih zinh zoih camv.
Mienh nyei zinh zoih haih zuoqc ninh nyei maengc, mv baac mienh jomc mienh maiv haiz mienh gorngv haeqv nyei waac.
