Mv baac daic mingh puix duqv nangh daaih yiem nqa'haav wuov seix m'jangc m'sieqv maiv longc auv longc nqox, maiv bungx sieqv zoux cing-jaa.
Ninh mbuo yaac maiv haih daic weic zuqc ninh mbuo hnangv fin-mienh nor. Ninh mbuo zoux Tin-Hungh nyei naamh nyouz weic zuqc ninh mbuo daic mingh aengx nangh daaih.

Mose yaac bun cing mienh daic mingh aengx nangh daaih weic zuqc ninh gorngv douz zieqc ndiangx-dorn-fomv wuov diuh jauv. Ninh heuc Ziouv zoux ‘Apc^laa^ham nyei Tin-Hungh, I^sakc nyei Tin-Hungh caux Yaakopv nyei Tin-Hungh.’
Tin-Hungh se mienh nangh mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, maiv zeiz daic mingh nyei mienh nyei Tin-Hungh, weic zuqc ei Tin-Hungh mangc, yietc zungv se ziangh jienv nyei.”
Maaih deix njaaux leiz nyei fin-saeng gorngv, “Fin-Saeng aac, meih dau duqv horpc haic.”
Gorngv liuz ninh mbuo maiv gaamv naaic haaix nyungc ninh aqv.
Yesu ziouc naaic ninh mbuo, “Mienh hnangv haaix nor haih gorngv Giduc zoux Ndaawitv Hungh nyei Zeiv-Fun?
Weic zuqc yiem Singx Nzung Sou Ndaawitv ganh fiev, ‘Ziouv gorngv mbuox yie nyei Ziouv, “Zueiz jienv yie nyei mbiaauc maengx bung
zuov yie bun meih nyei win-wangv zoux meih lorngx zaux nyei dorngx.”+’
Ndaawitv heuc ninh zoux Ziouv. Wuov nyungc, Giduc hnangv haaix nor haih zoux Ndaawitv nyei zeiv-fun?”
Zuangx mienh muangx Yesu gorngv wuov zanc, Yesu mbuox ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo,

“Oix zuqc faix fim njaaux leiz nyei fin-saeng. Ninh mbuo a'hneiv zuqv lui-ndaauv mingh mingh daaih daaih, mingh wuov hei-horngc oix mienh taaih, zorqv yieqv bun ninh mbuo. Mingh wuic dorngh ninh mbuo ginv longx jiex nyei dorngx zueiz. Bieqc yinh ninh mbuo kungx oix zueiz dieh gorn hnangv.
Ninh mbuo nduov auv-guaav nyei jaa-dingh nyanc yaac duqv-eix daux gaux ndaauv nyei nduov mienh. Dongh naaiv nyungc mienh oix zuqc dingc zuiz gauh hniev jiex.”
Yesu cau hmien buatc butv-zoih mienh dapv nyaanh zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv wuov norm siou nyaanh nyei faang.
Ninh yaac buatc dauh auv-guaav-jomc daaih dapv i norm dongh zinh siqv.
Yesu gorngv, “Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, naaiv dauh auv-guaav-jomc fongc horc nyei nyaanh gauh camv jiex dauh dauh nyei.
Weic zuqc wuov deix mienh nyaanh camv, ninh mbuo fongc horc deix baav hnangv. Mv baac naaiv dauh auv-guaav ndongc naaic jomc, liemh ninh nyei yungz maengc nyaanh ninh fongc horc nzengc mi'aqv.”
Maaih deix mienh ceng zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv zorng duqv nzueic haic. Longc la'bieiv-nzueic zoux daaih, yaac longc mienh fongc horc nyei zingh nyeic zorng nzueic. Yesu gorngv,
“Meih mbuo buatc naaiv deix ga'naaiv, maaih norm hnoi yietc zungv zuqc caeqv nzengc. Maiv maaih yietc kuaaiv la'bieiv lapv jienv aqv.”
Ninh mbuo naaic Yesu, “Sai-Diex aah! Tov mbuox yie mbuo oc. Naaiv deix sic haaix zanc oix cuotv? Sic oix cuotv wuov zanc maaih haaix nyungc jangx-hoc bun cing ziangh hoc taux?”

Yesu gorngv, “Oix zuqc faix fim oc. Maiv dungx muangx haaix dauh nduov meih mbuo. Maaih mienh camv oix longc yie nyei mbuox daaih gorngv, ‘Yie dongh Giduc aqv,’ yaac gorngv, ‘Ziangh hoc taux aqv.’ Maiv dungx gan ninh mbuo.

Meih mbuo haiz mborqv domh jaax caux deic-bung lunc nyei fienx, maiv dungx gamh nziex. Naaiv deix sic ndongc haaix yaac oix cuotv ndaangc. Mv baac setv mueiz nyei hnoi-nyieqc liemh zeih maiv gaengh taux.”
Yesu aengx gorngv, “Naaiv fingx caux wuov fingx oix mborqv jaax. Naaiv norm guoqv caux wuov norm guoqv oix mborqv domh jaax.

Aengx maaih deix dorngx ndau yaac dongz duqv seix haic. Maaih deix dorngx buangh domh ngorc, maaih deix butv domh wuon-baengc. Yaac maaih gamh nziex haic nyei sic, caux domh jangx-hoc yiem wuov lungh cuotv.

“Naaiv deix sic maiv gaengh cuotv nyei hnoi-nyieqc, mienh oix zorqv meih mbuo yaac zoux doqc hoic. Ninh mbuo oix zorqv meih mbuo jiu bun wuic dorngh yaac bun meih mbuo zuqc wuonx jienv loh. Meih mbuo weic yie nyei mengh aengx zuqc dorh mingh yiem hungh diex caux zungx nyei nza'hmien.
ziouc maaih qangx gorngv weic kuv fienx zoux zorng-zengx.
Oix zuqc jaa-ndaangc dingc hnyouv maiv dungx nzauh taux wuov zanc hnangv haaix nor dau.
Weic zuqc yie oix bun meih mbuo maaih nzuih maaz, maaih cong-mengh, bun meih mbuo nyei win-wangv nzaeng maiv hingh yaac maiv maaih waac gorngv aqv.
Meih mbuo nyei diex maac, muoz-doic, cien-ceqv, gorx-youz yaac oix maaic meih mbuo. Maaih deix meih mbuo yaac oix zuqc ninh mbuo daix daic.
Laaix yie, zuangx mienh oix nzorng meih mbuo.
Mv baac meih mbuo nyei mba'biei yietc diuh zungv maiv zuqc mietc.
Meih mbuo diev duqv taux daauh nor, ziouc njoux duqv meih mbuo nyei maengc aqv.
“Meih mbuo buatc baeng weih jienv Ye^lu^saa^lem wuov zanc, meih mbuo ziouc hiuv duqv zingh zuqc baaic huaang nyei ziangh hoc taux fatv aqv.
Wuov zanc yiem Yu^ndie Saengv wuov deix oix zuqc biaux faaux mbong. Yiem zingh nyei mienh oix zuqc biaux cuotv. Yiem ga'nyiec ziqc zingh wuov deix maiv dungx bieqc zingh aqv.
Weic zuqc naaiv se dingc zuiz nyei hnoi-nyieqc, oix bun nyungc-nyungc cuotv daaih doix nzengc Ging-Sou fiev jienv nyei waac.

Yiem wuov deix hnoi-nyieqc, maaih jienv sin caux maaih gu'nguaaz hopv nyorx nyei m'sieqv dorn za'gengh kouv aqv. Naaiv norm deic-bung oix zuqc domh zeqc naanc yaac zuqc Tin-Hungh nouz, ziouc dingc naaiv deix mienh nyei zuiz.
Maaih deix zuqc nzuqc ndaauv daix. Maaih deix zuqc caangv mingh taux maanc guoqv. Janx oix caaiv jienv Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh taux Janx nyei ziangh hoc buangv soux mouc.
“Wuov zanc hleix, hlaax, mba'hnoi oix cuotv jangx-hoc. Lungh ndiev maanc fingx oix nzauh taux ndoqv yaac hnamv maiv mengh baeqc weic zuqc koiv jiex domh laangc yaac ba'laqc mbui duqv seix haic.
Mienh gamh nziex gau, ziouc meih muangv nzengc. Ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic yiem naaiv lungh ndiev oix cuotv daaih nyei sic, weic zuqc yiem lungh maaih qaqv nyei ga'naaiv zungv zuqc ndanc dongz.
Taux wuov zanc ninh mbuo ziouc buatc yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, maaih qaqv caux domh njang-laangc yiem dorv mbuonx njiec daaih.
Buatc naaiv deix sic jiez gorn cuotv, oix zuqc souv jiez daaih cau hmien mangc jienv lungh, weic zuqc zuoqc meih mbuo nyei ziangh hoc taux fatv aqv.”
Yesu aengx gorngv naaiv diuh waac-beiv bun ninh mbuo muangx. Ninh gorngv, “Mangc gaax ngongh nyorx ndiangx caux nyungc-nyungc ndiangx!
Buatc cuotv normh lunx ziouc hiuv duqv oix bieqc haac gueix aqv.
Naaiv fih hnangv nyei. Meih mbuo buatc naaiv deix sic cuotv, meih mbuo ziouc hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh zoux Ziouv gunv mienh nyei hnoi-nyieqc taux fatv aqv.
“Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, naaiv doic mienh jiex seix maiv gaengh nzengc, naaiv deix yietc zungv sic ziouc cuotv daaih aqv.
Lungh ndau oix jiex nzengc mv baac yie nyei waac yietc liuz maiv jiex.

“Oix zuqc ging hnyouv mbungh jienv, maiv dungx laaix hnamv oix nyanc beuv hopv nquin yaac laaix seix zaangc nyei jauv kuonx hnyouv. Gamh nziex wuov norm hnoi liemh zeih taux, hnangv zaeng hlaang hlopv jienv meih mbuo nor.
Weic zuqc wuov norm hnoi za'gengh oix taux lungh ndiev norm-norm dorngx nyei mienh.

Oix zuqc zanc-zanc ging hnyouv zuov jienv, daux gaux tov Tin-Hungh bun meih mbuo maaih qaqv haih diev duqv yietc zungv oix cuotv daaih nyei sic, yaac duqv souv jienv yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, nyei nza'hmien.”
Yesu hnoi-hnoi mingh zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv njaaux mienh. Hmuangx deix ninh ziouc cuotv zingh mingh ziangh muonz yiem Ga'lanv Mbong.
Ndorm-ndorm nziouv nyei zuangx mienh mingh zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv oix muangx Yesu.
Maiv an bingv nyei Njuov nyei Zipv, aengx maaih norm mbuox heuc Siex Maengc Zipv, aav lamh taux aqv.
Sai mienh bieiv caux njaaux leiz nyei fin-saeng oix bingx jienv lorz qangx daix Yesu, weic zuqc ninh mbuo gamh nziex zuangx mienh.
Wuov zanc Saadaan bieqc Yu^ndaatc nyei hnyouv. Wuov dauh Yu^ndaatc, mienh yaac heuc I^saa^kaa^li^otc. Ninh zoux Yesu nyei ziepc nyeic dauh sai-gorx nyei yietc dauh.
Yu^ndaatc ziouc mingh sai mienh bieiv caux goux zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv nyei baeng-bieiv wuov caangh laangh hnangv haaix nor haih zorqv Yesu jiu bun ninh mbuo.
Wuov deix mienh a'hneiv haic yaac laengz bun nyaanh ninh.
Yu^ndaatc ziouc laengz aqv. Ziouc lorz qangx, dongh zuangx mienh maiv yiem nyei ziangh hoc, zorqv Yesu jiu bun ninh mbuo.
Jiex Maiv An Bingv nyei Njuov nyei Zipv, dongh oix zuqc daix yungh dorn nyanc Siex Maengc Zipv wuov donx nyanc hopv nyei hnoi taux aqv.
Yesu paaiv Bide caux Yo^han, mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo oix zuqc mingh mbenc Siex Maengc Zipv wuov donx nyanc hopv daaih bun mbuo lomh nzoih nyanc.”
Ninh mbuo naaic gaax Yesu, “Sai-Diex oix yie mbuo mingh haaix mbenc?”
Ninh dau, “Meih mbuo bieqc zingh wuov zanc ziouc maaih dauh mienh ndaam norm dapv jienv wuom nyei nie-ha'louh daaih buangh meih mbuo. Ninh bieqc haaix norm biauv, meih mbuo gan jienv ninh bieqc.
Yaac naaic gaax biauv-ziouv, ‘Sai-Diex naaic, ninh caux ninh nyei sai-gorx oix zuqc yiem haaix qongx biauv nyanc Siex Maengc Zipv wuov donx nyanc hopv?’
Biauv-ziouv ziouc dorh meih mbuo faaux mingh mangc gu'nguaaic wuov nzangh biauv, maaih qongx jangv nyei. Nyungc-nyungc maaih nzoih nzengc. Meih mbuo yiem naaic mbenc aqv.”
Ninh mbuo ziouc mingh buatc nyungc-nyungc doix Yesu gorngv nyei waac. Ninh mbuo ziouc yiem wuov mbenc Siex Maengc Zipv nyei hnaangx.
Taux nyanc nyei ziangh hoc, Yesu caux ninh nyei gong-zoh mbuo faaux dieh nyanc hnaangx.
Yesu gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Yie maiv gaengh zuqc siouc kouv, yie za'gengh oix caux meih mbuo nyanc naaiv donx Siex Maengc Zipv nyei hnaangx ndaangc.

Yie mbuox meih mbuo, yangh naaiv jiex yie maiv nyanc Siex Maengc Zipv nyei hnaangx. Zuov taux naaiv donx hnaangx nyei zien eix leiz dunh yunh nzengc, se dongh Tin-Hungh daaih zoux Ziouv gunv mienh nyei ziangh hoc, yie cingx daaih aengx duqv nyanc.”
Gorngv liuz, Yesu zorqv zaanv a'ngunc diuv daaih laengz zingh Tin-Hungh yaac gorngv, “Zipv naaiv norm zaanv mingh bun nqoi yietc laanh hopv deix.
Yie mbuox meih mbuo, yangh naaiv jiex yie maiv hopv a'ngunc diuv. Zuov taux Tin-Hungh daaih zoux Ziouv gunv mienh cingx daaih aengx hopv.”

Yesu zorqv njuov daaih laengz zingh liuz Tin-Hungh, ziouc maeqv nqoi bun sai-gorx mbuo, yaac gorngv, “Naaiv yie nyei sin, se weic meih mbuo siev nyei. Meih mbuo oix zuqc hnangv naaiv zoux weic jangx yie.”
Nyanc liuz hnaangx, Yesu aengx zorqv zaanv a'ngunc diuv daaih gorngv, “Naaiv norm zaanv se longc yie nyei nziaamv liepc jiez nyei siang-ngaengc waac, se weic meih mbuo liouc cuotv daaih.”
“Mangc maah! Oix maaic yie wuov dauh nyei buoz caux yie nyei buoz juangc dieh lorngx jienv.
Yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, oix zuqc ei Tin-Hungh jaa-ndaangc dingc daaih nyei guei seix, mv baac maaic yie wuov dauh zungv zuqc kouv aqv.”
Sai-gorx mbuo ziouc laanh naaic laanh ninh mbuo haaix dauh oix zoux cuotv naaiv deix sic.
Sai-gorx nzaeng jiez daaih gorngv, yiem ninh mbuo mbu'ndongx, oix zuqc funx ninh mbuo haaix dauh zoux hlo jiex.
Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Janx nyei hungh gunv jienv baeqc fingx. Zoux jien-fouv wuov deix, baeqc fingx heuc, ‘Nzie mienh nyei gorx-youz.’

Mv baac meih mbuo maiv horpc zuqc hnangv naaic. Meih mbuo haaix dauh zoux gauh hlo jiex, wuov dauh oix zuqc zoux hnangv gauh lunx jiex wuov dauh. Haaix dauh zoux bieiv, wuov dauh oix zuqc zoux hnangv bou nor.
Haaix dauh zoux gauh hlo? Zueiz jienv nyanc wuov dauh fai liuc leiz wuov dauh? Zueiz jienv wuov dauh zoux gauh hlo maiv zeiz? Mv baac yie yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx hnangv fu-sux nyei mienh nor.
Yie buangh zuqc kouv meih mbuo caux yie yiem, maiv guangc yie.
Yie nyei Die hnangv haaix nor zorqv norm guoqv bun yie, yie ziouc hnangv wuov nor zorqv norm jiu bun meih mbuo.
Se weic bun meih mbuo yiem yie nyei guoqv caux yie juangc dieh nyanc juangc dieh hopv. Meih mbuo yaac duqv zueiz weic, siemv wuov deix ziepc nyeic fingx I^saa^laa^en Mienh.
“Simon aah! Simon! Muangx oc. Saadaan duqv Tin-Hungh nqoi nzuih seix meih mbuo yietc zungv hnangv mienh nyomx cuqv nor.
Mv baac yie zungv weic meih daux gaux tov Tin-Hungh bun meih sienx wuonv, maiv tuix. Meih aengx nzuonx daaih lorz yie, meih oix zuqc tengx meih nyei gorx-youz henv jiez daaih.”
Bide dau, “Ziouv aah! Maiv gunv bieqc loh, maiv gunv daic, yie ziangh yaac caux meih yietc ndui. Daic yaac caux meih yietc kuotv.”
Yesu gorngv, “Bide aah! Yie mbuox meih, ih hnoi jai maiv gaengh nqaaix, meih oix gorngv buo nzunc meih maiv hiuv duqv yie.”

Yesu aengx naaic gaax ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo, “Yie paaiv meih mbuo mingh wuov zanc, yie mbuox meih mbuo maiv dungx dorh nyaanh mbuoqc, yaac maiv dungx dorh mbuoqc dapv ga'naaiv fai dorh heh, meih mbuo caa haaix nyungc fai?” Ninh mbuo dau, “Maiv caa haaix nyungc.”
Yesu gorngv, “Mv baac ih zanc haaix dauh maaih nyaanh mbuoqc fai dapv ga'naaiv nyei mbuoqc oix zuqc dorh jienv mingh. Haaix dauh maiv maaih nzuqc ndaauv oix zuqc maaic ninh nyei domh lui maaiz zung.
Ging-Sou fiev jienv gorngv, ‘Ninh zuqc funx caux zuiz-mienh fih hnangv.’ Yie mbuox meih mbuo, naaiv joux waac oix yiem yie cuotv daaih, zungv cuotv jienv aqv.”
Sai-gorx mbuo gorngv, “Ziouv aah! Mangc gaax naaiv! Maaih i zung nzuqc ndaauv.” Yesu dau, “Naaiv gaux aqv.”
Yesu cuotv zingh mingh yaac hnangv yietc gau nor, mingh Ga'lanv Mbong. Sai-gorx mbuo gan jienv mingh.
Taux wuov norm dorngx, Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo oix zuqc tov Tin-Hungh tengx meih mbuo maiv zuqc buangh seix hnyouv nyei sic.”
Gorngv liuz, ninh ganh aengx mingh norm dorngx go deix nyei, ndongc zoi yietc lau la'bieiv go nyei dorngx, yiem wuov gueic njiec caux Tin-Hungh gorngv waac.
Ninh gorngv, “Aa Die aah! Se gorngv ei Die nyei eix nor, tov zorqv nqoi yie oix zuqc hopv naaiv norm zaanv. Mv baac maiv dungx ei yie nyei eix. Oix zuqc ei Die ganh nyei eix hnangv.”
Maaih dauh fin-mienh yiem tin-dorngh daaih hinc cuotv tengx qaqv Yesu.
Yesu ba'laqc nzauh duqv kouv haic ziouc jaa longc qaqv daux gaux. Ninh cuotv hanc yietc norm yietc norm hlo nyei, hnangv nziaamv nor ndiepv njiec ndau.
Yesu daux gaux baac, jiez sin daaih taux sai-gorx mbuo wuov, buatc ninh mbuo laaix nzauh duqv kouv haic, m'njormh mi'aqv.
Ninh gorngv mbuox sai-gorx mbuo, “Meih mbuo fungc hnangv naaiv nor m'njormh? Jiez sin tov Tin-Hungh tengx meih mbuo maiv zuqc buangh seix hnyouv nyei sic maah!”

Yesu gorngv waac zungv maiv gaengh setv, maaih guanh mienh daaih. Ziepc nyeic dauh sai-gorx nyei yietc dauh, mbuox heuc Yu^ndaatc, yaac dorh jienv ninh mbuo daaih. Yu^ndaatc mingh fatv nyei oix zom Yesu.
Mv baac Yesu naaic, “Yu^ndaatc aac, meih zom yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, weic zorqv yie maaic fai?”
Caux Yesu yiem wuov deix sai-gorx buatc oix maaih haaix nyungc sic cuotv, ninh mbuo ziouc naaic gaax, “Ziouv aah! Baeng nzuqc ndaauv hngaqv ninh mbuo duqv nyei saah?”
Maaih dauh zungv hngaqv domh sai mienh nyei nouh ziouc pai zuqc nouh nyei mbiaauc bung m'normh ndutv mi'aqv.
Mv baac Yesu gorngv, “Maiv dungx zoux maah!” Ninh ziouc hluo wuov dauh nouh nyei m'normh zorc longx mi'aqv.

Yesu gorngv mbuox daaih zorqv ninh wuov deix sai mienh bieiv caux goux hungh dinc nyei baeng-bieiv caux mienh gox, “Meih mbuo buatc yie hnangv zaqc baeng cingx daaih dorh jienv nzuqc ndaauv caux ndiangx-ndonx daaih zorqv yie?
Yie hnoi-hnoi caux meih mbuo yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv, meih mbuo yaac maiv zorqv. Mv baac ih zanc se meih mbuo nyei ziangh hoc aqv. Hmuangx nyei qaqv yaac gunv jienv.”
Ninh mbuo zorqv Yesu dorh mingh domh sai mienh nyei biauv. Bide yaac gan jienv mingh mv baac leih go deix nyei.
Yiem laatc gu'nyuoz, mbu'ndongx wuov norm dorngx, ninh mbuo buov jienv douz zueiz jienv. Bide yaac caux ninh mbuo zueiz wuov.
Maaih dauh m'sieqv bou buatc Bide zueiz douz-nzauc hlen, douz aengv zuqc Bide. Wuov dauh bou nuqv-nuqv nyei mangc yaac gorngv, “Naaiv dauh yaac caux wuov laanh mienh yiem.”
Mv baac Bide maiv nyiemc. Ninh gorngv, “Meih naaiv dauh m'sieqv dorn aah! Yie maiv hiuv duqv ninh niaa.”
Aav dangh aengx maaih dauh mienh buatc Bide ziouc gorngv, “Meih yaac dongh yietc dauh wuov guanh mienh niaa.” Mv baac Bide dau, “Meih naaic dauh mienh aah! Yie maiv zeiz lorqc.”
Nqa'haav yietc norm ziangh hoc nyei dorngx, aengx maaih dauh mienh daaih dic jienv gorngv, “Naaiv dauh ndongc haaix zungv zoux yietc dauh ninh nyei mienh, weic zuqc ninh se Gaa^li^li Mienh.”
Mv baac Bide dau, “Meih naaic dauh mienh aah! Yie zungv maiv hiuv duqv meih gorngv haaix nyungc.” Bide gorngv naaiv deix waac maiv gaengh setv, jai ziouc nqaaix aqv.
Ziouv huin nzuonx mangc jienv Bide, Bide ziouc jangx zuqc zinh ndaangc Ziouv gorngv nyei waac, “Ih muonz jai zungv maiv gaengh nqaaix, meih maiv nyiemc yie buo nzunc.”
Bide ziouc cuotv mingh qaqv nyiemv duqv kouv haic.
Goux Yesu wuov deix mienh guatc doqc jatv Yesu yaac mborqv ninh.
Ninh mbuo buang jienv ninh nyei m'zing naaic ninh, “Cai gaax! Haaix dauh mborqv meih?”
Ninh mbuo yaac gorngv waac camv nyei huotv Yesu.
Lungh njang wuov zanc, Yiutai Mienh nyei mienh gox caux sai mienh bieiv caux njaaux leiz nyei fin-saeng gapv zunv aengx dorh Yesu mingh yiem ninh mbuo nyei Gunv Sic Wuic nza'hmien.
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Se gorngv meih za'gengh Giduc, mbuox yie mbuo maah!” Yesu dau, “Se gorngv yie mbuox meih mbuo nor, meih mbuo yaac maiv sienx.
Se gorngv yie naaic joux waac meih mbuo, meih mbuo yaac maiv dau.
Mv baac yangh naaiv jiex, yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, ziouc zueiz jienv maaih qaqv nyei Tin-Hungh nyei mbiaauc maengx.”
Ninh mbuo yietc zungv gorngv, “Wuov nyungc, meih zoux Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn?” Yesu dau ninh mbuo, “Yie dongh haaix dauh meih mbuo ganh gorngv liuz aqv.”
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo maiv zuqc aengx longc haaix nyungc zoux zorng-zengx aqv. Yie mbuo zungv haiz ninh ganh nyei nzuih gorngv liuz aqv.”
Gunv Sic Wuic nyei mienh yietc zungv ziouc jiez sin dorh Yesu mingh Bilaatv Zungx wuov.

Yiem wuov ninh mbuo gox Yesu. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Yie mbuo buatc naaiv laanh mienh nduov yie mbuo nyei baeqc fingx zoux dorngc. Ninh yaac mbuox ninh mbuo maiv zuqc cuotv nzou-zinh bun Lomaa Domh Ziuh Hungh, yaac gorngv ninh ganh zoux Giduc yaac zoux dauh hungh.”
Bilaatv ziouc naaic gaax Yesu, “Meih gengh zoux Yiutai Mienh nyei hungh fai?” Yesu dau, “Se hnangv meih gorngv nor.”
Bilaatv ziouc gorngv mbuox sai mienh bieiv yaac mbuox zuangx mienh, “Yie zaah maiv cuotv naaiv laanh mienh maaih haaix nyungc zuiz.”

Mv baac ninh mbuo njiec qaqv jaa gorngv, “Naaiv laanh mienh njaaux nyei leiz bun zuangx mienh lunc nzengc. Ninh njaaux gormx Yu^ndie Deic, yiem wuov Gaa^li^li Saengv jiez gorn, ih zanc zungv njaaux taux naaiv daaih aqv.”
Bilaatv haiz ninh mbuo hnangv naaiv nor gorngv ninh ziouc naaic gaax, “Naaiv dauh se Gaa^li^li Mienh?”
Bilaatv hiuv duqv Yesu zoux Helotv Hungh nyei baeqc fingx, ninh ziouc fungx Yesu mingh taux Helotv wuov. Wuov zanc Helotv yaac yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh.
Helotv buatc Yesu ziouc a'hneiv haic aqv, weic zuqc kungx haiz mienh gorngv hnangv. Maiv gaengh duqv buatc yietc nzunc. Ninh yaac oix buatc Yesu zoux deix mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Helotv ziouc naaic camv-nyungc nyei mv baac Yesu maiv dau yietc joux.
Sai mienh bieiv caux njaaux leiz nyei fin-saeng souv jienv wuov, qaqv gox Yesu.
Helotv caux ninh nyei baeng mangc piex, huotv ninh, zoux doqc bun ninh. Ninh mbuo zorqv deix nzueic haic nyei lui tengx ninh zuqv jienv aengx fungx ninh nzuonx Bilaatv wuov.
Zinh ndaangc Bilaatv caux Helotv zoux win-jaa. Mv baac dongh naaic hnoi ninh mbuo zoux longx daav loz-gaeng.
Bilaatv heuc sai mienh bieiv caux jien-fouv caux baeqc fingx daaih gapv zunv

gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo dorh naaiv laanh mienh taux yie naaiv gox ninh. Meih mbuo gorngv ninh coqv baeqc fingx lunc nzengc. Ih zanc yiem naaiv meih mbuo nyei nza'hmien yie zaah liuz. Dongh meih mbuo gox ninh wuov deix sic, yie maiv buatc ninh dorngc haaix nyungc.

Helotv yaac fih hnangv nyei maiv buatc ninh maaih haaix nyungc dorngc nyei dorngx, weic zuqc ninh fungx Yesu daaux nqaang nzuonx mbuo naaiv. Mangc gaax, naaiv laanh mienh maiv dorngc haaix nyungc zuiz zic duqv daix lorqc.
Hnangv naaic, yie bun baeng mborqv liuz ziouc bungx ninh aqv.”
Hnyangx-hnyangx taux Siex Maengc Zipv, Bilaatv oix zuqc bungx dauh zuiz-mienh cuotv bun baeqc fingx.
Zuangx mienh yietc zungv nauc jienv kih kungx kaatv nyei gorngv, “Daix naaiv dauh aqv. Bungx Mbaa^lapv^mbatc bun yie mbuo.”
Naaiv dauh Mbaa^lapv^mbatc ceux lunc zingh gu'nyuoz yaac daix jiex mienh cingx daaih zuqc wuonx jienv loh.
Bilaatv maaih hnyouv oix bungx Yesu, ninh ziouc gorngv hlo nyei mbuox zuangx mienh.
Mv baac ninh mbuo aengx nih nungx nauc nyei heuc jienv gorngv, “Dorh ninh mingh ding jienv! Dorh ninh mingh ding jienv ziepc nzaangc jaax!”

Bilaatv aengx gorngv da'faam nzunc, “Wuov nyungc, ninh zoux dorngc haaix nyungc zuiz? Yie gengh maiv buatc ninh dorngc haaix nyungc zic duqv daix ninh lorqc. Yie ziouc bun yie nyei baeng mborqv liuz, bungx nqoi ninh aqv.”
Mv baac zuangx mienh yietc zei kih kungx kaatv nyei gorngv oix zuqc dorh Yesu mingh ding jienv ziepc nzaangc jaax. Zuangx mienh heuc taux hingh.
Bilaatv ziouc dingc ei ninh mbuo tov nyei zoux.
Ninh bungx ninh mbuo tov wuov dauh, dongh laaix ceux lunc zingh gu'nyuoz daix jiex mienh, zuqc wuonx jienv loh wuov dauh. Ninh aengx zorqv Yesu jiu bun ninh mbuo, sueih ninh mbuo zoux.

Ninh mbuo dorh Yesu cuotv jauv wuov zanc, buangh zuqc dauh Sailin Mienh, mbuox heuc Simon, yiem wuov naah daaih oix bieqc zingh. Baeng ziouc caa daaih zorqv ziepc nzaangc jaax lorngx jienv Simon nyei mba'dauh, aapv ninh ndaam gan jienv Yesu mingh.
Mienh camv nyei yaac gan jienv Yesu mingh. Maaih deix m'sieqv dorn yaac nyiemv duqv kouv haic weic zuqc ninh mbuo korv-lienh haic Yesu.
Yesu huin nzuonx daaih gorngv, “Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh nyei m'sieqv dorn aah! Meih mbuo maiv dungx weic yie nyiemv oc. Oix zuqc weic meih mbuo ganh caux meih mbuo nyei fu'jueiv nyiemv hnangv.

Weic zuqc ziangh hoc oix taux, mienh oix gorngv, ‘Maiv haih maaih saeng-yungz nyei wuov deix, caux maiv gaengh yungz jiex gu'nguaaz wuov deix, aengx caux maiv bun gu'nguaaz hopv jiex nyorx wuov deix m'sieqv dorn maaih njien-youh aqv.’
Taux wuov zanc mienh oix gorngv mbuox domh zorng, ‘Mbaang daaih ndapv yie mbuo maah!’ Aengx heuc fiuv-mbong, ‘Biopv jienv yie mbuo aqv.’
Se gorngv ndiangx nyiemz nyei ziangh hoc ninh mbuo zungv hnangv naaiv zoux, ndiangx-kou-nqaai oix hnangv haaix nor?”
Ninh mbuo aengx dorh i dauh zuiz-mienh mingh caux Yesu yietc jauv daix.

Ninh mbuo mingh taux norm dorngx mbuox heuc M'nqorngv-Korqv Dorngx, zorqv Yesu ding jienv ziepc nzaangc jaax. Aengx ding wuov deix i dauh zuiz-mienh yiem Yesu nyei ga'hlen. Maaih dauh yiem mbiaauc maengx, maaih dauh yiem zaaix maengx.
Yesu gorngv, “Aa Die aah! Tov Die guangc nqoi ninh mbuo nyei zuiz, weic zuqc ninh mbuo zoux nyei ninh mbuo maiv hiuv.” Ninh mbuo yaac zorqv Yesu nyei lui-houx daaih ndouv mangc weic bun nqoi.

Zuangx mienh souv jienv wuov mangc. Mv baac zoux hlo wuov deix Yiutai Mienh jatv ninh. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Ninh njoux duqv mienh. Se gorngv ninh dongh Tin-Hungh Ginv Daaih nyei Giduc, bun ninh njoux ninh ganh maah!”
Baeng yaac fih hnangv nyei huotv Yesu, aengx mingh fatv deix zorqv a'ngunc diuv-sui cunv bun ninh
yaac gorngv, “Se gorngv meih za'gengh Yiutai Mienh nyei hungh nor, njoux meih ganh maah!”
Yiem Yesu gu'nguaaic fiev jienv naaiv deix waac, “Naaiv dauh se Yiutai Mienh nyei hungh.”
Caux Yesu ding jienv wuov deix i dauh zuiz-mienh maaih dauh gorngv doqc ki Yesu, “Meih zoux Giduc maiv zeiz? Njoux meih ganh yaac njoux yie mbuo maah!”
Mv baac wuov dauh zuiz-mienh baav ninh gorngv, “Meih maiv gamh nziex Tin-Hungh? Mbuo lomh nzoih zuqc dingc zuiz daic.
Weic mbuo se horpc nyei, puix duqv mbuo zoux nyei. Mv baac naaiv dauh maiv zoux dorngc haaix nyungc.”
Ninh aengx gorngv mbuox Yesu, “Yesu aah! Meih daaih zoux hungh nyei ziangh hoc, tov jangx deix yie oc.”
Yesu dau ninh, “Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih, ih hnoi meih duqv caux yie yiem orn-lorqc huingx.”
Wuov zanc aav lamh ziangx aanx nyei ziangh hoc, wuov norm deic-bung hmuangx nzengc taux njiec aanx buo norm ziangh hoc.
Mba'hnoi yaac hmuangx mingh. Yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv wuov kuaaiv mbaeqc gaengh ndie yaac mbaaix zoux i maengx.
Yesu heuc qiex hlo nyei gorngv, “Aa Die aah! Yie nyei lingh wuonh yie jiu yiem Die nyei buoz.” Hnangv naaiv gorngv liuz ziouc dangx qiex mi'aqv.
Maaih dauh baeng-bieiv buatc naaiv deix sic cuotv ziouc ceng Tin-Hungh yaac gorngv, “Naaiv laanh mienh za'gengh! kuv mienh.”
Gapv zunv mangc naaiv deix sic nyei zuangx mienh buatc sic hnangv naaiv nor cuotv, ninh mbuo ziouc nzauh haic, nzuei jienv la'kuotv nzuonx.
Caux Yesu jiu zuoqc wuov deix mienh aengx caux yiem Gaa^li^li gan Yesu daaih wuov deix m'sieqv dorn souv jienv go deix nyei mangc naaiv deix sic.

Maaih dauh Yu^ndie Saengv, Aa^li^maa^tie Mungv nyei mienh, mbuox heuc Yosepv. Ninh zoux dauh kuv mienh, gan longx Tin-Hungh nyei leiz yaac zanc-zanc zuov jienv Tin-Hungh daaih zoux Ziouv nyei hnoi taux. Ninh yaac zoux dauh Gunv Sic Wuic nyei mienh. Mv baac wuov deix gunv sic mienh caangh laangh dingc hnangv haaix nor zoux wuov zanc, Yosepv maiv tengx ninh mbuo gorngv.
Yosepv mingh lorz Bilaatv tov Yesu nyei sei.
Tov liuz ziouc mingh zorqv sei njiec daaih, longc la'maah ndie beu jienv fungx mingh zangx norm zuqc daaih nyei la'bieiv-zouv. Naaiv norm zouv maiv gaengh zangx jiex yietc dauh janx-daic.
Wuov hnoi se liuc leiz jiex Dingh Gong nyei Hnoi, Dingh Gong Hnoi oix taux aqv.
Yiem Gaa^li^li gan Yesu daaih wuov deix m'sieqv dorn gan jienv Yosepv mingh mangc zouv, yaac mangc ninh mbuo hnangv haaix nor an Yesu nyei sei.
Mangc liuz ninh mbuo ziouc nzuonx mingh mbenc jienv ndaang nyei ndie, ndaang nyei youh, oix dorh mingh hietv Yesu nyei sei. Taux Dingh Gong Hnoi, ninh mbuo ziouc ei leiz-latc dingh gong.
Taux wuov norm leiz-baaix nyei da'yietv hnoi lungh ndorm nziouv nyei, lungh mbiouz-mbiouz njang hnangv, wuov deix m'sieqv dorn dorh jienv ninh mbuo mbenc daaih nyei ndie-ndaang mingh Yesu nyei zouv.
Taux wuov buatc mbaeqc zouv-gaengh wuov kuaaiv la'bieiv tui nqoi mi'aqv.
Ninh mbuo ziouc bieqc mingh mangc, maiv buatc Ziouv Yesu nyei sei.
Ninh mbuo souv jienv wuov hnamv maiv mengh baeqc. Liemh zeih maaih i laanh mienh zuqv jienv lui-houx zaengh zaengh nyei souv jienv ninh mbuo nyei ga'hlen.
Wuov deix m'sieqv dorn gamh nziex haic ziouc puoqv njiec ndau. Naaiv deix i laanh mienh naaic ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo weic haaix diuc daaih naaiv janx-daic yiem nyei dorngx lorz mienh nangh mienh?
Ninh maiv yiem naaiv lorqc. Ninh nangh daaih aqv. Meih mbuo oix zuqc jangx taux ninh yiem Gaa^li^li wuov zanc gorngv mbuox meih mbuo wuov deix waac.
Ninh gorngv, ‘Yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, oix zuqc jiu bun mienh waaic mienh dorh mingh ding ziepc nzaangc jaax. Mv baac da'faam hnoi yie aengx nangh daaih’ wuov deix waac.”
Wuov deix m'sieqv dorn ziouc jangx zuqc Yesu nyei waac aqv.
Yiem zouv nzuonx mingh, ninh mbuo zorqv naaiv deix yietc zungv sic mbuox wuov deix ziepc yietv dauh gong-zoh caux ga'hlen nyei zuangx mienh.
Mbuox gong-zoh mbuo wuov deix m'sieqv dorn, dongh Makv^ndaa^laa Mungv wuov dauh Maa^li^yaa caux Yo^an^naa caux Yaagorpc nyei maa, Maa^li^yaa, aengx caux ninh mbuo daaih wuov deix m'sieqv dorn.
Mv baac gong-zoh mbuo maiv sienx. Laaic naaiv deix m'sieqv dorn la'guaih gorngv hnangv.
Mv baac Bide jiez sin tiux jienv mingh taux zouv, ndoqv njiec ciepv mangc, kungx buatc ndie-damh hnangv. Ninh ziouc daaux nqaang nzuonx, yaac hnamv maiv mengh baeqc naaiv deix sic.
Dongh naaic hnoi maaih i dauh Yesu nyei sai-gorx mingh norm laangz heuc Em^maa^utc, yiem nitv Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh leih maiv go ziepc yietv gilo jauv.
Gan jauv mingh wuov zanc, ninh mbuo gorngv jienv koqv hoqc cuotv liuz nyei sic mingh.
Doix ninh mbuo gorngv jienv wuov zanc, Yesu ganh daaih fatv caux jienv ninh mbuo mingh.
Ninh mbuo buatc nyei mv baac weic haaix diuc mv bei, ninh mbuo zieqv maiv duqv ninh.
Yesu naaic gaax ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo gan jienv jauv mingh meih mbuo gorngv haaix nyungc?” Ninh mbuo ziouc dingh jienv, hmien nzauh nzauh wuov.
Maaih dauh, mbuox heuc Ken^o^batc, naaic Yesu, “Kungx meih ganh nduqc dauh kaeqv yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh maiv hiuv duqv naaiv deix i ziex hnoi cuotv daaih nyei sic?”

Yesu aengx naaic, “Haaix nyungc sic?” Ninh mbuo dau, “Naa^saa^letv Mungv nyei Yesu nyei sic. Ninh zoux dauh douc waac mienh. Yiem Tin-Hungh caux zuangx mienh nyei nza'hmien ninh gorngv nyei waac caux zoux nyei sic maaih domh qaqv.
Yie mbuo nyei sai mienh bieiv caux jien-fouv zorqv ninh jiu bun Janx dingc zuiz daix ninh ziouc dorh ninh mingh ding ziepc nzaangc jaax daic.
Yie mbuo yaac hnamv jienv dongh naaiv dauh oix zuoqc I^saa^laa^en Mienh nzuonx. Yaac maiv daan mbuoqc naaiv hnangv. Naaiv deix sic cuotv liuz duqv buo hnoi aqv.
Mv baac yiem yie mbuo wuov maaih deix m'sieqv dorn zoux bun yie mbuo hnamv maiv mengh baeqc. Ninh mbuo a'ndorm nziouv nyei mingh wuov zouv mangc.
Maiv buatc ninh nyei sei mi'aqv. Ninh mbuo nzuonx daaih gorngv ninh mbuo buatc fin-mienh hinc cuotv daaih mbuox ninh mbuo, Yesu ziangh jienv nyei.
Yie mbuo maaih deix mingh mangc yaac buatc hnangv naaiv deix m'sieqv dorn gorngv nor. Mv baac ninh mbuo maiv buatc Yesu.”
Yesu gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo mienh hngongx mienh aah! Douc waac mienh gorngv nyei yietc zungv waac meih mbuo weic haaix diuc sienx ndongc naaic ndanh?
Giduc oix zuqc siouc liuz naaic deix kouv nyei sic cingx daaih bieqc ninh nyei njang-laangc maiv zeiz?”

Yesu ziouc gorngv mengh Ging-Sou ziangv jienv ninh ganh gorngv nyei joux-joux waac bun ninh mbuo muangx, yiem Mose nyei Leiz-Latc Sou jiez gorn aengx gorngv nzengc Tin-Hungh nyei zuangx Douc Waac Mienh nyei Sou.
Mingh aav lamh taux ninh mbuo oix mingh wuov norm laangz, Yesu zoux hnangv oix baeng zaqc nyei jiex.
Mv baac ninh mbuo qaqv liouh ninh gorngv, “Ih zanc aav lamh hmuangx aqv. Mba'hnoi oix muotv aqv. Caux yie mbuo bueix muonz naaiv maah!” Yesu ziouc bieqc biauv caux ninh mbuo hitv wuov.
Yesu caux ninh mbuo juangc dieh nyanc hnaangx wuov zanc, ninh aengx zorqv njuov daaih laengz zingh liuz Tin-Hungh ziouc maeqv nqoi bun ninh mbuo.
Tin-Hungh bun ninh mbuo i laanh liemh zeih zieqv duqv Yesu, ziang naaic maiv buatc ninh mi'aqv.
Laanh mbuox laanh, “Mbuo gan jauv daaih wuov zanc, ninh caux mbuo gorngv waac yaac porv mengh Ging-Sou, mbuo haiz jorm hnyouv haic hnangv maaih douz zieqc jienv nor orqc?”
Ninh mbuo liemh zeih jiez sin nzuonx Ye^lu^saa^lem. Ninh mbuo buatc wuov deix ziepc yietv dauh sai-gorx caux deix ninh mbuo nyei doic gapv zunv wuov,
haiz ninh mbuo gorngv, “Ziouv za'gengh nangh daaih aqv. Ninh hinc bun Simon buatc liuz aqv.”
Wuov deix i laanh yaac gorngv ninh mbuo yiem jauv zaangc buangh nyei sic yaac gorngv Yesu maeqv njuov wuov zanc ninh mbuo zieqv duqv ninh aqv.

Wuov deix i laanh gorngv jienv naaiv deix jauv wuov zanc, Ziouv Yesu ganh liemh zeih hinc daaih souv jienv ninh mbuo zuangx mienh nyei mbu'ndongx gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo baengh orn aqv oc.”
Ninh mbuo laaic buatc janx-daic njoiz mv bei, ziouc haeqv ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic, hnyouv huaang nzengc.
Mv baac Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo weic haaix diuc nzauh faanh? Zoux haaix nyungc maaih hnyouv mbungh mbienv?
Samx mangc gaax yie nyei buoz-zaux! Hluo mangc, meih mbuo ziouc hiuv duqv dongh yie aqv. Janx-daic njoiz maiv maaih orv, maiv maaih mbungv hnangv meih mbuo buatc yie maaih nor.”
Ninh hnangv naaiv nor gorngv yaac bun ninh mbuo mangc ninh nyei buoz-zaux.
Mangc liuz ninh mbuo a'hneiv haic, mbuoqc horngh haic, mv baac corc maiv gaengh sienx. Yesu naaic ninh mbuo, “Yiem naaiv maaih nyanc nyei ga'naaiv nyei fai?”
Ninh mbuo zorqv deix ziqv daaih nyei mbiauz bun ninh.
Ninh zipv daaih ziouc dorng jienv ninh mbuo nyanc.

Nyanc liuz, ninh mbuox ninh mbuo, “Naaiv deix sic se yie caux meih mbuo yiem wuov zanc yie mbuox jiex meih mbuo. Yiem Mose nyei Leiz-Latc Sou caux Tin-Hungh nyei Douc Waac Mienh nyei Sou caux Singx Nzung ziangv jienv yie wuov deix waac yietc zungv, oix zuqc cuotv daaih doix-diuc nzengc.”
Yesu ziouc porv nqoi ninh mbuo nyei hnyouv bun ninh mbuo mengh baeqc Ging-Sou.
Ninh yaac gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Ging-Sou fiev jienv hnangv naaiv nor gorngv Giduc oix zuqc siouc kouv. Daic mingh taux da'faam hnoi aengx nangh daaih.

Oix zuqc dengv ninh nyei mbuox mingh zunh mbuox mienh goiv hnyouv guangc zuiz ziouc duqv Tin-Hungh guangc ninh mbuo nyei zuiz. Oix zuqc yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh jiez gorn zunh cuotv buangv maanc guoqv maanc fingx.
Meih mbuo zoux naaiv deix sic nyei zorng-zengx mienh.
Dongh yie nyei Die laengz bun nyei, yie ganh oix paaiv daaih caux meih mbuo yiem. Mv baac meih mbuo oix zuqc yiem naaiv zingh zuov taux yiem gu'nguaaic daaih nyei qaqv njiec taux meih mbuo.”
Yesu dorh ninh mbuo cuotv mingh taux Mbe^taa^ni Laangz-hlen ziouc cau jienv buoz buang waac ninh mbuo.
Buang gau waac, ninh ziouc leih nqoi ninh mbuo, faaux tin-dorngh mi'aqv.
Ninh mbuo ziouc yiem wuov baaix ninh, njien-youh a'hneiv nyei nzuonx Ye^lu^saa^lem,
yaac zanc-zanc yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv ceng Tin-Hungh.
Dongh cor maiv gaengh zeix lungh zeix ndau wuov zanc, Doz zungv yiem nyei. Doz caux Tin-Hungh yiem yaac dongh Tin-Hungh.
Zinh ndaangc yiem gorn wuov zanc, Doz caux Tin-Hungh yiem.
Tin-Hungh longc ninh zeix cuotv maanc muotc. Maiv maaih yietc nyungc Tin-Hungh maiv longc Doz zeix.
Doz zoux ziangh maengc nyei gorn-nyuonh. Naaiv nyungc maengc dorh njang daaih ziux baamh mienh.
Njang ziux bieqc hmuangx nyei dorngx, hmuangx yaac maiv haih hingh njang.
Tin-Hungh paaiv dauh mienh daaih, mbuox heuc Yo^han.
Ninh daaih tengx njang zoux zorng-zengx bun maanc mienh haih sienx.
Ninh ganh maiv zeiz zoux naaiv njang. Ninh kungx tengx njang zoux zorng-zengx hnangv.
Naaiv njang se zien haic nyei njang yaac bieqc baamh gen ziux njang lungh ndiev mienh maanh.
Naaiv Doz yiem baamh gen. Tin-Hungh longc ninh zeix baamh gen, mv baac baamh mienh zieqv maiv duqv ninh.
Ninh daaih taux ninh ganh nyei deic-bung, ninh ganh nyei mienh yaac maiv zipv ninh.
Mv baac zipv ninh yaac sienx kaux ninh wuov deix, ninh bun maaih leiz benx Tin-Hungh nyei naamh nyouz.
Ninh mbuo benx Tin-Hungh nyei naamh nyouz se maiv zeiz ei baamh mienh nyei nziaamv-fei fai ei baamh mienh nyei eix yungz. Tin-Hungh ganh zoux ninh mbuo nyei die.

Doz benx dauh baamh mienh yiem mbuo mbu'ndongx. Ninh maaih en-ceix caux zien leiz buangv nzengc. Yie mbuo duqv buatc ninh nyei njang-laangc, se weic zuqc ninh zoux Zaangc Diex nyei ndoqc Dorn duqv daaih nyei njang-laangc.

Yo^han tengx ninh zoux zorng-zengx. Ninh heuc jienv gorngv, “Yie gorngv jiex nyei wuov dauh se dongh naaiv dauh aqv. Yie daaih ndaangc, ninh nqa'haav daaih mv baac ninh zoux gauh hlo yie, weic zuqc yie maiv gaengh cuotv seix ninh zungv yiem nyei.”
Ninh nyei en hlo haic ziouc zanc-zanc ceix fuqv bun mbuo.
Tin-Hungh longc Mose bun mbuo duqv leiz-latc, mv baac longc Yesu Giduc bun mbuo duqv ninh nyei en caux zien leiz.
Maiv maaih haaix dauh buatc jiex Tin-Hungh. Kungx maaih ninh nyei ndoqc Dorn, dongh yiem Zaangc Diex nyei ga'hlen wuov dauh, bun mbuo hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh hnangv.
Yo^han zoux nyei zorng-zengx se hnangv naaiv. Yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh paaiv deix sai mienh caux Lewi Mienh mingh naaic ninh, “Meih dongh haaix dauh?”
Yo^han maiv bingx, ninh gorngv zaqc nyei. “Yie maiv zeiz Giduc.”

Ninh mbuo aengx naaic, “Wuov nyungc, meih dongh haaix dauh? Meih dongh E^li^yaa fai?” Yo^han dau, “Maiv zeiz.” Ninh mbuo aengx naaic, “Hnangv naaic, meih dongh wuov dauh Douc Waac Mienh fai?” Yo^han dau, “Maiv zeiz lorqc.”
Ninh mbuo aengx gorngv, “Wuov nyungc, meih dongh haaix dauh? Mbuox yie mbuo maah! Yie mbuo oix zuqc nzuonx mingh mbuox paaiv yie mbuo daaih wuov deix. Meih ganh gorngv meih zoux haaix nyungc mienh?”
Yo^han longc douc waac mienh, I^saa^yaa, nyei waac dau ninh mbuo. Ninh gorngv, “Yie dongh yiem deic-bung-huaang qiex hlo nyei heuc jienv gorngv, ‘Oix zuqc koi jauv zaqc nyei liuc leiz zipv Ziouv.’+”
Faa^li^si Mienh paaiv daaih wuov deix mienh
ziouc naaic Yo^han, “Se gorngv meih maiv zeiz Giduc, yaac maiv zeiz E^li^yaa, yaac maiv zeiz wuov dauh Douc Waac Mienh, meih weic haaix diuc tengx mienh jiex wuom nyei leiz?”
Yo^han dau, “Yie longc wuom tengx mienh jiex leiz. Mv baac aengx maaih dauh yiem meih mbuo mbu'ndongx, meih mbuo yaac maiv hiuv duqv ninh.
Yie daaih ndaangc, ninh nqa'haav daaih, mv baac yie liemh maiv puix tengx ninh jaiv heh hlaang.”
Naaiv deix yietc zungv sic yiem Jor^ndaen Ndaaih nyei dong bung maengx, Mbe^taa^ni Laangz cuotv, dongh Yo^han tengx mienh jiex wuom nyei leiz wuov norm dorngx.
Da'nyeic hnoi Yo^han buatc Yesu hungx jienv ninh daaih ziouc gorngv, “Mangc maah! Tin-Hungh nyei Ba'gi Yungh Dorn, dongh teix baamh mienh nyei zuiz wuov dauh.
Dongh naaiv dauh yie gorngv jiex mbuox meih mbuo, ‘Yie daaih ndaangc, maaih dauh nqa'haav daaih mv baac ninh zoux gauh hlo yie, weic zuqc yie maiv gaengh cuotv seix, ninh zungv yiem nyei.’
Yie ganh maiv hiuv duqv ninh dongh haaix dauh, mv baac yie daaih tengx mienh jiex wuom nyei leiz weic bun I^saa^laa^en Mienh hiuv duqv ninh.”
Yo^han aengx zoux zorng-zengx gorngv, “Yie buatc Singx Lingh hnangv norqc nqo yiem wuov lungh njiec daaih yiem ninh nyei sin.

Yie yaac maiv hiuv ninh dongh haaix dauh, mv baac paaiv yie daaih longc wuom tengx mienh jiex leiz wuov dauh mbuox yie, ‘Meih buatc Singx Lingh njiec daaih yiem haaix dauh nyei sin, dongh naaiv dauh oix longc Singx Lingh tengx mienh jiex leiz.’
Yie buatc liuz aqv, ziouc zoux zorng-zengx mbuox meih mbuo, naaiv dauh se Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn.”
Da'nyeic hnoi Yo^han caux i dauh ninh nyei sai-gorx aengx souv jienv wuov.
Buatc Yesu jiex jauv, Yo^han ziouc gorngv, “Mangc maah! Tin-Hungh nyei Ba'gi Yungh Dorn.”
Wuov deix i dauh sai-gorx haiz Yo^han hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, ninh mbuo ziouc gan jienv Yesu mingh.

Yesu huin nzuonx buatc ninh mbuo gan jienv daaih ziouc naaic, “Meih mbuo lorz haaix nyungc?” Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Lapv^mbi aac, meih hitv haaix norm dorngx?” (Lapv^mbi wuov joux waac nyei eix leiz se Sai-Diex.)
Yesu dau, “Daaih mangc maah!” Wuov zanc njiec aanx leih maiv go biei norm ziangh hoc. Ninh mbuo ziouc gan jienv Yesu mingh taux ninh hitv nyei dorngx yaac caux ninh yiem wuov taux hmuangx.
Haiz Yo^han gorngv ziouc gan jienv Yesu mingh wuov deix i dauh, maaih dauh zoux Simon Bide nyei youz, An^ndaa^lu.
An^ndaa^lu liemh zeih mingh lorz ninh nyei gorx, Simon Bide, mbuox ninh, “Yie mbuo buatc Me^si^yaa aqv loh!” (Me^si^yaa wuov joux waac nyei eix leiz se Giduc.)

An^ndaa^lu ziouc dorh Simon mingh taux Yesu wuov. Yesu mangc jienv Simon ziouc gorngv, “Meih se Yo^han nyei dorn, Simon. Yangh naaiv jiex meih nyei mbuox oix zuqc heuc Kefaatv.” (Kefaatv faan daaih gorngv Bide.)
Da'nyeic hnoi Yesu dingc hnyouv mingh Gaa^li^li Saengv. Ninh buatc Filipv ziouc gorngv mbuox ninh, “Daaih gan yie oc.”
Filipv se Mbetc^sai^ndaa Mungv nyei mienh hnangv An^ndaa^lu caux Simon nor.

Filipv lorz buatc Naa^taa^naa^en ziouc gorngv, “Dongh Mose fiev jienv wuov Leiz-Latc Sou, caux Tin-Hungh nyei zuangx douc waac mienh fiev nyei sou ziangv jienv gorngv wuov laanh mienh, yie mbuo duqv buatc aqv. Se Yosepv nyei dorn, Naa^saa^letv Mungv nyei Yesu.”
Naa^taa^naa^en naaic gaax, “Haih maaih haaix nyungc longx nyei yiem Naa^saa^letv Mungv cuotv fai?” Filipv gorngv, “Daaih mangc maah!”
Yesu buatc Naa^taa^naa^en daaih lorz ninh ziouc gorngv, “Naaiv dauh za'gengh zien I^saa^laa^en Mienh. Ninh maiv maaih guv guaix nyei hnyouv.”
Naa^taa^naa^en naaic Yesu, “Meih hnangv haaix nor hiuv duqv yie?” Yesu dau, “Filipv maiv gaengh heuc meih wuov zanc, meih yiem wuov ngongh nyorx ndiangx-gorn, yie buatc liuz meih aqv.”
Naa^taa^naa^en gorngv, “Sai-Diex aah! Meih za'gengh Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn. Meih zoux I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei Hungh.”
Yesu gorngv, “Weic zuqc yie gorngv yie buatc meih yiem ngongh nyorx ndiangx-gorn meih cingx daaih sienx? Meih zungv oix duqv buatc sic gauh hlo jiex naaiv.”

Yesu aengx gorngv mbuox Naa^taa^naa^en, “Yie mbuox zien meih mbuo, meih mbuo oix buatc lungh gaengh nqoi, yaac buatc Tin-Hungh nyei fin-mienh yiem yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, gu'nguaaic faaux-faaux njiec-njiec.”
Da'faam hnoi yiem Gaa^li^li Deic-Bung, Kaanaa Laangz, maaih norm cing-jaa-yinh. Yesu nyei maa yaac yiem wuov nyei.
Mienh yaac cingv Yesu caux ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo mingh wuov norm yinh.
Zoux gau, a'ngunc diuv nzengc mi'aqv. Yesu nyei maa gorngv mbuox Yesu, “Ninh mbuo nyei a'ngunc diuv nzengc mi'aqv.”
Yesu dau, “Aa Maa aah! Weic haaix diuc bun naaiv deix jauv paanx taux yie? Yie nyei ziangh hoc maiv gaengh taux.”
Yesu nyei maa gorngv mbuox wuov deix bou, “Ninh mbuox meih mbuo zoux haaix nyungc, oix zuqc ei jienv zoux oc.”
Yiutai Mienh ei jienv leiz nzaaux buoz-zaux nyei uix. Weic naaiv, yiem wuov norm yinh maaih juqv norm la'bieiv-ongx, yietc norm dapv duqv biaa juqv tongv wuom.
Yesu mbuox wuov deix bou, “Ndamv wuom dapv buangv wuov deix ongx maah!” Ninh mbuo ziouc ndamv wuom dapv buangv taux baengh ongx-nzuih.
Yesu aengx mbuox ninh mbuo, “Ih zanc ndamv deix naaiv ongx nyei wuom dorh mingh bun cing-suiv oc.” Ninh mbuo ziouc ndamv dorh mingh.
Cing-suiv seix naaiv deix wuom benx daaih nyei a'ngunc diuv. Ninh maiv hiuv duqv naaiv deix diuv yiem haaix daaih, (Mv baac ndamv wuom wuov deix bou hiuv nyei.) Ninh ziouc heuc siang-laangh daaih
gorngv mbuox ninh, “Yietc gau mienh cingv kaeqv ninh mbuo bun diuv-kuv hopv ndaangc. Zuov mienh hopv camv cingx bun maiv kuv nyei diuv. Mv baac meih liouh kuv wuov nyungc taux ih zanc.”

Yesu zoux cuotv naaiv daauh nzunc mbuoqc horngh nyei jangx-hoc, yiem Gaa^li^li Saengv, Kaanaa Laangz zoux. Ninh hnangv naaiv zoux biux mengh ninh nyei njang-laangc. Ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo yaac sienx kaux ninh.
Nqa'haav Yesu caux ninh nyei maa, ninh nyei youz mbuo, caux ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo mingh Kaa^be^naa^um Mungv yiem i ziex hnoi wuov.
Wuov zanc aav lamh taux Siex Maengc Zipv. Yesu ziouc mingh Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh.
Yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv ninh buatc mienh maaic ngongh, maaic yungh, maaic baeqc gopv, yaac maaih mienh zueiz jienv tiuv nyaanh.

Yesu ziouc longc hlaang gitv diuh hlaang-bin daaih zunc yietc zungv, liemh ngongh, liemh yungh, cuotv zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv yaac bungx king tiuv nyaanh nyei dieh, dox guangc nzengc ninh mbuo nyei nyaanh.
Ninh yaac mbuox maaic baeqc gopv wuov deix mienh, “Bienh meih mbuo nyei norqc cuotv mingh maah! Maiv dungx longc yie nyei Die nyei biauv zoux hei.”
Sai-gorx mbuo ziouc jangx zuqc Ging-Sou fiev jienv gorngv, “O Tin-Hungh aah! Yie weic meih nyei biauv jorm hnyouv, hnangv douz zieqc jienv yie nor.”
Zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh naaic ninh, “Meih oix zoux haaix nyungc jangx-hoc bun yie mbuo mangc, bun cing meih maaih leiz hnangv naaiv nor zoux?”
Yesu dau, “Caeqv naaiv norm zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv maah! Buo hnoi gu'nyuoz yie aengx ceix jiez daaih.”
Ninh mbuo naaic, “Buo hnoi meih haih zoux duqv ziangx nyei? Naaiv norm zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv zoux feix ziepc luoqc hnyangx cingx daaih ziangx.”
Yesu gorngv zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv mv baac za'gengh gorngv beiv ninh ganh nyei sin.
Nqa'haav Yesu daic mingh aengx nangh daaih, ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo jangx zuqc ninh gorngv naaiv joux waac ziouc sienx Ging-Sou yaac sienx Yesu gorngv nyei waac.
Yesu yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh jiex Siex Maengc Zipv. Maaih mienh camv nyei sienx kaux ninh weic zuqc ninh mbuo buatc ninh zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei jangx-hoc.
Mv baac Yesu maiv bungx hnyouv ninh mbuo weic zuqc ninh hiuv duqv maanc mienh.
Yesu maiv qiemx zuqc haaix dauh mbuox ninh baamh mienh hnangv haaix nor, weic zuqc ninh ganh hiuv duqv mienh nyei hnyouv.
Maaih dauh Faa^li^si Mienh, mbuox heuc Ni^ko^nde^matv. Ninh se yietc dauh zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh.

Maaih muonz ninh daaih lorz Yesu gorngv, “Fin-Saeng aah! Yie mbuo hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh paaiv meih daaih zoux Fin-Saeng. Se gorngv maiv zeiz Tin-Hungh caux yiem, maiv maaih haaix dauh haih zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei jangx-hoc hnangv meih zoux.”
Yesu dau, “Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih. Haaix dauh maiv ganh siang-yungz jiex, maiv haih duqv buatc Tin-Hungh nyei guoqv.”
Ni^ko^nde^matv naaic gaax, “Mienh gox nzengc, hnangv haaix nor haih siang-yungz jiex? Maiv haih bieqc maa nyei ga'sie ganh yungz nzunc saah?”
Yesu dau, “Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih. Haaix dauh maiv yiem wuom caux Singx Lingh ganh siang-yungz jiex, wuov dauh maiv duqv bieqc Tin-Hungh nyei guoqv.
Baamh mienh yungz nyei se baamh mienh nyei sin. Singx Lingh yungz nyei se lingh wuonh.
Meih maiv dungx weic yie gorngv, ‘Meih mbuo oix zuqc ganh siang-yungz jiex’ naaiv joux waac hnamv maiv mengh baeqc.

Nziaaux oix buonc haaix, ninh ziouc buonc wuov. Meih haiz nziaaux nyei qiex mv baac maiv hiuv duqv ninh yiem haaix daaih, yaac maiv hiuv duqv oix mingh taux haaix. Singx Lingh bun haaix dauh ganh siang-yungz jiex se hnangv naaiv nor.”
Ni^ko^nde^matv naaic ninh, “Naaiv deix sic fungc haih hnangv naaiv nor?”
Yesu dau, “Meih se zoux dauh I^saa^laa^en Mienh nyei domh fin-saeng, meih corc maiv mengh baeqc naaiv deix sic?
Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih, yie mbuo hiuv nyei, yie mbuo gorngv. Yie mbuo buatc jiex nyei, yie mbuo yaac zoux zorng-zengx. Mv baac meih mbuo maiv sienx yie mbuo zoux nyei zorng-zengx.
Se gorngv yie gorngv baamh gen nyei jauv meih mbuo zungv maiv sienx, yie dorh tin-dorngh nyei jauv daaih gorngv, meih mbuo fungc haih sienx?
Maiv gaengh maaih haaix dauh duqv faaux jiex tin-dorngh cuotv liuz yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, dongh yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih wuov dauh.
“Loz-hnoi Mose yiem deic-bung-huaang hnangv haaix nor zorqv dongh naang an wuov dongc liepc faaux hlang, yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, yaac oix hnangv wuov nor zuqc mienh zorqv liepc faaux hlang,
bun haaix dauh sienx kaux yie ziouc duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc.
“Tin-Hungh ndongc naaic hnamv lungh ndiev mienh cingx zorqv ninh nyei ndoqc Dorn ceix bun ninh mbuo. Haaix dauh sienx kaux Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn maiv zuqc mietc mv baac duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc.
Tin-Hungh paaiv ninh nyei Dorn njiec taux baamh gen maiv zeiz weic dingc baamh mienh nyei zuiz. Kungx oix bun baamh mienh duqv njoux hnangv.

“Haaix dauh sienx kaux Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn, wuov dauh maiv zuqc dingc zuiz. Haaix dauh maiv sienx kaux Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn nor, Tin-Hungh zungv dingc jienv wuov dauh nyei zuiz, laaix ninh maiv sienx kaux Tin-Hungh nyei ndoqc Dorn.
“Siemv zuiz nyei gorn se hnangv naaiv. Njang daaih bieqc baamh gen. Mienh maiv oix longc njang, kungx oix longc hmuangx hnangv, weic zuqc ninh mbuo zoux nyei sic se waaic haic.
Haaix dauh zoux waaic sic, wuov dauh nzorng njang yaac maiv oix mingh lorz njang. Nzauh heix ninh zoux nyei waaic sic oix biux mengh cuotv daaih.
Mv baac haaix dauh ei jienv zien leiz zoux, wuov dauh daaih lorz njang. Njang ziouc bun cing ninh zoux nyei sic se kaux Tin-Hungh zoux.”
Naaiv deix sic cuotv liuz, nqa'haav Yesu caux ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo mingh Yu^ndie Saengv yiem caamx wuov yaac tengx mienh jiex wuom nyei leiz.

Wuov zanc Yo^han yaac tengx mienh jiex wuom nyei leiz. Ninh yiem Aainon Mungv, leih Saax^lim Mungv maiv nangc go, weic zuqc wuov norm dorngx maaih wuom camv. Mienh yaac mingh wuov jiex wuom nyei leiz.
(Wuov zanc Yo^han maiv gaengh zuqc wuonx loh.)
Maaih deix Yo^han nyei sai-gorx caux dauh Yiutai Mienh nzaeng saax uix nyei leiz.

Wuov deix sai-gorx ziouc mingh mbuox Yo^han, “Sai-Diex aah! Meih jangx duqv nyei fai? Zinh ndaangc caux meih yiem Jor^ndaen Ndaaih nyei dong bung maengx, dongh meih zoux zorng-zengx gorngv mbuox jiex yie mbuo wuov laanh mienh. Ih zanc ninh tengx mienh jiex wuom nyei leiz. Zuangx mienh kungx mingh lorz ninh hnangv aqv.”
Yo^han dau, “Maiv zeiz Tin-Hungh bun nor, maiv maaih haaix dauh haih duqv haaix nyungc.
Meih mbuo ganh haih tengx yie zoux zorng-zengx, hiuv duqv yie gorngv jiex, ‘Yie maiv zeiz zoux Giduc wuov dauh. Mv baac Giduc maiv gaengh daaih, Tin-Hungh paaiv yie daaih ndaangc.’

Longc siang-mbuangz wuov dauh m'daaih siang-laangh. Kaeqv-lorngh zuov jienv muangx siang-laangh nyei qiex. Yietv haiz siang-laangh gorngv waac ninh ziouc njien-youh haic. Weic naaiv yie ih zanc duqv naaiv nyungc orn-lorqc taux daauh aqv.
“Ninh oix zuqc zoux hlo jienv faaux, yie oix zuqc zoux faix jienv njiec.

“Yiem tin-dorngh daaih wuov dauh zoux gauh hlo jiex yietc zungv. Yiem baamh gen daaih wuov dauh guei baamh gen, yaac gorngv baamh gen nyei jauv hnangv. Mv baac yiem tin-dorngh daaih wuov dauh zoux gauh hlo jiex yietc zungv.
Ninh zoux zorng-zengx gorngv ninh buatc jiex, haiz jiex nyei sic mv baac maiv maaih haaix dauh zipv ninh nyei waac.
Haaix dauh zipv ninh nyei waac se hnangv nqaapv jienv yienx nor, bun cing Tin-Hungh se zien nyei.
Tin-Hungh paaiv daaih wuov dauh gorngv Tin-Hungh nyei waac, weic zuqc Tin-Hungh ceix Singx Lingh bun ninh, yaac maiv maaih soux mouc.
Zaangc Diex hnamv ninh nyei Dorn, zorqv maanc muotc jiu bun yiem ninh nyei buoz-ndiev.

Haaix dauh sienx kaux Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn, wuov dauh maaih yietc liuz nyei maengc. Mv baac haaix dauh maiv muangx Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn nyei waac nor, maiv haih duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc yaac zuqc Tin-Hungh dingc jienv ninh nyei zuiz.”
Faa^li^si Mienh haiz gorngv Yesu duqv sai-gorx gauh camv yaac tengx sai-gorx jiex wuom nyei leiz gauh camv Yo^han.
Mv baac zien sic se maiv zeiz Yesu tengx mienh jiex wuom nyei leiz. Kungx ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo tengx hnangv.
Yesu hiuv duqv mienh hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, ninh ziouc cuotv Yu^ndie Saengv aengx nzuonx Gaa^li^li.
Ninh haiz hnangv haaix oix zuqc yangh Saa^maa^lie Saengv nzuonx.
Gan Saa^maa^lie Saengv mingh gau, taux norm mungv heuc Sikaa, leih Yaakopv bun ninh nyei dorn, Yosepv, wuov nzong ndau maiv go.
Yaakopv nyei wuom-kuotv yaac yiem wuov norm dorngx. Yesu yangh gau jauv, kouv haic, ziouc zueiz njiec wuom-kuotv hlen. Wuov zanc lungh aav lamh deix aanx aqv.
Maaih dauh Saa^maa^lie Janx-muangz mingh wuov wuom-kuotv zaangh wuom. Yesu gorngv mbuox ninh, “Dorc aac, tov meih bun deix wuom yie hopv oc.”
(Doix jienv wuov norm ziangh hoc sai-gorx mbuo bieqc mungv maaiz ga'naaiv nyanc.)
Wuov dauh Saa^maa^lie muangz gorngv, “Meih Yiutai Mienh fungc tov yie Saa^maa^lie m'sieqv dorn bun wuom meih hopv?” (Weic zuqc Yiutai Mienh maiv caux Saa^maa^lie Janx jiu tong.)

Yesu dau, “Se gorngv meih hiuv duqv Tin-Hungh bun nyei zingh nyeic, yaac hiuv duqv tengx meih tov wuom hopv se dongh haaix dauh, meih ziouc tov ninh, ninh yaac oix bun yungz maengc nyei wuom meih hopv.”
Wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn gorngv, “Domh Gorx aah! Meih liemh maiv maaih haaix nyungc cie wuom. Wuom-kuotv yaac ndo nyei. Yungz maengc nyei wuom meih mingh haaix lorz daaih?

Yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix-ngaeqv, Yaakopv, zorqv naaiv norm wuom-kuotv liouh yie mbuo longc. Ninh ganh caux ninh nyei dorn-jueiv, saeng-kuv yietc zungv yaac hopv naaiv norm wuom-kuotv nyei wuom. Meih zoux gauh hlo jiex Yaakopv fai?”
Yesu dau, “Haaix dauh hopv naaiv norm wuom-kuotv nyei wuom, nqa'haav jaang aengx haih nqaatv nyei.

Mv baac haaix dauh hopv yie bun nyei wuom, jaang yietc liuz maiv haih nqaatv. Yie oix bun wuov nyungc wuom yiem ninh nyei hnyouv hnangv yietc zingv wuom baetv cuotv daaih nor, bun ninh duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc.”
Wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn aengx gorngv, “Domh Gorx aah! Tov bun deix naaic nyungc wuom yie hopv maah! Yie ziouc yietc liuz jaang maiv nqaatv yaac maiv zuqc daaih naaiv zaangh wuom.”
Yesu mbuox ninh, “Nzuonx mingh heuc meih nyei nqox caux jienv daaih naaiv maah!”
Wuov dauh Janx-muangz dau, “Yie maiv maaih nqox.” Yesu gorngv, “Meih gorngv maiv maaih nqox gengh zeiz nyei.
Meih longc jiex biaa torngx nqox mi'aqv. Ih zanc longc jienv naaiv dauh yaac maiv zeiz meih nyei nqox. Meih nyei waac gengh zien nyei.”
Janx-muangz gorngv, “Domh Gorx aah! Yie buatc meih zoux dauh douc waac mienh.
Yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix yiem naaiv norm mbong zaangc Tin-Hungh, mv baac meih mbuo Yiutai Mienh gorngv horpc zuqc yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh zaangc Tin-Hungh.”
Yesu gorngv mbuox ninh, “Dorc aah! Sienx yie nyei waac maah! Ziangh hoc oix taux, meih mbuo maiv yiem naaiv norm mbong yaac maiv yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem baaix Zaangc Diex.
Meih mbuo Saa^maa^lie Mienh maiv hiuv duqv meih mbuo zaangc haaix dauh. Mv baac yie mbuo Yiutai Mienh zaangc haaix dauh yie mbuo hiuv nyei, weic zuqc njoux en yiem Yiutai Mienh daaih.

Wuov norm ziangh hoc oix taux, zungv taux daaih aqv. Zien-zien buoqc zaangc Zaangc Diex wuov deix, oix longc Singx Lingh yaac longc zien leiz zaangc, weic zuqc Zaangc Diex lorz naaiv nyungc mienh zaangc ninh.
Tin-Hungh se Singx Lingh. Zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei mienh oix zuqc longc Singx Lingh caux zien leiz zaangc.”
Wuov dauh Janx-muangz gorngv mbuox ninh, “Yie hiuv duqv Me^si^yaa, dongh mbuox heuc Giduc wuov dauh, oix daaih. Taux daaih wuov zanc ninh zungv oix mbuox nzengc nyungc-nyungc yie mbuo.”
Yesu gorngv, “Dongh ih zanc caux meih gorngv jienv waac naaiv dauh se dongh wuov dauh aqv.”

Wuov zanc sai-gorx mbuo nzuonx daaih buatc Yesu caux wuov dauh Janx-muangz gorngv waac ziouc hnamv maiv mengh baeqc. Mv baac maiv maaih haaix dauh naaic wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn, “Meih daaih lorz haaix nyungc?” fai naaic Yesu, “Zoux haaix nyungc caux ninh gorngv waac?”
Wuov dauh Janx-muangz ziouc guangc jienv ninh nyei nie-ha'louh wuov, nzuonx mungv mingh mbuox yiem mungv nyei mienh,
“Meih mbuo daaih mangc gaax, maaih dauh mienh ninh gorngv nzengc yie zoux jiex nyei nyungc-nyungc sic. Naaiv dauh maiv zeiz Giduc fai?”
Zuangx mienh ziouc cuotv mungv mingh mangc Yesu.
Janx-muangz nzuonx mingh wuov zanc, sai-gorx mbuo heuc Yesu, “Sai-Diex aah! Nyanc hnaangx aqv.”
Mv baac Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Nyanc hopv yie maaih nyei. Dongh yie maaih nyei wuov nyungc nyanc hopv meih mbuo maiv hiuv.”
Sai-gorx mbuo laanh naaic laanh, “Maaih mienh dorh hnaangx daaih bun ninh nyanc fai ni?”
Yesu dau, “Yie nyei nyanc hopv se yie ei jienv paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh nyei za'eix zoux, yaac zoux ziangx ninh nyei gong.
Meih mbuo maaih joux waac gorngv, ‘Aengx maaih biei hlaax nyieqc siou gaeng-zuangx nyei ziangh hoc taux aqv.’ Yie mbuox meih mbuo longx-longx nyei mangc wuov ndeic. Cun-gaeng zuoqc, siou duqv aqv.
Ih zanc siou gaeng-zuangx nyei mienh duqv ninh mbuo nyei gong-zinh yaac siou gaeng-zuangx weic bun duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc. Zuangx nyei mienh caux siou nyei mienh ziouc lomh nzoih a'hneiv.
Weic zuqc mienh gorngv, ‘Maaih dauh zuangx, maaih dauh siou,’ wuov joux waac za'gengh zien.
Yie paaiv meih mbuo mingh siou dongh meih mbuo maiv ndortv qaqv zuangx nyei. Ganh dauh ndortv qaqv zuangx mv baac meih mbuo baeqc baeqc duqv ninh nyei qaqv.”
Wuov norm mungv nyei Saa^maa^lie Mienh camv nyei sienx Yesu weic zuqc wuov dauh Saa^maa^lie Janx-muangz zoux zorng-zengx gorngv, “Ninh gorngv cuotv nzengc yie zoux jiex nyei nyungc-nyungc sic.”
Hnangv naaic, Saa^maa^lie Mienh daaih lorz Yesu wuov zanc, ninh mbuo tov Yesu caux ninh mbuo yiem wuov. Yesu ziouc caux ninh mbuo yiem i hnoi.
Weic Yesu gorngv nyei waac aengx maaih mienh camv nyei sienx ninh.

Naaiv deix mienh gorngv mbuox wuov dauh m'sieqv dorn, “Ih zanc yie mbuo maiv zeiz weic meih gorngv nyei waac sienx. Yie mbuo ganh haiz ninh gorngv yaac hiuv duqv naaiv laanh mienh za'gengh zoux baamh mienh nyei Njoux Ziouv.”
Jiex liuz wuov deix i hnoi, Yesu cuotv jauv mingh Gaa^li^li Saengv.
Yesu ganh gorngv jiex, “Douc waac mienh yiem ganh nyei deic-bung, ganh nyei mienh maiv taaih ninh.”
Taux Gaa^li^li Saengv, Gaa^li^li Mienh zipv ninh, weic zuqc ninh mbuo yaac mingh Ye^lu^saa^lem jiex Siex Maengc Zipv ziouc duqv buatc Yesu zoux nyei yietc zungv sic.

Yesu aengx nzuonx Gaa^li^li Saengv, Kaanaa Laangz, dongh zinh ndaangc ninh longc wuom zoux benx a'ngunc diuv wuov norm laangz. Maaih dauh hungh nyei domh jien, ninh nyei dorn yiem Kaa^be^naa^um Mungv butv baengc mi'aqv.
Domh jien haiz gorngv Yesu yiem Yu^ndie Saengv daaih taux Gaa^li^li, ninh ziouc mingh lorz, tov Yesu mingh Kaa^be^naa^um zorc ninh nyei dorn. Ninh nyei dorn butv baengc oix daic haic aqv.
Yesu gorngv mbuox ninh, “Se gorngv meih mbuo maiv duqv buatc yie zoux jangx-hoc caux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic, meih mbuo zungv maiv sienx yie.”
Domh jien gorngv, “Domh Gorx aah! Tov meih gan yie mingh maah! Nzauh heix yie nyei dorn haih daic.”
Yesu gorngv, “Meih gunv nzuonx aqv. Meih nyei dorn longx aqv.” Wuov dauh jien sienx Yesu nyei waac ziouc nzuonx mi'aqv.
Nzuonx gau, buatc ninh nyei bou mbuo daaih mbuox ninh, “Ih zanc meih nyei dorn longx mi'aqv.”
Ninh naaic ninh nyei bou, “Yie nyei dorn ziangh haaix longx?” Ninh mbuo dau, “A'hnoi nqa'haav aanx yietc norm ziangh hoc sin laangh mi'aqv.”
Wuov dauh dorn nyei die ziouc jangx zuqc za'gengh doix Yesu gorngv mbuox ninh, “Meih nyei dorn longx aqv,” wuov norm ziangh hoc. Ninh caux ninh nyei yietc biauv mienh ziouc sienx Yesu nzengc.
Naaiv se Yesu yiem Yu^ndie Saengv mingh Gaa^li^li Saengv zoux da'nyeic nzunc mbuoqc horngh haic nyei jangx-hoc.
Nqa'haav Yesu mingh Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh jiex Yiutai Mienh nyei yietc norm zipv.
Yiem Ye^lu^saa^lem maaih dauh gaengh heuc Ba'gi Yungh Gaengh. Gaengh ga'hlen maaih norm wuom-domh, Hipv^lu waac heuc Mbetc^saa^taa. Wuom-domh hlen yaac maaih biaa norm bingx laangh nyei liuh.
Butv-baengc mienh camv nyei bueix wuov. M'zing maengh, m'zing mbuov yaac maaih, zaux waaic nyei yaac maaih, butv baengc-mbai maiv haih dongz nyei yaac maaih. Ninh mbuo zuov wuom dongz,

weic zuqc maaih deix ziangh hoc maaih dauh Ziouv nyei fin-mienh njiec daaih muoqv wuom dongz. Wuom dongz liuz, haaix dauh njiec mingh ziemx ndaangc, maiv gunv butv haaix nyungc baengc, baengc ziouc longx nzengc aqv.
Yiem wuov maaih dauh mienh butv faah ziepc betv hnyangx baengc.
Yesu buatc ninh bueix wuov yaac hiuv duqv ninh butv baengc lauh haic, ziouc naaic gaax ninh, “Meih oix baengc longx nyei fai?”
Wuov dauh baengc mienh dau, “Domh Gorx aac, wuom dongz nyei ziangh hoc maiv maaih haaix dauh dorh yie njiec wuom. Yie ganh mingh maiv gaengh taux, mienh bieqc ndaangc mi'aqv.”
Yesu gorngv mbuox ninh, “Jiez sin daaih, dorh jienv meih nyei jiuc yangh jauv mingh aqv.”
Wuov dauh mienh liemh zeih longx daaih ziouc dorh jienv ninh nyei jiuc yangh jauv mingh mi'aqv. Wuov hnoi se doix zuqc Dingh Gong Hnoi.
Yiutai Mienh ziouc gorngv mbuox baengc longx wuov dauh, “Dingh Gong Hnoi meih dorh jienv jiuc mingh haaix ndau se dorngc mbuo nyei leiz.”
Ninh dau, “Zorc yie longx wuov dauh mienh heuc yie dorh jienv jiuc yangh jauv mingh aqv.”
Wuov deix mienh aengx naaic ninh, “Heuc meih dorh jienv jiuc mingh wuov dauh se haaix dauh?”
Mv baac baengc longx wuov dauh mienh maiv hiuv duqv zorc ninh longx wuov dauh dongh haaix dauh, weic zuqc mienh camv haic, Yesu yaac leih nqoi mingh mi'aqv.

Nqa'haav Yesu aengx buatc ninh zorc longx wuov dauh mienh yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv ziouc gorngv mbuox ninh, “Mangc gaax, meih nyei baengc zorc longx nzengc. Yangh naaiv jiex maiv dungx baamz zuiz aqv oc. Nziex meih aengx haih buangh gauh kouv jiex nyei naanc zingh.”
Wuov dauh mienh nzuonx mingh gorngv mbuox zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh, “Zorc yie longx wuov dauh se dongh Yesu.”
Weic zuqc Yesu longc Dingh Gong Hnoi zoux naaiv deix sic, Yiutai Mienh cingx daaih zoux doqc ninh.
Mv baac Yesu gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Yie nyei Die zanc-zanc zoux gong taux ih zanc. Yie yaac zoux gong aqv.”

Yesu hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh gauh fatv oix daix ninh, weic zuqc ninh maiv daan dorngc Dingh Gong Hnoi nyei leiz hnangv. Ninh yaac gorngv Tin-Hungh zoux ninh nyei Die, ziouc taaih ninh ganh caux Tin-Hungh fih ndongc hlo.

Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, Zaangc Diex nyei Dorn maiv haih sueih ganh nyei hnyouv zoux haaix nyungc. Dorn buatc Die zoux haaix nyungc, ninh ziouc kungx zoux wuov nyungc hnangv. Die zoux haaix nyungc, ninh nyei Dorn ziouc zoux wuov nyungc.

Zaangc Diex hnamv ninh nyei Dorn, ziouc zorqv ganh zoux nyei yietc zungv sic bun ninh nyei Dorn mangc. Ninh zungv oix zoux gauh hlo naaiv deix sic bun ninh nyei Dorn mangc, meih mbuo ziouc mbuoqc horngh haic.
Zaangc Diex hnangv haaix nor bun daic mingh nyei mienh nangh daaih ziangh jienv, ninh nyei Dorn yaac hnangv wuov nor bun dongh ninh oix bun wuov deix duqv ziangh jienv.
Zaangc Diex ganh maiv siemv haaix dauh nyei zuiz. Ninh zorqv lingc jiu bun ninh nyei Dorn siemv yietc zungv zuiz,
weic bun mienh taaih ninh nyei Dorn hnangv ninh mbuo taaih Zaangc Diex nor. Haaix dauh maiv taaih ninh nyei Dorn, wuov dauh maiv taaih Zaangc Diex, dongh paaiv ninh nyei Dorn daaih wuov dauh.

“Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, haaix dauh muangx yie nyei waac yaac sienx kaux paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh, ziouc duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc, yaac maiv zuqc dingc zuiz. Ninh biaux ndutv daic nyei jauv duqv ziangh maengc.
Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, ziangh hoc oix taux, zungv taux aqv, daic mingh nyei mienh haiz Tin-Hungh nyei Dorn nyei qiex, ziouc nangh daaih ziangh jienv.
Zaangc Diex hnangv haaix nor zoux ziangh maengc nyei gorn-nyuonh, ninh yaac jiu bun ninh nyei Dorn hnangv wuov nor zoux ziangh maengc nyei gorn-nyuonh.
Zaangc Diex yaac bun ninh nyei Dorn maaih lingc siemv zuiz weic zuqc ninh nyei Dorn zoux Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn.
“Meih mbuo maiv dungx weic naaiv deix sic hnamv maiv mengh baeqc. Ziangh hoc oix taux, yiem zouv nyei yietc zungv duqv haiz ninh nyei qiex
ziouc yiem zouv cuotv daaih. Zoux longx wuov deix duqv nangh daaih ziangh jienv. Zoux waaic wuov deix nangh daaih zuqc dingc zuiz.

“Yie maiv haih ei yie ganh nyei hnyouv zoux haaix nyungc. Tin-Hungh hnangv haaix nor mbuox yie, yie ziouc hnangv wuov nor siemv. Yie yaac baengh fim nyei siemv, weic zuqc yie maiv zeiz oix ei yie ganh nyei eix zoux. Kungx oix ei paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh nyei eix hnangv.
Se gorngv yie weic yie ganh zoux zorng-zengx, mienh ziouc funx maiv zien.
Mv baac aengx maaih dauh tengx yie zoux zorng-zengx. Yie hiuv duqv ninh nyei zorng-zengx waac za'gengh zien nyei.
“Meih mbuo paaiv mienh mingh Yo^han wuov, ninh yaac weic zien leiz zoux zorng-zengx.
Yie maiv zeiz qiemx zuqc mienh tengx yie zoux zorng-zengx. Yie kungx hnangv naaiv nor gorngv weic bun meih mbuo duqv njoux hnangv.
Yo^han beiv norm dang, diemv zieqc njang nyei. Meih mbuo yaac njien-youh a'hneiv yiem caamx ninh nyei njang.

“Yie yaac maaih nyungc zoux zorng-zengx gauh hlo jiex Yo^han zoux nyei. Se dongh Zaangc Diex paaiv yie zoux ziangx nyei nyungc-nyungc gong. Se ih zanc yie zoux jienv naaiv deix gong bun cing Zaangc Diex ganh paaiv yie daaih.
Zaangc Diex paaiv yie daaih, ninh ganh yaac tengx yie zoux zorng-zengx. Mv baac meih mbuo maiv haiz jiex ninh nyei qiex yaac maiv buatc jiex ninh nyei fangx zeiv.
Meih mbuo nyei hnyouv maiv zaangh ninh nyei waac, weic zuqc meih mbuo maiv sienx ninh paaiv daaih wuov dauh.
Meih mbuo qaqv zaah Ging-Sou, laaic Ging-Sou haih tengx meih mbuo duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc. Naaiv Ging-Sou tengx yie zoux zorng-zengx
mv baac meih mbuo maiv kangv daaih lorz yie duqv ziangh maengc.
“Yie maiv zeiz lorz mienh ceng yie.
Yie hiuv duqv meih mbuo, yaac hiuv duqv yiem meih mbuo nyei hnyouv meih mbuo maiv hnamv Tin-Hungh.
Yie ndaam yie nyei Die nyei mengh daaih mv baac meih mbuo maiv zipv yie. Se gorngv maaih dauh ndaam jienv ninh ganh nyei mengh daaih, meih mbuo oix zipv ninh nyei.
Meih mbuo a'hneiv duqv mienh ceng, mv baac meih mbuo maiv lorz nduqc dauh wuov dauh Tin-Hungh ceng meih mbuo. Wuov nyungc meih mbuo hnangv haaix nor haih sienx yie?
“Meih mbuo maiv dungx hnamv yie oix yiem Zaangc Diex nyei nza'hmien gox meih mbuo. Oix gox meih mbuo wuov dauh se Mose, dongh meih mbuo maaih lamh hnamv wuov dauh.
Se gorngv meih mbuo za'gengh sienx Mose, meih mbuo ziouc sienx yie, weic zuqc ninh fiev nyei gorngv taux yie.
Mv baac meih mbuo maiv sienx Mose fiev nyei nor, meih mbuo hnangv haaix nor haih sienx yie nyei waac?”
Nqa'haav Yesu jiex wuov ngaanc ziqc Gaa^li^li Koiv-Dorn (aengx maaih ganh norm mbuox heuc Ti^mbe^lietv).
Mienh camv nyei gan jienv ninh mingh weic zuqc ninh mbuo buatc ninh zoux jiex mbuoqc horngh nyei sic zorc longx butv-baengc mienh.
Yesu ziouc faaux mbong-aiv mingh caux ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo zueiz jienv wuov.
Wuov zanc aav lamh deix taux Yiutai Mienh jiex Siex Maengc Zipv aqv.
Yesu cau hmien mangc, buatc mienh camv nyei daaih ninh wuov ziouc naaic gaax Filipv, “Mbuo oix zuqc mingh haaix maaiz ga'naaiv gaux bun naaiv deix zuangx mienh nyanc?”
Yesu kungx hnangv naaiv nor naaic weic seix Filipv. Ninh ganh oix hnangv haaix nor zoux ninh zungv hiuv mi'aqv.
Filipv dau, “Longc nyic baeqv hnoi nyei gong-zinh maaiz nyanc nyei ga'naaiv zungv maiv gaux yietc dauh duqv diqv dien.”
Maaih dauh Yesu nyei sai-gorx, dongh Simon Bide nyei youz, An^ndaa^lu, gorngv,
“Yiem naaiv maaih dauh dorn maaih biaa norm longc mbiauh mbaali zoux daaih nyei njuov caux i dauh mbiauz. Mv baac mienh ndongc naaic camv hnangv haaix nor haih bun duqv nqoi?”
Yesu gorngv, “Mbuox zuangx mienh zueiz njiec maah!” Wuov deix dorngx miev camv nyei. Zuangx mienh ziouc zueiz njiec. Daan m'jangc dorn maaih leih maiv go biaa cin dauh.

Yesu ziouc zorqv wuov deix njuov daaih daux gaux, laengz zingh liuz Tin-Hungh, ziouc bun nqoi zueiz jienv wuov deix zuangx mienh nyanc. Mbiauz yaac fih hnangv nyei bun nqoi, ziux gorqv-mienh oix camv fai zoqc.
Zuangx mienh ziouc nyanc beuv nzengc. Yesu mbuox ninh nyei sai-gorx mbuo, “Mingh siou nyanc zengc wuov deix daaih, maiv dungx guangc yietc aax.”
Dongh wuov deix biaa norm njuov zuangx mienh nyanc beuv nzengc, mv baac sai-gorx mbuo aengx siou zengc wuov deix dapv buangv ziepc nyeic norm ndaan.
Zuangx mienh buatc Yesu zoux naaiv nyungc mbuoqc horngh nyei sic, ninh mbuo gorngv, “Naaiv se oix daaih taux baamh gen wuov dauh Douc Waac Mienh aqv.”
Yesu hiuv duqv mienh oix daaih zorqv ninh, aapv ninh zoux hungh, ninh ganh ziouc simv nqoi aengx faaux wuov jiex mbong mi'aqv.
Lungh maanz-hmuangx deix, Yesu nyei sai-gorx mbuo njiec taux koiv-hlen,
bieqc nzangv hungx jienv mingh wuov ngaanc ziqc koiv, Kaa^be^naa^um Mungv. Wuov zanc, zungv hmuangx aqv. Yesu yaac maiv gaengh taux ninh mbuo wuov.
Wuov zanc borngz gorng domh nziaaux buonc koiv jiez laangc.
Sai-gorx mbuo nzaeng nzangv mingh biaa juqv gilo nyei dorngx, buatc Yesu yangh wuom-minc daaih nitv fatv ninh mbuo nyei nzangv, haeqv ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic.
Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Maiv dungx gamh nziex. Se dongh yie aqv.”
Sai-gorx mbuo ziouc a'hneiv zipv ninh bieqc nzangv. Nzangv liemh zeih taux ninh mbuo oix mingh wuov norm dorngx mi'aqv.

Da'nyeic hnoi corc yiem wuov ngaanc ziqc koiv wuov deix zuangx mienh hiuv duqv yiem wuov kungx maaih nduqc poux nzangv hnangv. Yesu yaac maiv zeiz caux ninh nyei sai-gorx bieqc wuov poux nzangv, kungx sai-gorx mbuo ganh mingh hnangv.
Maaih deix nzangv yiem Ti^mbe^lietv Mungv daaih dingh jienv wuov koiv-hlen, nitv Ziouv zorqv njuov laengz zingh liuz Tin-Hungh ziouc bun zuangx mienh nyanc wuov norm dorngx.
Zuangx mienh buatc Yesu caux sai-gorx mbuo maiv yiem naaic, ninh mbuo ziouc bieqc wuov deix nzangv mingh Kaa^be^naa^um Mungv lorz Yesu.
Zuangx mienh lorz buatc Yesu yiem wuov ngaanc ziqc koiv ninh mbuo naaic, “Fin-Saeng aah! Ziangh haaix daaih taux naaiv?”
Yesu dau, “Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, meih mbuo lorz yie maiv zeiz laaix buatc yie zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei jangx-hoc, se weic zuqc meih mbuo duqv njuov nyanc beuv.

Meih mbuo maiv dungx cuotv qaqv lorz haih waaic nyei nyanc hopv. Oix zuqc lorz bun mienh duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc wuov nyungc nyanc hopv. Yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, oix bun naaiv nyungc nyanc hopv meih mbuo, weic zuqc yie nyei Die, Tin-Hungh, jiu hatc maaz bun yie, hnangv mborqv jienv yienx nor, bun cing yie horpc nzengc ninh nyei hnyouv.”
Ninh mbuo ziouc naaic Yesu, “Yie mbuo oix zuqc zoux haaix nyungc cingx funx Tin-Hungh nyei gong?”
Yesu dau, “Tin-Hungh oix meih mbuo zoux nyei gong se oix zuqc sienx ninh paaiv daaih wuov dauh.”
Ninh mbuo ziouc mbuox Yesu, “Wuov nyungc meih oix zoux haaix nyungc mbuoqc horngh nyei jangx-hoc bun yie mbuo buatc ziouc haih sienx meih? Meih oix hnangv haaix nor zoux?
Yie mbuo nyei ong-taaix yiem deic-bung-huaang duqv nyanc maa^naa hnangv Ging-Sou fiev jienv gorngv, ‘Ninh bun yiem lungh daaih nyei nyanc hopv ninh mbuo nyanc.’+”
Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, se maiv zeiz Mose bun yiem lungh daaih wuov nyungc zien nyanc hopv. Se yie nyei Die zorqv yiem lungh nyei zien nyanc hopv jiu bun meih mbuo.
Weic zuqc Tin-Hungh nyei nyanc hopv se dongh yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih bun baamh mienh duqv ziangh jienv wuov dauh.”
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Fin-Saeng aah! Tov zanc-zanc bun naaiv nyungc nyanc hopv yie mbuo maah!”
Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Yie ganh se yungz maengc nyei nyanc hopv. Haaix dauh daaih lorz yie, wuov dauh yietc liuz maiv ngorc. Haaix dauh sienx yie, wuov dauh yietc liuz maiv nqaatv.
Mv baac hnangv yie mbuox jiex meih mbuo nor, meih mbuo buatc jiex yie yaac maiv sienx.
Da'faanh yie nyei Die ceix bun yie nyei mienh yietc zungv oix daaih lorz yie. Haaix dauh daaih lorz yie, yie yietc liuz maiv guangc.
Weic zuqc yie yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih mv baac maiv zeiz sueih yie ganh nyei eix zoux. Yie daaih zoux ei paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh nyei eix hnangv.

Paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh nyei eix se hnangv naaiv. Dongh ninh ceix bun yie wuov deix mienh, ninh maiv oix yie bun laaih zitc yietc dauh. Taux nqa'haav laai wuov hnoi, oix yie bun ninh mbuo yietc zungv nangh daaih.

Weic zuqc yie nyei Die nyei eix se hnangv naaiv. Haaix dauh buatc ninh nyei Dorn, yaac sienx kaux ninh nyei Dorn, wuov dauh ziouc duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc. Taux nqa'haav laai wuov hnoi yie yaac oix bun ninh nangh daaih.”
Yiutai Mienh ziouc ngopv Yesu weic zuqc ninh gorngv, “Yie se yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih nyei nyanc hopv.”
Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Naaiv dauh se Yosepv nyei dorn, Yesu, maiv zeiz? Ninh nyei diex maac mbuo hiuv duqv nyei. Ninh hnangv haaix nor haih gorngv ninh yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih?”
Yesu dau ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo maiv dungx ngih ngungx ngopv nyei maah!

Maiv maaih haaix dauh haih daaih lorz yie cuotv liuz Zaangc Diex, dongh paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh, yuoqc ninh daaih. Haaix dauh daaih lorz yie, taux nqa'haav laai wuov hnoi yie ziouc bun ninh nangh daaih.
Douc Waac Mienh nyei Sou fiev jienv gorngv, ‘Tin-Hungh ganh oix njaaux ninh mbuo yietc zungv.’ Haaix dauh haiz Zaangc Diex nyei waac yaac hoqc hiuv nyei, ninh mbuo yietc zungv oix daaih lorz yie.
Naaiv maiv zeiz gorngv maaih haaix dauh duqv buatc jiex Zaangc Diex. Kungx yiem Tin-Hungh daaih wuov dauh duqv buatc jiex Zaangc Diex hnangv.
Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, haaix dauh sienx yie, wuov dauh maaih yietc liuz nyei maengc.
Yie zoux yungz maengc nyei nyanc hopv.
Meih mbuo nyei ong-taaix-ngaeqv yiem deic-bung-huaang nyanc maa^naa mv baac ninh mbuo daic mi'aqv.
Haaix dauh nyanc yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih nyei nyanc hopv maiv zuqc daic.

Yie zoux ziangh jienv nyei nyanc hopv yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih. Haaix dauh nyanc naaiv nyungc nyanc hopv, wuov dauh duqv yietc liuz ziangh jienv. Yie bun nyei nyanc hopv se dongh yie ganh nyei orv weic bun baamh mienh duqv ziangh jienv.”
Yiutai Mienh haiz naaiv deix waac ziouc nzaeng jiez jaax daaih gorngv, “Naaiv laanh mienh hnangv haaix nor haih bun ninh nyei orv mbuo nyanc?”

Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Yie gorngv zien mbuox meih mbuo, se gorngv meih mbuo maiv nyanc Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn nyei orv, yaac maiv hopv ninh nyei nziaamv, yiem meih mbuo gu'nyuoz maiv maaih ziangh maengc aqv.
Haaix dauh nyanc yie nyei orv, hopv yie nyei nziaamv, wuov dauh maaih yietc liuz nyei maengc. Nqa'haav laai wuov hnoi yie yaac oix bun ninh nangh daaih.
Weic zuqc yie nyei orv caux yie nyei nziaamv se zien nyanc hopv.
Haaix dauh nyanc yie nyei orv yaac hopv yie nyei nziaamv, wuov dauh caux yie juangc maengc ziangh. Yie yaac caux wuov dauh juangc maengc ziangh.
Ziangh jienv nyei Zaangc Diex paaiv yie daaih, yie yaac weic ninh duqv ziangh jienv. Hnangv naaic, haaix dauh nyanc yie nyei orv, wuov dauh yaac weic yie duqv ziangh jienv.

Naaiv se yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih nyei nyanc hopv. Se maiv hnangv mbuo nyei ong-taaix nyanc nyei maa^naa. Nyanc liuz corc haih daic nyei. Mv baac haaix dauh nyanc yiem tin-dorngh njiec daaih nyei nyanc hopv ziouc duqv yietc liuz ziangh jienv.”
Yesu gorngv naaiv deix waac wuov zanc ninh yiem Kaa^be^naa^um Mungv nyei wuic dorngh njaaux mienh.
Yesu nyei sai-gorx camv nyei haiz liuz naaiv deix waac ziouc gorngv, “Naaiv deix njaaux nyei waac za'gengh aqc duqv haic. Haaix dauh haih muangx duqv laeh?”
Yesu hiuv duqv ninh nyei sai-gorx hnangv naaiv nor ngopv naaiv deix waac ziouc gorngv mbuox ninh mbuo, “Laaix yie gorngv naaiv deix waac meih mbuo haiz oix tuix bouc fai?
Wuov nyungc se gorngv meih mbuo buatc yie, Baamh Mienh nyei Dorn, faaux taux zinh ndaangc yiem nyei dorngx, meih mbuo hnangv haaix nor?

Se Singx Lingh bun mienh maaih ziangh maengc. Baamh mienh maiv haih bun mienh maaih ziangh maengc. Yie gorngv nyei waac haih bun meih mbuo duqv Singx Lingh. Singx Lingh yaac bun meih mbuo duqv ziangh maengc.
Mv baac meih mbuo maaih deix maiv sienx.” Weic zuqc Yesu yiem gorn m'daaih hiuv duqv wuov deix mienh haaix dauh maiv sienx ninh, haaix dauh oix maaic ninh.
Ninh ziouc gorngv, “Weic naaiv yie gorngv jiex mbuox meih mbuo nyei, cuotv liuz Zaangc Diex bun daaih wuov deix, maiv maaih haaix dauh haih daaih lorz yie.”
Yiem naaic daaih Yesu nyei sai-gorx camv nyei tuix bouc, maiv gan Yesu aqv.
Yesu ziouc naaic gaax wuov deix ziepc nyeic dauh sai-gorx, “Meih mbuo yaac oix guangc yie fai?”
Simon Bide dau, “Ziouv aah! Yie mbuo oix zuqc mingh gan haaix dauh? Se dongh meih ganh nyei waac haih bun mienh duqv yietc liuz nyei maengc.
Yie mbuo sienx yaac hiuv duqv meih zoux Tin-Hungh nyei Cing-Nzengc Mienh.”
Yesu dau, “Yie ginv meih mbuo ziepc nyeic dauh maiv zeiz? Mv baac meih mbuo maaih dauh zoux hieh guaiv mienv.”
Yesu hnangv naaiv nor gorngv se gorngv zuqc Simon I^saa^kaa^li^otc nyei dorn, Yu^ndaatc. Maiv gunv ninh zoux wuov deix ziepc nyeic dauh sai-gorx nyei yietc dauh, nqa'haav ninh maaic Yesu.
Nqa'haav Yesu youh jienv Gaa^li^li Saengv mingh. Ninh dingc hnyouv maiv mingh Yu^ndie Saengv weic zuqc ninh hiuv duqv yiem wuov zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh oix lorz qangx daix ninh.
Wuov zanc aav lamh taux Mbiorv Liuh nyei Zipv aqv.
Yesu nyei youz mbuo ziouc gorngv mbuox ninh, “Gorx aah! Meih cuotv naaiv norm dorngx mingh Yu^ndie Saengv maah! Oix zuqc bun meih nyei sai-gorx mbuo buatc meih zoux mbuoqc horngh nyei sic.
Haaix dauh oix duqv mengh dauh, ninh maiv bingx ninh zoux nyei sic. Meih zoux jienv naaiv deix sic, oix zuqc mingh bun lungh ndiev mienh mangc meih maah!”
Liemh Yesu ganh nyei youz mbuo yaac maiv sienx ninh.
Yesu mbuox ninh mbuo, “Yie nyei ziangh hoc maiv gaengh taux, mv baac meih mbuo haaix norm ziangh hoc yaac mingh duqv nyei.
Baamh mienh maiv maaih dorngx nzorng meih mbuo mv baac ninh mbuo nzorng yie, weic zuqc yie zoux zorng-zengx gorngv ninh mbuo zoux nyei waaic sic.
Meih mbuo gunv mingh jiex Zipv aqv. Yie maiv gaengh mingh weic zuqc yie horpc zuqc mingh nyei ziangh hoc maiv gaengh taux.”
Yesu caux ninh mbuo hnangv naaiv nor gorngv liuz, ninh corc yiem Gaa^li^li Saengv.
Yesu nyei youz mbuo mingh jiex Zipv mi'aqv. Yesu nqa'haav mingh mv baac ninh maiv dorng zuangx mingh, kungx bingx jienv mingh hnangv.
Yiem wuov zipv nyei yinh gu'nyuoz, zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh lorz Yesu yaac naaic mienh, “Wuov laanh mienh yiem haaix?”
Yiem wuov jiex zipv nyei zuangx mienh sih sungx sapv nyei gorngv Yesu. Maaih deix gorngv, “Ninh gengh zoux kuv mienh.” Maaih deix gorngv, “Maiv zeiz! Ninh kungx nduov mienh hnangv.”
Mv baac haaix dauh yaac maiv gaamv dorng zuangx gorngv taux Yesu, weic zuqc ninh mbuo gamh nziex haic zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh.
Jiex Zipv taux ndaamv-dingh, Yesu mingh zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv njaaux mienh.
Zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh mbuoqc horngh haic yaac gorngv, “Naaiv laanh mienh maiv duqv doqc sou hlang. Ninh fungc haih ndongc naaic hiuv?”
Yesu ziouc dau ninh mbuo, “Yie njaaux nyei waac se maiv zeiz yie ganh hnamv cuotv daaih njaaux. Se dongh paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh nyei waac.
Haaix dauh dingc hnyouv ei Tin-Hungh nyei eix zoux, wuov dauh ziouc hiuv duqv yie njaaux nyei waac yiem Tin-Hungh daaih fai yie ganh hnamv cuotv daaih njaaux.

Haaix dauh ei ninh ganh nyei za'eix hnamv cuotv daaih njaaux, wuov dauh kungx oix mienh taaih ninh hnangv. Mv baac haaix dauh oix mienh taaih paaiv ninh daaih wuov dauh, ninh kungx gorngv zien waac hnangv. Maiv haih gorngv-baeqc.
Mose bun leiz-latc meih mbuo maiv zeiz? Mv baac meih mbuo yaac maiv maaih yietc dauh gan leiz-latc. Meih mbuo weic haaix diuc lorz qangx daix yie?”
Zuangx mienh gorngv, “Mienv muoqv meih maiv nzang mbor lorh! Maaih haaix dauh oix daix meih laeh?”
Yesu gorngv, “Yie zoux nzunc sic meih mbuo yaac mbuoqc horngh haic.

Mose heuc meih mbuo tengx mienh jiex gaatv nyei leiz. (Mv baac naaiv nyungc leiz maiv zeiz yiem Mose daaih, se yiem meih mbuo nyei ong-taaix-ngaeqv daaih.) Dingh Gong Hnoi meih mbuo yaac tengx mienh jiex gaatv nyei leiz.

Se gorngv meih mbuo doix Dingh Gong Hnoi tengx mienh jiex gaatv nyei leiz weic maiv oix dorngc Mose nyei leiz, wuov nyungc yie longc Dingh Gong Hnoi zorc dauh mienh longx nzengc, meih mbuo weic haaix diuc qiex jiez yie?
Maiv dungx mangc beih zaangc siemv, oix zuqc baengh fim nyei siemv.”
Weic naaiv maaih deix Ye^lu^saa^lem Zingh nyei mienh gorngv, “Ninh mbuo oix daix wuov dauh mienh dongh naaiv dauh saah?
Mangc gaax, ninh dorng zuangx mienh gorngv waac mv baac ninh mbuo maiv gorngv yietc nyungc bun ninh. Zoux hlo nyei mienh za'gengh hiuv dingc ninh zoux Giduc mv bei?
Mv baac naaiv laanh mienh yiem haaix daaih mbuo hiuv nyei. Giduc yiem haaix daaih maiv maaih haaix dauh hiuv. ”

Yesu yiem zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv njaaux mienh wuov zanc ninh longc qiex hlo nyei gorngv, “Meih mbuo za'gengh hiuv duqv yie yaac hiuv yie yiem haaix daaih. Yie maiv zeiz sueih yie ganh nyei eix daaih. Mv baac paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh se zien nyei. Meih mbuo yaac maiv hiuv duqv ninh.
Mv baac yie hiuv duqv ninh nyei, weic zuqc yie yiem ninh wuov daaih, ninh yaac paaiv yie daaih.”
Ninh mbuo ziouc oix zorqv ninh haic aqv, mv baac maiv maaih haaix dauh njiec buoz zorqv weic zuqc ninh nyei ziangh hoc maiv gaengh taux.
Yiem wuov nyei zuangx mienh corc maaih camv nyei sienx ninh. Ninh mbuo gorngv, “Giduc daaih wuov zanc ninh haih zoux duqv mbuoqc horngh nyei jangx-hoc gauh camv naaiv dauh fai?”
Faa^li^si Mienh haiz zuangx mienh sih sungx sapv nyei gorngv Yesu nyei jauv, ninh mbuo caux sai mienh bieiv ziouc paaiv goux zaangc Tin-Hungh nyei biauv nyei baeng mingh zorqv Yesu.
Yesu gorngv, “Yie aengx caux meih mbuo yiem dangh baav hnangv. Nqa'haav ziouc nzuonx taux paaiv yie daaih wuov dauh.
Meih mbuo oix lorz yie yaac lorz maiv buatc, weic zuqc yie mingh yiem nyei dorngx meih mbuo mingh maiv duqv.”

Zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh, laanh naaic laanh, “Aa, naaiv laanh mienh oix mingh haaix mbuo cingx lorz maiv buatc? Ninh oix mingh mbuo Yiutai Mienh nzaanx mingh yiem wuov deix Janx-Gikc nyei zingh njaaux Janx-Gikc fai?
Ninh gorngv mbuo oix lorz ninh yaac lorz maiv buatc, yaac gorngv ninh mingh nyei dorngx mbuo mingh maiv duqv. Naaiv haaix nyungc eix leiz mv bei?”
Zipv nyei nqa'haav laai wuov hnoi, se gauh hlo jiex nyei hnoi, Yesu souv jiez daaih gorngv hlo nyei, “Haaix dauh jaang nqaatv oix zuqc daaih yie naaiv hopv.
Hnangv Ging-Sou fiev jienv gorngv nor, ‘Haaix dauh sienx yie, yungz maengc nyei wuom ziouc yiem wuov dauh nyei hnyouv liouc cuotv daaih hnangv camv-diuh ndaaih nor.’+”

Yesu hnangv naaiv nor gorngv se gorngv taux Singx Lingh, dongh sienx ninh nyei mienh oix duqv zipv. Mv baac wuov zanc Tin-Hungh maiv gaengh bun Singx Lingh mienh, weic zuqc Yesu maiv gaengh duqv njang-laangc.
Zuangx mienh haiz ninh hnangv naaiv nor gorngv, maaih deix ziouc gorngv, “Naaiv dauh za'gengh dongh mbuo zuov wuov dauh Douc Waac Mienh aqv.”
Aengx maaih deix gorngv, “Ninh zoux Giduc aqv.” Mv baac maaih deix gorngv, “Giduc fungc haih yiem Gaa^li^li daaih?
Ging-Sou fiev jienv gorngv, Giduc zoux Ndaawitv Hungh nyei Zeiv-Fun yaac yiem Ndaawitv Hungh nyei buonv-mungv, Mbetc^le^hem, daaih maiv zeiz?”
Weic naaiv mienh ziouc laaix Yesu bun nqoi.
Maaih deix oix zorqv Yesu mv baac maiv maaih haaix dauh njiec buoz zorqv.
Mingh zorqv Yesu wuov deix baeng nzuonx daaih, sai mienh bieiv caux Faa^li^si Mienh naaic ninh mbuo, “Meih mbuo zoux haaix nyungc maiv zorqv jienv ninh daaih?”
Wuov deix baeng dau, “Maiv maaih jiex yietc dauh mienh gorngv waac hnangv naaic dauh.”
Faa^li^si Mienh gorngv, “Meih mbuo yaac zuqc ninh nduov mi'aqv saah?
Maaih haaix dauh zoux hlo nyei Yiutai Mienh fai Faa^li^si Mienh sienx jiex ninh nyei fai?
Maiv maaih lorqc. Mv baac naaiv guanh mienh maiv hiuv duqv Mose nyei Leiz-Latc ziouc zuqc Tin-Hungh zioux ninh mbuo.”
Maaih dauh wuov deix Faa^li^si Mienh, dongh zinh ndaangc mingh lorz Yesu wuov dauh Ni^ko^nde^matv, naaic,
“Ei mbuo nyei leiz, mbuo maiv gaengh haiz mienh gorngv, maiv hiuv duqv ninh nyei gorn-baengx, mbuo haih dingc ninh nyei zuiz fai?”
Ninh mbuo dau, “Wuov nyungc meih yaac yiem Gaa^li^li daaih? Dimv mangc Ging-Sou maah! Meih ziouc hiuv duqv maiv maaih yietc dauh douc waac mienh yiem Gaa^li^li cuotv daaih niaa.”
Jiex zipv nyei wuic nzaanx, gorqv-mienh nzuonx gorqv-mienh nyei biauv.
Mv baac Yesu mingh wuov Ga'lanv Mbong.
